rnal 'byor pa rang nyid lhar mngon par brtags ①la bskyod pas 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor sprin bzhin du spros pas/ phyogs bcur g.yos nas gal te tshig pa de dag bkug nas/ gzugs brnyan de la bstems pa la/ /phur pas yang nas yang du btab la/ rdul gyi dum bur byas la tsha ba'i mar dang tsher ma can gyi dug shing lnga til nag po dang sbyar la/ brgya rtsa brgyad du 'bar ba gtum chen rngam pa'i tshogs me'i nang du spyan drangs pa la dbul lo/ /brgal te/ sems can thams cad rang bzhin kyi dkyil 'khor du ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin can yin na 'o na 'di ltar gdug pa'i las kyis gnod par byed pa 'gal te—/ de ltar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las kyang / sangs rgyas thams cad gsod pa yis/ /ji ltar sdigs kyang mi gos te/ /gal te gos na ji ltar 'bras//zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar yin kyis kyang / ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i rtog pa'i dra bas non pa'i rtog pa de bsgral ba yin pas—/ 'gal ba ma yin no/ /phyi ma gsum la yang las ni de nyid du bas te/bye brag ni dkyil 'khor dang / lha'i sku mdog dang so so'i phur pa khro bo'i lhag ma gsum dang / ji ltar 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyes bye brag tsam du bas so/ /phyi ma ni go sla'o/ /dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las/ lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi byin gyis brlob pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste/ nyi shu pa rdzogs so// //bstod gnas dang bstod bya dang bstod mkhan dbyer med kyis kyang /phyis 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i don du bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs 43—757

bsags pa'i phyir/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis shin tu rngam pa'i gdangs kyis glu 'di blangs so/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas/ nyi shu gcig pa gru ye shes kyi le'u gsungs so/ /de la de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po rdo rje khrag 'thung gi 'khor bud dha te ru ka la sogs pas shin tu rngam pa'i gdangs kyis dpal rdo rje khrag 'thung la bstod pa'i phyir/ gtso bo la bstod pa'i gru blangs so/ /de yang ye shes lnga'i sgo nas bstod pa la/ dang po 'dis ni bud dha te ru ka'i sgo nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su mthong nas bstod pa'o/ /hūṃ zhes pa ni khro bo'i glu yin pas de yang ye shes lnga dang ldan par mkha' 'gro ma'i tan+t+ra las gsungs so/ /gtum chen zhes pa ni gtum po drag po las khyad par gyur pa'o/ /dus mtha'i zhes pa ni 'jig pa'i dus kyi bsam gtan dang po man chad me lce gasbug tu gyur pa'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /me ni byin za'o/ /lhag ma ni go sla'o/ /gnyis pa ni gsung gi dkyil 'khor du'ang mthong nas bstod pa'o/ /tshig gi don ni go sla'o/ /gsum pa ni thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du mthong nas bstod pa/ thugs ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa nas/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor shes rab chen po las byung ba ni 'od chen po yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu gsal zhes te/ de ni phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor la'ang gsal zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /de nyid kyi phyir 'bar ba'i ye shes zhes te/ don bya ba'i gdug pa can dang / des nyen pa'i sems can gyi phyir 'joms zhes bya'o/ /de ltar 'joms par byed pa'i don byed mkhan yang gcig pu gnyis su ma yin te/sna tshogs zhes te/ rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa kho na'o/ /yang khams 43—758

gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje khro bo yang sna tshogs zhes 'byung ngo //ci'i phyir gdul bya sna tshogs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pas ni yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor du'ang mthong nas bstod pa'o/ /kye khro bo'i rgyal po chen po khyod ni/snying rjes brlan pa'i phyir ro/ /ye shes kyi tshogs byang chub kyi sprin las/bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi yon tan rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi khro bo'i dkyil 'khor chen po gsang ba'i bha ga la sogs pa nas/ char chen 'be+ebs pa'i phyir/ci ltar 'tshal ba'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor yid bzhin 'byung ba'i gter yang yin no//de nyid kyi phyir sna tshogs khros pa'i thig le che ho/ /zhes bya'o/ /lnga pa ni 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor du'ang mthong nas bstod pa'o/ /bdud kun zhes pa ni—/ gang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ bdud du grags pa thams cad ci snyed pa de dag thams cad kyi rje bo'i phyir/ bdag chen no/ /de nyid kyi phyir/ bdud kyi bdud ces te/ gang drag po chen po de'i yang bdud du gyur pa'o/ /bdud rnams zhes pas ni bdud sde bzhi'o/ /de yang dbang du byed pa'i phyir 'joms pa'o/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs zhes pa ni/'jigs byed chen po'i skyi bung byed pa'o/ /de dag rlag par byed pa'i phyir 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /de'i phyir mtshan yang 'jigs byed chen po zhes bya'o/ /phyi ma ni yum bzhis yab kyi sku la mnga' ba'i 'byung ba chen po bzhi ni/ bdag cag dang tha mi dad do zhes ched du blangs so zhes pa/ ston pa dang 'khor tha dad pa ma yin na yang / ston pa'i yon tan las ha las pa'i phyir/ de tsam zhig ha chang yang ngo mtshar che zhes nas blangs pa'o/ /de'i phyir 'khor gyis gtso bo la bstod pa'i le'u ste/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //43—759

ston pa dang rgyud dang sdud pa dbyer med kyis kyang / phyis 'byung ba'i le'u la gzhan dag yid ches pa'i dad pa la gzhag pa'i phyir/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos zhes bya ba la sogs pas nyi shu gnyis pa rgyud yongs su gtad pa'i le'u gsungs so/ /de nas zhes pa ni skabs de 'khor rmis ston pa la mchod pa brjod pa'i rjes la'o/ /nyid la nyid ni tha dad pas ma yin no/ /gsang sngags ni tan+t+ra te/ yid mnyam pa nyid du byed pa ste/ de ngan song las bskyob pa'o/ /rgyal po ni rgyal por gyur pa na'o/ /brtan par bzung ba ni de gtod pa'i tshig spangs pa'o/ /kye kye zhes pa ni gzhogs kyis sbran pa ste/nyon cig ces spangs pa'o/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rang bzhin ni rgyud dang dpal kun tu bzang po tha mi dad pas so/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid ces pa'o/ /'o na de ltar yin na/ 'gro ba de bzhin gshegs par ma gyur pa ci zhes pa yod na/ gzung 'dzin zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /'o na theg pa so so'i 'dod gzhung mang po ci'i phyir na/ de ltar yin du zin kyang / sa rnams mang po so so'i bkod pa yang / gsang ba'i snying po dpal kun tu bzang po'i mya ngan 'das par bgrod pa'i lam du gyur pa'o—/ /de'i phyir dpal kun tu bzang pos theg pa so sor bstan kyang /don du mi 'gyur ba ni yod ma gsungs so/ /zhes bya'o/ /da ni dpal gsang ba'i snying po'i rnal 'byor pa la bstod pa gsungs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sku'i phyag rgya gsang chen gsang mchog gi snying po 'di/ rnal 'byor pa gang gis shes rab rnam gsum la brten nas/ don mngon du ma 43—760

nor bar rtogs te/ gzhan la/ smra bar gang byed pa/ de ni dpal kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo yin te/ de la slob dpon gyis mchog gi dbang ma bskur yang ngal te/ 'di ni rang bzhin gyis dbang yang rdzogs zhes bya'o/ /da ①ni rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa ci'i phyir de ltar yin na/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la/ gsang ba 'di las gzhan mi mnga' 'o/ /zhes smos te/ da ni yongs su bstan pa ste/ de yang phyi rabs kyi rnal 'byor pa the tshom gcog pa'i phyir—/ yod med kyi mtha' spangs pa'i sgro dang skur ba zhi ba'i rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po 'di/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i de kho na nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i nges pa'i dbyengs nas phyung nas 'khor ba bstan pa 'di su las phyis 'byung bar lung bstan zhe na/ thugs dang 'dra ba'i sras sa bcu mthar phyin pa ye shes kyi bdag nyid la gnas pa las/ phyis 'byung ba de ltar shes par kyis shig pa'o/ /de yang gtad ces pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ rang bzhin gyi tshig sun pa'i skyon du gyur pas so/ /zhes smos pa ni/ gong du thal ba'i tshig don ci snyed pa'o/ /brjod pas ni ston pas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ces pas ni/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bya na/ 'di 'khor yan chad kun la bya'o/ /ci'i phyir de khyad par dbyer med pa'i 'khor rnams dgyes nas/ dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyan—/ rdo rje'i lhun chos kyi dbyings/ stug po bkod pa'i rgyan nyid du/'khor thams cad kyang bzhugs so/ /'o na de lta bu'i dam pa'i chos 'di phyis su las 'byung bar lung bstan na/ de ni sa rab rig 'dzin la gnas zhes gsungs pas/ gsang ba rdo rje'i lhun phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud la yod par bstan pa 43—761

yin no/ /'o na slad kyis des ci mdzad ce na/ de'i slad kyis rgyud thams cad phyag na rdo rje grub pa'i gnas gsang ri'i nang du gshegs te/ rgyud thams cad bsdus so/ /zhes 'byung bas na/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes gnas der bsdus shing gtan la phab par rig par bya'o/ /de nas yang rgyal po chen po'i khang bzangs rab tu dang ba'i nang du/ gsang ba'i rgyud thams cad char bzhin du phab pa snga ma bzhin no/ /'phags pa rtog pa'i rgyal po/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba le'u stong phrag brgya pa las/ mtshan nyid dang rgyud thams cad kyi lung gi spyi/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba/ gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las/ thams cad ma lus par 'phros te/ 'khor lo bskor ba de dag gi 'bras bu'i mchog /yongs su gtad pa'i le'u ste/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o rdzogs so// //thibs po'i mun nag gis non shin tu gsal bar dka' ba dang / /nyi zer 'od tsam bdag las snang gyur pa/ /bla ma'i drin gyis bdag la snang ba yin/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyigs ma lngar ldan lnga brgya'i ①mthar nye la/ /shākya'i bstan pas 'gro ba dbugs byung ste/ /don mchog bdud rtsi'i ro ni rnyed 'gyur bas/ /bla ma'i drin gyis bdag la'ang gnas pa yin—/ /de la brten nas rnam bshad 'di bgyis pa/ /nor bar gyur pa mchis na bzod par gsol/ /skye bo dam pa'i skyon du ma bkyis te/ /bdag gi sangs rgyas chos la mos pa yi/ /blo ngan rnams kyi don du 'di bkyis te/ /'di la bsod nams gang dam mchis pa ni/ /'gro ba rgya mtshos byang chub mchog thob shog /dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las/ slob dpon 43—762

nyi ma'i seng ge'i 'od kyis mdzad pa'i rgya cher bshad pa'i 'grel pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pra swa ta la/ sgyur byed kyi lo tsa ba pad ma ru tshes gsang ba'i dbang mnos nas bsgyur te/ dge bar shog /ma rig mun sel ye shes nyi ma'i sgon/ /mu stegs klad 'gems smra mchog seng ge des/ /shes rab mchog gi rtsal ni 'od zer 'bar/ /dgos don phyogs bcur 'phro la dad pas bstod/ /ces bya ba ni lo tsha bas bstod pa'o// //bsdur mchan/429 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉tha'i/ 1〈〈pe 〉7so//431 ①〈〈pe 〉7pa/432 ①〈〈pe 〉ra//423 ①〈〈pe 〉7sngon/ ④〈〈pe 〉7du/435 ①〈〈pe 〉7du/436 ①〈〈pe 〉stanam/ ②〈〈pe 〉me / ①〈〈pe 〉sngagasal/ rjo〈〈pe 〉ra tags/437 ①〈〈pe 〉thasang ④〈〈be+e 〉sngag/439 ①〈〈pe 〉8/ ④〈〈pe 〉ṅkan/ ①〈〈pe 〉tharngod/44༷ ①〈〈be+e 〉〉 /441 ①〈〈pe 〉sngating /443 ①〈〈pe 〉modi'i/444 ①〈〈pe 〉shesar/ ④〈〈pe 〉ra phra/ ④〈〈pe 〉mthu/447 ①〈〈pe 〉ra par/ ④〈〈pe 〉stanasal/448 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagasal/449 ①〈〈pe 〉stanas/ ①①〈〈pe 〉stanasal/ rjo〈〈pe〉7)nga /45༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉stod/451 ①〈〈pe 〉ma /457 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈la/ ②〈〈pe 〉stabs/ ①〈〈pe 〉ma mas/458 sde〈〈pe 〉dz+rad pa'i/43—763

༄ga /sgyu 'phrul dra ba rdo rje las kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/①ga sgyu 'phrul dra ba rdo rje las kyi rim pa bzhugs④/ ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du—/ ma ya dza karma badz+ra kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba rdo rje las kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ bdud bzhi la sogs rig pa sdeng gis dag /sku lnga la sogs yon tan lhun grub kyang / /rang gi ngo bo 'di 'dra bstan du med/ /rang bzhin mngon byas ma lus re ba skong / /sku gsum ma byas mi phye mtha' rnams dag /rang rig kun gsal bdag phyir rnam rtog bral/ /dus gsum mi 'gyur rgya mtsho che las sgol/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems la 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /rang bzhin kun rdzogs khong gsal rkyen bcas rtogs gsum rbas/ /log gsum gnyis snang phan tshun rgyu 'bras nyams pa med/ /kun mkhyen rang bzhin gsal byed gsum las lta ba sogs mang po/ /gang la'ang gang yang rgyas dang 'brel men ra chod lung rigs 'brel/ /dgos phyir rgyud rigs ston pa rdo rje'i thugs 43—770

la gnas lung bstan/ /gnyis gzhol gnyis rmongs don phyir gsal byed rdo rje las rim dbye/ /rnal 'byor theg mchog sangs rgyas chos kun lam dang 'bras bu thugs chud don/ /rin chen rgya mtsho'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud chen po/ /shes bya'i dngos po ma lus las/ /gzhi rtsa'i dkyil 'khor dbang gi don/ /dngos po gsal byed mdor bsdus ming / /rang bzhin ye shes rdo rje ni/ /mtha' bral mi phyed rdo rje dang / /rkyen dang bral phyir 'jigs med paske/ /shes thob rtags ming ngo bo phyir/ /rdo rje las rim gnyis su bsdus/ /'di dag 'brel pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol 'jug sgo skyen/ /nang rgyu rten bcas ngo bo'i phyir/ /'brel pa rgyu 'bras thabs su bshad/ /lus kyi dngos nyid dang po nyid/ /dkyil 'khor don ni gnyis yin te/ /rnam grangs ming nges tshig tu bshad/ /rang bzhin la sogs dngos po bdun/ /rnam pa'i yan lag bcas pa dang / /skabs ming sgyu 'phrul thugs rje bsogs/ /gzhung rgyas tshig gis 'jigs phyir dang / /lung las gsal bas 'dir bris byas//skabs kyis lhag gnyis byang sems gsum/ /ting 'dzin lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor ni—/ /bdag nyid las kun byed dkyil 'khor/ /rab gnas kun la 'jug pa ste/ /mtshan nyid yan lag rim pa rnams/ /gzhan las rgyas par shes par bya—/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis su rnam dbye ba/ /sa gzhi mnyam dang chad thig dang / /tshon dang bri ba'i rnam pa dang / /rab gnas sbyin sreg 'jug pa dang / /yon tan rnam bcu rgyas shes bya/ /gzhi dang rang mtshan blang dbang dang / /sbyang sbyin bsrung dang bzung ba ni/ /dang po'i nying lag nyid du bshad/ /zur brgyad la sogs rtse mang dang / /chu bo bzhin du ma po zhing / /mnyam zhing log 43—771

pa'i chu ltar dang / /nyi ma shin tu gnas pa ni/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /mtho dang 'dud pa nub byang yin/ /shar lho bshol zhing 'jam pa la/tho sgro drog tho chu sna tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor dbang sgra mtshams rtags bya/ /lhun sdug ri bo nagaṭasdo tshal ldan/ /rab tu mnyam zhing snum bag ldan/ /chu bo dbang gi phyogs yin te/ /chung zad tsam gyis rlung nyung zhing / /me tog shing tshal bya skad rtag /lo rgyus shis pa'ang mchog tu gsungs/ /①bdag nyid rtags shing nyams dga' dang / /bsam gtan sgra las ring gyur pa/ /khang khyem la sogs de bzhin te/ /nan tan nus mthu ldan phyir yin/ /mtshan nyid sbyang ba phyogs gsum ste/ /thad ka so le lta bu dang / /rma dang po ba'i mtshan nyid dang / /tsha rko zug sngo rus sbal dang / /ram pa thal ba shing sol dang / /gyo mog rus pa gsong la sogs/ /rgo kro ta dang pa la sha /u rdu ba ra a shat+tha/ /abyu la sogs pa'i tshul/ /'dod pa ma yin sbyang sbo bya/ /bkra shis gtsang ma me tog shing / /gnag dang kha dog ldan pa dang / /rtsibs ma sgyus ma rab nyung zhing / /lhag par gyur pa mchog tu bshad/ /shin tu'ang brtags pa'i sa dbus su/ /dkyil 'khor lci ba'i dris byugs las/ /mnyam zhing glang ko ⑪ tsam byas la/ /ga bur tsan dan ldan byas la/ /sngags mkhan zhi ba'i chas ldan la/ /phyag rgyas legs 'khyud bde bar 'dug /bdag nyid mi 'chi'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mchod ①ting 'dzin ye shes brlab/ /lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal byas la/ /lugs su mchongs sogs legs par sbyar/ /sa gzhi lam las gser mdog can/ /bum pa rin chen gang ba dang / /phyag rgya ston pa mchod sbyin yin/ /lha mo spyan gyis rang bzhin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyis 43—772

bstan par bya/ /rang snying snang mdzad phyag rgyas bdag /tshigs bshad ting 'dzin ldan pa yis/ /bos te phyag rgyas gnyis med bya/ /mchod pa bdud rtsi glu gar gyis/ /rgyas mchod 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ /gtor ma bza' btung me tog ldan/ /de bzhin rin chen ldan pa'i chang / /'dod yon bdud rtsi byin brlabs la/ /zhing skyong rnams la rgyas par sbyin/ /nam mkhar bzhugs te sa dbang rnams/ /tshom byas bgo ba drag byas la/ /sangs rgyas byin brlabs rab bsdus te/ /mi zad shin tu 'jigs pa yi/ /zhe sdang rdo rje spyan 'bar ba/ /rkang mthil thugs la mthing nag hūṃ/ /gsang sngags rdo rje gom par bcas/ /khro bo yungs kar phyogs bcur spro/ /'og dang phyogs mtshams rgya gram gur/ /'bar ba'i me yis phyogs mtshams bskor/ /rang gi gnas su brjid bag gis/ /'dug ste rin chen blang bar bya/ /phyag rgya tri shul gnyis gnas te/ /ji ltar ches brjod rdo rje yis/ /dpung bzhi bdud kyi sde btul ①nas/ /rgyal srid chos kyi spung rtsugs pa/ /de bzhin du ni bdag gis kyang / /nges par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /sa'i dngos grub sprul du gsol—/ /oṃ rat+na mas tshang tsang se ti ku ru sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bsam gtan ldan par lan gsum bya/ /oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha ni hūṃ/ grisna grisna hūṃ/ griṭ+wā ④pa ya hūṃ/ā na ya ho/ bha ga bān/ badz+ra rā dzā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lha mo rang bzhin gnyis med phyir/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis 'od khyab pas/ /thams cad rin chen ngo bo ste/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du/ /brtan byas dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur—/ /dngos grub dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ /zangs sogs phur bu zla gam la—/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i dbang mchog khro/ /rā ga'i mdog 'dra zla gam rtse/ /43—773

pad+ma'i zhags pas phur 'dril zhing / /sdang mig phyag bzhi nges bsams te/ /sku gsung byin brlab dbus su sbyar/ /'od kyis thams cad bsdus byas la /bdag gir gyur pa'i sa dag ni/ /las thams cad la shes par 'gyur/ /dbang du sa gzhi grub pa'i mchog /sbyang ba las me sngags phyag rgya/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis dag par 'gyur/ /lto 'phye'i dus tshod gzhan shes bya/ /ma nor phyogs nas las rnams rtsam/ /rgya spangs khru gang bzhi'i dbus/ /bshad pa'i mtshan nyid bzhin du'ang rtag /chus bkang gom pa brgya bor bya/ /bzang dang bkra shis rin chen sa/ /'bru sna bcas gzhug 'thas par brdung / /tshad dang mnyam pa'i rgyas byas la/ /'jim pa ba spus mnyam par bya/ /nas sran gro 'bras til dkar po/ /rang bzhin sku lnga thob phyir dang / /dag pa phung po lnga ru shes/ /gur gum ga bur tsan dan gnyis/ /dran 'di dag gi dri 'di dag /'phrin las yul gyi rang bzhin te/ /thob phyir nges par tshad par sbyar//byu ru mu tig gser dngul dang / /rin po che ni 'byung ba'i dngos/ /zhi sogs yon tan thob phyir sbyar/ /lan tshwa sbrang rtsi bu ram mar/ /a 'bras la sogs 'bru sna lnga/ /rnam shes ye shes rang bzhin te/ /nges pa nyid du bzung bar bya/ /ha sa de ba bri ha ti/ /sweng tang ①kan dha ki ra dang / /a 'bras rtsi te sman gyi mchog /dbang po dag dang bsung gi tshogs/ /nyi zla chu dang ser bcas nas/ /rnam pa lnga'i rma sa ni/ /khams kyi rang bzhin rigs lnga ste/ /sum cus rab mnyam skam par bya/ /kun nas mtshan ma ngan 'gyur na/ /gzhan du sgrod dam zhi ba'i/ /me yis rab tu dag par 'gyur/ /'bring gyur lag g.yas mthil sor la/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga hūṃ lnga thim/ /rtse lnga rdo rje hūṃ bcas 43—774

bsam / /sngags kyis lan gsum sa la skul/ /'od kyis ma lus sbyang bar bya//oṃ badz+ra ha na ha na kro ta hūṃ phaṭa/ thams cad dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis sbyang zhes bya/ /thams cad rang sems rnam pa'i phyir/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur rang bzhin gnas/ /'khrul snang sa dang sa 'dzin no/ /'khrul chos chos can la gnas phyir/ /dag par ltas na mtshan nyid med/ /rjes su skul bar byed pa'i sngags/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā snyo na badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko haṃ/ rang rig stong pa'i ye shes la/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis med phyir/ /spyod yul yongs su dag par bya/ /rang rig skad cig hūṃ bsams te/ /ye shes snying po hūṃ nyid las/ /rtse lnga rdo rje hūṃ bcas pa/ /hūṃ gyur nam mkha' e gzugs can/ /thams cad kun gyi gzhir gnas pa'o/ /dran bskyod rlung ni yo sngon po/ /sa bon chu ste baṃ kar bshad/ /ma lus gzhi ste gser mdog la/ /skad cig sgra med dmar ser ram̐/ /ma nges kun gzhi sna tshogs bye/ /rgyas dang 'bring po la sogs pa'i/ /sna tshogs gdan ldan rin chen khang / /ji ltar gyur pa bzhin du bsgom/ /gdan sogs gzhung gi gnas de ru/ /dbang phyug rgyas pa'i cha lugs la/ /rdo rje 'gros kyis phyogs ltas 'dug /thabs shes phyogs lta sbyor ba las/ /'khor rnams rgyas par sbyar bar bya/ /bzhi bcu lnga sogs dus gsum pa/ /yid kyis nam mkha' gang bar dmigs / /rnam pa gsum gyi mchod pa dbul/ /rigs dang mthun sgom phyag rgya bzhi/ /spyan la sogs pas sbyor stims te/ /mchod dang thal mo mnyam sbyar nas / /dkyil 'khor byin brlabs skul bar bya/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs sgogs pa/ rang gi mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil/ /ye shes bzhi spro 43—775

'khor lo'i tshul/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol/ /phyogs bcu ma lus dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol/ /che ge mo sogs don gyi phyir/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bdag bgyid pas/ /bdag cag rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /sa 'di shis par byin gyis rlobs①/ /bde bar gshegs pas mdzad du gsol/ /rdor dril 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis bskul/ /sku gsung thugs byin brlabs hūṃ bsdus/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i tshul bzung la/ /'bar ba'i spyan sogs bshad bzhin bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyi ma dang / /chos dang rta mchog snang mdzad dang / /bdag nyid chen po'i ngang nyid yin/ /thams cad bka' las ding ma 'da'/ /gsang sngags ting 'dzin las sngon bzhin—/ /rang gi gnas su brtan byas la/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i rtsibs brgyad la/ /nyi stengs gsum las lha rnams gnan/ /hūṃ bcu thugs las nges phyung dgod/ /oṃ dang badzā tī la yā/ /rang sngags las dang bcas pa ni/ /rnam rgyal la sogs rim par sbyar/ /mtshon cha lnga'i rim pa 'ang nges par gzhung bzhin bya ba yin/ /gang yang bar chad skabs med pa/ /srung ba'i mchog tu de gsungs so/ /de nas phyogs mtshams legs brtags te/ /dam tshig ye shes thig gnyis dor/ /tshad zhing 'khrul pa med pa na/ /byang chub mchog tu nyi zla shar/ /de nyid bzhugs gnas yin gsungs pas/ /rdo rje'am gzhan gyi thig le ni/ /dkyil 'khor cha las 'gyur med bya/ /rang sngags nyi zla hūṃ bcas la/ /bsam gtan ldan par bya ba yin/ /mi bskyod ting 'dzin sbyor ba'i mkha'/ /sku gsung dkyil 'khor las byung ba'i/ /lha rnams phyi rol khyab par bya/ /drang bstem yan lag ldan pa la/ /rnam gsum mchod pa rgyas 43—776

par bya/ /sgra dang ldan pas 1nges bstod de/ /mgon po kun mkhyen bdag nyid can/ gcig 2dang du ma yongs bral phyir/ /ma lus bdag nyid dgongs su gsol/ /khyed la mos shing mchod pa dang / /khams gsum yongs su bzung bya zhing / /rang bzhin mnyam par sbyar ba'i phyir/ /che ge mo dag dkyil 'khor gyi//las rnams yongs su rdzogs par bgyid/ /thugs rjes nye bar dgongs mdzad de//dkyil 'khor byen gyis brlabs nas ni/ /sa gzhi yongs su bzung bar mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya satwa s+t+waṃ/ nges brjod rol pa'i gzi brjid kyis/ /thams cad dkyil 'khor rang bzhin du/ /gsal byas yongs su bzung bar bya'o/ /thams cad rang sems mnyam spyor bas/ /sa gzhi can yang de bzhin bsgrub/ /'di ltar gang gi gsal 'gyur ba/ /sa gzhi rab tu mnyam zhes bya'o/ /tshad ni rkyen gyis ma nges te/ /mchog dang mchog dang mchog gis bzhi/ /slob dpon mthar nye'i lam gnas pas/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gsum 'phro zhing / /sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor sogs/ /rdo rje'i thig tshad dor tsam gyis/ /rgyang grags la sogs mtshan ma yi/ /dkyil 'khor phyag rgyar gsal ldan pa/ /ting 'dzin lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /dag pa'i las kyang de bzhin te/ /'dod pa'i las su'ang mthun par sbyin/ /khru tshad nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor lnga rnams dang / /bar khyams bcas dang khro bo dang / /mos dang sbyor bas rnam par phye'o/ /drug dang brgyad gnyis ldan pa la/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rnam par brgyan/ /mtha' ma'i gong du shes par bya/ /brgyad dang bzhi la nges par ni/ /stangs sbyal gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /phyag rgya dgu gnyis mtshan mas gdab/ /gang 'dod de ni phyir bar bya/ /shin tu phra ba 73—777

gzhan dkyil 'khor/ /gtso bo thugs te rigs ldan pa/ /rnam pa'ang rim pa'i skabs su bshad/ /pad+ma'i rgyu la kha dog sgyur/ /bcu drug phyag rgyas legs brtags pa/ /rnal ma cig dang lnga lnga ldan/ /ye shes rang bzhin shes par bya/ /kha dog sum ldan rnal ma dgu/ /ras bal las brtags sku gsung thugs/ /gtsang ma'i snod du legs bkod de/ /nyi ma zla ba'i gdan dag la/ /thugs las ye shes 'bru grangs bzhin/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi mdun grangs te/ /mchod sbyar gsol ba gdab par bya/ /sbyor ba'i ye shes grangs mnyam dang / /rdo rje gsum byin nges par bstem/ /dngos po rang bzhin mnyam byas nas/ /cung zad mchod pa rtag par bya/ /phyogs mtshams legs par phye nas ni/ /so so'i tshad bzhin rgyas par dgye/ /mchog gi thig bran bzhi bcu bzhi/ /legs par kha dog phye yang rung / /rta babs brgyad po cha mnyam zhing / /'khor lo la sogs nyis 'gyur yin/ /rdo rje lag chu har bcas pa/ /rta babs phyed dang gsum du dbye/ /mtshan nyid rgyan gyis brgyan pa yi/ /grogs gsal ldan nam byin rlabs ①la/ /gnyis med ye shes thig gdab bya/ /ye shes dam tshig la mnyam bstem/ /kha dog dbyengs dang ldan pa 'am/ /pho brang nyams dgar sgom par bya/ /oṃ sarba sho ta ni hūṃ phaṭa/ /sku gsung thugs dang thig thams cad—/ /'khrul pa dag pas gdab par bya/ /'da' ba med pa'i dam tshig yin—/ /oṃ badz+ra su tra sa ma ya ma tri ga tra ma hūṃ phaṭa/ ye shes rdo rjes mdor bsdus lnga/ /dam tshig rjes su rim gsal dbye/ /ye shes skud pa'i sngags mtshan nyid/ /skud pa chad pas slob dpon 'chi/ /phyogs 'khrul pas ni gnyis ka nyams/ /rgyun chad lam la gnod par 'gyur/ /de phyir mkhas ldan 43—778

sgrims te bya/ /kun tu rgyas par gyur pa dang / /ting 'dzin ldan pas ye shes la—/ /ye shes thim par des mchod de/ /dam tshig phyag rgya mu yis gshegs/ /de nas gang yang nyes pa med/ /rab gnas ldan pa'i thig 'gongs na/ /bde gshegs sku la btab dang mtshungs/ /sangs rgyas chos las ring 'gyur phyir/ /tri'i sgra'i phyag rgyas 'dzul bar bya/ /rin chen lnga las byas pa'i tshon/ /in tra nī la zla 'od bzang / /spu sha ra ga bya ru bzang / /ma ra ga ta las byas dge//de bzhin 'byor pa gzhan dag bsdu/ /mtshams sems khro bo la sogs phyir/ /kha dog nyi shu rtsa lngar ldan/ /snod rims ma 'dres dag byas la/ /hūṃ sogs yig 'bru cig kyang lnga/ /kha dog rjes su 'thun byas te/ /yongs gyur nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lha/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan par sgom/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las ye shes lnga/ /stems pas yongs gyur dngos po lnga/ /sku gsung yon tan 'phrin las thugs/ /ye shes rgyu las grub pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas su brtag par bya/ /chos rnams bdag sems rtogs byas nas/ /byang chub sems nyid dag pa'i phyir/ /shin tu dgar ba'i mdog tu bstan/ /de rtogs bya phyir dag pa'i mdog /chos rnams sems su sngon chags pa/ /pad+ma rā ga zhes brjod do/ /chags dang chags par bya ba med//chags med phyir na dmar po'o/ /yon tan gter ldan zad mi shes/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas yin te/ /dbyings nyid mi zad gter gyur pas/ /kha dog gser gyi mdog tu bstan/ /'khrul snang phyin ci log rnams la/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dbyings sdud las rnams rdzogs mdzad pas/ /kun tu las kun ljang gu'i mdog /de bzhin nyid kyis dbyings nyid la/ /43—779

cis kyang mi tshugs bcos su med/ /kha dog nag po'i dngos dang bzhin/ /de nyid mtshon phyir mthing gar bstan/ /ma mthong rmongs la ye shes sogs/ /bstan phyir tshon lnga dgye bar bya/ /sman pa rnams la lnga'i phyir/ /rigs kyi ye shes lngar shes bya/ /oṃ a sarba pa tsa rat+na sa ma ya hūṃ hūṃ/ 'bru bcu zung ldan sor mo lngas/ /sru zhing snun pa ltar byas la/ /rdul tshon sbyang ba'i sngags phyag rgyasaske/ /bag med gyur pa'i mnyes pa yang / /bshad pa'i rjes su shes ①par bya—/ /de dag bri ba'i cho ga ni/ /chas ldan dbang phyug thig bteg la/ /dang por dbang ldan phyogs nas bskor/ /de nas zhal dbang thob pa rnams/ /'bru ldan rdo rje thal khu tshur/ /phyag rgya ting 'dzin ldan par bri/ /lte ba rtsibs dang ldan bzhi la/ /rtsibs bzhi 'khor lo mu khyud bcas/ /kha dog so sor sgram par bya/ /gru chad bzhi dang gru bzhi'i/ /bar khyams sgo khyud ldan par bya/ /'khor lo gcig gis yongs rdzogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis la rtag par bya/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba'i rim pa gnyis/ /kun la nges par sbyar bar bya/ /ye shes rin chen rim brtsegs 1tshul/ /thams cad sems phyir chad pa med/ /rdo rje nor bus mdzes pa yi/ /ka ba phyag rgya'i gdung bzhir sbyar/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga/ /bar snang khams su khrigs par bya/ /zhabs dang pad+ma'i rin chen snod/ /gnam 'phyong las byung za ra tshags/ /chu 'phyang shar bu bya khyung dag /rim bzhin kha dog mdzes par bya/ /rin chen ldan pa'i dpag bsam shing / /rtsa ba la sogs rnam phye ba/ /phyi rol yongs su khyab par bya / /'khor gyi gtso bos yongs bskur ba'i/ /mchog gsum la sogs rnam mang ba'i/ /brgyan dang mchod par ldan pa bri/ /rnga yab lhab lhub 'phreng ba 43—780

yis—/ /nges par phyogs bcur 'khrigs par bya/ /rdo rje me ra'i lag chu ha/ /thams cad kun tu khyab par sbyar/ /dbang phyug chas ldan bsam gtan bya/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum dag tu/ /gzhung nyid kyis ni gsal bar gsungs/ /yan lag brgyan rdzogs gzugs sku nyid/ /nyi zla pad+ma rim bzhugs lapa/ /dkyil 'khor sku'i mtshan nyid yin/ /phyag rgya gsal bkod thugs dkyil 'khor//tha sogs yang na hūṃ sum̐ ni/ /mchod dang bri sogs phye ba ste/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du shes par bya/ /rigs kyi dbye ba gzhung gzhan 'gyur/ /rang sngags tishā badz+ra ldan/ /gang yang rdzogs par ting 'dzin bya/ /mchog la sogs pa khro bo'i tshogs/ /rdzogs dang rgyang dang phye nyid ni/ /tha ma'i dus su hūṃ nyid ni//dza la sogs pa chung ngu'i yum/ /gang yang kha dog mtshan mar ldan/ /mkhas pas rab tu sgrim par bya/ /rab gnas yugs ni gsum yin te/ /bum pa rin chen las byas pa/ /lto dang mgrin par ldan pa ni/ /zha grum la sogs skyon spangs pa/ /kha dog ldan pa'i ras kyis gri/ /sna tshogs ljang gu rdo rje ldan//bdud rtsi la sogs bcud ldan pa/ /mi 'chi thabs sbyor rang gnas kyis/ /ye shes rdo rje'i chu dag ni/ /thams cad las la 'jug par bya/ /gzhan yang yab yum 'brel pa'i rgya/ /nges par gdan dang ldan par bya/ /bdag nyid las kyi lhar zhugs pa/ /so so gang yin bskyed ④drangs sbyang / /yan lag rdzogs nas mchod sbyar la/ /rang sngags zhal skor zlas pa bya/ /nges par khro tshogs byin ldan pa'i/ /yongs gyur byang sems ye shes rtsi/ /dbang bskur ba'i mchog tu gsungs/ /lha dbang la sogs sprul pa rnams/ /rang bzhin 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku/ /nges par 'od du gyur pa yin/ /thams cad las ni 43—781

bdag phyogs te/ /gzhan ni rang gi phyogs su'o/ /dbus kyang phyogs kyi dang por bshad/ /gnyis pa slob bur shes par bya/ /dgos pa'i yo byad rab bsogs la/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor las rim sbyar/ /khrus byas dri dang ldan pa'i bu/ /nges par gnas su thal sbyar nas/ /sprad de sems lnga bskyed par bya//de la lan du sbyin bya ba/ /e ma'o bde gshegs snying po las/ /rang gi rnam rtog las kyi ①sprul/ /sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang / /gnas dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ /bdag dang bdag gir so sor 'dzin/ /sus kyang ma bcings bcings med de/ /bcings par bya ba yod ma yin/ /bcings med rnam par grol med de/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos/ /khyod la rab tu bstan par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor don dang yon tan rnams/ /gsal byas rab tu spro ba bskyed/ /rdo rje nges drangs hūṃ 'od zer/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab gnas bya/ /de bzhin yan lag ldan pa la/ /rdo rje'i go chas khyab par sbyar—/ /so shing ku sha srung skud chu/ /byin la las sbyar mtshan ma rtag /gang zhig ngan par gyur pa la/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin sbyor byas te/ /mche ba'i phyag rgyas bsrung bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro ta sa ma ya rda tai hūṃ phaṭa/ bar chod kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /thams cad thams cad de bzhin pas/ /drag po me yis zlog par bya/ /las rjes shis par brjod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs gang byas pa/ /rab gnas ye shes mi ldan rnams/ /sog dang bri ba'i nus pa med/ /de bzhin mkhas zhes rab sgrims te/ /bcos bu'i ras ni sna tshogs dang / /brgyan 'phreng la sogs bro bas bskor/ /bum chu cung zad dbus bsdus la/ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg shar du sbyar/ /mchod pa'i rgyan rnams rgyas 43—782

par dgram/ /ba'i rnam lnga legs byugs la/ /tsan dan dkar dmar u rdu bar—/ /n+ya gro dha dang bar ba ti'i/ /shing shun phye mas phyi bar bya/ /de dag la sogs bum chu rnams/ /dngos men gzugs brnyan las shes bya/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor legs mchod la/ /stong nyid ye shes gsang sngags kyis/ /sku gsung thugs sogs chos thams cad/ /gang yang mi gnas mi dmigs par/ /mig yor tshul du sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' sgom/ /e sogs 'bras bu hūṃ nyid las/ /dkyil 'khor gdan dang ldan par bya/ /rnam pa'i dkyil 'khor rjes dag tu/ /yab yum las byung dngos po gsum/ /rjes su 'thun par gnyis skyed la/ /yi ge'am gdan sngags phyag rgya la/ /sku gsung thugs ldan byin gyis brlab/ /ye shes gsal stems gzi brjid bskyed/ /rang gi bum pa'am cig shos kyis/ /dbang bskur dbu rgyan ldan par bya/ /don lam ye shes lnga 'bras bu/ /bu dang sems can thams cad yin/ /rin chen las byas dbu rgyan sogs/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan lnga dbul bar bya/ /rin chen 'phreng ba dbu rgyan dang / /gdub bu do shal sku rags dag /'byor pa'i dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /gnyis med rgyan du bzhes su gsol/ /rjes mthun (na lam longs spyod sku/ /cod pan thabs dang shes rab kyis/ /gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ /ting 'dzin 0na lam ldan par bya/ /thur ma snyan gzhar rmang tsher dang / /chan pa gser byas tshems shing dngos/ /dang po skyon bsal spu byegs la/ /shākya'i dbang po las la sbyar/ /mngon shes gnyis dang shangs dag ni/ /sems kyis rnam grangs de bzhin te/ /rtsi yis chos kyi ro byong zhing / /ma 'dres ston pa'i mchog 'gyur ro/ /shin tu mnyam 43—783

gzhag thob pa dang / /dus gsum zug rngu dag 'gyur sra/ /shin tu mdzes par gyur pa las/ /seng sogs gdan rnams dbul ba dang / /nan tan gus pas phyag bya'o/ /sa pa la sogs ma lus pa'i/ /phyag gnas 0na pa sngon bzhin bya/ /dug sogs rin chen snod ldan pa'i/ /chu gtsang la sogs sku khrus gsol—/ /thugs rje lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas gzugs sku la/ /sri zhu gus phyir ras kyis sku phyis pas/ /las dang nyon mongs bag chags kun bsal nas/ /spyod lam rnam par dag pa'i sgo thob shog /yon tan lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas sku gzugs la/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i me tog dor byas pas/ /log lta'i nyon mongs tha ba kun bral te/ /lta bas mi ngoms mdzes pa'i sku thob shog /mchog tu rnam par dag pa'i sku mnga' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas sku la gdugs mchog 'di phul bas/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i nyes skyon kun bral nas/ /ye shes thugs rjes ma lus skyob par shog /rang rig thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la/ /mun pa snang byed mar me 'di bltams pas/ /ma rig ①'thibs pa'i mun pa kun bsal nas/ /sangs rgyas la sogs spyan lnga thob par shog /snyigs ma lnga nyid 'bras bu yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sku la dri chab 'di phul bas/ /gdung ba zug rngu mya ngan kun bral nas/ /'od zer mtha' yas 'gyed pa'i sku thob shog/dug lnga ma spangs sku lngar rnam dag pa'i/ /bde chen sku la dam rdzas 'di phul bas//kun tu bzang po'i spyod lam yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /kun nas yongs su smin pa'i sku thob shog /chos rnams longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i sku la gtor ma 'di phul bas/ /rdzas su spyod pa'i gdung ba kun bral nas/ /gsang ba'i longs spyod yongs su rdzogs par shog /ye shes spyod yul yongs su dag 43—784

pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i sku la mchod pa 'di phul bas/ /khams gsum dug gsum rtsad nas dag 'gyur te/ /sku gsum lhun grub zhing khams dag par shog /thabs dang shes rab 'du 'bral med pa yi/ /bde chen sku la 'ga' na 'di phul bas / /spyod yul byang chub sems su rnam dag nas/ /mtha' yas snyoms par 'jug pa thob par shog /mtha' yas ldan dang bral ba med pa'o/ /gnyis med sku la 'dod yon lnga phul bas/ /mtha' la zhen pa'i gdung ba kun bral nas/ /bde ba chen po'i thabs rnams rdzogs par shog /gzi brjid khyad par 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bla re la sogs lhab lhub phul byas pas / /log par lta ba rnams dang yongs bral nas/ /'bar ba'i rgyal po thub med 'grub par shog /byams mgon sku la stoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rin chen ldan pa'i na bza' 'di phul bas/ /thabs rgyags pa'i spyod lam kun bral te/ /gzi brjid khyad par 'phags pa'i sgu thob shog /gling bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rin chen ldan/ /dpag bsam shing dang rdzing bu mdzes/ /sa gzhi khang par byin brlabs pa/ /lha dang lha mo me long ldan/ /lhag pa'i ting 'dzin mchod par bya/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun zhing dag pa'i/ /smon lam rjes su gdab par bya/ /bu dang chung ma yul khams dang / /bran dang bzhon pa de bzhin te/ /sems dang rdzas kyi 'khor gsum po/ /yongs su dag par bya ba ni/ /tshogs kyi mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /'dod yon lnga sogs mchod pa dag /mkhas pas gnas su stobs par bya/ /glu dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa dang / /gar thabs rol mo nges par sbyar/ /bden pa'i mthu yis bskul byas la/ /'dod pa yongs su ma rdzogs par/ /nam yang bstan par bya ba min//43—785

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bañcit+ta shra badz+ra/ sa la sogs la phyag rgyar byas/ /rnam grol rim pa thob gyur na/ /dag pa'i ye shes kyis sbyangs nas/ /smos ci dgos te de nyid yin/ /mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po dag /ye shes bdud rtsi byin rlabs nas/ /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la dbul/ /zhing gyur mchog dang mchog bran rnams/ /'dab bzhi la gnas sa bon drug /nyi zla'i steng du mkhas pas bzhag /ye shes lnga 'am gsum gyis sbyar/ /khro bor gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ /'bru lnga lag gi 'od 'phros pas/ /mi shigs thig le hūṃ dkar po/ /rdo rje'i lam byung mkha' dbyings bzhag /dbang skur sbyor ba'i cho ga yin/ /dpe byad mtshan rdzogs sku nyid la/ /gtsug tu rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs / /zla rlung spyor bas 'og min du/ /rgyal ba'i sras su dbang bskur nas / /dus gsum mchod pa chen por sbyar/ /de ltar rgyal ba kun byas kyang / /bsgral ba'i dngos po gang yang med/ /phung po lnga po bshig pa la/ /gzugs ni 'byung ba'i bag la zha/ /ma zhig na yang 'byung ba yin/ /rnam shes med pas bsang byas kyang / /gnas pa nyid na dngos med pas/ /sems kyi rang bzhin de la ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dgrar langs kyang / /sus kyang zin cing sod pa med/ /'o na thugs rjes gang bsgral na/ /phyin ci log las zlog byas nas/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /shin tu goms pas dbang bsgur te/ /byang chub zhing la dgod par bya/ /de rtsam la ni sgral zhes gdags//lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /dbye ba'am 1yang na mi dbye bar/ /rang rig shes rab byin rlabs 2la/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor kun bkod de/ /bdag nyid rig pa'i lhar bsgoms la/ /gnyis su med par ldan par bya/ /43—786

yum kyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus la/ /dgyes mnyam mchog gi sbyin pas bstem/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor mnyes pa dang / /'gro ba ma lus bde thob nas/ /slar yang gnyis med dbyings su bstem/ /chags med tshul kyis rol par bya// /de ni tshangs mchog rgyal po yin/ /sbyin sreg rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /sa dang rab gnas rnam gnyis dang / /bde ba sbyin pa'i dus nyid du/ /dbyibs dang kha dog mtshan ldan pa'i/ /lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi ru/ /zhal du gyur pa'i me bos la/ /las bzhi mchod pa rab tu sbyin/ /mchog tshogs rnam bzhi ltar grangs bzhin/ /skabs bzhin rgyas par mchod par bya/ /de nas lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'jug pa'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /dbang phyug 'jug dang bzod par gsol/ /khrus dag dri dang lus dbul dang / /bgegs skrad lhar slob dam tshig sbyin/ /de nyid dpog dang chu nam bya/ /bsgrag dang rin chen dor ba dang / /lha dbab pa dang nan tan dang / /mig dbye dkyil 'khor legs bstan dang / /tshogs mchog yon tan rnam bco brgyad/ /'di yis yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur/ /gyas 1pa'i mchod pa legs sbyar nas/ /dbang gos ldan pas dbang phyug yin/ /gzhan dag gzhan gyis mdzes par bya/ /shar sgor 'dug ste dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha rnams mngon byas rin chen ldan/ /'bru lnga rdo rje dam tshig gis/ /sngags kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /'phrin las ye shes gnyis med sbyar/ /oṃ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las smad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam spyor 2bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ skul ba'i 43—787

dam tshig rjes dran pa'i/ /'od zer gzi brjid ldan par bya/ /rang bzhin gnyis med gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /pho brang snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /bzod pa mdzad de dgongs su gsol/ /'dzum bcas snang ba thob par bya/ /shin tu bzang po 'dra bo rnams/ /dri'i chu yis dgag par bya / /snyim pa me tog ldan par bya/ /ras sogs dmar po'i gdong yogs la//bu khyod ci la dga' zhes dri/ /skal 1bzang dag gis lan slan pa/ /'khor lo'i drung du dkri bar bya/ /thal sbyar gus dang bcas pa yis/ /phyogs bcu'i sras dang bcas pa la/ /dbang phyug sangs rgyas dag ltar bdag /ma 'ongs rang bzhin sems can la/ /dgos pa gsum phyir lus dbul bya/ /mchog gi yon sbyin snod du 'gyur/ /tshe srung spyor ba'i khro tshogs kyis/ /bar chod nges bskrad mtshams gcad la/ /sgrib sbyang rnam shes cho ga yis/ /hūṃ las sems dpa' 'am gzhan yang rung / /mtshan ma rdzogs pa'i bsam gtan bya/ /dam tshig chen po bdud rtsi lnga/ /rang bzhin 'bru 2gsum sku gsung thugs/ /gzi brjid ldan pa'i byin rlabs la/ /dam tshig sdom pa mchog ces bya/ /snying gar rdo rje bstan byas la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'di/ /dam nyams ma 'dres med pa la/ /nam yang smra bar ma byed byug /theg pa chen po ston byed pa / /rang la snyas dang smad mi rung / /sku gsung thugs la rtag gnas shing / /ma lus sems can don kyis shig /tsan+dan dkar dmar sbyar byas la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rab gnas bya/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /rdo rje khro bo chen por 'gyur/ /rdo rje chu 'di btung bar 43—788

gyis / /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ de lta bas na bu khyod kyis/ /dam tshig 'di dag srung bar gyis/ /de bzhin pas na dngos grub pas/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi chu 'thung zhig /oṃ badz+ra ud ga da ya hūṃ/ lan gsum byin nas rab bsgrags pa//thabs dang shes rab sems nyid kyis/ /rtag tu dogs pa me+ed kyis la/ /'dod pa lnga'i yon tan spyod/ /gzhan yang stong khams thams cad na/ /shes rab dbyings dang 'dod yon gzhan/ /rab 'bring tha ma thams cad spyod/ /gzhan yang dam tshig nyams pa dang / /skye bo gang zhig dam la gnod/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 'dir drongs la/ /snying la khrag chen btung bar gyis/ /sems nyid jeg par rab nges na/ /nyon mongs 'dod lnga kun spyod kyang / /pad+ma la ni 'dam bzhin te/ /byas la mi gos sdom pa rdzogs/ /dkyil 'khor yid la mngon sbyar 1snal/ /'dod pa'am yang na gzhan yang rung / /dor de 'brel ba'i legs bstan bya/ /rang gi dam tshig hūṃ dang bcas/ /dam tshig phyag rgyas lan gsum bstan/ /lcags kyu ho yis dgug byas la/ /nyes legs 'phrin las gsal byas la/ /phyag rgya bstems la bstan par bya/ /'od zer thur mas dbye byas la/ /badz+ra tsa gru napra be+e sha phaṭa/ /'khor lo mngon pa'i nga rgyal bya/ /gser sogs mtshon byed nges blangs la/ /chos rnams thams cad gnyis min pa'i/ /dbyings su thims — pa'i 'od zer gsal/ /cig dang spyos pa thams cad med/ /dkyil 'khor spros med zlum po'i tshul/ /rang rig ye shes mya ngan 'das/ /ye shes sgyu dang 'bras bur ldan/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yongs kyis bskor/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs spros pa yin/ /ye shes bzhi'i dkyil 'khor spro/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga/ /byin rlabs ya mtshan 43—789

pas mi khyab/ /rang snang ba'i thabs las byung / /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir/ /mtha' dbus med par rgyas par gnas/ /stong smon mtshan med 'od gsal 'jug /de phyir ye shes sgo bzhir shar/ /sa rnams khyad par bkod pa'i phyir/ /der 'gro lam stegs brgyad dang ldan/ /rang bzhin ye shes 'od gsal phyir/ /nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan 'bar zhing / /ye nas rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i gdan/ /zad med ye shes gter 'gyur bas/ /yid bzhin rin chen 'bar ba'i gdan/ /'bras bu'i chos rnams yongs rdzogs phyir/ /seng ge la sogs bstan pa yin/ /ye nas mnyam nyid mi 'da'i phyir/ /rta li'i ljon shing rang bzhin gnas/ /thams cad la ni dbang sgyur phyir/ /'jig rten lha chen rnams kyis bskor/ /thams cad rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /thams cad lha nyid rtag tu sbyor/ /thams cad ma lus dkyil 'khor mchog /mtshan nyid legs par shes par bya/ /rang gi lha'i 'bras bu'i/ /gzhi phyir mchog tu'ang nan tan bya/ /bskal pa mnyam pa'i ye shes te/ /gnyer na nye bar 'byung ba'i/ /ya mtshan chen po 'byung bar nges/ /dad med nyams na phung bar 'gyur/ /lha spangs dge spyad don med pas/ /gang zhig phyag rgya 'di spangs na/ /nyon mongs ngan song gnas su skye/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur / /bla med 'gro ba'i rgyun chad nas/ /rigs chad nyid du gnas par 'gyur / /bdag nyid lha dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /yon tan chung yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /gcig dang du ma yongs bral ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par gsungs/ /de nas rigs kyi bu mchog des/ /rgyal srid dang ni 43—790

rang gi lus/ /bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad dbul / /dbang phyug longs spyod lngas mchod na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod pa yin/ /nye ba'i dkyil 'khor smos ci dgos/ /nyes pa thams cad dag par 'gyur/ /dbang dang dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /'di ltar shin tu nan tan bya'o/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas legs zhugs pas/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhir gshegs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu zhugs pa yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i/ /'khor lo sngon du bzhugs pa'i/ /bsod nams bstan pa gang yin pa/ /phyis byas de bzhin lung bstan phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul bde chen dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /gtang dbyal gnyis sam yang na lnga/ /byas te dad ldan rab zhugs na/ /'dod pa yid 'ong mchog la sogs/ /sngon byas pa dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di la mos gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyis/ /phyogs dus kun nas thams cad du/ /nye ba'i sras su dgongs par 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dzin par rigs nges shing / /gdon rnams zlog cing ngan song sbyong / /longs spyod 'du ba rnam pa gnyis/ /ye shes spyan gyi gzhi ru nges/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /byang sems dkyil 'khor zab mo'i dbang / /phan tshun rgyu dang 'bras bu ni/ /phyi nang gsang ba nyid du gsungs/ /lte snying dbu mgrin yan lag bcas/ /rnam shes gcig gi rten gzhi ste/ /ye shes rnam pa bzhi /bcu gnyis/ /gzhi dang rgyu phyir phyi rol don / /dbang po yul dus gsang ba'i gnas/ /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i thig le che/ /khams la sogs pa'i bde ldan pa'i / /kun sdob nang gi don du bshad/ /tha dad min las tha dad pa'i/ /43—791

—rang nyams bde ba'i ye shes ni/ /cig ces 'di zhes brjod du med/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du med/ /gsum tshogs sna tshogs 'byung zhing 'phro/ /byin rlabs sna tshogs mtha' yas mchog /don basbus dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis / /ye shes phyag rgya gsal 'gyur ba/ /bcu gsum la sogs mthar phyin pas/ /'bras bu nyid du'ang 'di shes bya/ /bden gnyis byang chub dbyer med pas/ /dngos po ming gis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de dag nges pa'i ming bstan pa/ /snying po thams cad dus gsum gyis/ /gang yang yan lag 'khor du 'gyur/ /rgyu 'bras rnam par spang bar bya/ /rang rig mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil/ /ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul/ /'das pa dag tu dkyil yin te/ /'jig rten sna tshogs 'khor du gsungs/ /ting 'dzin rang bzhin don shes bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dkyil nyid de/ /rigs bzhi lha dang lha mo dang / /khro bo khro mo 'khor yin te/ /lhag pa gnyis sogs don du gsungs / /bco brgyad khams gsum snying po nyid/ /de dag 'khor de bde ba'i khams/ /ye shes de bzhin lha de bzhin/ /byang sems rnam gnyis mthar thug phyir/ /nges tshig las dang ngo bo yin/ /dngos po gnyis pa mchog yin te//rgyu 1rkyen ngo bo 'bras bu dang / /las rim skyon yon brgyad shes bya/ /ngo bo snod kyi mtshan nyid kyis/ /dbye ba rnam pa lnga ru 'gyur/ /bdag gzhan nus pa gnyis kyi las/ /nying lag lnga phrag gnyis dang cig /de dag phyi rol don shes bya/ /bde sogs spyod pa gsang bar 'gyur/ /rang gnas rang rig ye shes gsal/ /bcu dag bum pa'i rnam pa yin/ /dbang po mchog ni rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ /ma lus sems phyir longs spyod de/ /khyab pa'i mkha' 'gro 43—792

srung bar byed/ /thabs dang shes rab bde ba'i lam/ /yan lag yan lag bcas g.yon bcings/ /kun tu 'phyo ba cod pan mchog /dbu 'am 'dud pa bcud ldan 'phreng / /rdo rje phung sogs bzhi bcu gnyis/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byung ba'i dngos/ /'phra rags thabs dang shes rab mtshan/ /rnam pa sum cu de bzhin te/ /phyogs mtshams srung bar byed pa'o/ /phung po 'byung bcas dkyil 'khor cig /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub de nyid/ /sngon byas rgyu sgo'abras dbyer med la/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i bde chen po/ /rdo rje sku phyir bstan pa yin / /sgyu gnyis rang bzhin mtshungs pa ni/ /ngo bo bzhin du grangs 'jug ste—/ /sgyu'i 'khor lo gdugs su gsal/ /reg sogs las kyi yum du 'gyur/ /phyag rgya grangs kyi rab 'bring rnams/ /rang bzhin rgyu las rkyen slong dang / /ting 'dzin byed pas dbang sgur sna'agyur/ /kun la rgyas 'debs phyag rgya yis //rnam shes rang bzhin ye shes lnga/ /khams lnga bde byed rang bzhin ni/ /sku gsung 'phrin las yon tan thugs/ /spyod yul yongs 'gyur rgyu 'bras kyi/ /snying po mchog tu de gsungs so/ /phung sogs rtsa dang khams rnams kun/ /rang bzhin 'khrul pa'i tha snyad du/ /sna tshogs snang la gnas pa med/ /rang bzhin ye nas zlum pa ni/ /las dang ngo bo dbang du 'gyur/ /'chad sogs las kyi mtshan nyid lnga/ /yang lag dbang po'i dkyil 'khor lngas/ /las thams cad la dbang sgyur zhing / /rlung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ /snying sogs gnas pa las dkyil 'khor/ /sgra dbyangs gsung gi gsal byed dang / /mi shigs thig le rang gi lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin/ /'di dag las su spyod byed kyang / /rang bzhin ma skyes sems kyi phyir/ /bsgo dang 43—793

bsgo bar bya ba med/ /chags med tshul du rang bzhin gnas/ /gsum pa'i rang bzhin bshad bya ba/ /ma bcos rgyun gyi skad cig mas/ /de yis ma byas gang yang med/ /'das dang ma 'das thams cad kun/ /rigs pa nyid du thams cad 'dus/ /sems dang chos su dbyer med par/ /mtha' bzhi yongs bral bde chen po/ /so sor zhen pas de nyid snang / /dngos po ming gis 'thad pa nyid/ /snang byed rgyu yang de bzhin nyid/ /rang bzhin bde ba gnas pa'i lam/ /brgyud pas bde ba myong bar byed/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i don du bstan/ /byin rlabs thabs kyis spar ba'i phyir/ /thams cad sbyad cing blang bar bya/ /ma lus sems phyir gnyis med pas/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam bral te/ /mtha' rnams ci la'ang mi gnas pas/ /rang rig 'od gsal thams cad mkhyen/ /rang rig snang ba ma skyed phyir/ /sku dang ye shes bsam mi khyab/ /ngang nyid lhun gyis grub pa ni/ /rgyu 'bras snga phyi ma yin pas//rgyu'i dus nyid 'bras bu'i mchog /de bzhin nyid du shes pa yang / /sna tshogs zhen las grol bar zad/ /yang dag nyid la ye rdzogs phyir/ /dngos po ming gnyis 'thad par 'gyur/ /de phyir dus gsum 'gyur med pas/ /bstan pa zhes su gsungs pa yin/ /'bras bu rgyu la mi gnas na/ /phyogs gcig rgyu dang rkyen dag gis/ /kun nas slong bar rigs ma yin/ /'ching bu nor bur dbang bskur yang / /de la rin chen mngon rtags med/ /chos dbang sems la yod pa ru/ /kun bzangs rdo rje sems dpas gsungs/ /dbang mchog rang la med 'gyur na/ /bskur bas thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /dang po la sogs sems rims lnga/ /gong nas gong du rgyun ldan pa/ /phyogs gcig rgyu ru 43—794

spyir bshad de/ /rkyen dang thun mong 'byel zhes bya/ /rkyen bzhi snod kyi mtshan nyid gnyis/ /chags gnyid rang phyogs chad dang ni/ /yi dwags gti mug rtsod pa dang / /nyes pa du ma'i rgyur shes bya/ /dregs sgur phrag dog le lo yis/ /nyams sgrib dngos grub mi 'byung dang / /'bras bu kun kyang yal bar 'gyur/ /zhe sdang snying rje las ring ba/ /theg pa chen po rigs ma yin/ /khe drags longs spyod kyis phyogs pa/ /bsam bya ring du spong bar 'gyur/ /sgra'i nga rgyal nyams pa'i gzhi/ /don ni nges pa ldan par gsungs/ /nan tan dam tshig mi byed pa/ /thar pa'i lam las ring bar 'gyur/ /de dag thun mong spang ba'i rigs / /rang bzhin gnyis kyis skal med dang / /bus pa rnam gnyis ma ning sogs/ /thar lam gnyis las ring bar 'gyur/ /rtse ba nan tan ldan pa dang / /skyon zlog yon tan nyid du 'gyur/ /ci la'ang yid rings ldog pa med//skye gnas sems la rkyen thub pa/ /rmad par gyur pa'ang blang bar bya/ /dad pa'i tshul gyi snang ba ni/ /phyogs gcig rkyen du nges par bshad/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya dag /dkyil 'khor rdzas dus la sogs pa/ /nus mthu mang po snang bar 'gyur/ /shes rab ting 'dzin nogs dang ldan/ /log spangs yang dag dug dang ldan/ /man ngag brtul zhugs snying rjer ldan/ /las dang man ngag rgyun ma chad/ /rgyud goms las sbyor ma mthong dang / /dngos lnga rdzogs phyir nyams ldan pas/ /de nyid de la snang bar 'gyur/ /rim pa skabs kyi tshul dag gis/ /ltos nas rgyu me'abras go 'byed pa/ /de ma thag pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /ting 'dzin la sogs rim bshad pa/ /mchog sogs phyag rgya gang yin las/ /rang gi rab gnas cung zad mchod/ /rang bzhin 43—795

gsal bar byed pa dang / /snang byed la sogs dbang skur byed/ /rtog tshogs sems phyir ma skyes pa/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin lam/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgyas dbang bsgur nas/ /las rnams byed par dbang bskur ba'o/ /rnam shes nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /sems phyir mtshan ma ma skyes pa/ /mi bskyod yab yum rang bzhin las/ /ting 'dzin thugs su dbang bsgyur snanas//dngos grub las rnams mngon byed shog /hūṃ badz+ra byug /sum̐ dwa du shwa ra sto/a bi shin tsa hūṃ/ mig gzugs sems phyir ma skyes pa/ /sa snying yab yum rang bzhin las/ /ting 'dzin sems dpas dbang sgyur nas/ /spyod yul yongs su dag byed shog /k+shi hi rā dzā ya/ hūṃ la se sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a bi shin tsa hūṃ/ reg shes rtag pa ma skyes sems/ /gshin rje yab yum rang bzhin las/ /ting 'dzin 'jom pas dbang sgyur nas/ /gdul bya ma lus thar byed shog /ya mān+ta kred hūṃ/ badz+ra da ra ma hā kro ti sho ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ yid chos rang rig ma skyes pa'i/ /kun bzang yab yum rang bzhin la/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgyas dbang sgyur nas/ /ma lus kun gyi byed por shog /gsang sngags ldan par byin byas la/ /gnas stem rang gi phyag rgya gsal/ /shin tu rdzogs par dbang bsgur bya/ /mgo lce snying lte g.yas zur la/ /zla ba oṃ sogs 'bru lnga dgod / /sku gsung yon tan las byin bsdu/ /sku sogs phyag rgyar gsal bar bya/ /oṃ bde gshegs sgu'i ngo bo las/ /mi shigs rdo rje rgyal po'i gtso/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ldan pa yis/ /rdo rje'i sku'i ngo bor shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ bde gshegs gsung gi ngo bo las/ /mi shigs rdo rje chos kyi dbyings/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ldan pa yis/ /rdo rje 43—796

gsung gi ngo bor shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā bag badz+ra swa bhā wa ad+ma ko haṃ/hūṃ bde gshegs thugs kyi ngo bo las/ /mi shigs rdo rje thugs kyi thugs/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ldan pa yis/ /rdo rje'i thugs kyi gtso bor shog /oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ swa mi 'gyur ba'i zhing khams las / /ma skyes pa'i 'bras bu shar/ /ma bsags pa'i 'bras bu 'byung / /cir yang 'gyur ba'i ye shes kyis/ /rang dbang thabs kyi sgyur 1bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā bu tsa badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ ha thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /'dod chags chen po'i ting 'dzin las/ /las sngon kun tu grub snang bas/ /ma lus mnyam par spyor bar shog /na ma sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ rin chen rab gnas las byung ba'i/ /rin chen mjes pas dbu brgyan cing / /rigs lnga 'dus pa'i bum chu sbyin/ /thabs shes 'byel pa rigs lnga'i dngos/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun las de bzhin skyes/ /i chos nyid mnyam pa chen po las/ /ye shes gsal bas rnam par dag /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /skye med chos la dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā shu bye tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ dag cing gsal ba'i rang bzhin te/ /skyon med sems nyid rin po che/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /srid pa gsum la dbang sgyur shog /oṃ ma hā a ta ri sha na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/swa khams gsum re skong rgyal po ste/ /yon tan rin chen gter kyi mchog /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis/ /'gro ba'i re skong rgyal por shog /oṃ ma hā sa man ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ nyes pa'i skyon bral dri ma med/ /skye 'gag med pa'i dngos grub ste/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis/ /srid gsum 4 3—797

nyes dmigs sel bar shog /oṃ ma hā pra ta pra be+e sha ya dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ ha dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor mthar phyin cing / /grub pa las kyi bye brag las/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes kyis/ /skye 'gro dbyings su sgrol bar shog /oṃ ma hā kri te a nu ta na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ rin chen rab gnas 'phreng ba bcing / /tram̐ gzungs snadang ting 'dzin rgyu 'bras chos/ /byang chub phyogs rnams shes rab brgyan/ /mi 'jigs stobs dang dpe byad mtshan/ /'bras bu rdzogs par dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ rat+na ma le a bi shin tsa tram̐/ ha khyung gi gshog pa rab sdebs pas/ /klu rnams zil gyis gnon pa ltar/ /srid gsum yon tan sdogs mdzes cod pan mchog /che mchog bdud bzhi zil mnan dbang thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu h+ya badz+ra ma le badz+ra a bi shin tsa hūṃ/rab gnas chos 'byung ye shes dngos/ /kha dog gnyis ldan dbang bskur bya/ /las mchog rab gnas rdo rje'i go/ /g.yog pa'i tshul kyis sbyin par bya/ /mi shigs ye shes rdo rje ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ya lang de/ /khyab pa'i tshul gyis dra ba yin/ /dbang mchog dam pa sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ka a bi shin tsa hūṃ/rdo rje rab gnas las byung ba'i/ /rgyal mtshan rin chen tog ldan pa/ /de'i lag par sbyin par bya/ /hūṃ sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che/ /log pa'i lta ba zil mnon mtshan/ /thams cad tshar gcod rin chen rgya/ /yon tan mngon byung dbang bsgur ro/ /o badz+ra ke du a bi shin tsa hūṃ/ /mi bskyod rab gnas rin chen gdugs/ /snying po ldan par slar gnas bya/ /hūṃ gnyis med ye shes rtog bral ba/ /rmongs sogs sems phyir rang bzhin stong / /log 'byung rgyu 'bras ma gsungs pa/ /thugs rje skyob par dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ 43—798

rabe+e ts+tsha tram̐ a bi shin tsa hūṃ/ sangs rgyas rab gnas lha mo'i tshogs/ /rol pa'i tshul du gus stabs bya/ /oṃ bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo/ /rang sems rnam dag brgyan pa'i phyir/ /gnyis med rol pa'i dbang bsgur bas//bdud rtsi yid bzhin sku grub shog /oṃ badz+ra to ru a bi shin tsa hūṃ/ sbyor ba las byung leb rgan bye/ /gang yin rnams su 'khor lo'i khang / /nyi zla'i gdan du sems byung rgyu/ /lnga gnyis zung las 'khril sbyor skul/ /ye shes spyan drangs cung zad mchod/ /yongs gyur de'i phyag rgya gsal/ /nyan byed 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le ngo bo nyid/ /tram̐ gi phyag rgya'i tshogs mchog las/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor gsal spro bstem/ /tram̐ gsang ba'i gsang chen gsang mchog gang / /gsang 1ba kun la snyan par bya/ /gsang ba'i don nyid brtag pa la/ /gzhan du smra bar bya ba min/ /gsal ba 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /rigs gang yi ge'i tshogs mchog las/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal spro bstem/ /saṃ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras chen po/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje zung / /rgyal ba thams cad mnyes mchod la/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ /lag pa 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /hūṃ gi phyag rgya'i tshogs mchog las/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor gsal spro bstem/ /oṃ khyed ni rdo rje las yin gyis/ /las rnams ma lus kun byon zhig /pho nya'i 'du 'phro mang po kun/ /khyod kyi dgos pa byed pa yin/ /smra byed 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le'i ngo bo nyid//tri'i phyag rgya'i tshogs mchog las/ /chos kyi 'khor lo gsal spyo stem/ /oṃ chos kyi rgyal po bla med kyis/ /dad ldan skyes bu ngoms par byos/ /rab 'bring tha 43—799

ma'i blo can la/ /mthun par gsang sgrags gzhan du min/ /bskyod chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /oṃ hūṃ swā oṃ ha rnams las/ /dkyil 'khor lnga dang khro 'phreng sgom/ /rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor gsal spro bstem/ /thim 'gyur dbyings nas byed por 'bar/ /oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje che/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi byed pa po/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi sbyin pa spyod/ /glegs bam 'phreng ba rgya gram ljang / /'khor lo rdo rje dril bu sbyin/ /cung zad rab gnas gsal ma byas/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub thabs gsal bar dbye/ /shin tu 'phra ba'i dam tshig mchog /sor bzhi'am yang na mdzub gang la/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor legs par brtag /bcu drug phyag rgya phyi rim gsal/ /spyod lam kun kyi rgyud 'thun pa/ /bcud dang nyes par ldan pa la/ /zas srung gos rje dam tshig sbyin/ /las dang 'gag sogs legs par bslabarmye / /byin rlabs mchod pa chen po bya/ /gnyis med ye shes ror ldan pas/ /khrus sogs ldan pa'i bu rnams la/ /mdzem pa'i nyes dmigs sngar shes bya/ /ting 'dzin ldan pas thogs med sbyin/ /bde dang mtshan ma brtag par bya/ /bar nas phyag mthil phrad dkyil 'khor/ /phyi rol nang gi tshul du bshad/ /rig pas me tog dor bar bya/ /dogs med bde bar ldan pa gang / /sdug bsngal las grol zhes dbugs 'byung / /thun mong rigs mthun rtog med kyang / /ud+mal dkar nag phyed dkyugs ldan/ /phyogs dang bla 'og 'bring du bshad/ /dri mchog spos dang chu rlung bdag /lto ba 'phra zhing rgyas pa yin/ /zla ba mang bas nyung bar 'gyur/ /yan lag pad 'dra'i phyag mtshan can/ /shin tu 43—800

mnyes shing gzi brjid ldan/ /khong yangs ngal ba gus dang ldan/ /skabs phyed snyan smra dang che ba/ /sngon nas shin tu'ang brtag par bya/ /las spyor bshad pa bzhin shes nas/ /rin chen la sogs 'dod yon kyis/ /mnyes pa'i me tog dor bar bya/ /sems kyi dkyil 'khor legs bstan la/ /rab gnas las kyis rgyas par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du/ /bdag gam yang na gzhan gyis brlabs/ /rlung khams dang po shes pa yis/ /dus dang rab gnas 'bras bu ni/ /gnyi ga la yang shes par bya/ /bde ba myong ba de bzhin te/ /mnyam par sbyor zhes dus nyid yin/ /gnas kyi ye shes bcu drug po / /tshogs sbyor ba sogs dang po nas/ /mthar phyin sangs rgyas sa 1nyid de/ /gnas bzhin de bzhin dbye ba las/ /gnyis pa'i gnyis par rab dga' sogs//pha rol phyin dang sa mtshan nyid/ /mtshungs phyir rdzogs par bshad pa yin/ /de dag thabs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /dbang po ma lus bcud dzo'adus pa/ /phyag rgya'i sems sogs thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin gnyis med ma skyes pa/ /dang po byed phyir mi bye thob ste/ /de nyid gang la bstan gyur pa'i/ /rgyal mtshan mchog ni dbang por gsungs/ /sngon bshad shes bya'i mchog gyur pa/ /gang dang ldan de shes bya'i yul/ /rten can rang bzhin bdag nyid phyir/ /'dres pas de nyid gsal 'gyur ba/ /rnam shes thugs ni rdo rje sems/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i gter nyid dang / /thams cad 'gro ba'i gnas nyid de/ /de yis ma bskyed gang yang med/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyu/ /de las thams cad skye zhing 'byung / /kun kyi phyag rgya'i rgyu yin te/ /bde ba'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i rdzas/ /de la thabs kyi lus 43—801

zhes bya/ /ye shes rang bzhin lus bstan pa/ /thams cad bdag phyir gnyis med cing / /shes bya shes byed ma skyes phyir/ /thams cad mtha' stong rang rig nyid/ /stong pa'i stong pa'ang chen por gsungs/ /gang nas ma 'ongs gar mi 'gro/ /'gro dang 'ong bar bya ba min/ /shin tu rtag dka' mi dmigs la/ /mtha' dang dbus su rtag tu med/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang rig nyid/ /dmigs med tshul du de snang ngo / /dbyings dang dbyings kyi ye shes kyang / /rang rig kho nas tsam du zad/ /'das dang ma 'das bdag yin pas/ /kun la smon cing chags su med/ /sems dang byang chub dbyer med pas/ /sems can ma lus thams cad dang / /dus gsum chos rnams thams cad gsal/ /rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' ste/ /de yis mi mkhyen ci yang med/ /'od gsal thams cad mkhyen dbang du/ /kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' gsungs/ /gang zhig cung zad ma lon pas/ /rjes su mthun pa'i yul nyid la/ /khyad par cung zad nyid ldan ma/ /yul gyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar bya/ /gang gis de dag nyams lon pa/ /lha mdzes rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /rdo rje nyi ma thabs kyi rgya/ /de zla bsil byebyed shes rab dngos/ /gnyis med bde ba mtha' bral la/ /gdags pa yod phyir zung 'jug sku/ /ri dwags nor 'dzin spyi gzugs ni/ /ji ltar ltas pa der snang ste/ /rang gi ngo bo bstan du med/ /yod la rtsal na sgro brtags 'gyur/ /med la rtsal na skur btab ste/ /yod med gnyis las rtsal byas na/ /de ni lung du ma bstan 'gyur//rkyen bral rang dbang ye shes ni/ /thams cad lhun grub rang dbang 'gyur/ /gar yang ma chags pad+ma bzhin/ /phung sogs ye shes phyag rgya dag /bsam 43—802

gyis mi khyab bsam bral bas/ /rang rig nyid du rang gsal bas/ /gcig dang du ma yongs kyis bral/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa rdzogs byed kyang / /gdul bya bdag phyir dmigs su med/ /de nyid shes rab thabs su rdzogs/ /tshogs gnyis nges rdzogs sa mchog ni/ /gdod nas dus gsum 'gyur med de/ /gang zhig rkyen gyis ma bskyed phyir/ /bstan 'gyur dbang gis mchog tu gsungs//dgos pa rang bzhin don min te/ /rgyu rkyen sgribs g.yog dbang du gsungs/ /shes rab thabs kyi ye shes tshogs/ /thig le bsam yas ye shes che/ /bdud rtsi bsel dro 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rtsa gnas pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /gong thabs rigs pa rlung mthu yis/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /'od gsal 'pho bas kun la khyab/ /bde ba nyams pas kun tu thim/ /bzhi bcu gnyis sogs phyag rgya che/ /gzugs mdzes skyod pas phyogs bcur g.yo/ /snying po'i thig le mnyam sbyor bas/ /bde ba'i ye shes rol mo yis/ /ye shes dgye la mchod pa 'bul/ /zag pa med pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /ye shes sgyu ma rang snang ba/ /rol mo'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas mchog /gsang ba'i thig le nyid kyi dbyings/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi sngon sdogs pa'i/ /sku gsung yon tan 'phrin las thugs/ /ma lus bdag nyid zhal mthong ba/ /dbang bskur mchog nyid dam pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor la gnas dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /rgyan du dkyil 'khor ma lus thogs/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mnyam sbyor bas//thugs rje dkyil 'khor yongs kyis 'byung / /zhi dang spyod yul de bzhin te/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul rmad kyi chos/ /gzhan nas yod 'ongs ma yin te/ /thabs 43—803

la bstan pa'i shes rab nyid/ /de lta bu'i ngang du byung / /shes rab dbyings kyi de bzhin nyid/ /thabs kyi phyag rgyar gyur pa'i phyir/ /ye shes la ni ye shes rol / /ye shes rol pa nyid kyang gsog /rgyal ba sngon byung skyob pa dang / /byin rlabs ston pa de bzhin te/ /bya byed nus mthu'i gzi byin gyis/ /sgyu ma rdo rje btsan po mchog /ther zug rgyun las rab grol ba/ /ngo bo nyid rtag rdo rje'i sgu/ /dmigs pa kun las rab grol te/ /rdo rje de bzhin nyid du son/ /de nas yang dag sdogs pa'i/ /yon tan ma lus bdag tu gsal/ /sa sogs lta ngan las grol ba'i/ /rang sems ye shes mtha' dbus med/ /yon tan bsam yas dngos grub kyang / /rang gi ngo bo bstan par dka'/ /'du 'bral med gzungs bde ba che/ /rjes su 'das dang ma 'das rol/ /phyogs bcu sku gsung yon tan ni/ /du ma cig bral tshul snang la/ /dus gsum chos kun bdag cig phyir/ /mngon mkhyen thad ka'i dmigs yul grol/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /thabs chen thabs la byung ba'i sku/ /de ni byang chub rdo rje'i mchog /snod bcud rim pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sems skyed las kyis dad rnams la/ /gnyis kyi nang du phan gdags bya/ /bdag gzhan don byed brtson 'grus ldan/ /gnyis dang gsum du phye ba yis/ /las kun dngos grub thogs pa med/ /brtul zhugs rnam pa gnyis ldan pas/ /gzhan kyi longs spyod thams cad bya/ /'bras bu rgyun la ming brtags pas/ /rigs dang mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs kyi/ /las thabs nyams dang ldan pa la/ /'od gsal ye shes thams cad mkhyen/ /bdag nyid kyis kyang gtad par bya/ /de bzhin de nyid nyams thob pas/ /sems mtha' 'gro 'ong la gnas te/ /sa 43—804

rnams slar la zlog pa ni/ /'khor ba nyid dang spang du med/ /dbyer med kun bzangs sa la 'god/ /dngos grub zhing gyur dbang phyug ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid de/ /'bad pas mnyes par mi byed pa/ /bskal par sbrebs dang mun nag sogs/ /bde bas rab tu byel 'gyur zhing / /thabs dang shes rab la sogs lam/ /shin tu ring bar 'gyur ba yin/ /nus mthu byin rlabs bde gshegs lung / /nor bu rgya mtsho mkha' lta bu/ /sa bcu sems dpa' chen pos kyang / /nus mthu gzu lums ma yin phyir/ /gus pas rim par blang ba rnams/ /gang zhig dbang rnams ma thob pas/ /nyan pa la sogs rtsom pa rnams/ /'bras bu sked cing klag par 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab bde ldan pa'i/ /'bras bu rgyu las gzhan med phyir/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi bde spong ba/ /bskal pa bye ba mtha' klas par/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid sangs rgyas ngo bo'i phyir/ /lam yang gzhan na yod ma yin/ /rmongs pas gzhan na rnyed mi 'gyur/ /thabs dang mi mthun sman pa'i don/ /zhi spyod bde bas bde 'tshol ba/ /bde ba 'dod pas rgyab kyis phyogs/ /shin tu lam ring sngon spyod pa/ /'di la mi shong phra dog mchog /gang yang phan pas dbang bskur ba'i/ /dus 'di phyin chad rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngan song thams cad med pa dang / /mtho ris thar pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ /las thams cad la thogs med pa'i/ /dngos grub kun la dbang byed pa'o/ /dbang phyug chen po nyid du nges/ /lha mig la sogs mngon byas nas/ /lus dang longs spyod bcas pa yi/ /rigs 'dzin sa la rab gnas nas/ /'jigs med kun tu bzang por sbyor/ /yum dang sgeg mo la sogs pa/ /de 43—805

nyid byin gyis rlob par 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa rang rig gis/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang spyod yul cig /de la sogs pa bsam mi khyab/ /yon tan rdzogs shing rdzogs mi 'gyur/ /kye ma'o ye nas gsang ba'i chos thams cad kun la rang bzhin gnas/ /ngang gis bdag snyam ma rtogs pas/ /kun la yod cing rang bzhin gsang / /gzhan du min la shin tu gsang / /don nyid kyis ni gsang ba'i sku/ /mnyam pa'i rdo rje can gyi gsungs/ /de phyir gsang ba'i don mchog 'di/ /lta ba dman 2la bstan byas na/ /dus min par ni srog zad nas/ /mgo 'gas snying yang tshig par 'gyur/ /khab len gyis ni lcags sdud ltar/ /mi 'dod bzhin du dbang med par/ /ngan song bskal par myong bar 'gyur/ /de bas rdo rje gsang mchog 'di/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis/ /chos la skyon yod ma yin te/ /sems can don du shin tu gsang / /theg pa dman snedang phyin ci log /de la gsang ba stan gyur na/ /rang bzhin gsang don mi shes par/ /'phral gyi spyod yul de dag la//shin tu nges pa don bzung nas/ /gsang don de nyid log par khrid/ /ma rtogs de nyid dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas rab tu gsang bar bya/ /gsang ba spel bar byed pa yang / /smra bye byed lce la zhing rmo zhing / /sdug bsngal chen po myong bar 'gyur/ /de phyir rdo rje lce yod kyang / /jeg pa dman bya dang ma 'dres dang / /skye bo phal la smra mi bya/ /gang yang sbyor ba mi shes sems blangs chags sogs rang bzhin rmongs dbang dang blangs pa/ /rgyal zer nges par dbang 'gags bzod dka' skyed sogs bcu'i cig 'khrul 'khor nges thong ba/ /de nyid rigs ldan cung zad dang blangs bde zlog thabs spyor cig gis gol thar 43—806

zhing / /tshe sogs mang thob rgyu 'bras kun rdzogs thabs rgyal 'di dka' she— 'gro mang byang chub shog /sgyu 'phrul dra ba rdo rje las kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ dngos po gnyis pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/77༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ tsho3〈〈pe 〉d+kus bya ba bzhugs so/ /772 1 〈〈pe 〉7bdag nyid lo rgyus shis pa'ang mchog tu gsungs/ rngu 〈〈pe 〉dza/ 1 〈〈pe 〉7de/773 rmye〈〈pe 〉rabartul/ 3 〈〈pe 〉stabagrwa/774 ①〈〈pe 〉〉trang /776 lku〈〈pe 〉rabarlobs/777 lku〈〈pe 〉mi ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉cig778 lha 〈〈pe 〉〉brlabs/ 78 ༷ lku 〈〈pe 〉rabashes/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉gas/78 1 rmye〈〈pe 〉mthugs/ ② 〈〈pe 〉〉skyed/78 2 2〈〈pe 〉〉kyis/78 4 lku 〈〈pe 〉shesdegs/78 6 lku〈〈pe 〉d+kum/ phya〈〈pe 〉tharlabs/7/ 7 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rgyas/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉sbyar/78 8 1 〈〈pe 〉riskal/ lku〈〈pe 〉ju/ lku 〈〈pe 〉sngazi'/7/ 9 1〈〈pe 〉45ra/ ñcha〈〈pe 〉phrog shu/ zhu 〈〈pe 〉〉thim/791 1〈〈pe 〉stanazhi/792 cho〈〈pe 〉〉sgyu/79 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgyu/ du 〈〈pe 〉thaskur/ zhu 〈〈pe 〉yonan/795 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgyu/796 1〈〈pe 〉〉sgyur/797 lha 〈〈pe 〉8sa bsgyur/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉byu n+ya tā p+ta/43 byed807

798 tshod〈〈pe 〉sngagazugs/799 she〈〈pe 〉stanang /8༷༷ (7〈〈pe 〉〉brlab//༷1 she7〈〈pe 〉〉was/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/ zhu 〈〈pe 〉〉pa/8༷2 te 〈〈pe 〉〉bsal/8༷6 skye sa 〈〈pe 〉tshosan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〉/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉tshosan/8༷7 she〈〈pe 〉〉dga'/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2523)43wa 808

snyo /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dbang gis gal po/ ) ༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das/ /dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad brtson ldan pa'i slob ma yis/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /nus dang phan pa'i dbang thob nas/ /brtul zhugs ldan pa'i bu mchog la/ /ye shes rang gnas rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /sor bzhi'am mdzub gang tshad ldan la/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga rab bsnyams te/ /gdan dang phyag rgya yi ge sogs/ /rgyud bzhin mkhas pas byin gyis brlabs/ /blo ldan sngon nas shes bya ba/ /bcu drug nyi shu lnga gnyis tshad/ /yon tan bcu gsum rab ldan zhing / /mnyen drang skra ring sems ma'i tshul/ /gsang ba'i gter du ming gis bzung / /'o ma'i spos chus mgo lus bkru/ /tsan dan gur gum a ka ru zer lo/ /gon pan 'dza ti shing tsha yis/ /dri zhim ngad ldan chab kyis slubs/ /gsal ldan ma 'am byin brlabs pa'i/ /kha snying pad+ma la sogs la/ /gsang yum lnga dang khro mo bzhi'i/ /43—809

dbyibs dang kha dog gsal bar bya/ /rang gi mchod pa legs sbyar la/ /yum dang 'dzom ma sems ma yis/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i las bzhin mchod/ /zad med gter la longs spyad 1phyir/ /rin chen snyim pa bkang nas ni/ /rdo rje sems gtso khyed la 'dud/ /thar lam chen po de 'dod de/ /mgon po dpa'o skyabs song zhing / /theg chen khang par zhugs pa dang / /mkhyen rab gsang ba bdag la gsol/ /bu 'dir shog cig ci bde bar/ /las spyod rim par 'gro ba dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje zung / /rdzogs pa'i ye shes bde chen la / /dmigs pa med par gnas phyir ru/ /ser sna spangs pa'i dang yid kyis / /gtong zhing rang sems brtan par zung / /ye shes rang gnas rdzogs dbang sbyin/ /'dod pa'i dngos pos rol pa'i/ /phyag rgya bzhi ldan 'gyur ba dang / /rgyal po'i phyag rgya lnga ldan pas/ /stong gsum yungs 'brur 'jug tshul gyis/ /dbyings nas dkyil 'khor spyan drang mchod/ /shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya las/ /bde ba'i 'bru tshogs gsal ba'i rgyun/ /rdo rje lam nas pad+mor skyil/ /'khyud dang bzlog pa'i bde ba yis/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus la/ /dgyes mnyam mchog gi sbyin pas bstem/ /sgo 'byed bde bas gyen du bskyil/ /de nas dbang phyug chen po des/ /mi 'gyur sgron ma sgul bskyod cing / /sems kyi thig le sgo phye ste/ /tshangs pa chen po dbyangs bzhes nas/ /go 'byed rdo rje ljags brkyang nas/ /grub pa'i nyi zla snying po ste/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje lce yis blang / /rtse nas bstems shing dkyil 'khor bsgyur/ /tshangs pa sgo ba 'di gsungs so/ /nga ni rgyal ba kun gyi bla/ /thig le byang chub sems chen po/ /nga ni khrag 'thung kun gyi rje/ /ye shes rol pa'i 'byung 43—810

gnas gter/ /nga ni spyi dpal bla na med/ /skyon bral thabs kyi rgyal po yin/ /sems kyi dkyil nas drangs pa'i chu/ /khyod kyi lce la phab pa 'di/ /snying gi dkyil du bzung bar byos/ /rigs kyi bu mchog 'di phan chad/ /rdo rje sems pa'i thugs mchog zung / /sangs rgyas kun kyi gtso bo yin/ /byang chub sems dang mnyam pa'i phyir/ /sems dpa' kun gyi mchod gnas yin/ /rigs kyi bu mchog ding phan chad/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi/ /bstan pa'i phyi nang zab mo kun/ /sems kyi dkyil du bsdus nas kyang / /rdo rje lce'i sgo phye ste/ /bdud rtsi sman mchog dam pa 'di/ /dad ldan skyes bu ngoms par byos/ /gdul ba'i phyag rgya 'di yang spyod/ /phyi nang snod bcud rnam par dag /rnam dag chen po nyid kyi lam/ /byed spyad rmyethams cad tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /'gro don bde chen pad+mo sbyin/ /sems kyi chu ni 'thung bar 'ebya'o/ /rnal 'byor chen pos dam du bzung / /yungs kar tshad tsam rdo rje sems/ /gnas ngan len pa gsum sbyangs te/ /hūṃ nyid ring po mtshams sbyar nas/ /thams cad bde ba chen po'i dbyings/ /dge sdig las kyis ma bcos shing / /bsgom zhing bsgrubs pas mi 'byang ba'i/ /rnam dag sems kyi rin chen gter/ /rdo rje snying bo ye shes kyis/ /khro rgyal kun gyi gtsor gyur cig /shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra bo dhe hūṃ ho oṃ/ /rdo rje snying gar legs bzung la/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di skad bsgo/ /oṃ mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes nas/ /ma brtsal phyin pas bde ba'i mchog /ma bltas gsal ba ye shes spyan/ /gong na med pas kun gyi rje/ /ye shes rang gnas brdal ba la/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung sa bon shog /oṃ ma tā gu ya/ rgyu dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la/ dz+nyā na ghu ya sid bye/ sarba ad+ma ko haṃ/ ye shes 43—811

rang gnas su 'dod pas/ /thig le mtshan ma legs rmye snyed nas/ /khrus dang mdzes par dbul bar bya/ /ye shes rang gnas rgyal pos byen brlabs te/ /rdo rje zla ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /rdo rje dbyings phyug rab byas te/ /rin chen snod du mdzes pa'i dkyil/ /rang gi sems nyid yungs kar bsam/ /phab pas thig le dbang skur te/ /g.yas g.yon gung mo rin chen chos kyi sku/ /shes rab thabs kyis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /'di dang skye ba thams cad du/ /dngos grub bde 'di ma spong zhig /rgyal bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyod las byung / /spangs na rdo rje dbyings phyug basprul/ /bkug dang sdom pa ma shes na/ /rdo rje bskal pa mtha' klas par/ /chos sku thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba'i don mchog 'di dag ni/ /lta ba dman pya la bstan byas na/ /dus min par ni srog zad nas/ /mgo 'gas snying yang tshig par 'gyur/ /khab len gyis ni lcags sdud ltar/ /mi 'dod bzhin du dbang med par/ /bskal par ngan song myong bar 'gyur/ /de bas shin tu gsang bar bya/ /de skad gsang ba'i las gnyer gtad/ /de nas rigs kyi bu mchog des/ /ye shes rang gnas rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /dgug dang dkug 1pa'i thabs 'di bstan/ /bde chen bzang po'i mtshan ldan pas/ /rang bzhin ldan pa'i chos sgu ste/ /bcu drug thabs dang shes rab gnyis/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku gcig cha yis/ /gnas pa med par rol zhes bshad/ /chos nyid thabs dang shes rab las/ /rtsa bzhi 'od bzhi sa bon drug /mdor sdus snying po chos kyi sku/ /de'i phyir chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /dur khrod brgyad po kun bsdus pa'o/ /bcu drug gcig dang bzhi dgyes pa/ /khams gsum khyab pas 43—812

sprul sku'o/ /me dang rdo rje dbyings phyug gnyis/ /mnyam du gnas pas drag par bshad/ /rlung ngan bkug pa'i gzhung dbyings te/ /sa bon yang gis spro byed pa/ /las ni mthur du sel ba ste/ /bud med rgyud la gtu 1mor bshad/ /zla ba rgyas pa'i thig le gnyis/ /chos la thig ler bskul ba bzhin/ /de sogs mang po bkug pa kun/ /sdogs pa'i skyed par bla mas gsungs/ /rang bzhin thig le mtshan rdzogs pa/ /yi ge med par byin brlabs pa/ /dbyings phyug me+ed par byin brlabs pa/ /snang ba thob par 'gyur bas na/ /thabs dang shes rab gang yin gang min sku/ /bkug dang rlung phye phyi nang can/ /gsang snod gsang sgo sdom pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mi rtog dngos po thob par bshad/ /dang po'i sa la reg par nus/ /de phyir rdzogs pa'i yi ge med/ /chos sgu thob par the tshom med/ /yangs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan kun/ /'bad pa med par shugs kyis 'byung / /gsang dbang pad mar ldan 'gyur nang / /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /pha rol phyin bcu rgyu 'bras rdzogs/ /sa bcu rim gyes bgrod byed rdzogs/ /kun tu 'od gsal pad+ma spyan yang sdogs/ /thabs dang shes rab sa yang rdzogs/ /yang dag rdzogs chen thabs dang ldan/ /shes rab bla med yang dag sdogs/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs/ /'di ltar snang ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /g.yeng ba med par zhugs byas te/ /brtson 'grus yu ba gcad pa des/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub ces gsungs/ /dbang bskur gnas pa gang thob pa/ /dus 'di phan chad rgyal ba'i sras/ /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /ngan song thams cad med pa dang / /mtho ris thar pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ /'jigs med kun tu bzang por spyor/ /rdo rje 43—813

༄/ /dbang gi don nges par 'byed pa/2 kho dbang don nges 'byed bzhugs/ ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a bhe shiñca arjan ya hi sa du nā ma/ bod skad du/ dbang gi don nges par 'byed pa/gsang ba'i ye shes chen po la/ /sgyu ma'i rig pa'i thabs ldan pas/ /mos rnyed mngon du gyur pa'i sa/ /gnyis med gsal 'byams dang bas 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba rdo rje sems/ /rgyud rgyal rgya mtsho dbang gi don/ /thams cad rgyud du ma bstan pa/ /bdag gis gsal bar brjod par bya/ /rang bzhin thob bya dbus gter gyad nor bzhin te gzhan ming bdag la gnas 'gyur kyang / /rang gi rang bzhin mi mthong yul med shes bral brtag dka' gsal mthong nus med phyir/ /nam mkha'i ri bong can dang bya dang mdzub mo lta bur bskul bral tshig gis ni/ /phan nus gsang rig brtan don rang gnas lam blos rim bgrod man ngag lung gis mtshan/ /rgyal sras mchog bzhin ldan 'gyur brgyad 43—815

bdun dbang bskur ḍāsnarang gi sa non dbang sgyur ltar/ /snod ldan chos bzhi ldan 'gyur mdo lnga bco brgyad dbang bskur lam bgrod sa non thabs/ /grangs mdo rnam pa'i lus bzhag gnas lugs lam thabs 'bras mthar phyin yul rnam bkod de/ /bra sran 'bras bzhin med na mi 'byung phyir na thog mtha' bar dus gzhan min shes/ /thog ma'i mtshan nyid bshad bya ba/ /snod kyi thob bya pan tsa ste/ /til mar bzhin du ye gnas pa'i/ /ngo bo lnga pa'i dang po nyid/ /rgyu'i dus na rdzogs pa ni/ /bum pa nang gi rtsa bcud de/ /bde ba'i 'khor lo gdung ba sel/ /gsang dbang rtsa sdong rgyal mtshan go/ /dngos po sems phyir longs spyod do/ /la la ra sa g.yas g.yon gnyis/ /bden lam spros ldan g.yas g.yon bsdus/ /lus kun khyab pa cod pan te/ /dbu ma char yang mdud ldan 'phreng / /dpung sogs rtogs pa rtsa ba 'bring / /'byung chung rtsa lnga gtso bor rags/ /'phra ba'i mtshan nyid yul de bzhin/ /rnam min lus kyi phyogs cha bcu/ /phyogs mtshams bsrung byed khro bo ste/ /phra rags tshul gyi stangs dbyal lo/ /yid chog chags bsogs rnam drug po/ /bya byed sprul sku'i phyag rgya ste/ /rgyas par brgyad cu rtsa gnyis so/ /gzugs nyid rgyu 'bras bcud ldan la/ /stangs 'byal bcu'i ngo bo ste/ /gsang chos lus kyi mtshan ma rnams/ /las kyi sgo bsrungs brgyad gyur pa/ /sdud pa'i phyag rgya shes par bya/ /rnam shes ye shes lnga ldan pa/ /dbu brgyan rigs lnga lhun gyis grub/ /rnam lnga khams bcud snying bo lnga/ /phan dbang rang bzhin gnas pa'i don/ /lam dus mtshungs pa'i 'di zhes bshad/ /gnyis pa'i ngo bo ṭanyid nus gnas la/ /nyan sogs las kyi dkyil 'khor lnga/ /rna dbang rnam shes dkyil 'khor nyan/ /43—816

yan lag lnga la rab 'byam ste/ /sgra sogs las la dbang sgyur zhing / /rang bzhin gnas pa'i don du bstan/ /myong dbang 'chad pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /sgra dbyangs yi ge sgyur phyir ro/ /sgrom mdo rlung sogs las bzhi'i dbyibs/ /snying gi thig le bsgom lha ste/ /snod bcud kun gyi bdag po dang / /bsam pa'i las la sbyor phyir ro/ /las su 'di dag byed spyod kyang / /rang bzhin ma grub sems med phyir/ /bsgom dang bsgom par bya med phyir/ /chags med tshul du rang bzhin gnas/ /rang bzhin gnas don gsum pa ni/ /tha snyad gnyis sdud byang chub sems/ /ma'i stitha snyad kun rdzob don/ /yul ming ma mthong gsang ba'i ming / /snang byed thabs kyang de bzhin te/ /rang bzhin bde ba gnas pa'i lam/ /khu ba rgyud pas bde myong ba/ /rang bzhin gnas lugs gsang ba'i dbang / /thabs dang byin brlabs 'brel pa'i phyir/ /brtul zhugs ldan pas spyad cing blang / /bzhi pa'i gnas lugs 'di bzhin te/ /tha snyad rig phyir mtha' bral bas/ /'dzin dang bzung ba med pa'i phyir/ /rang rig gsal bas khyab gnas pa'o/ /lnga pa bde chen brtan pa nyid/ /rang rig rkyen med rang gsal ba/ /sku dang ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /ngang nyid lhun gyes grub pa ni/ /rgyu 'bras rim pa'i dus bral ba/ /rgyu'i dus nyid 'bras sdogs pa'o/ /thob bya rgyu la mi gnas na/ /phyogs dus rgyu dang rkyen dag gis/ /kun nas slong thob rigs med de/ /bra sran 'bras su dbang bskur yang / /de la 'bras bu snang ba med/ /dbang mchog rang la gnas par ni/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i lung las gsungs/ /dbang rnams rang la med 'gyur na/ /bskur bas thob par mi 'gyur te/ /gdod nas ldan phyir mtshungs pa ste/ /43—817
