gzhi'i phyir thog mar bkod pa yin/ /lus gzhan bar ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /ngo bo dbang lnga thun mong du/ /lus ni bcu dang drug gis rdzogs/ snod dang dkyil 'khor skur ba'i dus/ /rang gi ngo bo nges tshig dang / /bskur rdzas thabs dang rgyu dang rkyen/ /gnas dang sgrib spong thob pa'i tshad/ /chos dang dgos ched skyon yon gyis/ /mdor bsdus lus kyi mtshan nyid bzhag /phan pa rgyas pa'i don bstan pa/ /phan dbang bcu la mos dang na/ /de nyid sbyin pa'i snod du bstan/ /rgyas 'bring dkyil 'khor ri mo ru/ /las kyi gzhung rdzogs phan dbang bskur/ /dang po sems bskyed 'jug dus su/ /rdzas kyi dbang bcu rdzogs par sbyin/ /ngo bo'i mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ /mtshon bya dbang dang mtshon byed de/ /mtshon bya bdag la rdzogs pa ste/ /mtshon byed rab gnas ldan pa'i rdzas/ /thob bya gang yin ngo bo ste/ /rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pas bskur ba yis/ /bdag la nus bskyes rno la ngar brtags bzhin/ /bdag la phan phyir ming du brjod/ /rdzas ni rnam bcu'i ngo bo nyid/ /las kyi rim pa rgyas pa yis/ /bskur ba'i thabs kun gsungs pa yin/ /mtshungs ldan lhan cig rgyu yin te/ /mtshungs pa rang bzhin gnas pa nyid/ /lhan cig byed pa rdzas bcu dngos/ /phyag rgya rang gi mtshan nyid dang / /gdugs la mi bskyod rab gnas te/ /bum pa rang gi byang chub sems/ /dbu brgyan rang bzhin snying po 'bras/ /'phreng ba cod pan rin chen pad/ /go cha rgyal mtshan rdo rje sems/ /bza' btung snang mdzad rab gnas ldan/ /dngos su las sbyor lhan cig rgyu/ /rkyen ni rgyu dang bdag po dang / /de ma thag pa dmigs pa bzhi / /slob ma'i yon tan bcu drug nyid/ /chags gnyis rang phyogs chang 43—818

dad chung / /dregs bskur phrag dog le lo med/ /snying rje ldan zhing kheng sems med/ /longs spyod mi chags nan tan ldan/ /yid ring ldog med rkyen thub cing / /dang ba'i sems ldan thob pa'i rgyu/ /dkyil 'khor bsgur rdzas dus nyid dang / /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /nus mthu mang po snang ba nyid/ /bdag po'i rkyen du brjod pa yin/ /dngos bcu skad kyi tshul dag gis/ /snga phyi ltos nas go 'byed pa/ /rgyu 'bras tshul de de ma thag /lta ba ting 'dzin nongs ldan zhing / /log pa'i lta 'bras byin brlabs can/ /las dang man ngag rgyu ldan pa/ /dngos rjas rdzogs pa'i slob dpon ni/ /rim pa nod pa'i yul du gsungs/ /gnas ni spyi dang khyad par te/ /gnas ni phyi dang nang gnyis te/ /phyi rol ri dang yul phyi dang / /sgrub khang sa nas lo rgyus can / /blang bya de bzlog nas/ de bzhin nang la stims gnyis/ /spyi dbang lus la bskur ba ste/ /brgyad par snying po dbu brgyan rmyebum/ /gdugs dang cod pan 'phreng ba gos/ /go cha lus te rgyal mtshan lag /bza' btung ngag gi lam la'o/ /phyag rgya spyi bo'am snying ga ste/ /gzhag pa'i gnas dang bstem pa'i gnas/ /de bzhin khong du chud pa gces/ /sgrib pa spong lugs spyi khyad par/ /las dang rnam smin phyogs cha re/ /skye gnas brgyad spong spyi'i ste/ /khyad par bkur gnas spyi dang sbyar/ /dbang thob ces pa'i tha snyad ni/ /spyad rgyu mngon sum thob pa yang / /go mi 'gog cing rig la snang / /tha mar sangs rgyas thob byed cing / /nus pa gang skyes thob pa'i tshad/ /chos dang chos ni nyan bshad de/ /phyi rol drang don mnyan bshad rung / /dkyil 'khor la sogs mtshan nyid bshad/ /brod dang g.yang sa shes phyir ro/ /43—819

dgos ched spyi dang khyad par ro/ /nus sgo 'byed dang sa bgrod phyir/ /skabs kyis rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /khyad par rang gi don du'o/ /skyon ma mgo 'gas chos mi thos/ /yon tan tshe ring bde ba thob/ /'di dang phyi mar thob pa'o / /nus pa'i snod ni bdag dang gzhan/ /gnyis ka'i don byed brtson ldan pa/ /khyad par snod ces bstan pa ste/ /bcu drug mtshan ldan spyi'i snod/ /phan bzhin ri mo'i dkyil 'khor dang / /yan lag lnga sogs dkyil 'khor te/ /slob ma'i dus su nus dbang bskur/ /phan pa thob pa'i dus nyid du/ /ngo bo mnyam bya bsgom bya sogs/ /dbang po yan lag gnas gsal ba'o/ /bdag gzhan don la nus gsal ba/ /rdzas ni glegs bam rgya gram dang / /'khor lo phreng ba rdo rje dril/ /'byung ldan don yod snang mtha' yas/ /yi dam rigs lnga'i rab gnas ldan/ /thabs ni dbang sogs gnas lnga ru/ /so so'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bgyed/ /rgyu ni rnam grangs bshad bzhin te/ /bdag gnas mtshungs rgyu la sogs pa/ /lhan cig rgyu ru bshad pa yin/ /nus la dad ldan rgyu'i rkyen/ /bdag po yan lag tshogs rmyepa'i mthu/ /de ma thag pa nus rim lnga//balhos nas 'bras go 'byed pa'o/ /dmigs pa mtshan ldan man ngag can/ /byin rlabs ldan pa pha nyid do/ /gnas ni rna ba snying lag dang / /lce dang yan lag rnam lnga'o/ /mgrin pa phan dang nus ming ste/ /khyad par phan dang nyon mongs dang / /tha mar rtog pa 'jil bar byed/ /thob pa'i tshad ni nus pa lnga//bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka'i don/ /spyod sgo ma 'gags thob pa'i tshad/ /chos ni nges grol nges bshad rnams/ /snang byed man chad nyan du rung / /dag pa gsang ba'i sgo 'byed dang / /bsgom dang dbugs phyung rjes su sbyar/ /43—820

don gnyis mthar phyin bya phyir ro/ /skyon ni dbang med las brtson dang / /de nyid glags pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /yon tan don mthar phyin byed pa'i/ /thams cad la ni thogs med pa'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang zhes brjod pa'i snod/ /spyod pa'i brtul shugs ldan pa yis/ /dam rdzas rnams la mdzem med pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor sor bzhi mdzub gang ste/ /phyi rol nang gi tshul du dbye'o/ /dus ni nus thob rdzogs slob pa'o/ /mtshan nyid bar mar 'jug pa yi/ /ngo bo rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /khu ba ye shes ro ldan pas/ /mi rtog myong ba'i dus ldan pa'o/ /thob bya rang gi ngo bo yi/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med drug /bla ma'i nyi zla ro ldan pa/ /ma thob rab tu snang med gsang / /de nyid byin pas snang med pa/ /bde dang mtshan ma skyes pa ni/ /dbang zhes tha snyad brjod pa yin/ /rdzas ni dngos dang nus pa ste/ /dngos ni nyi zla byang chub sems—/ /bskur thabs chen mchog gsal ba la/ /nus pa skyed phyir thob pa shun//las kyi rim pa thabs brjod de/ /sor bzhi pa nas che mchog par/ /mtshungs rgyu lngar bshad gnas lugs de/ /lhan cig byed rgyu ro ldan sems/ /rkyen ni brtul zhugs dang sems rgyu/ /yan lag tshang zhi'i nus pa dag /sbyor mnyam ldan pa'i slob ma'i yul/ /skad cig las rim go 'byed pa/ /de ma ①thag pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /gnas ni gzhan dang stem gnyis so/ /sems kyi dkyil nas drangs pa'i chu/ /khyod kyi lce la phab pa ni/ /snying gi dkyil du gzung bar byos//gdams pa lce nyid gnas bskul nas/ /yungs kar tshad tsam sems 'od kyis/ /rang rgyud sa bon bsreg sbyangs phyir/ /rnam smin sgrib pa phyogs gnyis dang / /khyad par ngag gi skyon sbyangs pa'o/ /thob tshad khu bas bsku ba'i dus/ /'od 43—821

gsal phyogs bde mtshan mthong ba'o/ /bde dang mtshan ma bu'i rtags/ /dpe don mtshon bya byed par shes/ /chos ni sdogs rim nyum lus dang / /gdams ngag dpog pa man chod nyan/ /'dzin pa'i nyes dmigs gnas brgyad bshadaske/ /yon tan sdug bsngal las grol bstan/ /'chad par gyur pa de bzhin no/ /gsum pa dbang gi rgyu phyir dang / /che'i dngos grub thob phyir ro/ /skyon ni chos rnams mi thos dang / /rim pa gong du bgod pa 'gag /khyad par bzhi pa'i dbang sgo 'gags/ /tshe ring 'gyur ba'i nus med pa'o/ /yon tan rgyal ba'i sras 'gyur nas/ /sgeg mo yum sogs byin rlob 'gyur/ /zab mo rnams kyi thun mong ste/ /khyad par man ngag snod du 'gyur/ /bzhi pa'i dbang gi snod bstan pa/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs ldan pa'o/ /sems kyi dkyil 'khor legs bstan la/ /rab gnas sngar bzhin rgyas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor nang gi rtsa gnas dang / /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /thun mong 'jug par gsang bar gcig /bzhi lam ting 'dzin gsal ba dang / /rdzogs rims ting 'dzin las rlung dgag /stong du gyur pa'i dus nyid du/ /thig le mtshan ldan lag tu gtad/ /ngo bo shes rab ye shes ni/ /mtshon bya mtshon byed rnam pa gnyis/ /dpe dang don gyi bde ba yang / /rgyu 'bras 'byung zlog skabs su shes/ /brag gdung gnyis phrad 'od gsal bde/ /bzlas pas lhan cig dag bral du/ /skyes pa'i gcig rig gsal ba yis/ /gsal ba mi rtog nyams rnyed pa'o/ /rig pa spros bral shes rab nyid/ /ma 'gags mi rtog gsal ba nyid/ /thabs kyi gsal bya dbang du brjod/ /rdzas kyi skabs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /zla ba ldan pa gtad pa'o/ /thabs ni bden pa'i 43—822

tshig bzhin te/ /zab mo'i theg par grol byed pa'i/ /mi slu thabs kyi man ngag sbyin/ /don nyid mngon byed bden tshig go/ /rgyu ni bshad bzhin rnam pa gnyis—/ /rang rig gsal rig mtshungs pa'i rgyu/ /bden tshig sbyin pa lhan cig byed/ /bcu drug phyag rgya zla ldan pa'o/ /las dang dgag sogs slab goms pas/ /zla ba'i thig le gnyis bstan pa'o/ /rig pa'i shugs dang ldan sems bus/ /thob bya thob phyir rgyu'i rkyen/ /byed pa'i sdom pa la sogs dang / /cha dang bsod nams ting 'dzin byin/ /phyag rgya'i yon tan 'dzoms pa'i mthus//bde ba skyed phyir bdag po'i rkyen/ /shes rab ye shes nyams lon pa'o/ /bu la snang ba'i byin brlabs can/ /de lta'i pha ni dmigs pa'i rkyen/ /shes rab ye shes 'pho ba'i chas/ /rgyu 'bras go 'byed de ma thag /bden tshig sbyin zhing bde snang ba'i/ /gnas ni rig pa'i pho brang ngo / /thams cad rdos pa'i dngos bral bas/ /rang rig gsal phyir shes bya'i phyogs/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa dka' nas sbyangs/ /sa bcu sems la gnas par sbyong / /shes rab ye shes thob pa ni/ /brag gdung lta bur phyed myong 'phrad/ /de la brten nas rig gsal ba/ /gsal la rtog med nyams myong la/ /rgyu 'bras byung tshul rten can no/ /de nyid thabs lon rten med de/ /gzhi phyir phyag rgya 'bras mi nyam/ /rjes su 'jug par bshad pa yin/ /bzlog skabs nyi zla nang 'dres dus/ /lhan cig dga' bral gnas su zin/ /de'i bde ba rtog med gsal/ /rten dang rten 'jug bshad bzhin no/ /gsang bshad khyad par thabs kyi mchog /'od gsal bde dang thabs rnams mnyam/ /bstan pa'i dbang la sbyang phyir dang //sangs rgyas mthar thug bya phyir nod/ /shes shes pa shes ma rnyed na/ /rdo rje 43—823

bskal pa mtha' glags par/ /'od gsal bde ba med par ni/ /nam mkha'i chu skyes bzhin de skyon/ /skyon bzlog yon tan nyid du 'gyur/ /grangs kyi lnga pa'i ngo bo bstan/ /mthar thug bde ba chen po'i dbang / /snod ni mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs ldan/ /dkyil 'khor lnga bzhi thun mong ste/ /dus ni phyi dang nang gi ste/ /phyi rol sa bcu mthar phyin dang / /shes rab ye shes thob pa'o /nang gi sa rlung rgyu ba'i dus/ /ngo bo bden gnyis dbyer med pa'o/ /ye shes chen po thob bya de'o/ /nges tshig rnam grangs lnga par brjod/ /don dang ngo bo bstan bde chen/ /gnyis med bde ba mtha' bral ba/ /grub dang bde ba gcig par bde/ /ngo bo 'gyur med brtan par brjod/ /de nyid rten dang brten can dang / /mtshon bya mtshon byed dpe dang don/ /dngos dang rdzas 'jug rim dang zlog /de ltar grangs don shes bya'o/ /rten can pa ni nyi ma dag /zla bar 'dres pa kha sgyur zlog /sa lu yu sbubs chu 'dren bzhin/ /goms pas ri mos drangs pa'i rgyus/ /chu mar bzhin 'dres bden bde ni/ /rgyu las skyed phyir rten can te/ /ngo bo mtshon phyir dpe ru brjod/ /phyag rgya bral yang nyams med pa'i/ /gnyis med ye shes gsal ba ni/ /rten las 'byung ba'i rten med de/ /rjes 'jug rnal 'byor brda' zhes brjod/ /sa bon gnyis 'dres skyes pa ni/ /rgyu 'bras rim pa'i dbang du brjod/ /thig le bsgyur bas mthar phyin dus/ /skyes pa brjod pa'i dbang du brjod/ /rdzas ni phyag rgya nyi ldan pa'o/ /bskur thabs bzlog pa'i man ngag dang / /bde ba rin chen tshim sbyin pa'o/ /bden gnyis dbyer med bdag gi sems/ /ye nas gnas pa mtshungs zhes bshad/ /nyi zla ldan dus sbyin pa'i las rim pa 43—824

lhan cig byed pa'o/ /mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs rab ldan zhing / brtan pa'i dpal ldan dad pa'i bu/ /rgyu'i rkyen du brjod pa yin/ /bzlog pa'i ral rims man ngag tshogs/ /bde ba'i gzhi phyir bdag por brjod/ /brtan dbang nyams dang tsher ldan pas/ /bu la snang bus pha nyid yul/ /rim gyis bzlog pa bcu gsum po/ /thig le 'phos pas go 'byed pa/ /rgyu 'bras tshul de de ma thag /gnas ni khyad par thun mong ngo / /sa bcu mthar phyin byang chub sems/ /rigs la gnas pa'i shes rig 'phra/ /'phra ba'i 'phra dang shes sgrib gnon/ /mun dang snang bzhin ma gsal dag /tshad ni skabs kyis gnyis 'gyur te/ /skad cig ma dang rgyun dbang du/ /zung 'jug bde ba gsal ba ste/ /dpe don cha gnyis dbye ba shes/ /chos ni 'bras bu pad+ma spyad/ /mthar thug ma lus mnyam du rung / /thig le nyi zla dbyer med pa'i/ /bdag gzhan bde ba spong ba ni/ /bskal pa'i rnam grangs ji snyed pa'i/ /mthar phyin mi thob skyon zhes bya/ /yon tan ma lus lhun grub pa'i/ /mgo lus kha lce bye bas kyang / /dus tshigs mi mthun mang brjod kyang / /zad byed phyir sdogs mi 'gyur ro/ /tha ma'i don kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /lam gyis bsgrubs pas 'bras bu ste / /lam du rgyu dang 'bras bu ste/ /bdag yul gnyis kar shes par bya/ /phyag rgya ma la cig car te/ /pha la rim pa'i dbang du brjod/ /rim pa'i las 'bras skad cig ma/ /bcu drug dag bzhi mchog la bzhi/ /gang bral rtsa lnga tshogs sbyor lam/ /gnyis pa'i gnyis sogs tha mar ba/ /sa bcu 'og gsal bcu gcig ste/ /pha rol phyin dang sa mtshan nyid/ /mtshungs phyir dpe don bde bar sbyor/ /'pho ba yod phyir lam gyi 'bras/ /bzlog pa'i skabs su yang 43—825

de bzhin shes/ /skabs kyi 'bras bu'ang 'di bzhin te/ /phan pa'i dbang bsgur dus 'di nas/ /rgyal ba'i sras 'gyur lha'i ming / /'khor lo sgyur sogs longs spyod ldan/ /dam pa'i gsang sngags spyod bskal ldan/ /brgyud nas kun bzang nyid du 'gyur/ /de yang spyod dang khyad par ro/ /nus pas lha mi nor 'grub ste/ /bdag gzhan las rnams mthar phyung bas/ /bsod nams tshogs rnams mngon sdogs te/ /bgrod nas sku gsum tha mar 'grub/ /gsang ba dbang thob 'bras bu nyid/ /'od gsal phyogs kyi bde ldan pas/ /khams gsum kun da'i zhing khams mthong / /de phyir bde dang mtshan ma brtag/bzhi pa'i dbang gis 'bras bu ni/ /sa rims kun tu 'od thob nyid/ /rten pa'i rgyu ni brag gdung ste/ /sangs rgyas dang po de 'bras bu/ /yang na nyi zla 'dres bzlog bde/ /skad cig rgyun gyis dpe don thob/ /lnga pa'i 'bras bu mthar thugs/ /nyi ma zla ba 'phrad pa'i rgyud/ /gsum pa'i bde ba'i ye shes ni//myong la mi 'dzin pad+ma spyan/ /rtsar gnas lhar gsal 'khor lo yis/ /lhar gsal mi 'dzin shes rab thabs/ /'gro don lhun 'char thabs kyi sa/ /rang 'byung chen po ye shes sa/ /lam 'dres mi phyed kun bzang sa/ /dngos po nyid du mtshon pa'i dpe/ /skad cig rgyun dus bshad bzhin no/ /skabs su 'phros pa dbang gi don/ /de dag tha ma'i spyod yul te/ /brnyan ma'i dkyil 'khor las kyi yum/ /dngos su rten pas dman don te/ /'bras bu'ang mtshon pa'i bde ba skye/ /dus kyang skad cig dbang tsam ste/ /slob ma bshad pa'i snod ldan pa/ /bla ma rim pa'i drod thob pas/ /kun na byin brlabs skye bar 'dod/ /blo 'bring ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor du/ /slob dpon ting 43—826

'dzin gral non pas/ /drod thob slob ma dbang bskur ba/ /drod thob sa la sbyar phyir sbyin/ /rig pa'i lha mo dag dang sbyor/ /'bras bu dngos su rigs 'dzin thob/ /blo rab rigs 'dzin sa thob pa/ /bla ma bde bar gshegs nyid de / /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas nyid sbyar phyir/ /ye shes phyag rgya mos dang sbyar/ /'bras bu yang dag dze+egs sangs rgyas / /rin chen rgya mtsho rdo rje sems/ /sgyu 'phrul pa'i rgyud nyid las/ /byed pa yab yum sbyor ba yis/ /dbang bskur chos bshad 'khor rnams kyis/ /rgyud rtogs sngon byung shes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor tha mar phyin pa'o// //sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho'i dngos lnga nyon mongs pa/ /rig pa'i kyi gnas bsrungs te bsdus pa'i/ /man ngag thabs mchog 'di thob don rtogs nas/ /lam gnyis rnal 'byor ma lus mthar phyin no/ /de ltar thabs lam don phye nas/ /kun gyi theg chen don mthong ste/ /dug gi nad sel bde rnyed ltar/ /nyon mongs nyid kyis grol bar shog /dbang gi don rab tu 'byed pa rdzogs so// //slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'o// //43—827

༄khya/ /thugs kyi thigs pa zhes bya ba/khye༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsi ta bi du nā ma/ bod skad du/ thugs kyi thigs pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo ma byas lhun rdzogs khyab gsal 'jigs med kun ma spangs/ /mi phyed gcig snang ma lus rang rig nyid du sgrol/ /swa ti ka bzhin dngos lngas mngon par dzegs pa'i sku/ /zhar byung lnga gnyis bco lnga'i bdag nyid che la 'dud/ /gsum gnyis go lo mchod byas nas/ /bcu par lnga gnyis gcig gsal bas/ /'dir min lnga'i rig pa nyid/ /'bras bcas pa tra shas bshad bya/ /bcu pa'i bcu drug nyams rnyed pas/ /sku bzhi'i dkyil 'khor khams thig le/ /ji bzhin shes pa de nyid las/ /chos lo gyen du rim pa bzhin/ /spros bcas med dang ldan bsgoms pas/ /khyad par thabs kyis rims bsgul nas/ /rim par skye ba'i ye shes ro/ /lha mig dag pas shes par bya/ /yi ge lnga dang 43—829

gsum gnas su/ /mi dmigs ye shes rtags yul can/ /skar zla'i dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /gnyis med thabs kyis rten shes na/ /gnyis med sems kyi snang ba'o/ /brtags bral shes rab 'od gsal ba'i/ /phyi nang kun gsal rang rig dngos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes che/ /me long lta bu'i rgya tshogs snang / /thun mong sdig las grol bar 'gyur/ /de nyid stobs 'gyur rnal 'byor che/ /dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thig le nyid/ /phan tshun rgyu 'bras tshul shes pas/ /chos khams g.yas g.yon tshul rigs lnga/ /rnam shes bdag po rten 'dus rnams/ /g.yas g.yon rims bzlog brgyad gnyis shes/ /dpung gsang lte khro de bzhin te/ /bya byed hūṃ phaṭa gsal bar bya /rang mtshungs lha nyid drangs mchod bzlas/ /bcu gsum drug gi dkyil 'khor gnyis/ /shes rab thabs la rnam par brtag /thabs lam rol mo'i mes bzhu ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor las byung gsang thig le/ /bya byed gnas su lhag pa'i ro/ /gsal bas kun kyang ye shes blta'o/ /'od zer snying po nyi ma dang / /ye shes thig le mnyam spyor bas/ /shes rab snying rje gnyis med pa'o/ /bde ba chen por lhun gyis grub/ /gur gum bzung bslabs goms las kyis/ /bde chen yig gsum gnas bzhugs na/ /gsang sngags ngo bor rang gsal ba/ /dgyes pa chen por stobs par bshad/ /yungs kar ltung med bde ba yis/ /ye shes skad cig rim skye ba/ /rang bzhin rang snang chos kyi sku/ /sprul pa sna tshogs ro ldan pa/ /bdag gsal 'dzin bral pad+ma can/ /gsang thig rang gnas rang rig pa/ /me la shing bsnan ji bzhin du/ /'khor lo kun gyi gzhir gyur las/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus dngos yin phyir/ /lam gnas kun 43—830

tu spros thim pas/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis nyi shu lnga/ /ma lus snang bas/ zhi khro 'dres mas thabs shes sogs/ /gdul bya bsam bzhin dbang bsgyur 1ba/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor mtha' yas rdzogs phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas snying po kha spyor las/ /dkyil 'khor lnga sogs bsal med snang / /rgyu tshul 'thun pas don byas kyang / /bya byed gang yang dmigs mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin mnyam sdogs thig le ba/ /shes rab gsum mthar lam rim gyis/ /dus gsum kun mnyam lhun gyis grub/ /gcig dang du ma'i mtha' bral bas thams cad tshul nyid 'di 'dra shes/ /lam 'dir gnas la sras bcas ril/ /thugs rjes ring nas byin rlob mdzad/ /bskal mang bsal bas 'di thob ste/ /rgyal ba ma lus mdzad dgongs phyir/ /gang yang 'da' 'gyur rigs ma yin/ /de nas thams cad phyag rgya 'dis/ /blo ldan chags bral ngang du mkhyen/ /'dod tshol bsam mang thabs shom dang / /dam nyams g.yo rgyus tshod len zhing / /bka' gcig la spel bka' rkus pas/ /srog chad dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal thob/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyang sdang / /lhar bcas rnal 'byor smos ci dgos/ /de bas rab tu snod brtag bya/ /sgyu 'phrul thugs kyi thigs pa sgogs so// //43—831

༄ga /gsang ba'i thigs pa'i man ngagakle༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ghu yā rnyi du u pa de sha /bod skad du/gsang ba'i thigs pa'i man ngag /dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la yod pa rnam pa brgyad du shes/ /gang la ci 'dra de nyid bsres pa yin/ /rnam bzhi bye brag drug las brgyad dkyil na/ /don dam snying po de la phyag 'tshal lo / /gang la snyoms 'jug de la yod pa la/ /de la yod de de la blta bar bya/ /gang las byung ba de las byung ba yin/ /de las de byung de nyid kho na'o/ /gsang ba'i shes rab thig le dbyings/ /bcu drug gnyis kyi dkyil na bzhugs/ /shes rab thabs kyi snyoms 'jug la/ /kun tu rgyas btab dkyil 'khor yin/ /bdag nyid chen po lnga blta zhing / /thur du 'phro zhing gyen du 'bar/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pa yis/ /gong gi snying po bskul bar byed/ /de 'od thig le mnyam sbyor bas/ /lnga gnyis drug gi dkyil na'o/ /bde ba chen po'i ro yis ni//43—833

dgyes pa chen por rtogs par bya/ /shes bya 'byung zad bsod nams kyi①/ /de nyid sgyu mar rang snang ba/ /gzigs mo'i bde ba mtha' yas kyis/ /bde ba chen po'i 'be+en la phog /bcu gsum gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor lo/ /de'i thig le mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /kun gyi dngos yin kun gyi gtso/ /bcu dang bzhi ni mngon rdzogs pa/ /gsum dang gnyis su yang dag gnas/ /kun gyis dngos por bdag gyur pa/ /de la dbang sgyur dam pa yin/ /nying la gnas pa gnas nyid la/ /de la gnyis rdzogs lhun gyis grub/ /thams cad de'i rgyan du che/ /gnyis rdzogs thig le mnyam sbyor bas/ /snying rje chen po yongs kyis 'char / /bcu bzhi'i sems can 'dul ba la/ /sgyu ma'i sems can sgrol ba yi / /rnal 'byor chen po 'od ldan spyod/ /'di la rtag tu gang 'dug pa/ /sangs rgyas sras dang 'khor bcas kyis/ /thugs rje nyi ma shugs las 'byung / /de la bde byed bde ba sbyin/ /bskal pa rdul snyed grangs med du/ /thos bsam sgoms pa rab mtha' las/ /'byung ba bde ba chen po yin/ /slob dpon rten byed kye 'di lta/ /gang la gang med gang la 'ang / /de la de med de la 'ang / /dmyal bar bsreg dang sdug bsngal che/ /de bas gzhan du bstan mi bya/ /gsang ba'i man ngag thig le 'di/ /thig le chen po 'di snang bas/ /sems can kun gyi rang bzhin la/ /bde ba chen po snang bar shog /gsang ba'i thigs pa'i man ngag /slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //43—834

bsdur mchan/833 humatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stanasang ba'i thigs pa'i man ngag zhugs so//834 ①〈〈pe 〉7)sa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2527)43wa 835

༄/ /rnal 'byor chen po shes rab spyan 'byed kyi man ngag ces bya ba/1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yo ga pradz+nyā pyapra be+e sha tsak+ṣu u pa de sha nā ma / bod skad du/ rnal 'byor chen po shes rab spyan 'byed kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo skyes bu'i mchog /dam pa lha phyir phyag 'tshal nas/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud don mchog /rang bzhin rkyen gyis mngon bya'i phyir/ /rgyud gsum snang ba rnal 'byor gsum/ /bya byed tshul gnyis bdag nyid dang / /tshig don dang ni de nyid can/ /rgyu 'bras thabs tshul 'byel phyir gsum/ /shes thob byed pa bar tshul la/ /ngo bo rkyen bshad thabs dang dbye/ /rim par mi brjod 'dir brjod pa/ /dang po bar mas mthar byed pa'i/ /lam gnyis thun mong rgyu dang mchog /mchog la phyi dang nang la 'ang / /thabs dang shes rab lam gnyis kyis / /nges byed sngon la steng 'og thabs/ /cig rngushos gtsor byed spyi blugs 43—836

rim / /bzhi bral lngas dbul las bzlog pa'i①// /rnal 'byor che la mos rnams kyi/ /shi sha'i ⑤don phyir mdo tsam brjod/ /phun sum tshogs pa lhun grub rnams/ /gsang dbang mchog gis 'byen byed pa'o/ /sngon byas thabs mchog chags mchog don/ /sangs rgyas zhabs kyis gsungs par shes/ /thos bsams sgoms 1pa'i mnyam sbyor gyis/ /rang 'byung kun dam lhun grub phyir—/ /bsum ④gyis grol byed lam bshad pa/ /mtshan nyid gsum la gcig bzhi rgya gsum/ /gtso mchog mtshan nyid dang po bshad/ /lam kun gzungs su bya phyir ro/ /de la brtag bya thabs ngo bos/ /nges tshig rtags kyang du dang / /khyad par gol sa yon tan skyon/ /spyan mchog lus su rnam par bsgrags/ /'ching grol byed pa lhun rdzogs kyang / /dbang spyan mchog dang bral ba yis/ /srid rgyu 'bras bu ming tsam snang / /dang po chu bo bzhi rgal ltar/ /snang ba gcig la gnyis tshul snang / /ngan shos bdag gzhan stong phur snang / /de de rim par grub ma grub/ /mtha'i don rnams cir 'gyur brtag /mthong byed thabs kyang rgyud pa dang / /rtags kyis mtshon cing gtan la 'bebs/ /dman la rgya gsum goms pa yis/ /brtan nas brtags spyad klung zhugs mthong //bsgom pa lam du bstan par bya/ /rim par skye la the tshom med/ /shes bya dam pa rtags mtshon pa'ang / /rang bzhin rtags dang 'bras bu'i rtags/ /dang po rang gi rigs pa yis/ /cho 'phrul snang ba'i 'byung ba dang / /phyogs dang kha dog la sogs kyis/ /mtshon nas ji bzhin nyid rtogs byed/ /sems can ma lus thams cad la/ /ye shes lnga yis kun khyab kyang / /rang gi rnam rtog bsgribs byas te/ /ye shes lnga'i don ma mthong ma mthong rmongs pa thams 43—837

cad la/ /ye shes mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ /dkar dang dmar dang ser ba dang / /ljang gu la sogs nag por bstan/ /'di yis lhun grub rtogs par ces/ /cig shos mthar phyin ye shes kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rten dang brten can ltar/ /snang ba'i gnas brgyan gdan sogs dang / /rten cing rgya bzhi rgyan sogs mtshungs/ /gtan tshig rgyas par lus bzhag na/ /tshad ①ma bka' gzhung gtan tshigs dang / /sgra mthun don spags gtan tshigs kyis/ /gzhal bya bdag nyid tshe sogs blta/ /tshad ma bka' la dag mnyam grangs/ /rtogs pa bzhi dang bden gsum dag /skabs kyis bya thabs mthar 'gyur yang / /byed la gtsor brjod dag pa yis/ /snang ba mi spong 'bras bu 'ubyed/ /mnyam pas mnyam byed bdag nyid che/ /rtogs pa rnam bzhi'i gtan tshigs kyis//mi zad rgyun gyi 'khor lor byed/ /bden pa gnyis med zung du 'jug /ldems dgongs man ngag gtan tshigs kyis/ /skabs kyis don nyid mthong bar byed / /dngos po lo rgyus gtan tshigs kyis/ /bdag nyid chen po smos ci dgos / /rang bzhin gtan tshigs lhun grub 'jug /'on tang tha dad don la med/ /sgra mthun don spags rang dang spyi/ /mtshan nyid gzhal mtha' bral ba'o / /chos kun rang dang spyir btags pas/ /ma skyes thams cad mkhyen pa'i don/ /rnam pa kun ldan stong par snang / /de phyir sku gsung thugs su snang / /dngos kun gcig dang du mar bral/ /mtha' gsum dang ni bzhi bral lugs—/ /khyad par can kyis de nyid mthong / /de yang ma spangs bral bar brjod / /rnam par dbye dang mtshon pa'i dpe/ /de bzhin nyid du the tshom rnged—/ /shes rab spyan gyis ngo bo nyid/ /gnyis kyi ngo bo skabs 'jug kyang / /43—838

rgyu 'bras phyir na cig shos la/ /yul med rang rig mngon sum pa'o/ /bye brag 'dod gzhung gtan tshigs kyis/ /zhor brjod bcu gsum rnam grangs tsam//mthong byed nges tshig mthong lta gnyis/ /sgros bral skur med don chen po/ /sa lu phub khrod snang med bzhin/ /yul med rang gsal nyams rnyed la/ /mthong zhes tha snyad brjod par zad/ /de phyir blta dang blta med pas/ /chos kun rang rig nyid snang ba/ /me long lta bu'i tshul bzhin du/ /mi rtog gsal bas nges tshig 'grub/ /de ltar skyes mchog su ldan pa/ /dam la rub cing snying rjer ldan/ /pha la drin skye man ngag 'tsho'o/ /mi skyo don brtson chags bral 'byung / /spyod zhib nyam nga g.yang sa med/ /de yod dmigs dang ldan pa'i rtags / /rnal 'byor che la phyir rgyu dang / /mu stegs zhor 'byung rig byed dang / /ngo bo rgyur smra phyogs lung rten/ /bdun sde mnyam 'jog la sogs kyis//reg min de las gzhi nas spags/ /lta spyod mi mthun smos ci dgos/ /bskal par sbyangs pas don mthong ba/ /phyin chad mi ldog sa la gnas/ /spyod sogs las kun pha rol phyin/ /gzungs kyi dam par rgyal bas gsungs/ /shes rab spyan dang ma ldan na/ /dkar phyogs lha mi stegs tsam las/ /spyad kyang mi thob 'chi bar 'gyur/ /nag po'i las spyod smos ci dgos/ /tshig tsam lta la rten byed cing / /dam med spyod cing sgo dgu yi/ /nyod pa byed de thar bar dka'//stegs dbang tsam kyis rnyed dka' bas/ /sgra 'dul bdud bzlog brtson par 'bod / /de med nam yang thar mi srid/ /spyo ①dang skyon bcos mi bzod cing / /lci dang gdung med 'dod thob nas/ /mi khur spongs byed rigs ma nges//ltung byed de dang ma phrad cig /de bzlog snod ldan dpal du shog /des kyang 43—839

26༷2༄༅/ /man ngag gi rgyal po lta ba'i phreng ba/shā ga lta ba dang theg pa la sogs pa'i khyad par bsdus pa'i bskyus byang / rak+ṣa/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang / rdo rje chos la phyag 'tshal lo 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sems can phyin ci log gi lta ba grangs med pa'i mdo rnam pa bzhir 'dus te/ phyal ba dang / rgyang phan dang / mur thug pa dang / mu stegs pa'o/ /de la phyal ba ni chos thams cad la rgyu dang 'bras bu yod med du ma gtogs te/ kun tu rmongs pa'o/ /rgyang phan pa tshe snga phyi yod med du ma gtogs shing / tshe gcig la btsan phyug dang / mthu stobs bsgrub pa ste/ 'jig rten gyi gsang tshig la brten pa'o/ /mur thug pa ni chos thams cad ni rgyu dang 'bras bu med pa ste/ tshe gcig la skyes pa'i chos thams cad kyang glo bur du skyes la/ mtha' chad par lta'o/ /43—841

mu stegs pa ni/ chos thams cad la kun tu btags pa'i bdag rtag pa zhig yod par lta ba ste/ de yang rgyu med pa la 'bras bu yod par blta ba dang /rgyu 'bras log par lta ba dang / rgyu yod pa la 'bras bu med par lta ba'o/ /'di dag ni ma rig pa'i lta ba'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la yang rnam pa gnyis te/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la yang rnam pa gsum ste/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'o/ /de la nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa'i lta ba rnams ni/ chos thams cad la mu stegs la sogs pa yis sgro dang bkur bar btab pa'i ye med par blta ba dang / rtag pa la sogs pa yod par lta ba ni/thag pa la sbrul du mthong ba med/ phung po dang / skye lkumached dang / khams la sogs pa 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i/ rdul phra rab dang / rnam par shes pa ni don dam par yod par lta ba dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi sgoms pa'i rims kyis/ 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi grub pa yin no/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi lta ba ni/ chos thams cad la mu stegs la sogs pas/ sgro dang bkur bar kun tu rtags pa'i bdag rtag pa la sogs pa med par lta ba ni nyan thos dang mthun/ de la khyad par du gzugs kyi phung po chos kyi khams kyi phyogs gcig la bdag med par rtogs shing /rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i dus na yang nyan thos ltar dge ba'i bshes 43—842

—gnyen la mi ltos par/ sngon goms pa'i shugs kyis rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas/ chos nyid zab mo rtogs nas/ rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu 'grub pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la/ zhugs pa rnams kyi lta ba ni/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i chos thams cad don dam par ni rang bzhin med pa yin la/ kun rdzob tu ni sgyu ma tsam du mtshan nyid ma 'dres par yod de/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu spyad pa'i 'bras bu sa bcu rims kyis bgrod pa'i mtha'—/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'grub par 'dod pa yin no// //rdo rje theg pa la yang gsum ste/ bya ba rgyud kyi theg pa dang / gnyis ka rgyud kyi theg pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi theg pa'o/ /de la bya ba rgyud kyi theg pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi lta ba ni/ don dam par skye 'gag med pa las/ /kun rdzob tu lha'i gzugs kyi skur bsgom zhing sku'i gzugs brnyan dang / thugs mtshan dang / bzlas brjod dang / gtsang sbra dang / dus tshigs dang /gza' dang rgyu skar la sogs pa/ gtsor yo byad dang rgyu rkyen 'tshogs pa'i mthus 'grub pa'o/ /gnyis ka rgyud kyi theg pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi lta ba ni/ don dam par skye 'gag med pa las/ kun rdzob tu lha'i sku nyid rnam pa bzhi dang ldan par bsgoms pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yo byad dang rgyu rkyen la sogs pa gnyis ka la 43—87/3

yang brten nas 'grub pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi theg pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi lta ba ni/ rnam pa gnyis te/ rnal 'byor phyi pa thub pa rgyud kyi theg pa dang / rnal 'byor nang pa thabs kyi rgyud kyi theg pa'o/ /de la rnal 'byor phyi la thub pa rgyud kyi theg pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi lta ba ni/ phyi'i yo byad la gtso bor mi 'dzin par/ don dam par skye 'gag med pa'i lha dang lha mo dang / de dang 'dra ba'i rgyud yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'phags pa'i gzugs kyi sku phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan par bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i gtsor byas pas 'grub bo/ /rnal 'byor nang pa thabs kyi rgyud kyi theg pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi lta ba ni/rnam pa gsum ste/ bskyed pa'i tshul dang / rdzogs pa'i tshul dang / rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul lo/ /de la bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum rims bzhin du bskyed cing / dkyil 'khor rim bzhin bkod nas/bsgoms pas 'grub bo/ /rdzogs pa'i tshul ni/ don dam par skye 'gag med pa'i lha dang lha mo'i rnam par mi rtog /dbu ma chos kyi dbyings las kyang ma g.yos la/ kun rdzob tu gzugs kyi sku yang gsal bar bsgom zhing / mnyam la ①ma 'dres par bsgoms pas 'grub bo/ /43—844

rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad dbyer med par sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin ye nas yin par rtogs nas bsgom pa ste/ de yang rgyud las rdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags/ /skye mched khams rnams mang po kun/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /sa chu tū spyan dang mā ma gī—/ /me rlung gos dkar sgol ma ste/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /srid gsum ye nas rnam par dag /ces 'byung ste/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ye nas ma skyes la/ bya byed nus pa'i sgyu ma bde bar gshegs pa yab yum bcu la sogs pa'i rang bzhin ye nas yin pa'i phyir / chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ chen po lnga ni yum lnga'i rang bzhin yin/ /phung po lnga ni rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la/rnam par shes pa bzhi ni byang chub sems dpa' bzhi'i rang bzhin/ yul bzhi ni mjos pa lha mo bzhi'i rang bzhin/ dbang po bzhi ni byang chub sems dpa' bzhi'i rang bzhin/ dus bzhi ni mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi'i rang bzhin/ lus kyi dbang po dang / rnam par shes pa dang / yul dang / de las 'byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ni khro bo bzhi'i rang bzhin/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rdo rje kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin/ yul chos 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas ni kun tu bzang mo'i rang bzhin te/ de dag kyang ye nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin yin gyi༄ /da lam gyis bsgrub pa ni ma yin no/ /de ltar phyogs bcu dang dus gsum dang /khams gsum la sogs pa/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos thams cad 43—845

rang gi sems las gud na med na/ ji skad du/ rang gi sems so sor rtogs pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub de nyid do/ /'jig rten gsum po de nyid de/ /'byung ba che rnams de nyid do/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /ji skad du/ chos thams cad ni sems la gnas so/ /sems ni nam mkha' la gnas so/ /nam mkha' ni byu yang mi gnas so/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni gzod ma nas rnam par dag pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni yongs kyis 'od gsal ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni ye nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /'di rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul lo/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul ni/ rtogs pa rnam bzhi lam gyis yid ches pa ste / de la rdzogs pa chen po ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pas/'bras bu chos lhun gyis grub pa'i don no/ /tshul ni don la 'jug pa'o/ /rtogs pa rnam bzhi ni/ rgyu gcig par rtogs pa dang / yig 'bru'i tshul gyis rtogs pa dang / byin gyis brlabs par rtogs pa dang / mngon sum par rtogs pa'o /de la rgyu gcig par rtogs pa ni/ chos thams cad don dam par ma skyes pas/ so so ma yin pa dang / kun rdzob sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid kyis so so ma yin pa dang / ma skyes pa nyid chu bzla hūṃltar sgyu ma sna tshogs su snang zhing bya ba byed nus nga dang / sgyu ma nyid ngo bo med do/ /ma skyes pas kun rdzob dang / don dam par dbyer med pas rgyu gcig par rtogs pa'o/ /yig 'bru'i tshul kyis rtogs pa ni/ /chos thams cad ma skyes pa ni a ste 43—846

gsung gi rang bzhin la/ ma skyes pa nyid sgyu mar snang zhing bya ba byed nus pa ni oṃ ste sku'i rang bzhin/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rig pa ye shes sgyu ma mtha' dang dbus med pa ni hūṃ ste thugs kyi rang bzhin du rtogs pa'o/ /byin gyis brlabs par rtogs pa ni/ dper na ras dkar po la dmar pos byin gyis brlab pa'i mthu rtsod la yod pa bzhin du/ chos thams cad sangs rgyas par byin gyis brlob pa'i mthu yang rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul gyis mthus byin gyis brlabs par rtogs pa'o/ /mngon sum par rtogs pa ni/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par gnas pa de yang lung dang man ngag dang 'gal ba yang ma yin la/ lung dang man ngag gi tshig tsam la rten pa yang ma yin la/ rang gi rig pas blo'i gting du yid ches par mngon sum du rtogs pa'o/ /lam gyi yid ches pa ni/ rtogs pa rnam bzhi'i don rig pa de nyid rnal 'byor pa'i lam /zhe yin te/ de yang rgyu bsgrub pas 'bras bu 'byung ba'i dus la ltos pa lta bu ni ma yin gyi/ rang gi rig pas mngon sum du rtogs shing yid ches pa'o / /de la mtshan nyid gsum gyis don mthar phyin par 'gyur te/ rtogs pa rnam bzhi'i tshul rig pa ni/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /yang nas yang du goms par byed pa ni/ 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /goms pa'i mthus mngon du gyur pa ni—/ 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid do/ /mtshan nyid gsum gyi 'brel ba dang / dgos pa dang / dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'o/ /de la 'brel pa ni ②kun nas nyon mongs pa'o/ /rnam par byang ba'i chos su brtags pa thams cad ye nas sku gsung 43—847

thugs kyi bdag nyid/ rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas pa'i dbyings dang / byin gyis brlabs yin pa'i don rtogs pa ni shes pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de bla na med par sangs rgyas su 'grub pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir dgos pa'o/ /dgos pa ni kun nas nyon mongs pa/ rnam par byang ba dang chos dang /sman lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga la sogs par btags pa thams cad/ ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i mnyam pa chen po la blang dor yomed par spyod pa ni 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de ni bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas su grub pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir dgos pa'o/ /dgos pa'i yang dgos pa ni/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i chos dang / sman lnga dang / bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i khyad par du brtags pa thams cad/ ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du/ blang dor med par srid pa'i 'khor ba nyid ye nas bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtshan nyid lhun gyis grub pa yin pas/ 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid de/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan bye gyi 'khor lo mngon du gyur pa ni/ dgos pa'i dgos pa'o/ /de la bsnyen pa dang / nye ba'i bsnyen pa dang / bsgrub pa dang bsgrub pa chen pos/ /don lhun kyis grub par gyur pas/ rnal 'byor la brtson par bya'o / /de la bsnyen pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems shes pa ste/ de yang chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin du da lam gyis bsgrub cing gnyen pos bcos su med par rtogs pa'o/ /43—848

nye ba'i bsnyen pa ni bdag nyid lhar shes pa ste/ de yang chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin ①yin pas/ bdag nyid kyang ye nas lha'i rang bzhin yin par shes kyi/ da bsgrub pa ni ma yin par rtogs pa'o/ /bsgrub pa 'di ni yum bskyed pa ste/ de yang yum chen mo nam mkha'i dbyings las/ nam mkha' nyid yum chen mo/ sa chu me rlung bzhir snang /bya ba med pa'i yum ye nas yin par rtogs pa'o/ /bsgrub pa ni thabs dang shes rab 'byel pa ste/ de yang yum chen mo lnga'i shes rab dang / yum gyi nam mkha' stong pa nyid las/ phung po lnga'i sangs rgyas thabs kyis yab/ rngon pa med pa ye nas zung du 'gyur ba'i 'brel pa las byang chub kyi sems sprul pa tsam bral du gyur pa'i rang bzhin/ ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don sgyu ma la sgyu ma rol cing bde mchog sgyu ma'i rgyun la/ bde ba'i dus nyid na/mtshan ma med pa'i don mi dmigs nam mkha' dang snyoms pa ni/ klong du gyur nas lhun gyis grub pa ste/ bdud rnam bzhi yang brtul bas mthar phyin pa'i don 'grub pa'o/ /chos thams cad gzod ma nas rnam par dag pa'i yid bzhin gyi gzhal yas khang / rgya yongs su ma chad 'khor lo/ ye nas bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa yang / thabs kyi theg pa'i gsung thos pa ni mig bye ba'o/ /don rtogs pa ni dkyil 'khor mthong ba'o/ /rtogs nas goms par byed pa ni/dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'o/ /zhugs nas mngon du gyur pa ni/ dngos grub chen po thob pa'o/ /de ltar tshud 'di ni rdzogs pa chen po'i mthar phyin pa'i don/ yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen kyi sa la lhun gyis 'jug pa ste/ skyes bu blo rtsal rab kyis/ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don la ye nas sangs rgyas par rig pas gom pa drag dal 43—849

du 'gro ba yin gyi/ phal gyis bya ba ni ma yin no/ /phal gyis thog te ji ltar bsams kyang / bden zhing bzang zhing yid ches par mi 'gyur ro/ /yid ma ches pa dang / phal gyi blo la dka' zhing bden pa dang / bzang bar ma shes pa'i nyams dang sbyar nas/ kun kyang de dang 'dra snyam ste/ yo rdzun zhes skyes bu rab la yang bskur pa 'debs shing sun 'byin pa'i blo skye bar ①'gyur bas/ rab tu gsang ba'i phyir/ gsang ba'i thigs pa zhes bka' stsal to/ /de bas na chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don rtogs pa'i blo ma skyes kyi bar du/ theg pa 'og ma 'gro ba'i don byas nas/ gdul bya mi za bas/ slob dpon gyis 'khor ba'i skyon dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan dang / theg pa thams cad la mkhas par byed pa yin kyi/ phyogs 'ga' tsam shes pas slob dpon gyis gzung du mi rung bar yang rgya cher 'byung ngo / /lta ba'i khyad par dka' thub pa dang / brtul zhugs kyang bye brag tu 'gyur te/ dka' thub med pa rgo 'jig rten phyal ba dang / mur thug go/ /dka' thub yod pa ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ rgyang phan pa dang / mu stegs pa ste/'jig rten pa'i dka' thub dang / nyan thos kyi dka' thub dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dka' thub dang / bla na med pa'i dka' thub bo/ /de la phyal ba ni rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa'i phyir dka' thub med do/ /mur thug pa ni chad par lta ba'i phyir/ dka' thub med do/ /rgyang phan pa ni tshe 'di'i khyad par dag bsgrub pa'i phyir/ gtsang sbra la sogs pa'i dka' thub can no—/ /mu stegs pa ni/ bdag tu brtag pa ④cig yod pa de dag par bya ba'i 43—850

phyir / lus sun 'byin cing / me lnga rten pa la sogs pa'i dka' thub dang /brtul zhugs log par spyod pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi dka' thub ni/ 'dul ba las sdeg pa ci yang mi bya ste/ dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /ces 'byung ste/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i chos thams cad / kun rdzob dang don dam pa gnyis ka so sor yod par lta bas dge ba ni spyod / /mi dge ba ni spong ba'i dka' thub dang / brtul zhugs spyod pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dka' thub ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la/ skyen du 'tsham par tshar mi gcod/ /rdzu nya'aphrul la sogs sdig mi byed/ /snying rje ldan zhing byams phyir dang / /sems dge ba la nyes pa med ces 'byung ste/ snying rje chen pos zin na dge ba dang mi dge ba'i chos gang spyad kyang / sdom pa nyams par mi 'gyur bas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dka' thub ni/ /snying rje gzhi bzung nas spyod pa'o/ /bla na med pa'i dka' thub ni/ /dam tshig chen po'i mdo las kyang / /sangs rgyas theg pa rab nges na/ /nyon mongs 'dod lnga kun spyad kyang / /pad+ma la ni 'dam bzhin te/ /de la tshul khrims phun sum tshogs zhes 'byung ste/chos thams cad ye nas mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir/ snying rjes sneni rten du med la/zhe sdang ni spang du med de/ de ltar ma rtogs pa la/ thugs rje mi 'byung ba yang ma yin te/ ji ltar lta bas ye nas/ ye nas rnam par rtog pa bzhin/dka' thub dang brtul shugs kyang de ltar rnam par spyod pa'o/ /lta ba 'phreng 4 3—851

ba'i gsang rab 'di/ /dmu rdzilong rang phye mig med ltar/ /shes rab thabs kyi rtsal 'chad pa'i/ /skyes mchog yod na phrad par shog /man ngag gi rgyal po lta ba'i 'phreng ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/841 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/842 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skyes/844 ①〈〈pe〉〉pa/845 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/ ②〈〈pe 〉sno)sa/846 ①〈〈pe〉phos/847 ①〈〈pe 〉〉walam ②〈〈pe 〉〉wani/848 ①〈〈pe 〉riganyed/ ②〈〈pe 〉thargyan/849 ①〈〈pe〉〉〉du/85༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉skyes par/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wapa/851 ①〈〈pe 〉skrudron/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rje/852 ①〈〈pe 〉stanabu/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2529)43—852

༄༅/ /las shan lta ba'i sgon ma zhes bya ba/tso sngal/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po dang / rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis bsdus ma lus sems nyid la/ /lta ba'i bya byed gnyis med cing / /rang gi ngo bo'ang ma grub pas/ /lta ba med pa'i lta ba ni / /lta ba'i dam pa kho nar 'dod/ /rmongs pa'i lta ba dngos dmigs pa/ /ldongs pas nam mkha' bsnyags pa rnams/ /mtshan nyid mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ /rgyu rkyen las kyis ma byas pa'i/ /gser go las byas rdzas rnams kun//ming dbyibs dngos las tha dad kyang / /ngo bo gser du gcig pa ltar/ /rang byung rang snang byang chub sems/ /spros bral rang rgyud min pa'i yul/ /med sgyu brtags chags bsgrubs 'grub snang / /rig phyir phyi nang dngos kun tu/ /rang snang mtshan nyid so sor yang / /sems phyir rtog med 'od gsal ba'i/ /sems nyid 'ba' zhig kho na byebs/ /cir yang snang la gzung du med/ /sna 43—853

tshogs gnyis par mi phyed pa/ /bdag po zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku/ /cir snang ma spangs dngos mi dmigs/ /sprul rdzogs chos sku ma 'dres gsal/ /de sogs lhun grub byang chub sku/ /ma nor ma bcos kun 'byung ba/ /de la de bzhin dbyings zhes bya'o/ /cis kyang ma bsgribs ye shes mchog /thams cad ma 'dres ye shes gsal/ /dngos po thams cad de nyid de/ /rgyud dkyil rdzogs chen sangs rgyas sogs/ /rang bzhin ngo bor de brjod de/ /'khor ba dkar dag rin chen gling / /mya ngan 'das zla brjod med pa/ /tha snyad ci yang min pa ste/ /ming grangs gdul bya'i ched du zad/ /de ltar rang rig rang snang bas/ /gang la cir snang dus nyid na/ /lta bya lta byed gnyis med pa//mthong ba med pa'i mthong yin yang / /nges pa'i rkyen gyis ma nges dang / /spyi'i snang gnyis rtags gsum du/ /rang blo'i rgyun las grub pa'o/ /bshad pa bzhin du rang snang la/ /ma rig bdag lta brtags pa yis/ /zhor blos gus ①na 'dug pa dang / /rdzas bems snang ba'i brtags pa gsum/ /goms pas nyams su skye ba nyid/ /log rtog rgyun la rtag gnas pas/ /nyon mongs las kyis cir snang ba'i/ /dngos kun log rtog tsam nyid las/ /'phra dang zab pa yod min pas/ /'khrul pa'i snang ba zhes su gsungs/ /rang bzhin shes spangs zlog pa'i phyir/ /chos nyid bya byed rigs pa gnyis/ /rang bzhin las kyis tha dad do/ /snod bcud rims sbyar theg bsam yas/ /dgongs gsung brlabs 'byung du ma las/ /rang bzhin cha 'thun gol ba gnyis/ /bye brag du ma'ang gnyis 'dus te/ /ril lta byed po rtag pa gnyis/ /bdag dang dngos po rkyen las 'byung / /'jig mtha' stong pa'i chad lta'o/ /mos pa chung ngu ba 43—854

dag ni/ /sems ni gzhir snang skad cig ma'i/ /rgyun la lta ba gnyis ma grub/ /so so'i ngo bo phra rab ni/ /bdag dang 'jig rten gzhir 'dod pa/ /chos tsam 'phags pa'i spyod yul la/ /yor por rnam par shes pa yis/ /mu rdzas lta bur sgog gyur pas/ /spang phyir rjes su 'gog byed pa'i/ /gzhan dag 'dzin pa cha mdun yang / /'phra mo phyogs chas ma grub phyir/ /dngos po'i ngo bo mtha' stong yang / /stong pa'i rgyun gyis stong pa 'ang / /so so'i cha yis 'ching bar 'gyur/ /phyogs rtogs pa yi gzhung dag kyang / /don ni rgyud bcas chos tsam min/ /rnam rig skad cig ngo bo nyid/ /dngos nyid snang phyir sems tsam ste/ /rmi lam khang sogs ji lta bar/ /dngos po thams cad skad cig ma'o/ /gang yang de snang dus nyid la/ /snga phyi kun bsgribs da lta nyid/ /cig phyir cha shas rnam pas stong / /nyi shar chu shel bai ḍūr sogs/ /brtag par dka' ba'i ye shes nyid/ /de lta'i rgyun du rang gnas pa'o/ /rjes su 'jug par byed pa ni/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /mi gnas theg chen gzhung gsum med① / /gzhan gyi dam pa'i don de nyid/ /phyogs gcig la gnas yang dag min/ /rkyen snang se gol cha'i phyir/ /gnyis bral smra ba'ang rigs byepas 'gal/ /gang yang rang grub ma yin te/ /lag sor tshogs kyis dngos min bzhin/ /brgyad phyed gzhan dbang snang ba yang / /mthun snang la sogs rigs pa bzhis/ /nges par yod par kun bsgrib 'dod/ /'dus snang don byed rgyu tsam la/ /chos dang ldan pa zhes brjod kyang / /ngo bo mthong ba ming tsam phyir/ /rang gi mtshan nyid brjod bya min/ /gzhan snang rgyu dang grangs bral dang / /bdag gzhan gnyis sgyus mi skye phyir/ /gang yang rang gi 43—8du5

ngo bo stong / /dus gsum du yang ma grub pa/ /rang bzhin ngo bos stong pa nyid//ma byas mi 'gyur ma reg cing / /ngo bos brjod med rigs bzhis nges/ /shes bya bden gnyis ngo bo nyid/ /mun snang bzhin du 'thad min la/ /lo ma mtshon bzhin gzhan las min/ /gang yang gnyis las 'da' med pa/ /mtha' las 'das phyir dbu mar 'dod/ /theg pa mchog la bye brag ste/ /dmigs pa 'phra mo bya ba nyid/ /rang sems mtha' bzhi yongs bral la rang rig ye shes gzhan las min/ /rkyen snang glang ba'i ye shes kyis/ /mthong ba'i dngos po mthong 'jam rtsub/ /drug phyed rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /mthong ba rnam par ①dag ces bya'o/ /dag pas ltas na kun kyang gtsang / /rtogs pas bsams na ci yang 'grub/ /dngos kun rang rig mtshan nyid de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyis/ /lugs bskur bzhi ④du snang bar 'dod/ /ye shes byin brlabs snang ba nyid/ /sdeng ma chud par rims lta zhing / /snang stong rim gyis brtan par byed/ /cho ga las dang rdzas bsogs pa/ /rnal 'byor gnyis dbang smra gzhung ni/ /thams cad sems kyi brlabs snang phyir/ /de nyid mtha' stong rig gsal bas/ /rgyu rkyen ma byas mtha' bral ba'i/ /rang bzhin chos kyi sku nyid do/ /kun gzhi sems btun tshul bzhin du/ /chos sku snang ba'i byin rlabs rol/ /rdor sogs rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sangs ma rgyas pa med pa ni/ /rang bzhin stug po bkod pa'o/ /rkyen lam rnal 'byor rnam gnyis kyis/ /mngon byas lhun grub rnal 'byor ni/ /byin brlabs ya mtshan bsam yas kyang / /rnal 'byor gsal ba mnyam par 'dod/ /rnal 'byor gsum po rims snang ba/ /gcig dang du mar smra ba ni/ /rang 43—856

rig nyi ma'i snying po nyid/ /dngos gnyis las sogs byed pa'i phyir/ /cho 'phrul gnyis las mi zhan pas/ /dbang sgyur thabs kyis rgyal bar 'dod/ /cho 'phrul yul sems tshul nyid kyang / /thabs dang shes rab mtshan nyid de/ /phung sogs yab yum dkyil 'khor ni/ /rgyud min rang bzhin snang ba nyid/ /gnyis med byang sems ngo bo las/ /'khor ba'i mtshan nyid ngang gis med/ /sman gyi rgyal po ma ki tas/ /gang la reg pa sman du 'gyur/ /dbang sgyur man ngag la gnas pas/ /dug sogs byang chub lam du 'gyur/ /thabs kyis dbang sgyur ma chags pa'i/ /thogs med shes rab spyan snang bas/ /rnam gsum ting 'dzin rims bsgoms yang / /dbang sgyur sems kyis cho 'phrul las//rgyu 'bras rim pa med par 'dod/ /rjes la thob 'jug rnal 'byor gzhung / /ma skyes rang rig ye shes ni/ /rtsal rdzogs rol pa rang snang bas/ /grangs mdog ma nges sku gsung thugs/ /rang snang phyag rgya bsam mi khyab/ /kun bzangs ril phyir blang dor med/ /gang yang sems la gzhan min pas/ /rang bzhin cir yang ma skyes phyir/ /rtogs pa'i smra bsam yul bral ba/ /kun gzhi bzang mo'i mnga' klong las/ /cir yang snang ba yum gyi dbyings/ /rang snang rol pa bsam yas kyang / /bha ga'i klong las g.yos med de/ /'du 'bral med pa'i bde chen po/ /sangs ma rgyas pa cig med pa'o/ /mang nyung grangs kyi lha rnams kyang / /chu la nya ldang tshul snang bzhin/ /'od kyis ting 'dzin shugs kyis 'gro/ /gang zhig 'di las gnas gyur na/ /dam tshig spyod sogs gtsor ma gsungs/ /rang bzhin nyid mthun rang bzhin sgogs/ /de phyir lta sogs khyad par 'phags/ /rnal 'byor ming gsum gzhung nyid2/ /dngos 43—857

po de nyid ji lta ba/ /de bzhin ma log mngon byed pa/ /spyi min rang gi mtshan nyid du/ /rang rig mngon sum gsal dus na/ /rang snang mtha' bral rgyun las grol/ /ye shes nam mkha' dbus mtha' med/ /de bzhin nyid gshegs yang dag rdzogs/ /tha snyad gnyis kyi chos rnams ril/ /mnyam rdzogs bdag nyid chen po'i brgyan/ /las yon lhun grub byed dang bral/ /dngos de nyid kyang mdor bstan na/ /chos sems ye nas gnyis su med/ /thams cad ma 'dres yongs rdzogs pa/ /cir snang ci yang ma yin te/ /btsam bzhi byas dngos lhar 'dod pa'i/ /dngos po rnam drug la sogs pa/ /gang yang min phyir nges tshig ldan/ /yul bral gnyis med rang mi dmigs/ /kun bzang nyid kyis bstan dka' la/ byed po chos can skad cig dang / /sgyu snang rtogs pa'i rigs snang dang / /brlabs dang cho 'phrul rtsal snang ba/ /'di la gdod nas yod ma yin/ /rig pa bzhi snang brlabs sogs pa/ /bltas pa tsam ste bye brag med/ /rgyu nyid rdo rje rkyen de bzhin/ /des na skye med 'gags sogs stong / /bdag las gzhan pa mi snang zhing / /bdag kyang 'di 'dra mi dmigs pas/ /snang med stong pa chen por gsungs/ /gnyis bsdus brjod snang thams cad kun/ /mi 'gog sems la gzhal med pas/ /'dogs snang brtags par rung ma yin/ /rnam pa kun ldan stong chen po/ /sangs rgyas pas kyang sngar sangs rgyas/ /snang gsum grags pa'i chos rnams kun/ /'di las brtags nas brtags snang phyir/ /thams cad kun snang gzhi rtsar bshad/ /gang la'ang gdod nas yod min pas/ /brtags rnams khyi bus khyi tshul gsungs//dus gsum chos kun gcig khyad med/ /sngon med phyis med gdod nas byung / /43—858

thams cad sems gsal de bzhin nyid/ /ma byas rgyun min phyogs med gsal/ /ye shes ming bzhi'i rang bzhin nyid/ /mtha' bral bsam pa'i yul 'das pas/ /thig le chen po gcig tu nyid/ /ther zug rgyun las ye nas grol/ /don dam nor bdun gzhan 'dod pa'ang / /gdul bya'i ngo bo 'dod pa min/ /gang yang dam par mi lta na/ /ci bsams skyon med bya lam dang / /rgyu shes slu ba med pa bzhin/ /'di la gol sa yod ma yin/ /mnyam rdzogs bdag nyid chen po'i phyir/ /bden pa gnyis kyi snyad las 'das/ /bzhi gnyis spros bral chos kyi dbyings/ /rang bzhin gyis stong de bzhin nyid/ /gdod nas skye ba med pa'i ngang / /rigs bzhis nges pa don dam dngos/ /bla med mi gnas nges par 'dod/ /de nyid rang rig kho na'i phyir/ /stong nyid ye shes ngo bo las/ /byen brlabs snang ba gzhir gyur pas/ /yid bzhin nor ltar rim 1 snang ba/ /jes thob la sogs theg pa'i gzhung / /bden gnyis mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings/ /dngos kun ma bcos sems gsal ba/ /ma nor ma bcos de bzhin nyid/ /'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang / /shes bya khyad 'gyur don dam gsum/ /de sogs bltos brtags brjod bral ba'o/ /ming bzhi sogs mtshon shes bya nyid//ye nas yin zhes ye shes kyang / /gnas 'gyur lam dang 'bras skabs su/ /rgyu yis gnyis dang bzhir 'dod pa/ /yul phyir rgyu 'thun skabs cig ma'o/ /rnal sogs stong nyid ye shes dang / /don shes skabs kyi ye shes bzhis/ /don drangs kyis kyang khyad par 'gyur/ /kun ye rang rig shes gsal ba/ /cis kyang ma bsgribs nges pa'i tshig /rang byung rang rig dbyings 2mi gnas/ /skabs ming bzhi phyir gcig med la/ /chos kun ma 'dres bdag gsal phyir/ /43—859

ye shes rnam grangs bsam mi khyab/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi 'ang / /ye shes yul med cang mi shes/ /ma lus bdag gsal rtog med pa/ /ye shes ming gnyis dngos gcig pa'o// //gang gis don 'di mthong gyur na/ /de bzhin nyid gshegs kho na'i phyir/ /ji bzhin pa'i dngos de bzhin/ /rtogs gnyis grol ba'i ye shes sku/ /ngo bo nyid rtag brjod las 'das/ /brtags sogs thad ka'i chos kun yang / /sems phyir yod min ma dmigs pas/ /blang dor byed dang don gyis bral/ /'du shes rang gzhin ①ye shes kyang / /'du shes thams cad 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rang 'byung ye shes mngon byes pa'i/ /nyi ma bye ba 'od brdal yang / /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas par bya byed med pa'i/ /chos ni rdul tsam yod min pas/ /sangs rgyas med pa'i tsher bas gsungs/ /bskal pa'i grangs dang tshe rabs su/ /dman pa'i blang dor ci byas dang / /'bring gis dmigs pas gol thob kyang / /don 'di nyams su ma myong na/ /brtags pa nyid las ma gtogs par/ /spangs thob ngo bo gdod nas med/ /dngos drug dmigs dang gzhan don kyi/ /'du shes rgyun dang bya las grol/ /bdag gi mu mtha' yas sangs rgyas/ /ji bzhin der gyur kun bdag rdzogs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag rdzogs/ /de sogs tha snyad tsam du zad/ /dman 'bras sku dang ye shes mchog /dngos nyid shin tu rnam dag dang / /gnyen med don bzhin rnam par shes/ /ming gsum ldan 'di mchog gi gzhung / /tshogs brgyad la sogs chos kun dang / /dngos cig bsal ⑤bas tha dad pa/ /dngos med ye shes sna tshogs can/ /dngos nyid chos kun ldan bral min/ /43—860

don 'di rnal 'byor mngon sum mo// //mchog gis rang rig mngon sum du/ /rang grol gsal thob gnyis las 'das / /ngo bo bsam rdzogs ril dang bral/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang bstan dka' ba/ /dman don gzhung gis ga la sdogs/ /de'i rjes 'jug tshad dag kyang / /dngos de nyid la rnam med kyang / /rang bzhin las kyi rtsal rim pas//bcos phyogs sbyangs rgyud thabs rtsal gyis/ /mi bzlog rim pa sngon bya'i phyir/ /gtan tshigs bzhis sogs rims bkod pas/ /dngos de nyid shes kun smra yang / /brtsal bral bya med don ma rig /rjes sogs ltos ltas kho nar snang / /rtse mchog gzhung gi tshad gsum nyid/ /bzhi sogs so so'i tshad ma yis/ /dngos de nyid sogs gang de nyid/ /gnas min tshad dang de ru mtha'/ /spangs pa'i rang rig gang yin pa/ /khyu mchog mdo ris lta bus shetshad/ /de phyir lam kun mkhas spyod yul/ /nam mkha' rmad sogs rjes mthun par/ /myong ba'i nyams bsdur mi 'gal rigs/ /tshig spangs yid ches tshad mar gsungs/ /ma lus sems phyir snang mi 'dzin/ /ci yang min phyir cir mi gnas/ /thams cad bdag phyir thob spangs med/ /bdag gzhan don bral cang mi 'gog /lta bsgom kye'abras bcas gtan tshigs mod/ /rgyas par mdo bzhi me long dang / /nges bdun nges zin gtan tshigs drug /tshul gyis nges pa bcu gnyis sogs/ /gzhung mdo tshad mar lta bar bya'o/ /gzhung ngan grib ma lta ba'i long thug bzhin//mi lus ma 'dres gzhung nub rmongs don du/ /la shan me long 'di ltas bsod nams gang / /'gro kun dngos po'i de nyid mngon byed shog /las shan lta ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ bzhad pa rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //43—861

༄ga /lta ba'i rim pa yi man ngag①༄7/ /pad+ma'i spyan la phyag 'tshal nas/ /lta ba'i rim pa bshad par bya//'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'das/ /gser gyi rdzas ltar cig la snang / /rnam grangs rnam pa lnga gsum gnyis/ /shes nas bzhag dang bslang ②bar bya/ /thams cad byang chub snying po'i klong / /pad+ma 'khyil pa'i rang bzhin la/ /rang gi rtog rnyog ri bos mnan/ /rang rgyud rkyen kyis log snang ba/ /skye bo ba dang mu stegs pa/ /drug dang rtag chad snang bar 'gyur/ /dmus long tshul du skye bo bas/ /mtho yor mi ltar brtags snang ba/ /dmyal ba'i rang sems me sogs snang / /yi dwags sdig sems mi gtsang snang / /byol song ma 'grogs gyen thur snang / /mi la mthong yul 'di nyid snang / /de bzhin lha min go mtshon snang / /lha la dge sems rin chen snang / /cir yang snang phyir mthong mi bden/ /skye bo rtog pas phrogs pa yi/ /snang 'phrul phyi nang lta bur snang / /43—863

brtags pas brda'i tha snyad shar/ /rkyen gyis log tshul mu stegs pa/ /khrid byed drug gi ston pas bslus/ /mdor bsdus mu stegs chad pa la/ /glo bur tsam snang mtha' med de/ /rtag pa byas snang dngos por 'dod/ /de yang rgyu med rgyur smra ba/ /rang bzhin rgyur 'dod dbang phyug rgyu/ /ngo bo nyid la rgyu smra dang / /rdul phran rgyu ru 'dod pa dang / /byed po rgyu ru 'dod pa log /gzhan yang mu steg zhar byung ba/ /phyi rol pa dang yang dag par/ /gsang sngags pa dang gsang chen pa/ /gnyis gsum lnga rnams rgyu'i tshul/ /gsum gnyis 'bras bu'i tshul snang ba/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gzhi la lta/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lta ba'ang / /cig shos lta ba las 'phags pa/ /nyan thos rang rgyal mdo sde dang / /kri ya u pa ya dag dang / /de bzhin yo ga'i theg pa dang / /ma hā yo ga'i theg pa dang / /a nu yo ga'i theg pa dang / /a ti o ga'i zeg pa'o/ /chos tsam lta ba'i nyan thos pa/ /mdo sde pa dang bye brag pa/ /phyi rol rdul la rtsod byed cing / /shes pa skad cig snang bar 'thun/ /de bzhin rang rgyal theg pa ba/ /phyi rol bcu gnyis sgyu ma tsam/ /rdul yang phyogs chas ma grub 'phags/ /shes pa skad cig rjes 'thun 'dod/ /mtshan nyid theg pa'i 'ang rnam pa gsum/ /rnam rig pa dang rnal 'byor pa/ /de bzhin mdo sde dbu ma'o/ /rnam rig phyi rol tho yor mi/ /sag mo rta ltar med bzhin du/ /rang rig rnam shes 'khrul snang 'dod/ /don dam ye shes skad cig 'dod/ /rnal 'byor dbu ma'i kun rdzob mthun/ /don dam stong pa ma skyes 'dod/ /mdo sde kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam/ /yul rnams logs nas snang bar lta—/ /dam par mtha' gnyis bral ba yi/ /dbu ma chen por 'dod pa'o/ /43—864

kri ya don dam chos nyid lta/ /kun rdzob rang rig yon tan lta/ /rigs gsum dkyil 'khor snang bar lha/ /skyo ba'i 'khrul pa med par 'dod/ /gnyis ka rgyud kyi 'dod pa ni/ /lta spyod gong 'og rjes su 'thun/ /yo gas don dam rnam dag pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su/ /rtogs pa'i byin brlabs lha snang ba/ /skye bos de ltar mthong bar 'khrul/ /ma hā yo gas don dam du/ /rang rig gnyis med de bzhin nyid/ /rtogs pa'i cho 'phrul drug sogs pa'i/ /lhar snang ngang la 'khor ba med/ /a nu yo gas don dam du/ /bde chen rtogs pa'i rig pa'i rtsal/ /kun rdzob lha'i dkyil 'khor snang / /de phyir skye bos rtags pas 'khrul/ /a ti yo ga bden gnyis bral/ /thams cad rang rig rang byung ba'i/ /ye shes mtha' gsum bral ba la/ /brtags pa sa/nyis po gdod nas med/ /de phyir gser la gser mthong ltar/ /ji bzhin ma nor bden mthong yin/ /mnyam nyid rang bzhin ma nges pas/ /ji ltar brtags pa de snang phyir/ /dngos por brtags pa yod min de/ /yod na kun la mthun snang rigs/ /de phyir rang sems so sgor snang / /brtags pa cig yul cig med pas/ /'khrul pa snang bar the tshom med/ /des na gzhan dbang gdod nas med/ /rtog sems 'gro ba so so sems/ /gcig na dge sdig rnam smin te/ /ma spyad kun gyis myong bar rigs/ /de min yang dag don mi rung //rnam smin thun mong ma gyur phyir/ /cig min de nyid ma skyes pas/ /tha dad du yang mi rung ste/ /gcig dang tha dad las grol ba'o/ /dngos po sna tshogs brtags pa'i/ /ming las grub pa'i gtan tshigs med/ /de phyir mtshan nyid ci yang med/ /ma grub pa las yod rtogs pa/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu shes gyur gyi/ /43—865

rgyal ba nyid kyis mi mkhyen no/ /snang ba spyod yul ma grub phyir/ /dmigs pa'i shes pa yod mi rung / /spyod yul ma skyes ye shes phyir/ /bsgom bya'i chos nyid gud na med/ /sems kyi ye shes mtha' bral phyir/ /bsgom pa po yang ga la yod/ /de ltar bsgom mkhan dngos med na/ /mi gnas mi rtog 'jug pa su/ /nam mkha' lta bu rang gsal ba'i/ /rang sems yo gi de lta'o/ /ci yang yid la mi byed na/ yang dag don la phebs pa'i rigs/ /lus ngag ma skyes gzhi med phyir/ /skyil krung smra cad kha na med/ /de bzhin sems kyang dngos bral bas/ /rtog spangs sgom pa'i khar mi 'ong / /de ltar rtogs pa'i sgom pa po/ /yal bar 'dug pa nam yang med/ /ci phyir bdag nyid de phyir te / /rang rig dbyings lam g.yos pa med/ /rtog pa'i mtshan ma bzang ngan dang / /ci skyes dgag par mi bya zhing / /de don dran pas bral ba'ang yin / /rang byung rang bzhin ngas smra'o/ /dper na rkun mo tshor ma thag /ma skrad bros bzhin sdeng gis zhi/ /lta ba'i shugs las 'byung ba'i phyir/ /ched du tshor ba rten mi dgos/ /de mi blo'i skad cig tu/ /rnam rtog rang gi de nyid lta / /byis pa'i shes pa ldang mi nus/ /rmugs pas don nyid mi gsal ba'o/ /bying rmugs rab tu bying rmugs dang / /shin tu bying dbang du mi btang / /de bzhin rgod pa'ang rnam pa gsum/ /le lo snyoms las sman la sbyor/ /dogs pas gol pa lhung ba gnyis/ /re ba rtags dang 'bras bu'o/ /'khrul pa 'jug tu mi btub dang / /lus kyi bya byed spyod la dga'/ /ngag gi ca co smra la dga'//yang dag don la ring ba'i phyir/ /bya byed grong yul gtam mi glan/ /sbyin dang cho ga'i las mi bya/ /dge ba las kyang g.yeng 'gyur na/ /sdig las mi bya 43—866

smos ci dgos/ /nyams dang g.yo dang goms pa dang / /brtan pa'i nyams dang sbyar bar bya/ /don du 'di nyams bstan du med/ /de rtogs yang dag nyams dang ldan/ /de tshe phyi nang gsang ba'i drod/ /phyi nang rtags kyang rim par 'byung / /skyes kyang dga' brod sems ma skyed/ /med kyang de la mi dga' med/ /de dag g.yo dang thob brtan na/ /rim 'byung gsangs na dngos grub myur/ /klungs gsum ldan pa'i skyes mchog la/ /seng ge lta bu 'jigs tshogs bral/ /zas dang nor gnyen ma chags shing / /snying rje chen po ma bral na/ /chos nyid dang yang 'phrad pa'i rtags/ /ci spyod don las ma nyams na/ /goms pas las su rung ba'i rtags/ /'di ldan dbang po phyed btsums med/ /snang ba gang yang mi skyo zhing / /yid la bya ba med phyir ro/ /lus kyis rim par bzod thob dang / /tshes brgyad spong len med pa dang / /gang la yang nyon mongs mi skye na/ /'di yang sa la bgrod pa'i brtags/ /yid la byed med dgag snang med/ /'du shes ma bzung rang gsal la/ /gang yang nyams su mi len cing / /sems kyis mngon par ma phyogs shing / /dmigs med tshul du rang snang ba/ /tha snyad tsam du sgom zhes brjod/ /yang dag don kyi sdeng med par/ /tshig tsam lta la khungs phyung zhing / /bya med chos la blo gtad nas/ /rtsing chos phaṭa ral spyod byed pa/ /rgyal ba'i bkas kyang mi skyob ste/ /dmyal ba'i 'bras bu the tshom med/ /rtogs pa'i mtshon rtogs brgyad ldan na/ /skyes bu de ni rgyal ba'i sras/ /sdeng med lta ba mthong 'dod pas / /rang gis nga rgyal snyems byed pa/ /ri bos srog chags gnan pa ltar//nan yang thar pa'i khar mi 'byung / /gsang sngags pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /43—867

yang dag don la mi 'dud par/ /mi chos zang zing las byed cing / /rang dbang yod bzhin dbang med ces/ /smra zhing gsang don yal 'jog pa/ /phyi ma gar 'gro rtol med par/ /gal med le lo las byed pa/ /e ma rang 'joms dpa' bo de/ /rgya mtsho 'jings kyi pha 'ong ltar/ /thugs rje zhags pa'i spyang thag yan/ /rang gis rang slus snying re rje/ /le lo can la thar lam med / /lta ba'i rim pa yi man ngag /dka' ba dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad pa/snang ba bcu bdun rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/863 skyematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉long /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2531)43—868

༄ga /g.yu'i thang ma kras dgu// bhesngal/ /dpal kun tu bzang po'i sems kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu 'bras lus kyi rjes 'brang rig pa yis/ /gang zag blo dman rnams kyi don phyir du/ /rin chen g.yu ltar dgongs mdzes kun khyab don/ /theg dgu'i lta rim skas byekyi gdang lta bu/ /kun bzang dgongs don rdo rje sems la stan/ /na gardzu na bdag blo mun par shar/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen kun dga' la sogs pa/ /phyi rabs rdo rje 'chang gral 'byung ba'i mi/ /sa gser lta bur mi 'gyur brtan pa'i blo/ /dad ldan rgyal ba'i thugs dang 'dra rnams khyer/ /skal ldan dbang phyug rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa/ /dad can rnams kyi btsas su bzhag pa yin/ /shin tu rnal 'byor mchog gi mchog /'phags pa las kyang 'phags pa'i don/ /gser gling rin chen lta bu'i mchog/'di la sgrib byed chu na'abrang dang / /chu srin nya mid lta bu'i dgra/ /'jig rten 43—869

'das pa'i rgyur zhugs pa'i/ /jeg pa che chung rim pa dang / /yo ga bzhi sogs gol sgrib rnams/ /so so'i khyad par rtogs chud nas/ /mi gnas mi spong theg pa'i mchog /lhun po bzhin 'phags rtse rgyal nyid/ /che ba rtog phyir khyad par dbye/ /sprul pa'i gsung rab rgyu yi don/ /'dul dbang blo bzhin grags pa dag /bsdu ba che chung gnyis bcos so/ /chung sdus nyan thos nga rgyal te/ /nyan thos 'dod pas gnyis su 'gyur/ /mdo sde pa dang bye brag pa'o / /rang gi shes rab lta ba'i dngos/ /spyir na yang dag lta ba nyid/ /mi rtog sbug bsngal stong bdag med/ /mi rtag la sogs dngos su 'dzin/ /kun sdob bye brag 'dod gzhung nyid/ /snod kyi rdzas rnams dngos po 'di/ /rdul phran sil bu phan tshun pas/ /ma 'dres ne+e seng lta bu ste/ /mthu yi stobs kyis 'dus par 'dod/ /don dam shes pa skad cig ma/ /re rer yod par 'dod pa'o/ /mdo sde kun rdzogs phra rab rnams/ /'dus pa'i rnam pa gcig tu 'dod/ /don dam shes pa cig par 'dod/ /spyod pa rang don 'ba' zhig pa'i / /de la dbu mas skyon brjod pa/ /yul sems dngos su 'dzin bcas pas / /dngos ltar 'jog pa'i nyan thos khyod/ /'khor ba 'di las mi 'das pas/ /'bras bu skyon du 'gyur ba nyid/ /bka'i bden pa rnam bzhi las / /dngos por 'dzin pas bka' don 'gal/ /'jig rten dngos 'dzin rgyu 'di las/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob 'dod pa/ /las dang 'bras bu 'gal ba'i phyir/ /khyod kyi 'dod pa bden pa min/ /rang rgyal nyan thos don dam 'dra / /kun rdzob snang ba'i khyad par ni/ /gzugs kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rten 'byel rgyu rkyen dbang sgyur nas/ /rmi lam tshul de logs na 43—870

med—/ /des ni kun rdzob khyad par 'phags/ /spyod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis//gzhan don shes 'ga' la'ang spyod pa'o/ /dbu ma'i theg pa bstan pa ni/ /yul rnams rmi lam ma grub na/ /de dang 'dra ba'i shes pa'ang rdzun/ /de min rdzun gyi yul nyid la/ /don dam bden pa'i shes pa nyid/ /skye zhing dmigs par rigs pa min/ /des na rgyu 'bras 'khrul 'khor te/ /rgyu 'bras mi mthun 'gal ba yod/ /rdzun rgyus yang dag 'bras mi thob/ /de phyir phan tshun spangs te 'gal/ /bsdu ba theg pa chen po la/ /theg pa phyi nang rnam pa gnyis/ /phyi pa rnam par rig pa ba/ /kun kyang rang rig yul med 'dod/ /de yang rnam bcas rnam med gnyis/ /rnam bcas dbyig gnyen thog med gzhung / /yul ltar snang ba 'di dag kun/ /rab rib sku mthong rmi gzugs 'dra/ /shes pa 'khrul pa'i gzugs brnyan phyir/ /de yang de'i ngo bor 'dod/ /rnam med shan ta rak+ṣi ta/ /rjes 'brang zhes pa'i 'dod pa ste/ /rang rig gnyis med shel ltar dag /de nyid dam par yod par smra/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas 'dod pa ni/ /gzugs brnyan gzugs la sogs pa'i yul/ /gang ltar snang yang sgo lnga yi/ /mi rtog shes pa rnam pa lnga/ /rjes 'jug ngo bo 'byel par 'dod—/ /brtag pa'i 'khor ba'i chos rnams ni/ /yod de shes pa ngan rgyu bsog /de ltar bsgrub pa byed pa po/ /de la nang pas skyon brjod pa/ /rang sems gnyis med shel lta bu/ /dag par lta bas dngos bcas skyon/ /yul rnams 'khrul snang rdzun rgyu dang / /shes pa rang rig don dam nyid/ /ngo bo gcig par 'dod pa ni/ /phan tshun spangs te 'gal bar 'gyur/ /de min yul brdzun shes pa'ang rdzun/ /mdo de dbu mar brjod pa ni/ /yul rdzun phyir 43—871

na shes pa rdzun/ /ngo bo gcig phyir de ltar 'gyur/ /rang rig gnyis med don dam min/ /skad cig rgyun tu yod phyir ro/ /gal te kun rdzob tsam du'ang / /yul sems gnyis su med 'gyur na/ /tha snyad chad par 'gyur ba ste/ /gzugs sgra yin min la sogs pa/ /nam du shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /nang pa rnal 'byor dbu ma ni/ /kun rdzob rdzun pa tsam du yang / /yul sems gnyis med yul snang sems/ /kun rdzob rnam rig ji lta bu'o/ /don dam ma skyes stong par lta/ /de la mdo sdes rgal ba'i tshig /kun sdob rdzun pas mi 'gal la/ /don dam shes pa yod 'dod na/ /yul rnams rdzun bzhin shes pa'ang rdzun/ /rang sems gnyis med don dam na/ /'bras bu la 'ang dgos med 'gyur/ /yul la snang du rung mi 'gyur/ /lam kyi stegs su 'ang mi 'gyur dang / /'bras bu grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /brtag bya rang rig don dam de/ /gal te rgyu las ma byung ba'i/ /rang rig gnyis med dag pa 'am/ /rgyu la brten hūṃnam rang byung ba'i/ /glo bur bar ram rang byung ba'i/ /de dag de bzhin rig pa med / /mdo sde dbu mas kun rdzob tu/ /yul sems rdzun pa sgyu ma tsam/ /snang ba'i yul sems so sor 'dod/ /dam pa'i don du gnyis su med/ /dbu ma phyi mo pa rnams ni/ /don dam gtso bo mi dmigs lta/ /kun rdzob mdo sde rnal 'byor gnyis/ /gang la rung ste spong mi phyed/3/ /de kun byang chub spyod pa'i mchog /rgya cher gzhan don rdzogs par byed/ /gzhan la dmigs pa'i mtshan mo'i tshul/ /spar ba lta bu'i bdag don 'byung / /de la sngags kyi kri ya bas / /brtsad pa khyed kyi bden pa gnyis/ /so sor lta ba bden med de/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes gnyis med la/ /re mos snang ba'i rgyus mi 'grub/ /de phyir 43—872

rgyu 'bras 'khrul te 'gal/ /gal te kun rdzob sgyu ma nyid/ /don dam bden dang tha dad na/ /don dam bden par cig mi rung / /cig la snga phyi snang mi rigs / /shes pa gnyis kyi yul 'gyur bas/ /snga phyi re mos 'gyur snang phyir//lhan cig mi snang skyon du 'gyur/ /gal te ngo bo cig min na/ /phan tshun spangs te 'gal 'gyur zhing / /bsod nams dang ni 'byel med de/ /des na sangs rgyas sku mi 'grub/ /thams cad don dam 'ba' zhig na/ /tha snyad chad par 'gyur ba ste/ /sgyu ma tsam du'ang snang mi rigs/ /'bras bu nyid la'ang tshogs mi 'byung / /lam gyi chos su'ang mi rung ste/ /bdag gzhan don kyang 'gag par 'gyur/ /gal te bden gnyis dbyer med na/ /rang gi tshig rtsal mi 'gal snang / /kun rdzob bden par cig ce na/ /don dam mtshan mar snang mi rung / /de min don dam dang bsgoms nas/ /rjes la sgyu ma snang zhe na/ /don dam mtshan ma'i sa bon tsam/ /rigs pa ma yin gzhan yin na/ /kun sdob rang bzhin can 'dod na/ /sgyu ma tsam du'ang mi rung 'gyur/ /de bas dmigs pa'i shes pa'ang / /cig la phyed phyed bden rdzun 'gyur/ /khyed kyang bya byed med 'dod ces/ /bsod nams ci nus spyod byed 'khrul/ /des na da dung shed ma byebye/ /byis pa gtso mchog khyed rnams kyis/ /gsang ba nga la reg mi nus/ /de phyir khro bo ye shes sku/ /don dam ngang nyid snang bar 'dod/ /snang ba'i don dam dbyer med pa/ /mtha' yas ma bsgoms chos nyid dag /grub pa bya phyir rjes 'thun spyod/ /de la rgyu 'bras 'khrul mi 'byung / /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bka' lung rgyud/ /yo ga phyi pa rim pa gsum/ /bya byed rgyud dang snyernam pa gsum/ /gdul bya'i shes rab dbang pos phye/ /de dag lta spyod 43—873

khyad par 'gyur/ /bya byed kri ya'i don dam du/ /kun kyang dag pa'i chos nyid la/ /mtha'i dri ma ye nas med/ /kun rdzob rang bzhin rigs gsum sku/ /kun kyang dag phyir dug gsum gsum/ /lha'i dkyil 'khor yin par 'dod/ /ma grub tshul nas 'jig rten chos/ /mthun par bya phyir rje khol lta/ /dam tshig cho gas rdzogs byas nas/ /bshags dang mchod stong drug ldan pa'i/ /bzlas pas sdig sgribs dag pa'i sems/ /chu dang lta bur grub shar ba/ /lha mchog rgyu phyir lhas rtsal smra/ /khrus dang spyod pa'i gtsang sbra slang / /'di la yo gas rtsad pa'i don/ /kun rdzob lha dang rje khol na/ /chos nyid ngang la bzang ngan 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dag par cig lhami 'gyur/ /kun rdzob don dam tha dad na/ /lha yang ye shes sku min te/ /bsgoms pas 'bras bu snang mi rigs/ /don dam dag rtogs kun rdzob tu/ /khrus dang gtsang sbra ci zhig sbyang / /gal te bden pa re mos na/ /gsang ba'i don du'ang mi rung la/ /rgyu 'bras mi mthun 'gal ba 'byung / /ma grub cha yis khrus byed ces/ /lta spyod ya cha bdud kyi las/ /gnyis ka rgyud kyi 'dod pa ni/ /spyod pa bya ba'i rjes 'thun par / /lta bas rnal 'byor rjes 'jug phyir/ /rigs dang lta bas khyad par 'gyur / /'di la yang yo gas bcad pa'i tshig /spyod pa gol bas lta ba gol//lta spyod ya cha bdud du 'gyur/ /de min rigs la nges med pas/ /grub pa'i 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor phyi ma'i 'dod pa ni/ /rang rig dngos stong mtshan ma gnyis/ /dbyer med dbyings dang ye shes so/ /byin rlabs rdo rje dbyings kyi sa/ /shar lta gogs po'i tshul du mchod/ /ma grub tshul gnas 'jig rten dag /grogs la brten nas nor 'tshol mtshungs/ /spyod pa ting 43—874

'dzin gtsor byed pa'o/ /'di la nang pas skyon brjod pa/ /gnyis med rnam dag ye shes la/ /rgyud '-iranas bskur snang bden zhe na/ /rgyu'i ye shes skad cig 'gyur / /de min 'byung 'jug cha yis na/ /bden pa res 'jog spyon 'gyur bas/ /ye shes sgu ru mi rung ste/ /lhan cig mi gnas 'gal bar 'gyur//grogs po'i tshul du lta byed pas/ /tha dad bdag tu tha dad de/ /'byel pa med pas mi 'grub dang / /des na don nyid la yang skyon/ /gnyis pa yod 'gyur cig ce na/ /rang la grogs su ltar mi rigs/ /des na bdag nyid chen po'i don/ /rang gi shes pa mthong ba min/ /ting 'dzin rtsor spyod dngos po mtha'/ /ji snyed bral ba'i theg chen med/ /de min rgyal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /dam rdzas 'dod yon sman pa rnams/ /chu yi mtshon bzhin spyod mi nus/ /de phyir gnyis med don la skyon/ /yang na shes pa gnyis 'gyur bas/ /cig la rgyud gnyis ldang mi srid/ /des na khyod kyi lta spyod rdzun/ /lhun grub bka' lung skyed rdzogs gsum/ /thog mar bstan pa'ang rnal 'byor che/ /lus kyi dngos po gnyis sdus rnams/ /rang rig nyid phyir snang ba kun/ /ye nas ye shes sku gsal ba/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis drug la sogs shing / /snang ba nyid nas rang bzhin med/ /des na mtha'i skyon dang bral/ /snang stong bral ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /ngang las rig pa'i lhar bskyed pas/ /tha mal rtog tshogs ma spangs dag /gser 'gyur mun snang ji bzhin pa'o/ /cir snang rang gi rig pa'i phyir/ /lta dang lta ba yongs kyis med/ /ting 'dzin ye shes bsgur shar bas / /sus kyang ma byas byed med de/ /ngo bo gzhan nas 'ongs pa'ang med//des na bdag nyid chen por lta/ /spyod pa bzang ngan gtsang sme sogs/ /gang 43—875

la chags sdang blang dor med/ /bde myong mi 'gog mi 'dzin phyir/ /tshogs gnyis rgyun tu tshogs par byed/ /de la'ang rjes su rnal 'byor pa/ /skyon brjod khyod kyi lta ba'i don/ /mnyam nyid snang stong dbyer rnged dag /yin na rig pas bskyed mi dgos/ /ye shes sku yang 'dus byas 'gyur/ /gal te bdag gis bskyed pas na/ /snga bar bdag nyid ma grub bam/ /de min thug pa med par 'gyur/ /yang na bdag nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ /tha dad ye nas 'byel med pas/ /skyed du 'ang mi btub 'grub mi 'gyur/ /spyod pa blang dor med ce na/ /de nyid gtsor spyod blang dor nyid/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi brjod pa ni/ /mnyam nyid bdag nyid chen po ni/ /rang la rang gis sgom ci dgos/ /bdag gis bdag la 'ang dmigs rung na/ /mdzub mo rang la reg par rigs/ /tha dad rang gi tshig gis 'gal/ /gal te mi sgom bya med na/ /rnam gsum rim pas smos ci dgos/ /thams cad bdag la ma'i sgus/ /gzer la gzer bzhin 'byung mi rigs/ /yul med don la gtsor len pa/ /de nyid dmigs lta rtsa ba'i don/ /khyod kyang gal te ldun grub na/ /spyod dang phrin shālas dang len 'khrul / /bya ba med pas spyod do zhes/ /de nyid ched spyod thabs rten 'khrul//snang stong ye nas dag 'dod na/ /bsgrib pa gnas 'gyur dri ma'i tshul/ /blang dor med pa'i spyod byed na/ /de nyid dang len snyoms sam ci/ /kun kyang rang rig shesems yin na/ /dbugs phyin dkyil 'khor skyed ci dgos/ /las bzhin 'go don rtsal ba yis/ /lhan grub mdzad pa ga la mthong / /gu 'jo'i spyod dang ma bral phyir/ /rtsol ba'i chu bor bying ba yi/ /rjes 'jug rnal 'byor 'dod pa yi/ /snang srid bzang mo'i mkha' klong la/ /ma skyes dkyil 43—876

'khor kun bzang shar/ /shar ba nyid na shar ba med/ /yab yum sras bcas 71 bde chen po/ /lhun rdzogs sa la skad cig gis/ /snying po dran brjod skur shar ba'o/ /'di la rim pa'i rtsol ba med/ /rgya mtshor nyi zla shar ba 'dra/ /don gnyis ma rtsal rdzogs par byed/ /spyod pa blang dor med par spyod/ /de ltar ma nus nyams mi lta/ /de lta gong mas skyon brjod pa/ /thams cad bde ba chen po la/ /ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs 'dod na/ /mtshan ma'i skye skyed snyoms sam ci/ /khye'u bzhi rtog 'byung mi 'gal lam/ /mtshan mas 'gro don sdogs 'dod nor/ /yab yum 'byed dang kha dog grangs/ /rtsol ba bde chen don de 'gal/ /de phyir bya bral mthong ba med/ /gal te ma grub pas byed na//rgyu 'bras 'khrul te 'gal bar 'gyur/ /don gnyis ma brtsal rdzogs she na/ /skad cig dkyil 'khor bskyed ci bya/ /rang gi bcings pa'i smongs pa khyod/ /bya byed don la btang snyoms byed/ /de nyid rtsol ba ma yin nam/ /spyod yul bral la dmigs par byed/ /de nyid yul dang yul can mod/ /bsam med ngang la gsal bar 'dod/ /de nyid bsam spyod gtogs pa'i gzhi/ /bsgrub med ngang la don du gnyer/ /de nyid re dogs rtsa ba yin/ /de lta'i spyod yul bems po yin/ /klong chen ngang la thigs mi 'gyur/ /de dag skabs kyis rang rang gi/ /lha la zhen pas ldongs pa yin/ /ldung ba'i phyir na gol sa che/ /des na gol bsgrib thun mong ste/ /lta ba dmigs kyis dbul ba dag /ye shes nyid la bdag tu 'dzin/ /rang la rang nyid yul du byed/ /don la don nyid rjes su 'breng / /ye shes nyid la gsal bar 'dod/ /bdag la bdag nyid spyod mtha' 'tshol/ /zin pa'i don la bsgrub par byed/ /bya bral nyid kyi bya ba med//43—877

bsgrod med lam la bsgrod par byed/ /mi dmigs pa la dmigs par byed/ /kye ma'o thugs rje'i gnas su rung / /deng sang dus kyi gang zag rnams/ /ma rig ling 1tog ma sol bas/ /lta ba'i la shan ma phyed cing / /lta ba'i mche ba ma mthong bas/ /rgyud lung man ngag goms pa yis/ /rmangs dang rje dang rgyal 'dra la / /kun rdzob mi mnyam don dam mnyam/ /de skad smra ba'i dmus long dag /khrel 'bru ma thub sa gzhi che/ /ma mthong tshul dang mtshungs pa'o/ /mig lta brtan pa'i 'di dag gi/ /bza' bral ngang las gnas mi 'gyur/ /de nas bskal ldan skyes mchog bu/ /ma bgrod sa la gnas bya'i phyir/ /rdzogs chen nga'i don la ltos/ /yod med stong pa'i mtha' la thud/ /kun gyi sku mchog ye shes zhal/ /'dongs pas rmongs 'khrul dug gsum kyi/ /snying khrag 'thung zhing kun gzhi nyid/ /gtan nas phung byed nga la thud/ /zad pa'i dus na bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ /mi zad 'jigs gzugs mnga' ba nga la 'dud/ /bskal pa'i chu chen rab tu 'khrugs pa 'bum/ /'jigs byed des kyang ljags kyi mtha' ma snubs/ /khrag mtsho mtha' med bskams la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thor rlung drag pos 'jig rten kun g.yeng ba/ /des kyang nga'i ba sru'i cha tsam bskyod mi nus// /zil gnon sku tshad mnga' ba nga la thud/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo thams cad kun gsol ba'i/ /'jigs byed de lta bu la ji skad bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gsol bas nga ma zhos/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsol bas kha byugs tsam/ /da rung 'gro kun gsol byed sgribs shing skems pas nga la thud/ /'on kyang ma sgrod rdzogs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /lhag pa'i rnal 'byor lugs nyid kyis / /bslab pa med pa'i bslab pa nyid/ /bslabs nyarnams 'jigs byed 43—878

bslab pa'i mchog /dngos po spyod cig mtha' mi tshol/ /don la mngon du 'dod pa med/ /gza' bral ngang la gza' mi byed/ /bya med don la de nyid kyang / /ched du len cing rtsol ba med/ /rang sems ci la'ang 'brang ba dang //'dod pa'i sems dang ye nas bral/ /de nyid las ni 'gyur ba med/ /thig le chen po rgyal ba'i thugs/ /brtags na med la bsams na snang / /dngos med cha lugs kun la ston/ /rang bzhin cig tu ma nges pas/ /rdzas kyi rnam pa cig tu'ang / /log mthong drug dang yang dag dgu/ /cir yang snang ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /'di 'dra rgyal bar brjod du med/ /gal te brjod kyang thabs mi 'gyur/ /sna tshogs snang ba nga'i sku / /ji skad grags pa nga'i gsung / /dran rtog rig shes nga'i thugs/ /sna tshogs snang la ngo bo med/ /che ba lnga yis ye nas 'phags/ /thig le drug dang rang bzhin ldan/ /khams gsum bde sdug nga la rdzogs/ /de la bde sdug ngang gis bral/ /dus gsum rgyal bar nga nyid shar/ /de la byung shar gdod nas med / /gza' ltas med pa'i rta mchog la/ /de nyid du yang lta ba med/ /gal te gdod nas dmigs lta mod/ /thams cad mkhyen pa sgom pa'i mchog /ngo bo nyid ni dmigs su med/ /snang ba med pa'i chos nyid ni/ /ma rtsal gzhag na bsgoms pa yin/ /de la bzhag par bya ba'ang med/ /bya byed don la yid mi rtog /de ltar gang shes ting 'dzin mchog /dmigs pa'i skyon byung 'gog mi byed/ /don la gsal bas 'bad mi dgos/ /drod rtags snang la re ba med/ /thams cad bdag nyid chen po'i phyir/ /snod bcud 'jig rten bde sdug bsngal/ /nyi zla 'od gsal byed 'dod pa'i/ /ji srid cir snang 43—879
