spyod pa kun/ /bdag nyid chen po'i mdzad spyod pas/ /de nyid gsal bar spyod pa ste/ /de la spyod dang mi spyod med/ /'go don rgyun du ma byas rdzogs/ /yang dag sa la ma song phyin/ /tshogs gnyis ma bsags lhun gyis rdzogs/ /ma bsgral stong gsum gnas su stobs/ /ma phul mchod pa kun la thim/ /ma blangs dngos grub rang la shar/ /ma bsrungs dam tshig nyams pa med/ /ma nor thams cad rang dbang sgyur/ /ma ltas lta ba kun tu gsal/ /ma bsgoms ting 'dzin yengs pa rnged/ /ma bcos rnam rtog sgyu 'phrul bral/ /ma bsgrubs 'bras bu bdag nyid che/ /ma sbyangs dus gsum 'du 'bral med/ /ma sbyangs bsgrib pa ye nas med/ /ma bzung thugs rjes kun na bsnubs/ /des na byas zin bya ba med/ /bya ba gang yang 'gog pa med/ /de lta sus rtogs byas pa'i mchog /bya med brtson 'grus bar chad med/ /skyes mchog gang zhig 'di ltar ltos/ /thams cad snang ba nga'i sems/ /theg pa mtho sman ji snyed pa/ /nyi 'od lta bur nga la snang / /bsgal bar dge spyad rtsol byas kyang / /nga dang ma phrad sangs mi rgya/ /des na sdeng chen don la ltos/ /mthong ba nyid na chos kyi sgu/ /go ba'i yul na bde ba che/ /de la 'jig rten rang bzhin med/ /de nyid rnam dag 'jig rten yin/ /bdag nyid chen po don ni nges par ston/ /ji bzhin byang chub snying po la/ /bsgrub bya lhun sdogs bla med pas/ /nga zhes mang du snyad par zad/ /don du nga la 'di 'dra zhes/ /dngos gzhir bstan par nus pa med/ /brtan g.yo dngos por 'dzin byed cing / /rtag chad gnyis kar slong zhen pas/ /snying po'i don la gol bar gsungs/ /shin tu rnal 'byor chen po nyid/ /dngos por zhen dang gdod nas bral/ /'jig 43—880

rten phal bar lhang sa med/ /rtag chad gnyis la mi gnas pas/ /mu stegs lta la gnas pa med/ /stong nyid don dam ma skyes pa'i/ /phyogs la bya bral mi lta bas/ /mthong med lta bas nga mi mthong / /mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sku mi bsgom—/ /gnyis med don la gtsor mi 'dzin/ /sgur bskyed 'gro don mi rtsom pas/ /yo ga phyi nang sar mi lhung / /bya med ngang la bya ba'ang rdzogs/ /rtsol ba'i dus na gdug pa'ang kromed/ /de nyid don la bdag 'dzin na/ /de ltar lta ba 'di rtog pa'o/ /snying rje med pa'i gang zag rnams/ /deng sang dus na'ang 'byung ba dag /kun bzang tshig tsam smra byed cing / /sdeng med don dang mi ldan par/ /de ltar lta ba'i 'dir rtog pa'o/ /rgyu 'bras don la yid 'byung zhing / /tshig tsam lta la rten pa dag /sdeng med spyod rtsing 'chol ba'i rgyus/ /bskal par bskal pa ci spyad kyang / /snying po'i don dang 'phrad mi 'gyur/ /des na zab mo'i spyod pa mnos/ /ci spyad kun bzang spyod par 'gyur / /sdeng chen don du gar ldan pa/ /rnam par dkar spyad spang mi bya/ /bsam gtan ro mchog rlung gnas kyang / /'gro ba'i bla ma spyi bos bkur/ /stong gsum sangs rgyas sa shes kyang / /snying rje'i don dang bral mi bya/ /skye shi med pa'i sdeng ldan yang / /sems can sbom 'phra'i srog mi gcod/ /'du 'bral med pa'i don snyems kyang / /'jig rten 'phyo g.yem las mi bya/ /rang bzhin ma nges don shar yang / /don du mi 'gyur brdzun 3mi bya/ /bdag nyid thig le'i ngang gnas kyang / /pha rol rdzas la bskam mi bya/ /khro gtum ngang thung 'khrug pa'i bdud/ /snang ba'i yul nas bya ba med/ /de nyid ngang la de mred phyir/ /rjes 'jug de yang de bzhin no/ /de bzhin mi spyod de dag gang //43—881

rag sha yag sha'i rgyud 'dzin pas/ /theg chen rigs su gang chud pa/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i ming ci yod/ /sangs rgyas khas ches spyang thag yan/ /bya byed rnal 'byor mchog spyod pas/ /spang med shes nas dkar phyogs kyang / /ched du bya ba med ce na/ /sdig las mi bya smos ci dgos/ /lhun grub spyod dang bya bral spyod/ /thugs rje chen po'i mdzad spyod dang / /nam yang bral bar ma byed cig /de ltar rtogs dran spyod pa'o/ /gol sgrib thong gnas g.yang sa yang / /spang du med de thig le'i dbyings/ /lhung dang ma lhung tha snyad bral/ /chos nyid don la ma bcos na/ /me dang dud ltar ltung sgrib 'byung / /gang du 'du shes ma skyes pas/ /grol dang ma grol ming ci yod/ /kun du rgyu la 'jigs pa 'byung / /phyin pa med na 'jigs dang bral/ /des na gang la dogs mi bya/ /re ba'i sems ci ①spyod de bzhin te/ /de dogs med pa'i don ched bstan/ /gang dag dmigs pa dngos 'dres pa'i/ /ling ②thog bsal phyir thugs 'dra 'dis/ /rab rib nad bral rdzogs chen sku/ mngon mthong kun kyis mchog thob shog /pho dreg phyi la ngang 'thung 'khrug /bcos dka' gdung bral gdong 'das can/ /dad med chags bcings slu brid mkhan—/ /sems med yal 'jog rnal 'jog byed/ /phyi ba'i sems bral rang gar spyod/ /byil ma nor chung mtshang sdogs po/ /lce mkhan thabs 'bru zol ba la/ /snying sgor byung yang bstan mi bya/ /g.yu'i thang ma kras dgu rdzogs so// //bi ma las phan yul du gnya' la gtad do// spri //43—882

bsdur mchan/869 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉ri mkhas/ ③〈〈pe 〉lo6ba/872 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rton/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉byed/873 ①〈〈pe 〉〉byed/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉rnam pa/874 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ci/875 ①〈〈pe 〉〉spya/876 ①〈〈pe 〉toraphrin/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rigs/877 0)〈〈pe 〉〉 sa/878 ①〈〈pe 〉〉snying / 〈〈pe 〉〉bslab/881 ①〈〈pe 〉stanadung ba'ang / ②〈〈pe 〉mudron/882 ①〈〈pe 〉to/ci/ ②〈〈pe 〉nyamang /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2532)43—883

2606༄7/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba me long lta bu'i bsgrub thabs/tsho snasngal/ rgya gar skad du/ ma ya dza lin tra a dar sha sā dha na/ bod skad du/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba me long lta bu'i bsgrub thabs/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan gnyis med sgrib pa spangs pa yi/ /ye shes rang rig gsal ba'i mkha' dkyil nas/ /dkyil 'khor spro bye bhedang 'gro don sprul pa yi/ /ma lus thugs su chud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gzhung lugs las/ /'gro ba'i rnam par rtog pa'i phyir/ /ye shes skyed pa'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /rgyud bsnyus bdag gis rtsam par bya/ /ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs/ /phyogs rtogs yang dag nyid ma rtogs/ /'dul ba dgongs pa gsang ba dang / /rang bzhin bsang bye ba'i don rnams ni/ /yi ge sgra brtags ming tshogs la/ /brten pa'i tshig gis rab mtshon nas/ /khong nas gab sbas don 'byin pa/ /ston pa rdo rje'i thugs la gnas/ /thos bsam bsgom la rab 43—884

sbyangs pa'i/ /shes rab mig ldan rnams kyis zung / /snod ldan ngang tshul bzang la bstan/ /lus dang longs spyod stong la sbyin/ /slob dpon mnyes par byas pa dang / /sgyu 'phrul ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dam tshig rnams ni dze+egs pa yis/ /'dod dang g.yeng ba kun spangs te/ /dka' thub spyod pas ma gdungs par/ /ting 'dzin mthun pa'i sa phyogs su/ /rab bde'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms mang po rab bsgoms rmyenas/ /sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ /sku gsung thugs ni bsgrub bya zhes/ /bdag nyid bsam pa bstan byas te/ /rang nyid sa bon 'od zer las/ /sprul pa mchod pa'i tshogs spros nas/ /mdun du dkyil 'khor tshogs rnams dang / /bla ma phyi sogs rnams kyis mchod/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa dang / /skyabs 'gro la sogs byas nas ni/ /bgegs grurnams ma lus gzhom pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ las skyes/ /rdo rje sa bzhir kyebasam par bya/ /rnam rtog 'du shes kun spangs nas/ /bgegs kyi sbyar jeb yod mi 'gyur/ /de bas rnam rtog bgegs yin par/ /yang dag rigs pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis gsang / /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes pa nyid na skye ba mred—/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā p+ta na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ de ltar stong nyid rab gsal nas/ /snying rje yul gyis slangs nas ni/ /sa bon shin tu gsal bar 'gyur/ /rab tu brtan 'gyur a kar las/ /shin tu phra ba'i a rnams spro//phyogs bcu gang bar gsal 'gyur ba/ /bsdus kyang 'phel 'grib med par bstan / /de las ming tshogs gsal 'bar kun/ /spro zhing bsnyu ba de bzhin 43—885

noske/ /'di ni rdo rje dngos grub kyi/ /brtan ①'byung ye shes rgyu yin no/ /de nas mtha' dang dbus med pa'i/ /'og min chos 'byung bsam par bya/ /de nas yo las byung ba yi/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /de steng yi ge ram las ni/ /me'i dkyil 'khor bskyed par bya/ /de yi steng du baṃ bsams te//de las chu'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /chu'i dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /lo las ye shes sa gzhir brtag /rgyu bi shwa bi shud dha/ /rgyu las ye shes gzhal yas khang //ye shes rin po che rang bzhin/ /rgya rnams yongs su ma chad pa/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rgyas pas/ /kun tu gru bzhir gnas par 'gyur/ /lhag pa'i ye shes glo 'bur mdzes/ /thams cad ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir/ /rtse mo kun tu 'dus pa yin/ /ye shes sna tshogs las grub pa'i/ /rin chen la sogs bye brag gi/ /bsam mi khyab pas spras par 'gyur/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo khyud la/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi rta babs ldan/ /kun nas skor ba'i kha khyer la—/ /rol mo sna tshogs sprin dpung bzhin/ /phyi dang nang med kun tu nang / /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas/ /gru chad bzhis brgyan bar 'khyams dang //dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis kyis brgyan/ /dbus su mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri/ /brgya byin gyi phyogs glang po'i gdan/ /rdzu 'phrul rta ni gshin rje'i phyogs/ /dbang gi rma bya chu lha ste/ /thogs med mkha' lding gnod sbyin phyogs/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal nyi zla dang / /chags med pad+ma so sor mdzes/ /gzhan yang nyi zla pad+ma dang / /gdan ni sum brtsegs dag tu gnas/ /seng ge'i gdan kyi dbus su ni/ /dam pa'i yi ge sa bon bsam/ /de nas pad+mo rdo rje brtag /so so'i snying pos mtshan par bya/ /de la sangs rgyas sku ni spro/ /phyogs bcu'i 43—886

'jigs dhirten khams rnams su/ /sems can don ni mdzad nas su/ /phyag mtshan yongs su gyur pa las/ /kun bzangs yum dang ldan pa ni/ /zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar zhing sdang / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis brgyan kyis mdzes/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbu rgyan can/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pa las/ /sprul pas sems can don rnams mdzad/ /kun tu bzang mo 'jo sgeg tshul/ /in+d+ra dī la'i kha dog 'dra/ /rgyan dang dbu rgyan yab dang mthun/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bstan/ /g.yon pa dril 'dzin yum la 'khril/ /dbu ni 'jo zhing 'dud pa'i tshul/ /de nas yongs su skyod nas ni/ /gnyis med chags pa spyor ba'i sgras/ /de bzhin gshegs pas kun bsdus nas/ /yab la de bzhin gshegs rnams thim/ /rdo rje lam nas byung nas ni/ /yum kyi pad+ma'i mkha' dkyil du/ /byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du las/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa yi/ /de nas rjes su chags pa yis du/ /sems can ma lus bsdus nas su/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol 'khod nas ni/ /de dag 'jug par gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba brjod pa'i tshig gsan nas/ /thams cad dkyil 'khor 'jug par 'gyur—/ /bdud rtsi 'od kyis reg ma thag /thams cad rang nyid sangs rgyas shes / /de ltar rgyal ba'i byin brlabs kyis/ /rang lus sangs rgyas shes nas ni/ /ngo mtshar tshig kyang brjod par byed/ /e ma rdo rje phung po yan lag ni / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags/ /skye mched khams rnams mang po kun / /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /sa chu spyan dang mā ma ki//me rlung gos ni sgol ma ste/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas zhing / /thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sangs 43—887

rgyas nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid la gzhan pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi mnyes so/ /de ltar ngo mtshar tshig brjod nas/ /de nas yid bstan bya ba'i phyir/ /gnyis med kun tu bzang po yis/ /ched du brjod pa 'di dag brjod/ /e ma phyogs bcu stong khams ye nas dbe+en/ /srid pa gsum nyid dag pa'i zhing / /snyigs ma lnga nyid bde ldan gnas/ /phung po lnga nyid mngon sangs rgyas/ /thams cad mchog gi snying po bas/ /gzhan du rgyal bas chos mi btsal/ /nyid la'ang gzhan zhes bya ba'i chos/ /btsal kyang rgyal bas mi mnyes so/ /de nas rgyal ba sangs rgyas rnams/ /so so'i zhing du 'khod par byas/ /yongs sbyangs gsung gi yig 'bru ni/ /yab kyi thugs kar thim gyur nas/ /yum gyi pad ma'i chags blan gyis/ /yab yum gnyis med dkyil 'khor thim/ /de ltar rgyal ba snyoms zhugs nas/ /bde ba'i 'bru tshogs mngon dran te/ /rgyu cig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul/ /byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum pa/ /rab tu gtogs pa rnam bzhi yis/ /thams cad mngon rdzogs rgyal por des/ /de ltar rtogs pa rnam bzhi yis/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni mngon bskyed pa/ /in+d+ra bhā la'i kha dog 'dra/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbu ①gsum ldan/ /ye shes drug gi phyag nyid la/ /rdo rje pad+ma ral gri ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams par mdzad/ /dril bu 'khor lo rin chen 'bar/ /g.yon kyi ye shes phyag na bsnams/ /g.yas pa'i rdo rje'i thugs kar bstan/ /g.yon pa dril bus yum la khyud/ /thabs dang shes rab zhabs gnyis ni/ /mnyam pa'i brtul ④zhugs skyil krung bzhugs/ /mdun dang rgyab med kun tu zhal/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kun gyis spras/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs chen las/ /43—888

thub pa'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs 'phro/ /rgyal ba'i rigs lngas dbu rgyan bcingasatsho—/ /sna tshogs rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /btsun mo snang ba'i dbyings phyug ma/ /gzhon tshul 'khril ldem shin tu chags/ /cha lugs la sogs yab dang mthun/ /g.yon pa dril bu thugs kar bstan/ /g.yas pa nyi ma las la 'khril/ /phung po dbang po rnams bhe shes kun/ /rnam smin oṃ du shes par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du bsgom/ /spyi bor yi ge oṃ bkod de/ /lce la a ni rab tu gnas/ /snying ga lte ba chu sor na/ /hūṃ dang swā hā rim bzhin dgod/ /mig dang rna ba sna dang lcer/ /k+ṣi tram̐ hri dza rim bzhin bsam/ /ma dz+re hūṃ sum̐ dang bzhi/ /mig sogs phyi rol rim bzhin bsam/ /de ltar yi ge rnams la ni/ /rgyal ba'i sku'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka nas/ /'od zer rnam pa mang po 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i sku gsung thugs bsnyus nas/ /bdag gi mdun du bzhugs pa la/ /tshig bshad 'di yis gsol ba gdab/ /oṃ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon can 'phrin las smad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag spyor cig /bdag gi sku gsung thugs su zul ni/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zhugs par gyur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā bāg badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ de ltar sgu gsung thugs gsum du/ /nga rgyal dbang du skyed nas ni/ /yum gyi sgu'i dkyil 'khor dgod/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs/ /rnam smin sum̐ du shes par bya/ /hūṃ 3kyi dkyil 'khor nyid du bsgom//spyi bo mgrin pa gnyis su ni/ /lo dang mo ni rim bzhin bsam/ /snying ga lte ba 43—889

chu sor —/ /sum̐ dang bye dang tai rnams dgod/ /mig dang rna ba sna lce la/ /hūṃ tri hri a rim pa bzhin/ /mig rna sna lce'i phyi rol tu/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrim bzhin sgom①/ /sku gsung byin brlabs yab ji bzhin/ /de nas yum rgo byen brlabs bya/ /oṃ uhūṃ swā hā lnga/ gnas lnga dag tu bsgom par bya/ /de ltar yab yum sku rdzogs nas/ /dkyil 'khor chen po rnam sprul phyir/ /gnyis med chags pa'i sbyor don du/ /rdo rje pad+ma byin gyis brlab/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rab tu shes—/ /oṃ las 'byung ba'i nor bu bsam/ /a las pad+ma skyed par bya/ /oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga badz+ra swa bhā ④ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ bsnyen pa dang rgo nye bsnyen pa/ /bsgrub pa dang ni bsgrub chen po/ /yum gyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /byang chub sems kyi byin brlabs las/ /tha sogs yi ge sprul par 'gyur/ /sa bon mtshan mas sku rnams rdzogs/ /sum cu drug gi dkyil 'khor du/ /de nas 'gro ba rmongs pa la/ /bstan phyir dkyil 'khor gdon par mdzad/ /badz+ra dh+rig /sum̐ dha du shwa ri/ mi bskyod yab yum ston nas ni/ /bdag nyid la ni thim par 'gyur/ /oṃ dzi na dzika /swa rad na byug /i a ro lig /ha prad nya dh+rig la dhe sha ra ti/ mi mo ha ra ti/spe ra ga ra ti/ tai badz+ra ra ti/ k+shi hi ra tsa ya/ tram̐ a kar pa ya/ hri pad+ma da ma/ dzi ku ru pa na hri/ hūṃ la se sa ma ya two/ tram̐ ma le sa ma ya ho/ tri gir ti ra ho haṃ/ a nir ti ra ga ya mi/ me da ra ni swā hā/ zlo swa ri pa ya swā hā/ hūṃ swa ra tsa ya swā hā/ sum̐ shri saṃ ra ga ya swā hā/ dza du pa pra be sha ya/hūṃ pus pa a be sha ya/ baṃ di pa su ki ni/ ho gan+de tsi ta ho/ hūṃ ya mān+ta krid phaṭa—/ hūṃ bighanān+ta krid phaṭa/ hūṃ pad+mān+ta krid phaṭa/ hūṃ prarnyesto krid phaṭa/43—890

oṃ badz+ra dha ra ma hā gro ti shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na dha ra ma hā kro nyi shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma da ra ma hā kro ti shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ karma dha ra ma hā kro ti shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tsi ta oṃ/ a a a badz+ra pa tra sa ya a/ so so'i sngags kyis ston nas ni/ /brgya byin la sogs phyogs su gnas / /mthing ga dkar po ser leb rgan/ /ljang gu'i mdog tu tshor ba yi//gtso bo gdan la rdzogs pa'i tshul/ /'khor rnams sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs//so so'i sku mdog yab dang 'thun/ /'khor lo rgyal po rgyal mo dang / /g.yas nas mthong thos snom pa dang / /myong dang btsun mo'i tshogs su bcas/ /gru chad la ni mthong byed dang / /thos byed myong byed snom byed rnams/ /btsun mo yi ni tshogs dang bcas/ /mdun dang rgyab tu byed pa dang / /bya ba dag ni gnas par bstan/ /sgo khyud bzhi la 'joms pa ni/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang ldan par gnas/ /yab yum bzhugs tshul phyag mtshan ni/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /hūṃ sgreng rtse mor rdo rje 'bar/ /zla gdul 'bru sbas dril bsil zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /sum̐ greng rtse mo dril bsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /oṃ sgreng rtse mor 'khor lo 'bar/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril bsil zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /lam bsgreng rtse mo'i dril bsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis blta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /swa rtse 'bar ba rin po che/ /zla btul 'bru sbas 43—891

dril yo bsil zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /saṃ sgring rtse mo dril bsil 'bar④/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /oṃ sgreng rtse mo pad+mo 'bar/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril bsil zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /sri sgreng rtse mo dril bsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis blta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /haṃ sgreng rtse mo ral gri 'bar/ /bzla btul 'bru sbas dril bsil zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /tai sgreng rtse mo dril bsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril—/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis blta/ /ud+mal klu shing la sogs mtshan/ /mdzes tshul mnyes pa'i yo byad 'dzin/ /las la 'khril zhing chos la bstan/ /dbu rnams 'byo zhing 'dud pa'i tshul/ /gong gi phyag rgya chen po bzhin/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /bya byed khro bo'i phyag rgya ni//rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin du brtag /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can//gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid ldan/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs chen po/ /'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa ste/ /mtha' dbus med par khyab pa yi/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs chen po/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub gnas/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa la/ /rgyal ba yongs su mnyes par 'gyur/ /mnyes nas sems can don bya zhes/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan gyur kyang / /sems can ma rig gis bsgribs pas/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i skal med 43—892

'gyur / /rgyal mchog thugs rje skyes nas ni/ /de nas gnyis med spyor bar 'gyur / /de nas byang chub sems 'phros pas/ /i sogs yi ge mngon par byung / /sa bon las ni phyag 'tshan 'bar/ /de las thub pa'i sku rdzogs te/ /so so'i snying po brjod pas 'dzin/ /mkha' dbyings sgu gsung thugs gnas nas//'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcur spros/ /oṃ mu ni kri swā hā/ oṃ mu ni hūṃ bye swā hā/oṃ mu de sum̐ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e bye swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e k+ṣ-i swā ༄1hā/ oṃ mu ne+e ye swā 2hā/'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcur ni/ /'dul ba bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad/ /ltam dang rab tu byung sogs dang / /mngon par sangs rgyas bdud 'dul dag /'khor lo bskor snyedang cho 'phrul ston/ /mya ngan 'das sogs thub pa yis/ /spyod pa rjes mthun ston par mdzad/ /mngon shes drug po'i cho 'phrul kyis/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ston/ /sgu dang gsung dang thugs rnams kyis/ /bye brag sna tshogs ston par mdzad/ /'gro ba yongs su 'dul ba bzhin/ /byin brlabs 'dul ba ston par mdzad/ /so so'i bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ /lha dang mi'i theg sogs pas/ /jeg pa lnga rnams so sor ston/ /rjes su bstan nas 'gro btul te/ /'gro ba sangs rgyas sar bzhag nas/ /slar byon nga/ra 'khyams thub drug bkod4/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor rnams spros la/ /khyab par kun tu bltas nas ni/ /sgyu ma bzhin du dmigs nas kyang / /so so'i yab yum bye brag la/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par dgod/ /sku gsung thugs ni byin gyis brlabs/ /gtso bo yab yum bzhin du bya/ /ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /rigs lnga'i dbu brgyan kun la bsam/ /thub drug lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /byin brlabs dbu brgyan ma gsungs so/ /thugs kyi sa 43—893

bon 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drang ste/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che/ /mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo / /oṃ a ha hi bha ga bān/ ma hā ka ru ni kra tri sha ho/ sa ma ya two/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ rang gi mdun du mngon par bsam—/ /zhabs bkru la sogs byas ni/ /oṃ dang sum̐ gnyis rtse sprad de/ /'bru brgyad rnol te rtse basbyar ba/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam spyor ba'i/ /bde ba chen po sbyin pa'i rgya/ /de nas tshig 'dis gsol ba gdab/ /oṃ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las smad po che/ /de nyid du ni bdag sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa yi/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ /nye bar gyur pa'i dam tshig mchog /de ltar ye shes dkyil 'khor dang / /dam tshig dkyil 'khor mnyam sbyar bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun la mnyam ltas nas/ /sgyu ma mig yor lta bur bsam/ /de nas lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam sbyor zhing / /mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bsgom/ /bdag gi snying po'i sa bon las/ /'od zer mang po'i zer 'phros te/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kun bsdus te/ /bdag nyid kyi ni thugs kar thim/ /rdo rje'i lam nas byung nas ni/ /byang chub sems nyid mkha' dbyings nas/ /byang chub sems kyi 'od zer las/ /mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs spros te/ /rgyal mchog dkyil 'khor mchod par byed/ /de nas lha mo'i 43—894

tshogs rnams kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dgyes pa'i glu 'di blangs par bsam/ /oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /ye shes 7 dkyil 'khor thig le che/ /bsod nams dkyil 'khor sku yi tshogs/ /snang stong thig le kun tu rdzogs/ /ho/ oṃ rdo rje bsod nams thig le che/ /rdo rje ye shes dkyil 'khor ldan/ /rdo rje sgra chen mtha' yas pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po thig le che ho/ /oṃ sku gsung thugs kyi rdzogs pa che/ /yon tan 'phrin las kun tu sdogs / /ye nas lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang / /'dus pa'i tshogs chen thig le che/ /ho/ oṃ mi dmigs rgyu 'phrul mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /mtha' yas kun nas sna tshogs 'phro/ /mtha' yas kun nas lhun gyis thim/ /sna tshogs sku gsung thugs chen po/ /ho/ /oṃ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rdul snyed du/ /rgyal ba'i don rnams rdul phran snyed/ /sprul pa rdul phran bsam yas kyis/ /skad cig yud tsam lhun gyis grub ho/ /oṃ thams cad ma lus thams cad sgu gsung thugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che/ /sgu gsung thugs kyis 5kun tu khyab/ /sku gsung thugs kyi thig le che ho/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /skyed pa yongs su rdzogs byas te/ slar yang bdag gi thugs kar bsdu / /de nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gtang sbyar gnyis sam yang na lnga/ /byas te dad pa ldan bzhugs ( — na / /'dod pa yid 'ong mnyam par 'gyur/ /cho ga lnga ni rdzogs byas shing / /yo byad lnga ni rdzogs par ldan/ /sngags kyis yan lag lnga rdzogs pas/ /ma nyams 'jug la rab brtson na/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang sgyur rigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ /de tshe bcu 43—895

drug tshun chad kyis/ /sku lnga lhun gyis rdzogs pa ni/ /ye shes thig le de nyid la//ye shes thig le nyid snang bas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog /phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /zhing khams rnam dag gzhal yas dang / /rgya dang bral ba'i gzhal yas khang / /'khor lo'i gdan dang rol mo'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsam yas kun/ /mthong nas nye bar bsnyen pa dang / /rgya chen gsung las don 'byung ba/ /mthun pa'i ye shes rang snang ba'o/ /gcig dang du ma bral ba yi/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs te/ /rang byung ye shes gnas med snang / /log par rtogs rtags rnam dag cing / /ye shes dbyings las mi zhan phyir/ /thugs rje chen pos 'brel bas na/ /'gro drug dus gnas ma lus snang / /de ltar rgyal mchog dpal ldan pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba sgrub pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor bsgom—/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /gsang ba'i thig le dkyil 'khor dbyings/ /'byung ba shes rab rigs kyi yum/ /chen po rigs kyi de bzhin te/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje'i tshogs/ /dbang po yul du rig pa rnams/ /kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bdag nyid chen po lhag pa yi/ /thugs kyi ye shes lngas ltar shing / /snying po'i thig le mnyam sbyor bas/ /bde ba'i ye shes rol mo yi//ye shes dgyes la mchod par 'bul/ /zag pa med pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /ye shes sgyu ma rang snang ba/ /rol mo'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas mchog /gsang ba'i thig le nyid kyi dbyings/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /43—896

phyogs bcu dus bzhi mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /sku gsung yon tan 'phrin las thugs//ma lus bdag nyid zhal mthong ba/ /dbang bsgyur snamachog nyid dam pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor la gnas dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub / /rgyan du dkyil 'khor ma lus thogs/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mnyam spyor bas/ /thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor yongs kyis 'byung / /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor 'dul ba'i mgon/ /sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor sgol ba'i phyir/ /bya byed med pa'i dkyil 'khor sbyong / /ye shes rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i mnyam sbyor gyis/ /rang byung sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'da' bar mi mdzad dam tshig mchog /gang zhig 'di las thumos gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyis/ /phyogs dus kun nas thams cad du/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsnyen pa yi/ /nye ba'i sras su dgongs par 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i ye shes bsgom pa'i gnas/ /mkha' dkyil dang ba'i dbyings nyi zla/ /ye shes rgyal po yab yum bsgom/ /gang zhig glang chen myos 'dra'i sems/ /mnyam par bzhag pas btul nas su/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rab bstan pa/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen por 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin las langs nas su/ /spyod lam rnam pa gnas nas kyang / /snang ba'i dngos po so sor snang / /lha'i dkyil 'khor nyid du lta/ /yang dag sgyu ma la sogs tshul/ /zas la sogs pa bza' ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i byin brlabs mngon bsdus nas/ /bdud rtsi lngar ni byin brlabs te/ /lce'i dbang po rab sbyangs nas/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor thugs kar ni/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams tshim par bya/ /dam tshig nyams pa tshul bzhin bshags/ /yang 43—897

na rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /byin brlabs kyis ni rnam par sbyangs/ /sems can thams cad mthong ba na/ /snying rje byams pa'i sems bskyed de/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bya'o zhes/ /smon pa'i sems ni khyad par can/ /blo can kyis ni rtag tu bya/ /de ltar dus bzhi'i nyin mtshan du/ /rnal 'byor tshul la gnas pa yin/ /bdag gis mi shes rmongs pa gsal don tu/ /sgyu 'phrul gsang don sgrub thabs 'di byas te/ /bdag blo chung bas nor dang 'khrul mchis pa/ /'phags dang mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /'di las bdag gis dge ba gang thob pa/ /'gro ba blo zhan rnams kyis chos kun rgo/ /stong nyid sgyu ma lta bur rab rtogs nas/ /ye shes gnyis med sku gsum thob par shog—/ //sgyu 'phrul dra ba me long lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ /slob dpon chen po dz+nyā na dza yas mdzad pa'o/ /rdzogs so// //43—898

bsdur mchan/884 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /sgyu 'phrul dra ba me long lta bu'i bsgrubu thabs bzhugs so// ③〈〈pe 〉〉spyod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉gsang /885 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgoms/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bgeg ①〈〈pe 〉sngagazhir/ du〈〈pe 〉〉sbyor/886 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bstan/887 ①〈〈pe 〉skorajig ②〈〈pe 〉staspri/888 ①〈〈pe 〉stanabus/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉btul/889 ①〈〈pe 〉stabargyan cing / ②〈〈pe 〉smonam/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉wasu/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉ba/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉thum/79༷ 0)〈〈pe 〉〉bsgom/ 00〈〈pe 〉starto/892 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gril/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bar/893 ①②〈〈pe 〉〉su/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉bkor/ du〈〈pe 〉〉bgod/895 ①〈〈pe 〉〉de/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉nugs/897 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgyur/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2533)43wa 899

༄/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'od kyi rim pa jes bya ba/ rmyesngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ satwa badz+ra ma ya dz+wa kra ma pra ba nā rngo ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje sems dpa' zusgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'od kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud dag gis/ /mthar phyin 4lha'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsgom thabs rim pa mdo tsam zhig /legs par btus te bstan par bya'o/ /ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs/ /phyogs rtogs yang dag nyid ma rtogs/ /'dul ba dgongs pa gsang ba dang / /rang bzhin gsang ba'i don rnams ni/ /yi ge sgras brtags mi tshogs la/ /brten pa'i tshig gis rab mtshon la/ /khong nas gab sbas don 'byin pa/ /ston pa rdo rje thugs gnas phyir/ /mnyes pa'i thabs kyis zin par bya/ /thos bsam bsgom la rab sbyangs pa'i/ /shes rab mig ldan rnams kyis bzung / /snod ldan ngang tshul bzang la bstan/ /lus dang longs spyod gtod la sbyin/ /43—900

gang la gsang chen 'di yod par/ /me mar mur kyi dong 'bogs shing / /spu gri'i so dag gtams pa la/ /'dzegs pa bu dag 'gro bar kyis/ /khong na gnas pa'i yang khong du/ /lcags ① kyi sgrom bu kha bsdam mo/ /slob dpon nges par mnyes byas shing / /sgyu 'phrul ri mo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang rnams thob par byas pa dang / /ston pa mchod brtson rtogs pa gsal/ /dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ /ma nyams shes shing yo byad ldan/ /sngags dang cho ga yan lag kun/ /tshang zhing lam la goms 'dod pas/ /khe grags 'dod g.yeng kun spangs te/ /dka' thub gdung bas ma nyes par/ /gnas dang longs spyod ci bde dang / /ma nyams blo ldan tshogs par bsgrub/ /ri bo dben pa'i gnas mchog ni/ /me tog shing dang bkra shis bya/ /snyan pa'i sgra ldan bar chad med/ /chu bo nub nas shar 'bab cing / /bar snang mtshams sam dgra ni nyung / /rnal 'byor spyong la dogs med pa/ /yo byad btsal sla mchog yin te/ /yon tan bzlog pa spang bar bya/ /bsam spyod mthun pa'i sa phyogs der/ /sa'i bya ba rgyas byas la/ /stod byed mgon rnams tshim byas te/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bgo bar bya/ /bu mchog gzhug pa'i las rtsom pas/ /nyi shu 'am nyi shu rtsa lnga yi/ /tshad ldan stegs bu bcu gsum byug /thig g.yog grogs mor ldan byas la/ /thig gdab cho ga phun sum tshogs/ /mkhas ldan chen pos bsgrims te bya/ /phur bu srad bu tshon phyer ldan/ /rab tu gnas byas byin ldan pas/ /'og gi rtsibs bzhi pho brang lnga/ /cha chen cha bran gsal ldan bya/ /bco brgyad gnyis kyi pho brang du/ /dkar dmar thig le gdan byas pas/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshang bar bsgom/ /gshegs gsol byin ldan rin chen 43—901

mtshon—/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mtshon ldan pas/ /lte ba'i cha byad tshul bzhin bri/ /bcos bu ras ni sna tshogs dang / /rgyan phreng ①btung ba'i bro ldan pas/ /dag par sbyangs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bdag gzhan don phyir 'byor pa 'bul/ /dbang phyug thog mar rigs pas 'jug /dkyil 'khor gsol gdab gnang zhugs par/ /bu mchog ser sna spangs pa nyid/ /gzhug skar langs bzhin rdzogs par bya/ /yang na dpag tshad rgyang grags te/ /ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor du'o/ /rnal 'byor 'dris goms 'dod pa yis/ /tshad med thugs rjes 'gro sgral zhes/ /dam bcas bstan te 'phar bstan nas/ /khams bsangs lus kyi lugs bzhin 'dug /rang gi snying gi sa bon zad/ /'phos pas bde gshegs mdun grangs 'bul/ /bla ma kun kyi yab phyir bsam/ /phyi bsogs nang gi lha mos mchod/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bstod bshags pa dang //yi rang skyabs gsol sems bskyed bsngo/ /mos pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod zin nas—/ /sems phyir bdag la bsdus par bsam/ /bar chad bgegs rnams bsal ba'i phyir/ /stong chen gsal ba'i rig pa nyid/ /skad cig sa bon rang gi lhar/ /gsal bas hūṃ sku la 'phro 'du las/ /zhe sdang rdo rje gsal ba yi/ /thugs kyi sa bon 'od zer las/ /mtshon cha rim spros bar chad bskrad/ /slar 'dus rim bzhin steng 'og gur/ /dz+wa la re gyi me dpung 'bar/ /ji tsam lcogs par mtshams bcad bya/ /ma rdzas chu bdag sa bon gyi/ /'phro 'du bzlas te bsal bar sbyang / /nyams chag bar chad bsal ba'i phyir/ /sgrub po rdzas bsags bgegs la gtor/ /mi mthun phyogs la gtor byas na/ /drag po gtum po'ang lhan rgor 'gyur/ /dam bcas snyan po shar phyir ro/ /oṃ badz+ra 43—902

kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ bi shud dha a mṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ dar ma a mṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ thams cad dag gyur bdud rtsir gyur/ /srid pa phyi nang 'byung tshul kyis/ /snod bcud dkyil 'khor bskyed byas te/ /tshe 'pho yul bral bar ma'i lus/ /sgyu snang ming gzugs 'brel ba'i bzhin/ /ting 'dzin gsum yang rim bzhin sgom/ /dngos rnams nyid na dngos med pas/ /rtog pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /de phyir dngos po dngos med pa'o/ /oṃ ma ha shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ de las snying rje chags pas bskul/ /lus dang ngag sems chos thams cad/ /gang na 'ang ni mi dmigs pa/ /mig yor tshul du sbyor ba yi/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bsgom/ /rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun kyi rtsa ba yin/ /sems nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin te/ /yi ge yid bzhin rin chen sprin—/ /yi ge mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /a rab tu brtan 'gyur a dkar las / /shin tu phra ba'i a rnams spro/ /phyogs bcu gang bar gsal 'gyur nas—/ /bsdus kyang 'phel 'grib ①med par bstan/ /de las ming tshogs gsal bar 'gyur/ /spro zhing bsdu ba de bzhin no/ /'di ni rdo rje dngos grub kyi / /brtan 'byung ye shes rgyu yin no/ /ma dmigs stong chen gzugs brnyan a/ /yid kyis nam mkhar gsal ba las/ /snying sgog lte ba 'gro mdo rlung / /las bzhi lus bzhin e mthing las/ /'phro 'dus chos kyi 'byung gnas bsam/ /de steng yam̐ 1/las gzhu dbyibs rlung / /dud ka baṃ rmye dkar chu dkyil bzlum/ /lam̐ ser ri rab ser rgyas dbyibs/ /de steng re las ye shes me//dkyil 'khor sna tshogs bye du 'phro/ /yongs 'gyur ye shes gzhal yas khang / /43—903

ye shes rin chen rgyu las byung / /tshad med rtsibs bzhi 'khor lo la/ /rtsibs bzhi mu khyud pan tsar ldan/ /gru chad blo 'bur bar 'khyams ①bcas/ /sgo khyud bzhir ldan lta babs brgyad/ /ste gnas lam gyi bgrod phyir ro/ /'bras bu yon tan brgyad rdzogs phyir/ /rta rkang chu skyes rin chen sgom/ /snam 'phyo bzhi las za ra tshags/ /rin chen sgril 'chang shar bu khyud/ /rims bzhin dbyibs mdog mdzes par ldan/ /tha snyad sems phyir bum pa gcig /rma bya'i mdongs ldan cir yang snang / /mthon dman tshad med bya 'dab ldan/ /thugs rje kun snyoms khyab phyir ro/ /yang thog mtho dman rim ldan pa'i/ /tha ma'i 'dab mas kun g.yogs par/ /ye shes rtsig ste se gol gtams/ /mi 'jigs kha nas mu tig har/ /pha khu mdzes pa'i bde dang ldan/ /dra ba dra byed 'gul 'khor bar/ /gzugs sogs lha mos 'khrigs pa ste/ /sna tshogs mchod byed rol mo yis/ /bar snang khams su sprin dpung bzhin/ /sgo bzhi g.yas g.yon ljon shing dang / /dpag bsam shing zung tsong tsong 'phel/ /dril bu g.yer ga theg sgrogs pa/ /bkra shis bya snyan sgra sgrogs ldan/ /yid bzhin rin chen brgyan bskor bas/ /rin chen phung po bzhi gnyis ldan/ /thams cad la ni dbang sgyur phyir/ /lha chen phyogs skyong brgyad kyis bskor/ /'khor ⑤lo rtsibs chen mu khyud ldan/ /rtsibs ldan pho brang lnga pa nyid/ /bar khyams sgo khyud ldan pa la/ /dkyil 'khor bcu phrag brgyad gnyis ldan/ /pho brang dbus kyi lte ba la/ /mi 'jigs seng ge brgyad dang ldan/ /shar phyogs lte bar stobs glang che/ /lho ru rdzu 'phrul rta brgyad steng / /nub kyi pho brang rma bya dbang / /byang du 'phrin las shang shang brgyad/ /khri rkang bar mdzes pad 43—904

ldan pa/ /nyi ma zla ba lnga brtsegs ldan/ /nyi zla chu skyes sum brtsegs sems/ /nyi rkyang khro dang pad kyang thub/ /bya byed kun bzang yab dang yum/ /nyi zla pad ma rin chen rgyas/ /gdan la mnyam pa'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /bdun phrag sum cu rtsa brgyad rlung / /las kyi rim bzhin rnam smin lus/ /rdzogs bzhin dam pa'i sa bon las/ /'phro 'du gsum gyi sku rdzogs bskyed/ /rgyu'i a las hūṃ oṃ tram̐/ /a haṃ saṃ sogs yi ge bcu/ /pho brang lnga la rim bzhin bsam/ /rtsibs bzhi yi ge e tram̐ hri/ /dza dang dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdang / /tram̐ de du ha sogs pa 'am—/ /yang na so so zung bcas pa'o/ /ak+ṣa hūṃ drug bar 'khyams la/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsgo bzhi ste/ /hūṃ chen nyi shu phyi rol tu/ /bskal pa'i me la rims bzhin bsam/ /sa bon yi ge phyi ru thim/ /de dag 'du 'phro yongs 'dus pas//so so'i phyogs mtshams 'bar bar 'gyur/ /yongs gyur 'phra mo kun phro hūṃ 'dus/ /phyag rgya chen po rdzogs par bskyed/ /tha snyad bdag phyir bdag las skyed/ /bde 1gshegs rigs las shar ba'i phyir/ /rgyal ba bdag gi sras gyur te/ /sgyu'i 'khor lo bskyed pa'o/ /'bras bu'i 'khor lo bsam pa ni/ /gtso bo thugs las shar ba dag /'jig rten mes po sras kyi mchog /bdag gis bzung ste gsol ba gdab/ /ho sems nyid theg par rab nges pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad cu rtsa gnyis rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsam yas pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs su bdag sbyor cing / /bskul bas gnas gsum gzer 'phros te/ /mngon sum sbyangs pas lugs ka bzhin—/ /gyur pa 'phros pa'i yi ge gsum/ /yi ge hūṃ du gyur pa la/ /zla rlung sbyor bas gtegs nas ni/ /bskor te rtse ba'i thugs kar thim/ /rdo rje 43—905

lam byung yum gyi mkhar/ /rgyu'i chos sku sems su gnas/ /lha rnams so sor sgra phyung rol/ /kun kyang 'od dpung sna tshogs mdog /skad cig dran pas ak+ka ste/ /yongs gyur rdo rje dril 'bar bsam/ /'phro 'dus 'gro don 'phags mchod nas/ /slar 'dus 'phra mo'i sku 'phro 'dus/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sku gnyis rdzogs/ /byed pa rdo rje yab yum gnyis/ /in tra nī la'i kha dog 'dra/ /rang rtags rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /'khril pa chen po'i tshul du bsam—/ /nus mthu ldan phyir byin rlabs dbang / /thugs ka'i 'od zer khyab skul bas/ /phyogs dus bde gshegs rigs lngar gshegs/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs dbu brgyan dhidabang / /de nyid rkyen kyi sngags kyi bskul/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'phro 'du las/ /sku gsung thugs ldan lhar bskyed de/ /gsum pa'i sngags kyi nga rgyal bya/ /mtshon gang dkar dmar thig dkar shar/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gdon pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje skye mched gsang gnas brlab/ /kun bzangs spyi bo ljags steng snying / /lte ba nang gi gsang ba la/ /oṃ hūṃ swa saṃ hā rims bzhin/ /gnas der yi la sum̐ lo saṃ/ /paṃ tai bsam pa yab yum bcu—/ /rna sna lce'i phyi nang la/ /bhe tri dz+re a/ me zli hri ②sum̐ sogs brgyad/ /yum gyi gnas der hūṃ tram̐ hri/ /a sogs dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbazhis/ /sems ma brgyad po rims bzhin bsam/ /g.yas g.yon yan lag mkha' gsang la/ /hūṃ bzhi khro bo bzhi ru bsam/ /yī la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥlas/ /sgo ma bzhi bsam bco brgyad las / /yab yum gnyis la rdzogs par bya/ /de nas gsang gnas byin brlabs pa—/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga phaṭa/ /de las pad+ma 'dab rgyad saṃ/ /rjes su chags pas tshul bzhin skul④/ /phyag rgya bzhis rol dgyes sprin 'phro/ /mkha' la thig 43—906

gdab gzhal yas gdan/ /bsams te sku rdzogs gnas pa nyid/ /gtso 'khor rims bzhin dza yis gdon/ /phyi rol gnas su khyab par sbyar/ /rgyu bi shud dhe dz+nyā na tsakra/ du ti tsakra ①nan/ sur+ya tsakra rat+na pad+ma ma da la/ hūṃ badz+ra drig sum̐ da du shwa ri/ oṃ satwa badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ ti shra badz+ra ā/ oṃ rat+na badz+ra tram̐/oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la hūṃ/ oṃ dharma badz+ra hri/ oṃ sang gra badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ karma badz+ra ha/oṃ tsad tsa la badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ dzi na dzig /oṃ lo sha ra ti/ oṃ badz+ra sang twa/ oṃ badz+ra la se oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra du be+e oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ra ga oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra saṃ gu sha oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra su oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra de sha ra ti oṃ/ swa rad+mā drig /oṃ mo ha ra ti/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra rat+na tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra ma le tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra sur+ya tri/ oṃ badz+ra ke du ①tri/ oṃ badz+ra pa sha /oṃ badz+ra has — tram̐/ oṃ rat+na ra ti tram̐/ oṃ ①a ro lig /baṃ ra ga ra ti/ oṃ badz+ra dar ma tri/ oṃ badz+ra gir ti hri/ oṃ badz+ra tig sna hri/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ge hri/ oṃ badz+ra tsa tra hri/ oṃ badz+ra spo ta tri/ oṃ badz+ra pa sha hri/ oṃ badz+ra a lo hri/ ha prad nya drig /tai badz+ra ra ti/ oṃ badz+ra kar ma ha/ oṃ badz+ra nir ti ha/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ka ha/ oṃ badz+ra gan te ha/oṃ badz+ra yak+ka ha/ oṃ badz+ra gan to ha/ oṃ badz+ra san to ha/ oṃ badz+ra a be+e sha ha/oṃ badz+ra a gu sha dza dza/ oṃ badz+ra pa sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bo ta paṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan de ho—/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra tsi ta oṃ/ a a a badz+ra batra sa ma ya oṃ oṃ nu ne+e kring swā hā/ oṃ mu ne dṛ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne bro rjoswā hā/ oṃ mu de srum sru hā/oṃ mu ne+e k+ka swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūṃ ka ra/ hūṃ phaṭa/ gro ⑤ti shwa rik+ka ya te hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi hūṃ phaṭa/ gro ti shwa ri la se ge hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ni la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ kro ti sho ri pra ti dza hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka 43—907

hūṃ phaṭa/ kro ti sho ri ta na ba ti hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ār+ya a tsa la hūṃ phaṭa/ kro ti shwa ri mu ha la hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya shrī ba hūṃ phaṭa/ kro ti sho ri tsan dha he ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa ra tsi ta hūṃ phaṭa/ kro ti sho ri sha ya bya ti hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ kro ti shwa ri ba ya ba ti hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta tre log kya bi dz+ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ kro ti sho ri ma re na hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā ba la hūṃ phaṭa/ kro ti sho ri tsan ta mu ne+e hūṃ/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gsal ston pas/ /so so'i gnas su rgyas par 'god/ /gdan la rdzogs dang sems dpa'i tshul/ /'joms dang thub pas brkyang skum bzhengs/ /'khor lo'i dbus la rgyal po yum//mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon phyogs bzhi ru/ /sems dpa' sems ma rigs bzhin gnas—/ /bar khyams la ni thub pa drug /rgyud drug sbyong ba'i phyag rgyar gnas/ /shar lho lha dang lho phyogs mi/ /lho nub byang nub yi dwags byol/ /byang dang byang shar lha min dmyal/ /mdun rgyab bya byed yab yum gtso/ /sgo khyud bsrung ba khro mo bzhi/ /bskal pa'i me la khro zung bcu/ /phyogs mtshams srung ba'i tshul du gnas/ /de kun byin dbang nus ldan pas/ /'gro don bya phyir tshul bzhin bsam/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā ①na badz+ra swa bha ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma ha a ta ri sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ②ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā ①sa man+ta snyo na badz+ra swa bhā ④ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā pra ta bra be sha snyo na badz+ra swa bha ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ ma hā kri ta a nu ta na dz+nyā ⑤badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā bāg badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsi ta badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ dkyil 'khor dbang bskur ⑥thim par 'gyur/ /byin brlabs rab tu gsal bar 'gyur/ /rin chen smug 43—908

po gnas cig tu/ /mtshon gang sems dpa' 'od ldan pa/ /thugs kyi sa bon brlabs pas bskor/ /kun gyi bdag nyid dkyil du bsam/ /thub drug sprul pa rang byung phyir/ /byin brlabs dbu brgyan ma gsungs so/ /mthing kha dkar po ser le brgan/ /ljang gu kha dog gsal 'tsher 'bar sems dpa' rnams ni rigs kyi tshul/ /gser 3dang dkar mthing byeser nag dang / /dmar nag dud ka thub pa'i sku/ /sngo ser dmar ljang sgo bsrungs sku/ /khros pas bsrung phyir rtsa gnag pa'o/ /mthing ga hūṃ chen rnam rgyal dkar/ /dbyug pa sngo la gshed mthing gnag /mi g.yo ljang sngo rta mgrin dmar/ /'dod rgyal dud ka bdud rtsi ljang / /khams gsum dkar ljang stobs chen dud/ /khro bo rnams ni khro dang mthur/ /kun kyang dur khrod chas ldan par/ /me dpung 'phros 'dus ldan pa'o/ /sku'i mtshan nyid dgu ldan te/ /mnyen lcug 'khril sdem gzhon tshul can/ /gsal 'tsher lhun snyug gzi brjid ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad+ma ral gri dril bu 'bar/ /gtso gzungs 'phel ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /sor rtser 'chang ba thugs kar bstan/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dri/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mda' gzhu brgya/ /rin chen myu gu nyi ma dang / /rgyal mtshan sor 'phreng 'dzin pa dang / /pad+ma kha 'byed ral gri dang / /'khor lo 'dzin dang lce 'dzin pa/ /ral gri rdo rje 'phreng ba dang / /mche ba khu tshur bcangs pa'o / /me long pog phor lcags kyu 'phreng / /rin chen me tog zhags gsil yab/ /pi bang mar me lcags sgrog gdongs/ /gar 'dzin spos dril rma bya bum/ /gseg ④gshang par bu pi bang dang / /go cha mdung thung po ti brtsegs/gye / /rin chen sgrom bu me dang chu/ /kun bzang mnyam bzhag ye shes 43—909

'phro—/ /yum 'gyur mnyam rdzogs pad mo dkyil/ /yang na rdo rje dril bu nyid//lcags kyu zhags pa po ta ho/ /'khor lo dri mgo rdo rje ster/ /zhugs gling dang ni drang srong nyid/ /zhing dbyug gshin rje rka bzung ba/ /ral gri bde bral ster dbyug gshog /ba dan lce spyang brgyad be ram thogs/ /rin chen mgo bo gsum kyi dbyug /rdo rje rtse gsum dri 'go dang / /thong bshol gtun shing g.yas g.yon thogs/ /yang na phyag drug mngon par rol/ /khro mo'i g.yas ni gtso la 'khyud/ /g.yon par ga ta ston pa'o/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che/ /mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo / /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa'i/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ /nye bar gyur pa'i dam tshig mchog /ha nyi ba ①ga bān/ ma hā ka ru ni ka tri sha ho/ sa ma ya ṣ+ṭi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/oṃ a hūṃ swā hā/ ba ba ba ba ba dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra ②sa sa sa sa sa ma ma ma ma ma ya ya ya ya ya/ oṃ e hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /phyag rgya chen po bdag sbyor cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ṣ+ṭi/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ho—/ sgo bzhir byin bstem brtan byas la/ /gnyis med phyag 'tshal tshogs phyir mchod/ /mi bskyod ④nyi ma'i dkyil yi ge/ /rin chen zla ba'i dkyil yi ge//lnga gnyis zung du spros pa las/ /sbyar ba'i phyag rgya 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /bskyed chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /tshom bu dkyil 'khor gsal bsgoms na/ /bsgul bskyod thams cad phyag rgya yin/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar skan/ /43—910

hūṃ sgreng rtse mor rdo rje 'bar/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril bsil ①zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar skan/ /sum̐ greng rtse mor dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /rigs bzhi kun kyang gtso bo bzhin/ /g.yas g.yon mdzub mo oṃ lo la/ /'khor lo dril 4bu 'bar bar bsam/ /the 'ong gnyis la swa mo ste/ /rin chen dril bu rab 'bar ba/ /srin lag g.yas g.yon oṃ paṃ ste//pad+ma dril bu rtse la 'bar/ /the chung ha ti ral gyi dril/ /'bru sbas bkan dang bstan 'khril pa'o/ /yang na rtsa skyed sngags kyis so/ /g.yas g.yon sor rtser hūṃ tram̐ hri/ /a sogs zung bzhi nyi zla ste/ /rims bsams gung mo rtse sprad pa/ /sems dpa' rdo rje yab yum mo/ /mdzub mo rtse sprad rin chen no/ /srin lag rtse sprad chos rdo rje/ /the chung rtse sprad las rdo rje/ /the bo mdzub mo rdo rje 'dzin/ /the bo gung mo rgyal ba 'dzin/ /srin lag the bong chags pa che/ /the chung the bong legs pa mchog /g.yas rol hūṃ dza ho dang swa/ /mdzub mo gnyis sbyar rin chen mchog /gung mo gnyis sbyar rin chen don/ /srin lag gnyis sbyar rgyal mtshan te/ /rdo rje gzhad pa the chung sprad/ /tai dang he du sta rims bzhin/ /mdzub mo steng 'og rdo rje chos/ /gung mo steng 'og 'jam dpal mchog /srin lag steng 'og 'khor lo mchog /the chung steng 'og rdo rje smra/ /tri baṃ tram̐ dang hi bzhi bsam/ /mdzub mo rgya gram rdo rje las/ /gung mo rgya gram rdo rje bsrung / /srin lag rgya gram gnod sbyin mchog /the chung rgya gram khu tshur ro/ /haṃ hūṃ a baṃ sor rtser bsam/ /dza dang ho la sogs pa'o/ /gar du sgyur bas rdo rje 'chang //phyag rgya brda tshig chen po 'dis/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor byed par snang / /43—911

rang bzhin dkyil 'khor phun sum tshogs/ /glu gnyis phyag rgyar ldan pa yis/ /sa ler gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'be+ebs/ /phyag rgya spros pa chen po ni/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam gnyis po/ /dag par gsal bas phyag rgya yin/ /yi ge so sor gsal ba yis/ /gar du bsgyur bas mya ngan 'das/ /gseg par pi bang go cha dang / /po ti sgrom dang me chu rgya/ /ji ltar gnas bzhin bca' ba ste/ /lcags kyu zhags pa dril bu sgog /yi ge gsal bas bzung ba'i tshul/ /khro bcu g.yas g.yon nyid hūṃ gis/ /gar du sgyur zhing rim bzhin gsal/ /dpel dang zhal gsil gsol mchod bya/ /mnyam pa'i bsgrub ①rdzas chen po dag /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshigs la 'bul/ /lha yang rtag tu mchod byas na/ /bdag dang gnyis su med par 'gyur/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo//longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor thim/ /shes par rab spyad na/ /ngo mtshar 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor mnyes/ /ri rab chen po'i gling bzhi la/ /gnas pa'i sems can ma lus kun/ /bdag nyid chen po rtogs pa yis/ /dbyibs su yang ni sba bar bya'o/ /'khril pa'i mchod chen mnyam spyor bas/ /bdag nyid mnyes pas mnyes par bya'o/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad la/ /dga' ba chen po khyab par 'gyur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ thig le 'dres pas phyi nang gi/ /lha mo spros te bdag nyid mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pu tsa badz+ra swa bhā ⑤ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs kyis—/ /snod dang bcud kyis dngos po kun/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i sems phyir dbul/ /'bras bu don gyi dgyes bya'i phyir/ /glu'i mchod pa tshul bzhin 43—912

mchod—/ /'phags bstod sems can grol bya'i phyir/ /dung dang zangs dang mud rtsa ra/ /pi bang gling bu ke ko ta/ /pheg rdob rdza lnga pi bang dang / /dgu po rgyud mangs sgra sgrogs sbyar/ /rgyal po 'khor bcas dgongs gsol te/ /tshogs phyir mchod pa rgya mtsho 'bul/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyams chags bshags / /las la don phyir 'phrin las bcol/ /grub pa'i 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ /phyi dang nang gi phra mo yis/ /rnal 'byor bsgrub phyir bzlas par bya/ /phyi rol yan lag brgyad ldan pa'i/ /dam tshig ye shes yig gsal bas—/ /rnam gsum ma 'khrul tshul gyis bzlas/ /oṃ hūṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ badz+ra pra ban hūṃ/ sum̐ badz+ra gdan/ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tsa tra ma da la oṃ/ lo badz+ra ga na da pa sha lo/ swa rad na pra pa ni swe/ oṃ badz+ra gan dha pa sha oṃ/ saṃ pad+ma pra pa na saṃ/ paṃ badz+ra gan dha pra pa na paṃ/ haṃ khang rtig sna pra pa na haṃ/ tai badz+ra ga na da pra pa na pa sha haṃ/ yang na bskyed dang zlas thun mong / /nang du yab yum zhal sprod de/ /dgra bcom med pa'i zlas pa yis/ /dbus kyi rtsa nyid 'phro 'du'i lam/ /zhal nas zhal dang mkha' nas mkhar/ /skor bas drug log bde myong du/ /bsnyen pa grangs dus mtshan ma yis/ /thabs kyi mchog tu de gsungs so/ /rims ①par goms dang nyams ldan pas/ /rdzu skye'i tshul du skad cig gis/ /yongs su rdzogs par skyed byas te/ /de goms grangs med slob sdebyed pas/ /bdag gzhan las kun byed pa'i phyir/ /skabs kyis dang por brjod pa yin/ /de goms rigs 'dzin tshe la sbyor/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang sgyur rigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ /lus dang phung por bcas pa yin/ /tshe la dbang pa'i rigs 'dzin 'grub/ /rig pa 'dzin 43—913

pa'i tshe nyid kyis/ /bla med kun tu bzang gyur pa/ /lhag ma bcas dang lhag med pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i tshal ①nyid kyis/ /'di dang bar mar sbyor ba ste / /dper na khyung dang seng ge bzhin/ /rnam smin rgya mdud grol ma thag /bar ma ye shes sgyu ma'i sku/ /mngon mtho rig pa'i sa la gnas/ /de tshe bcu drug tshun chad kyi②/ /sku lnga lhun kyis rdzogs pa ni/ /ye shes thig le ①de nyid la//ye shes thig le nyid snang ba'i/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog /mngon 'gyur chu dang nyi zla bzhin/ /de nas longs spyod bde ldan pas/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir yo byad lngas/ /sna tshogs mchod pa rgyas mchod pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug longs spyod de/ /sems phyir hūṃ gis longs spyod pa 'am//ye shes rol pa'i tshul 'chang ba/ /tha mal 'dzin grol de la sbyor/ /de phyir 'byor pa nan tan bskyed/ /bdag nyid mkha' 'gro 'dul byed pa/ /dbang phyug rgyal ba rigs lnga yi/ /bsam dang ldan pas lhag ma nyid/ /gzhung bzhin btsal te tshim byas la/ /rjes su mthun rjopa'i las stsol te/ rang rang gnas su las dgye'o/ /rtag chad mtha' las grol bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor rims bzhin snying la bsdu/ /mi dmigs ngang las gtso bor bskyed/ /bskyed pa'i rdzogs par bstan pa'o/ /bar chod rgyun las grol ba'i phyir/ /rgya gram go dang khro lus byung / /de nyid 'gro don nus ldan phyir/ /dbang bskur dbu rgyan cod pan ldan/ /bdag nyid spyod lam 'gro 'dug nyal/ /longs spyod dus bzhir mnyam langs tshe/ /rig phyir thams cad dkyil 'khor ltar/ /gsal byas tha snyad zhen las 'das/ /phyag rgya chen po nyid du 'gyur/ /de phyir le lo gnyid sbyangs 'bad/ /de ltar ting 'dzin skyod rjoldang na/ /rdzogs pa'i bsam 43—914

pa sbyor bya ste/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /gsang ba'i thig le nyid kyi dbyengs/ /'byung ba shes rab rigs kyi yum/ /chen po rigs kyi de bzhin te/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje'i tshogs/ /dbang po'i yul dus rig pa'i rnams/ /kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bdag nyid chen po lhag pa yi/ /thugs kyi ye shes lnga lta zhing ①/ /snying po'i thig le mnyam sbyor bas/ /bde ba'i ye shes rol mo yis/ /ye shes dgyes la mchod pa dbul/ /zag pa med pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /ye shes sgyu ma rang snang ba/ /rol mo dkyil 'khor mtha' yas mchog /de la sogs pa'i gdams ngag ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o//de goms 'khor lo'i rims bsdus te/ /ma ta'i sgra la dmigs te 'dug /de'i ngang las nang bar dus/ /skad cig lha kun rdzogs bsams te/ /bstod mchod la sogs rgyas par bya/ /rdzogs pa nyid du sbyor ba yis/ /na ta'i sgra yang mi dmigs sbyar/ /stobs 'gyur thams cad ye shes sras/ /skad cing rig la gsal mthong ba/ /rdzogs pa'i rdzogs par bshad pa yin/ /bdag nyid nam zhig 'pho ba'i tshe/ /ye shes sku nyid gsal bstan la/ /'pho ba'i sems stobs drag po yis/ /bar ma ye shes gzugs skur sbyor/ /de ltar goms pas snga ma bzhin/ /tshe dang phyag rgya lhun grub rigs/ /des thob rdzogs pa'i sar sbyor ba/ /ye shes lha mo rol spyod dang / /gsang ba'i rdzogs sku byin brlabs kyis/ /skad cig lhun grub sa la 'gro/ /log par rtogs brtags rnam dag cing / /ye shes dbyings las mi zhan phyir/ /thugs rje chen po 43—915

'brel pas na/ /'gro drug dus gnas snang ba yang / /mtho dman kun gyi gzugs snang yang / /bla med byang chub skur snang ba/ /me long lta bu'i tshul bzhin du/ /sna tshogs kha dog dbyibs su snang / /lhun grub sku las ma g.yos bzhin—/ /so so ji ltar 'dul ba bzhin/ /rtog pa rnams la 'khor ba'i lus//thar pa'i cha ston rgyal po dang / /tshangs dang lha chen tha dad snang / /thar pa rnams la dag pa'i sku/ /nyan thos rnams la dgra bcom lus/ /rang rgyal rnams la bse ru'i tshul/ /mos spyod mdo sder shākya'i tshul/ /byang chub sems la rdzogs longs spyod/ /lhun grub rnams la rdo rje dbyings/ /zhi khro 'dul ba'i tshogs chen la/ /so sor mthun byas kun tu snang / /dper na me long chu zla bzhin—/ /'gro 'ong med la kun tu gsal/ /so sor mthun byas kun tu snang //dper na me long chu zla bzhin/ /'gro 'ong med las kun du gsal/ /gsal nyid sgyu mas mig yor tshul/ /tshul nyid dbyings las g.yos pa med/ /thar pa skul zhing ngan song sbyong / /zhi ba phyogs cig shes bya sbyor/ /sa bcu mnyam par sbyor byed cing / /tshogs gnyis yang dag rdzogs byed ①pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal ba nyid kyi sku/ /kun tu rin chen lta bu'o/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud kyi rgya mtsho las/ /gsang bas 'o ma'i tshul bzhin 'od kyis sneskas/ /rim pa'i bsgrub thabs gsal byed yi ge 'di/ /shes chung phyogs shar bdag gis legs par btus/ /'di la nongs 'gal ra chod gyur pa dag /mi dmigs sems kyi dag pa'i klong du gshags/ /de lta'i dge rtsa lam gnas rnal 'byor kun/ /bskyed rims mthar phyin yang dag zhen grol nas/ /kun gyi thar lam mngon gyur don rdzogs te/ /mtha' yas 'gro don tshul bzhin byed par shog/ //43—916

sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skyed pa'i rim pa ting nge 'dzin/ dkyil 'khor lnga'i /dza /kye1re /de /re /sgo 11dbang du sbyar ba da ma pa sa bya ba man ngag / ba da na sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i man ngag /'od kyi rim pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/9༷༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉rdza rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'od kyi rim pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉ra/ ①〈〈pe 〉rapa'i/ rjo〈〈pe 〉l+len/9༷1 ①〈〈pe 〉7gas/9༷2 ①〈〈pe 〉thaphreng /9༷3 ①〈〈pe 〉thab/ sne〈〈pe 〉la pe〈〈pe 〉tsā/9༷4 ①rte〈pe 〉ma sa/ sde〈〈pe 〉lker/9༷5 sti〈〈pe 〉〉〈/ khru〈〈pe 〉8/9༷6 ①〈〈pe 〉d+kun/ 1〈〈pe 〉7hri/ ①〈〈pe 〉miskul/9༷7 ①〈〈pe 〉tsha tra/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tu/ ①〈〈pe 〉mgo ༷〈〈pe 〉tsā/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉tha/9༷8 ①〈〈pe 〉snganya'/ khru〈〈pe 〉lta/ ①〈〈pe 〉d+ku/ du〈〈pe〉sto/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉snyo/ du〈〈pe 〉thor/9༷9 ①〈〈pe 〉'ar ②〈〈pe 〉〉thing 1〈〈pe 〉thapheng / rjo〈〈pe 〉thaseg ⑤〈〈pe 〉ldegs/91༷ sde〈〈pe 〉wā/ ②〈〈pe 〉7dz+ra/ ①〈〈pe 〉sta / 911 ①〈〈pe 〉rasil/ ②〈〈pe 〉tsās/912 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ma / ②〈〈pe 〉sto/913 ①〈〈pe 〉'am/ ②〈〈pe 〉7slob/914 ①〈〈pe 〉7tshal/ ②〈〈pe 〉7sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉'ag rjo〈〈pe 〉mothun/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉skyo/915 ①〈〈pe 〉8nga /916 ①〈〈pe 〉thad/ ①〈〈pe 〉tha/43—917
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2534)43wa 918

༄ga /sgyu 'phrul phyag rgya bsam gtan/ hūṃ༄4/ /rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rdo rje chos kyi phyag rgya che/ /'jug dang dmigs pa las 'das pa'i/ /bsam gtan bsdus pa 'di bshad do//sgyu 'phrul dra bas khudabang bskur ba'i/ /rgyud dang bden pa'i dbang thob pa'i/ /sngags pa blo ldan dbe+en dga' bas/ /sngon du bya ba kun byas te/ /bar chad rnam gsum med pa'i gnas/ /rnyed nas cig pur gnas par bya/ /rang gi gzugs brnyan mdun bzhag la/ /slob dpon rgyal po rdo rje chos/ /zla ba dza yis spyan drangs thim/ /bdug sogs mchod de thal sbyar la/ /rdo rje slob dpal sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mngon sbyar yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang / /43—919

dag pa mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /mchog gsum rten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su gsol/ /tshe rabs bsgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /sgrub rdzas pad+ma'i 'brus sbyangs la/ /zla 'bru'i steng du hri zin par/ /hri yis nam mkha'i bdud rtsi dbab/ /sngags zlas bdud rtsi dkyil bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi ta sa ma hūṃ tri tha/ dngos rnams nyid na dngos med par/ /rtog pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /de phyir dngos po dngos med pa'o/ /de bzhin nyid du gsal brtan nas/ /skyes stipa'i phyag rgya rig pa nyid/ /a ma sbyar te bstan pa dang / /'od 'phros don byas byin brlabs te/ /gang ba'i nyi zla pad mor bcas/ /bstan pas gzhal yas rang gi sems/ /sngon po hūṃ nyid rig pa'i dngos/ /dbyings la dbyings kyis bris pas te/ /gzugs dang bral bas kha dog med/ /'od kyi phyogs kun sems su byas—/ /slar 'dur lta bar bcas par grol/ /rnam lngas rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya yin—/ /brtan nas khams gsum skus bkang ste/ /dril bu thabs dang shes rab sku/ /zhal gsum phyag drug yang na gnyis/ /shu snyo ta sogs brgyad pa'i sngags—/ /rdzogs pa'i tshul du rdzogs dbang bskur②/ /zla stengs sgo gsum gsal ba'i 'bru/ /bsdu ba'i sbyor bas rlung bsdus te/ /dngos po sgo gsum phyag rgya gsum/ /dkar dmar thing ga dkyil yi ge/ /phyogs bcu khyab pa'i hūṃ 'od zer/ /skras bskul thams cad rdo rje bzhengs/ /rtse mo lcags kyus spyan drangs la/ /e ha hi zhes dgug ste bstem/ /hūṃ dza spo ta ho yis gzhugasne /mchod de rdo rje'i zlas pa bya/ /khams gsum dbang phyug mun gnas la/ /spro 43—920

ba gsum gyis gsal gdab bskul/ /rdo rje gsum dngos 'dus pas stem/ /rdo rje chos kyi gzi 'drar 'gyur/ /zla drug de bzhin lo zla bzhi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas te/ /brtson 'grus yu ba bcad pa bzhin/ /rdo rje nyid 'gyur the tshom med/ /dbang po rnam gnyis byin brlabs 'khyud/ /rdo rje khu bas mkha' bkang bluste/ /thig le ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /'dod pa drug dang tshim pa bzhiblu/ /spros nas ma lus bdag nyid mnyes/ /pu tsa badz+ra sngags kyis thob//de bzhin mnyam pa'i bsgrub rdzas dag /ye shes bdud rtsis thim par dbul/ /dngos po 'bru gsum blangs nas su/ /rdo rje lce gzhag dngos grub 'gyur/ /oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor thig le che/ /bsod nams dkyil 'khor sku yi tshogs/ /snang stong thig le kun rdzogs ho/ /oṃ rdo je bsod nams thig le che/ /rdo rje ye shes dkyil 'khor ldan/ /rdo rje sgra chen mtha' yas pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po thig le che ho/ /oṃ sku gsung thugs kyi rdzogs pa che / /yon tan 'phrin ke las kun tu rdzogs/ /ye shes lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang / /'dus pa'i tshogs chen thig le che ho/ /oṃ mi dmigs sgyu 'phrul mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /mtha' yas kun nas sna tshogs 'phro/ /mtha' yas kun nas lhun kyis thim/ /sna tshogs sku gsung thugs chen po/ /ho/ oṃ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sdul snyed du/ /rgyal ba'i don rnams gdul phran snyed/ /sprul pa rdul bral bsam yas kyis/ /skad cig nyid la lhun gyis grub/ /ho/oṃ thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che/ /sgu gsung thugs kyis kun tu khyab/ /sku gsung thugs kyi thig le che/ /ho/hūṃ badz+ra be+eg /sum̐ da du shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ spyod lam rnam pa gsum du yang / /'bad 43—921

de yengs pa med sems shing / /spyod yul mtshan nyid thams cad la/ /thig le'am yang na lha mo drug /nyid du sbyor bas mthong thos med/ /dmigs rgyu la sogs mtshan ma lnga/ /bstan pas nyes pa'i rtsa ba med/ /'dri mchog dkyil 'khor bri la sogs/ /skabs 'dir gags yin slang mi bya/ /de ltar goms rtogs rigs mchog des/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /rigs 'dzin sa la gdon mi za/ /rgyud las rmos pa'i yon tan rnams/ /tshe 'dis mngon du gyur pa yis/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen mnyes/ /'di ltar bsgrubs shing sgom byas na/ /'bras bu mngon du ma byung yang / /tshe rabs skye ba thams cad du/ /las ngan kun tu skye mi 'gyur/ /theg pa sman par yong mi skye/ /bde gshegs 'byung dang skol mi 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal thams cad yong mi 'byung / /lha mi mtshan rdzogs yongs su 'grub/ /mthar ni skye med rdo rje'i sar/ /'grub 'gyur the tshom med ces bshad/ /sgyu 'phrul phyag rgya bsam gtan rdzogs so// //rgyal ba kun tu bzang po'i sgyu 'phrul las/ /ngang pas 'o ma blangs pa'i dpe bzhin du/ /rab 'bring kun gyis nyams su slang ⑨ba'i chos/ /gab sbas mngon du byung ba'i man ngag 'di/ /'phangs med ser sna spangs las ma rtogs pa—/ /dam med chags pa'i 'khor dang ma phrad cig /slob dpon bi ma las mdzad pa rdzogs so// //43—922

bsdur mchan/919 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉tha'i/92 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skyed/ ②〈〈pe 〉skasar/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bzhug921 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bgang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉bzhin/ ②〈〈pe 〉99na/922 ①〈〈pe 〉〉zang /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2535)43wa 923

༄/ /na mo rin chen mngon rjegs zhes bya ba/rmye༄7/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /ye shes rgya mtsho rab zab thugs / /dkyil 'khor yid bzhin 'byung ba'i gter/ /nor bu rin chen yon tan mdzod/ /rdo rje'i yid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma'o bde gshegs snying po las/ /rang gi rnam rtog las kyis sprul/ /sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang / /gnas dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ /bdag dang bdag gir so sor 'dzin / /sus kyang ma bcings bcings med de/ /bcing bar bya ba yod ma yin / /rnam rtog bdag tu 'dzin pa yis/ /nan gyis mkha' la mdud pa 'dor—/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgya dral nas/ /byang chub mchog la dgod pa dang / /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas blo ldan don/ /bla med ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir / /rgyud kyi don bsdus snying po 'di/ /ma nor btus te bstan par bya/ /ri bo 'dus pa'i rtse rnams dang / /dbe+en pa chen po'i sa phyogs dang / /tsan 43—924

dan nags tshal me tog tshal/ /yid 'ong bkra shis sems dga' ba'i/ /bdag dbang bar chad med pa'i gnas/ /der ni ting 'dzin bsgom par bya/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin mod kyi/ /rtog pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba las/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes pa nyid na skye ba med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis ⑫gsang / /'gag pa med las thams cad 'gag /'gag tsam nyid na 'gag pa med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar smad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis gsang / /gnas pa med las thams cad gnas/ /gnas pa nyid na gnas pa med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis gsang / /dmigs pa med las thams cad dmigs/ /dmigs pa nyid na dmigs pa med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun kyis gsang / /'gro 'ong med las 'gro dang 'ong / /'gro 'ong nyid na 'gro 'ong med/ /bsgrub pa'i gtsor ni ting 'dzin pas/ /ting 'dzin 'di 'is byed par 'gyur/ /mun la snang 'byung ji bzhin du/ /'gyur bas gser 'gyur sman gyi tshul/ /rtog pa'i dbang 'gyur ting 'dzin yin/ /de ltar ting 'dzin rims bzhin bsgomatsho—/ /dngos rnams nyid na dngos med pas/ /rtog pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /de phyir dngos po dngos med do/ /de bzhin nyid de spros med kyang / /rang bzhin kun tu snang ba'i dbyings—/ /sems can rnams la snying rje'i phyir/ /nam mkha' la ni nam 43—925

mkha' sgom/ /dngos po med las dngos po sprin/ /sna tshogs rnam par 'byung zhing 'gyur/ /bzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun kyis rtsa ba yin—/ /sems nyid yi ge rang bzhin de/ /yi ge yid bzhin rin chen sprin/ /yi ge'i mchog ni sgom par bya/ /a rab tu brtan 'gyur a dkar las/ /shin tu phra ba'i a rnams 'phro/ /phyogs bcu gang bar gsal 'gyur nas/ /byang chub sems su byin brlabs te/ /bsdus kyang 'phel 'grib med par bstan//de las ming tshogs gsal 'bar kun/ /spro zhing bsdu ba'ang de bzhin no/ /'di ni rdo rje dngos grub kyi/ /brtan 'byung ye shes rgyu yin no/ /de las rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas bsten/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor rim bzhin bsgom/ /e yam̐ baṃ su lo ram̐ spru bi shuste/ ye shes phyogs bzhi dbus brtags te/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun kyis grub/ /lhag pa'i ye shes glo 'bur can/ /rdzogs chen rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /kun 'byung dkyil 'khor chen por spyod/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas/ /gru chad bzhis brgyan bar khyams dang / /kun tu gru bzhi sgo khyud ldan/ /rol mo sna tshogs sprin phung bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis brgyan/ /seng ge glang chen rta dang khyung / /nam mkha' lding gi khri chen la/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin po che/ /a ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha rnye dzha ①nya/ ta tha da dha na/ ṭa ṭha ḍa snya ṇa/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya wa ra la sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ i yī u spru e i/ o ā+o ā nyid sna tshogs par snang ba'i/ /ka la sogs pa bzhi bcu gnyis/ /sgra'i ming gis thams cad bsdus/ /mngon rdzogs rgyal por de nyid nges/ /de las spro dang bsdus pa yis/ /so so'i phyag mtshan gsal bar 'gyur/ /de las phyogs bcur rab spros pas/ /rgyal ba 43—926

rnams kyi thugs dam bskul/ /de dag slar ni 'dus pa dang / /hūṃ badz+re drig /oṃ dzi na dzig /swa rad+mā drig /oṃ a ro lig /ha prarnye dh+rig① /sum̐ dha du ṣari—/ lo dhe sha ra ti/ oṃ mo ha ra ti/ paṃ ra ga ra ti/ tai badz+ra ra ti/k+ṣi hi ra tsa ya/ tram̐ a gar ba ya/ hri ha ④pad+ma ba dha ma/ dzi ku ru pa na hri/hūṃ la se sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ tram̐ ma le sa ma ya ho/ rji gir ti ra ho ya haṃ/ a nir ti ra ga ya mi/ me dha ra ni swā hā/ zli ni swa ram̐ ①pa ya swā hā/ hūṃ swa ra tsa ya swā hā—/ sum̐ shri e ra ga ya swā hā/ dza du pa pra be sha /hūṃ pus pa a be sha /baṃ di pa su ki ni ho gan de tsi ta ho/ hūṃ ya mān+ta krid phaṭa/ hūṃ prad dz+nyo ta krid phaṭa—/ hūṃ pad+man+ta krid phaṭa/ hūṃ bigha nan ta krid phaṭa/ ma hā badz+ra dha ra ma hā kro ti shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma ha rabe+e da ra ma ha ko ti shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ ma hā pad+mo dar ma ha kro ti shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā rjokar ma da ra ma hā kro ti shwa ri dza ⑤la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tsi ta oṃ/ a a a badz+ra ba tra sa ma ya dze+e oṃ mu ne kring swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e thru swā hā—/ oṃ mu ne+e gru swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e k+ṣ-i swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e ye swā hā/ gdan la rdzogs dang sems dpa'i tshul/ /'khor lo rgyal po rgyal mo dang / /g.yas na mthong thos snom pa dang / /myong dang btsun mo'i tshogs su bcas/ /gru chad rjol ni mthong byed dang / /thos byed myong byed snom byed rnams/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas par gnas/ /bar khyams la ni thub pa drug /mdun dang rgyab tu byed pa dang / /bya ba dag ni gnas par bstan/ /sgo khyud bzhi la 'joms pa ni/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang ldan par gnas/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad+ma rab gri dril bu 'bar/ /ud pal klu ⑦shing la sogs 43—927

mtshan—/ /rin chen myu gu ral gyi 'bar/ /pad+ma dkar po rdo rje 'bar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rin chen snye/ /gzugs mdzes rin chen 'phreng ba dang / /pi bang gar mkhan mchog nyid de/ /me tog 'phreng ba spos mchog dang / /mar me byug pa la sogs pa'i/ /las la 'khril zhing chos la bstan/ /dbu rnams 'byo zhing 'dud pa'i dus/ /gong gi phyag rgya chen po bzhin/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi nang du 'khril/ /sgo bzhi khro bo phyag rgya ni/ /mi mgo gdengs dang rdo rje gnon/ /thong sbrul chen pos gnon pa dang / /rdo rje rgya gram las kyis gnon/ /lcags kyu sdezhags pa po ta ho/ /sgo bzhir gnas pa de dag kyang / /'dud tshul 'khril ba gong ma bzhin/ /thub drug phyag rgya sna tshogs te/ /mdor bsdus phyag rgya drug tu bstan/ /sreg par dang ni pi bang dang / /go cha po ti rin chen sgrom/ /me dang chu ru rab tu bstan/ /yum ni dmigs med chos kyi dbyengs—/ /kun bzang mnyam gzhag ye shes 'phro/ /yum 'gyur mnyam rdzogs pad+mo'i dkyil/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya sna tshogs te/ /yang na de bzhin gshegs nyid dam/ /yang na rdo rje thal mo nyid/ /mthing ga dkar po ser leb brgan/ /ljang gu la sogs sna tshogs pa'i/ /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can/ /gsal 'tsher lhun stug gzi byin che/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs chen po/ /'bar ba'i 'phreng bas 'khyil ba ste/ /mtha' dbus med par khyab pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis grub/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang / /dbang bskur skebyin brlabs tshul bzhin bya/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā a ta ri sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā sa mān+ta snyo na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ o ma 43—928

hā prad ta pra be sha dz+nyā ①na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā kri ta a nu rtan dzha na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā ka ya badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma bā ga badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsi ta badz+ra swa bhā sdeb ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pu tsa badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/ sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan can/ /rin chen dbu rgyan 'phreng ba dang / /dpung rgyan se mo do la sogs/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan ni sna tshogs kyis/ /dbang mchog des ni dbang bskur ro/ /de ltar rtog pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dus bzhi phyogs bcu gang nas kyang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid rtogs ①pas sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du ma 'tshol cig /dkyil 'khor kun tu rab sbyor bas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni gsang chen nges pa yi/ /'bras bu lam du gyur pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /'di las gsang ba'i nges don med/ /btsal kyang rgyal bas mi rnyed do/ /kun ni phyag rgya chen po'i mchog /ma 'gags rnam pa cir yang ston/ /'dul ba mdo sde chos mngon dang / /dam tshig bsgrub dang bsgrub pa dang / /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud/ /phyogs bcu kun tu rab grags pa/ /gsang ba'i snying po las 'phros te/ /rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po 'di/ /sde snod kun dang rgyud kun gyi/ /'byung gnas bstan la nges par 'be+ebs/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drang phyir/ /gsal ldan ma 'am byin rlabs la/ /stong gsum yungs 'brur gzhug rjotshul du/ /dbyings nas dkyil 'khor spyan drang mchod/ /e bye hi bha ga bān ma hā ku ṇi ka dri sha /43—929

sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho zhes brjod pas/ /thams cad ma lus 'dus pa dang //sku gsung mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ /bstod dang mchod pa tshul bzhin bya/ /oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa'i/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor thig le che/ /bsod nams dkyil 'khor sku'i tshogs/ /snang stong thig le kun tu rdzogs ho/ /oṃ rdo rje bsod nams thig le che/ /rdo rje ye shes dkyil 'khor ldan/ /rdo rje sgra chen mtha' yas pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po thig le che ho/ /oṃ sku gsung thugs kyi rdzogs pa che—/ /yon tan 'phrin las kun tu rdzogs/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang / /'dus pa'i tshogs chen thig le che ho/ /oṃ mi dmigs sgyu 'phrul mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /mtha' yas kun nas snang tshogs spro/ /mtha' yas kun nas lhun gyis thim/ /sna tshogs sgu gsung thugs chen ho/ /oṃ phyogs bcu 'jig rten rdul snyed du/ /rgyal ba'i don rnams rdul phran snyed/ /sprul pa rdul phran bsam yas kyis/ /skad cig nyid la lhun kyis grub ho/ /oṃ thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che/ /sku gsung thugs kyis kun tu khyab/ /sku gsung thugs kyi thig le che ho/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po 'di/ /sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs kyis/ /phyogs bcu thams cad sangs rgyas zhing / /mnyen 'jam reg na bde ba dang / /sna tshogs rin po che'i gzhi/ /mdzes par bris shing spras pa dang / /kun 'byung rin chen phung por 'bar/ /dbyibs legs rdzing bu bro mchog bsil/ /rin chen khang pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan dang dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshal glu dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra/ /bla re rgyal mtshan na bza' gdugs/ /do shal dpung rgyan se mo do/ /bza' dang btung ba'i mchog rnams dang / /rang 43—930

la mjos par brgyan pa yi/ /lha dang lha mo rdul snyed kyi/ /bro gar la sogs bsam yis ①kyis/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor kun la rgyas par 'bul/ /skal ldan gsal ba'i khyad par gyis/ /rims kyis yang na cig ②car du/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam sbyar zhing / /mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por sgom/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngon ①rdzogs pa'i/ /dbang po yul du gang 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan 'gyur zhing / /mnyam pa'i ngang nyid rtogs gsal na/ /thams cad byang chub mchog gi rgyu/ /bskyed chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /thabs dang shes rab thams cad kun/ /gsal zhing 'od zer 'phro bsgoms na/ /bsgul skyod thams cad phyag rgya yin/ /'di ni spyi rgya chen po ste/ /bla med chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /gsang ba de nyid nges pa yi/ /snying po phyag rgya 'da' ka ba'i/ /mi skyod nyi ma'i dkyil yi ge//rin chen zla ba'i dkyil yi ge/ /lnga gnyis zung du sbyar ba las/ /sbyor ba'i phyag rgya 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /oṃ dang sum̐ gnyis rtse sbyar te/ /'bru brgyad bsnol te rtse sprad pa/ /rgyal ba'i kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /bde ba chen po sbyin pa'i rgya—/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril gsil zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul kyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs khar bkan/ /sum̐ gyi rtse mor dril bsil rjo'abar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril / /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /oṃ bgreng rtse mor 'khor lo 'bar/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril bsil zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas pas thugs kar bkan/ /lam gyi rtse mor dril bsil zhing / /nyi ma 'bru lnga las 43—931

su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyi lta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /swa rtser 'bar ba rin po che/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril bsil zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan—/ /rmi gyi rtse mor dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /saṃ ni rtse mor pad+ma 'bar/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril bsil zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /paṃ bsgreng rtse mor dril bsil zhing / /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud te 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /haṃ bsgreng rtse mor ral gri 'bar/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril bsil zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /tai bsgreng rtse mor dril bsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /de ni rgyal ba thams cad kun/ /dgyes pa chen po bskyed pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i mchod pa chen po yis/ /de la mchod sbyin dam pa ni/ /thog mar bdag nyid rtogs bsgoms sgral/ /de nas gnyis med blo yis ni/ /blo ngan sems can snying re rje/ /gnyis su med par bsgral bar bya—/ /zhing 'gyur mchog dang mchog phan rnams/ /nyi zla'i dkyil du mkhas pas bzhag /nga rgyal lag gi 'du byed bsgom/ /hūṃ du gyur par rnam par dag /dbyings su thim nas phyag rgyar gsal/ /skur gyur 'od zer 'phro bar brjod/ /gtsug tu rnam par rgyal ba bsgom/ /ngo mtshar ngan 'gror thar pa'i lam/ /shes rab mchog de byin rlabs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /43—932

pad+mo la ni rdo rje zhugs/ /'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba/ /bdag nyid mnyes pa kun la mchod/ /ye nas skye med de bzhin nyid/ /sgyu mar snang ba'i mig yor tshul/ /sbyor sgrol bya ba kun byas kyang / /rdul bya tsam yang byas pa med—/ /mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po bdag /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bsgo/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor thim/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bro gar phyag rgya'i 'phro 'du yis/ /'dzul lam nam mkhar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /glu tshig sgra'i phyag rgya yis/ /chos kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rgyan dang bgo ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /'bar ba'i rgyal po thub med 'grub/ /bza' dang btung ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /yid sbyin sku dang bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /ā li kā li'i phyag rgya yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor pa yisaske/ /'bras bu smin byed ①rgyu dang rkyen/ /nus mthu can du gang gyur pa/ /rigs 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /phyogs bcu de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /bde gshegs yon tan rmad po che/ /gzhan na yod pa ma yin na/ /lha srin la sogs smos ci dgos/ /rnal 'byor las su rung rnams kyis/ /phyag rgya chen po rdzogs 'gyur zhing / /gsal ba'i yid gnyis med pas na/ /dkyil 'khor chen po rab 'bar 'gyur/ /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam sbyor ba/ /phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa yi/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ /nye bar 'gyur ba'i dam tshig mchog /cho ga lnga ni rdzogs byas nas/ /yo byad lnga ni rdzogs par ldan/ /sngags kyi yan 43—933

lag lnga rdzogs pas/ /ma nyams 'jug la rab brtson na/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gnas/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang sgyur rigs kyi dam par 'grub/ /de tshe bcu drug tshun chad kyi/ /sku lnga lhun gyis rdzogs pa ste/ /ye shes thig le de nyid las/ /ye shes thig le nyid snang ba/ /bsam kyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog /phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa'i zhing / /zhing khams rnam dag bsam yas dang / /rgya dang bral ba'i gzhal yas khang / /'khor lo'i brgyan du rol mo'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsam yas kun/ /mthong nas nye bar mnyes pa dang / /rgya chen gsung las don 'byung ba/ /mthun pa'i ye shes rang snang ba'o/ /gcig dang du mar bral ba yi/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs te/ /rang byung ye shes snang med snang / /dbang mchog dam pa ma thob par/ /bsgrub kyang cung zad 'grub mi 'gyur/ /oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje che/ /dkyil 'khor kun kyi byed pa po/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi spyad pa spyod/ /slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing / /dbang rnams thob par ma byas par/ /nyan pa las bsogs rtsom pa rnams/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /dbu rgyan cod pan 'phreng ba dang / /go cha rgyal mtshan phyag rgya dang / /gdugs dang bum pa bza' ①btung dang / /snying po lnga yis dbang bskur na/ /dus 'di phyin cad rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngan song thams cad med pa dang / /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /mtho ris thar pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis 'grub pa'i gzhi/ /rdo rje dam tshig chen po ste/ /bla med mi spang bla ma bkur/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad//43—934

yang dag lam du zhugs la byams/ /gsang ba'i don phyir smra mi bya/ /de ni rtsa ba lnga rnams te/ /bsgrub dang srung ⑨ba'i dam tshig mchog /gti mug chags dang zhe sdang che/ /nga rgyal phra ⑤dog mi spong ngo / /dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chen//dag pa'i snod chu mi 'dor ro/ /yan lag bcu'i dam tshig ste/ /ye nas dag nyams ke rtogs pas spyad/ /gsung zhing bsgrub pa'i dam tshig lnga/ /rtsa ba yin te rigs med 'gyur/ /mi spang mi 'dor lnga nyid ni/ /yan lag dam tshig 'da' ka ba'o/ /mnyam la mnyam par spyor ba yi/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig la gnas na/ /mnyam rdzogs chen po thob 'gyur bas/ /'das na sangs rgyas ma yin no/ /rtsa ba nyams pa phyal ba dag /gso la nye bar mi brtson na/ /skad cig yud tsam smra ma byed/ /nyams 'gyur nyes pa brjod mi lang rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pas na/ /bsgrub pa thams cad log par 'gyur/ /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs pa'i/ /'bras bu mi 'dod bzhin du 'du/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams gyur 5na/ /'bras bu med cing ngan song lhung / /dam tshig 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor kyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /gsang ba'i thig le ⑤dkyil 'khor dbyings/ /'byung ba shes rab rigs kyi yum/ /chen po rigs kyi de bzhin te/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje'i tshogs/ /dbang po yul dus rigs pa'i rnams/ /kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bdag nyid chen po lhag pa yis/ /thugs kyi ye shes lnga lta zhing / /snying po thig le mnyam sbyor bas/ /bde ba'i ye shes rol mo yis/ /ye shes dgyes pa 43—935
