mchod par 'bul/ /zag pa med pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /ye shes sgyu mar rang snang ba/ /rol mo'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas mchog /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid kyi dbyings/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /yang dag don gyi snying po 'di/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /shin tu sbyangs la rab gnas shing / /dkyil 'khor ma lus brnyes pa'i sa/ /'bras bu gsang chen 'di yin te/ /shes rab mig ldan rnams kyis zung / /snod ldan ngang tshul bzang la bstan/ /lus dang longs spyod stong la sbyin/ /gzhan du nams kyang sbyin mi bya—/ /rmongs la byar bar gal te byin/ /dus med par ni srog zad nas/ /bsregs dang sbebs la yun ring gnas/ /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor du//thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid la bsdu/ /hūṃ hūṃ zhes ni rab brjod pas/ /chos kyi dbyings su thim par 'gyur/ /de nas snying po dran tsam gyis/ /phyag rgya chen por gsal 'gyur nas/ /go sgo mtshams bcad lus bsrungs te/ /de nas rnal 'byor chen po ste/ /'gro sdod 'dug nyal bzhi phor ①ni/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtang kyezhing / /spyod lam kun tu ma nyams par/ /bdag nyid chen por rtag par bsgom/ /rgyud kyi don las btus pa yi/ /rin chen dra ba mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /ma 'ongs rnal 'byor thams cad dang / /mtha' yas sems can don gyi phyir/ /bstan pas bsgrib pa kun byang nas/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /na mo rin chen ①mngon rdzogs zhes bya ba mthar phyin pa'o/ /rdzogs so// //43—936

bsdur mchan/924 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/925 ①〈〈pe 〉nya)/ ②〈〈pe 〉starim bzhin sgom/926 ①〈〈pe 〉mdza dzha/927 ①〈〈pe 〉〉drig ②〈〈pe 〉〉ta/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉ri/ du〈〈pe 〉〉ta/ du〈〈pe 〉mdza/ du〈〈pe 〉〉chud/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉glu/928 ①〈〈pe 〉skruskyu/ ②〈〈pe 〉musar/929 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sto/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rto/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rtog du〈〈pe 〉〉bzhug931 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pas/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanacig ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉don/ du〈〈pe 〉stanasil/933 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ged/934 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bzang /935 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsru/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉phrag ②〈〈pe 〉〉panyam/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉byur/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉spog936 ①〈〈pe 〉〉por/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉btang / du〈〈pe 〉〉〉drab/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2536)43wa 937

༄go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyi phyabadag /ye shes rgya mtsho rab zab thugs/ /dkyil 'khor yid bzhin 'byung ba'i gter/ /rdo rje yid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma'o bde gshegs snying po las/ /rang gi rnam rtog las kyis 1sprul/ /rang 'byung ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir/ /rgyud kyi don bsdus snying po brtsam/ /thos bsam bsgom la rab sbyangs pa'i/ /shes rab mig ldan rnams kyis bzung / /snod ldan ngang tshul brtan la bzang / /lus dang longs spyod gtong la sbyin/ /slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing / /dbang rnams thob par ma byas par/ /nyan pa la sogs rtsom pa rnams/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /mnyam la snyam par spyor ba yis/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig la gnas na/ /mnyam rdzogs chen po thob 'gyur te/ /'das na sangs rgyas ma yin no/ /dus bzhi phyogs bcu gang nas kyang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs 43—938

rgyas rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid rtogs pa sangs rgyas pas/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du ma 'tshol cig /gang gis glang chen myos 'dri ⑪sems/ /mnyam par bzhag pas brtul nas su/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar rab brtan nas/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen por 'gyur/ /dgon pa dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /tsan dan nags dang me tog tshal/ /yid 'ong bkra shis sems dga' ba'i/ /rang dbang bar chad med pa'i gnas/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin mod kyang / /rtog pa'i dbang gis 'khor bas na/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes tsam nyid na skye ba med/ /'gag pa med las thams cad 'gags/ /'gag tsam nyid na 'gag pa med/ /gnas pa med las thams cad gnas/ /gnas pa nyid na gnas pa med/ /dmigs pa med la thams cad dmigs/ /dmigs pa nyid la dmigs pa med/ /'gro 'ong med las 'gro dang 'ong / /'gro 'ong nyid na 'gro 'ong med/ /bsgrub pa'i gtso ni ting 'dzin pas/ /ting 'dzin 'di yid byed par 'gyur/ /gser 'gyur sman dang mun sel bzhin/ /rtog pa'i dbang 'gyur ting 'dzin yin/ /de phyir ting 'dzin rim bzhin sgom/ /dngos po rnam gnyis dngos med pas/ /rtog pa smra bsam yul las 'das/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes te/ /de phyir dngos po dngos med pa'o/ /de bzhin nyid ni spros med kyang / /rang bzhin kun tu snang gi dbyings/ /sems can kun la snying brtse'i phyir/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' sgom/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun kyi rtsa ba yin/ /sems nyid yi ge rang 43—939

bzhin pas/ /yi ge yid bzhin rin chen sprin/ /yi ge'i mchog ni bsgom par bya—/ /a/ rab tu brtan 'gyur a dkar las/ /shin tu phra ba'i a rnams 'phro—/ /phyogs bcu gang bar gsal gyur nas/ /bsdus kyang 'phel 'grib med par bstan/ /de las ming tshogs gsal bar snang / /spro zhing sdu ba de bzhin no/ /'di ni rdo rje dngos grub kyi/ /brtan 'byung ye shes rgyu yin no/ /e yo khaṃ sum̐ lo ram̐ 'bru bi sha bi shud de/ ye shes phyogs dbus blos brtags te/ /dkyil 'khor bsam byas lhun grub ni/ /rdzogs shing rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /kun 'byung dkyil 'khor chen por spyod/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas/ /lhag pa'i ye shes glo 'bur can/ /gru chad bzhis brgyan bar 'khyams dang / /kun tu gru bzhi sgo khyud ldan/ /rol mo sna tshogs sprin phung bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis kyis mdzes/ /seng ge glang chen rta dang khyung / /nam mkha' lding gi khri chen las/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin po che/ /a ni skye med de bzhin nyid—/ /k+ka ni thugs kyi ye shes shar/ /de las cho 'phrul gsum kyis bskyed/ /kun bzang mnyam gzhag ye shes 'phro/ /yum 'gyur mnyam rdzogs pad+mo'i dkyil//phyag rgya chen po'i sku gnyis rdzogs/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che/ /kun bzang ye nas yin pa'i phyir/ /thabs dang shes rab dgyes sprin las/ /byang chub sems tshogs rgyu 'khor lo/ /'bras bu rgyal ba smin 'grub byed/ /ngo mtshar ming tshogs bzhi bcu gnyis/ /a/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza rnye nya/ṭa ṭha ḍa bhā ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya wa ra la/ sha ṣa sa ha/k+ṣa—/ i ā+o/ u u/ e i/ o ā+o a nyid sna tshogs par snang ba'i/ /43—940

ka la sogs pa bzhi bcu gnyis/ /sgra'i ming gis thams cad sdus/ /mngon rdzogs rgyal por de nyid nges/ /de las rkyen gyi sngags kyis bskul/ /sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /dra ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon rdzogs pa/ /'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas kyi/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor 'byin pa dang she/ /dbang med rgyu rkyen 'tshogs pa'i mthu/ /de nas bcom ldan dgyes chen rigs/ /thon gyis grub par bya ba'i phyir/ /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam spyor ba/ /rang gi ngang tshul der bzung nas/ /bskul tshig 'di yang rab tu brjod/ /oṃ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las smad po che/ /de nyid du ni bdag sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /ye shes zer gyis lus rtog sbyangs/ /gser zhun lta bu'i sems dag las/ /gsum gyes byin rlabs 'od kyi 'bru/ /thugs kar thim nas sku yi dbyig /rdo rje'i lam byung yum gyi mkha'/ /chos sku byang chub sems su gnas/ /lha rnams so so'i snying po'i sgra/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis sgra byung bas/ /byang chub sems su cig par thim/ /de nas snying po dran tsam gyis/ /ak+ka gsung gi phyag rgya gnyis/ /cho ga gsum gyi spyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sku gnyis rdzogs/ /'bru gsum 'bru lnga byin rlabs dbang / /rdo rje pad+mor byin rlabs te/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga oṃ/ /pa las pad+ma 'dab brgyad saṃ/ /rdo rje chags pa tshul bzhin bskul—/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā su kha badz+ra swa bha ldub ad ma ko haṃ/ yum gyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /gzhal las kyethig gtab 13—941

snying po dgod/ /de las spro dang bsdu ba yis/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya bzhi bcu gnyis—/ /de las 'phra mo'i spros bsdus pas/ /so so'i sngags kyis bskyed cing gdon/ /hūṃ badz+ra drig /sum̐ da du shwa ri/ oṃ dzi na dzig /lo dhe sha ra ti/swa rad na drig /saṃ mo ha ra ti/ a a ro lig /paṃ ra ga ra ti/ ha prad nya drig /tai badz+ra ra ti①/ k+ṣi ti ra tsa ya/ hūṃ la sa ②sa ya ṣ+ṭi/ tram̐ a gar ba ya—/ tram̐ ma le sa ma ya ṣ+ṭi/ hri ha hūṃ pad+ma bha dha ma/ hri girti ra ho haṃ/ sna ku ru pa na tri/ a ni ra ti ra ga ya mi/ me dar ya swā hā/ dza du pa pra skebe+e sha zlo swa ram ya swā hā/ hūṃ pus pa a be+e sha ya/ hūṃ su ra rtsa sa ma ya/ baṃ di pa su ki rgo/ sum̐ tra saṃ rjor ga ya swā 0hā/ ho gan dhe tsi ta ho/ hūṃ ya man ta krid phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra da ra ma hā kro ti shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ prad nya ta krid phaṭa—/ oṃ rad na da ra ma hā kro ta shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ pad+ma mān ta krid phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma da ra ma ha kro ti shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ big nan ta rjokrid phaṭa/ oṃ kar ma da ra ma hā kro ti shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tsi ta oṃ/ a a a badz+ra ba dh+ra sa ma ya oṃ/ oṃ mu ne+e tram̐ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e hūṃ sum̐ swā ⑦hā—/ oṃ mu ne+e sum̐ swā hā/ oṃ mu ④ne bre swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e k+shi swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e ye swā hā/ gdan la rdzogs dang sems dpa'i ⑨tshul/ /'khor lo rgyas po rgyal mo dang / /g.yas nas mthong thos snom pa dang / /myong dang btsun mo'i tshogs su bcas/ /gru chad la ni mthong byed dang / /thos byed snom byed myong byed rnams/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang ldan par gnas/ /bar khyams la ni thub drug dang / /mdun dang rgyab tu byed pa dang / /bya ba dag na gnas par bstan—/ /sgo khyud bzhi la 'joms pa ni/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang ldan par 43—942

gnas—/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad+ma ral gri dril bu 'bar/ /ud pal klu shing la sogs mtshan/ /rin chen myu gu ral gri 'bar/ /pad+ma dkar po rdo rje 'bar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rin chen ste/ /gzugs mdzes rin chen 'phreng ba dang / /bi bang gar mkhan mchog nyid de/ /me tog 'phreng dang bdug spos mchog /mar me byug pa la sogs pa'i①/ /las la 'khril zhing chos la bstan/ /dbu rnams 'byo zhing 'dud pa'i tshul/ /gong gi phyag rgya chen bo bzhin/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /sgo bzhi khro bo'i phyag rgya ni//dz+re mgo gdengs dang rdo rje gnon/ /thod sbrul chen pos gnon pa dang / /rdo rje rgya gram las kyis gnon/ /lcags skyu zhags pa po ta ho/ /sgo bzhi gnas pa de dag kyang / /'dud tshul 'khril ba gong ma bzhin/ /thub drug phyag rgya sna tshogs te/ /mdor bsdus phyag rgya drug tu bstan/ /sreg par dang ni pi bang dang / /go cha po ti rin chen sgrom/ /me dang chur ni rab tu bstan/ /yum ni dmigs med chos kyi dbyings/ /kun bzang mnyam bzhag ye shes 'phro/ /yum 'gyur mnyam rdzogs pad+mo'i dkyil/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya sna tshogs te/ /yang na de bzhin gshegs nyid dam/ /yang na rdo rje thal mo nyid/ /mthing ga dkar po ser leb rgan/ /ljang gu la sogs sna tshogs pa/ /gnyen lalcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can/ /gsal mdzes lhun tug gzi byin che/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs chen po/ /'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa ste/ /mtha' dbus med par khyab pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis grub/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā snyo na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā bhar sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ①ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā pra ta pra be+e sha rnye na badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ 43—943

ma hā sa man+ta dzha na badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā kri ta ya nu tan rnye na badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā bā ga badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsi ta badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga//dbang dang byin brlabs kun bsdus thim/ /dkyil 'khor shin tu gsal bar 'gyur—/ /sa la sogs pa'i phyag rgya byas/ /rnam grol rim pa thob par 'gyur//dag pa'i ye shes kyis sbyangs na/ /smos ci dgos te de nyid yin/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsal skyed la/ /dbang skur byin brlabs rdzogs byas la/ /stong gsum yungs 'brur 'jug tshul du/ /dbyings nas dkyil 'khor spyan drangs mchod/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che/ /mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo / /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam sbyor ba/ /phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa yi/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ /nye bar gyur pa'i dam tshig mchog /oṃ e bye hi bha ga bān ma hā ka ru ni ka tri shra ho—/ sa ma ya sto/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya oṃ/ saṃ badz+ra sa ma ya saṃ/hūṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ swa badz+ra sa ma ya swa/ ha badz+ra sa ma ya ha/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sto/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ me tog dor la dngos grub gsol/ /gnyis med thim bzhugs brnyes par bya/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /dbang po yul du gang gyur pa/ /mnyam pa'i ngang nyid rtogs gsal na/ /thams cad byang chub mchog gi rgya/ /skyod chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /thabs dang shes rab thams cad kun/ /43—944

gsal zhing 'od zer 'phro bsgom na/ /sgul bskyod thams cad phyag rgya yin/ /gsang ba'i de nyid nges pa las/ /snying po'i phyag rgya 'da' dka'o/ /mi bskyod nyi ma'i dkyil yi ge/ /rin chen zla ba'i dkyil yi ge/ /lnga gnyis zung du spros pa las/ /sbyar ba'i phyag rgya 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /oṃ dang sum̐ gnyis rtse sbyor te/ /'bru brgyad bsnol te rtse sprad na/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /bde ba chen po 'byin pa'i rgya/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /hūṃ bsgreng rtse mo rdo rje 'bar/ /zla gtul 'bru sbas dril bsil ①zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /sum̐ bsgreng rtse mo dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /saṃ bsgreng rtse mo 'khor lo 'bar/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril gsel zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul kyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /lo bsgreng rtse mo dril gsel zhing / /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /swa bsgreng rtse mo rin chen 'bar/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril gsil zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul kyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /oṃ bsgreng rtse mo dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /e sgreng ②rtse mo pad+mo 'bar/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril gsil zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs ①kar bkan/ /phyo bsgreng rtse mo dril gsil 'bararjo/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i 43—945

mdangs kyis lta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /ha bgreng ①rtse mo ral gri 'bar/ /zla btul 'bru sbas dril bsil ②zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul kyis chos la bstan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kar bkan/ /tai bgreng rtse mo pad+mo dril bsil ①zhing / /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs kyis/ /phyogs bcu thams cad sangs rgyas zhing / /mnyen 'jam reg na bde ba dang / /sna tshogs rin po che'i gzhi/ /mdzes par bres shing spras pa dang / /kun 'byung rin chen phung por 'bar/ /dbyengs legs rdzing bu ro mchog bsil/ /rin chen khang pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan dang dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshal/ /glu dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra/ /bla re rgyal mtshan na bza' gdugs/ /do shal dpung rgyan se mo do/ /mdzes pa'i brgyan rnams sna tshogs dang / /bza' dang btung ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rang la mdzes par brgyan pa yis/ /lha dang lha mo rdul snyed kyis/ /bro gar la sogs bsam yas kyis/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor kun la rgyas par 'bul/ /skal ldan gsal ba'i khyad par gyis/ /rim gyis yang na cig car du/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam sbyor zhing / /mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen bor bsgom/ /thob ④ mar bdag nyid rtogs sgoms sgral/ /de nas gnyis med blo yis ni/ /blo ngan sems can snying re rje/ /gnyis su med par sgral bar bya/ /gsal ldan ma 'am byin brlabs la/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /'khril pa'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor zhing / /bdag nyid mnyes par mnyes par bya/ /mnyam pa'i sgrub dzas chen po dag /bdag dang mnyam 43—946

pa'i tshogs la dbul/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung ba sgo/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad kyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor thim/ /oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor thig le che/ /bsod ①nams dkyil 'khor sku'i tshogs/ /snang stong thig le kun rdzogs ho/ /oṃ rdo rje bsod nams thig le che/ /rdo rje ye shes dkyil 'khor ldan/ /rdo rje sgra chen mtha' yas pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po thig le ②che ho/ /oṃ sku gsung thugs kyi rdzogs pa che/ /yon tan 'phrin las sku ru rdzogs/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang / /'dus pa'i tshogs chen thig le che ho/ /oṃ mi dmigs sgyu 'phrul mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /mtha' yas ye nas lhun kyis 'phro/ /mtha' yas kun nas lhun gyis jim/ /sna tshogs sku gsung thugs chen po ho/ /oṃ phyogs bcu 'jig rten rdul snyed du/ /rgyal ba'i don rnams rdul phran snyed/ /sprul pa rdul phran bsam yas kyis/ /skad cig yud la lhun gyis grub bosne/ /oṃ thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che/ /sku gsung thugs kyis kun tu khyab/ /sku gsung thugs kyi thig le che ho/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bro gar 'du 'phro phyag rgya yis/ /'dzul lam nam mkhar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /glu tshig sgra'i phyag rgya yis/ /chos kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /brgyan dang bgo ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /'bar ba'i rgyal po thub med 'grub/ /bza' dang btung ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /yid bzhin sgu dang bdud rtsi 'grub/ /ā rjoli kā li'i phyag rgya yis—/ /thams cad thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /de'i zlas pa 'phrul che rjoni—/ /rnam gsum tshul gyis ma 'khrul bar/ /sngags zlas 'phro 'du rgyun mi 43—947

bcad①—/ /'dris gsal bstan pa mchog gis bya/ /shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor pa'i gzungs/ /'bras bu smin byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /nus mthu can du gang gyur pa/ /rigs 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /bsnyen pa rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor kun/ /hūṃ zhes brjod cing thugs kar bsdu/ /skye med mnyam rdzogs dbyings su bstem/ /stong pa'i go chas lus bsrung ste/ /spyod lam kun tu btsal med par/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor las byung ba'i/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /'gro dang 'dug dang nyal ba dang //ma nyams de'i dbyengs na ⑤gnas/ /de yis byang chub snying po len/ /cho ga sngags dang yo byad rnams/ /rnal 'byor tshogs pa'i yo byad kyis/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang sgyur rigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ /de tshe bcu drug tshun tshad kyis/ /sku lnga lhun kyis rdzogs pa ni/ /ye shes thig le de nyid la/ /ye shes thig le nyid snang bas/ /bsam kyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog /phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /zhing khams rnam dag gzhal yas dang / /rgya dang bral ba'i gzhal yas khang / /'khor lo'i rgyan dang rol mo'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus thams cad kun/ /mthong nas nye bar bsnyen pa dang / /rgya chen gsung las don 'byung ba/ /mthun pa'i ye shes rang snang ba'o/ /gcig dang du ma bral ba yi/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs te/ /rang 'byung ye shes gnas med gnas/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /bde gshegs ye shes rmad po che/ /gzhan nas yod 'ong ma yin te/ /lha srin 43—948

la sogs smos ci dgos/ /rgyud kyi don las sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rin chen dra ba 'di bsdus pas/ /bcom ldan kun bzang sku gsung thugs/ /sems can kun gyis 'thob par shog /dra ba chung ngu rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/938 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉nya)sa/ ①〈〈pe 〉4)/939 ①〈〈pe 〉skoradra'i/941 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dam/ ②〈〈pe 〉71/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉thas/942 ①〈〈pe 〉state/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉re ①〈〈pe 〉〉ma du〈〈pe 〉〉mi/ du〈〈pe 〉sngas/ du〈〈pe 〉〉da/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉bru swa/⑤〈〈pe 〉mthu/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉mi'i/ 943 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉panyen/ ②〈〈pe 〉starto/945 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagasil/ ②〈〈pe 〉stabasgreng / ②〈〈pe 〉〉wathugs/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉bar/946 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgreng / ②⑧〈〈pe 〉〉gsil/ du〈〈pe 〉〉thog947 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉thigs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉to/ du〈〈pe 〉snam/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉can/948 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagacad/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2537)43wa 949

dzo /de go na nyid snang ba dam pa brgyan/①༄4/ /thams cad ngo bo mnyam nyid sku/ /bde chen gar dbang sku gsung thugs/ /mi zad rgyan kyis ④'khor lo'i/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal te/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud dag las/ /lha'i rnal 'byor rim pa zhig /sems can ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir/ /legs par bsdus te bstan par bya'o/ /slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing / /dbang rnams thob par ma byas par/ /nyan pa la sogs rtsom pa rnams/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /yi ge sgra btags ming tshogs la/ /brten pa'i tshig gis rab mtshon te/ /khong nas gab sbas don 'byin pa/ /ston pa rdo rje'i thugs la gnas/ /'di ni gsang chen nges pa yis tshe/ /'bras bu lam du gyur pa yin/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /de las gsang ba'i nges don med/ /kun gyi phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs//thos bsam sgom la rab sbyangs pa'i/ /shes rab mig ldan rnams kyis bzung / /43—950

snod ldan ngang tshul can la bstan/ /lus dang longs spyod gtong la sbyin/ /gzhan du rnams ①kyang sbyin mi bya/ /rmongs la 'phyar bas gal te byin/ /dus min par ni srog zad nas/ /bsregs dang stebs par yun rings gnas/ /gang gis glang chen sbyo 'dra'i sems/ /mnyam par gzhag pas gtul nas su/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rab bstan na/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen por 'gyur/ /dur khrod chen por rab dbe+en pa'i/ /ri bos bskor ba'i lcug ma dang / /me tog 'phreng bas brgyan pa 'am/ /bde ba'i gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /'dzin pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal zhing / /gdug pa srid gsum gdul ba yi/ /nga rgyal chen po bstan pa'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis gsang / /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes pa nyid na skye ba med/ /stong pa nyid du rab bsal ba'i/ /snying rje'i yum ni bsgom ①par bya/ /nges pa las ni rdo rje che/ /de las dpal chen he ru ka /'bar ba chen po gar dgu yis/ /'jigs pa yi ni dus ltar drug /baṃ hūṃ bi shwa bi shud de/ /dur khrod chen po rab 'jigs pa'i—/ /khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i dkyil/ /keng rus chen po ri rab kyi/ /steng gi 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /phyogs bcu rgya yongs ma chad pa'i/ /phyi dang nang med kun tu snang / /'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la/ /gru chad bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /gru bzhi sgo khyud bzhi dang ldan/ /'bar ba'i bar 'khyams gnyis kyis mdzes/ /thod sbrul sna tshogs nyi mas brjid/ /'bar ba'i 'phro ba mang po 'khrug /khyu mchog ma he gzig ①dang stag /gtum pa dom gyi spar bas ni/ /dbang phyug la 43—951

sogs lha chen bzung / /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag /khro rgyal ye nas yin pa'i phyir/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nas ni/ /khro mo dbang phyug mngon phyung ste/ /nyi nyi dgyes pa'i gzi mdangs kyis/ /rin chen pad+ma rgyas mdzad nas/ /gnyis med 'khril ba'i dgyes pas bstem/ /byang chub sems sprin 'phros pa las/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha/ dz+wa la man dha/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ha la ha la hūṃ/ 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu dag /mtha' yas khyab par khro bo yi/ /dkyil 'khor stong gsum 'jig rten tsam/ /phyogs bcu'i rdul snyed 'thon par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan dgyes chen po/ /dbu dang phyag zhabs stong khams kyi/ /rdul snyed mtshon cha 'jigs pa de/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir 'gyur/ /'bar chen klong gi 'khor lo dkyil/ /dbang phyug che dang dur khrod kyi/ /bdag po dregs pa khyo shug gi/ /gdan la brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /khro bo dkyil 'khor sprin phung yang / /dpal ni khrag 'thung chen po dang / rin po che dang pad ma dang / /lus su gyur stite phyogs bzhir bzhugs/ /de kun 'jigs byed chen po yi/ /cha lugs rngam pa'i nga ro yis/ /'bar ba'i klong na dbu gsum pa/ /phyag drug zhabs bzhi dri za dang / /gnod sbyin srin po gshin rje la sogs pa'i/ /khyo shug bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /btsun mo khrag 'thung chen mo rnams/ /so so'i sku la 'khril te 'khod/ /de nas dgyes te ha brjod pas/ /byang chub sems kyi sprin dag las/ /dkar mo'i tshogs dang rkun mo dang / /rmongs mo dang ni thal byed ma/ /sgos mo dang ni gtum mo dang / /dme sha can dang ma tshogs ma'i/ /tshogs rnams rang gi lag cha dang //43—952

ngo mtshar chas nas rngam mthon te/ /'bar chen 'khor lo'i shar mtshams nas/ /'khor bar 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis 'khod/ /de nas dgyes te te brjod pas//seng gdong ma'i tshogs dang ni/ /stag dang wa dang khyi dang bzhad/ /rka ka dur bya 'ug gdong che/ /tshogs rnams rang gi lag cha dang / /ngo mtshar dag tu chas nas 'thon①/ /'bar ba chen po'i 'khor lo yi/ /phyi rol shar kyi phyogs dag nas—/ /'khor bar rngam pa'i mdangs kyis 'khod/ /de nas dgyes te phaṭa brjod pas/ /rdo ②rje sring 'gro ma tshogs dang / /gdong mo 'jig rten ro langs ma'i/ /tshogs rnams rang gi lag cha dang / /ngo mtshar chas nas 'jigs mthon te/ /dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir rngam gzugs nas/ /dgyes pa'i sprin las phyogs bcu nas/ /phaṭa ces grags pas thams cad khros/ /de nas dpal chen khro bo'i rigs/ /lhun gyis grub par bya ba'i phyir/ /rang gi ngang tshul de bzung la/ /skul ①tshig 'di yang rab tu brjod/ /oṃ sngon gyi thugs dam chen po ni/ /'jig rten ma lus thams cad kun/ /rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyor bas ni/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /ye shes gzer gyis lung rtog sbyangs/ /gser zhun lta bu'i sems dag la/ /gsum gyi byin brlabs 'od kyi 'bru/ /thugs kar thim nas sbu'i dbyig /rdo rje lam 'byung yul gyi mkha'/ /chos sku byang chub sems kyi gnas—/ /lha rnams so so'i snying po'i sgra/ /hūṃ ha te phaṭa ces byung nas/ /byang chub sems su gcig par thim/ /de nas snying po dran tsam gyis/ /gsung gi phyag rgya gnyis rdzogs nas/ /'od zer 'phro dhi'adu'i sbyor ba yis/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya rab tu 'bar/ /de las 'phra mo'i sku spro bsdu/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sku 43—953

gnyis rdzogs/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā a da ri sha dz+nyā na badz+ra bha ①ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā pra ta pra be+e sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā sa mān+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā kri ta a nu ta na dz+nyā na swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sabaṃ ta thā ga ta ma hā ka ya swā ⑤bhā wa ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā bā ga badz+ra swa bhā ba ad+ma ko haṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ha 1tsi ta badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko rjohaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pū tsa badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma ko haṃ/ rdo rje pad+mar byin rlabs pa/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /ba las pad+mor gyur pa'i dbus/ /ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /sha ta pa la sogs pa yis/ /bskul ba dag kyang tshul bzhin bya/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen po/ /bsgrub pa dang ni bsgrub chen po/ /yum gyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du—/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus la//dgyes mnyam mchog gi sbyin pas bstem/ /de las dkyil 'khor gsal bar dgod—/ /oṃ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ ma hā shrī te ru ka ma tsam dha sarba du sh+kan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī te ru ka ma hā tsan dha sarba du jinaske/ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rad+mā ma hā shrī he ru ka /ma hā tsan dha sarba du ṣ+ṭan ta ka na dha ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ma hā shrī te ru ka/ma hā tsan dha sarba du stan/ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ karma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsan dha sarba du stan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kro ti shwa ri sarba du stan hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra ma hā kro dhi pyashwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā sur+ya rat+na ma hā kro ti shwa ri bi da ma hūṃ phaṭa/43—954

oṃ hri shwa ta sa ma ya/ ma hā kro ti shwa ri ka'i hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a mo ka ma hā kro dhi ①shwa ri bi shwa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ke'u ri ha/ badz+ra tsi'u ri ha/ badz+ra pra mo ha/badz+ra be+e ta li ha/ badz+ra pu ka si ha/ badz+ra kas ma hri ha/ badz+ra tsan dha li ha/oṃ badz+ra sing ha mu ka he/ badz+ra bya gri mu ga he/ badz+ra si la mu ka te/ badz+ra sho na mu ka he/ badz+ra kri ta mu ka te/ badz+ra kang ka mu ka he/ badz+ra khwa kha mu kha he/badz+ra u lu ka mu ka he/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ya te dza te nga dza/ badz+ra a mu ka hūṃ/ badz+ra lo ga baṃ/ badz+ra ba smi pa la ya ti ho// //bh+yo byo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo byo/ /bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ /sa la sogs la phyag rgya byas/ /rnam grol rim pa thob par 'gyuraske/ /dag pa'i ye shes kyis sbyangs na/ /smos ci dgos te de nyid yin//phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che/ /mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las—/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo / /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam spyor bas/ /phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa yi/ /bsnyan pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ /nye bar gyur pa'i dam tshig mchog /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ e bye he a na ya badz+ra/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥho re/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ khro la khros pas zhi mdzad pa/ /thugs rje khro dpal rngam pa'i tshogs/ /'bar ba'i byin rlabs rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni bdag la gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ya sto/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ya phaṭa—/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ya ho/ a li u li ta la ta pa te/ tram̐ sto kho go na/ro ti kha re yo gi ni kha hi hūṃ ha hi phaṭa/ smug nag sngo nag ser nag dang / /dmar nag ljang nag 'jigs pa'i sku/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir 43—955

bgrad—/ /ko rlon gos ni sna tshogs gon/ /rngam pa'i sgra chen 'jigs par bsgrogasaske/ /sbrul dang thod rlon nyi zlar bcas/ /stong gi 'jig rten 'khor yug bcas/ /rdo rje dung chen gang ba dang / /ral gri dgra sta gshol la sogs//rang gi lag cha sna tshogs dang / /btsun mo 'jigs pa'i tshogs dang 'khril/ /gnas dang yul kyi phyag rgya dang / /sgo bzhi'i phyag rgya rab mdzes shing / /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /bcu gnyis dang ni brgyad kyis mdzes/ /rang gi stan ①dang lag cha dang / ci bgyi zhes te chas te gnas/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gsal bkod nas/ /mtha' dbus med par khyab pa yi/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu na/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar snang / /hūṃ gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /khro gnyer glog stong 'gyu ba bzhin/ /mche ba zang yag za byed che ho/ /hūṃ rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir/ /tug chen ri rab 'bum snying skad/ /a a ha la'i gad rgyangs ⑤che/ /dbyugs pa'i thur ④rlung g.yeng ba che ho/ /hūṃ/khros pa'i shes rab 'od po che/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor kun tu gsal/ /'bar ba'i ye shes kun tu 'joms/ /sna tshogs ye shes thig le ho/ /hūṃ khros pa'i rgyal po sprin chen po/ /khros pa'i rgyal po char chen 'be+ebs/ /dkyil 'khor yid bzhin 'byung ba'i gter/ /sna tshogs khros pa'i thig le che ho/ /hūṃ bdud kun gyi ni bdud chen po/ /bdud kyi bdud de bdud rnams 'joms/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs kyang 'jigs 0par byed/ /'jigs byed chen po rjozig le che ho/ /hūṃ rdo rje brag chen sra ba'o/ /rdo rje chu bo bdud chen po/ /rdo rje me ste kun 'bar che/ /rdo rje rlung chen thor rlung che ho/ /yan lag ma nyams yo byad 43—956

ldanaske/ /cho ga rdzogs par shes pa yi/ /rnal 'byor tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi—/ /nges par legs pa'i dgos pa 'grub/ /khro bo khro mo'i tshogs chen po/ /pho nya phyag nyan bka' nyan tshogs/ /ci bgyi las sogs tshogs rnams kyis/ /dngos grub las rnams sdogs par byed/ /de nas dkyil 'khor thams cad kun//rang gi snying gar bsdu ba ni/ /hūṃ hūṃ zhes ni rab brjod nas/ /'dus pa de nyid ci bder spyod/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bsdus nas kyang / rnal 'byor bdag nyid chen po yis/ /spyod lam kun tu ma nyams shing / /lha nyid du ni rtag tu bsgom/ /phung po lnga nyid khro rgyal gtso/ /chen po lnga nyid dbang phyug yum—/ /skye mched khams rnams ma lus kun/ /thugs rje rngam pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul/ /byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum par/ /rab tu rtogs pa rnams bzhi yis/ /thams cad mngon sdogs rgyal po che ho/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /sku gsung yon tan 'phrin las thugs/ /ma lus bdag nyid zhal mthong ba/ /dbang sgyur mchog nyid dam pa yin/ /bsgrub pa'i thabs 'di bsdus pa yis/ /bsod nams bdag gis gang thob pa/ /dpal chen kun bzang sku gsung thugs—/ /sems can kun kyis thob par shog /de kho na nyid snang ba dam pa brgyan rdzogs so// //43—957

༄ga /lam rnam par bamakha pa sangs rgyas gsang ba'i man ngag①༄4/ /dpal gyi dpal gsum nyid ldan rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes 'dus ma byas—/ /ma btsal lnga rdzogs skyon bral mi shigs dbyangs nyid ye shes 'du 'bral med—/ /lnga yis grub nyid gnyis med dang gsal mi g.yo mi sems sems chen po—/ /'phrin las bzhi bcom dpa' bo rang nyid lha'i lha la gnyis med mos/ /gsang ba'i bdag po mngon gshegs nas/ /lha klu gnod sbyin srin po dang / /mi las skal ldan 'dus pa la/ /dbang pos ji ltar lung bstan dus/ /rgyal bu rigs can ltas shar ba/ /'brel ba snang la mngon brtags pas/ /thugs kyi sgrub pa mngon rtogs te/ /de nyid sgo nas de nyid grub/ /bstan pa'i dngos grub de nas thob/ /don dam bcud kyis de nas rgyas/ /'dod pa'i bsams ②pa de ru 'grub/ /smon pa'i lha dang de ru 'jal①/ /de nas rdo rje gdan stengs kyi/ /'dzam gling shar gyi phyogs mtshams su/ /pho brang dam pa 43—959

rin chen nang / /bkra shis dam pa'i khang pa ru/ /ku ku ra tsa in+t+ra bo ti dang //sing nga u pa ra tsa dang / /sras mo 'go ma sa la sogs/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dbang thob nas/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mngon bsgrubs te/ /rdo rje 'chang sar mngon du gshegs/ /de phyir sangs rgyas mtshan thob ngas/ /dam pa'i rigs can dra ma dang / /de rjes ma 'ongs skal ldan phyir/ /stong phrag brgya'i rgyud dag las/ /gshegs shul lam mchog 'dir bsdus te/ /snyigs ma'i rgyud drag dus kyi tshe/ /dus kyi 'dul phyir bstan par bya'o/ /spyan bzangs 'gro mthu med pa yi/ /dmigs bu bral ba'i nyams stor bas/ /bgrod cing phyin par mi nus bzhin/ /rtsing po rmu dgod rang nyams kyis/ /gsang ba'i snying por mi 'gyur te/ /bud shing me tog 'bras bzhin 'gyur/ /de bas bla ma lung bzhin bskur/ /brtag spyo zhe gcod bzod bya ste/ /mthong ba'i gdung ba khur mi lta/ /de kun yum gyi don du bzod/ /dka' bas bsten na rdo rje rgyal—/ /nyams snang mthong zer thob 'gyur te/ /de tshe rgyud chen gzhung gi yon—/ /phul na thugs kyi nying khu ster/ /de yis bzhon pa bzang 'gro bzhin//gsang ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs zhon pas/ /mthong 'jug mthar phyin bzhi bgrod ⑨nas—/ /ye shes snying po'i gnas su phyin/ /de bas rdo rje gnyer ldan pas/ /rgyang drung sems spra mkha' 'gro yi/ /gsang sngags ltas ston spyo ba yis/ /ci nas brtags te bzang ldan na/ /mi ldog brtan byas rtas pa yi/ /shi sha gang yin lag tu gtad/ /ngan pa'i ltas mthong mngon shes pas/ /'dod pa 'phro ②mo'i rgyur byed dang / /khe dang grags pa che ba'i rgyu/ /byed cing bcud chen 'dzag dang 'go/ /ma chags ma rungs byed pa dang / /zang zing mtha' gtong 43—960

dbus 'ching dang / /g.yon can ngo dga' lhag sprang skur/ /lkog na rang dgar byed pa dang / /ngag la rigs nges bsam mi des/ /bud med 'dod pas phyal ba dang / /mun sgog prad par 'dod spyod snyeg /pho mo gtad trar ma sngags la/ /skal par dri bzhin 'khor 'gyur yang / /thugs kyi bde ba spro mi bya/ /'tsham par skur bstan gcan 'phran bzhin/ /de men be+e sbrel g.yang 'gyur bzhin/ /'dod khes 'phogs shing bcas 'phyar bas/ /ma gtogs spros na dur khrod gling / /brgyad kyi mkha' 'gro bzhin 'dus nas/ /sha za srog la 'bebs shing lhung / /de ltar brtags pa'i skal ldan phyir/ /rang bzhin ye shes rang gnas dang / /der mthong der 'jug rnal 'byor bzhi/ /bar chad med bsgrub rnam par smin/ /sbas sgyur phyag rgya lhun grub lam/ /mngon byas rim pa brjod par bya/ /de la dang po nyid spros pas/ /de nyid de yis shes bya ba/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rang bzhin 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /'khor ba sems phyir bdag med pas/ /de phyir de bzhin gshegs bsam yas/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin mi dmigs phyir/ /mya ngan 'das pa yod ma yin/ /de ltar rigs dang rgyud med par/ /byang chub mchog gi ngo bo la/ /so so'i rang bzhin nges shes na/ /yang dag lam gyis bcos su med/ /yang dag gshegs dang log rtog gnyis/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gnas gyur na/ /de la bcos shing bsgyur du med/ /'ching bu rin chen bzhin mi rigs/ /de bas de lta 'di bzhin pas/ /ma rig log rtogs zhags pa'i rgyus—/ /las dang nyon mongs rgyu rkyen gyis/ /bcu gnyis 'khor lo gnas su skyar—/ /rten dang 'dod pa tha dad pa'i/ /bde sdug gdung bas nyam thag 43—961

bral—/ /rtsom med bzhi ①dus kun du nyams/ /rang bzhin nyid las nyams pa med—/ /de lta'ang rgyal po phru gur 'khyams/ /de bzhin rigs la 'gyur med pas / /shul don rang las gzhan med phyir/ /'phrul dga'i tshal gzhan tha dad zer du min/ /de'ang rnams gsum gnas tshul gzhag /'bru lnga gnas pa'i thabs chen po/ /'gro ba kun la rang gnas te/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi dang srog shing gsum/ /gnas na ka la sgra dbyangs ldan/ /e baṃ ma ya mkha' ldan dang / /snyeng po rlung sgom gnas na yod/ /de yis tan+t+ra 'byin par byed/ /de don de na chos nyid dang / /ye shes yon tan las nyid dngos/ /rnal 'byor lam rim rang bzhin ldan/ /snod kyi 'od dbyebs 'phrin las bzhi/ /thig le bsnyen bsgrub rang bzhin ldan/ /bzhi brgyad k+shi ra ma dal/ /ra ya g.yas g.yon sbyin sreg ldan/ /gnas bzhi 'byung ba las bzhi ste/ /gsang ba'i mkha' la rang bzhin ldan/ /gnas rten rtsa dang thig le la/ /bcu dbang lnga gsum dbang rnams ldan/ /gsang ba nang gi 'dod yon dang / /dam rdzas lnga ldan mchod pa ste/ /de dag rang gnas mi 'du ba/ /rang bzhin gsang ba'i sa ma ya/ /rang bzhin phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /'du byed sprod pa ngang gi gnas—/ /chags pas 'khams 'grub cig shes kyi/ /rang bzhin ye shes 'grub byed pa'o/ /rdo rje phung bo yan lag kun/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sngar grags sogs/ /dngos kun chags dang ngang tshul gyis/ /las dang ngo bo 'bras bur gnas/ /chu zla sgyu ma sprul pa bzhin/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /bzhi rdzogs phyag rgya ma 'dres gsal/ /cir yang 'gyur zhing cir yang 'grub/ /bar ma lam dang 'bras bu rnams/ /gang yang rigs rgyud 43—962

rtag med pas/ /sems phyir kun kyang de de dang / /gzugs gnyis mtshan gsum yod dang med/ /gnas ris sde cha yod min sogs/ /gnyis yul bral bzhin de ldan pa'i/ /don mchog lnga 'bras ye shes dbyings/ /bdun dang gsum phyir don dam la/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen ltar/ /de kun ngo bo nyid rgyur gnas/ /'jig rten brtan g.yo la sogs pa/ /snang ba nyid na ngo bo med/ /de nyid chos sku chen po yin/ /rang bzhin ngang gis de ltar gnas/ /de las gzhan pa'i thob bya med/ /kun kyang smin zin bgrod pa med/ /de nyid lam gyi'ang ngo bo ste/ /'jug ①gnas 'byin pas che ba yin/ /phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad la/ /rang 'byung chen pos kun tu khyab/ /rang 'byung de nyid dngos med par/ /kun gyi phyag rgya'i rgyu yin phyir/ /de lta bu'i ngang du nges—/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya kun gyi rgyu/ /ming grangs med pa'i rgyu nyid dang / /yongs su rdzogs pa zhes kyang brjod/ /gsum pa dngos por zhen pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba'i chos ye nas rigs rgyud rtag min pas/ /so so'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg /chos kyi bye brag tha snyad kun/ /'ja' snang mkha' ltar ma 'dres shig /'dus ma byas pas 'dus byas snang / /'dus byas snang ba rdo rje nyid/ /rgyal 'gros ma mdzad ma bcos pas/ /rang bzhin rang gis dbyer med pa'ang/ /de min zhen pas sgol phyir las/ /tha snyad gnyis par bsam brjod 'das/ /yul dang shes par snang ba yang / /rang 'byung ye shes rang snang zad/ /rgyu 'bras snang yang gnyis pa med/ /phyi nang gsal ba'ang nang nyid dang / /de ltar ye shes rang snang ba/ /lam dang 'bras bu kun dngos pas/ /'brel pa bdag phyir 43—963

thabs chen pos/ /mngon byed rang las 'byung bar zad/ /ye shes rang la gnas pa'i le'u ste/ dang po'o// //lhun grub ngang la phyag btsal nas/ /dang por lam mchog bshad par bya/ /gang dag rang gnas mthong 'dod dgos/ /dus snod rgyu rkyen ①thabs grangs dngos—/ /spyod yon drong rtags tshad dang skyon/ /yan lag spros pa'i rtsa bar gzhag/bsam gyis mi khyab ma mthong bar/ /bsam med dkyil 'khor 'jug byed pa/ /blun po mun sprul blo can de/ /long ba'i grong khyer chen por 'gro/ /de bas ma rig gi ling thog dmig /ldongs pa rdo rje thur ma mkhan/ /mnyes thob sngon byas gzhung thos pas/ /spyan phye dkyil 'khor mthong bya dgos/ /de yang rang bzhin sbyangs pa yis/ /snod du gyur pa'i nye ring phyir/ /rims dang cig car bzhi cha yis/ /phye bas rnal 'byor chen por 'jug /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /shin tu sbyangs la rab gnas pa'i/ /shes rab mi ldan 'dir 'jug phyir—/ /ring ba'ang rims dang cig car pa'o/ /snga ma'ang tan+t+ra gzhung nyid las / /sa rnams khyad par bskong ba yang / /gsang ba'i snying por 'gro ba'i lam—/ /theg pa bzhi'i nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /lam stegs sngon du rdzogs par sbyor/ /de phyir ma nges rigs mchog nas/ /mun pa'i shes pa pa ste gnyer/ /rang bzhin sgyu yis sgyung bar gnas/ /phal pa'i sems brgyad mthar gnas tshe/ /snying po rang bzhin mtshungs pa dang / /bshes ④gnyen mgon la lung gnyis thos/ /yon tan mthong dang skyon mthong dang / /kyis zer de yis skyon rmongs brod dang ba/ /gnyis pa'i sgyu ru 43—964

gsungs pa yin/ /de bdag gsang tshogs dmigs pa ste/ /skad cig 'phel ba de ma thag /drug las rtswa me bzhin g.yos ste/ /bzhi'i theg pa dang por zhog/bden zer de nas rims bzhin bgrod bya ste/ /rgyu nas rkyen gyis 'phar ba de dang zer/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la gnas pa la/ /'di ston mgon la lung thos pas / /de ji bzhin du gnyis dang bzhis/ /mchog gi g.yo ba'i sems 'byung 'gyur/ /bzhi des khong du chud smos pas/ /lhag par gzugs brnyan 'jug par byed/ /mchog gi dam tshig de ru byin/ /rigs nges gyur la phan pa bcu/ /nus pa gnyis kyi byin brlabs bzhag /rang gi spyan mchog byed pa brtson—/ /rgyu'i dkyil 'khor mthong bya'i phyir/ /thos bsam dam pa len par byed—/ /kha cig dus mtha'i cig car ba/ /bskal pa rdul snyed sngon song nas//thun mong de rnyed sbyangs pa'i mtha'/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i don zhugs pa'ang / /sngon byas 'di che nges 'byung ba/ /rims kyis sbyangs la cig car drod/ /la la dbang po rno ba dag /theg pa chen po gnyis 'jug ste/ /ma sbyangs sgrub pa gsum phyir gyi/ /mtho brtan myur rno rgya che yang / /zab mo sgyu'i gang zag de/ /nyid kyang rkyen dang de rim pas/ /phye bas rgyu 'bras chen po rnams/ /ma nges 'jug dang 'di nyid do/ /de de'ang rang sems brtan pa'i dngos/ /bshes gnyen rnams dang ngo bos 'brel/ /de ltar bya byed snod bcud du/ /chen po'i lung dang 'byel ba dang / /mgon dang bya byed thugs rjes 'brel/ /de phyir mchog lung rdo rje rnams/ /dang 'byal byed phyir rgyu rkyen drug /ldan pas ma nges 'jug pa ni/ /dbang po ji bzhin mos rkyen gyis/ /rgyu 'am bya ba'am gnyis ka'o/ /rnal 'byor theg par sbyor bar byed/ /de nas de bzhin 'dir 43—965

'jug pa'ang / /sngon bzhin g.yo rton 'jug sems sbyor/ /gnas pas mthar phyin byed pas ni/ /ltos pa ring ba'i dus nyid do/ /ma nges sa nas 'brel rgyu rkyen/ /ldan pas rnal 'byor mchog sbyor ba/ /mun pa'i zer tshul rtswa me bzhin/ /g.yo smon 'jug pa sngon bzhin te/ /bdud ldan pa'ang tan+t+ra yin//gzhung gi ngang tshul rang bzhin sogs/ /snod yon ldan pa bslab pa la/ /gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /'jug pa bzhi'i yan lag mchog /dang po ched du gnyer bar byed/ /gang de thos pas tshol ba'i tshe/ /rgyu gnyis rkyen gyis bzod thob pas/ /rang bzhin rang gis bzod thob pa/ /res smon sems kyis nyan brtson ①sbyor/ /gang dag mnyan bsam shes rab tshe/ /nyan cing thos 'dzin bsam pa dang / /bsam pa'i tshe na stag spyod pa/ /gnyis po 'di dag shes pa'i rgyu/ /mkhan po lung dang man ngag bcas/ /lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen du 'dod/ /rang bzhin bdud dang mtshungs ldan pa/ /cig shes rgyu ru nges pa yin/ /de ltar ldan pas spyan tshol tshe/ /gtan tshigs rnams kyis smal byas te/ /nor ba'i shes rab dmigs gsal nas/ /ma nor dmigs nas blang bar bya/ /gzhi dang gtan tshigs grub pa'i don/ /rnam gsum lnga pa'i bzhi ru gzhag /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas ston pa/ /sku lnga 'dul ba'i 'khor rnams la/ /gsung lngas bstan pa de kho na/ /gtan pa phebs shing gzhan byed pa'o/ /de nyid dngos lnga tshul dang tshig /brjod pa lngas mtshon byung ba bzhi/ /de la gtan tshigs dngos lnga yis/ /brda' sprod rjes su 'jug pa bstan pa'ang / /bsregs bcad ②brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /dngos lngas legs par btags te dbab/ /de yang yongs su brtags bzhi'i/ /dbang 43byed966

po yul dang snang ba kun/ /yul rnams yod pa ma yin te/ /kun gzhi rnam par shes pa nyid/ /dngos po sna tshogs par snang bas/ /'khor dang 'das dngos zhe sdang brtag /'jig rten 'di na ci yod pa'i/ /ming dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa yi/ /log rtog so so rang spyi'i mtshan/ /ji ltar gnas par spyad par bya/ /dngos gnyes zhen dngos dus gsum chos/ /skad cig gcig la kun rdzogs phyir/ /de dngos mthong ba yang dag par/ /rigs bzhi kun kyang de ltar shes/ /kun brtags shes pa bar mar 'gyur/ /spyi'i yul lus med grib ma bzhin/ /med pas mi btub rang nyid la/ /mi btub mdzub mo bzhin dogs pa/ /gnyen po med pa dag min zhing / /bar ma'i yul phyir nges tshig 'grub/ /de ltar lnga yis de de la/ /de de'i rang bzhin rtag bya ba'ang / /rtog dang ldan pa'i mi rnams la/ /dngos po sna tshogs sems gsang sngags—/ /des lung yin phyir chos tshur ston/ /brjod dang 'dra bar brda sprod ①pas/ /ngo bo nyid kyis bshad pa'i phyir/ /ma 'ongs don du gtan tshigs nges/ /yong ni sa gnas mi ldan pa/ /rang bzhin shugs kyis skye med don—/ /ma btsal ngang gis snang byed pa/ /brjod med de nyid brjod dang 'dra—/ /gang dag gzugs dang rnal 'byor gyis/ /mthong thos la sogs rang bzhin brda'/ / dpa'o brda' ④dang dgongs pa dang / /rang gi ting 'dzin kyis brda' sprod/ /dper na sa 'og gser rlangs dang / /me long nyi ma'i ngang bzhin du/ /kun kyang rig phyir rang bzhin drod/ /rang bzhin ngang gis brjod 'drar snang / /kun kyang brag ca'i sgra bzhin phyir/ /grag stong dbyer med rdo rje gsung / /sgra thos nyid kyis de nyid du/ /so sor ma brtags 'jal 43—967

bar byed/ /so so'i skad du brda' sprod ltar/ /tshig sbyangs med pa'i ngag lta bu//mos spyod grol bzhin brjod pa yis/ /brda sprod yongs su grol bar byed/ /dang po rgyud la tha dad phyir/ /gang mos grol ba yod mod kyang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i mnyam sbyor zhing / /rang 'byung kun ngam sgrub byed phyir/ /mi dmigs ngang las dmigs pa'i/ /cho 'phrul tshig gis mtshon par bya/ /gsung lnga thos pa lnga tshul yang / /rjes su tshig gis mtshon par bya/ /ngo bo snang tshig rang snang tshig /ldem dgongs tshig dang bkri drang rgyud/ /'dod rkyen tshig dang rdo rje tshig /rang rig mngon gsal tshig gis mtshon/ /thams cad gsang sngags ngo bo'i phyir/ /mtha' dbus med pa de bzhin nyid/ /dbyer med ngang du gnas pa la/ /ye shes rtogs pa'i don bya'i phyir/ /phyogs dang dbus su gnas par bya/ /kun la de bzhin sbyor bar gyis/ /yi ge tshig dang sgras spangs pa'i/ /brjod med ngang du gnas pa ni/ /gsung nyid rang bzhin med pa yi/ /chos rnams thams cad ye nas dag /thams cad thugs su gyur pas na/ /sgra dang tshig la gnas pa min/ /'das dang ma 'das thams cad kun—/ /yang dag shes pas rab brtags nas/ /rang bzhin med par cir yang snang / /snang ba nyid na dbyings yin te/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i ye shes ni//kun la dbang sgyur rang dbang can/ /thams cad tshig gi sgra ltar gnas/ /'di ni ye shes gsung mchog yin/ /chos rnams bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /mtha' dang dbus med kun tu khyab/ /khyab dang khyab med rdo rje sku/ /sgra skad sna tshogs sgrags pa yang / /dngos po med las dngos po'i sgra/ /ji ltar pi bang lag thogs na/ /sgra ni sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur yang / /dngos po med de 43—968

de bzhin nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams la/ /de bzhin gsung mchog mi smra ste/ /sku yis chos rnams 'jal bar ston/ /me long bzhin du sku la snang / /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /ming dang tshig tu brtags nas ston/ /ji snyed mang po'i don brjod kyang / /rdo rje'i gsung la spros pa med—/ /spros med de nyid sna tshogs pa'i/ /kun la brda 'jal ye shes gsung / /sgra dang ming tshig kun las 'das/ /thams cad pad ma chags med pa'o/ /dbang po rnam gnyis bsrungs pa yis/ /mkha' la nyi zla dus gcig 'char/ /mi 'jigs tshul du zil mnan mthong / /de phyir gtan tshigs las las brjod//de lta mod kyang bsdu na gnyis/ /bzhi rjes mi dpyod cig rjes dpyod/ /rnam gnyis tshul gyis mthong bar byed/ /dbang po gnyis dang mthun sbyar ba'o/ /de la snga mas go bya ba'ang / /sems can ma lus thams cad kun/ /ye nas byang chub snying por gnas/ /de phyir dbe+ed pa'i bya byed med/ /tshig dang yi ger mi mtshon te/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang rnyed par dka'/ /rgyal ba'i sras po cang mi gsung / /ma gsungs pa nyid rgya cher bshad/ /bshad dang nyan pa gnyis ka med/ /dpyod pa zhugs na rtog pa'i gzhi/ /rtog pa zhugs na dmigs pa'i rten—/ /dmigs pa zhugs na 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ /'dzin pas zin phyir grol mi 'gyur/ /de bas gser lta gser bzhin du/ /bdag phyir bya byed ma dmigs pas/ /rtog dpyod dmigs 'dzin mi tshol ba/ /de brjod nyid kyis de nyid mthong / /sus kyang ma bcings bcings med de/ /bcing bar bya ba yod ma yin/ /bcings med rnam par grol med pas/ /grol bar mi 'dod bcings dang bral/ /so sor gang la rtog med pas/ /so sor snang ba kun 43—969

rtogs phyir/ /so sor rtog stipa'i mchog yin te/ /brtags pa med pa'i bla dwags yin/ /kha cig phyin ①mas gol byed pa/ /brjod pa'i dngos po spyod yul la/ /so sor rtog pa gtan tshigs rkyen/ /don dang mthun dang mi mthun paske/ /phyi ma mi mthun mtshon byed ltar/ /chos kun mtha' las 'das pa las//mtha' rnams gang yang dor med pas/ /'di ltar 'di'o zhes bstan med/ /rang gi ngo bo bstan par dka'/ /'on kyang yin min 'dzin grol phyir/ /mdor na ji ltar brtags bsams bzhin/ /'gyur bas kun gyi ngo bor snang / /de mtshon ci yang yin pa'i phyir/ /sems chos ci yang ma yin no/ /de phyir ma yin kun yin pas/ /ci yang yin no lhun gyis grub/ /mtha' kun phyogs su ma chad phyir/ /mtha' dang bral phyir ma bral ba'o/ /gang yang ma spangs mi ldan pas/ /ma bral phyir na bral zhes bya/ /ngo bos phebs pas rgyas par 'gyur//cig shos mthun par ston pa'ang / /bye brag bsdus pa kun khyab gsum/ /de ltar rnam par bsam yas pa/ /cha tsam brjod pa 'di lta mod/ /chos rnams yongs kyis dag pa yi/ /rnam bzhi'i tshul gyis don rtogs mngon/ /snod bcud rgyud rnams dag rtogs shing / /mnyam nyid lhag pa'i mnyam nyid kyis/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bzang po'i zhing / /rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul/ /byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum pa/ /rab tu rtogs pa rnam bzhi yis/ /thams cad mngon rdzogs rgyal po che/ /nyid las dbang sgyur nyid spyod phyir/ /bdag dang gzhan dang rtog pa'i rgyun/ /rnam dag bla med theg pa'i mchog /'das dang ma 'das thams cad kun/ /yang dag shes pas rab rtags nas/ /rang bzhin med las cir yang snang / /snang ba nyid na dbyings nyid yin/ /43—970

gshegs sku sgyu mar snang ba dang / /log rtog sgyu mar snang ba gnyis/ /bzhi rtsa med de rang bzhin stong / /rigs dang rgyud du rtag tu med/ /rigs dang kha dog dbyibs med las/ /phyi nang snod bcud thams cad snang / /snang ba nyid na chos kyi sku/ /cir yang 'gyur zhing thams cad grub/ /nyon mongs rang dang spyi bstan pa/ /mtshan nyid ma nor don rtogs na/ /rnam par byang ba'i lam du 'gyur/ /de phyir rang spyi'i gtan tshigs zhes/ /mtha' dang dbus med du mar bral/ /gang yang ma yin de bzhin nyid/ /dbyer med pa'i tshul rtogs phyir—/ /mtha' dang bral ba'ang de bzhin no/ /'byung ba chen po lnga rnams la//rang bzhin med par gzhig bya'i phyir/ /gcig la yang lnga lngar dbye bya zhing / /sum̐ gyi dbyings su thim par bya/ /sum̐ nyid smra bsam yul las 'das/ /nam mkha' bzung du med pa ltar/ /snang srid thams cad de dang 'dra/ /rten sa gnyen khrus rten med rlung / /gsal sreg me ltar shes par bya/ /de bzhin phung po dbang yul lnga/ /nyon mongs kha dog la sogs pa/ /don dang ngo bo cig ma 'dres—/ /de phyir de yi mtshon rtogs byed/ /gtan tshigs gtan tshigs brjod pa rnams/ /bsgrub bya gang yin shes don la/ /nges tshig ngo bo mtshan nyid sogs/ /gang nas 'be+ebs kyang rgyas par bya'o/ /thams cad 'jigs byed dam tshig dang / /shes pa'i dam tshig ldan par bya/ /thams cad ma lus don 'byung ba/ /tshig gis mtshon pas gud na med/ /sgra nyid don kyis dngos po med/ /don gnyis sgra las gud na med/ /ming tshig sgra la mi rten par/ /blo'i ting du go bar byos/ /gsum bzhi lus don brjod bya ba/ /sngags mchog bla na med pa yi/ /mtshan ma kun tu ma brtag par/ /mnyam pa'i ngang du 43—971

thams cad shes/ /kun kyang mnyam pa nyid yin pas/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /so so'i lta ba brjod mi bya/ /dag cing blang bar bya ba med—/ /spyir ni log rtog bsam yas pa/ /ye nas yod pa ma yin te/ /so so'i 'dzin rtog bag chags kyis/ /bzung 'dzin dra bas bsgribs 'gyur te/ /ci yang med las cir yang snang / /byang chub snying po'i gzhi las gol/ /bden min ma grol bcings pa dang / /dus dgras 'joms bslus mi rtag dang //'phags lam bral dgos btson rar chud/ /sdug bsngal mi 'jil rgyu phyir 'khrul//de bas mnyam nyid ma rtogs pas/ /dug lnga 'jogs spyod rgyud lngar 'khor/ /dge bcu dag la gtsor len cing / /dge dang mi dge mi nyams ①pas lha dang mi'i skye gnas te/ /mnyam nyid ma rtogs 'dod khams 'khor/ /mnyan ②pa'i don nyid ma rtogs shing / /tshad med bzhi dang bsam gtan bzhi/ /rim pas so sor bdag 'dzin cing / /gzugs rnams kun la bdag tu rtogs/ /'di ni tshangs gnas rim par skye/ /mnyam dang gzugs med ma rtogs ①nas/ /ming bzhi med par ma shes na/ /skye mched bzhi la gnas 'gyur ba/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i sa ru skye/ /rtag chad gnyi gar blo zhen pa/ /don gyi snying po nyid las gol bar gsungs/ /sa dgu dag pa'i ye shes ni/ /sa dgu ma spangs ngang du bcom—/ /gnyis med me rtogs thams cad la/ /bden bzhi'i dngos po yod lta zhing / /spong dang mi spong byed 'gyur na/ /'di ni nyan thos sa pa yin/ /las dang nyon mongs thams cad la/ /mnyam pa'i don du ma shes shing / /rten 'brel rgyu 'bras yod zin na/ /'di ni rang sangs rgyas kyi sa④/ /mnyam pa'i don nyid mi shes shing / /kun rdzob don dam gnyis 'byed la/ /chos 43—972

dang gang zag bdag med na/ /'di ni byang chub sa pa yin/ /bla med theg pa'i nang nas ni/ /don dam du ni dbyer med 'ang / /kun rdzob tu ni thams cad la/ /dag dang ma dag gnyis kar 'dzin/ /thabs kyi theg pa chen po ni/ /rnam par byang dang sdug bsngal dag /kun rdzob tu yang dbyer med de/ /lta ba mthon sman de tsam mo/ /thabs kyi lta spyod chen po ni/ /bla med theg pa las 'phags pa/ /don dam du ni skor 'dun no/ /kun rdzob tu ni mnyam rdzogs so//yang dag skyes mchog dam pa yis/ /don dam kun rdzob dbyer med pa/ /yang dag nyid du rab tu rtogs/ /mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya chen por ston/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam par dag /thams cad dag ces bya ba'ang / /dngos po gsal dag ma yin te/ /snang spyod nyid na rnam par dag /de phyir kun rdzob brdzun mi lta/ /gnyis med mnyam pa ma shes pas—/ /don dam dag pa chos nyid tsam/ /ye shes bzhi yon kun rdzob ltar/ /re bsgom ①bya ba las kyi sa/ /lhun grub mnyam pa ma mthong bas chos sku rnam dag ye shes kyi/ /byin brlabs rdo rje dbyings sprul pas/ /blang dor byed pa rnal 'byor sa/ /de ltar mngon rtags dmigs phye na/ /ma nor don gyis grub mtha' ni/ /theg pa mthon dman thams cad dang / /'jig rten lta ba thams cad kun/ /ye shes chen por rab rtags nas/ /rang bzhin med las cir yang 'grub/ /rang bzhin nyid la mnyam pa med/ /mnyam pa'i don nyid ji lta bu/ /mnyam nyid rang bzhin gang yang min/ /kun yin ngo bo 'di 'drar med/ /mnyam dang rtogs pa gang yang med/ /byang chub sems zhes brjod pa ni/ /gang nas ma 'ongs gar mi 'gro/ /rtog med rang rig kho na 43—973

tsam—/ /sangs rgyas sems can sems la gnas/ /byang chub sems rnams thams cad ni/ /shin tu brtag dka' gting zab pas/ /ma dmigs mi dmigs dmigs su med/ /sems nyid de nyid ji lta bu/ /byang chub de ni sems yin no/ /sems dang byang chub dbyer med pas/ /sems can ma lus thams cad dang / /dus gsum chos rnams thams cad yin/ /yod las btsal ni sgos brtags te/ /sgro btags brgyad du ltung bar 'gyur/ /med las btsal na bkur btab ste/ /bskur pa bcu'i gnas su ltung / /yod med gnyis las btsal byas nas/ /de snyed lung du ma bstan 'gyur/ /de phyir nam mkha' yod med ces/ /blun po gang zhig rtog par med/ /mkhas pas nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /med par mi 'dzin yod min 'dzin/ /sems nyid yod med kun ngo bo/ /sgra tsam brjod rung don nyid kyi/ /ngo bo 'di zhes bstan dka' la/ /yod dang med ces ci byar yod/ /sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas la/ /de min lta ba zlog pa'i phyir/ /gnyis med mnyam dang sangs rgyas dang / /bdag nyid lhun grub chos dbyings dag /byang chub chos nyid stong bsam 'das/ /de bzhin nyid dang skye 'gag med/ /mtha' bral 'das dang grol sogs su/ /bla dwags tsam du brjod pa yin/ /de nas tshig dngos tshig lam chad/ /sems nyid de kun rang bzhin la/ /de dag sgra brjod skad ci dgos/ /brtan rtag dka' bar rgyal bas gsungs/ /ma chags pad+ma 'dra ba'i—/ /ye shes can gyi spyod yul te/ /kun dang thun mong de ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul te/ /skyes bu blo rtsal rab kyis rtogs/ /de phyir blo can rnams kyis brtson/ /shes pa'i mtshan nyid dngos mi grangs/ /ngo bo 43—974

rim pas phye ba yin/ /snga ma kha cig mngon sum la/ /drug gam brgyad gnyis gnas gyur phyir/ /shes rab dbang drug tshul nas brjod/ /nges par ma nor mthong ba yang / /ye shes lnga ru gsal ba'i phyir/ /brgyad kyi ngo bo de nyid de/ /lnga dmigs byed pa med pa'i phyir/ /de bas yul med rang gsal ba'o/ /dbyengs dang rig pa gnyis med par/ /de bzhin nyid du rdo rje rigs/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang rig nyid/ /dmigs med tshul du der snang ngo / /yangs shing rgya che lhun grub ni/ /phyi nang snod bcud ye nas dag /dag rtogs nyid kyang dbyings nyid yin/ /'di ni rdo rje mnyam nyid yin/ /shes dang spyod yul gnyis med pas/ /thams cad ma lus cig pa'i ngang / /ma 'dres yongs sdogs gsal stong gzugs/ /lta dang lta bar bya med par/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad mthong / /gang du'ang ma mthong spyan gyi mchog /khyab gsal rang bzhin go ba'i sgra/ /thos pa med pa thos pa'i phul/ /dang bas tshim byed chos kyi dri/ /snom byed med par tshor ba'i shangs/ /don bcud nyams su myong ba'i ro/ /myong ba'i bya byed med nyid myong / /yang dag don la reg pa nyid/ /reg pa kun dngos reg la dang / /chos khams sna tshogs kun mkhyen pa/ /rang rig rgyal po rang snang ba'o/ /de bas bdag 'dzin rang gsal la/ /bdag bcas bdag dang bral ba'i yid/ /don dang sems can rtog med gsal/ /rang 'byung ye shes thams cad mkhyen/ /yang ni rim pa don grags brjod/ /don dam kun rdzob gnyis med mthong / /dngos byas rim par rtogs goms rim/ /rnam bzhi lam dang sgo bzhi dang / /bsnyan bsgrubs lam grangs nyams g.yo thob/ /goms bstan mtha' ru phyin par 'phar/43—975

mnyam pa'i ngang las mi skrag pas/ /mngon byas nges pa'i shes rab dang / /rnam pa kun ldan stong chen mthong / /rang rig snying rje ye shes gzigs/ /phyag rgya cig sku 'bras bu lta/ /thams cad gsal ba'i lta ba dang / /bar chad med pa'i tshogs chen mthong / /dbang sgyur mnyam nyid mi g.yo ba/ /ye shes kun mkhyen lta ba dgu/ /thos bsam so sor rtogs sgoms dang / /rnal 'byor rim pa'i rgyud las skyes/ /de bas shes rab gsum la 'bod/ /rgyud don gzungs kyis zin pa ni/ /dam tshig dam tshig ces bya ba/ /rang gi lta ba dam tshig yin/ /sdom pa rnam pa bcu gsum dang / /spyi'i dam tshig mtha' yas pa/ /thig le chen po ngang du gsal/ /ji ltar spyad kyang sdom mi 'da'/ /spyod pa rnam pa gnyis po yang / /thig le chen po'i ngang du nges/ /ci la yang mi gnas kun la spyod/ /spyod pa byed dang spyod med mthong / /bya byed med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /kun la thogs pa med par spyad/ /bzhi'i las dang cig po'ang / /thig le chen po'i ngang du gsal/ /mchod pa'i rgyan dang log spyod kun/ /reg pa byang chub sems chen po/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i ngang du 'dus/ /phul ba med pa thams cad mnyes/ /gzhal yas khang dang dkyil 'khor dang / /khro tshogs 'du 'phro mang po yang / /sems kyi cho 'phrul chen po yin/ /de bas rnam 'dun ring ba'i ngang / /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /rang bzhin ngang gis dag nyid phyir/ /dbang lnga ma brtsal lhun gyis rdzogs/ /bco brgyad rang rig cho 'phrul snang / /e ma'o ma bsgrubs sgrub chen po/ /grub pa chen po ye shes che/ /don du gnyer ba'i rnam grangs kun/ /rang rig byang chub sems chen po/ /ting 'dzin lta ba'i bye brag kun/ /rang rig snang phyir chu bur dang //43—976

nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /rang rig ye shes nyid las min/ /sngags dang phyag rgya sems nyid phyir/ /brag ca chu zla 'dra shes na/ /'ching brjod las nyid mya ngan 'das/ /de bas bya byed mnyam nyid rtogs/ /lta ba lta ba gtsor brjod mod/ /don du shes rab kun mnyam nyid/ /ded dpon rin chen ji bzhin du/ /'dod mtha' bye brag 'dir shes dgos/ /shes rab rtogs pa gnyer chub che/ /bdag dang gzhan phyir bya ba rnams/ /shes pa'i gzhi las kun kyang spyod/ /thos bsams bcu spyod chen du gnyer/ /'di yang rgyal pos sa khams dang / /stobs can rtsal gyi drag zhan dang / /mkha' yul che chung ji lta bar/ /gzhi cig stobs kyi khyad par 'gyur/ /ye nas dbyings su cig pa na/ /de la nga dang bdag ma rtog /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa la//btsad dang rtse ba'i blo ma byed/ /thams cad bde gshegs snying po bas/ /rkyen gyi rdul gyis gang la 'go/ /shes rab mchog gis de ltar rtogs/ /ma lus kun 'dus dbyings shes byos/ /de bas shes par bya ba rnams/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i ngo bor byed/ /bdag dang gzhan phyir gtsor byed cing / /dang po'i sdom pas kun kyang slob/ /shes rab chen po'i sbyin sreg gis/ /srid gsum sreg pa'i me yin te/ /yid kyis ye shes me ru 'bar/ /re/ kun kyang chos nyid ngang du sgral/ /gdod mthar lam gnyer spros pa gcod/ /grub pa bsgod dang 'jug pa 'ang / /bdag bzhan chos phyir dam bcas pas/ /bdag nyid la'ang gzhan don rdzogs/ /de bas byis par mi mtshungs te/ /kun lam skabs las shes par bya'o/ /gang zhig 'di 'drar mthong rtogs pa/ /dngos grub mchog gi snying po ste/ /chu srin phyag rgya de bzhin du/ /dang po don rtogs 43—977

mtha' mi gtong / /spyod yul kun tu tshad dpag med/ /kun nas nyon mongs sbyod pa'ang grol/ /thun mong lam gnyis de bzhin pas/ /rnam smin gnyis med tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /gang gis de ltar rtogs gyur pa/ /sgro skur ①mtha' gsum las grol te/ /'jug pa'i don rnams 'byen par byed/ /de bas bdag gzhan chos don rdzogs/ /rgya che zab yangs shes rab myur/ /zab pa'i don rtogs mi ldog bde/ /nga dang bdag med spangs pa bde/ /brtson pas rtogs pa lhur byed na/ /dbang thob bde ba dag mthong zhing / /rtsa ba'i drod las yan lag kun/ /shugs kyis 'byung bar the tshom med/ /de las mtshan ma byung ba ni/ /stobs kyis rtogs pa'i rlung ldan la/ /'pho 'gyur mthong la 'jigs med cing / /'khrul pa'i khams la skyo ba med/ /grub pa'i gnas la mi pon te/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod mnyam par sbyor/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs bzod chen te/ /las rnams gang lta khur mi lta/ /tan tra'i khungs dang 'gal med spyod/ /tha mal spyod pas lhag par 'gyur/ /spyod pa rgyun gyi tshogs gnyis sdogs/ /mdo ldos tha dad brjod mi lang / /rgya mtsho dang ba'i gzugs brnyan ltar/ /sgra rten yid la byed min par/ /rang rig mngon sum dmigs bral bas/ /rang gsal gsum bral mi bsgul bas/ /nges par rdeng du gang byas pas/ /thos bsam rten pa'i lta mthar phyin/ /'on kyang sa dang sa'i rims/ /dbang po dang pa'i spyod yul la/ /nye ring drung bzhin stobs 'phel bas/ /rgyu rkyen gong 'og 'bras bur 'byel/ /gsal ba'i bye brag rim par 'gro/ /de chas skabs ming brjod dngos cig /gong gi don ltar ma rtogs pa'i/ /blo ngan mnyam par khungs phyung nas/ /ma gtogs ⑤le lo 43—978

snyoms las byas/ /don ma grub par ngan song 'gro/ /sems kyis mnyam pa ma rtogs na/ /tshig gi mnyam pas sangs mi rgya/ /de bas don tshig ldan par byos//'on tang the tshom ①med par 'grub/ /spyan bzangs lam zhugs ji bzhin phyir/ /lam kun zag cing 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /don du mi 'gyur phyir na klag /de bas don las 'grus par gyis/ /de ltar don mthong gang dang gang zhig gis/ /gzhan du mi bsam de la 'dris par byas/ /skyes bu dam pa mchog 'dod pas/ /de la rtags 'grub gsal bar gyis/ /lam shes lam du 'jug bzhin phyir/ /'jug pa rnams dang rgyu 'bras tshul/ /rang gnas mthong ba'i le'u ste/ gnyis pa'o—/ / //bdag nyid dang chen rtog pas mos/ /rdo rje goms byed bshad pas na/ /snga ma snga ma gang dang gang / /phyi ma phyi ma'i thabs dang rgyu/ /de bzhin phyi ma phyi ma gang / /snga ma snga ma las 'byung 'bras/ /de ltar rgyu 'bras thabs 'byel pa//srid pa'i 'khor lo tshul bzhin du/ /dbang po brtson 'grus bzang ngan gyis/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i lus bstan pa/ /srid pa rdzogs pa'i smin tshul gyis/ /lhag par rdeng ldan skyes bu yis/ /bsgom pa rnam bzhi zung ldan par/ /gdon ma nyid nas goms par byed/ /thig le chen po'i rang bzhin la/ /bsgom pa rnam gsum dus cig rdzogs/ /de ni de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /de ni kun tu snang gi ngang / /de ni rgyu'i rim par ldan/ /tshogs brgyad ye shes lngar rtogs pa/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang sgyur nas/ /ye shes lnga ru gsal ba nyid//thugs kyi phyag rgya chen po'o/ /mnyam la mnyam par sbyor ba yi/ /mnyam pa'i 43—979

dam tshig la gnas na/ /mnyan rdzogs chen po thob 'gyur bas/ /'das na sangs rgyas ma yin no/ /yang na dam tshig 'di lta bu/ /ji ltar spyad kyang sdom mi 'da'/ /byed spyod tshogs chen gnyis su 'gyur/ /'gro dang 'dug dang nyal ba dang / /ma nyams de'i dbyings na gnas/ /shes rab mchog gi rtag tu spyad/ /dbyings nyid la ni mi spyod phyir/ /dbyings nyid mchog gi gnas la spyodaske/ /de nyid mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes yid bzhin gter—/ /thams cad la'ang me long bzhin/ /ltas kyang gzugs brnyan mi snang ngo / /shes rgyud ci yin gang gis ngo shes shing / /bya byed 'phags kyis 'dug byed pa/ /gang zhig slong la spyod pa byang chub thob/ /rnam par dag pa'i g.yung drung sangs rgyas la/ /thams cad ye nas mnyam par rnam dag cing //mi rtog sa le gnas la rtog par mdzad/ /bsnyan du med pas sna tshogs 'byung ba yin—/ /bdag med bdag chen thams cad 'byung ba'i gter/ /ma bkag pa las rgyu zhing 'byung med pa'i/ /rnam rtog nyid na ye shes rang bzhin te/ /rnam gsum snang ba rang bzhin stong nyid pas/ /rnam rtog mi skyo ye shes brjod du med—/ /thams cad sems kyi ngang ste sems zhes gdags su med/ /ma bcos lhun gnas ye shes byang chub cing / /thob rgyu med pas ye nas bde gshegs yin/ /nam mkhar bzung bas sprin gyis khebs par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' med par gang gis shes pa ni/ /sprin dag 'byung zhing khebs pas mi srid bzhinaske/ /bsgoms ①pa'i sems kyang de ltar lta bar bya/ /ma bcos lhun mnyam ji bzhin dang bzhag dang / /rgyu 'bras lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung / /de bzhin nyid la gnas byas na/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal mi 'byung 43—980

ste—/ /rtag tu bde gnas byang chub nyid/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kun dang ldan—/ /srid pa'i rims par smin tshul gyis/ /'jug pa'i yan lag lnga ru bzhag /gang dag dngos kun rang rig phyir/ /shi ba don dam bden pa ste/ /skye ba bar ma kun rdzob yin/ /skye ba'i rim gsum gnyis med do/ /dang po lam la rten byed pas/ /de bzhin nyid du goms par bya/ /sngon dgos thabs dang ngo bo dang / /mi mthun bcos nyams spyod dam tshig /drod rtags mtshan yon 'da' ka ma/ /rang gi 'bras bu rdzogs par 'gyur/ /skyes bu seng ge bzhin rgyu bas/ /sngon du ri mo rim par rdzogs/ /ston pa mchod brtson rtogs pa gsal / /dam tshig ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /byang chub sems dang snying rje lnga/ /lhag pa'i yo byad lnga rdzogs bya/ /de nas ma'i sems ldan pas/ /gnas drug thar par dgod dam bca'/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi sngon song bas /yid 'ong skyon med sa rtsal bslang / /ran byas byi dor ldan byas bsrung / /pi par stan dang ldan par bya/ /bar chad gsal zhing lam rdzogs phyir/ /tshogs dang sbyin sreg dpung tshogs 'bad/ /phyi nang 'brel chags thams cad kun/ /gzhan phyir dus rgyun sems kyis dor/ /khams dang ting 'dzin rkyen bsdus la/ /bar chad bsrung ba mngon rdzogs nas/ /longs spyod rig ma'ang ldan par bya/ /'tshe ba bzlog pa'ang nyer rdzogs nas/ /thun mong spyi'i mngon rdzogs nas/ /mchod rten nye ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhugs/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i tshal bzung la—/ /yongs 'gyur thim byas rjes la 'jug /dag pa rnam gsum ma nor zhing / /rang rig rgyal po goms pa yis/ /byang chub mchog 'di rnyed par 'gyur—/ /de phyir mthong rjes de bzhin nyid/ /snying rje 'byung ba'i bzhi ru 43—981

gzhag /go rims 'byung ba'ang de bzhin nges/ /gang zag skal ldan cung sman pas/ /gzhan sel phyir dang don gnyer ①phyir/ /'jug pa'ang snga ma gnyis don du/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i 'dam dbyings su/ /ye shes sgron ma'i mda' ④phangs nas/ /gti mug mun pa rnams gsal te/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal bde ba'i mchog /mdor na sgrib tshogs mun snang tshul/ /chos dbyings mkha' dkyil yangs pa la/ /shes rab myur du don 'gro ba'ang / /'gro med 'ong med mi gnas pa/ /byang chub sems mchog a rab bde/ /mun snang bdud rtsi tshul bzhin du/ /rtog pa'i dbang sgyur ting 'dzin yin/ /don du gnyer ba gang dag kun/ /ting 'dzin 'di yis byed par 'gyur/ /gal te rnal 'byor 'di min na/ /rgya mtsho gting gi pha bong ltar/ /bskal ①par lam la btsal byas kyang / /don med snying po skams pa yin/ /de phyir lhag ma cha bsnyams pa'i/ /bde ldan brod pas chos bdun rjotshul/ /ldan byas rje btsun snang tshul bzhin/ /'dzin rtsol med pa'i sems kyis bu'adug /de'ang gdams ngag shes rab kyis/ /stobs kyis bzhag pas goms par byed/ /sngon brjod bu des dbe+en pa'i sar/ /rin chen lhab lhub longs spyod kyis/ /mnyes byas slob bu'ang 'phang du bzhag /bgegs skras ④dbu pas chu bur gtim—/ /dngos grub myur du 'grub 'dod na/ /shin tu mi dmigs dbyengs sgoms ④pas/ /phyi ma'ang spyi lugs mthong rjes gzhag /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan rnams ni/ /shin tu mi dmigs dbyings su sgom/ /rang rig nyid la gnas pa'i/ /sus kyang ma byas rang 'byung ste/ /thams cad de bzhin nyid du sbyor / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du sbyor/ /rang 'byung ye shes dkyil 43—982

'khor gyes/ /ma lus de bzhin nyid du sdud/ /snyud dang mi sdud gnyis ka med//yang dag kho na nyid du'o/ /bsgom bya sgom byed ma skyes na/ /chos nyid sgom par bya ba'ang med/ /don dam sgom par byar med pas/ /gang la'ang mi 'jug zhugs pa'i mchog /bsam bya bsam par mi bya ste/ /mi bsam par yang mi bsam na/ /gang la rnam par mi sems pa/ /de ni rang rig mnyam yin no/ /byang chub sems kyi de bzhin nyid/ /shin tu mi dmigs brtag dka' ba/ /yangs la rgya che gting zab pas/ /shes rab zab pas rtogs 'gyur te/ /gang nas ma 'ongs gar mi 'gro/ /'go dang 'ong bar bya ba min/ /shin tu rtag dka' mi dmigs pas/ /mtha' dang dbus kyang rtag tu med/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang rig nyid/ /dmigs med tshul du der snang ngo / /dbyings dang dbyings kyi ye shes kyang / /rang rig kho na tsam du zad/ /gang zhig dmigs nas 'jug pa ni/ /de srid 'jig rten rgyang 'phan pa/ /'jug med sangs rgyas yin par ni/ /dbang po nyid dang kun gyes gsungs/ /nges nga/ra bsam zhing dmigs yod na/ /phra rab 'jen thag 'jud /lta bus/ /de bzhin nyid 'di mi mthong ste/ /then thag 'jug sa mkha' bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor mnyam pa de bzhin nyid/ /ngo bo bzhin du drangs 'jug cing / /nges tshig rnam pa 'byung ba yin/ /de bas kun 2la 'byor par gyis/ /chen po sman nga/sa/ mtha' gsal ba'i/ /ma skyes de bzhin nyid stong pa/ /sdong stong stong pa'i tha snyad bral/ /spros pa brgyad bral 'dod ma yin/ /gang gis rang sems mtha' dri ma/ /med nga/ de bzhin dag pa nyid/ /rnal 'byor mtshan med de bzhin nyid/ /gnyis/ med lhun mnyam de bzhin nyid/ /grangs bzhi'i rim pa 13—983

tha ma nyid/ /byin brlabs yon tan ngo bos brlab/ /bla ma'ang skabs mi mnyam nyid dang / /lhun grub mtha' bral tha snyad med/ /stong chen ma skyes chos dbyings sogs/ /yon tan cha re brjod par zad/ /re re'i 'ang skabs kyi ngo bo dang / /ming don nges tshig brjod pa dang / /gtan tshigs yan lag du ldan pa/ /rnam gsum 'phrugs par 'byung ba yin/ /lhag pa'i don mchog gang yin pa/ /dngos rnams nyid na dngos med pas/ /rtog pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /de nyid rang gsal mi g.yo ba/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyings nyid de/ /dbyings la dbyengs ni rnam par sbyor/ /shes rab dbyengs nyid sbyor ba yis/ /byang chub rdo rje thig le yin/ /de yang so sor rtog sgom dang / /mi dmigs shin tu mi dmigs dang / /rjes su mi dmigs rim pa yis/ /mi gnas mi rtog zlas sems med/ /rang bzhin ngang gis bdag med pas/ /bya byed gnyis ka mi dmigs phyir/ /mkha' ltar 'du byed kun bral ba/ /bsam med 'dug la sgom zhes brjod/ /'du shes gang du'ang ma zhugs na/ /'dod chags med par 'du 'bral med/ /de ltar de ltar mnyam 'jog tshe/ /gnas dang spyod lam sgrib pa rnams/ /nor bar zin na mi phrog par/ /bya phyir mdo tsam brjod par bya/ /dmigs pa rjed dang bying rgod drug /rtsol dang mi rtsol byed pa dang / dogs pa log pa bcu gcig dang / /thun mong bdun de bco brgyad do/ /de bzhin g.yeng ba rnam drug ste/ /ngo bos g.yeng ba rnam shes lnga/ /phyi rol yul lngar 'pho bas g.yeng / /bying rgod ro myong nang yin te/ /gzhan phyir dge spyod mtshan ma'o/ /snyoms 'jug 43—984

gzhan nam theg pa gzhan/ /de'i lugs la sems 'phro yin/ /nga'o snyam pas snyoms 'jug pa/ /gnas ngan len par the tshom med/ /dran 'byung rjes su 'brang ba dang / /'gog dang ther zug phyal pa dang / /ched du gsum 'chos yod la byed/ /myong dang 'du shes gnas dmigs dang / /sbud dang mngon byed re ba dang / /sgrib pa lnga bcu rtsa yan lag /'jig rten dang po bsam gtan bzhi/ /snyoms 'jug bzhir gol sa dgu ste/ /ther zug chad pa'i phyin ci log /bya ba mang la 'byung skyen zhing / /ngang thung 'khrug dang du bshad thos//'khor zhing kha dog mthong ba dang / /khams las gyur pa'i cha yang shes/ /de yis 'gro nyal 'dug sdod dang / /longs spyod tshe na'ang rnal 'byor bral/ /'u tshe dur kun nya slang gnyid/ /skam chags tshong sems spre spyod rkyen/ /de ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad ston pa'am/ /so sor cung zad blta bya 'am/ /yang na rang 'byung rang zhir bya/ /ji ltar byis pa shes 1ma phye/ /bya byed mang por g.yeng bar gnas/ /bya byed mang pos bdag med pas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang sgyur nas/ /mtshan ma mnyam pa'i dbyings su gnas/ /dgag dang bsgrub pa gang 2la yin/ /cung zad khams kyi cha nyams pa/ /mi gsal mthong dang mi 'jug rtsogs/ /zin nas spyod lam dga' rten dang / /mthun pa'i cho gas gso bar bya/ /spyod lam rnal du ma spyor bas/ /so mthas chod na dor bya zhing / /dran pa'i thag pas bsdam bya ste//rnam pa kun tu mi nyams bya'o/ /de ltar nong rtson yun ring bar/ /gnas pa'i gdon mthar 'phel ba 'am/ /g.yo thob goms bstan mthar phyin pa/ /mu lngas yongs su rdzogs nga/ra 'gyur/ /gang zag gzar po'i chu gnas tshe/ /43—985

kun rtags goms pa'i rdza mkhan gyis/ /mi sdod 'gro bas skyo bar byed/ /de tshe mgo la me 'bar bzhin/ /cung zad yod la de dag nyung / /de tshe dal bus 'byung 'jug sring / /de goms ched du byed sogs dang / /btang snyoms dang po blang ①bar bya/ /ngo bo lta bur mi sgul bar/ /thun kyang nus na sun mi bya/ /ro myong dor bas de mthar phyin/ /shugs snang mthong la dga' brod med/ /gnyis pa bar 'ga' 'chor thob la/ /khams dang tshor ba rgyu rtags dor/ /shin tu yun rings brtson pa yis/ /gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur/ /bdag dang gzhan phyir bya ba kun/ /slob g.yo nas bzung lnga'i bar/ /rnam par rtog med tshul kyis ni/ /thams cad kun la chags med rol/ /spyod dgu dor ba'i cig cha yang / /mi dmigs mthun pas spyod ces bya/ /'gro 'ong med las 'gro dang 'ong / /'gro 'ong nyid na 'gro 'ong med/ /gnas pa med las thams cad gnas/ /gnas pa nyid na gnas pa med/ /longs spyod med las thams cad spyod/ /spyod pa nyid na spyod pa med/ /nyams pa med spyod chags mi bya/ /mi 'gog mi zin tshogs gnyis ldan/ /bdag phyir kun la mi dmigs pa/ /rnal 'byor myur thob the tshom med/ /'gro nyal 'dug sdod longs spyod tshe/ /de ltar spyod pas chos nyid du/ /byin brlabs sgol ba cig shos te/ /gang yang gzhan phyir sems la rdzogs/ /gzhung las grags pa'i spyod pa rnams/ /skye bo kun gyis spyad gsungs pas/ /mos slob ci rmos rkyen mthong na/ /de dag shes goms bzhi las spyod/ /shes 'jug kun kyang gzhan don du/ /las bzhi spyod cing bsgrub dbang tshe/ /lam kun skad cig chas sgoms nas/ /spyod pa'i 'khor lo mos sgom zhing / /rang bzhin phab rdzogs 43—986

mched mnyen nas/ /nus pa'i byin ldan rdzogs par byed/ /de tshe sdom pa thams cad kun/ /mos slob mi stong srung mod kyang / /khyad par ting 'dzin dam tshig ldan/ /dam tshig dam tshig ces bya ba/ /logs na yod pa ma yin te//rang gi rta ba dam tshig yin/ /mi gtong phyir na dam zhes bya/ /sngar ldan de'ang 'dir goms byed/ /de bas rang sems rtogs byas te/ /le lo g.yeng ba yongs spangs la/ /nga dang bdag med mnyam par bsrung 1/ /de bzhin nyid las 'da' mi byed/ /de bzhin nyid ldan dam pa de/ /de las 'das na tshig par 'gyur/ /snga ma snga mar rdzogs byas pa/ /gong ma gong ma rgyud ldan pas / /yongs su 'phar gyi sngon spyod min/ /'phar bas spyod kun mngon du sgyu / /de bas so so'i lta bzhi las/ /spyod sogs nam mkha'i yul 'dra'o/ /zhing khams dbang po sa khams bzhin/ /stobs ni stobs ldan rtsal bsgyid 'dra'o//de lcar 2bya byed med srings na/ /lus ngag sems la drod 'byung ste/ /bzod pa 'phra mo thob pa dang / /'gyu ba'i dbugs la dbang thob dang / /don la snal du 'phebs pa ni/ /nges par drod gsum thob pa'o/ /gzhan du rdul phran phyi rol dang / /zla tshes la sogs mtshan ma mthong / /rig pa rlungs su 'bab pa dang / /'dod pa'i yul la mi 'gro zhing / /'phro 'gyur dag la mi nga ba//phyi nang chags yul zhen pa chung / /snga bas spags pa nyams su 'byung / /gzhan yul thugs sems phrogs pa dang / /chos brgyad mnyam rtsogs phal cher 'byung / /de yang dbye thob stan rims kyis/ /kun tu 'khor bar 'byung ba yin / /gul ljong smin pa'i rigs de la/ /pha mas khyim thab ltas/ bstan nas/ /brod pas bsu zhing zang zing dag /don du gnyer la brtson par byed/ /de (3—987

bzhin rnal 'byor sde tshol ba/ /drod rtags mthong ba'i brod tshul gyi/ /shin tu lam la brtson byed 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di dag rjes su bstan/ /phyi ma'ang lam gyi stobs cha las/ /rtags sngon rdzu 'phrul snang bar 'gyur/ /de la snga ma phyi nang ste/ /phyi rol zad par skye mchog sngos/ /mthong dang pad+mo 'od sogs mthong / /nang du bzod thob bye brag dang / /chu lnga rgyun las bags kyis bcad—/ /mi phrogs dhimyo grag dga' brod med/ /shugs snang brgyad po mthong ba 'byung / /bco brgyad bdud yul cha yang 'byung / /mngon par shes pa rnam pa drug /las kyi zag pa yod med pa/ /sngon la dmigs pa'i mngon shes dang / /yongs su rdzogs pa'i mngon shes dang / /bar chad med pa'i mngon shes so/ /dmigs pa 'gag dang 'phel ba dang / /nyi shu lnga sogs yul khams mthong / /gling grangs mthong thos rim pas phye/ /phyi ma stong gsum brgya yul dang / /stong gsum stong sogs yul 'gyur sogs/ /stong gsum stong phrag bcu rdul snyed/ /grangs med brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul/ /de snyed yul 'gyur rgyal ba dang / /mnyam pas phye bas lam rdzogs yin/ /de bas rgyu'i sems dpa' dang / /skal mnyam phyir na brjod pa'i tshul/ /shes pa'i khyad par dgongs pa yi/ /bzhi yis phye bas rgyu 'bras nges/ /'di tshe rdzu 'phrul rjes brtan dang / /chos snang kun brjod cig car la/ /rdzogs kyi 'di tshe 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /nyams thar bzhi char 'byung srid do/ /rnal 'byor rnams la rmi lam yang / /gcer bur 'byung zhing dri ma dag /byang chub chen po'i mchod rten mthong / /dam pa mthong dang dam pa yis/ /sras dang spun dgongs byin brlob phyir/ /rmi lam mtshan mar bla ma mgon/ /snang bas dbang bskur byin 43—988

rlob sogs/ /lam du 'jug pa lnga byed cing / /bar chad legs nyes rtson lung ston/ /de 'ang bdud dang cha dbye ste/ /byin rlob lung ston ltar snang ba/ /'byung bas nyes byed bdud 'byung phyir/ /bdud dang cha btags kun tu ces/ /bar chad gsal phyir de dag kun/ /bla ma nyid las gzhan du min/ /de bzhin nyid du mthong goms na/ /dge dang mi dge gnyis su med/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma yongs mi 'dzin/ /rang bzhin ye nas 'od gsal ba'i/ /dge sdig med par shin tu bde/ /bde dang mi bde gnyis su med/ /ye shes chags med rnam par dag /thams cad dbyer med ye shes yin/ /sems nyid dang bas a rab bde/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad la/ /gtsang dang che ba'i blo ma 'dzin/ /thams cad chos nyid ro gcig pas/ /gnyis su med par shin tu bde/ /shes rab che chung ting 'dzin gyis/ /thams cad ma nor gzhung lugs bzhin/ /'khor ba ma spangs sdug bsngal med/ /gnyis med zil pas a rab bde/ /thams cad ma lus cig pa'i ngang / /lta dang lta ba gnyis ka med—/ /ye shes sgron ma steng ba stini/ /phyogs bcu zhing khams thams cad mthong / /'di dag pha rol gnyis med phyir/ /'gro dang 'ong bar bya ba min/ /yan lan stobs chen ma mchongs par/ /phyogs bcu'i stong khams thams cad gnan—/ /'di tshe spyod yul 'gyur mthong na/ /g.yeng gsal stong nyid ngang la 'dug /dran pas las kyi rgyun bcad de/ /'dod khams lha mi theg chen sbyor—/ /yang na gsang ba'i gser sgrom du/ /mtshon gang 'od dang zla ba'i hūṃ//ring po brtsegs pa mig thob nas/ /rlung gi 'phro 'dus 'od brdal 'dug /snang stong dbyer med rnal 'byor mthu/ /mngon byas lhag pa'i chos skur sbyor/ /43—989

'bras bu nyid la lam phyir te/ /phyogs mthun brjod kyi ris ma yin/ /stong pa chen po'i rnal 'byor bstan pa'i le'u ste/ gsum pa'o// //chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal te/ /snying rje chen po'i rnal 'byor bshad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i lus nyid kyis/ /yan lag sgo nas shes par gyis/ /sngon du stong goms rnal 'byor pas/ /khams gsum thugs rjes bzung ba'i phyir/ /yan lag brgyad sngon bzhin byas nas/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i snying rje sgoms/ /bdag nyid dri ma gsal ba dang / /stong pa'i mdud pa gshig pa dang / /gdul bya sa la dgod pa dang / /phyag rgya cig pa'i sgyur bya zhing / /rnal 'byor 'di nyid gnyer ba dang / /bden pa gnyis su mi stong phyir/ /rnal 'byor 'di la gnas byas te/ /'jug pa'i thun mtshams dus kyis bya'o/ /gang gis khams gsum 'das pa'i chos/ /thugs rje chen po'i ye shes su/ /mthong thos myong reg tshor ba'ang / /so sor brtag rgyu'am rjes la thob/ /de yis ma lus chos so cog /snying po yod pa ma yin te/ /sgyu ma mig g.yor sprul pa dang / /mig rgyu 'ja' tshon chu zla bzhin/ /bdag dang 'gro ba ngo bo gcig /gsal dang rtags pas tha dad phyir/ /cig dang tha dad gnyis med pas/ /bya med bya ba 'gog med par/ /mthong ba ma shor tsam du bya/ /rjes sam rtog spyod sngon 'gro bya/ /de bas gnyis goms sgyu goms pas/ /dran pa'i spyi blugs ye shes gsal/ /sngon du btang ba gang yang med/ /nam mkha' nam mkha' ji bzhin du/ /lus ngag sems dang chos thams cad/ /gang na'ang mi gnas mi dmigs pa/ /dmig ①g.yor tshul du sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' la ni nam 43—990
