mkha' sgom/ /thams cad thabs kyi mtshan nyid de/ /thabs la thabs ni rnam par sbyor/ /thabs chen thabs las byung ba'i/ /des ni byang chub rdo rje'i mchog /thams cad du ni ye shes gsal/ /ye shes de ni ma yin pa/ /chos 'ga' tsam yang yod min pas/ /gdung 'dra ma sgral dus cig bsgral/ /bsod chen snying rje'i rang bzhin te/ /mi 'dod phan 'dogs ①byams chen po/ /mi 'gyod dga' mchog bral med snyoms/ /tshangs pa'i rgyu bzhi dus gcig rdzogs//mngon par gdung ba de la med/ /de phyir rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dang / /dus dang rang bzhin 'khrul pa dang / /tshul kyis nyams dang ngo bo dang / /btson ra lta bu brgyad la dmigs/ /de yis cig shes bzhi 'byung bas/ /pha rol phyin dang mtshungs ma yin/ /de dag ngo bo nyid stan pa'ang / /rnam grangs bzhin du 'jug ②pa ste/ /don dam rnal 'byor ngo bo yis/ /phye bas zung 'gyur nges tshig 'byung / /de la log rtog sgyu ma ni/ /chos dang bdag dang dngos po rnams—/ /ngo bo yod la sogs rtags pas/ /rtog pa sgyu ma'i rlung 'gyur ba/ /skye dang mi bden slu bas 'grub/ /rten cing 'byel pa'ang shing rta bzhin/ /'jig rten rnam rtog gzugs brnyan phyir/ /sgyu ma lta bur rkyen las skyes/ /'phral snang bya ba kun kyang byed/ /rtog can rnams la mthun par snang / /gzugs brnyan 'dra phyir brtags pas dbe+en/ /de phyir thams cad rdzun pa tsam//ming las dngos med 'dod pa min/ /yang dag nyid du grags so cog /gnyis snang nyid na gang min pas/ /sems phyir ci yang rgyu med shar/ /snang la ngo bo nges med cing / /ji ltar bltas par snang ba ltar/ /snang bzhin ther zug chad dang bral/ /rgyal ba'i sku 'ang ma skyed par/ /rig pa'i ye shes sgyu 43—991

mar shes/ /khams gsum pa 'ang de bzhin pa/ /thabs chen sgyu ma kun ngo bo/ /ye shes la ni ye shes rol/ /ye shes rol pa nyid kyang gsog /rgyal ba mngon 'byung skyob pa dang / /byen brlabs ston pa'ang de bzhin te/ /rgyu rkyen rags pa med pa'i phyir/ /sgyu ma rdo rje brtsan po mchog /'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas snang / /'dus byas sna tshogs rdo rje nyid/ /yin phyir ngo bos tha dad min//dman pa rnal du goms byed tsam/ /'gro la skad cig gnyis mi 'chang / /rgyud cig ma 'gags ma skyes pas/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang rig nyid/ /ye shes sgyu mar mi g.yogs la/ /chu dang zla ba ji bzhin du/ /mtshungs par gsal bar ngo bor brjod/ /sems las ma rtogs chos med phyir/ /ye shes sgyu ma gzhan na med/ /sgyu ma nyid kyi chags bral ba/ /tha snyad tsam du sgom zhes bya/ /mi mthun sgrib pa'i dmigs gzung ba/ /rgyu dang ngo bo nyes pa ni/ /ma goms pa dang 'grus byed pas/ /me dang du ba'i tshul bzhin du/ /bdag du 'dzin pa rnam gnyis kyis①/ /ting 'dzin bsgrib pa 'byung bar byed/ /sngon du ji bzhin nyid bstan mod/ /mtshams sbyor snying rje g.yung min pas/ /brjod kun 'bring dang nyung bar 'byung / /skye spangs goms pas tha mal dkon/ /'on kyang 'di nyid 'phro snyu dang / /ma nges sa phyogs mkhar bcas mthong / /zad par mthong na ma nges mdog /me chu rlung sa'i cha 'khrul pas/ /mi gsal mdog mthong khams 'khrul ltar/ /sa g.yos mthong ba'ang cha dbye'o/ /sprin dang ling thog mun pa bzhin/ /gang de gzhung las grags pa'i skyon/ /phra rags cha yis sgyu ma'i don/ /mi gsal shin tu bul bar byed/ /sngon bzhin rtog pa'i nad bcos pa/ /shes bzhin so mtha' chod par bya/ /de ltar gyur 43—992

na kun mo'i tshul/ /ma gsal rang bzhin dang bar 'gyur/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma ci skyes kyang / /ye shes sgyu ma rang snang phyir/ /chags sdang re dogs mi 'byung ste/ /ye shes sgyu ma gzhan du min/ /de ltar ma ldan gang dag gis/ /tshor nas lo rgyud bcad pas zhi/ /yang na rtog pa'i gnas yul blta/ /de mthong mun pa rnam dag spangs/ /'dod min kha dog mthong ba ni/ /'byung ba bzhi'i gnyen pos gzhol/ /sngon bzhin sngar 'brangs phyis sngon byed/ /de ltar rang bzhin rkyen gyis skyes/ /tshor na thog ma'i nyes bsams te/ /skyo ba skyed la dor dran bcing/ /brod pas 'jug cing gzengs bstod bya/ /de lta de ltar brtson 'gyur ba'i/ /skabs su ye shes rnal 'byor nyid/ /'phel ba'ang g.yo thob goms pa dang / /bstan mthar 'gro ba ngo bo la/ /med kyang rab rim dag chas brjod/ /'bo dgyes thim pas ru drag chu/ /cung zad thun kyi sum char yod/ /bzhi cha lnga char de med thob/ /thun kyang nus shing gsal ldan na/ /chu klung dal 'bab tshul bzhin no/ /sgo rten rdzas ltar ①rtog rlung gis/ /mi bsgul ②bzhi la gnas pa'o/ /dbang po mngon sum gang byas pa/ /bskyed du bya med phyir mtha' 'o/ /snying rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pas/ /srid gsum sgyu ma 'dra bar ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub mkhas pas shes/ /'gro ba'i ched du go bsgos te/ /'gro ba de ltar snga nas shes/ /log par rtogs brtags rnam dag cing / /ye shes dbyings las mi gzhan cing / /thugs rje chen pos 'brel pas na/ /'gro drug dus gnas ma lus snang / /rjes su 'jug pa'ang de bzhin shes/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings sna tshogs mang po thabs su snang / /thabs nyid rgyu ma mig yor chu zla gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /de nyid rang rig ye 43—993

shes chags med sna tshogs snang / /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa mchog gi gnas gyur pas/ /ji ltar dpyad kyang zad med gnyis grub sgrib mi 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs chen mchog la ye nas rol pa yin/ /byang chub sems su rgyu gcig pas—/ /rtsa ba'i snying rje chen po 'byung / /sangs rgyas sems can cig rtogs na—/ /snying rje chen po skye zhes bya/ /brdal chen blo ni kun tu snang / /thabs chen kun mdzad 'od gsal byams/ /thams cad dgyes mdzad dbyings ma gdungs①ske/ /sems can ma lus thams cad la/ /snying rje thag pa ma chad par/ /nyon mongs lam las sgrol byed cing / /byams pa dag gis mnyes par gyis/ /de bzhin 'khor ba'i btson ra la/ /snying rje chags pa cher bskyangs nas/ /nyon mongs 'dam nas 'dren par byed/ /snying rje chen po skyo ba med/ /de bzhin skye bo phal pa rnams la②/ /las kyi sgrib pas ma gos shing / /thams cad mngon par sangs rgyas par/ /dga' ba dag la 'gyod ma byed/ /sems can nga dang bdag med la/ /thugs rje gnyis rtogs mi 'byed de/ /bu gcig 'dra bar blo gzhag bya/ /thams cad dri ma med par bya/ /sngon rdzogs rkyen bral sngon bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor nyid la gzhan don rdzogs/ /dmigs pa bdun gnyis gdul bya dang / /ngo bo las dang phan yon gyis/ /phyogs btang med de thun mong gi/ /chen po dag las slar 'gyur yin/ /bdag phyir spyod yul thams cad kun/ /ye shes sgyu ma rang snang phyir/ /phyi nang sgrib med gsal ba'i ngang / /ye shes blo bstan shin tu bde/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad la/ /gtsang dang rme ba'i blo ma 'dzin/ /thams cad ye shes ro gcig pas/ /gnyis su med pas shin tu bde/ /de bas spyad dang mi spang len//43—994

'dod yon la sogs ye shes rol/ /thub chen ston pa'i spyod yul ni/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /chos rnams thams cad dmigs su med/ /ye shes sgyu ma cir yang 'grub/ /zag med zag pas rtog pa na/ /dag par ma gyur gang yang med/ /ye shes ma bcos kun tu gsal/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'o/ /de phyir spyod lam thams cad kun/ /sgyu ma ye shes 'da' mi bya/ /rtsa ba yan lag thams cad kun/ /snga ma bzhin te nus pa 'phel/ /de ltar sgyu ma thob goms pas/ /'khor ba'i chos la tshad med pa'i/ /byang chub sems kyis 'phrogs par 'gyur/ /ma 'khrul 'khrul la ya mtshan skye/ /don med 'dug la de bzhin te/ /rnam gsum lnga las 'phel bar snang / /nyams rims 'phel ba'i mtha' rtags ni/ /shing bal lta bur yang ba dang / /lus kyi bzod pa 'phra thob ring / /khams bde mi bde snyoms pa dang / /phal cher yod cing chos brgyad snyoms/ /de bas mang dang 'bring la snyam/ /kun kyang lnga las grangs 'phel zhing / /ngo bo gsal la yun ring po'o/ /lhan cig drug 'dug phyi rol gyi/ /mngon shes 'phel dang cung zad bstan/ /gzhan pa'ang shes pa cung zad 'byung / /de bas rnal 'byor bstan par bya/ /'di tshe spyod yul thams cad kun/ /rmi lam du'ang sgyu mar mthong / /snying rje gang yang mthong ba dang / /byin rlob dbang bskur mang mthong dang / /bdud kyi spyod yul mtshan mar mthong / /de sogs snang yang chags mi bya/ /snying rje chen po goms byas nas/ /rnal 'byor don chen rtogs pa yis/ /dus mtha' med par de ltar sgom/ /yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /spyod yul sangs rgyas nyid dang cig /rgyu spyod bsod nams tshogs chen ldan/ /de ming 43—995

ma chags ye shes che/ /rnal 'byor phyi ma btsal ba med/ /nyi 'od sa bon dkyus dgra bzhin/ /'pho ba med bzhin 'gyur snang tshe/ /sgyu ma bstan byas las rgyun spyod/ /'phel bas lam dang skol mi 'gyur/ /phyi ma'ang lan grangs gzhan dag la/ /mi ldog dbang sgyur rigs su nges/ /lam 'dir cha skyen rdzogs bsgrub na/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kun ldan pa'i/ /dbang phyug chen po'i gnas nyid du/ /mngon du 'byung bar the tshom med/ /mi ①rtogs le lo snyoms las byas/ /don ma grub par ngan song 'gro/ /snying rje chen po'i rnal 'byor bstan pa'i le'u ste/ bzhi pa'o// //gnyis med ngang la phyag 'tshal nas/ /phyag rgya cig pa'i rnal 'byor bshad/ /gang dag rdo rje gsum sgom pa'ang / /snga par 'das pa'i lus kyis shes/ /spyi'i sa las sngon rdzogs pa yis/ /'di nyid sgyu mthar mngon bya zhing / /lugs sogs mtshan ma'i phyag rgya gzhag /de la yan lag brgyad sngon bzhin/ /'bras bu yongs su rdzogs bya zhing / /spras pa'i rgyu yis thob bya dang / /rgyu stong rtog zhen dbang du bya/ /rtog pa'i phung sogs gnas bsgyur zhing / /gzhan dag smin par bya ba'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor shin tu gces/ /de la 'jug thabs rnam gnyis te/ /sems sbyang ba dang lhar bskyed pa'o/ /snga ma gdams ngag shes rab kyis/ /'jug pa'i gzhi'o 'di nyid de/ /a/ rab tu brtan 'gyur a dkar las/ /shin tu 'phra ba'i a rnams spro/ /phyogs bcu gang bar gsal 'gyur nas/ /bsdus kyang 'phel 'grib med par bstan/ /de la'am yang na thugs yig ste/ /de bzhin yang nas yang goms nas/ /phyi 43—996

nang snod bcud hūṃ du bsnyu/ /yan lag rnam shes ye shes phyir/ /yi ge hūṃ la shin tu bsdu/ /dri'i dmig gis bltar yod par/ /'dris nas bdag gzhan don phyir spro/ /mchod don rdzogs nas slar bsdus te/ /hūṃ nyid mi dmigs dbyings su gsal/ /goms par bya ba shin tu gces/ /phyi ma tshangs pa srin po'i tshul/ /rdzogs par bya ba zung du 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs bya ba'ang / /gang bsgrub yi ge so so ste/ /spyir ni gang bsgoms kun tu 'dra/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'dus/ /'di ltar de nyid goms bya ba/ /sngon du mi dmigs ngang nyid las/ /a dkar gsung gi phyag rgyar 'bar/ /shin tu 'tsher bar gsal sgoms la/ /thams cad ar ni gyur par sgom/ /de bzhin nyid du 'dris gyur nas/ /a las ma'i dkyil 'khor spro/ /a ma gsal bar 'byor gyur nas/ /hri gsal pad+ma chags med sgom/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas bsgom/ /nyi zla gdan dang gzhal yas khang / /thams cad bsdus shing gsal bar bsgom1/ /de dkyil yi ge hūṃ gnas par/ /mthing kha 'tsher la gsal ba yi/ /'od zer 'phro ba rnam par bsgom/ /'od 'phros dbyings su bslar bsdus nas/ /shin tu rdo rje 'phra bar sgom/ /rdo rje 'od 'phros gsal 'bar nas/ /dbyings su yang ni bstem par bya/ /de nyid sems dpa'i sgur gyur pas/ /shin tu 'phra zhing 'dus par bsgom/ /de bzhin gnyis med gsal gyur nas/ /sgu gcig rdo rje dril 'bar bsgom/ /de bzhin nyid du gyur pa dang / /dbu gsum phyag drug nyid du sgom/ /rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri 'bar//rin chen pad+ma dril bu 'bar/ /'phro ba'i gzhal yas gdan dang ldan/ /gnas gcig ye shes sems dpa' sgom/ /spyi mgrin tsi ta gnas gsum du/ /43—997

byin brlabs rdo rje gsum sgom bya/ /dbu'i gnas lngar yi ge lnga/ /ye shes lnga dbang rdzogs pas rgyan/ /blo'i shes rab che chung gis/ /yang na phyag rgya chen po ste/ /chu las nya ldang ji bzhin du/ /bdag nyid phyag rgya chen po ste/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dag tu sgom/ /gzhal yas gdan sogs snga ma bzhin/ /yan lag lha dgu'ang de bzhin no/ /de la shin tu goms par bya/ /rag sha cha lugs 'dzin pa'ang / /rims dang gcig car mngon bzhin te/ /rdo rje cho ga kha dog dang / /gzhal yas la sogs bsgyur te bsgom/ /thugs kyi rigs gzhan mos pa'ang / /'bru bzhi sbyangs te gdan gnas cigasti /rdo rje rnam gsum rigs su bsgyur④/ /sku dang yan lag de bzhin no/ /rim pa thob pa'am cig car ba/ /brgyad mthar phyin phab ltar bskyed la/ /mchod pa'i byin rlabs skur bsgoms te/ /yan lag lhan rdzogs mchod stod bya/ /yan lag ma nyams sngags 'das pa'ang / /bskyon bcu spangs te rnam gsum gyi/ /bzlas pa grags bzhin rdzogs par bya/ /spro bsdus bdag dang gzhan don rdzogs//phyi nang gsang ba gang mos su/ /bzlas brjod tshad du phyin par bya/ /dub na ye shes thig le blta/ /nyal bas nad par de nyid las/ /hūṃ sogs bsgyur te skur rdzogs pas/ /sngon bzhin brtson pas 'dris par bya/ /gzhal yas lha'i dkyil 'khor yang / /sems kyi cho 'phrul rang snang phyir/ /lha la dmigs med rig pa nyid/ /bzhi rdzogs sku de rang snang ba'o/ /rgyal ba rgyal ba rnams kyi sku//kun tu rin chen lta bu ste/ /rdzogs par rtog med re ba skong / /zad 'phel 'gro 'ong nye ring med/ /phyag rgya yod med grol ma grol/ /bdag phyir phyogs med blang dor med/ /bying rgod snyoms tsam mnyam gzhag pa'o/ /mi mthun 43—998

'di tshe dmigs bzung ba/ /yi ge nas gzung rdzogs pa'i bar/ /thun mong kun tu 'byung rags 'phra/ /tha ma 'di la so mtha' gcad/ /khyad par rab rib mag mog drib/ /gang tshod dmigs pa tshad dang tshul/ /grangs dang cha lugs mdog dbyibs dang / /kha dog 'ba' zhig rim par nub/ /de ltar gyur pa tshor bya ste/ /'du byed rlung gis bskyod mi bya/ /de ltar zin pa de dag kun / /khyad par gsum la'ang sgyu steng 'dug /rjes las thob pa ma sun 'dug /drug pa ji ltar sngos cher bya/ /bdun pa dbyibs dang sre bar bya/ /brgyad la spyi men bye brag gnas/ /bya min las kun dor byas te/ /spyod lam skyon rnams gtang bar bya/ /gnyis la khugs mod rgya cig la/ /goms pas 'phel ba gong ma bzhin/ /smig rgyu du ba srin me khyer/ /mar me nyi ma'i tshul dang sbyar/ /btang snyoms rims dang brtson pa dag /skabs kyis blang dor nyams las shes/ /'bru bzhis rtag tu mtshams bcad de/ /bdag nyid chen po'i tshogs mchod bya/ /nang gi sbyin sreg blang bar bya/ /gzugs sogs thig le'am lha mo drug /dbang po yul dang sbyor ba bya/ /zhi khro gang yin skabs kyis bsgyur/ /bdag nyid chen po'i mchod pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad la/ /dga' ba chen pos khyab par 'gyur/ /'gro 1nyal 'dug sdod longs spyod kyang / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal tshe na 'ang / /theg chen phyag rgya mi btang ste/ /sngon bzhin spyor bas myur du 'grub/ /rgyu 'bras mtshams sbyar bar skabs kun/ /chos spyod dgu'i spros pa dor/ /rgyud la ldan yang blang bya min/ /mtshan ma'i g.yeng ba yin phyir ro/ /rdo rje gsum sgo phyag mi bya/ /phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor spyod pa la/ /43—999

don ldan ma nyams dag byas nas/ /brtson 'grus cher bskyed myur bar 'grub/ /lha la lha rol bsod nams te/ /spyod lam chags gnyis med pa'o/ /gzhan phyir 'phro 'du rim par rdzogs/ /rkyen dang phrad pa'ang mi 'dor te/ /dus min gzhan phyir spros pa'ang len/ /gang 'tsham par don rdzogs byed/ /bdag phyir thun mong mchog bsgrub rnams/ /'di bstan rnal 'byor the tshom med//'di tshe sa gzhi kun ldan no/ /gsung gi gzhi las lhun bya zhing / /phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor du/ /spyod yul kun tu bsdam par bya/ /phyi nang gsang ba shin tu 'phel/ /thob dang bstan pa'i char 'gyur te/ /longs spyod zhen pa med pa dang / /dbang po yul du goms pa dang / /rgyu ba chad dang thun mtshams thal/ /drod kyi bye brag kun dang ldan/ /rtags chen goms mthar mtshan ma lnga/ /dngos su mthong dang rdo rje gsum/ /skye mched mthong ba mtshan ma ste/ /grub pa dang po rtags zhes bya/ /dmigs pa rgya chen mngon shes kyang //grangs dang yul gyis bla na med/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mngon shes kyang / /g.yo thob 'byung bar the tshom med/ /lus ngag sems mthu'i rtag rnams kyang / /cho 'phrul bzhi tshul g.yo thob byed/ /gzhan yang sngon pas gsal bstan pa/ /rnal 'byor lhag pa'i stobs kyis thob/ /spyod lam nyid du nyes legs kun/ /gsal bar 'byung zhes shin tu bstan/ /bsam gtan 'bad pa bzang ba yin/ /bsgrub pa pos ni rtag tu mthong / /sangs rgyas mthu dang mtshungs par mthong / /sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /bdag med par ni myur du mthong / /sems dpa' chen po khams gsum pas/ /mchod par byed pa nges mthong ngo / /ye shes chen po 'od dri'i gzugs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems pa ①yis/ /43—1000

'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis/ /rtag tu mchod pa byas pa mthong rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs chen dang / /grangs chen rdo rje mchog dag tu/ /rmi lam dag tu rab gzugs mthong / /grags chen rdo rje gsang ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa' 'khor lo can/ /sangs rgyas chen po phyag 'tshal ba'i rmi lam 'di dag mthong 'gyur na/ /lus ngag sems kyi mthu las skyes/ /brgyad rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /lha yi bu mo yid 'ong dang / /khye'u dang bu mo dag mthong nas/ /de ni dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rnams/ /zhing na gnas pa nges par mthong / /thugs ni dgyes par gyur nas kyang / /chos mthong yid du 'ong la sogs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba'i sku/ /sems can kun gyis yongs bskor ba/ /bsam gtan rdo rje la gnas pa'i/ /dam tshig sbyor ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /sna tshogs kun bdag skyed mod tshal/ /lha'i bu la sogs pas brgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlab pa/ /bsam gtan dam tshig can kyis mthong / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /de ni mngon par dbang bskur mthong //rigs 'dzin rgyal po chen po yis/ /bskor ba byas pa de mthong ngo / /rdo rje las byung sna tshogs pa'i/ /rmi lam dri med de mthong na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /skye ba bla na med pa 'grub/ /gdol pa khyi'i sbyor ba sogs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas mthong nas ni/ /blo ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /sems kyi gnas ni grub par gsungs/ /yi ge phyag rgya rnams ①gnyis kyis/ /skye mched mthong ba de bzhin no/ /lha'i sku ni gsal bsgom na/ /bsod nams chen po thob par 'gyur/ /de nyid chu zla'i shes rab ni/ /ye shes tshogs ni rdzogs 43—1001

par gyur/ /bdag nyid lha dang mnyam spyor bas/ /yon tan chung yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /ye nas mnyam nyid sbyor bas su/ /lha nyid du ni rtag tu bsgom/ /bde gshegs kun dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /dkyil 'khor kun dang mnyam par 'gyur—/ /dkyil 'khor kun dang mnyam pa'i phyir/ /sku gsung ye shes lnga rdzogs 'grub/ /yi dam lha yi mtshan nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung rdo rje ①bdag po'i phyir/ /lha spangs ②dge sbyong don med 'gyur—/ /dam tshig bsrung dang sngags zlas dang / /phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad pa gzhi'i—/ /brtson 'grus che zhing brtan par bzung / /rnal 'byor brtson 'grus chung 'gyur na/ /mi 'grub nyen yang med par gsungs/ /ji ltar ral gri'i so la nan tan du/ /legs par ma bzung lag pa chod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin nan tan med pa'i gsang sngags la/ /phung ba'am yang na 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /de bas bar chad brtson med na/ /dper na sa bon tshig pa las//'bras bu 'dod pa dang 'dra ste/ /bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu med par dang / /mi khom 'khor bar brgyud par 'gyur/ /gang zhig zhal mthong mos pa yis/ /bsnyen bskur mchod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /mi dge mtshams med bco lnga sogs—/ /las ngan sbyangs te rigs la sbyor/ /gang gis mi rtag mthong na 'ang / /phyag rgya ma nyams gsal bzung ste/ /las kyi mi 'khor ①gang 'dod du//a yi rjostobs kyis bskul bar bya/ /rnam smin rigs la the tshom med/ /'on te 'am ni rim pa yis/ /de nyid bar phyir lan grangs gzhan/ /che 'am phyi ma'am gzhan thob nges/ /rnal 'byor las su rung rnams kyis/ /phyag rgya chen po rdzogs 'gyur zhing / /gsal ba'i yid gnyis med pa na/ /dkyil 'khor 43—1002

chen po 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ltar bsgom zhing 'grub byas na/ /'bras bu mngon du ma byung yang / /tshe rabs skye ba thams cad du/ /lha mi mtshan sdogs sdug bsngal sel/ /bde gshegs 'byung dang mi skol zhing / /theg pa sman la 'jug mi 'gyur/ /byang chub gzungs snal zhugs pa yin/ /de bas lam 'di 'bral mi bya'o/ /phyag rgya bcing ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u ste/lnga pa'o// //rang gi lha la phyag 'tshal te/ /spros pa'i 7rnal 'byor bshad par bya/ /spros pa bzhi po de lta bur/ /gzhan pa 'grol phyir rgyas par bshad/ /rnal 'byor rnam gsum mngon rdzogs nas/ /sa la sogs pa phyag rgyar byas/ /ri mo rgyu'am 'bur lugs sam/ /'jim pa las byas dkyil 'khor ni/ /lhag pa gzugs brnyan khung bu dngos/ /ye shes byin ldan rten par bya/ /ma hā ba lo a mṛ ༄ ta/ /dmar chen phyi nang mchod pa bkram/ /rol mo mchod sogs cha rkyen rnams/ /ji ltar 'os pa bzhin du bya/ /phyogs bcing brgyad kyi rim sdogs nas/ /las kyi lha'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs sngupar bya/ /bdud rtsi chus bsang bgegs bskrad 'dug /bsod nams yongs su sdogs bya zhing / /spyod yul byin gyis brlab pa dang / /'khor lo sa mthar dbyung ba dang / /tshogs la dus kyi bsgrub phyir sgom/ /dgug gtang bcing sgrol gso dang gsad/ /'pham rgyal ting 'dzin 'dis byed phyir/ /gang dag gdul bya ji snyed pa/ /spros pa'i las kyis gdon phyir ro/ /ci gnas spros pa'ang rnam gnyis te/ /rjes su mthun par zhi dang khro/ /de re re'ang tshul 43—1003

gnyis kyis/ /blo dang ldan par mtshan ston yin/ /snga ma rim dang cig car ba//che bas phyi ma bzhin 'jug pa/ /nyi zla gza' skar dus gcig ①tu/ /chu dkyil dang bar gsal ba bzhin/ /sku gsal skad cig 'od du 'bar/ /snying po brjod pas 'khor lo shar/ /de sngon bstan pa bzhir 'jug pa/ /mthong dang snga ma'i rnal 'byor stobs/ /thob pas shes bya bslab tshul dang / /du ma gcig gis gsal byed pa'ang / /ma bsgyur rnal ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'khor lo tshom bu grangs zhal phyag /dang po bco brgyad bzhi bcu gnyis/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rim par bslab/ /gnyis pa'ang bdag cag yab yum gnyis—/ /gnas pa'i 'khor lo gsal bya ste/ /gdan ldan dbus na bdag po gnas/ /de la sems dpa' khro bos bskor/ /bstan nas mdun rgyab sku gsung thugs/ /'khor lo rdzogs pa 'bru gsum brda'/ /mi'i dbang du tshom bu gsum/ /shin tu goms par bya ba yin/ /bstan na ②g.yas dang g.yon nyid du/ /yon tan 'phrin las dkyil 'khor gzhag /rnal 'byor dbang du tshom bu lnga/ /shin tu 'dris nas dus tshogs sbyar/ /gsum pa rtsa ba sku nyid du//bstan nas sku gsum gtso bor gsal/ /gsum tshor med na yon tan gsal/ /lnga rdzogs yab yum zung bstan nas/ /lnga po'i don spros bzhi bcu gnyis/ /ma bcos ngang gis gnas pa las/ /ye shes lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /yan lag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /de nyid yan lag spros bdag ste/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gsum 'phror 'gyur/ /stangs dbyal gnyis kyi phyag rgya dang / /sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor yang / /ri rab til 'bru'i tshul bzhin du/ /dpe byad mtshan kyis rnam spras pa'o/ /de ltar gtso mchog ldan byas nas/ /bya 43byed1004

byed rigs bzhi'ang stong sgom bya/ /bcu gnyis drug gis 'od 'phro 'bar/ /nyi khri bzhi stong dus cig 1gsal/ /phyogs bcu ma lus gzhal yas khang / /nyi zla gza' skar rgyan dang gdan/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor ma lus sgom/ /bsam yas lhun grub nyid la slob/ /bzhi pa cig zhal gsum phyag drug /bstan na gsum la'ang de bzhin te/ /lnga pa rjes su mthun goms nas/ /spyos pa'i zhal phyag sgogs gsal ba'o/ /bsgyur ba'i 'khor lo'ang de bzhin te/ /dang po lnga bcu brgyad goms nas/ /drug cu rtsa brgyad de bzhin te/ /dbus kyi he ru bzhi po la/ /sku gsung khro bo mdun rgyab gsal/ /de bstan 'khor dang bcas par bsgomabye / /sku gsung thugs la bstan byas nas/ /g.yas g.yon pa 'phrin las khro bo/ /yab yum gsal nas 'khor lo lha/ /rdzogs par sgoms gapa'i rims bzhin du/ /gang byas ma sun gyen du 'bar/ /rjes su mthun pas 'jigs byed kyang / /gabyug dang gnyis dang gsum bzhi lnga/ /yab yum mthar phyin 'khor lo'i chas/ /lnga bcu'i tshom bu gnas yul dang / /sgom slas chohūṃ chen brgya rtsa brgyad/ /yan lag bkod pa lnga bcu brgyad/ /chas lnga'i grangs ni nyis brgya 5dang / /dgu bcu'i lha rnams yan lag ldan/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gsum drug dang / /dgu dang bco brgyad kun ldan dang / /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhi bcu gnyis/ /dgu brgya stong brgyad brgya zhabs dang / /grangs med bar du slob byed pa/ /rims thabs brjod kyi spyod yul ni/ /nyi shu gcig dang dgu brgya dang / /grangs med mthar lam rim par ldan/ /de ltar ldan pa'i ting 'dzin gyes/ /zhugs slob mthar phyin bar skabs su/ /rang bzhin yul nas dbab bya ste/ /bzhugs shing stan 9sogs ldan byas te/ /13—1003

rdzas dang ting 'dzin rim ①bzhin mchod/ /bstod smad ④ldan nas bsnyen pa bya//bar skabs lhag ma'i gnas skabs nas/ /dam bsgrags bcol zhing las la dgye//'khor lo bsdu srung spyod lam kun/ /khro zhi man ngag gzhung bzhin bya/ /phung sogs dkyil 'khor lhar snang ba/ /rgya mtsho'i gzugs brnyan ji bzhin du/ /kun rngos rang rig lhar gsal ba/ /gcig dang du ma yongs kyis med/ /gsal la yul ni mi g.yo ba/ /rnal 'byor ngo bor rgyal bas gsungs/ /rang bzhin spyos pas rnal 'byor spros/ /de yang gdug 'dul khro zhis ①spros/ /'khor lo spros dang phyag rgya spros/ /tshom bu spros dang zhal phyag spros/ /kun nas spros phyir 'bras bu'ang spros/ /spros pas nyams gsal rnal 'byor sgra'o/ /'di tshe le lo rnam gnyis dang / /mtshan mtha' lnga dngos mthong 'dzin dang / /rnal 'byor bdud kyi yul mthong ba/ /sprul pa grangs med dgye ba mthong / /dam par mdun mthong dam par smra/ /rgyal bas gsungs kun gsal mthong dang //dus gsum gsal shes mthong ba dang / /rgyud drug lam gnas kun mthong na/ /de la snying rje'i shugs 'byung dang / /kun kyang gsal bar mthong ba dang / /ci la'ang thogs med 'gro ba dang/ /mkha' la sa gzhi 'dra 'dug dang / /rgyal bas phyag brkyang lung ston dang / /kun gyi skad du chos smra dang / /snod bcud ste gnas mthong ba dang / /stong gsum mnyam par bkod pa dang / /de nyid rang bzhin gsal snang dang / /las su rung bas thogs med dang / /dam pa'i don la sgom pa dang / /'jig rten gtso bos mchod 'byung rnams/ /rang bzhin rtogs na dam pa'i rtags/ /mi shes dga' brod byed pa bdud/ /khe dang grags pas phrogs pa dang / /sngags pa thob pas mtshan ma g.yengs/ /43—1006

re dang dogs pa cung zad yod/ /nga 'am nga zhes che bas rgyal/ /tha mal pa 'ang nyung la phra/ /rgyu ba'i gzung 'dzin bye brag shes/ /shes 'jug 'byor pas 'go thob cing / /zung du 'brel pas bskyed mthar phyin/ /'bras bu lam shes bstan pa yis/ /bya ba med pa'i brtson 'grus blang / /mtshan ma rang rig cho 'phrul pa/ /sems phyir mthong la re dogs med/ /dper na nam mkha' rang bzhin la/ /nyi zla gza' skar glog 'gyu dang / /'ja' tshon sprin mnga' 'khrul 'gyur yang / /nam mkha'i dbyings la 'gyur nyams med/ /chos kyi dbyings ni bsam yas par/ /sku gsung rmad 'byung ngo mtshar dang / /mtshan ma sna tshogs snang 'gyur yang / /de bzhin nyid la nyams 'gyur med/ /rnal 'byor stobs yon rdzogs 'gyur yang / /bdag gnyis med shes nga rgyal med/ /spyod yul mtshan ma gang mthong yang / /ye shes rang snang nyid du sbyar/ /snang byed khros pa'ang 'phel ba'i rims/ /bslab pa'i rim pa ji bzhin te/ /sngon brtan mod kyang 'di slob pa/ /ma goms dbang ni rnam lnga'o/ /gsum lnga lha gsal cung zad g.yo/ /bar chad 'byung ba'ang dang po'o/ /de gsal thun gyi bzhi cha gsum/ /gsal ba mi g.yo gnyis pa ste/ /thun kyang nub pa gsum pa'o/ /de nyid rkyen dbang mi 'gro ba/ /bzhi pa'o phyar par gnas pa yin/ /shin tu mi 'phrogs lnga pa ste/ /grangs la sbyar na mthar thal 'gyur/ /de bas nyams tshod zin pa zhes/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i lta spyod ni/ /ji ltar spyad kyang rang bzhin med/ /mkha' la bya chen lding ba bzhin/ /chu la rkyal chen 'phyo ba bzhin//mkha' la rlung chen 'phyo ba bzhin/ /rnal 'byor lta ba de ltar lta/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i spyod pa ni/ /thams cad kun la dbyer med spyod/ /bde ba'i 43—1007

ro mchog myong 'gyur te/ /de la su zhig chags par byed/ /spyod bzhin ma chags ye shes yin/ /bde ba mchog nyid bsod nams tshogs/ /de lta bu'i ngang la spyod/ /'di ni spyod pa rlabs chen yin/ /lta spyod ya char ma gyur par//sngags 'chang rnams kyi rtag tu dpyad/ /lnga bzhi'i spang bya rmad spyod kun/ /bdag dang gzhan phyir 'jol nyog ste/ /gang yang byas la ma mthong zhing / /tshogs 'gyur 'dam skyes bzhin spyod thabs/ /yan lag dbang po rnam shes kun//rnam smin oṃ du shes par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid du sgom/ /yang na khros pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom①/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs/ /rnam byun sum̐ du shes par bya/ /yum gyi dkyil 'khor nyid du sgom/ /yang na khro mo'i dkyil 'khor sgom/ /spyod yul lha dang lha mor rol/ /'dod yon lnga bo thams cad dang / /sna tshogs snang ba thams cad kun/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /gzugs mdzes lha dang lha mor brtag /thams cad kun tu bzang po yi/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams la/ /thogs pa med par sbyad bya ste/ /bsod nams tshogs chen yin par brtag /de bzhin gshegs pa lngar yang brtag④ /gzhan yang stong khams thams cad na/ /shes rab dbyings dang 'dod yon rnams/ /rab 'bring tha ma thams cad dpyad/ /dang du blang dang mi blang ba/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu dpyad/ /chags pa med par gyur pa dang / /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po ni/ /dam tshig mdo bshad nang nas 'byung / /spyod yul mthong thos thams cad kun/ /'gro dang 'dug dang nyal ba na/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pas/ /ma nyams pa'i dbyengs na gnas/ /shes rab mchog gis brtag tu dpyad/ /yang na 43—1008

dam tshig 'di lta bu/ /ji ltar spyad kyang sdom mi 'da'/ /thams cad ma lus sangs rgyas la/ /bsgrub cing srung bar bya ba med/ /dge dang mi dge gnyis kha med/ /de la bsrung du rdul tsam med/ /gzhan phyir dregs pa'i bsrungs 1 bya kun/ /gang ltar 'tsham par gda' mi byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bka' bshad pa'i/ /sdom pa'i rtsa ba thams cad kun/ /de bzhin nyid du ma srungs na//yag sha khro bo me dpal gyis/ /snying las drangs te khrag 'thungs nas/ /ngan song gsum du skye bar 'gyur/ /de'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med/ /de'i phyir lam bzhir ldog zag yod/ /shing bal lta bur shin tu yang / /dbugs kyi rgyu ba yun rings bral/ /rnal 'byor mkha' la gza' skar bzhin/ /gsal 'a/ mi g.yo spyod yul med/ /zhor las byung bas rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /'di zhes grangs kyi cha las 'das/ /las su rung ba'i rtags rnams kyang / /sngon byung stobs su 'phel ba dang / /khams snyoms rang lus bde bas rgyas/ /'du ba bzhi bral bzod thob tshe/ /mngon shes drug dang rtsa lnga rdzogs/ /rab 'bring cha yis yul khams gling / /tshun chad gsal zhing 'dul bar byed/ /tshogs drug dag pa'i stobs las gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul nyi shu cha g.yo thob/ /thams cad skad mthun chos ston rjes/ /sa g.yos chos snang byed pa dang / /yi ge sgrar byed kun brjod pa'o/ /'di dag mthong dang bco brgyad dang / /shugs snang brgyad mthong re dogs gzhag /rmi lam gcig dang chos mthun par/ /'byung ba gsal dang stan pas dbye/ /'byung ba lnga nyid rigs kyi yum/ /bzang po ltas su lung bstan kun/ /lam 'di rdzogs par 'byung ba yin/ /bsgrub pa'i rigs 'dzin lam 'di nyid/ /mthar phyin rigs kyi rgyu yin phyir/ /mtshan ma 43—1009

'byung ba'i sa yin te/ /bar chad med tshogs skabs su'ang 'di'o/ /phung po lnga nyid de bzhin gshegs/ /dbang po rnam shes byang chub sems/ /yul dus byang chub chen mo yin/ /bdag rtogs rnam bzhi khro bo yin/ /rtag chad mu bzhi khro mo'o/ /de sems rang rig nyid ces bya/ /de bzhin mnyam rdzogs lhun grub pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs dang ye shes lnga/ /rang 'byung chen po'i dkyil 'khor sgom/ /rtog gnyis bral ba'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /lha gsal dngos po med sgoms nas/ /mthong thos la sogs med pa'i tshul/ /rang rig ye shes gsal sgoms na/ /rang bzhin med las cir yang 'grub/ /rkyen gyis 'gyur ba'i dus byung na/ /spros pa gang yin gzung ba yis/ /las ngan lam zhes rgyun bcad nas/ /bar ma'am phyi mar gnyis sbyor 'dzin/ /gang zhig nus gzhan skabs med pa'o/ /'phen pa'i 'brel pas sa bon kyis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bde thob nas/ /gsum dang mi skol spyod pas thob/ /snyoms ①las med par brtson byas na/ /lam du rigs 'dzin thob pa yang / /chos nyid dam tshig smon mthu dang / /yan lag rdzogs par rigs 'dzin 'gyur/ /spros pa'i rnal 'byor rgyun chags pa'i/ /bsod nams ye shes longs spyod kyi/ /mun snang dug 'gyur ji bzhin du/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs mchog bsnyes/ /spros pa'i rnal 'byor la slob pa'i le'u ste/ drug pa'o// //dkyil 'khor gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bar chad med par sbyor ba yi//bsgrub pa dus kyi tshogs bshad bya/ /bar chad med pa'i lam bsgrub pa'ang / /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen dang / /bsgrub pa dang ni bsgrub chen pos/ /43byed1010

rdzogs par skabs 'dir shes par bya/ /'di yang lam bsgrub spyor ba yi/ /cha'i dang po bsnyen pa 'di/ /byang chub sems rtogs 'grus pa dang / /bsten pa'i dam pa yin pa'i phyir/ /sems chas snying rje man chad do/ /phyag rgya gsal ba nye bsnyen pa/ /de phyir gcig dang spros pa'o/ /bsgrub pa nyid ni bar chad med//dus kyi tshogs mtha' bsgrub chen len/ /mthar lam gang thob grub pa po/ /gsum pa mchod pa'i skabs su shes/ /gnyis pa gtso bo 'dir bstan pa/ /bzhi dang gzhung gis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga bzhi la/ /bsnyen bsgrub bzhi yis gzhung bsrangs pa'o/ /gang dag mos pa ji bzhin du/ /zhi dang khro bos bsgrub par bya/ /de la snga ma gnas dang dus/ /yo byad ston 'khor bsgrub pa po/ /bsgrub thabs phun sum tshogs pa yis/ /bzhi dang spyor bas gzhung rdzogs bya/ /de la spros pa mthar phyin pas/ /cho ga lnga ni rdzogs byas shing / /yo byad lnga ni rdzogs par ldan/ /sngags kyi yan lag lnga rdzogs pa'i / /rnal 'byor tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /nges par legs pa'i dgongs pa 'grub/ /ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo 1sdogs/ /gnyer lngan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ /man ngag drod 'chang brgyad 'chang ba/ /rnal 'byor mthar ldan shin tu bsten/ /ston pa mchod brtson rtogs pa gsal/ /dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ /ma nyams shes shing yo byad ldan/ /'khor gyis 'grub 'gyur mi ldan brlag /sde dpung chen pos mi tshugs shing / /sa dang bar snang shis pa dang / /lo rgyus rnam gnyis ldan pa dang / /yid 'ong sa brtsal rgyas par bya/ /rnyed nas tshom bu'i grangs bzhin du/ /che chung rkyen du 'tsham par bya/ /'khor khang phyi nang ldan pa'i/ /rin chen byug pas bsrungs 43—1011

pa dang / /rin chen spros pa'i gzhal yas khang / /yid 'ong bya ba shin tu gces—/ /tshes grangs yar gyi brgyad la rtsam/ /shin tu skar ma rgyal rnams la//byang chub spyod pa cher spyod bya/ /gsang chen dngos grub myur ba'i phyir/ /gza' ①skar shis pas blang bar bya/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang sgyur rigs kyi mchog bsgrub phyir/ /rnal 'byor brtson chas rims bzhin bsgrub/ /gos brgyan bza' btung gsang ba dang / /bsgrub pa'i yo byad lnga rnams dang / /dkyil 'khor yo byad mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dngos grub rten dang bar chad bzlog /yo byad dag par bsdu byas te/ /tsho gsum bcad la byin kyis brlab/ /sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi sbyar ba/ /gnas dang longs spyod ci bde dang / /ma nyams blo ni rab ldan pas—/ /dang ba'i dam mnos bzhin du bya/ /dam bcas ldan pas 'dus te bsgrub—/ /yang na dpag tshad rgyang grags tshad/ /so sor 'tsham pa'i gzugs brnyan bri/ /brgyan dang mchod sogs 'khor ba dang / /phyi rol mchod pa la sogs te/ /phyin chad bsrung sgo rims bzhin bya/ /bsnyen pa'i don du sngon bya ba—/ /rdzogs pa'i las rnams zin par bya/ /'dus pas phyogs bcing rdzas brlabs nas/ /spyi 'am yang na re re zhing / /tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor rims bzhin sgom/ /rnal 'byor thabs dang shes rab kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum du bsgom④/ /sems dpa' sems ma nyid du bsgom④/ /so so'i rigs dang phyag rgya dang / /ting 'dzin yang dag so sor gsal/ /rigs kyi rigs te rigs kyi gtso/ /thugs kyi thugs te thugs kyi mchog /khro bo'i tshogs dang ldan pa yi/ /tshom bu gcig pa'i lha rnams bsgom/ /de bzhin 43—1012

rigs dang rdo rje'i rigs/ /pad+ma'i rigs te sku gsung thugs/ /khro bo'i tshogs dang ldan rig pa'i/ /tshom bu gsum pa'i lkulha rnams bsgom/ /lnga dang lnga'i sbyor ba yis/ /tshom bu lnga'i lha bkod la/ /khro bo bcu dang khro mo bcu/ /'khor lo'i tshul du rnam par bsgom/ /byin brlabs dbang dang ldan byas nas/ /rang bzhin gnas nas dbab byas te/ /bzhugs dang bstan byas rim par mchod / /rdzogs nas bstod de bsnyen pa bya/ zin nas bsdu ste rnal 'byor tshogs / /tshul bzhin mchod pa'i 'phrin las bya/ /nang nub mkha' 'gro lhag ma sbyin/ /bar chad zlog cing bsnyen pa bya/ /zla phyed phyed zhag nye bsnyen pa/ /lha gsal 'phro 'dus snod du rung / /bco lnga mar phyed bsgrub pa ste/ /'phro 'du bsnol nas bsgrub par bya/ /zhag grangs tshangs nas rtags byung na/ /dngos grub bzlas bslang bsgrub chen po/ /de bzhin rgyud kyi zhag grangs bzhin/ /bar chad med par bsgrub par bya/ /spyod lam yo byad lnga spyod cing / /dngos su mchod pa rnam gnyis po/ /gtso ru dgos pa gang yin pa/ /phyi ma'i gdug pa 'dul bar shes/ /snga ma rgyas par bshad par bya/ /gos brgyan bza' btung glu gar rnams/ /hūṃ du shes pas rab spyad na/ /ngo mtshar dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i phyir/ /gsang sogs yo byad lnga po rnams/ /rig phyir ma skyes ye shes gsal/ /chos nyid ye shes rol par sgom/ /cig shos tshe yang de bzhin no//phyogs bcu mtha' yas dus bzhi'i/ /thams cad dbyer med ma 'da' la/ /nyi zla shar ba'i gzhal yas nang / /pad+ma chags med gdan bting nas/ /rin chen zad med pho brang sa/ /che chung tshad dpag med pa'i/ /byang chub bde ldan dkyil 'khor la/ /bde ldan byang chub rab bkod nas/ /ma lus thams 43—1013

cad dbyengs bsdus nas/ /lus bskyod yan lag bsgul gsigs nas①/ /dbang po lnga'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /phyag rgya chen po yin par bshad/ /lhag pa'i ting 'dzin 'ba' zhig gam/ /bro sogs tshe na sgom pa 'ang / /bye dang tsakra'i dkyil 'khor du/ /pad+ma chags med gdan bting nas/ /thabs dang shes rab chags med tshul/ /yan lag lnga po thams cad kun/ /rang bzhin yongs kyis dag pa dang / /ting 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'o/ /ye nas ma bcos yongs rdzogs kyis/ /lhag pa'i ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor/ /yan lag bzhi la rigs bzhi'i 'khor/ /kha dog dbyibs dang phyag rgya dang / /thabs dang shes rab gsal bsgoms te/ /phyogs bcur spros shing ngan song sbyong / /gnas su bsdu zhing dkyil 'khor bstem//'das dang ma 'das thams cad kun/ /bde gshegs zhing du rnam par sbyong / /yan lag chen po lnga bskyod na/ /rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor ma lus g.yo/ /'gro lnga byang chub lam du mdzad/ /snyigs ma lnga yang rnam par dag /bzang mdzes legs par gos bgos na/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'phro bar 'gyur/ /de nas mthar thug yang ba'i bar/ /ye shes lnga yis brgyan par 'gyur/ /brgyan mchog mdzes par lus brgyan nas/ /ting 'dzin 'od 'bar gsal bsgoms te//phyogs bcu gang bar dkyil 'khor spros/ /bdag nyid chen po'i dkyil 'khor la//mi dmigs dbyings nas dkyil 'khor mchod/ /'dod lnga thabs dang shes rab gnas—/ /bde mchog ro yang stsong bar byed/ /bag chags tshogs chen gnyis dang ldan/ /bro thabs gar gyi phyag rgya dang / /glu dbyangs tshig gi sgra bsgrags na—/ /phyogs bcu skye gnas ma lus kun/ /lhun grub rdo rje'i sku mthong zhing / /43—1014

chos kyi dung chen sgra yang thos/ /sgrib gnyis byang nas byang chub 'grub/ /bde mthong snyan grags tshogs chen 'grub/ /ma chags ye shes che dang ldan/ /thabs dang shes rab thams cad kun/ /dbus nas shar phyogs kha bsten te/ /seṅge stabs chen mchod par bya/ /dbang po lnga la yi ge lnga/ /gsal ba'i 'phro 'du mngon shes rdzogs/ /'dod pa lnga la chags med rol/ /bdag dang gzhan don rdzogs par byed/ /tshom bu gsal ba'i yab yum rnams/ /phan tshun 'od 'phro stem bya ste/ /dkyil 'khor 'bar ba gsal gyur nas/ /bdag dang phyogs bcu'i gnyis med sgom/ /phyogs phyogs rim bzhin kha ltas te/ /thugs sku gsung yon las kyi glu/ /bro tshig brjod dang ye shes rgyan/ /bro glu rigs lnga spyi glu tūbo/ /rnam lnga stan nas glu ldan bya/ /sreg ldan bro glus don gnyis rdzogs/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung myur rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab nyid gnas shing / /bdag nyid chen po mchod pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad la/ /bde ba chen pos khyab par 'gyur/ /bdud rtsir 'gyur zhing 'byung ba dang / /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad sel cing / /longs spyod 'byung zhing ngan song spyong / /cir yang gzhan du 'gyur bar 'grub/ /de ltar bzhi dang ldan pa yis/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur na/ /byin brlabs cha rnams rdzogs par bya/ /bsnyen bsgrub gsang ba bzhi rim pa/ /thams cad gnyis med dbyings su spyor/ /gnyis med dbyings nas byang chub 'bar/ /'od 'phro 'bar bas phyogs bcur gsal / /bde byebs thabs chen thabs kyi mchog /shes rab bde mchog brtan ldan rdzogs/ /rdo rje dril bu yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang lha mo 43—1013

brgyad / /rdzogs rol nyi zla dus cig ldan/ /gnyis med zung du 'brel 'gyur na/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor ma lus 'byung / /thig le rdo rje'i gzugs su chags/ /mchod chen mkha' 'gro gsal bar 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /dra ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon rdzogs pas/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi mngon dze+egs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur / /sgyu 'phrul dra ba brtan pa yis/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi gshegs pa yi / /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus dang / /khams gsum 'gro rnams mngon du 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor brtan pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bro gar 'du 'phro'i phyag rgya yis/ /'dzul lam nam mkha' 'gro bar 'gyur/ /glu tshig sgra'i phyag rgya yis/ /chos kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur / /brgyan dang bgo ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /'bar ba'i rgyal po thub med 'grub / /bza' dang btung ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /yid bzhin sgu dang bdud rtsi 'grub / /ā li kā li'i phyag rgya yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'grub par 'gyur / /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bsgrub bya ba/ /gnas dang zla dang rdzas rnams ni/ /tshogs kyi mchog tu dmigs par gzhag /nags tshal chen po dbe+en pa'i sar/ /gzhung dang mthun pa rnyed nas ni/ /gnod sprad sa gnan byen gyis brlab/ /sa gzhi mnyam pa rgyas par bya/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dkyil 'khor lnga bcu brgyad bstan pa'i/ /cho ga yan lag sdogs pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 'dus pas nges par 'grub/ /ston pa rdo rje rgyal dbang can/ /rgyal tshab rgyal por mtshungs pa dang / /dkar ma 'dangs chen 'phreng bar ldan/ /ljon cug sdong reg mtshan rdzogs dang / /rnal 'byor ming 13byed/016

sring brtse gdung ldan/ /tshom bu lnga 'am zung gis 'grub/ /dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chen/ /rdo rje dung chen dmar gyis bgang / /dung dang srog shing gsar rnying dang / /gzugs dang lugs chen dung mchog dang / /rgyan chas bcu drug tshang ba dang / /bsgrub po 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang / /bsgrub pa rdzas kyi yo byad dag /zhing 'gyur mchog dang mchog phran dang / /skyen bzlog yungs kar lce pog nag /gu gul sman dang bcas pa dang / /rdo rje go mtshon bcas pa dang //ji snyed pa'i rdzas rnams kun/ /'jigs byed chen po'i ting 'dzin dang / /nyams pa med pa'i sems kyis spyad/ /basbus te tshogs su bya ba'i phyir/ /byu 'dod snang ba bdag gis dgod/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /drug cu dgu bcu rtsa drug tu/ /'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor sgom/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdeb dang bcas pa'i bsam pa yis re ba med par rab tu bsgrub/ /glu dang gar dang phyag rgya dang / /byang chub sems kyis mchod pa dang / /brda' la sogs pa'i yon tan dang / /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad kyis/ /mdor na tshogs rnams mngon du bsgrub/ /spyi'i bsnyen bsgrub sngon bzhin shes/ /bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi bsnyen bsgrub bzhi/ /dang po'i tshe na gnas chen der/ /rgyang grags dpag tshad la sogs dang / /lus ngag lus ni gsum gyi tshad/ /rang gi rig pas ci nus par/ /phyag rgya gzugs brnyan snying po rnams/ /lnga yi tshon gyis bri bar bya/ /yo byad sngon bzhin byen brlabs nas/ /'phags rgyal mchod cing phyi rol pa/ /bcu bzhi mnyes dang gnyis po yang / /sbyin pas tshim byas bgo bar bya/ /'jigs byed dbang du bdag zhugs nas/ /khro bo khro mo'i 73—10/7

'khor du bya/ /gdan du gzir zhing phur bus gdab/ /rang bzhin phal ba mchod bstod de/ /bar chad ting 'dzin mchog gis bzlog /thun mong bsrung ba'i 'khor lor bya/ /de nas gnyis pa rgyun rnams ①dang / /bsgrub rdzas mchod pa dam rdzogs nas/ /phyi nang gsang bas bsrung byas te/ /srin po rgyal po tshul bzhin mnan/ /rtags ldan rdzas la byin brlabs bya/ /de nas rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab/ /de nas 'khor lo gcig pa 'am/ /gsum dang lnga ru sgom bya ba/ /'khor lo bar 'khyams sgo rna dang / /'jigs byed 'khor lo rigs kyi gtso/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang ldan par bya/ /zhi dang drag po dbang dang rgyas/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs chen de dbus su/ /bdag nyid drag por bcos tshul du/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor sgom/ /de bzhin rdo rje pad+ma dang / /rin chen ral gri tshom bu sgom/ /cig la'o rdo rje gsum mos pa sku gsung thugs kyi yojigs byed do/ /'jigs byed lnga rdzogs dkyil 'khor ni/ /'dus pa'i tshom bu lnga'i rigs/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las rdzogs par bsgomarjo/ /rgyan dang cha lugs la sogs pa/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs ni ji bzhin par/ /spyi 'am yang na re re ru/ /tsham ngam chen po'i cha lugs sgom/ /lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor dgu rgu ldan/ /byin dbang thob pa'i bdag dkyil la/ /rang bzhin phab bkug gzhug ④cing brtan/ /dgyes nas rim bzhin mchod par bya// //oṃ āḥhūṃ su ra to/ ma hā pan tsa shri he ru ka /man tra dz+wa la ma hā man da la/ kā ya bāg tsi ta/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ swe swe sum̐/ s+t+waṃ sde s+t+waṃ/haṃ haṃ haṃ/ badz+ra ma hā kā pa la khar ga dan ta dan dz+wa la sidhirjo/ ma hā shrī he ru ka 43—1018

a me du a bid dong bha be+e/ sang ha ra na hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ma hā yo ga ad dha ma hā sa ma ya / ru lu ru lu/ a la la la ho/ oṃ 26hūṃ su ra to ka ma la/ ma hā su ka ma bye/ ma nu sa man/ dza li dha na/ a ba spo ka kha'i/ a la la la ho/mchod stod shārdzogs nas bsnyen pa ni/ /ye shes mdun du lhag pa la/ /bzlas pa gsal ba gsum kyis bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī te ru ka /badz+ra kro ti shwa ri sarba dus stan hūṃ phaṭa/ ru lu ru lu ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ// //de sogs bzlas bsnyen 'phro 'du yis/ /bdun par bskul dang snod byed pa//bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor sdogs pa'o/ /de bsnyen de bzhin bsgrub pa yang / /'phro 'du bskul dang dngos grub sdud/ /skyon bcu spangs te bsgrub pa ni/ /bsgrub pa'i dus su shes par bya/ /gcig la dzas btar tshur 'du ba/ /bsgrub pa chen por shes par bya/ /shel dang byu ru bung ba dang / /mthing gi bung ba mang po dag /rim bzhin bung ba me tog dang / /mtsho la ser chen 'bab bzhin no/ /'od dang dri dang sgra gzugs dang / /'khor dang 'bar dang khol 'byung na/ /bar chad cha rnams brtag bya ste/ /bar chod bskrad de bdag bsrungs la/ /zhag grangs tshang zhing rtags byung na/ /dkyil 'khor 'thun pa nyid du sbyar/ /gnas su stem zhing bstan par bya/ /de nas sngon bzhin rnam gsum thob/ /gsang mchog rgyas par bshad bya ba/ /zhing 'gyur mchog dang mchog phran rnams/ /nyi zla'i steng du mkhas pas gzhag /nga rgyal lag gi 'du byed sgom/ /hūṃ du gyur pas rnam par dag /dbyings su thim nas phyag rgyar 'bar / /skur gyur 'od zer 'phro bas brjid/ /gtsug tu rnam par rgyal ba bsgom / /de bzhin gshegs par byin brlabs nas/ /rgyal ba'i sras su 43—10/9

dbang yang bskur①/ /shin tu khro bo chen po yis/ /thabs kyi lha chen bsgral ba ltar—/ /chos nyid rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gnyis su med par thal gyis bsgral/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs kyis/ /lam lnga'i sems can kun bkug nas/ /thams cad ma lus bsgral bar bya/ /phyi nang snod bcud ji snyed pa/ /gnas pa'i sems can ma lus kun/ /bdag nyid chen po rtogs pa yis—/ /dbyings su yang ni bsgral bar bya/ /ri rab chen po'i gling bzhi la/ /gnas pa'i sems can ma lus kun/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs kyis/ /ye shes me chen sgom bya ste/ /thams cad ma lus bsreg par bya/ /dbyings su yang ni bstem par bya/ /srid gsum sreg pa'i me yin te/ /yid kyi ye shes me ru 'bar/ /ram̐/ ngo mtshar ngan 'gro thar pa'i thabs/ /ye nas skye med de bzhin nyid/ /sgyu mar snang ba mig yor tshul/ /sbyor sgrol bya ba kun byas kyang / /rdul cha tsam yang byas pa med/ /de ltar bsgral ba kun byas kyang / /bsgral ba'i dngos po gang yang med/ /phung po lnga po gshig par bya/ /bshig nas 'byung ba'i bag la zha/ /ma zhig na yang 'byung ba yin/ /rnam shes med pas bsang byas nas/ /rmi lam srog bcad tshul bzhin du/ /gnas pa nyid na dngos po med—/ /sems kyi rang bzhin de la ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dgrar langs kyang / /sus kyang zin cing sod pa med/ /'o na thugs rjes gang bsgral na/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma thams cad kun/ /phyin ci log las bzlog bya ste//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /shin tu goms pas dbang bskur te/ /byang chub zhing la dgod par bya/ /de tsam las ni bsgral zhes gdags/ /bsgral ba nyid na sbyor ba yod/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal rtsad bcad nas/ /byang chub 43—1020

gnas su bsgral bas na/ /gnyis med dbyings su spyor ba yin/ /lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /dbye 'am yang na mi dbye bar/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen po / /bsgrub pa dang ni bsgrub chen pos/ /shes rab dbyengs ma khrus byas la//bder gshegs dkyil 'khor kun bkod de/ /bdag nyid rig pa'i lhar sgoms nas / /gnyis su med par ldan par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu ldan gyur nas/ /yum gyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /byang chub pad+ma'i bde thugs spros/ /sems lnga rim par zin pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /dgyes mnyam mchog gi sbyin pas bstem/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor gsum mnyes dang //'gro ba mang po de thob nas/ /slar yang gnyis med dbyings su thim/ /thim 'gyur dbyings nas phyag rgyar 'bar/ /bde gshegs thabs dang shes rab sdogs / /phyag rgya drug kyang yang dag rdzogs/ /bsod nams tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs/ /bsgrub pa nyi zla'i snying po de/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje lce yis blang / /mkha' 'gro gsal 'bar tshe la sogs/ /yid bzhin sprin gyi bdag por 'gyur/ /'gro drug dus gnas de dag snang / /mchod pa chen po mnyam spyor zhing / /thams cad dbyings su spyor bas na/ /ngan 'gror mi ltung yang dag 'grub/ /'di ni bsgral ba chen po yin/ /bsgral ba nyid na spyor ba yin / /sbyor ba nyid na ma lus bsgral/ /ye nas lha dang lha mo yi/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag sbyor ba dang / /dbang po yul dus sbyor ba'o/ /phung po lnga nyid de bzhin gshegs/ /'byung ba lnga nyid yum du spyor/ /dus bzhi lha mo nyid du spyor/ /rtag chad mu bzhi khro mo bzhi/ /thams cad ma lus 'byung ba kun / /mnyam pa'i dbyings nyid rig par sbyor/ /thabs kyis srin mo rol 73—1021

pa ltar/ /sbyor ba nyid na chags pa med/ /ma chags pa la chags pa dang / /chags pa nyid na zin chags med/ /'di ni tshangs mchog rgyal po ste/ /shin tu chags pa chen po yin/ /ma rtags pa yi spyad gyur na/ /yi dwags srin po'i gnas su skye/ /mchod pa'am spyod lam thams cad du/ /chas ①brgyad brgyan rnams bgo byas te/ /bza' btung rjes su mthun par dbe+ed/ /bro gar glu ②tshig ldan par bya/ /dbang po yul dus rig pa rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan 'gyur zhing / /mnyam pa'i ngang nyid rtogs gsal na/ /thams cad bde ba chen po'i rgya/ /bskyod chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /khro bo khro mo thams cad kun/ /gsal zhing 'od zer 'phro bsgoms na/ /bsgul bskyod thams cad phyag rgya yin/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i zhabs/ /rtag tu rdo rje 'bar bar 'gyur/ /thabs chen re re bskyod pa na/ /pad+ma chags med re re 'byung / /rdo rje pad+ma de sbyor na/ /sems can thams cad bla na med/ /byang chub zhing du skye bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor lha rnams dang / /khro bo'i ⑦dkyil 'khor sgom bya ste/ /dbu'i dkyil 'khor bsgul bskyod na/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor thams cad g.yo/ /lag gi 'du byed bskyod byas na/ /rigs 'dzin zhing khams thams cad g.yo/ /rkang pa'i stabs chen mnan mchongs na/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad thams cad dang / /bdud dang log 'dren thams cad mnan—/ /yan lag thams cad bsgul bsigs na/ /ba sru bu ga re re nas/ /khro bo rdul snyed grangs med spro/ /de'i sprul pa grangs med kyis/ /phyogs bcu khams rnams rdul snyed du/ /khro bo'i don rnams rdul phran snyed/ /thugs rjes 'dul zhing dbyings su bstem/ /bro gar glu tshig stangs stabs dang / /ting 43—1022

'dzin yo byad thams cad kun/ /zhi ba tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /bro gar rtse 'jo la sogs bsgyur/ /'khor gyi 'phra men tshim bya ste/ /dbang du bsdu dang sgom pa rnams/ /rgyas byas skye las bsdud te dpyad/ /de ltar bsgrubs pas the tshom med/ /thabs dang shes rab thams cad kyis/ /de lta bu'i longs spyod ni/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes/ /srid gsum 'gro ba thams cad la/ /dga' ba chen pos khyab par 'gyur/ /rtags chen sngon bzhin 'phel ba rten/ /gling grangs mthong ba drug kyang 'byung / /sgra brnyan rmi lam dag tu yang / /bde ba'i 'jig rten gnas rnams dang / /skye ba gang dag 'dzin pa dang / /rigs 'dzin lung ston brtag par bya/ /zhag grangs bcu drug tshun chad kyis/ /lus ma spangs par rigs 'dzin sa/ /yun rings chos kyi bde spyad nas/ /bla med rdo rje sems dpa'i sar/ /dpe byad mtshan gyes rnam par brgyan/ /mngon shes drug ldan thams cad mkhyen/ /tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par rol/ /sangs rgyas zhing la dbang sgyur te/ /spyod yul kun tu ma 'da' la/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /de bas las dus rag lus sems/ /dor byas brtson 'grus chen pos sbyor/ /mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'da'o/ /rnal 'byor las su rung rnams kyis/ /'di lta bu'i las byas na/ /'bras bu mngon du ma byung na/ /lus ngag yid la dbang thob nas/ /sangs rgyas 'byung dang skal mnyam 'gyur/ /las dang 'brel ba'i byin brlabs kyis/ /theg pa dman par yong mi skye/ /bsod nams ye shes dpung tshogs kyis/ /las kyi mun pa sbyangs pa'i phyir/ /ngan song gsum du yong mi ltung / /gnas ngan longs spyod mi bde ba'i/ /ngan song brgyad du 43—1023

'go mi 'gyur/ /gzugs mchog dam pa ldan pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje theg mchog rjed mi 'gyur/ /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /lha mi'i gnas mchog sa skabs der/ /lus byad bzang zhing yan lag rdzogs/ /dbang po tshang zhing lhag chad med/ /skad gdangs snyan cing 'gro don byed/ /bdag gi longs spyod thams cad kun/ /gzhan la gnod pa med par 'grub/ /tshan po che'i mthu stobs ldan/ /'gro ba'i don dang yang dag ldan/ /gzhan la gnod pa yong mi byed/ /snying rje che zhing shes rab ldan/ /mthu stobs che zhing thabs ldan pas/ /bdag dang gzhan don rdzogs par byed/ /mthar phyin skye shi med pa'i sa/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rin po che/ /bkod pa'i gzhal yas thams cad la/ /'dod lha drug pa ji lta bar/ /dbang sgyur dpyod pa'i dngos grub thobaske/ /de phyir dbang bsgyur stiphyi ma'i dus/ /nyid du sbyor bas smos ci dgos/ /de ltar brtson 'grus ldan pas ni/ /mthong dang phyi mar ma gyur na'ang / /lan grangs gzhan du'ang bdun nyid las/ /mi 'da' rigs kyi dam par 'gyur//cho ga sngags dang yo byad dag /bco lnga rdzogs nas ma nyams ldan/ /nges par tshogs te tshogs dpyad na/ /'bras bu sngon du ma byung yang / /rgyal po bran mo ngan bshos kyang / /'byung nur chags pa'i rigs 'dzin te/ /mthong na dmangs kyi slar 'gyur zhing / /kun la dbang sgyur stobs ldan pas/ /lha rnams re ba'i mthu skye bas/ /bsrung rbed mchod pa byed pa ltar/ /rnal 'byor stobs ldan 'gyur ba na/ /rdo rje dam can mang po kun/ /de'i dbang gis khur bar byed/ /spyod yul dor nas phyag rgyar rdzogs/ /la la de ltar de nges na—/ /de ltar ma gyur bsod nams sa/ /tshe rabs skye ba thams cad du/ /43—1024

las ngan lnga bcu brgyad spyod pa'i/ /sa gnas kun tu skye mi 'gyur/ /nges 'byung bzhi 'ang spyod mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje rigs mchog 'dzin 'gyur te/ /rnam smin thob nas sngon bzhin te/ /'di la the tshom ldan min pas/ /skal ldan kun gyis rtags ①'grub bya'o/ /bar chad med pa'i lam/ tshogs bsgrub pa'i le'u ste/ bdun pa'o// //dngos grub lhag pa'i mchog nyid la/ /bsnyen bsgrub bzhi yis mos byas nas—/ /bde chen sa la dgod pa'i phyir/ /mthar phyin 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /dus tshogs bar chad med sa nas/ /lhag ma med dang yod pa yi//mya ngan 'da' bas mthar sbyor ba/ /thun mong lta bur zung du 'gyur/ /de la thog ma bshad pa ni/ /gcig dang du ma'i rnal 'byor ma/ /brtan nyid sa'am de thob nas/ /zla drug bcu drug bsnyen bsgrub tshe/ /rdo rje'i lus su ma gyur par—/ /stobs chung rkyen smon zhan pa'i phyir/ /rnam rtog 'byung ba'i lhag lus gzhag /rdo rje 'chang sar rig pas 'gro/ /lha'i rnal 'byor gsal rdzogs smin—/ /lus kyi dra bas bsgrib gyur pa'i/ /ka la bing ka mi 'jigs bzhin/ /bral nas snang byed de rnams smin/ /yid kyis lha'i gzugs bzung zhing / /lus kyi rgya mdud dral gyur nas/ /phyag rgya'i sku nyid gsal 'gyur nas/ /rnam par smin ces de la bya/ /rgya dmig rgya sa ji lta bar/ /phyag rgya thob la ma rag pi'o②—/ /gzugs rdzogs stobs chen de kho na'o/ /de yang dgongs sa khyad par gnyis/ /dgongs spyod rgya mtsho snga phyi dang / /rgyud mthun stobs chas ming grags pa/ /lhag med 'byung med las lus med/ /mya ngan 'das pa'am min 43—1025

ces brjod/ /dkyil 'khor rol pa'i tshul spyod pas/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pas bdag gi don/ /smin pas 'phrin las rdzogs byed pas/ /mi dor dgod pa gzhag kyi'o/ /de de'ang 'di dang phyi ma dang / /lan grangs gzhan du rab 'bring gis/ /thob kyi skal bar ma 'gyang ste/ /dgongs spyod rtson pa gtso phyir ro//gang de bral ma thag par du/ brgya bzhi rdzogs par bdag 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje lnga sogs rig pas 'dzin/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rigs 'bras bu/ /de phyir rgya che'i bar chad med/ /lam mchog dbye sa cig yin no/ /bar chad med pa'am smin pa'i/ /mngon par shes pa'ang de ming can/ /mi 'gyur nges par 'gyur ba'ang yin/ /dpag tshad gling khams yul la spyor/ /phyi ma dus kyi tshogs bsgrubs pas/ /dgongs spyod brtson pa stobs rdzogs dang / /yo byad thabs kyi stobs las skyes/ /gzhan pa'i yo byad rtags pa na/ /dngos grub rol pa'i mthu las byung / /thabs rgyus che bas so so'ang / /lam las skyes pas mchog yin te/ /de yang rgyu dus ngo bo grangs/ /dgongs spyod mngon shes sbyor ba'i tshul—/ /gzhi gnyis lus kyis rdzogs par bshad/ /thabs dang grang ba sgyur bya ba/ /shes rab rnam gsum goms byas nas/ /ting 'dzin mnyam pa'i don rtogs te/ /kun tu yangs pa chen por sgom/ /shes 'jug lnga rtogs goms pas ni/ /zla zhag rgyud bzhin bsgrub byed pas/ /rdo rje'i lus su the tshom ①med//ming bzhi lus nyid de lta'o/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /rab 'bring ji bzhin mi slu bar/ /dbang sgyur rigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ /rgyu 'bras dus gcig rdzogs pa'i/ /rang rig nyid la dbang thob ste/ /tshe ni bcu dang drug pa'i/ /brgya brgya dag tu snur zhing 43—1026

gnas—/ /lus ma bor bar sangs rgyas pa'o/ /don mthong 'jug pa mthar phyin pa/ /tshogs spyod bsgrub pa'i dngos grub kyis/ /lus khams skye gnas zag pa zad/ /rdo rje'i lus 'gyur tshe'i rigs/ /mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'das—/ /lus ma bor bar sangs rgyas sa/ /'jigs pa kun bral cho 'phrul tshogs—/ /lha mi'i rgyal po skye ba 'dzin/ /lha dang mi dang tshangs pa'i skye ba rnam dag 'dzin mod kyang / /khyad par sa la gnas 'gyur yin/ /cha byad de nyid kyis chos ston/ /gang dag mi 'jigs rtsi 'chang ltar/ /dbang sgyur 'jigs pa lnga sogs bral/ /drug bzhi'i yan lag kun rdzogs shing / /rang dbang sgyur ba'i skye ba yis/ /stong gsum 'jig rten rgyar 'dul byed/ /sgyu'i dang por bskal mnyam pa'o/ /bdag phyir don du gnyer ba ni/ /brgya phrag bcu drug tshe yis rdzogs/ /gzhan du rang dbang thob pa'i phyir/ /bskal pa grangs med gnas 'gyur yang / /sku ni shin tu gzhon pa'i tshul/ /'dul ba'i dus kyi 'pho 'dug byed/ /ngo bo sman dang thabs rigs 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor sgol ma'i rigs 'dzin dang / /lam mchog rdzogs pa'i rim pa'ang bzhi/ /bcu dbang dang por 'dra mod kyang / /de nyid mthu zag mi zag① /rgyu dang ngo bo rnam pa gnyis/ /de bas dgongs spyod smos ci dgos/ /gzhan las grub pas de rigs min/ /mchog la'ang yon tan mtshan chas brjod/ /lus dang phung por bcas pa yi/ /gnas par dbang ba'i rigs 'grub phyir/ /lhag rton 'byung las lus bcas 'das/ /zag kun zad pa'i rigs chen 'di/ /ji ltar spyad kyang ldog ma byed/ /rang dbang thob pas dbugs phyung phyir/ /skabs 'dir bden pa bar mthong nas/ /mkhas rtogs goms spyod rig pa 43—1027

'dzin—/ /lha la sogs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /ming rtog gzungs las ming thob pa—/ /yon tan grangs kyis bsam mi khyab/ /bsngos sa zhing khams lung ston pa / /rdo rje rdo rjer bos dbang bskur/ /mthong goms mthu ldan rig pa nyid/ /snang ba rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas/ /rigs snang gnas la nges pa med/ /skye ba cha byad don gyis 'gyur/ /chos rnams bdag phyir dmigs med phyir/ /chos kun mi mthong chos nyid kyang / /mi mthong sangs rgyas thugs mi mthong / /snod bcud mi mthong gang mthong ba/ /des ni yang dag bden pa mthong /de bas thos myong reg sogs lam/ /shes 'jug bar chad med las skyes/ /de phyir mngon gsum rtogs mchog ni/ /rang dbang thob nas mngon bzhin te/ /zag gsum zag pa 'di la med/ /sngan chad lam gyi 'du byed med/ /de'i re dogs chags bral bas/ /rim pa'am rim pa med tshul gyis/ /stong khri la sogs grangs mang lha'i/ /'khor lo gsal rdzogs rnal 'byor gnas/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis kyis don grub mdzad/ /de ming dbang sgyur rnal 'byor de/ /brgya phrag cha sdogs dus bar du/ /goms byas gnyis thob mtha' skad cig /cha'i rdo rje dpa' bos sbyor/ /rigs mthun mchog rgya sprul pa las/ /gsang thos bsam rig sgom spyor bas/ /dkyus sar phyin pa cang shes bzhin/ /kun tu 'gro ba bdag po'i don/ /rdzu 'phrul chos snang rjes ston brjod/ /drug shes de ming ldan pa yis/ /dbang sgyur rtsa ba rdo rje'i sku/ /bya byed rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin/ /bzhi'i thog mas don sbyong bas①/ /nus mthu can gyur dbang can des—/ /mkha' la 'phyo dang rigs 'dzin gnas/ /chu rgyun bzlog dang rlung mi 'gul/ /ri brag la sogs thogs med 'dzul/ /chu la mi 'jing ④mes mi 43—1028

tshig /dug dang mtshon gyis 'jigs mi 'gyur/ /mi snang ba dang mang por sprul—/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /lha srin rnams la dbang sgyur dang / /tshe dang dus la bsing btung dang / /stong gsum nyung 'brur shong ba dang / /nyung 'brus stong gsum gang ba dang / /ba spu gang bsdu'ang de bzhin noske/ /sreg pa'i bskal pa bzhil ba dang / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bum bgye ①dang / /skams sar chu 'byung bye ma gser/ /sol ba ljon shing dbyung ba dang //nam mkha' rdo rje sra 'byung zhing / /'bar na me'ang tshig pa dang / /chur 'gyur 'bab pa'ang de bzhin no/ /'jig rten gtor lung bya ba'ang 'grub/ /dgug dang gtang dang bcing dang dgrol/ /gso dang bsad dang 'pham dang rgyal—/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /sprul dang gcan gzan gdug pa rnams/ /khyi bzhin phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur/ /bdud dang gdug pa sna tshogs rnams/ /tshugs par mi 'gyur bran bzhin 'gyur/ /lus ma dor bar rigs 'dzin sar/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /so so'i skad dang mthun pa yis/ /so sor thar pa'i lam yang ston/ /ngan song stongs shing bskul ba dang / /lam stegs dgod cing de dag nyid/ /theg chen lam la dgod par mdzad/ /thar pa bskul zhing zhi ba slong / /sa bcu shes bya spyod byed cing / /bde gshegs 'khor la'ang chos ston mdzad/ /stong gsum brgya bcu'i 'jig rten rnams/ /g.yo dang rab g.yo shin tu g.yo/ /mdzad pa snang bas de gnas rnams/ /nang g.yos sa'i rim sbyor byed/ /gsang ba sngags kyi sgra bsgrags pas/ /kun kyang rmad 'byung sngags kyi sgrar/ /grags pas bdud 'dul ngan song sbyong / /'gro ba ma lus don yang byed/ /las rnams thams 43—1029

cad kun byas nas/ /skye shi med pa'i g.yung drung thob/ mtshan dang dpe byad kun gyis brgyan/ /mthar phyin bya ba med pa 'grub/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i lnga bzhi'o/ /spyod pa bcu gnyis 'phrin las rnams/ /dbang sgyur nyid du thogs med par/ /sngon bzhin yul khyon 'dul bar byed/ /skye mched rang 'byung ye shes phyir/ /de nyid gcig dang du ma'i mtha'/ /gnyis su med par mngon ①rtogs goms/ /mthong bas dri ma drug sbyangs phyir/ /de nyid gzugs sgra dri ro reg /shes pa'i ②bye brag rtsa lngar bshad/ /gcig gis yul lnga gcod byed pas/ /tshang dang ma tshang 'jigs dogs med/ /gzhan du lha'i rna ba dang / /spyan kyis mngon par shes pa dang / /sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang / /pha rol rnams kyi sems shes dang / /'chi 'pho skye ba mkhyen pa dang / /rdzu 'phrul shes pa'am zag zad shes/ /de rnyed tshul can yul shes pas/ /gang dang gang rnams 'dul bar mdzad/ /de ming mi ldog zag med dang / /dbang sgyur rigs kyi mtshan las brjod/ /bdag gam gzhan phyir dbang can nges/ /sku tshe'i tshad dam ji snyed par/ /bzhugs mtha' rang gi grub sbyor ba/ /sngon bzhin rims dang cig car ba'o/ /de 'ang snga ma mthong ba'i lam nyid du/ /rang gi shes rab gsum goms pas/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i phyag rgya che/ /gang sgoms mngon du gyur pa'i lha/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rigs 'dzin der/ /yongs 'gyur lhun grub thob nas gshegs/ /phyi ma rigs mchog de nyid nas/ /sngon bzhin goms pa gsum byas pas/ /rgya dor cig car mthar 'gro ba/ /chos nyid dam tshig smon mthu'ang yin/ /de nyid bar ma bshad bya ba'ang / /sngon kyi lus kyis rdzogs par bya/ /gcig dang du ma'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'byung 43—1030

lus sems phyir rang bzhin lha/ /mthong goms bsags pa'i mthar bsgrub pas//kun 'gro'i bsgrib dag ngo bo'i rgyu/ /rnam zhin tshal gyis 'grub pa med/ /snga phyi rgyu 'bras 'dod pa min/ /dus rims 'dod min cig 'dod phyir/ /cig pas de nyid lam byas pas/ /lhag ma bcas pas bsnur bsgrubs mtha'/ /de nyid gyur pa nges pa med/ /rang sems phyag rgya chen po ste/ /goms pa mngon gyur lha'i sku/ /bsgoms pas gang yin mngon 'gyur sku/ /thun mong mchog gi mtshan dper ldan/ /longs spyod gnyis pa phyag rgya'i rigs/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dang / /pad+mo ral gri rigs 'dzin 'gyur/ /rang lus sdong nas phyag rgya che/ /bsgoms pas sngon du gyur pa'i lha/ /mtshan dpe bzhi dang mngon drug rdzogs / /phyag rgya chen po'i rigs su grags/ /ye shes sku'i cha lugs can/ /'byung ba rdo rje'i lus la grol/ /de phyir sku tshe tshad med de/ /bsnur ①zhing mngon du bya dang bral/ /de nyid rigs gsum rigs bzhi dang / /lnga dang mchog lnga'i rigs 'dzin pas/ /rnam pa bzhi ru mngon bzhin 'gyur/ /mtshan gyi ming grangs gnyis dang gsum/ /mnyam pa nyid las mi g.yo zhing / /dbang sgyur 'du byed dang bral bas/ /zag pa med pa'i sgom pa'i lam mi g.yo rnal 'byor nyid du'ang brjod/ /rgyal bas lung bstan sngon 'byung ba/ /brtag pa'i bye brag 'di la'ang med/ /ye shes sku'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i spyan dgongs kyang / /rgyu mthun ④yod kyang mi g.yo thob/ /shin tu bstan pa'i rlung gnas pa/ /grangs can 'khor la mngon du snang / /'on kyang rnal 'byor rtsol ba can/ /mnyam gzhag ngang las ma ba/yos bzhin/ /stong gi 'jig rten brgya stong phrag /bcu'i rdul snyed 'jig rten dang / /zhing 43—1031

grangs med pas brgya stong phrag /bcu'i rdul snyed zhing khams su/ /sngon dang smad 'tshong la sogs pa/ /sprul pa'i lus kyis 'dul bar byed/ /bzhi dang drug sogs de bzhin no/ /drug dang lnga'i yan lag bcus/ /shes pa'ang 'dra mod bzhi sogs kun/ /de rnyed yul gyi khyad par dang / /sngon rdzogs mthu dang gdul byas spags/ /rang gi mi g.yo mthong goms dang / /don du gnyer rims la sogs pa'i/ /lam kun rdzogs pa'i stobs byin gyis/ /rnal 'byor bral nas lhun gyis grub/ /lhan cig gnas pa'i dri ma dag /brtsal ba med par lhun grub mthong / /de de mngon du byas pa yi/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i rig pas 'dzin/ /rang rgyud dag pa'i sangs rgyas de/ /sngon bzhin bzhi brgyad dgod par bya/ /snga ma'i rigs la mthu rdzogs pas/ /bshad pa bzhin du dri ma dag /sangs rgyas gnyis pa shes rab gsum/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i rigs su 'byung / /gnas der sngon bzhin gsum rdzogs pa/ /longs spyod gsang ba'i lung thob cing / /rang gi dgongs spyod nus pa can/ /mthar dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /de ltar dag pa'i shes pa nyid/ /sku lnga lhun grub rdo rje 'dzin/ /lhun mnyam ngang la mi g.yo zhing / /mi rtog nyid du bzhugs pa'ang / /bag la nyal ba 'joms byed cing / /skad cig rag las rigs 'dzin mtha'o/ /cha byad rgyal ba nyid du ste/ /lnga po lhun gyis grub phyir na/ /de 'dra de nyid rgyal tshab ston/ /de mi stong pas mi 'grub yin/ /nyid la skye shi mi mnga' phyir/ /rdo rje sgu 'ang gdul bya la/ /sprul pa rnams ni 'da' tshul ston/ /don grub la sogs ji lta ba'o/ /bya ba lhun grub rnal 'byor kyi/ /rigs 'dzin chen po na rigs 'dzin/ /tha ma'i ming grangs mthar phyin lam/ /rang rgyud dag pa'i 43—1032

sangs rgyas dang / /de nyid dang ni mthar sbyor lam/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i rgyal tshab bo/ /snga ma gsum dang dang po bzhi'i/ /cha lugs rang gi rgyal tshab sdud—/ /bsam yas lhun gyis grub rdzogs pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan mchog 'chang / /yi ge 'khor lo'ang mngon gzigs pa/ /mi g.yo ba la mi rtog pas/ /da rung mngon par mi rgya ste/ /dus mtha'i skad cig nyid kyis gshegs—/ /des na dgongs spyor rgya mtsho kun/ /ye shes rtsal sogs bya med pa'ang / /mthar phyin bya bral la sogs pa'i/ /ming grangs cha las brjod par zad—/ /nyid phyir rdo rje 'dzin sogs la/ /skad cig dus kyis brlab pa rdzogs—/ /tha ma'i bag la nyal ba dang / /bcom ldan 'das par gyur pa yin//de tshe de sgrib cha yod kyang / /lhun grub rigs 'dzin sar bzhugs nas/ /zhing khams thug pa med pa dag /gdul phyir sprul sku mdzad pa'ang / /srid gsum 'gro ba bsam yas su/ /thugs rjes ston pa bsam mi khyab/ /don dang mthun pa 'ba' zhig ston/ /mi mthun zhags pas 'khor ba gcod/ /la lar thoms zhugs bltam pa dang / /la lar rab byung dka' thub mdzad/ /la lar /bab dang rgyal srid dang / /chos ston mya ngan 'das sogs ston/ /res 'ga' zhi la res 'ga' drag /g.yem la g.yem ston sdang la sdang / /dregs la dregs dang mun la mun/ /rlung la'ang de bzhin mthun mi mthun/ /rgya mtsho lta bu thabs dpyod dang / /'phrin las de bzhin pa yis dkrol/ /gsang ba'i tan+t+ra ston pa dang / /de bzhin bsdu ba mdzad pa dang / /dman lus bsod nams ldan gnas su/ /sna tshogs lus can rigs la bskor/ /mngon shes drug ldan mtshan bzangs spags/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mnga' ba'i phyir/ /yul dang 43—1033

tshad med rgyal ba nyid/ /ji ltar me long lta bu'i tshul/ /mi mthun mtshan ma gzhom pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bdag rtog mtshan ma kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje dbyings su thim par byed/ /bdag med rang rig ye shes kyis—/ /dngos dang dngos med bag chags sregs/ /rang dang spyi'i chos rnams kun/ /sems kyi phrag dog thams cad kun/ /dngos po med par rtogs byas pas/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor dang / /rdo rje rtse mo'i mchog thob pas/ /yid tshod min dang bdud sde rnams/ /tshar bcad dpa' bos der rjes la/ /rgyan kyi dkyil 'khor ma 'di la/ /bsam yas lhun rdzogs kun mkhyen mdzod/ /mnyam gzhag ye shes dbang skur zhing / /don du gnyer ba'i smon lam mthus/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga gzhan las min/ /sku dang gsung thugs yon tan dang / /'phrin las rmad 'byung kun grags pa/ /gzhan nas yod 'ongs ma yin te/ /rang 'byung ye shes gnas med yin/ /de bas ngo mtshar cho 'phrul chos/ /gzhan nas yod thob ma yin phyir/ /thabs la brten pas shes rab nyid/ /de lta bu'i ngang du byung / /mun snang 'gyur rtsi ma ki ta/ /ji bzhin ma spangs de nyid 'gyur/ /'khor ba ma spangs rnam par dag /mya ngan mi 'da' ye nas gnas/ /'gro dang gnas par bya ba min/ /rtog pa thams cad ye shes tshogs/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam mi mnyam mnyam/ /bya dang mi bya bya med byas/ /grub dang ma grub thams cad grub/ /de phyir rigs 'dzin tha snyad bral/ /mthar phyin pa'i lam bstan pa'i le'u ste/ brgyad pa'o// //rang bzhin nyid du mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid la mos/ /43—1034

srid pa rims dang rdzogs tshul kyis/ /mngon byas don yod bshad par bya/ /mtshan nyid tha ma'i tha ma ni/ /ngo bo tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /lus gsum don du snang ba rnams/ /ji lta ba bzhin shes par bya/ /lus gsum snga ma brjod par bya/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs nyid dang / /yon tan 'phrin las rmad 'byung la/ /lnga pa'ang lnga nyid ngo bor gnas/ /e ma'o yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal ba lha'i lha/ /'phags pa'i 'phags pa kun tu bzang / /de bzhin gshegs las de bzhin gshegs/ /rin chen nor bu bzhin du bzhugs/ /chos drug nor bus mtshon pa na/ /gcig dang du ma kun bral ldan/ /de de rigs dngos rigs bral ba/ /nyi shu lngar ldan kun ngo bo/ /mos ①bzhin de rigs mthun snang la/ /yang dag nyid du 'di zhes med/ /lnga nyid lnga lngar ldan par snang / /rigs bdag yang dag sangs rgyas pa/ /tha ma'i tha ma zhen bral ba/ /ye shes 'gro 'ong med kun khyab/ /gnyis med pa'i de bzhin nyid/ /ngang nyid 'gro 'ong med par shes/ /de bzhin bde chen ngang nyid du/ /zung du kun bral gnyis phyir gshegs/ /sangs rgyas sems can sems la son/ /dbang phyug chen po'i skur bzhugs pas/ /gsang ba'i dbang po 'du bral med/ /dngos po gnyis la bde longs spyod/ /de nyid cha re brjod pa ni/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kun/ /dus gsum chos kun cig pa yi/ /rgyal ba nyid phyir sna tshogs chos/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ /de nyid dharma ka yar gnas/ /thams cad rang rig mngon sum snang / /zhen mtha' kun bral kun chub pa'i/ /rang 'byung ye shes tshon ④po nyid—/ /kun gzhi 'dul snang phyir sku mchog /'dod khams mtha' nas rdzogs 43—1035

kyi bar/ /sdug bsngal kun dang 'dod bsams snyoms/ /'gog zhi stang snyoms bde chen sogs/ /yul med kun rol longs spyod che/ /rta bdun ri bong can nyid kyi/ /gzhal yas khang las ma g.yos bzhin/ /kun tu tha dad snang ba ltar/ /'gro 'ong med 'dul kun sprul mchog /ji ltar mkha' la 'jig med ltar/ /mi rtog kun dngos rtag chen po/ /rdo rje sku mchog skye 'jig med/ /lnga pa nyid du bsgrags/ /so sor 'dul ba ye shes 'khor/ /rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang shes bya'i/ /sgrib pa mtha' spong sems dpa' che/ /rgyal po lnga sogs rgyud sbyangs dang / /mos spyod dang po'am dbang sgyur rigs/ /rdo rje tshogs mthong phyir ming 'grub/ /de la de'i dgongs bshad pa/ /brjod dang brjod 'drar phyir nges pa/ /yi ge med par 'byal ba bzhi/ /yi ge drug cu drug gsum brgyas/ /'byal ba lnga nyid tshul go ba/ /so so nyid dang gsang bdag gis/ /snyan cha lngar ①ldan phyir thos pa/ /gsang ba'i rgyud bshad thos zhes gsungs/ /rang bzhin 'brel dang dbang dang bas/ /dang ba'i chu la nyi zla bzhin/ /ma skyes don gyis gsung mchog gis/ /smra brjod med par snang bar mdzad/ /rig pa'i ye shes ming lnga pas/ /de bzhin 'brel pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /rang bzhin gsang ba'i rgyud rnams kun/ /nyi ma lta bur gsal bar snang / /me long lta bur chos brgyad kyis/ /mtshon pa'i dbang phyug sku mthong bas/ /byang chub sems dang sems dpa' che/ /rgyud la rdo rje'i don snang byed/ /grol thar lam dang 'khor ba'i sgra/ /drug gi rtsa ba yan lag tshul/ /tshangs pa'i ngag ltar las can la/ /snang ba sha'i rna bas thos/ /ji ltar go dang 'dul snang ba'i/ /gsung rnams ngos la sgras rkyen ②pa'i/ /sgra ltar grag ga43—1036

stong dbyer med pa'i/ /mthong thos byed pa'ang de nyid mthu'o/ /dngos po gnyis chos yan lag bcas/ /sems can phyir na stong chen po'i/ /ye shes zung du bral ba'i/ /bde ba chen po mchog gi thugs/ /nam mkha' lta bur sems gsal stong / /chos spyir rang mtshan dbyer med kun/ /yul med me long ltar gsal ba/ /mngon sum ①kun gyi mchog yin te/ /rnam par mi rtog mchog gi thugs/ /chen po lta bur thams cad la/ /mi 'byed blang dor med mnyam zhing / /mnyam pa chen po mchog gi thugs/ /thugs rje chen pos 'byel ba dang / /nyid kyi dbyings las mi zhan phyir/ /bya byed med pa rnam bzhi yis//'gro ba kun sgrol thugs chen yin/ /chos dang chos can kun bral bas/ /rang spyi dbyer med dus gcig tu/ /mkha' la 'ja' ltar gsal ba ni/ /mi phyed rdo rje thugs mchog go/ /phyogs bcu ma lus mi lus pa/ /rang rgyud med par rig snang ba/ /sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs kyis/ /phyogs bcu ma lus sangs rgyas zhing / /lhun rdzogs rig pa rang snang ba'i/ /gzhal yas khang du gzung dang 'dzin/ /bral ba'i rang rig rten pa dang / /rten can med pa kun gyi gnas/ /ma spangs lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs dkyil 'khor chen po'i rgyan/ /sna tshogs 'od zer phyogs bcur gsal/ /stobs sogs 'bras bu kun rdzogs phyir/ /gdan lnga'i bye brag rang snang ba'o/ /'dul ba'i bye brag tha dad pa/ /zhi dang khro dang mi mos nyams/ /gzhi phyir rnam bzhi rol pa rnams/ /gang la mtshams ⑧par 'dul bar mdzad/ /rnam bzhi'i bye brag tha dad pa/ /re re'ang lnga lnga'i tshul gyis snang / /de rigs bzhi'i cha 'dzin la/ /las kyi rigs la lhun gyis grub/ /rnam pa bzhi yis 43—1037

'dul mdzad pas/ /phyogs kyis 'dul ba'i rigs ma yin/ /de ltar sbyangs mtha' skyes bu pa/ /rigs la cha re 'dzin byed kyang / /cig shos sangs rgyas kun ngo bo/ /nyid du snga phyi drang ba tsam/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas zhes brjod pa'i—/ /tshul ni smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /de nod phyogs tsam brjod bya ba/ /drang don snga phyir sangs rgyas pa/ /don dam cig pu ma yin phyir/ /chu la chu ltar cig pa med/ /cig shos bden pa ma yin pas/ /so so tha dad cha rigs med/ /bden pa gnyis med dbang sgyur ba/ /bdag dang gzhan kyi gnyis med de/ /so sor med phyir der son pa/ /mtha' rnams kun bral kun ldan par/ /rang gnas zhen bral mngon bral ba/ /ming brjod 'di 'drar gnas smra dka'/ /ngo bo gcig la rgyud 'dres min/ /shing gi me dpung ltar brjod pa/ /drang ba tsam ste de nyid min/ /chu la chu ltar 'dod pa'ang de'o/ /bden pa'i tshul gyis skyon brjod pa/ /dag pa'i ye shes gnas yin par/ /tan tra nyid las grags pa dang / /bder gshegs mi gnas mnyam pa'i/ /ngang du byon gsung brjod pa'ang / /mnyam pa gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ /nges par rgyud 'dres ma 'dres pa'i/ /tha snyad bral ba'i tshul du gnas/ /thun mong min pa'i rgyal ming drang / /bde gshegs de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /bcom ldan 'das dang sangs rgyas dang / /dgyes chen mchod sogs mtha' yas kyang //lus gsum grangs ming khyad par tsam/ /mdo ①ru brjod pa chub par gyis/ /lnga dang lnga lngar lhun grub pa'i/ /rgyal ba gsung rdzogs so so'i/ /grub mtha' sa'i sangs rgyas las/ /grangs rdzogs ngo bo byin brlabs las/ /snang dang don byed che chung gis/ /pags pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gsal/ /de tshul sa gzhi 43—1038

rgyal ba dag /rgyud cig 'dres dang grol smra ba/ /'dir drang tsam yin bshad pa bzhin/ /rgyud kyi khyad par bsam las 'das/ /ming grangs theg chen dman pa las/ /thun mong tshogs kyis bder gshegs shing / /de bzhin nyid du gshegs pa'ang / /dus kyi dbang phyir snga ma bzhin/ /gshegs pa nyid dam gsang ba'ang / /bya ba'i lus kyis shes rab dang / /cho ga'i rnal 'byor grangs rdzogs pas/ /'bras bu lam byas bder gshegs pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin sar de bzhin gshegs/ /yang na bya rgod 'dab logs su/ /dgon phug bye ma 'dab sna ru/ /sa ri dbang skur ji bzhin nam/ /ba ra nā se'i bsil khang du//dam pa'i rigs can dbang bskur nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin thob ji bzhin no/ /thub pa'i dbang po de ji bzhin/ /gshegs pa rgyu dang bya ba dang / /gnyis ka rgyud las grangs bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor gzhung gis don grub nyid/ /na ra dza ra 'gram logs su/ /dka' thub dka' ba spyod pa'i tshe/ /phyogs bcu sprul pa'i longs spyod skus/ /byang chub lnga stabs dbang bskur bas/ /'og min nyid du don grub ste/ /sprul pa'i dka' thub khog pa nas/ /ye shes snang mdzad tshul du gshegs/ /ri rab rtse mor 'khor lor bskor/ /de yang rtog pa'i gzugs sku yin/ /thabs dang shes rab lam nyid kyis/ /'gro 'ong med par bder gshegs te/ /de bzhin lhun grub ngang son pa/ /tshul dang ngo bos khyad par che/ /don grub dka' thub lus can la/ /phyogs bcu rgyal ba sprin bzhin du/ /'dus pa gsang ba'i longs spyod kyis/ /srod dang tho rangs dus nyid du/ /nyi zla gsang ba'i dbang sbyin dbang / /rol pa'i ka ra bstan pa yis—/ /ye shes stan rdzogs dbang thob pas/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs 43—1039

pa'o—/ /de phyir thun mong rnam gsum las/ /byang ba bzhi dang chub pa bzhi/ /bde bar de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad/ /grangs dang ngo bo rtsal gyis 'phags/ /de nas rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das/ /thun mong mchog lugs snga ma bzhin/ /so so lam thabs shes rab kyis/ /rdo rje lta bu bzhi bskyed pas/ /bdud bzhi nges bcom mya ngan bzhi/ /'das shing mtha' bzhi'ang 'das pa dang / /mi mthun gzhung gis sangs rgyas pa/ /lta dpyod ting 'dzin lam rim bzhin/ /grub pa'i mtha' las khyad par ba/ /lta ba'i sgrib pas phye ba yin/ /de nas dgyes pa'i longs spyod kyang / /mdo dang bya ba rnal 'byor gnyis/ /rgyud las ji ltar grags pa bzhin/ /gong gi dgyes chen yid tshod min/ /de phyir dgyes pa rim yod pas/ /sa'i sangs rgyas rims yod phyir/ /ming grangs yon tan cha min te/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par 'phags// //lam gyi rtsol bas ngal ba rnams/ /bred pa bskyed phyir kun tu 'od/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa drug po bkod par bstan/ /mthar thug sa ①gsum cha las brjod—/ / //de phyir skan tsha lta bu ste/ /thabs mkhas 'di yis gzhan pa yi/ /thabs la brten nas mos bcug cing / /bsgyur bas 'dir grub rang thabs kyis//rang sa thob las ngo bo nyid/ /gcig par smra ba mun sprul pa'o// //mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u ste/ dgu pa'o// //'gro ba lam log lam stor ba/ /lnga dang lnga rnams bkri ba'i phyir/ /mi gnyis lam mchog 'di bgyid pa'i/ /ngal ba'i dge rtsa kun grol shog /byang chub zhor byed khe grags gnyer/ /bcud chen 'dzag cing gzhogs ngom can/ /43byed1040

gtsug hūṃrgyal sgeg mo 'jag skyel dang / /nags bya lta bur rkog g.yem sogs/ /tshal bsrung dam la mi gnas dang / /gsang ba'i gzhung la sran mi tshugs/ /gzhung mangs bsgrub la yid ches dka'/ /bla ma spyi bos mi len cing / /zhes pas bskur zhing yongs la bskur/ /snod med rnams dang ma phrad cig // //ri —mang yul khri babs su/ dz+nyā na ku ma ras bsgyur ba/ lam rnam par bkod rtepa/ sangs rgyas gsang ba'i man ngag rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/959 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ bye〈〈pe 〉thasam/ 〈〈pe 〉thamajal/96༷ k+ṣe〈〈pe 〉ra sgod/ — 〈〈pe 〉skaraphra/962 rmye〈〈pe 〉7zhin/963 sna 〈〈pe 〉〉'jugs/964 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉bso/ 2sna〈〈pe 〉sngagashes/966 she 〈〈pe 〉 na/ 2—〈〈pe 〉thacas/967 1〈〈pe 〉〉spyos/ 2 〈〈pe 〉rapa' bo brda/97༷ ma〈〈pe 〉〉rtogs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉phyi/972 ṭ+wā— 〈〈pe 〉thamanyam/ — 〈〈pe 〉masags/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉rgyas kyis/973 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉lta/ /re sgom/978 1〈〈pe 〉thaskur/ 2 〈〈pe 〉lkegs/979 1 〈〈pe 〉〉tsom/98༷ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉thasgom/982 1 〈〈pe 〉bher/ —〈〈pe 〉thada'/ she —〈〈pe 〉rdzal/ —〈〈pe 〉thadon/ 5〈〈pe 〉⑩/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉skrad/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉bsgoms / 983 1〈〈pe 〉d+kudzud/ 3 〈〈pe 〉bon/985 —zhe 〈〈pe 〉ma da/ 2 〈〈pe 〉sngag 〈〈pe 〉〉lngas/986 1 〈〈pe 〉snga nga /43byed1041

2613ra༅/ /sgyu 'phrul man ngag rnam par bkod pa/ 1ga sgyu 'phrul man ngag rnam bkod la sogs sgyu 'phrul gyi skor las tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / mdo'i don bsdus dang skabs 'grel/ rgyan dam pa rim par phye ba ste bcu dgu bzhugs so//4 ༄4/ dpal rdo rje mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo rang gi lha la phyag btsal nas/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud dag las/ /dad can skal ldan don phyir du/ /man ngag rim pa brjod par bya/ /shar phyogs in+d+ra'i lung pa na/ /rgyal bu rdo rje brtsegs pa ru/ /rigs can in+d+ra bo ti ngas/ /gsang ba'i bdag pos mngon bstan pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i bsgrub pa yang / /tshom bu lnga bcu stong dang bcas/ /phyag na rdo rje mngon bsgrubs te/ /spong len brtul zhugs 5spyod pa'i dbang / /dge bar bskul nas sdig pa med/ /de nas sa la sreg par byas/ /de bzhin pañca ya be+e sha /rim par thob pa'i skal ldan bu/ /gdungs brtag rigs nges spyod kyang bstan/ /lhag sems 43—1044
