phyir—/ /dbang po phye ①ba thugs thigs gsungs/ /dang por mtshon pa'i ming gsum ldan/ /nges pa lung ni rgyu 'dra'i phyir// //dngos po gnyis pa'i legs snang ba/ /bden pas 'brel pa gnyis su med//de nyid gnyis med 'jigs bral ba/ /gsal brtan las kyis lha yi ming // //de gnyis bstan pa'i dngos gzhi bas/ /spyi lung nges pa gnyis pa'i mtshan//brtags pa bstan pa'i don bcud de/ /bzhi yis kun la mi snang bas/ /kho na nyid gsum ldan bden pa'i/ /ming gis mtshon las lhag pa'i don/ /tshig rgyas kyis kyang mtshon mi nus/ /de bas gzhon nu'i rtogs pa bzhin/ /yi ge bsdus par don rgyas par/ /brda' 'phrad tha snyad bsdu ma yin/ /gsum pa'i ming la mos pa'i blos/ /so sor 'dod pa shes rab thabs/ /nyi mas mdzes pas rin chen ltar/ /ming gi sgron rnams ②shes rab thabs/ /'bring la snang ba mched pa'i phyir/ /rgyas pa bye brag thigs par shar/ /rang bzhin las kyi snod gyur la/ /bgrod thabs gnyis su yan lag rkyen/ /thog ma bar dang tha ma'i yul/ /lnga dang gnyis dang gnyis bstan no/ /dang po'i yul la rgyu rkyen dang / /bzhi bcu gtad pas rdzogs pa yin/ /thabs dang shes rab rgyu yang ni//snga ma'i stan pa gnas 'khor sdud/ /dus bstan drug nas rin chen sgon/ /gsang ba'i log min gnas kyis phye/ /yi ge bzhi yis shes par 'gyur/ /gsang ba tshad ma gnyis dang 'byel/ /blo gros rgyu la thun mong mchog /bla ma rang sems ye shes che/ /gzhi dang las kyi gnas ston la/ /ye shes mang po shes pa'i bdag /bstan pa'i bcud thugs bsdus dngos po/ /bkra gsal lung la dus bzhi mnyam/ /de de yod de de rtog 'gyur/ /thun mong pa la 43—1100

mtshan nyid gzugs/ /ston pa rang 'byung rdo rje 'dzin/ /rgyal tshab rgyud ni skyes bu gnyis/ /rang bzhin dus gsum chos las med/ /longs spyod chen po kun tu zhal/ /mos pa mtshan grangs rdul snyed la/ /mnyam bzhag longs spyod chos ston pa/ /ming gzhi ldan pa'i skyil krung gnas/ /de yi rten pa rang bzhin bzhi/ /chos dbyings 'og min gsang ba na/ /lhan cig 'dus pa'i rin chen khang / /ma spangs lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /dbyings tshad rtse mo sgo 'bur dang / /'bur 'phang rtse mo rgyan gdan ni/ /bdag nyid dang ni bdag po dang / /longs 'gul sgo dang phyi yi brgyan/ /snang ba dri za gnas bzhi pas/ /khyod khang spyod yul pa yi phyir/ /kun tu phyi rol de la med/ /chos kyi 'khor lo shes rab thabs/ /ma chags res bkang 'bras bu'i gdan/ /ye shes du ma cig bral bas/ /sna tshogs snang la rang bzhin med/ /de nas de la de gus pa/ /rgyal tshab rgyud dang rgyal sras sems/ /'jigs byed thugs rje sprul pa dang / /dad pas 'brel pa brgyad sogs 'dod/ /de ni ston tshul 'bab pa dang / /gyad thabs 'greng bar bzhugs pa'o/ /tshad las 'das pa'i grangs 'dus pa/ /chos dbyings mu mtha' med par khyab/ /nor bu rin chen sku mnga' ba'i/ /gsang bdag de yi bdag po'i phyir/ /tan+t+ra thugs bsnyus mos bzhin du/ /ku ma ra dang spyod tshor snang / /de ni de yi thugs skyes phyir / /de yi don ni des bsdus rigs/ /sgu yis phye ba'i 'khor rnams la/ /so so bstan pa'i dus snang yang / /lhan cig pa la dus cig snang / /gang gis mthong rtogs tshogs tshe na'ang / /dus bzhi mnyam las ma g.yos kyang / /de'ang rang bzhin mnyam pa'i dus/ /rtag pa rgyun tu thugs rjes 'dzom/ /‘(3byed/ /0/

mthar phyin dag pa'i dus la 'byung / /de tshe rang bzhin nges lung snang / /gsung lnga tshul kyis cig las snang / /mtshon byed bstan par de brjod de/ /de dag mtshon pas rang mtshan sgra'o/ /'gro ba gang gang gzugs snang yul/ /rigs mthun dga' byed mi mthun pa/ /sgyur med 'jigs gzugs snang ba ltar//rgyal ba'i gling bzhi'ang de bzhin no/ /de rjes rkyen gyi gleng bslang ba/ /ston pas snang dang 'khor gyis zhus/ /skabs las gleng bslang ston dang 'khor/ /gnang 'dri rkyen du gang gyur pas/ /de des gsungs la ma reg pa/ /nges pa'i tshig 'bru ngo bo'ang de/ /skabs kyis dris phan smos ci dgos/ /dris ①lan brdo bas nges par grubazhu/ /thabs sbyor shes rab gang tshe'ang / /rkyen byed 'byung la ma reg pa/ /'khor dang gzhan kyi don phyi ru/ /rgyu tshogs thugs rjes 'da' bar 'gyur/ /brjod bya rang bzhin gsang ba'i rgyud// //de ji bzhin du rjod byed dag /ston pa rgyud don lam dang tshig /'brel pa rim dang 'chol 'khrugs pa/ /rgyu 'bras thabs dang thabs byung yin/ /gleng gzhi rjes su nges par 'gro/ /tan+t+ra le'u'i grangs bsdus pa/ /me long bcu yis mtshon sbyar ba/ /bcu yi 'dren par shas kyis bsdus/ /bye brag bdag dang gzhan shes 'gyur/ /seng ge mchongs pa'i chos cig ltar/ /rnam grangs tshig lam chos cig tu/ /bya tri mchongs pa de bzhin pa/ /tan+t+ra'i tshig don dums su gcod/ /ka la ping ka chos bzhi pos/ /rnal 'byor can gyis 'phang gcod do/ /rus sbal 'gros kyi chos gnyis pos/ /'bru stong mi bzhag gzer bus gdab/ /dus kyi 'bru tshar chos gsum pos/ /bka' yi tshad gsum skabs sbyar snang / /glag gi gzan gyi chos gnyis ltar/ /don gyis dmigs 43—1102

bzung gags gsal lo/ /sna phrug 'dzag pa'i chos gnyis ltar/ /ldem dgongs bsang ba brgyad kyis sbyor/ /ngang mo 'gros chos rnam gnyis ltar/ /gzhan don dbu zhabs le'u mtshams 'brel/ /me long chos ltar mtshon pa'i dpe//kun la des mtshon thog du dbab/ /ji 'jigs phrug gu rtsal sbyor ltar/ /'bru tshig don gyi go rim bsdebs/ /tshig don mos par bshad pa'i phyir/ /rnam par phye bas ma 'dres gsal/ /thabs dang don la rang bzhin pa/ /tshig gis mtshon byas de snang byed// //ston pa gang gis gang zhig la/ /gtad pa gang ste gtad pa'i phyir/ /rgyal sras sdud mdzad ma 'ongs sogs/ /mi nub stan rtses phyir gtad pa/ /shes byed yul de bsgom bya med1/ /de yi phyir na'ang shes dgongs mod/ /skabs su byung bas 'dir ma yin/ /bar du mos pas lam gzhol sdom/ /thun mong mchog ste tha ma gnyis/ /dngos spyod rjes su gzhol ba dang / /pha rol phyin par shes rab gzhol/ /de de'ang cig gi rim spyor ba/ /rjes su mthun par lung bzhin ston/ /snga yi sngon spyod rjes 'brang ba/ /lam snod skal bas phye ba la / /mtshams bdag gis ni grol byed pa/ /gzhi dang rang bzhin stobs las 'byung / /de las khams kyi spyod pa yis/ /phye bas dang po thor gnas pa//rims dang rdzogs par smin tshul du/ /rim dang cig car snang ba ni/ /gzhi ra tsa gra a mi tsa/ /rang gnas gol ba gyen 'gro ba/ /de la brten pa'i rim pa yi/ /bye brag bskyed pa'i cha yin no/ /phyi ma dbang po gsang ba gnyis/ /nor bu skyes bur ldan gyur pa/ /bcu drug bzhi rdzogs phyag rgya bzhis/ /kha sbyor g.yo ba'i rten gnyis las/ /rten dang mthun pa'i bden mthong ba/ /sgyu73—/ /03

mchod pa gsum dang bden mthong du/ /shes rab gsum gyis mi 'byang ba/ /rang dag sngon du rdzogs phyir thob/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba'ang /gtso dang yan lag rnam bcu'o/ /kun kyis don du gnyer byed pa'ang / /mchog tu bya ba sngon bzhin gnyis/ /cig ni blo mchog skal ldan rnams/ /nges par khong du chud gnas pa/ /gnyis su med par byang chub sems/ /sems bsgom rnam gsum dus gcig rdzogs/ /de las ldog pa brten ①'brel bzhin—/ /lnga yi rim bstan don du gnyer/ /sngon du yan lag dang po sdom—/ /dgos ched thabs dang ngo bo dang / /skyon dang yon tan rim pas ni—/ /dbang po mchog ni rdzogs par bshad/ /gzhan kyis lta mig gsal ba dang / /mchog gis spyan rab mngon bya'i phyir/ /lta ngan go cha sdol byed pas/ /the tshom med pa'i mde thung ces/ /gling bzhi phal la re re bdun/ /lhun po gnas lta'i rim pa bzhin/ /rigs min rang bzhin balhos lta bas/ /phyogs bsgrub mi mthun 'gags pa dag /cha yod dug la mi reg bzhin/ /gang gis shes na mi gnas pa/ /bsam kyis mi khyab ma shes na/ /bsam med rnal 'byor gnyis don med/ /gang gis de ltar chub byas pa/ /stong rtog rnal 'byor rdzogs byang chub/ /gang gis thog mar rten pa'i thabs/ /ting 'dzin bye brag las spyod dang / /yan lag mang po'ang rnam grangs kyi/ /gtan tshigs thun mong yin med pa/ /rgyud las grags pa rkyen byas te/ /ri rgyal lta bur mthong ba ces/ /rgyu rkyen gang gis nges bskyed pa'ang / /the tshom yid gnyis som gnyis pa/ /med la brjod kyis nges thogs med/ /dgag bsgrub med pa'i rgyu las byung // //43—1104

dbang po drug gi char snang yang / /spyan la mchog tu brjod pa ni/ /shes rab yul du dbyer med pas/ /mngon sum rtogs pa rtogs pa'i mchog /rang rig ye shes tshogs gcig ①po/ /shes rab spyan gyis dam pa bas/ /de la phyi nang med pa'i phyir/ /chos nyid rang gi mtshan nyid mthong / /de lta'ang log rtog mi zad pas/ /'khor sgyur rgyal po'i stobs bzhin du/ /rang mtshan mthong yang de lta bas/ /'khor lo sgyur rig khyad par 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i rgyud la khyad par du/ /lta dang lta bya med pa'i phyir/ /ye shes sgon ma sbreng bar nirka/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad mngon/ /de bas spyi la gang zhig zhe na/ /gsang sngags yid yul gang gis snyed/ /rdo rje yid kyi sgra sgrol bas/ /'dus ma byas la dmigs pa dag /nges par 'di'o mnyam lta ba'i/ /rjes la rnal 'byor mi rtog ces/ /phyogs mthun rnal 'byor skyed 'dod pa/ /nges 'jog rtog pa'i gzung 'dzin can/ /kun tu rgyu dang gzhon nu ltar/ /go mchog thob pa'i khyad par ni/ /rigs brgyad mthong ba rtsa ba las/ /lta ba'i khyad par gsungs pa'ang yin/ /rnam grangs dam pa'i sgras gol ba/ /de yi sgra la ji bzhin rtog /de mi mthun pa ldog byed pa/ /dbul po lta ba kho na'o/ /bzhi pa 'di skad lung las 'byung / /thabs la mkhas pa ma zin na/ /lam gyi dge spyad stegs bcas kyang / /mtho ris lha dang mi ru skyes①/ /skye shi med pa'i las mi thob/ /lnga pa'ang 'di skad bstan zhe na/ /dngos grub mchog gi snying po ni/ /dang po don rtogs mtha' mi stong / /chu srin phyag rgya ji bzhin du/ /spyod yul kun tu dpag tshad med/ /de rjes gtso mchog goms byed pa/ /'byung rlung 'dus bral tshul bzhin pa'ang / /rang la yan lag rdzogs pa yis/ /43—1105

gang du 'du shes med gsal ba'ang / /gang dag bcu dang ldan pa ni/ /snga ma las kyang gnas bsgyur ro/ /'pho ba med par bzhis snang bzhin// //de yi yan lag de bzhin pas/ /rgyu las thob par rang gnas pas/ /snang ba kun tu khyab par ni/ /phyi nang med par mthun rdzogs bya/ /de yi stobs las skyes pa ni/ /rten 'brel bzhi pa nas 'byung ba'ang / /cig shos skye ba'ang ji bzhin pa/ /gnyis la gad mos gnyis tshul gyis/ /bzhi pa dgu dang ldan tshul gyis/ /rang gi cha rkyen tshang ba yis/ /de la zhen pa grol 'gyur zhing / /bzhi lnga ldan na ldan tshul kyis/ /gang mi mthun pa'i rgyud 'phel bzhin//de yi gzhi las tshangs ya ma/ /gzugs can spyod par gnas pa ste/ /rgya mtsho gza' dang skar ma'am/ /'byel bzhi rdo rje cho gas sam/ /bslab pa rang gi rkyen tshang bas/ /lung bcu ldan na des spro 'am/ /yang na de nas longs spyod sbyar—/ /lnga pa rnal 'byor 'ba' zhig gis/ /'das tshul gnyis thob sa 'ang yod—/ /de dang mi tshangs longs spyod lnga/ /rang gis bzhi bzhi thabs bzhi dang / /ldan pas grangs tshangs rtags thung na/ /dkyil 'khor mthun sbyor thabs gnyis pos/ /yan lag tshang na zag pa med/ /de min lan grangs gzhan nyid do/ /rgya mtsho rin chen bzhi yi 'od/ /phog pas ji bzhin mthong 'gyur ba/ /'di ni thar lam mi sbyar nas/ /sangs rgyas sa la gdon mi za/ /yan lag gnyis pa 'dir shes ste/ /de dag las su rung byed pa/ /dgos ched rnam grangs dus dang ni/ /skyon dang yon tan sdom gyis rdzogs// //bdag dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir/ /'bri sogs mi dgos goms par ces//gsang rgyud nyid las gsungs pa yi/ /glang po dam rdzas shas spyad dang / /43—1106

'dod yon nyon mongs nyi shu lnga/ /nag pos 'dul ba ji snyed pa/ /thun mong ming ste de ga dkar/ /khyad par lam dang mthun pa'o/ /zhen pa'i lam la de nyid de/ /ji ltar dug la dug nad bzhin/ /bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka laske/ /che dang mkhas pa'i thabs kyis spyod/ /cig shos pa de dmangs rje dang / /bram ze rgyal po lnga rim bzhin/ /shes rab bslab bya mang po kun/ /brtson pa dor bya yod ma yin/ /de la de goms mtshon pa ltar/ /'jug pa gsum la yid tshangs thabs/ /cha mthun gdams ngag bying rgod dang / /'bru sogs rims dang ldog la brten/ /gtsang ma rigs kyi mthun bzhin du/ /mthong goms bzhis mthus spyod yul spyod/ /lnga pa sri zhu rgyal chos ni/ /dang po bzhin du longs spyod lnga/ /shin tu spros spyod blang bar bya/ /lnga par lnga pa gtso bo yin/ /de nas bzhi ni zag bral nas/ /lcags zangs gser dngul go rim bzhin—/ /bdag gzhan yul gyi khyad par 'gyur/ /snga ma rgyud ldan rtsol ba med—/ /rang rang bslab pa gang yin pa/ /skabs su gces pa khyab par yin//lam dang sa yi rims sbyar nas/ /spyod par grags la mchod pa la/ /snga ma go mthar phyis 'jug che/ /des na rang rig spyod yul blang / /khyad par dor ba mthar phyin med/ /glang po rang gar spyad pa ni/ /don du mi 'gyur gzhi dbang bas/ /so so'i rnam smin tshad las 'das/ /de la de yi de yod phyir/ /de des gnyis po mi rtsang thob/ /so so'i thong thob grags pa bzhin/ /bsag bya gnyis 'gyur bri bar 'gyur/ /bya ba'i sdom ni dgos ched dang / /ngo bo rnam grangs nges tshig dang / /bya thabs skabs dang khyad par dang / /skyon yon dgu yis rdzogs pa yin/ /bdag dang gzhan dang gnyi ga dang / /dam 43—1107

chos phyir na rnam lnga'o/ /shing la chu bzhin dang blang ba/ /rab 'bring tha ma nus tshad sbyar/ /gdul bya phyi nang zung bzhi po/ /gdul bya'i mthu tshad rnam bzhi dang / /cig gis kun 'dul mthu la sogs/ /lnga po gang yin ngo bo'o/ /zung du phyi nang bzhi phyir dang / /'phel bya gnyis po 'phel phyir dang / /dgug dbang bzhi po sdud dbang bzhi/ /gdul bya rnam gnyis 'joms phyir dang //snga ma sngon du bstan zin phyir/ /nges tshig nges par 'grub pa yin/ /don kyi dmigs su gzung ba'i phyir/ /rang bzhin lam dang thugs rjes phye/ /bar ma thabs dang shes rab la/ /snga ma gnyis dang phyi ma la/ /shes rab ting 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / /longs spyod lhag pa gzugs brnyan gnyis/ /de la phyi nang gsang bar bshad/ /ngo bo rjes su zhi ba gnyis/ /phyi la nad bgegs dgra zhi ba'o—/ /nang la nyon mongs rtog zhi ba'o/ /rgyas par gnyis po gso dang 'brel—/ /na shi lo thog rtsi zhu sogs/ /tshe dang rigs rgyud longs spyod dang / /bsod nams bzhi po nang 'bras bu/ /dbang ni dgug dang sdud pa gnyis/ /phyi rol da ra'i rnam pa dgug /mi mthun rnam gnyis dbang po sgyur/ /rang sems 'bras lnga bsdu bar bya/ /mngon spyod bskrad dang mnan pa dang / /smyo 'bog byang dang skam pa dang / /rmongs dang gtan par rgyud gzhan la'o/ /rang gi phyi nang dgra bgegs 'joms/ /thabs ni thabs la gsang ba nang / /khams bzhi khams gsum las sbyar ba/ /shes rab phyi dang nang gnyis te/ /phyi rol tshad med gnyis las bzhi/ /lhag pa gzugs brnyan rnam gnyis dang / /mchod rten sgo dang sbyin sreg ste/ /phyi ma la gnas bsgrub po dang / /thab brgyad 'bru ba khung bcas dang / /phyogs dang kha dog dus gnyis dang / /43—1108

phur pa lha dang sems dang yum/ /bsgrub po ling ga me mchod dang / /dkyil 'khor yo byad tshang bar sbyar/ /bya thabs gtso bo sbyin sreg la/ /skabs su dgos pa'i ling ga gdab/ /bro stabs bcas pa'i cha rkyen no/ /de dag rtsa ba'i mchod mnyes so/ /gtan me mchod sbyin sreg ma rims/ /smon lam lhag ma'i las dag go/ /skabs ni dbang dang bsgrub pa dang / /mchod bshags tshe dang dus bab che'o/ /khyad par zag bcas bar chad med/ /mthar phyin lam kyis phye ba'am/ /shes rab dbang po rnam gsum gyis/ /nus mthu byin rlabs yul ngo bo'o/ /thabs dang bzhi dang khyad par ba/ /skas ka'i gdang bu'i ji lta ba'o/ /mi skongs mi 'phyang mi rdzogs dang / /don gnyis mi 'grub de yi skyon—/ /de las ldog pa'i tshul ldan pa/ /yon tan nyid du shes par bya/ /sa bzhi sdom ni ngo bo grangs/ /dgos ched dus dang che ba dang / /yon tan rkang thabs skyon dag gi/ /nges par dmigs su shes par bya/ /gsang sgor zhugs pa thabs dngos kyis/ /sgo gsum rang gi srung bya las/ /rgyal po bka' rtags ji lta bar/ /mi 'dral sdom pa de ngo bo/ /thun mong gzhung gzhan 'gro don du/ /khyad par rtsa ba yan lag de/ /mdo rgyas rab 'bring tha ma'i grangs/ /tan+t+rar gsungs pa bstan par bya/ /theg chen sa la khyad par ba/ /skabs kyi lam mchog mi mthun srung ①/ /skyon yon cha yis ched che ba/ /de dang de yi nges tshig 'grub/ /rang spyi'i gdul bya'i sbyang bsags pa'o/ /bsrung bya'i rim par yod pa'i phyir/ /sa lam gang thob de yi tshe/ /de la de dgos de bsrung ba/ /nyams su blang ba'i dus la bab/ /skabs dang 'byor na phan yon gnyis / /bsrung bya mchog la bskur ba'i phyir// //43—1109

smon pa bla med srung thub na/ /tshul khrims sdom pa thams cad rdzogs/ /bya byed med par nyams pa'ang med/ /ma nor gnas pa'i phan yon ni/ /rnam grangs rjes 'jug spyi rgyud grangs/ /gzungs dang thob pas dbye ba'ang / /bdag dang gzhan dgos grangs rdzogs pa'o/ /de de zhig ral 'byung ba yi/ /dmigs shes gtso bo'i rtsa ba lnga/ /le lo med pas mos stsogs sbyor/ /de la nges par rdzogs gzung thob/ /phyal pa le lo log pa dang / /zlas zhar nyon mongs dbang song dang / /bdud kyis bslus dang rang bzhin ngan/ /brgyad rgyus dka' thub ral pa dang / /dus 'di phyi mar grag zhan gyis/ /spyi dang sgo skyon gnod la gnod/ /bkod pa rgyu las bdun gsungs pa/ /sdom ni ngo bo khyad par grangs/ /dgos pa thabs dang dus nges tshig /yon tan skyon gyis gzhi ru bzhag /gnas skabs bdun du snying po len/ /bkod pa gang rdzogs de ngo bo/ /dang po rang bzhin nyid mthar phyin// //gdul byas zhi dang khro bo de/ /mos pas sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /'phrin las gtso bo phye bas lnga/ /rtsa ba de'ang skabs kyis grags/ /mchod pa dbang dang 'phrin las bsgrub/ /bzhi yang gtso bos grangs rjes mthun/ /kun las 'jug pa bcu bzhi dang / /sum cu rtsa lngar gyur pa yin/ /de yi rjes su drug spyor ba'o/ /bzhi po'i dus su bdag gzhan phyir// //drang dang rten dang 'byel pa dang / /bsgom dang bsgrub rdzogs mchod bsgrub phyir/ /shin tu nan tan blang bar bya/ /sa yi sbyangs ①thabs go rim dang / /de yi cho ga thabs dag ni/ /rang bzhin la sogs bdun dag la/ /gang la yod pa kun yod do/ /thabs dang shes rab las kyi bya/ /dkyil 43—1110

'khor mngon du 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdun gyi gtso snying gang gang la/ /de yi 'khor ldan nges pa'i tshig /lung las grags pas the tshom ①med/ /tha dad cig gis bcings dang bral/ /'phel 'grib phan yon thob 'grub bzhi/ /bye brag so so'i grangs bzhin no/ /de las bzlog pa'i skyon cha ni/ /grangs kyi rjes su nges par 'gro/ /mnyes par byed pa'i sdom tshig ni/ /dgos ched ngo bo grangs skabs dang / /skyon dang yon tan la sogs pas/ /ji lta ba bzhin shes par bya// //bdag gzhan don rtogs mnyes skong ba/ /'di dang phyi mar thob pa dang //yon tan bka' las gsungs pa bzhin/ /che skyon mi 'byung bya phyir ro/ /bya byed bya ba byed 'dus pa/ /dgyes tshim 'gyur ba'i sdom pa nyid/ /'jig rten spyod yul mos bya'i phyir/ /phyag dang phyag rgya glu gar tshig /phyi nang gsang rdzas dgos spyod pa/ /srog dang ldan pas bden gsum tshul/ /mchod pa gsum las spros pa dag /dkyil 'khor gsum gyi gnas dag las/ /dbul phyir dgos ched rjes bzung bas/ /las spyod bsgrub dbang mchod tshe na/ /dus kyis rjes zhugs yon tan dag /spyi dang khyad par dus kyis na/ /'di dang phyi mar gang thob pa/ /bdag gzhan don kyis gnyis su 'gyur/ /de las bzlog dang mi bskong g.yel/ /nyams chad mthu byen bral bar 'gyur/ /thob par bya ba'i sdom tshig ni/ /dgos ched rgyu rkyen ngo bo grangs/ /thabs dang thob tshad dus snod dang / /yon tan skyon dang dkyil 'khor sbyar/ /don 'gyur bzhi las khyad par du/ /bdag gzhan don nus tshogs las bsgrub/ /byang dang chub par 'gyur bas myur/ /de la de yod phyir nod bya/ /lung dang man ngag 43—1111

las 'byung ba/ /rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi yan lag snyan/ /drug la gnas pa'i thob bya de/ /ngo bo nyid ces rnam par bshad/ /rtsa ba rnal ma lnga bco brgyad/ /sgyur ba lnga la sum cu drug /dkyil 'khor las kyi rjes zhugs pa/ /snod rim sbyor ba'i las rdzogs bya/ /sno la til mar ngar rim bzhin/ /nus mthu gzhan la nges par bzhag /lam kyi shes rab sngon 'gro ba/ /thabs la de nyid rim par babe+eb/ /gnyi ga'i sa yi dkyil 'khor gsum/ /dang po drod rnyed mi ldog pa'i—/ /rim pas las rig ye shes kyi/ /rim pas rol pa rgyud nyid las/ /dad brtson gsum dang btul ①zhugs gsum/ /gang la yod pa de yi snod/ /'di dang phyi ma'i phan yon grangs/ /rgyud las gsungs pa de bzhin te/ /de bzlog ⑤rang yan chos nyid dang / /gsang ba ma nyams rtsang 'jigs pa/ /so ma gtang ba'i rdzas spyad ltar/ /'gyur ba gsang ba'i rgyud kun ltos/ /don du gnyer bya thob bya yis// //phye ba gnyis sogs sdom pa'i tshig /dgos ched ngo bo grangs thabs dang //dus dang skyon yon grangs thabs dang / /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub rnams//bdag gzhan thob nas don bzhi phyir/ /gang gis gang thob 'dod pa de/ /yan lag bcu ldan gnyer rdo ba'o/ /mngon shes tshe dang rdzu 'phrul las/ /sku gsung thugs kyi thun mong dag /bsgrub thabs mi mthun grags pa dag /zag med 'bras bu mchog lnga po// //bsgrub pa'i gnas su grags pa dag /sngags dang phyag rgya bstan pa dang //phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ldan nas/ /brtags shing byin gyis brlabs pa der/ /tshogs skyes bsnyen bsgrub drangs dus mtshan/ /so sor phye bas rgyud gsungs 43—1112

bzhin—/ /rnal 'byor stobs goms 'byor pa dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya stan pa dang / /mi spyogs med pa gang yod pa/ /cha rkyen tshang ba dbang bsgyur ①mngon—/ /yal bas mi 'byang mi thob bcu/ /bye brag rgya las gong du chud/ /de las bzlog pa de phyi mar/ /lnga lnga thob pas mngon nyid rdzogs/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i dam tshig ni/ /dgos ched ngo bo grangs thabs dang / /nges tshig gang du dgos pa dag /yon tan skyon dang spyod yul bshad/ /sbyang zhing nye bar bshad pa dang / /thob pa lnga po rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /gnyi ga'i ched du shin tu ces/ /yi ge 'dus pa grub pa bzhis/ /mthu can red pa gang yin pa//bzhi rdzogs nyid las mi 'da' ba/ /gang la snang ba de ngo bo/ /drag sngags gzungs zhes bya ba dang / /rtsa bskyed las bsnyen las rim dang / /mchod pa sngags dang brgya bzhi la/ /chen po'i rang bzhin ting 'dzin dang / /mtshon pa mtshan ma'i phyag rgya dang / /yum dang 'dzin bsam bca' ba'i dam/ /bsam dang bca' dang rang bzhin dang / /'phro 'du las kyi phyag rgya dang / /bde bar rang bzhin bzlas bsam dag /las kyi phye ba grangs mang po/ /skyon bcu le lo dor ba dang / /skyon brgyad pa'i brtson pas sbyar/ /mthu byin ldan zhing don mi 'da'/ /de phyir ming gi sgra 'jug pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dgos pa'i dug lnga dang / /bsnyen bsgrub rnam bzhi tshe na'o/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rab bstan na/ /dngos grub ya mtshan cher 'gyur bas/ /yid la bsams pa thams cad 'grub/ /ral gri so la bzung nyes ltar/ /nan tan med pa gsang sngags pa/ /phung zhing 'bras rnams med par 'gyur/ /gsang ba gsum la mos rims dang / /gang la spyod pa de yul lo/ /mtha' mar rig pa'i drod 43—1113

tshad pa/ /nye bar sbyor ba pa de ni/ /gang gis bsgrub dang ting 'dzin sbyor/ /zag lam sbyor ba tshogs gnyis grangs/ /thabs dang shes rab nying 'dzin grangs tshad gnyis las grags pa dang / /legs sbyangs thob nas zag pa med/ /thigs pa tha ma snga ma'i rgyas/ /thog ma'i sdom tshig mthar phyin pa/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba nyid yin no/ /de phyir bcu yis 'bru sbyar ste/ /rus ①sbal bsnur shugs blang bar bya/ /de yul byas snyed don la 'dud/ /thugs kyi thigs pa las/ gdul bya dag pa'i snang ba'i le'u ste/ gsum pa'o// //rdo rje yan lag bzhi po sdom/ /mtshan nyid tha ma lung bstan pa/ /rigs pa 'dzin dang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /snga ma thob tshul rnam grangs dang / /nges tshig gnas su rnam par bshad/ /lhag ma yod med 'da' tshul gyis/ /'di dang bar mar rnam par sbyor/ /rnam par smin pa bya btsan tshul/ /dbang bsgyur ②phung po 'jig pa med/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag lus snang / /nyi shu rtsa lngar rang snang ba/ /de la de yi rtsol ba can/ /me chu rlung gi rigs gnas bzhin—/ /gang rigs zin pa mi gtong ba/ /dang po byung dang bya ba byed pa dang / /tha mar rgyud 'dzin gsum gyis 'grub/ /de yi bzhugs gnas nges med de/ /sems nyid gnas snang gang yang rung / /bya ba bya ba'i grub pa dang / /'thob tshul ngo bo 'bras bu grangs/ /spyod yul gzigs dang thugs rje sprul/ /mdzad pa ye shes bzhugs tshul sdom/ /bdag gi dbang du 'di skad du/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin po che/ /de dag rdzas yod ma yin te/ /rang sems bsod nams btan pa yin/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul smad kyi chos/ /43—1114

gzhan nas yod 'ongs ma yin te/ /thabs rtsal bstan pa'i shes rab nyid/ /de lta bu'i ngang du 'byung / /gzhan gyi don du 'di skad du/ /bya ba ma lus kun byas nas/ /mthar ni skye med rdo rje'i sku/ /gsungs pa'i srid pa tha ma la//rdo rje 'dzin sku'i rdor gsum las/ /sprul pa drug gi dbang po yis mdzad pa rdzogs nas sangs rgyas tshul/ /gsang ba'i skabs la'ang shes par bya/ /gnyis med sems su mngon byas la/ /bden gnyis dbyer med rdo rje'i sku/ /chu yi zla ba lta bu la/ /rang bzhin kun dang tha mi dad/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las las/ /brgyan gyi 'khor lo rang bzhin gnas/ /thams cad mkhyen yul 'di skad du/ /log par rtog brtags rnam dag cing / /ye shes dbyings las mi zhan phyir/ /thugs rje chen pos 'byel pas na/ /'gro drug dus gnas ma lus snang / /yang na rnam rtog mi mnga' ste/ /sna tshogs kha dog dbyibs su snang / /bde gshegs rang bzhin thams cad phyir/ /sur+ya rtsa tra'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang yang 'gro 'ong ga la yod/ /de yod na ni gzugs brnyan can/ /sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgral ba yis/ /bya byed med pa'i dkyil 'khor sbyong ①/ /dus gsum rig pa'i rdzogs sangs pa'i log rtog tha dad dag pa yang / /ye nas mtha' yas grol ba'i phyir/ /gcig dang mi cig brjod bsam 'das/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rgyud las gsungs dang bgro blo yi/ /rgya mtsho'i chu dang rlabs bzhin no// //mkha' la 'ja' bzhin rgyud don bkra gsal 'dis/ /mi shes nga rgyal snyol zhing nyon mongs dgra rgyal ba/ /dpa' bor mtshon ni rnam lcags shag ti 43—1115

'dra—/ /rgyud kyi don bcud 'khor lo ngang ltar dang blangs pas/ /mi shes dra bar chud rnams gsang ba'i snying por shog /thugs kyi thigs pa las/ bde gshegs kyi snang ba'i le'u ste/ bzhi pa'o// //rgyu 'phrul spyi gcod rdzogs so// //sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'o// //bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa'o/ /dgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa'o/ /rma rin chen mchog gis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1༷93 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉thugs kyi thigs pa bzhugs so//1spyo94 ①〈〈pe 〉zosar+ya/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉sgribs/1༷97 1〈〈pe 〉ra sam/ 1/〈〈pe 〉sngagazhi/1spyo98 lku〈〈pe 〉thaza'/1༷99 ①〈〈pe 〉rasum/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉da/11༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉bye/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉pas/11༷2 ①〈〈pe 〉tsā/ zhu〈〈pe 〉sngaragrub/11 3 ①〈〈pe 〉'an/11༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉zadan/11༷5 ①〈〈pe 〉〉cig ④〈〈pe 〉〉skyes11༷9 ①〈〈pe 〉thasrung /111༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉byeng /43—1116
1111 4)〈〈pe 〉〉tsom/1112 4)〈〈pe 〉〉brtul/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉zlog1113 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉ra/1114 ①〈〈pe 〉〉du/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sgyur/1115 0)〈〈pe 〉〉spyod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2541)43—1117

2615ras /sgyu 'phrul man ngag gsal ba'i sgon me zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rdo rje sems dpal phyag btsal nas/ /rang gi las dang bla ma yi—/ /man ngag thob dang rtogs pa'i/ /nus pa'i shes stabs ci yod pa/ /nang gi ling rtog shes rab mig /mdongs pa'i 'go rnams sgrol bya'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul khog gzhung dbye' ba brtsam/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud dag gi/ /tshig don dgongs shugs bstan pa yang / /yi ge gab pas mi mngon pa/ /bzhi po dngos po lus nyid dang / /don du gnyer ba'i lam nyid dang / /mngon 'gyur 'bras bu lus bzhag pa'o// //bstan chos thog ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /'bru lngar 'dus pa'i thabs chen po//'gro ba kun la gnas pa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin rgyud kyi ngo bo las/ /'gro ba rnams kyang rgyud nyid de/ /gzhi phyir rgyu ru bstan pa yin/ /de yang ngo bo nges tshig dang / /rnam par dbye ba gsum du 'gyur/ /thams cad rang rig byang 43—1118

chub sems/ /gsung lnga la sogs lhun grub pa/ /mtha' rnams kun las yongs grol te/ /ngo bo bzung du med pa ni/ /nam mkha'i chu skyes ji bzhin de//lung gi tshad mar gyur pa ni/ /rgyu bzhi zhes su bstan pa'o// //thams cad rdzogs pa'i nges lung ni/ /rgyud gsum tshang dang nges 'brel pas/ /rang bzhin rgyud kyi ming du grags/ /mtshon byed rgyud kyang de bzhin no// //rigs dang rigs su nges pa'i sa/ /dbye' ba rnam pa gnyis su gsungs//sems can skad cig shes pa nyid/ /bde gshegs 'bras bu snying po'i rgyud/ /ye nas yin phyir rigs rgyud de/ /chos nyid rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro rnams kun la khyab phyir ro/ /g.yo ldang rton 'jug gnas mthar phyin/ /nges skyes phyir mi ldog pa'i phyir/ /rigs su nges zhes grags pa yang ngo bo'i tshal nas rang bzhin rgyud// //de yi ngang las rgyu rkyen bdun/ /'dzom pas 'khor bar snang ba yang / /byed po nyes pa'i tshul dang yang / /ngo bo snod bcud 'khor ba'i dus/ /ye nas chos kun sangs rgyas ste// //rgyu bzhi rang 'byung ye shes pas/ /rgyu'i ngo bo gdod nas dag /ma rig pa nyid ye shes phyir/ /'khor sgyu ma bcos rang bzhin mnyam/ /'phral du chags sdang ye shes lngar/ /ye nas ma bcos gsal ba ste/ /nyon mongs drang phyir sku gsung thugs/ /yin phyir rkyen yang sangs rgyas so/ /rgyu rkyen 'bras bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /ma byas 'bras bu sangs rgyas te/ /rdo rje phung sogs sangs rgyas pa'o/ /nyi ma'i snying pos mun pa bzhin/ /43—1119

rang bzhin ngang la 'khor ba med/ /lus bzhag par ma lam rkyen de// //lam gyi ngo bo snang lugs dang / /dgos pa nges tshig che ba dang / /gzhung gi rnam drug bstan pa'o/ /mngon byed rkyen mi rnam pa gsum/ /ngo bo sems lnga skyes pa ste/ /mngon sum snang tshul dang ba'i chur/ /nyi zla 'char bzhin skad cig gis/ /byin rlabs rig pa snang ba dang / /skal med rgyud nas thub pas ston/ /ye nas lhun grub sangs rgyas chos/ /gdul bya gnyis la rgyud pa dang / /mngon sum sgo nas bstan pa'i phyir/ /byin gyis brlabs dang tshig gis bstan/ /rgyud gsum tshang dang tshig 'byel pas/ /mtshan byed yi ge'i rgyud ces bya/ /thun mong ma yin nges rgyud phyir/ /gzhan las gsang ba'i che ba brgyad/ /rgya mtshor chu klung ①kun 'bab bzhin/ /theg pa kun 'dus yang rtser bstan/ /gsang ba'i snying po nges pa 'di/ /gsang ba kun gyi bdag nyid phyir/ /rgyud rnams kun kyi rgyal po'o/ /sde snod kun dang rgyud kun gyi/ /'byung gnas bstan la nges 'be+ebs phyir/ /bstan pa 'byung gnas lung gis 'grel—/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /'di las gsang ba'i nges don med/ /dgongs pa'i zhe phugs gnag pa'o// //sa rnams khyad par bkod ②pa yang / /gsang ba'i snying por 'gro bas na//'bras bu rnams kyi thug sa'o/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /brnyes nas sku lnga rdzogs pas na/ /lnga par 'das pa gshegs pa'i tshul/ /'byung dang ma 'ongs thams cad kun/ /'di yis lhun kyis grub byed phyir/ /ma 'ongs rnal 'byor rnams kyi lam/ /de phyir 'bras bu nges 'byung 'di/ /43—1120

thams cad rgyud las shin tu 'phags/ /gzhung gi dbye ba rnam pa gsum/ /rab la mtshan dang 'bring la dbye/ /tha ma 'bru gnyer dgrol ba'o/ /rab mtshan tha snyad gsum du grags/ /rgyu 'phrul snying po lung spyi yi/ /lag gi rtsa bzhin dbul zhabs rtogs/ /bska' ba can kyi ched phyir ro/ /grangs ka 'bring gi don bstan pa//gleng gzhi bsleng dang rgyud don dang / /dgos 'brel bstan pa dpe rnams dang / /skabs kyi dgos pa rdzogs par 'gyur// //gleng gzhi byed pa'i ngo bo dang / /dgos pa byed pa'i don nyid ni/ /thun mong gleng gzhi rnam gnyis dang / /thun mong min pa gsum du shes/ /grags pa thun mong ngo bo ni/ /thub drug ston pa stong gsum pa/ /khyad par shākya thub pa nyid/ /rgyal srid btsun mo 'khor spangs nas/ /rab tu byung sogs mdzad pa yi/ /rgyu yi 'khor lo bstan pa sgrogs/ /'gro drug 'khor dang rnam bzhi sogs/ /shin tu bkod pa'i dus su gsungs/ /khyad par thun mong 'di nyid du/ /ston gnas dus 'khor sdud bstan sogs/ /mtshan nyid gnyis kyis dgrol 'gyur yang / /'dul yang so sor snang 'dra'o/ /thun mong ma yin ston pa nyid/ /yab yum chags skul rol pa dang / /gsang ba phun sum tshogs drug gis/ /yig bzhi'i sgo nas byin rlabs ①kyi/ /dbang skur ma brjod rgyud bshad pa/ /kun yum med pas gsal ba dang / /ngo bo yang ni 'di lta ste/ /ston pa gnas dang sdud pa 'khor/ /dus dang ston pa rnam drug ste/ /ston pa'i rang bzhin brgyad dang ldan/ /bdag nyid byed pa kun tu bzang / /'chad pa'i skyes bu rigs lnga ste/ /mtshungs pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /lngas kyang bstan ②pa gsung mi 'gal/ /gnas kyi rang 43—1121

bzhin de bzhin nyid/ /ngo bo rin chen gzhal yas khang / /ye shes rgyu dang gru bzhi dbyibs/ /rtse mo tshad med mtshan nyid sems/ /phyi dang nang med rgya ma chad / /yon tan rdzogs rgyan rnam thar sgo/ /sna tshogs yon tan rgyan du go/ /rgyu 'bras brgyad nyid rta babs skad// //gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yis/ /thun mong ma yin nges pa'i rgyud/ /dris lan mi mngon don gyis bsdus/ /byin brlabs mi yul grags pa yis /'khor kyi tshad dang mang dang khyab/ /brjod med nam mkha'i mtha' klas gang / /ngo bo mi zhan rigs lnga dang / /rig pa ye shes byang chub sems/ /dad pa nyan pa'i lha chen rnams/ /'gro ba 'dul ba sprul sogs so/ /dus kyi ①ngo bo mnyam nyid do/ /skal ba can la kon pa dus/ /mtshon bya rang bzhin bzhi'i rgyud/ /sgo skur bral bar bstan pa ni/ /mtshon byed sgyu 'phrul dra ba ste/ /mdzub mo'i ri bong can bzhin no/ /dgos pa gleng gzhi ②rnam pa gnyis/ /lhan cig 'khor la go phye ba/ /thun mongs ①ma yin khyad par gyis/ /thun mongs durnam gnyis bcas pa yin/ /'gro ba chags can spong med la/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku btsun mo dang / /gnyis med rol sogs bstan pa dang / /mthun pas mthun pa dgrol phyir ro/ /skye bo chags can spong 'dul la/ /byin rlabs shar ba'i thub pa nyid/ /mi yi skyes pa ⑤bzhes snang nas/ /bcu gnyis la sogs rdzogs mdzad de/ /rnam dag mchod rten rdo rje'i gdan/ /rang 'byung mngon par rdzogs tshul snang // //de bzhin gleng bslang rnam pa gnyis/ /thun mong ma yin rnam pa gnyis/ /yab yum chags sku rol pa dang / /dgyes ltar 'khor la dbang skur dang / /43—1122

rgyud don 'byung phyir bslang ①zhes bya/ /de yang skye bo chags can don/ /thun mong gleng bslang ston 'khor dang / /thams cad snang nas dbang thob 'khor/ /nyid kyis rtogs nas 'gro don du/ /bka' sprul don gyis zhus dang lan/ /snang bar don gyi tshig tu 'byung ④/ /sku gsung thugs kyi spro ba mdzad/ /de ni skye bo phal pa'i don/ /ngo bo don blang tshig phyung ba'o/ /rgyud don lam dang yan lag ste/ /de yi gdul bya bsam pa gnyis/ /dbang gi lam yang gnyis su brjod// //thun mong ma yin rnam gnyis te/ /thung mong lam stegs nyid tsam du/ /pha rol phyin ①bcu rgyu 'bras spyod/ /ma yin pa yang bsam dbang gis/ /grol lam thabs su bstan pa yin/ /grol lam mthong dang sgom gnyis te/ /dag mnyam gsum bzhi bzhi dang lnga/ /bden pa gsum dang rtogs pa bzhi/ /ldan pas rang rig mngon sum du/ /nges par chod pas mthong ba'i lam mtshan nyid dang por bshad pa yin/ /bsgom pa skye dang de bzhin nyid/ /skyed dbang srid pa'i chos lugs su/ /ye nas gnas mthun de zlog phyir/ /dang po ma skyes snying rje dang / /phra rags mang por snang ba ste/ /dngos grub myur du grub 'dod pas/ /shin tu mi dmigs dbyings su bsgom/ /ting 'dzin de ni goms pa dang / /thams cad sgyu ma mig yor dang / /sprul pa'i tshul du shes par bya/ /ji bzhin yang dang yang goms nas/ /phyi nang snod bcud hūṃ du bsdu//gang bsgrub yi ge so so ste/ /phyir ni gang sgom kun tu 'dra/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du bsdu/ /yang na zhal gcig phyag gnyis sam/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rtag tu bsgom/ /de yang phra dang ring ba dang / /goms par re mos 43—1123

'dris par bya/ /de bzhin goms nas rigs lngar bsgom/ /bzhi bcu gnyis dang stong tshogs slob/ /de goms tshe yi rigs 'dzin du/ /sbyar nas mngon par sangs rgyas tshul/ /de yang lnga goms gsal phyir dang / /ral kyis rim pa nges par bzhag /de kho nyid de cig car ba/ /bsgom pa'i rim pa bslab bya bral/ /ma bcos ji bzhin mnyam gzhag na/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung / /mi gnas gnas la gnas par bsgom// //thabs las rgyud dang rim par ni/ /man ngag ting 'dzin stobs 'gyur zhing / /rlung 'gag las la goms par bya/ /shin tu bde ba 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /gsang dbang pad+mar ldan 'gyur na/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /bcu dang gsum gyi rgyu 'bras rnams/ /rdzogs phyir rims dang zlog shes na/ /byin brlabs shugs kyi rang snang 'thob/ /dbang po yul sa ldan gyur nas/ /gsang ba mchog gi 'phrul chen po/ /dkyil 'khor rdul snyed grangs med dang / /phun sum tshogs kyepa'i lhun grub rnams/ /gsang dbang mchog gis 'byin par byed—/ /thabs kyi lam la 'bad par bya/ /'jug dang thob phyir lam rjod ④de/ /skye bo nyid sgrol phyir bzhag ste/ /las su rung nas lam mthar phyin④/ /lam gyi yan lag rkyen bshad pa/ /rjes mthun spyod pa lta ba dbang / /bsgrub dang mchod pa 'phrin las dang / /dkyil 'khor la sogs brgyad kyi rdzogs/ /skabs kyi gtso dang grogs pos bsdu/ /de yang bdag gzhan don du'o/ /rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa yang / /skabs kyis ting 'dzin stobs chen bshad/ /bya ba byed la bye med la/ /dang po dpyod par bshad pa yin/ /snying rjes chud ma zos par 'dzin/ /thabs kyi pha rol phyin spyod pa/ /gnyis pa lam dang mthun 43—1124

pa yin/ /chos spyod bcu yi cig cha la/ /gnas pa gsum pa brjod pa yin/ /gnas dang longs spyod ci bde la/ /ma nyams blo dang ldan pa la/ /ting 'dzin langs te spyod pa ni/ /grangs kyi bzhi pa spros bcas pa'o/ /kun kyang dus ni nam langs tshe/ /sgo gsum phyir na nges tshig 'grub/ /bshad pa'i gtan tshig ldan pa yis/ /lta dang lta bar bya med pa/ /lhun grub shes rab sgron ma nyid / /rang bzhin gsal ba spyan kyi mchog /ngo bo yang de ltar nyid du shes//yul med gsal phyir lta zhes spyad/ /rim par bgrod phyir dbang bshad pa/ /ngo bo nus phan gsal dbang shes/ /shin tu bstan pa'i ngo bo lnga'o/ /dgos pa'i skabs kyis skabs phyed dang / /bshad pa bzhin du shes par gyis/ /ngo bo bzhin du grangs 'jug pa/ /dbang lnga rdzogs bus bco brgyad rgyas/ /dus ni rnam pa gsum du ste/ /phyi nang dkyil 'khor rnam gsum du/ /rim par bsgur ba dang po ru/ /ri mo bzhengs gsol phan nus bskur/ /skyed 1pa'i rim pa slob pa'i dus/ /rdzogs rims gdam ngag spyor dus su/ /gsang dbang bsgur ba sor bzhi pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor bstan pa shes bstan phyir/ /ngo bo'i dus kyang lngar 'gyur ste/ /rno la ngar btags nus pa bzhin/ /nus pa skyes dang thob pa'i tshad// //rgyu rkyen rgyu dang bdag po dang / /yul dang de ma thog pa dang / /ngo bo kun la skabs su sbyar/ /dad dang brtson 'grus gsum ldan dang / /brtul zhugs sum ldan slob ma la/ rgyu cig la 'am tha dad la/ /gang ldan chud ma zos pa sbyin/ /bsgur bas rkyen gnas las nyon mongs/ /shes sgrib che phra rnam dag pa/ /yon tan snang phyir ming du brjod/ /slob dpon mnyes par ma byas 43—/ /25

shing / /dbang rnams thob par ma byas na/ /las rtsom 'bras med thong bas rtsom—/ /gang yang phan pas dbang skur ba'i/ /dus 'di phyin chad rgyal ba'i sras—/ /phyir mi ldog phyir yon tan no/ /lha mi yon tan yan chad nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs skyabs kyi thob/ / bsgrub pa ⑨'jig rten pa dang 'das/ /'jig rten pa yang 'di lta ste/ /ro langs tshe pra bsgrub pa dang / /lha chen po dang rgyal po bzhi/ /gdug pa klu 'dul rgyal blon bzhin/ /chung ma dbang du bya ba gnyis/ /ro langs rkang mgyogs dam tshig bsgrub/ /mi snang gzugs bsgrub lha klu mo/ /rgyal blon dmag dpon zhang blon bsgrub/ /tshe 'di'i ched phyir 'jig rten pa'o/ /yi ge sgyu 'phrul tshogs bsgrub pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dang sman bsgrub dang / /rigs lnga bsgrub dang yul lnga sems/ /byin dbang bsgrub pa rnam gnyis sogs/ /phyag rgya rdzas dang thabs spyod la/ /rten pa'i bsgrub pa gsum du bsdu/ /don du gnyer phyir bsgrub mtshan nges/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir mchod pa ni/ /ting 'dzin sbyor sgrol dam rdzas dang / /'dod yon blo dang sems kyi sprin/ /rol mo la sogs dbang bskur dbul/ /gnas su stabs phyir mchod pa ste/ /thun mong khyad par yon tan ldan/ /bdag gzhan don grub 'phrin las ni/ /mchod rten phyag rgya'i sgo dang ni/ /ho bro klu dang dzas kyis bya/ /na so gzhon dang rigs 'phel dang / /skye rgyu med dang zla bral dang / /las bzhi dus su sbyar bar shis/ /las kyi nus mthu cher ldan phyir/ /sngon nas btsal bar rab tu gces/ /zhi la dang la rgyas la dga'/ /dbang la chags dang drag khro sems/ /'di yang las kyi stobs cher 'gyur/ /rgyal ba cig bsgoms kun la sgrub/ /byed kyang skabs kyis lha yang bzhi/ /bsgrub 43—1126

gzhi'i gzung phyir dam tshig ni/ /ngo bo mdo rgyas gsum du shes/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig gsum du mdor bstan pa/ /'bring du rtsa ba bco lnga ste/ /rgyas par su/ma rgya drug cu'o/ /yang na rtsa ba'i rtsa ba dang / /rtsa ba'i yan lag yan lag rtsa//yan lag yan lag bzhi ru bsnyu/ /byed pa'i ngo bo ji bzhin no/ /dgos pa spyi dang khyad par gnyis/ /rtog pa 'dul dang las don grubakyi/ /'dul dang sdom dang dam tshig sogs/ /'dus par gsungs pa che ba'i mchog /dpe yang skabs kyi rnam pa mang / /sa bzhi so mtshams mkhar sogs pa'o/ /nyams skyon spyi dang khyad par gyi/ /gnyis 'gyur rgyud nas gsal bar ston/ /gso thabs rtsa ba yan lag gi/ /skabs dang sbyar te gzhung bzhin bsab/ /yon tan mdor bsnyus spyi ru bstan/ /khyad par rang rang skabs su shes/ /rang bzhin ye nas sangs rgyas pa'o/ /nges tshig skyon yon skabs kyis 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor skabs kyis bdun gsungs te/ /thog mar rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /rang bzhin nyid dang lhun grub ni/ /'bras bu skabs kyi gsum du 'gyur / /chos nyid rang bzhin spyos bral te/ /rang bzhin nyid kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa lnga nyid/ /khams dang skye mched la gnas pa'i/ /lhun gyis grub par rgyas pas gsungs/ /'bras bu mthar phyin 'og min na/ /bzhugs pa dkyil dang 'khor gyi tshul/ /de yang zhi khro rnam gnyis te/ /nges par sku gsung thugs su 'gyur/ /ngo bo du ma shes bral ba'i/ /nges tshig skabs kyis gnyis su 'gyur/ /mos blos len pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor lhag pas gnyis su gsungs/ /rang bzhin de nyid 'dris pa'i phyir//de bzhin ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor gyis/ phyi nang snod bcud ma lus kun/ /43—/ /27

nyid kyi dbyings la thim bya ba/ /chos sku phyag rgya sgom pa nyid/ /rang rig mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil/ /ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor kyi tshul/ /'bras bu mthar phyin bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /lhag pa'i ting 'dzin rnam pa gnyis/ /gdul bya'i don phyir zhi khro dang / /las dang bsod nams bsgrub pa lnga/ /de yang sku gsung thugs gsum ste/ /zhi ba sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /sku yi cha lugs bzhugs tshul dang / /sku mdog brgyan sogs shes par bya/ /thugs kyang phyag rgya bca' ba dang / 'dzin dang bsam pa las sogs pa'o/ /gsung gi rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / /bzlas pa spyan drang me tog dor/ /bstem dang dngos grub gsol ba'i sngags/ /byin rlabs ①dbang skur la sogs sngags/ /de dag ngo bo shes par bya/ /khro bo lhag pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sku gsung thugs bshad de bzhin sbyar/ /lhag pa gsum yang grangs ldan sbyar/ /ting 'dzin rten phyir gzugs brnyan ni/ /gnyis su bye brag shes par bya/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor yang dag ni/ /chen po rags pa thabs su gtogs/ /mtshan 'dzin yul gyi dkyil 'khor ste/ /ye shes snang phyir gzugs brnyan no/ /lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan rnam pa lnga/ /dbang ni phyi nang bsod nams tshogs/ /bsgrub dang 'phrin las dkyil 'khor ro/ /dbang la mdzub gang sor bzhi'o/ /zhi rgyas 'bring rnam gsum ste/ /khru bzhi brgyad dang bcu gnyis dang / /bcu drug tha ma 'bring gi tshad/ /nyi shu'am nyi shu rtsa lnga yi/ /rgyas pa'i tshul du gsungs pa ste / /logs re tshad du gsungs pa'o/ /bsod nams rten ni mchod rten tshogs—/ /tshogs la dpag tshad rgyang grags so/ /bsgrub pa tshe spra la sogs pa'o / /skabs kyis dkyil 'khor gsum pa'o/ /de dag sa chog stegs rtsig dang //43—1128

'go ma g.yeng dang thig sta gon/ /bri dang rgyan dang rab gnas dang / /las kyi gzhung lugs bstan pa'o/ /khro bo skabs kyi de bzhin shes/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi dal brgyad dang / /gzugs brnyan skabs su bshad pa yin/ /zab phyir byang sems dkyil 'khor ni/ /rten dang brten can tha snyad gnyis/ /dbye ba phyi nang mthar thug 'gyur/ /ye shes lnga yi ro ldan pas/ /dkyil 'khor zhes su brjod pa ste/ /ngo bo gsang ba'i khams gsum mo/ /tshogs ni 'byor pa rnam gsum dang / /tshom bu cig gsum lnga pa'o/ /re re 'ang skabs kyis gsum gsum ste/ /dga' ldan lha dang dgyes ldan mi/ /'byor ldan yo byad lnga bsags pa'o/ /mthun dang tshang phyir tshogs su brjod/ /rnam grangs gnas dang longs spyod lha/ /ting 'dzin spyod yul 'bras bu lha/ /bdag gzhan don tshig la sogs kyis/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor yan lag shes/ /mtshan nyid bar ma gnas dus su/ /bsgrub pa'i stobs kyi rkyen du gsungs/ /rgol ba po dag tshar bcad phyir/ /brjod dang 'byel pa dgos yang dgos/ /brjod pa brjod bya rjod byed dang / /rang bzhin rgyud dang ston pa 'am/ /mtshon bya mtshon byed rgyus 1gnyis so/ /'brel pa yang ni 'di lta ste/ /dkyil 'khor gzungs mar 'brel pa dang / /gzungs ma dbang dang 'byel pa ni/ /gsang dbang mchog ni non tu bshad/ /dbang thob bsgrub la des bzhugs pa/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob pa'i mi/ /gdul bya zhing dang 'brel par gsungs/ /yang na rgyud gsum 'brel pa ste/ /mtshon bya mtshon byed rgyu 'bras tshul/ /shes dang yul du 'bras bu'o / /dgos pa'i lam rkyen rnam pa brgyad/ /don du gnyer phyir dgos pa'o/ /dgos pa'i dgos pa 'bras bu nyid/ /dgos pa 43—1129

bsgrub phyir yang dgos so/ /rgyud la ldan phyi rgol ba bzlog /mi nub bstan rgyas yun ring phyir/ /gtad pa'i ngo bo rnam pa gsum/ /sdud pa po dang bud med sogs/ /rnal 'byor mig can la sogs pa'i/ /rtogs dang bsrung dang gdam pa yi/ /tha snyad tsam du gtad ces bya/ /skabs kyi dpe yang rnam pa mang / /rtsod pa che 'phra mi 'thad pa/ /spyod mi 'tshogs pa gleng gzhi'i tshul/ /bden brdzun 'dran pa'i gleng bslang tshal/ /so sor rkang thabs rgyud bshad dpe//de gzhung bcos pa lam kyi tshul/ /tha tshig mi 'da' gtad pa bzhin/ /'dra phyir mtshon pa dpe ru grags/ /shes rab tha ma'i don bstan pa/ /bshad tshul snod dang sbyar ba ste/ /bshad tshul pha dang spyi dbang gnyis/ /pha yis 'bru gnas lan btab pa/ /khog dbub sa gcad bzhi por gsungs/ /spyi ni bzung bzhi gcig gi ste/ /thun mong khyad par slob pa'i sa/ /yon tan so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ /de yi bsam pa mthun phyogs su/ /rmad 'byung tshul kyis de bzhin no/ /tha ma don kyi lung bstan pa/ /ngo bo dbye ba rnam pa gnyis/ /lam du rgyu 'bras mthar thug 'bras/ /che la dbang dang phyag rgya che/ /lhun grub rigs 'dzin la sogs pa'o/ /lam dang 'bras bu thun mong brjod/ /mthar thug bskyed du bya ba med/ /'bras bu'i ngo bo sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin ①la sogs pa'o/ /de yang skabs kyis lnga lnga ste/ /mtshan nyid cig dang du ma med/ /log par rtog dang sems cig pas/ /thugs rjes gzigs dang byin rlabs 'byung / /de yang zhi khro la sogs sku/ /tha dad snang la snang ba med/ /bsgrub pa mthar 43—1130

phyin 'bras bu brjod/ /lam dang 'bras bu bcas pa yang / /'phral du byas pas 'byung min ste/ /sems can dus na lhun rdzogs ste/ /rgyas par bdag gis ma bkod de/ /yig mangs 'jigs dang brjod 'das phyir/ /rnam par phye nas ma bstan no/ /rigs pas skabs su sbyar byas shing / /tha snyad ji snyed gsum du bsdu'o/ /'gro mang lhan cig ling rtog gis/ /mdongs pa'i rgyud don ma shes 'dres/ /bdag gi yi ge 'di bskong bas1/ /sems can dmus long mig phye shog /'di rtog 'gro ba gzhan don du/ /bstan pa rgya cher dpel ba yin/ /kun kyang yang dag mig ldan la/ /log lta ma lus tshar gcod shog /sgyu 'phrul man ngag gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //blo no zab dang myur ldan zhing / /rgya che ba dang blo yangs dang / /ral gri rgya mtsho'i ri bo dang / /nam mkha' mkha' klong rdul phran 'dra/ /ngang ring tshul shis rang bzhin bzang / /dad pa snying rje ldan pa ni/ /chu bo dge slong rengs pa 'dra/ /nyi ma 'byor rtsi pha ma bzhin/ /mtshan nyid lnga gnyis byug ldan pas/ /de la log dang ma phrad cig/ sbi //43—1131

bsdur mchan/1118 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/112༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉rlung / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bgod/1121 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brlabs/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉stan/1122 ①〈〈pe 〉4)sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bzhi/ ①④〈〈pe 〉〉mong / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉skye ba/1123 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brlang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉byung / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉pa/1124 ①〈〈pe 〉toratshogs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉brjod/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉phyir/1125 zhu〈〈pe 〉〉bskyebad/1126 kye〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrubs/1127 ①〈〈pe 〉toragrub/1128 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brlabs/1129 ①〈〈pe 〉〉spyad/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉du'o/113༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉 las/1131 0)〈〈pe 〉stabakod pas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2542)43—1132

༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud mchog las/ /bskal mchog dbang mchog lnga ldan pa'i/ /dam pa'i yul lnga mthong goms mthar/ /byed phyir mtshan nyid gsum brjod bya'o/ /shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor pa'i gzungs/ /'bras bu smin byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /nus mthu can 'gyur bde gshegs rigs/ /yan lag 'byung ba'i bzhi ru bkod//bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor rgyud bshad pa/ /dbang po yul du snang ba kun/ /yul rnams yod pa ma yin ste/ /kun gzhi rnam par shes pa nyid/ /dngos po sna tshogs par snang ba'o/ /dang bo pa yi rtas bzhi ru/ /de bzod 'tshol dang 'phel rims dang / /nges pa gsum dang thog ma'i tshe/ /so so rtogs rgyu gzhung thos pa'i/ /dbang mchog tshig yul byas la brten/ /phyed pas rgyu byas bsams thog tshe/ /gzhung las grags pa'i gtan tshigs lnga/ /sngon 'byung 73—1 /33

rjes sogs las nyid dang / /mi mthun mthun pa'i gtan tshigs ces/ /des na rang spyi mtshan yul la/ /bshes gnyen bdag po rims ①'di zag /dad pas 'dod dang bag chags rgyu/ /shes rab spyan mchog rang rig nyid/ /gdod nas shes rab lnga yis mtshungs/ /gces smos la sogs lhan cig byed/ /de dag sgo nas 'tshol byed pa/ /kun tu rgyu zhing 'dod smon byed/ /de yis gzung 'dzin spyod yul mtha'/ /yod med lung du ma bstan las/ /tshol na skyon gsum 'du mi snyed/ /de dag mi 'dor bral la tshol/ /'on kyang gnyis rdzogs gnyis med don/ /kun yin gang kyang min pa'i phyir/ /phyogs bral phyogs bdag bsam brjod 'das/ /thams cad mkhyen don bco lnga bcod/ /sems chos ye nas dbyer med phyir/ /brgyad drug shes pa shes rab mchog /nges pa nyid du rgyal bas gsungs/ /de tshe g.yo smon 'jug pa'i ngang ngo bos 'byel phyir gzhi nyid nas/ /'dir 'jug nges pa'i don du rung / /la la thun mong lam rnams nas/ /rkyen rgyus 'dir zhugs slob par nges/ /kha cig sems brgyad nas rgyud de/ /skal pa zhing gi rdul snyed nas/ /thun mong mchog lam sbyangs pas 'phrad/ /thun mong sa mthar byas pa'i tshe/ /yang dag sgu gsung thugs bco lngas/ /byin brlabs 'tshal bar mos snang bas/ /'khor lo sa la 'gyur ba'ang nges/ /tha ma'i tshe na gsung lnga yis/ /dngos ston sngon 'byung lam shes bya/ /rjes su 'jug nga/'i shes 'tshol tshe/ /mos pa tha dad dbang gis na/ /bde gshegs sku gsung lnga tshul kyis/ /so sor 'tsham par bstan la dbab/ /bskal pa gsum na sbyangs pa yis/ /zab mo gsang thos bzod thob des/ /chos sku gsung gi tshul bzhin du/ /brjod med don kyis 43—1134

bstan la dbab/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gsung lta bu/ /dgongs dang brda' yis gtan 1la dbab/ /sprul pa'i tshig gis gsung lta bu/ /brjod pa tshig gis rmal bar bya/ /mngon par byang chub gsung de bzhin/ /rig pa brlabs kyis gtan la dbab/ /rdo rje sgu yi gsung lta bur/ /gnyis med mtha' bral don gyis 2dbab/ /la la ngo bo nyid gsung ltar/ /snang srid mthong thos nyid kyis 'bebs/ /gsang ba sku yi gsung lta bu/ /dpyod pa thabs kyis 'be+ebs par 'gyur/ /la la sngon 'byung bstan pa bzhin/ /ji bzhin don dam nges pa'i tshig /rang rkyen mtshan ma'i gtan tshigs dang / /ldem dgongs sbyor ba'i gtan tshigs dang / /bkri dang rgyud pa'i gtan tshigs kyis / /so so'i blo la nges byed byung / /brtag yul yongs su bshig byed cing //de dag las kyi gtan tshigs 'gyur/ /des na gtan tshigs dbang brtsan par/ /gtan tshigs ma gyur gang yang med/ /de las re zhig tshig dbang du/ /dngos po brtan la phebs mi phebs/ /dbab med ston pa'ang de yin te/ /mthong snyed byed phyir dgos yod la/ /so sor rtog pa'i yul du 'gyur/ /'chol tshe dgos phyir de ltar nges/ /de la cig shos thun mong mchog /thun mong grags pa rnam bzhi sogs/ /thun mong min pa rnam pa gnyis/ /tshig don mthun par 'bebs pa dang / /gtan tshigs don tshig mi mthun pas/ /gtan la 'be+ebs par byed pa'o/ /dang po tha snyad gtan la 'bebs/ /de bzhin nyid 'bebs dag mnyam rtogs/ /bden bdag gnyis med la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ci yang ma yin la/ /ci yang yin dang grub ma grub/ /de sogs don 'dod ci yang min/ /phyir yin phyir grub phyir ma grub/ /phyir brjed —bstan 4 3—1 /35

tshigs la sogs pas/ /mi 'dra bltos rgyu ngo bo'i phyir/ /de dag gtan tshigs 'gyur bar nges/ /de yang skabs 'dir de la brten/ /de nges yul dang shes pa dang / /'das 'khor snang ba shig bya ba/ /med na mi 'byung tshul nyid dang //de ma grub pas de ldog dang / /snang ba rang snang thabs chen de/ /snang bzhin ma grub shes rab nyid/ /bar ma sems rtogs rnam par thar/ /lnga bzhi gnyis sogs snga phyi 'phel/ /lam grangs 'phel ba'ang 'dir shes te/ /skabs skabs nyid du the tshom med/ /de mthar bzhi mthar rdeng ldan pas/ /dbyings dang rig pa gnyis med par/ /de bzhin nyid du rdo rjes rig /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang rig nyid/ /dmigs med tshul du der snang ngo / /byang chub sems snang thams cad ni/ /shin tu brtag dka' gting zab pas ma dmigs mi dmigs dmigs su med/ /sems nyid de ni ji lta bur/ /byang chub de ni sems yin no/ /sems dang byang chub dbyer med pas/ /sems can ma lus thams cad dang / /dus gsum chos rnams thams cad dang / /thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sems dang byang chub nyid du 'ub/ /yangs shing rgya che lhun grub ni/ /phyi nang snod bcud ye nas dag /dag rtogs nyid kyang dbyings nyid yin/ /'di ni rdo rje mnyam yin no/ /byang chub sems zhes brjod pa ni/ /gang nas ma 'ongs gar mi 'gro/ /rtog med rang rig kho na tsam//sangs rgyas sems can sems la gnas/ /mnyam pa'i don nyid ji lta bu/ /mnyam nyid rang bzhin gang yang min/ /mnyam dang rtog pa gnyis ka med/ /thams cad lhun kyis grub pa dang / /sgyu ma mig yor tshul shes pa/ /gnyis ka rang rig nyid du 'dus/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /rang bzhin 43—1136

ye nas dag pa yis/ /sus kyang ma byas ngang gis gsal/ /ma chags pad+ma 'dra ba yi/ /ye shes can gyi spyod yul ni/ /kun dang thun mong de ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul de/ /skyes bu blo rtsal rab kyis rtogs/ /thams cad ma lus cig pa'i ngang / /lta dang lta bar byar med pa'i/ /ye shes sgron mar sbreng ba ni/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad mthong / /thams cad ma lus don 'byung ba/ /tshig gis mtshon las gud na med/ /sgra nyid don gyi dngos po med/ /don nyid sgra las gud na med/ /sgra dang tshig tu brjod pa ni/ /yang dag don gyi snying po 'byin/ /ming tshig sgra la ma brten par//blo yi gting du go bar byos/ /dngos grub mchog gi snying po ni/ /dang po don rtogs mtha' mi gtong / /chu srin phyag rgya ji bzhin phyir/ /skye bar grangs 1kyang lhung mi 'gyur/ /tshong dpon lam mtha'i bsam pa bzhin/ /bsgrub pa'i rigs 'di rigs 'dzin bzhi/ /shes rab dang po smos pa gsum/ /bar du rgyu 'tshams 'bras bu gnyis/ /bar tshad med sbyor shes rab rims mtha' gsum kun 'gro mi g.yo dang / /mthar phyin shes rab rims shes dgos/ /bdag nyid mi mthong shes rgyud la 'byongs pa/ /gzhan du 'chongs 2shing rmongs pa'i sems can gyis/ /bstan kyang ma thos mtshon kyang ma mthong bas/ /bdag dang gzhan du 'tshol bas sangs mi rgya/ /ma g.yo bkod pa bsrung bar rol / /mdzad pa gnas stobs rim don gnyer/ /'ching zlos ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor dang / /dam tshig 'phrin las spyod pa dang / /mchod pa dbang dang bsgrub pa dang / /phyag rgya sngags kyis lta ba rnams/ /shes chod bya'i tshig tsam min/ /de bas lam 'di bye brag mthong / /thig le chen po'i rang bzhin 43—1137

la—/ /bsgom pa rnam gsum dus gcig rdzogs/ /de nyid ma bcos mi g.yo'i phyir—/ /de ni de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /de nyid kun gsal ye shes phyir/ /de ni kun tu snang gi ngang / /'bras bu'i chos rnams kun dngos phyir/ /de ni rgyu yi rim par ldan/ /rang rig byang chub dkyil 'khor dang / /thams cad kun la 'khyol bar gnas/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyi gnas/ /gzhal yas khang dang dkyil 'khor dang / /khro tshogs 'du 'phro mang po dang / /sems kyi cho 'phrul chen po yin/ /dam tshig dam tshig zhes bya ba/ /gud na yod pa ma yin te/ /rang gi lta ba dam tshig yin//sdom pa rnam pa bcu gsum dang / /spyi'i dam tshig mtha' yas pas/ /thig le chen po'i ngang du gsal/ /bya ba med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /kun la thogs pa med par spyad/ /bzhi yi las dang cig po 'ang / /thig le chen po'i ngang du gsal—/ /dngos por zhen bcom bdag dbang bsdus/ /bdun rgyas zug ngu gnyis zhi mthong / /spyod pa rnam pa gnyis po yang / /thig le chen po'i ngang nges phyir/ /cig la mi gnas kun la spyod/ /spyod par byed dang spyad par med//mchod pa'i brgyan dang longs spyod kun/ /bya byed gnyis rnams las de yang / /rig pa byang chub sems chen po/ /cho 'phrul chen bo'i ngang du 'dus/ /bdag nyid chen po'i ye shes las/ /dbang lnga ma btsal dus cig rdzogs/ /thob bya thob byed thob byas pa/ /rig phyir gzhan nas thob pa med/ /bsgrub med spangs med chos nyid du/ /'gro med 'ong med de bzhin nyid/ /thams cad gnyis su med pa la/ /bsgrub dang bsgrub pa ga la yod/ /dper na sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ltar/ /don du gnyer ba'ang chud par byas/ /brag ca'i sgra dang chu zla 43—1138

bzhin / /sgra gzugs mtha' dang bral bar rtogs/ /phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid ni/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhir 1gshegs pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga/ /bdag dang dbyer med phyag rgya che/ /phyag rgya bzhi bcu gnyis po la/ /thig le nyid las gzhan pa med/ /sngags zhes rab tu brjod pa 'ang / /don dam kun sdob dbye med pa'i/ /mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi yi ge oṃ/ /de sogs yi ge bzhi bcu gnyis/ /rtag tu mnyam gzhag 2phyag rgya ni/ /dus gsum ting 'dzin phyir sngags yin/ /rnam par dbye ba de dag kun/ /thos bsam rten pa las byung dang / /chags pa g.yas g.yon lam las skyes/ /rgyud pa'i rnal 'byor las skyes pa/ /sa'i cha yis phye ba ni/ /nus pa thob dang ma thob kyis/ /mthong lam gnyis su gyur pa yin / /zag yod zlog pa'ang gnyis yod de/ /mthu yis ngan 'gro ldog mi ldog /sngon gyi shes 'jug brgyad la yod/ /mthar zhes 'jug la ga la yod/ /skabs gnyis mthar phyin rnam pa gnyis/ /yod phyir cig la gsum gsum ldan/ /des na spyi dang bye brag shes/ /gong gi don ltar ma rtogs pa'i/ /blo ngan mnyam par khungs phyung nas/ /ma rtogs le lo snyoms las byas/ /don ma grub par ngan song 'gro/ /sems kyi mnyam pa ma gtogs na/ /tshig gi mnyam pa sangs mi rgya/ /de bas don tshig ldan par byos/ /'on tang the tshom med par 'grub / /bsgrub pa'i rkyen 'jug rnal 'byor spyod/ /rnal 'byor rkyen yang rnam lnga ste/ /skor bdun dngos nyid rang rig pa/ /don dam kun kyi rgyu yin phyir / /lhag pa'i rgyu de dang por bsgom/ /bsam bya bsam par mi bya ste/ /mi bsam par yang mi bsam mo/ /'du shes kun bral ting 'dzin mchog /de 43—/ /39

bas rang sems rtogs byas te/ /le lo g.yeng ba yongs spangs te/ /nga dang bdag med par mnyam bsrung / /mnyam pa'i dam tshig 'bral mi bya/ /yid shes de bzhin nyid mi dmigs/ /ci smos 'tshogs brgyad spyod yul rnams/ /mi rtog gyur pas dus gcig gsal/ /de phyir thams cad mkhyen sgom yin/ /de ltar rgyu la rten pa yis/ /gnyis phyir 'tshams sbyor ting 'dzin bsgom/ /de yang gnyis te phyag rgya dngos/ /phyag rgya shes nas stidus min phyir/ /mi sgom cig shos rang rig la/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs ngang gis med/ /kun tu rang gsal ye shes la/ /gnyis med don kyi gdung ba'i mchog /yongs sgrol las kyi skyabs kyis phul/ /de mthong de la zhen par bya/ /de ltar mthong goms su yod pa/ /gnyis las gsum gyi skyo ba'ang 'byung / /de la bstan par don bsgrub phyir/ /'bras bu'i ting 'dzin rims bzhin bsgom/ /sems nyid yi ge phyag rgya dang / /sku yi ngo bo rang snang phyir/ /'bras bu rgya cig spros bsgoms pa'ang / /sngon rjes cig la goms byas pas/ /rnal 'byor rig pa dbyibs med 'bru/ /kha dog med pa'i kha dog lnga/ /gang rung nyid dam gtsor hūṃ bsgom//de la kha dog med sngo dbyibs/ /med pa'i thug skeyig rang rig shar/ /brtan nas brgya gnyis rim brtan dang / /yongs 'gyur rgya che zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis yan lag tshang byas pas/ /rang bzhin phab mchod bzlas par bya/ /de gom drug la'ang de bzhin no/ /yang na mos pas khros pa bsgom/ /de yang de'i tshul bzhin bya/ /spyod yul drug nyid phyag rgya ldan/ /bstan nas spros pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /zhi khro gang la sngon byas pa'i/ /zhal phyag grangs dang phyag rgya'i grangs/ /gsum dang lnga dang dgu rtsa cig /dgu brgya la sogs zhal phyag 43—1140

dang / /rigs gsum lnga dang bzhi bcu gnyis/ /rigs sam tshom bu'i grangs bzhin bslab/ /goms nas chu la nya ldang tshul/ /skad cig brjod pas 'od du 'bar / /stong gi dkyil 'khor man chad du/ /rang rig gsal shar mthar phyin pa'o/ /stong khri ci smos tshom bu 'ang / /shin tu bstan nas gnas khang dang / /yo byad lnga sogs ldan byas te/ /bsgrub pa dus kyis tshogs la sbyar/ /zla drug bcu gnyis bcu bzhi drug /khams dang brtson 'grus shes rab dang / /ting nge 'dzin 'bring mthar phye bas/ /dus der rnam smin lus de nyid/ /rdo rje lus gyur tshe la sbyor/ /mi ldog sa la nges par phyin/ /shes rab ting 'dzin min pa yi/ /sman sngags la sogs tshe las 'phags/ /ldog bcas bzhi dang sbyor lam du/ /rdo je'i lus su ma grub par/ /rkyen gyi las kyis lus 'jig na//spyod yul gyur tshe rang rang gi/ /rnal 'byor gsal byas stobs chen pos/ /las ngan rgyun bcad 'byel pa yis/ /bde gshegs sngags dang bskol mi 'gyur/ /gnyen bshes dam mthong lam la sbyor/ /mdor na shes 'jug drug la 'ang / /skabs kyis rgyu rkyen 'bras gsum ldan/ /de de de 'ang dgos ched gnyis/ /'jug tshu' gnyis kyis sbyar bar byed/ /spyod pa rgyun gyi tshogs bsags phyir/ /bdag dang sazhan don sgrub bya ba/ /zag zlog mthong lam bslob byed pa'i/ /spyod byed bcu mthar 'byin byed pa'o/ /rnal 'byor dang po bdag phyi ru/ /bya byed mi dmigs tshul spyod pa/ /gnyis pa mtshan med bzhi la rol/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor phyogs la 'bad/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor spros la spyod/ /lnga pa dus kyi 'tshogs la rol/ /gzhan phyir so so'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /don byed ci smos dang po bcu/ /gzhan la ston cing bkre bar byed/ /spyod lnga mos slob cing 43byed1/41

'dzin dngos/ /gnyis kar g.yeng mor grol bar spyod/ /dbang sgyur thabs kyi spyod 'dra yang / /rnal 'byor mthu yis khyad par 'gyur/ /de bzhin las bzhi tshad med bzhi/ /'tsham par dus la spyod pa 'ang / /shes rab ting 'dzin stobs kyis phye/ /bdag gam gzhan phyir spyod lam du/ /rnal 'byor rim bzhin sgo gsum sdam/ /longs spyod rnam drug rnal 'byor rim/ /mthun spyod rang grol gzhan mos gzhug /longs spyod bde ba'i bsod nams nyid/ /zin chags bral ba'i ye shes mod/ /de de'ang sa yi zag dang spyor/ /lam bzhis zag med slob par 'gyur/ /snyan gsan mthong ba'i bsod nams dang / /dbang dang rnal 'byor bsgrub pa dang / /mchod pa'i 'phrin las dkyil 'khor dang / /spyod sogs kun la'ang tshogs gnyis te/ /spyod dang ma chags cha yis dbye—/ /rgyun tshogs gdod mtha' ldan par spyod/ /bdag phyir rnal 'byor grogs spyod pa/ /spyod lam kun tu nyams mi bya/ /de nyid gzhan phyir sems spyod pa/ /don du bya ba rnam gnyis rdzogs/ /de de de yi nus pa can/ /rnam smin tshe yi lus phye nas/ /lhag ma yod med lung bstan pa/ /mthar lam dngos la sbyor bar byed/ /phyag rgya cig bstan 'phos pa 'ang / /khyung dang seng ge ji bzhin no/ /spros tshogs skabs na smos ci dgos/ /yid kyis lha yi gzugs bstan cing / /phyag rgya sku nyid gsal 'gyur ba/ /lhag ma bzhag pa'i bar ma la/ /de men phyag rgya chen por smin/ /las kyi lus snubs rnal 'byor smin—/ /ma rag cha la ming btags pa/ /smin pa'i ye shes lus su 'grub/ /rgya mig rgya sa lta bu'i tshe/ /dgongs spyod 'gyur sa gsum 'drar spyod/ /sngon bzhin tshogs kyi dbang sgyur rigs/ /'dzin sbyor de nyid kyis bsgrubs pa/ /43—1142

gzhan kyi bskal par gnas mod kyang / /bdag phyir bcu drug tshun chad rdzogs/ /de tshe bsam yas lhun 'grub la/ /bsgoms mthong stobs kyi 'jigs dang bral/ /shes 'jug rgyu rkyen stobs kyis skyes/ /mthong nas gnyis med sku rdzogs pa/ /mthar phyin lhag ma'i lus smin te/ /ye shes sku lus nyid du 'grub/ /gzhan phyir smon dang sprul pa'i lus/ /thob nas tshogs chen sa la sbyor/ /kha cig dbang bsgyur 1rigs nyid nas/ /bcu drug rgyun gyis sku lnga rdzogs/ /kha cig phyag rgya chen po nas/ /bla med kun tu bzang por 'gyur/ /rin chen bzhi yi rgya mtsho la/ /zho mar me yi snang byed ltar/ /kha cig rnam gsum bgrod pa'i mthar / /khrun grub rigs las rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /shes rab dbang lnga rnal 'byor bdag /gzhi cig slob pa'i bsam yas pa/ /rnal 'byor bogs las skabs mi 'byor/ /mi ldog mi g.yo mthar phyin pa/ /kun 'gro 'jigs bral yong sdogs dang / /rtsal sdogs mtha' ma'i spyor zhes bya/ /bdag gzhan phyir na'ang spyod pa lnga/ /tshad med la sogs spyod pa rnams/ /mi gos mod kyang sgrib pa gsum/ /gong 'og cha yis dag pa'i phyir/ /de nyid lam la khyad par 'gyur / /yul dang shes pa mtho dman yod/ /de bzhin mngon shes spyod pa yis2 / /cho 'phrul bzhi rnams 'drar thob mod/ /rnam gsum yul dang zhing khams dang / /byen rlabs la sogs khyad par 'gyur/ /bdag phyir yongs su ma chags dang / /shin tu mi g.yo'i rnal 'byor spyong / /shes rab rtsal gyis spyod pa yin/ /sa rnams yongs su 'phar bar byed/ /de yang dang po dang po dang / /skal mnyam gnyis pa'i rigs mchog ste/ /brgyad pa'i sems par skal pa mnyam/ /gsum pa bcu dang skal mnyam mo/ /dgongs spyad rgya mtsho 43—/ / 43

khyad par 'phags/ /lta ba'i sgrib pas phye phyir ro/ /mthong bas ched du cho 'phrul ston/ /rnal 'byor mi g.yo bzhin sprul dang / /brtsal ba med par cho 'phrul mdzad/ /de de de yis phye ba yin/ /de mtha' lhun gyis grub pa de/ /drug pa'i rgyal tshab skyes bu mdzad/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo yang dag skor/ /kun la mthun pa'i gzugs ston cing / /mdzad pa bcu gnyis chos kyang ston/ /so so thar pa'i lam yang ston/ /las rnams thams cad kun byas nas/ /skye shi med pa'i g.yung drung thob/ /des na mthu can rnam gsum po/ /sprul pa longs spyod drug pa la/ /rim par zhal mthong nyan mod kyang / /cig gi ston par byug gyur pas/ /rim pa bzhin du be+er gyur par/ /khyad par che ba de ltar yang / /skabs nas rdzogs sangs rgyas pa 'ang / /rgyu dang dgongs dbang dgongs phye bas/ /khyad par med pa de 'dra yang / /de phyir mnyam par lta ma yin—/ /de ltar rnam gsum gang zhig nas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mngon byas pa'i/ /rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor du/ /ye shes lha mo rol dbang gis—/ /seng ge lta bu'i gsung go bas/ /dngos po rang 'byung ye shes myong / /rdo rje 'dzin pa spyi gzugs can/ /sku gsung thugs mnga' gsung sdogs de/ /byin brlab byin dang bstan pa'i phyir/ /lnga gsung kun gyi bstan pa zad/ /de phyir mun pa rnam gnyis so/ /rnal 'byor ye shes stobs dang ni/ /rim pa thob pa'i stobs bcom pas/ /gsang ba'i ye shes phyogs bral rgyas/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan las/ /ngo mtshar 'bras bu gzhan min te/ /thabs la bstan pa'i shes rab nyid/ /de lta bu'i ngang du 'byung / /spyod yul bral bas ma chags phyir/ /chu skyes spyan kyis sa yang thob/ /phung sogs rang bzhin 43—1144

dkyil 'khor der/ /mngon byas tshogs chen sa zhes brjod/ /de nyid rang 'byung 'od gsal ba/ /sngon byas ye shes bla ma'o/ /kun gzhi ma bcos sngon byas phyir/ /de bzhin nyid du gshegs pa 'ang / /drug 'gro brgyad rgyud tha dad kyang / /rigs rgyud med phyir shin tu cig /khrun grub mtha' bral gcig pu ma 'dres yongs rdzogs pas/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid bsam yas kyang / /rang rig de bzhin nyid du 'dus/ /de nyid thabs chen ma 'dres phyir/ /cig dang du mar bral bar cig /rang sems lhun grub mtha' bral te/ /gdod nas cha shas gnyis med pas/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs snying po de/ /mngon byas 'dra phyir kun yang cig /dus bzhi sems phyir kun bral ba'i/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /de phyir gnas der kun kyang cig /sems nyid gdod nas chos sku tshe/ /de bzhin nyid kyi de nyid ni/ /dpag med sangs rgyas pho brang phyir/ /de na kun bkod der cig gnas/ /'gro ba'i dus na rgyud drug nyid/ /rigs rgyud mtshan dang gzugs ris med/ /de yang de phyir rgyal ba'i rgyud/ /gnas 'gyur cha gzung ga la yod/ /'on te thams cad cig zhe na/ /gnas 'gyur rdzun zhing stong mthar 'gyur/ /dgos pa skye ba kun gzhi sems/ /gdod nas rang 'byung khrun dze+egs kyang / /mtshan nyid mtha' bral bkod med pa'i/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das kun dngos/ /smra bsam bral ba 'di 'drar med/ /ye shes lnga yang rang 'byung gi/ /cha lnga brtags kyi gzhan pa med/ /de phyir cig mthar lcung ba mred / /rgyal ba de nyid rin chen ltar/ /kun gyi spyi gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ /rgyal tshab lnga la ris yod kyi/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas la med/ /rgyal ba (3—/ / /5

kun dang dus gsum chos/ /bdag phyir kun phyi spyi gzugs can/ /cha gnyis yod par gang gis rung / /yod na bdag nyid chen po rdzun/ /nyi zer nyi ma'am shing me bzhin/ /ngo bo cig la ye shes rgyud/ /so so yin na sprul pa 'ang //gdul bya cig la mthu gnas pa/ /sems dpa' che dang khyad med 'gyur/ /spyan drangs byon dang ma byon 'byung / /gzhi don lung rigs kun dang 'gal/ /thugs rjes 'brel pas rigs chad 'gyur/ /de phyir shing me dpung lta bur/ /ye shes ston pas bkri grang phyir/ /rung gi yan lag nges par men/ /de bas sangs rgyas yang sangs rgyas/ /log pas rtogs rtags rnam dag cing / /ye shes dbyings las mi zhan phyir/ /thugs rje chen po 'brel pa yis/ /'go drug dus gnas ma lus gnang / /mtho dman kun kyi gzugs gnang dang / /bla med byang chub sku snang ba/ /me long lta bu'i tshul bzhin du/ /sna tshogs kha dog dbyibs su snang / /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /byang chub snying po'i ngang nyid du/ /mkha' la 'ja' snang ma 'dres cig /de phyir yul med thams cad mkhyen/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen ltar/ /rtog pa med par re ba skong / /nyi zla chu dang gzugs brnyan ltar/ /'gro 'ong med par kun la snang / /sku gsung thugs kyi bye brag rnams/ /ji ltar 'tsham par grol bar byed / /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i sems la son/ /dus gsum kun la snyoms par zhugs/ /'gro ba lam log lam gtor zhing / /dbang po lnga bral bcong rngo snying gis/ /zin phyir lam mchog sman chen 'di/ /bsdus pa mtha' yas rgyal bar shog /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lam bshad pa/ /slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //43—1146

bsdur mchan/1133 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngagazhi'i/1134 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rim/1125 ①〈〈pe 〉〉btan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉gyi/ ①〈〈pe 〉toratshol/ du〈〈pe 〉〉brjod/1137 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bgrangs/ ②〈〈pe 〉skoratshongs/1139 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gzhir/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bzhag ①〈〈pe 〉〉tsom/114༷ 0)〈〈pe 〉g.yos/ 90〈〈pe 〉〉thugs/1143 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgyur/ ②〈〈pe 〉stan/1146 ①〈〈pe 〉stanacong /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2543)43—1147

ra༅/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma skyes lhun grub dmigs med rang rig sna tshogs par snang ba/ /yig sogs dbang sgyur phra mo'i rigs snang thabs bsam lhun grub ni/ /lam bzhis bsgrub bya mngon sum rang rig 'brel pa'i tshul gyis sus mdzad pa/ /mnyam shes mos sbyor mngon byed skyed tshul rim gnyis rang snang tshul phyag 'tshal/ /bsgrub bya gzhan rgyus mi skyed de/ /rang bzhin thabs 'brel mngon byed pa'i/ /thabs chen gsang ba'i rim 'di dag /thams cad rgyud du ma bstan pa/ /bstan pa'i snying po gsal mdzad pa'ang / /lus rnams rim pa yan lag bcas/ /rgyas btab gzu lums ston mdzad de/ /rdo rje'i las gnyis gtad pa dag /gtan tshigs gnyis rjes rigs 'brangs nas/ /rnam gsum dang ba'i las dag gis/ /bla ma snyen byed don phyir 'bye/ /rim 'di gnyer gnyis kyis dbye na/ /lus 43byed1 / /8

kyi rnam pa gsum gnyis ste/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin lngar shes bya/ /rang bzhin rkyen gyis mngon byas pa/ /rgyu la 'bras bu'i ming btags kyang / /gsal zhing gsal bas gsum du 'gyur/ /'di dag mtshan nyid basbu ba ni/ /shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor pa'i gzungs/ /'bras bu smin byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /nus mthu can du gang gyur pa/ /rigs 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /bar ma goms pa'i lus nyid ni/ /srid pa 'byung ba'i rims tshul gyes/ /rang bzhin yan lag bzhi ru 'gyur/ /de dag 'brel pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /phung sogs rang rig dkyil 'khor kyi/ /dkyil 'khor nyid kyi dbyings yin par/ /tshad ma gsum gyi dngos bo yis/ /shes nas bsgrub pa'i gzhi ru bzhag /dag nga/ rnam gsum ma nor zhing / /rang rig rgyal po goms pa yis/ /byang chub mchog 'di rnyed pa'i phyir/ /mtshan nyid gnyis pa'i dang por bzhag /bden gnyis rgyu 'bras tshul dag gis/ /don dam skye 'gag med pa ste/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma cir yang 'gyur/ /mnyam nyid gsang ba dkyil 'khor dbyengs/ /dbyings nyid ye shes thig le'i dang / /de nyid gzugs brnyan sgyu ma'i tshul/ /snang byed nyid nas ma grub pas/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu lnga/ /bden pa gnyis su mi 'gyur phyir/ /ye shes sgyu ma rjes su bstan/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i lus nyid ni/ /rang bzhin cig tu ma nges pas/ /cir yang med la cir yang snang / /rdzu 'phrul mngon par shes tshul gyis/ /cig dang du ma ma nges pas/ /phyi nang snod bcud hūṃ du gyur/ /phra mo'i lus su sems dpas gsungs/ /phung sogs rang bzhin dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /'di la rim pa yod min te/ /shes bya bsnyud 1pa'i tshul dag gis/ /du ma dngos po cig gis snang / /skal ba 43—1149

sman pa'i don phyi ru/ /nges phyir rjes su bzhag pa yin/ /yan lag mtshan nyid 'dir gsungs pa/ /du ma gcig ①bral shes rab kyis/ /zin pa thabs kyis mi 'ching zhing / /nges par tshogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /yo byad lnga sogs ldan par bshad/ /'di dag dgos pa'i don yin no/ /de yi yang sgos bstan par bya/ /ting 'dzin spyod pa 'byel goms dang / /yo byad cig gis thabs chen po/ /ting 'dzin yongs su dgrol ba'i phyir/ /drug sogs mang po'i ro myong yang / /ma lus bdag las gzhan med phyir/ /mi dmigs mkha' dang snyoms pa yis/ /dgyes pa chen por longs spyod pa/ /dbang po yul du sbyor zhes bya/ /'khor ba spangs med sangs rgyas zhing / /rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis 'grub/ /bdud bzhi bcom pa'i dpa' bo ni/ /de las snang phyir der bzhag go/ /'di dag phal gyi yul min phyir/ /gzhan dag rgyud dang 'di nyid du/ /ma gsungs shin tu gab pa yin/ /yun dang rtsod par skal med phyir//ngang gis blo dman sgra goms nyung / /ser sna rang phyogs khengs sems kyis/ /dul bcas gus pa'i bsnyen bkur med/ /rdo rje spun la de bzhin te/ /lam kun blo dang mi 'tsham phyir/ /chung ngus mya ngan 'da' bar sems/ /gang yang phyogs cha chub pa dang / /ston pa gnyis la rgyab phyogs pa/ /gsang ba snying po'i snod min phyir/ /kham par seng ge'i zho mi blug /rmongs dang 'phyar bas gal te byin/ /dus min par ni srog zad nas/ /sregs dang sbrebs par yun rings gnas/ /mgo 'gas snying yang 'tshig par 'gyur/ /khab len gyis ni lcags sdud ltar/ /mi 'dod bzhin du dbang med par/ /bskal par ngan song myong bar 'gyur/ /de bas shin tu gsang bar bya/ /bran mtha' bzhin du 43—1150

gsum gnas shing / /chags gnyis bral ba'i bsnyen 1bkur can/ /shes rab rgya chen blo yangs pa/ /snying rjes sems can mi bslu zhing / /blo brtan ngang tshul bzang la sbyin/ /gser phyis blug pa'i seng ge'i zhos/ /zho ngan thams cad 'thor bar nus/ /de bas lam 'di snod brtag bya/ /dang po yan lag bcas pa'i lus/ /rgyu rkyen byed pa ngo bo dang / /rang bzhin mtha' drug gis rdzogs 'gyur/ /yang dag gshegs dang log pa gnyis/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gnas gyur na/ /de la bcos shing sgyur du med/ /ye nas rang bzhin dbyer mred phyir/ /nyon mongs spangs zhing spyad sgrub med/ /so so'i rang bzhin nges zhe na/ /yang dag lam gyis bcos su med/ /de bas yang dag blo chen gyis/ /thams cad dngos po med par bshad/ /'khor ba sems phyir bdag med pas//de phyir de bzhin gshegs bsam yas/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur na/ /phyin ci log nyid byang chub lam/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin mi dmigs phyir/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang yod ma yin/ /de shes bya phyir sgyu sogs dbye/ /ma rig lhan cig mtshungs pa'i rgyu/ /gti mug ming gi rnam grangs te/ /rang rig nyid la nyams med phyir/ /gnyis med don cig yin par bshad/ /chos dang bdag tu dngos po rnams/ /ngo bo yod sogs brtags pa yi/ /rtog pa sgyu ma'i rlung 'gyur bas/ /phyi nang rten 'brel gnyis 'khor phyir/ /srid pa'i nyes dmigs bdag las byung / /rnam rtog rang gi sems yin phyir/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /byang chub snying po yod par lta/ /rang bzhin ye nas 'od gsal ba'i/ /byang chub snying por thams cad thim/ /de phyir rang bzhin ma skyes pas/ /thams cad ming tsam stong nyid med/ /thams cad ma 43—/ 151

lus stong zhes te/ /sa rdo dran med ma yin pa/ /rtog med rang rig 'od gsal ba / /'di ltar snang ba thams cad kun/ /brdos pa can gyi chos min te/ /shes pa 'ba' zhig kho na'o/ /de phyir brtan g.yo ma lus kun/ /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin bya byed kyang / /snang ba nyid na ngo bo med/ /de nyid chos skur rang gnas pas/ /kun bzang rdo rje sems dpas gsungs/ /nyon mongs las kyis lhan cig byed/ /nyon mongs rang dang spyi bstan pa/ /mtshan nyid ma nor don rtogs na/ /rnam par byang ba'i lam du 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub kyang / /gang na'ang med de de nyid yin/ /sgyu ma rtsal 'dzin thabs su 'gros/ /mtshan rnams mi dmigs shes rab sbyor/ /gnyis med ye shes byang chub sems/ /nyon mongs spyi yi mtshan nyid ni/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /rang mtshan chags sogs snang ba ni/ /rnam rtog nyid na sems nyid de/ /rang bzhin rang rig 'di gsal phyir/ /nyon mongs ye shes spang bsgrub med/ /rtog zhen ngo la sgyu snang ba'ang / /sems nyid rang bzhin ma skyes pas/ /de nyid yi ge sgras mtshon ste/ /snang stong gnyis med chos sku'i rgya / /las rtog mi mthun tha dad phyir/ /rang mtshan rgyu ma lngar snang ba/ /rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /gdul bya so so'i don byed pa/ /cha gnyis ldan pa'i yig tshul gyis/ /gsung gi phyag rgya chen po yin/ /de ltar sgyu nas don lnga dag /rang rig sgyu ma lngas gsal ba/ /sems phyir cig dang du ma med/ /bden pa gnyis kar ①dbyer med phyir/ /de bzhin ting 'dzin dbang bsgyur zhun/ /ye shes lnga ru gsal ba nyid/ /yi ge rdzogs pa'i tshul nyid kyis—/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya chen po yin/ /de ltar don lnga dag pa nyid/ /mya 43—1152

ngan 'das pa'i rang bzhin la/ /thabs dang shes rab ma rtogs pas/ /ma grol khams gsum 'khor ba yin/ /de ltar nges par cis mngon na/ /sngags kyis yongs su zin pa'i dug /kun la gnod pa byed mi nus/ /thabs dang shes rab rtog pa yis/ /dug gsum sdug bsngal gnod mi 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa la/ /nyon mongs thams cad byang chub rgyu/ /lus ngag yid gsum rang bzhin ni/ /snang gtong gnyis med sku gsung rgya/ /chos kun rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /las rnams yongs su dag par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags bla na med pa ni/ /thabs kyis ji ltar zin bzhin 'grub/ /bsam kyis mi khyab nges pa med/ /thabs la mkhas pas ma zin na/ /lam gyi dge spyad rdegs bcas kyang / /mtho ris lha dang mi ru skye/ /skye shi med pa'i sa mi thob/ /thabs mkhas snying rjes zin pa ni/ /mtshams med sems can ma lus kun/ /byang chub snying rjes bsad na yang / /bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob/ /nyon mongs phyin ci log gi las/ /thabs la mkhas pas zin gyur yang / /grol lam thar par mi 'gyur na/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kun gyis/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis bya byed pa/ /sngon dang smad 'tshong ston pa'ang lhung / /byang chub sems dpa' spyod tshul bzang / /phal la med par mi rung yang / /sngags mchog shin tu zab pa yi/ /skye bo kun gyis bya bar nges/ /nges na rang bzhin dag pa yin/ /de dag mngon par bsgrub pa ni/ /ma bcos rgyun gyi skad cig ma/ /de yis ma byas gang yang med/ /dbang po yul du snang ba kun//yul rnams yod pa ma yin te/ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa nyid/ /dngos po sna tshogs par snang ba'o/ /nang dang nang gi phyi rol gyi/ /rnam rtog sna 43—1153

tshogs snang ba yang / /dngos po med dbyings skad cig ma/ /de nyid rnam par dag pa'i lam/ /yang dag gshegs dang log rtog dang / /gzhan yang sprul pa mang po'i tshogs/ /phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad kyi/ /de la bsad cing bzung du med/ kha dog gnas dang dbyibs rigs min/ /de nyid ye shes rang snang phyir/ /sna tshogs snang ba de bzhin lta/ /rang rig nyid las mi zhan phyir/ /snang stong gnyis med byang chub sems/ /skyes bu dam pa mchog 'dod pas/ /de la rtag 'grus gsal bar gyis/ /de yi 'bras bu mthar phyin niske/ /rgyu 'bras med pa'i dus cig ste/ /thams cad ming tsam mtshan nyid de//yi ge 'bru gsum rdzogs par 'gyur/ /mi zad brgyan gyi 'khor los bsdus/ /tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par rol/ /skye 'jig med pa'i dbyings la bzhugs—/ /de dag ngo bo nyid bstan pa/ /sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang / /gnas dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ /mi mthun bde sdug myong bar 'gyur / /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan rnams ni/ /log par rtogs pa tsam nyid las/ /phra zhing zab pa yod ma yin/ /log rtog nyid la'ang nyid spyod de/ /gzhan du g.yo ba ci yang med/ /log rtog rang bzhin rang rig phyir/ /thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sems nyid las ni gzhan na med/ /sems dang byang chub dbyer med pas/ /byang chub lam de ring ba men/ /cig phyir rang rig rkyen 'brel pas/ /rnam par dag pa dbyings nyid tshul/ /nyid la dbang sgyur nyid spyod phyir/ /bdag dang gzhan dang rtog pa'i rgyun/ /rnam dag snod bcud rgyud mi dmigs/ /lnga dpung yan lag thams cad ni/ /'bru lngar 'dus pa'i byang chub sku/ /'bru lnga ma skyes shes rab yum/ /skye mched khams 43—1154

rnams rdo rje'i tshogs/ /rnam shes ye shes dkyil 'khor du/ /dag phyir 'bras bu theg pa'i mchog /nges 'byung kun gyi bsgrub byar gsungs/ /dmigs bya dmigs byed med tshul gyis/ /shin tu gsal ba'i mngon sum pa/ /ngo bo nyid ni dmigs su med/ /de ltar 'khor ba ngo bos dag /de ltar de dag mtha' rtags na/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin ma skyes phyir/ /'khor ba yongs su shes pa na—/ /mya ngan 'das zhes de la bya/ /'jig rten 'di ni ci yod pa'i/ /ming dang tha snyad 'dzin pa dag /so so'i mtshan nyid bshig byas na/ /rang bzhin med de yang dag nyid/ /rang 'byung chen po'i ye shes kyis/ /thams cad sangs rgyas zhing du sbyor/ /ma bcos ma byas ngang gis gsal/ /ye nas 'od gsal sangs rgyas zhing / /phung sogs ma skyes ye shes gsal/ /snang stong gnyis med byang chub sems/ /sku dang ye shes bsam mi khyab/ /gang gis de ltar mngon sum pa/ /mtha' rnams lta las yongs grol ste/ /spyod yul yongs su dag 'gyur ba/ /mtshan nyid dang por shes par bya/ /dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa bsdus pa las/ rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i don rjes su shes pa'i mtshan nyid de/ rim pa dang po'o// //de nas nyams su blang ba'i don/ /mtshan nyid bar ma bshad par bya/ /de nyid gzhi yi dpes mtshon ste/ /rgyu 'bras tshul kyis 'byung ba yi/ /srid pa skye ba'i rim pa ni/ /khams dang las kyi rkyen dag gis/ /sum mdo snying gog lte ba yi/ /'byung bzhi'i las rlung rim 'dus pas/ /don rnams snang ba 'bral 'gyur zhing / /dngas ma'i snying por zhugs pa na/ /gnyis med 'dzin 43—1155
