pa nyams pa yin/ /thams cad 'dzin bral snang ba'i mthus/ /bar ma sgyu ma'i sku thob ste/ /sdos dang bral bas sa sogs min/ /phyis 'byung cha byad yongs bzung bas/ /rdzu 'phrul thogs med las las byung / /dbang po yan lag yongs rdzogs pas/ /dngos po kun la thogs med cing / /'dod ldan snod bcud gsal bar snang / /'od kyis dpag tshad bye ba gsal/ /zhag bdun nyid du gnas par gsungs/ /de nyid rnam shes skad cig ma/ /nyon mongs las rlung 'phangs pa nyid/ /sa bon gnyis dang lhan cig pas/ /ming don gnyis su 'gyur ba yin/ /stong phrag bdun cu gnyis gnyis bcud/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i nus mthu can/ /gsum 'dres tha dad tshul cig pa/ /rang gi las kyis rab bskul ba'i/ /rlung gi 'jug pas 'phel byed des①/ /rtun shing lta bur gyur pa dang / /de la yang ni de bzhin pas/ /yan lag chos rnams rdzogs par byed/ /rlung gis bskul nas sngon gyur pa/ /gang yin de 'drar bdag 'dzin sems/ /nges par snying la gnas pa yin/ /rim gro las kyis lus smin cing / /brda yis ngag kyang grol bar 'gyur/ /de nyid kyis ni rnam shes gsal/ /dngos po kun kyang shes pa nyid/ /yul zla zas nor dbang byed pas—/ /chags gnyis la sogs 'jug par byed/ /rkyen ldan phung po rgyas pa des—/ /rigs la sogs pa rgyas pa des/ /thams cad las la thogs med cing / /gzhan kyi don yang byed par nus/ /kun tu kun nas rtags pa yi/ /'khor ba lhun grub nyid du snang / /rang bzhin dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyang / /thabs dang lhan cig mi gnas pas/ /gzung 'dzin 'ching ba bcings par 'gyur—/ /de nyid tshul gyi 'jug sogs pa/ /rim pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i 43—1156

phyir—/ /lam kyi tshul yang de bzhin shes/ /rim par rjes 'jug don nyid ni//sngon du bya ba'i las byas nas/ /shin tu dbe+en pa'i sa phyogs su/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa'i rjes mthun par/ /de bzhin nyid dang mnyam sbyor zhing / /dam pa'i don gyis bsgom par bya/ /byang chub tshogs su gzung bar gnas/ /mchog du bde ba'i zhi gnas pas/ /mnyam rdzogs chen po mthun sgom zhing / /byang chub sems su brtan par bzung / /bya ba med pas bya med bya/ /mi gnas pa la gnas par bsgom/ /gtan tshigs rgyas par lus bzhag na/ /dgos ched thabs dang mi mthun dang / /bcos nyams rjes su spyod pa yis/ /rim 'di yongs su shes par bya/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /chos rnams ma lus rang bzhin ni/ /ma skyes sems las cir yang snang / /de phyir bden gnyis rgyu 'bras tshul/ /gser las byas pa'i rdzas rnams kun/ /mi las mtshan ma so sor yang / /thams cad gser gyi ngo bor cig /sems nyid rig dang ma rig las/ /'das dang ma 'das cir yang snang / /thams cad rang rig ngo bo'i phyir/ /rang bzhin nyid kyis dag pas na/ /sgyu ma stong sogs rnam grangs dang / /bden gnyis dbyer med ye shes dang / /dkyil 'khor la sogs don rnams kun/ /de nyid rjes su brjod pa yin/ /rang bzhin gtan tshigs sngon song ba/ /gsum sogs gtan tshigs tshig rjes su/ /de rjes nyams blang dgos ched ni/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub pa/ /mi dmigs dbyings nas don 'byin byed/ /ma bcos ji bzhin nga bzha' dang / /thon kyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung / /mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las / /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bsgyur lkunas/ /ye shes sprul pa sna tshogs 43—1157

'grub—/ /spyod yul thams cad maṇ+ḍa la/ /yongs rdzogs sku dang sangs rgyas zhing / /ji ltar 'dod pa smon na 'grub/ /yangs shing rgya che lhun grub ni/ /phyi nang snod bcud ye nas dag /dag rtogs nyid kyang dbyings nyid yin/ /'di ni rdo rje mnyam yin no/ /lhun grub ji ltar 'dod snang ba/ /gnyis sogs mtshan mas bsgribs pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar byis pa shed ma phye/ /bya byed mang pos g.yeng bar gnas/ /bya byed mang po bdag med par/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang sgyur nas/ /mtshan ma mnyam pa'i dbyengs su gnas/ /de dag dang po'i lus zhes bya/ /dngos grub myur du grub 'dod na/ /shin tu phra zhing zab par bsgom/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan rnams ni/ /shin tu mi dmigs dbyengs su bsgom/ /rang bzhin mthong las don med phyir/ /de nyid rjes su mngon byas pas/ /thabs kyi dam par de bshad de/ /yang dag gnyis med byang chub sems/ /snang stong gnyis sogs gang min zhing / /phyogs dang gnas pa yod min pas/ /rjes su 'jug phyir mi bsam zhing / /gang la'ang gnas pa bya ba min/ /gang zhig dmigs nas gsal ba ni/ /bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min/ /yod med la sogs mtha' dbus chos/ /gang yang dang du ma blangs zhing / /sems kyis ①mngon par ma phyogs pa/ /tha snyad tsam du mnyam bzhag go/ /bsam bya dmigs su med pas na/ /bzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang bzhin nyid/ /dmigs med tshul du rang snang ba/ /bsgom pa'i mchog tu 'di gsungs so/ /yid la byed dang bying rgod dang / /myong gzugs 'god dang 'gags 'bras dang / /chags bral re dogs bdag nyid dang / /'chos dang gnas dmigs sdud pa dang / /mngon byed ther zug 43—1158

phyal ba dag /bdag dbang 'du shes mtshan nyid de/ /'du shes stong pa ting 'dzin mchog /stong pa'i 'du shes ma rab sems/ /de phyir rgyu ba rtsing zhib sogs / /g.yos 'khrul dbang gis cir snang yang / /rang bzhin sems nyid yin par shes/ /mtshan nyid gang du'ang mi dmigs na/ /las su bya ba med pa'i phyir/ /tha snyad kun las grol 'gyur te/ /mi rtog ye shes gzhan du min/ /gang zhig bsam zhig dmigs yod na/ /nges par de nyid g.yeng sa yin/ /ci yang yid la mi byed pas/ /gol sar lhung ba ci zhig rtsang / /rang bzhin gnas dmigs med gsungs la/ /zhen blos gnas dang dmigs byed pa/ /gzung 'dzin zhes ni de la brjod/ /mi dmigs bsam pa gang spong ba/ /de nyid rjes mthun ting 'dzin yin/ /ring du byas pa'i rang nyams dag /drag dal chu dang mtsho gting gi/ /sems kyis brtan pa'i nyams bzung la/ /gzugs sgra reg dang rlung la sogs/ /snang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur na/ /gang yang zhen par ma gyur yin/ /lus sgra shin tu g.yeng 'gyur yang / /cig shos 'jug med tshul gyis bstan/ /rang rig shin tu gsal ba yang ngo bo dmigs su med par gsungs/ /de rjes mthun pa'i spyod pa yang las dang spyod pa thams cad la/ /rang bzhin bdag phyir mi dmigs shing / /byas mthong zos pa ci yang med/ /gang yang bya med tshul gyis bya/ /shin tu'ang zhi bar 'gyur ba'i rigs/ /dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las bsdus pa/de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa ste/ gnyis pa'o// //de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /ting 'dzin de ni goms pa dang / /43—1159

thams cad rang sems rnam pa'i phyir/ /thams cad sgyu ma mig yor dang / /sprul pa'i tshul du shes par bya/ /de nyid shin tu goms par bsgom/ /de nyid rgyas pa'i lung bstan pa/ /rang bzhin ngo bo spyod pa lus/ /'jig rten sna tshogs snang ba yang / /rang rig rnam rtog gzugs brnyan phyir/ /sgyu ma'i tshul du thams cad snang / /'phral snang bya ba kun byed kyang / /rtog pa kun gyi tshad mar snang / /'di dag thams cad gzugs brnyan te/ /byas byed snang zhing dngos po med/ /chu zla'i tshul du thams cad gnas/ /thams cad snang la rang bzhin med/ /rjes su dran par byed pas kyang / /thams cad sems kyi rnam pa ni/ /don gyi rtsa ba mchog yin te/ /thams cad dogs med ma chags pa'i/ /rang rig ye shes de bzhin nyid/ /phung sogs sna tshogs thabs snang ba/ /ye shes sgyu mar rang snang phyir/ /snang stong gnyis su ma yin pas/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan par gnas/ /goms blos ci sprod ①mi gos te/ /bsag bya gnyis su nges par 'gyur/ /rang bzhin ye nas de bzhin no/ /sngon goms rang rig snang ba'i chos/ /sdos pa can kyi chos min pas/ /rig pa rang dbang sgyur ba yis/ /khams sogs ji ltar bltas bzhin snang / /rgyu 'bras dbyer med snga phyi med/ /de nyid lam phyir mnyam par sbyor/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas yin te/ /kun kyang skabs las shes par bya/ /de nyid 'du bar 'gyur ba ni/ /gnyis snang bral ba mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /rang dbang 'gyur ba'i thabs nyid kyis/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad zad med 'phro/ /thams cad rang rig sgyu ma nyid/ /dmigs med tshul gyis snang ba yin/ /yan lag gsum pa bshad par bya/ /srid gsum sgyu ma 'dra bar ni/ /thugs rje'i 43—1160

spyan gyis gzigs par 'gyur/ /rjes mthun thugs rjes gsal mdzad kyang / /rang rig nyid las mi zhen phyir/ /mngon par gdung bas non mi 'gyur/ /rtsa ba byang chub sems nyid rtogs/ /thabs kyis pha rol phyin par spyod/ /dmigs med snying rje chud mi gsan/ /ma chags thabs mkhas spyod pa yis/ /don dang mthun pa 'ba' zhig byed/ /mi mthun zhags pas 'khor ba spyod/ /sa pa'i dpyod par de gsungs so// //dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las bsdus pa/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa ste/ gsum pa'o// //thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /sdogs sangs rgyas la phyag btsal nas—/ /phra mo'i ting 'dzin bshad par bya/ /thams cad rang rig sgyu ma'i phyir—/ /phyi nang snod bcud hūṃ du bsdu/ /gang bsgrub yi ge so so ste/ /spyir ni gang bsgoms kun tu 'dra/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'dus/ /yan lag lnga dang rnam shes nyid/ /yi ge hūṃ du shin tu bsdus/ /dri yi mig gis ltar yod pa / /rab tu 'dris nas spyo bar bya/ /phyogs bcu gang nas bslar bsdus bstem—/ /hūṃ nyid mi dmigs dbyings su bstem/ /rnam shes lhums su zhugs par bshad/ /hūṃ nyid a 'am ma dang gnyis/ /shin tu gsal zhing 'tsher ba la /thams cad yi ger gyur byas te/ /bsdu sa nyi zla gang sgril bsgom/ /sa bon gnyis kyi bdag nyid pas/ /rang bzhin hūṃ gi bdag nyid de/ /'dres phyir ming gnyis thob pa yin/ /phyag 'tshal tri las pad+mor snang / /thams cad rang rig snang ba'i phyir/ /byin brlabs 'od zer gzhal yas khang / /dang snyigs 43—1161

tshul gyis nyi zla gnyis/ /skabs 'dir mi 'byed tshul phyir rmos/ /shes rab cig las byung ba hūṃ/ /mthing ga 'tsher la gsal ba yi/ /'od zer phyogs bcu'i hūṃ bsdus pa/ /rlung gi mtshan mar shes par bya/ /mchig gu lta bu rdo rje'i gzugs/ /rjes su mthun pa'i 'phro 'dur ldan/ /de nyid sems dpa' yab yum sku/ /shin tu phra zhing 'dus par bsgom/ /mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad ldan/ /zhal gcig ①phyag gnyis yang na drug /rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri 'bar/ /rin chen pad+ma dril bu 'bar/ /phra ba'i gzhal yas nyi zla ldan//nges par snying la gnas par bya/ /der ni ye shes snying po ste/ /de ltar gnas cig gnas gsum dang / /gnas lnga dag tu sgom par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya dang / /ye shes lngas rgyas gdab par bya/ /de nyid shin tu gnas pa dang / /de bzhin phyag rgya chen po ste/ /gzhal yas phyag mtshan gdan la sogs//phra ba'i tshul de snga ma bzhin/ /mtshon gang ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /rtag tu snying la gnas par bya/ /sen zlum nyi zla gang ba la/ /yungs 'bru 'bar ba'i hūṃ gnas pa'o/ /rang bzhin sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ /ye shes dam tshig la mnyam bstem/ /bdag nyid chen po mchod par bya/ /rtag tu nang gi sbyin sreg gtang / /rang sngags 'phreng ba'i 'khor lo yis/ /shin tu gsal zhing bde la gnas—/ /'gro nyal 'dug sdod spyod lam kun/ /zeg chen sgom las nyams pa med/ /chos spyod rnam dgu rab spangs nas/ /phyogs cig spyod la gang gnas pa/ /rtse cig ting 'dzin nyid du bshad/ /mchod sogs rang gi don du min—/ /yan lag ma nyams sngags bzlas shing / /'dod pa kun la longs spyod bya/ /lus dang ngag sems brtan 'gyur na/ /byang chub rab 'byams 43—1162

thob par 'gyur/ /don ldan ma nyams dag byas shing / /brtson 'grus cher bskyed myur bar 'grub/ /sngags sgom ma nyams phyag rgya gsal/ /cho ga yo byad gtsor ma gsungs/ /lha yi sku rnams gsal sgoms pas/ /bsod nams tshogs chen rdogs par 'gyur/ /de nyid chu zla'i tshul snang bas/ /ye shes tshogs chen sdogs par 'gyur/ /gang gis mthong mos mchod pa yis/ /thun mong sdig las grol bar 'gyur/ /'di ltar bsgoms shing bsgrubs byas na/ /'bras bu mngon du ma gyur yang / /tshe rabs skye ba thams cad du/ /lha mi mtshan rdzogs sdug bsngal sel/ /bde gshegs 'byung dang sgol mi 'gyur/ /thog ma sman par 'jug mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i rigs su nges pa yin/ /dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las bsdus pa/ phra mo'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa ste/ bzhi pa'o// //de nas spros pa'i rnal 'byor bshad/ /de nyid nus mthu ldan pa ni/ /lta spyod 'byel bar bstan pa'i phyir/ /de nyid sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /de nyid thabs dang shes rab ldan/ /longs spyod sprul mchog rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /byang chub mchog tu nyi zla shar/ /de nyid bzhugs gnas yin par gsungs/ /gzugs sogs rang bzhin spros bcas pa/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i 'bru gsum ste/ /yang na 'od zer phyag rgya lnga'o/ /lnga po'i don spros bzhi bcu gnyis/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor bsam yas mchog /khro 'dul sna tshogs de bzhin te/ /ma bcos ngang gseg gnas pa la/ /ye shes lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /yan lag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /de nyid yan lag spros bdag ste/ /cig 43—1 63

la'ang bzhi bcu gnyis su 'phro/ /de ltar gtso mchog ldan byas nas/ /rigs bzhi rgyal mchog ①de bzhin ste/ /bcu gnyis gnyis kyang der shes nas/ /drug gi phyag rgya 'od 'phro 'bar/ /blo yi shes rab che chung gis/ /rim pa bzhin du bsgom par bya/ /phyogs bcu ma lus gzhal yas khang / /nyi zla gza' skar rgyan dang gdan/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor ma lus bsgom/ /nyi zla gza' skar dus cig tu/ /rgya mtsho dngas par 'char ba ltar/ /de ltar rtogs goms rigs mchog des/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /mkha' la 'phyo dang rigs 'dzin gnas/ /chu rgyun bzlog dang rlung mi 'gul/ /ri brag la sogs thogs med 'dzul/ /dug mtshon 'byung bas tshugs mi 'gyur/ /'byung ba lnga la dbang sgyur zhing / /lha srin rnams la dbang byed 'gyur/ /nad sel longs spyod ngan song sbyong / /dgug gtad bcings sgrol gso bsad dang / /yungs 'brur stong gsum dgang bsdu dang / /bdud dang gcan zan la sogs pas/ /tshugs par mi 'gyur bran bzhin 'gyur/ /lus ma spangs par rigs 'dzin sa/ /bsod nams ye shes longs spyod kyis/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen mnyes/ /thugs rjes sprul sku byin rlabs kyis/ /so sor thar pa'i lam yang ston/ /zhi ba phyogs cig shes bya sbyong / /sa bcu mnyam par sbyong byed cing / /bde gshegs 'khor las yang dag byed/ /las rnams ma lus kun byas nas/ /skye shi med pa'i g.yung drung thob/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kun gyis brgyan/ /mthar phyin bya ba med par 'grub/ /de ltar cho ga rdzogs byas shing / /sngags kyi yan lag lnga rdzogs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor 'tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /nges par legs pa'i dgos pa 'grub/ /gsang ba la 43—1164

sogs yo byad lnga/ /dgon pa'i gnas su bsdu byas te/ /rin chen spras pa'i gzhal yas khang / /'khor khang phyi nang ldan par bya/ /bde ba chen po skyed pa'i phyir/ /yo byad rol mo bde ldan dgod/ /yag lag dbang po rnam shes dang / /gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs/ /dkyil 'khor bshad bzhin gsal bar bya/ /gos sogs yo byad bzhi po las/ /sems phyir ma skyes ye shes brtag/chags med tshul kyis rol byas na/ /ngo mtshar 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor mnyes/ /rgyan dang bgo bas lus brgyan nas/ /yan lag dkyil 'khor gsal rdzogs pas//bro gar gru tshig la sogs pa/ /thams cad gzhung bzhin rdzogs par bya/ /bza' dang btung ba'i tshogs rnams kun/ /chags med tshul kyis bstem par bya//bdag mchod kun mnyes thams cad 'grangs/ /kun la phan pa'i sman yin te/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid chen po yis/ /thams cad bza' zhing brgyan par bya'o/ /lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /dbye 'am yang na mi dbye bar/ /bde ba'i gnas su spyad par bya/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen pa/ /bsgrub pa dang ni bsgrub chen pos/ /rtsa gnas pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gnas/ /bdag nyid chen po mchod pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus mnyes/ /srid gsum 'gro ba thams cad la/ /dga' ba chen pos khyab par 'gyur/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor yang / /skad cig gis ni gsal bar byed/ /lam dang sa gsum yongs rdzogs phyir/ /thabs chen theg pa theg pa'i mchog /mchog dang mchog phran la sogs pa/ /chags med thugs rjes dor mi bya/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bro gar 'du 'phro'i phyag rgya yis/ /'dzul lam 43—1165

nam mkhar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /glu tshig sgra yi phyag rgya yis/ /chos kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rgyan dang 'go ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /'bar ba'i rgyal po thub med 'grub/ /bza' dang btung ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /yid bzhin sku dang bdud rtsis grub①/ /a li ka li'i phyag rgya yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje pad+mar ldan pa yis/ /rak+ta byang chub dus cig 'bar—/ /gnyis med zung du 'byel 'gyur na/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor ma lus 'byung / /'go ba'i don rnams lhun gyis 'grub②/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i spyod pa ni/ /thams cad kun la dbyer med spyod/ /bde ba'i ro mchog myong 'gyur te/ /de phyir de la chags pa med/ /spyod bzhin ma chags ye shes yin—/ /bde ba'i mchog nyid bsod nams tshogs/ /de bas lam 'di tshogs su bshad/ /lta spyod ya char ma gyur pas/ /sngags 'chang rnams kyis rtag tu spyad—/ /bla med theg pa'i nang nas ni/ /don dam du ni dbyer med la/ /kun rdzob du ni thams cad la/ /dag dang ma dag gnyis kar 'dzin/ /thabs kyi theg pa chen po ni/ /rnam par byang dang sdug bsngal dag /kun rdzob du yang dbyer med na/ /lta ba mtho dman de tsam mo/ /thabs kyi theg pa chen po ni—/ /bla med theg pa las 'phags pas/ /don dam du ni skor bdun la/ /kun rdzob du ni mnyam rdzogs so/ /de phyir bden gnyis dbye ba med/ /thams cad dag ces bya ba yang / /dngos po gsal dag ma yin te/ /snang spyod nyid na rnam par dag /gdod nas de bzhin goms byed pa/ /lam gzhan rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor yin/ /tshom bu'i grangs ni ma nges ste/ /dang por dam nos bzhin du bya/ /le lo bgyid snyoms med pa yis/ /the tshom med par bsgrub 43—1166

byas na/ /bdag nyid chen po lhun grub pa/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang bsgyur ①rigs kyis dam pa thob/ /de tshe bcu dang drug pa yi/ /brgya brgya dag tu snur zhing gnas/ /lus ma bor bar sangs rgyas sa/ /mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'das/ /sku lnga lhun gyis rdzogs par 'gyur// //dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las bsdus pa/ snang ba rnam par 'byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa ste/ lnga pa'o// //de nas mthar gnas bshad par bya/ /ye shes rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la//rim pa lnga yis mnyam sbyor bas/ /rang 'byung sku ngam lhun kyis grub/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul rmad kyi chos/ /gzhan nas yod 'ongs ma yin te/ /thabs la brten pa'i shes rab nyid/ /de lta bu'i ngang du 'byung / /rang rig nyid la gnas pa ni/ /sus kyang ma byas rang 'byung ste/ /rang 'byung chen po'i ye shes kyis/ /ma lus de bzhin nyid du sbyor/ /sbyor dang sbyor ba gnyis ka med/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du thim/ /nyid la mtshan nyid yod ma yin/ /shes rab dbyings kyi de bzhin nyid/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya rang snang ba/ /tha snyad ma lus ye shes dngos/ /ye shes la ni ye shes rol/ /ma bkag tshul gyis rang snang ba/ /so sor don bzhin ro myong yang / /rang rig nyid las gzhan med phyir—/ /bde ba chen po'i ye shes la/ /bzung ba'i mtshan ma yod ma yin/ /mi rtog tshul gyis longs spyod pa/ /ma chags pad+ma dag gi sku/ /'das dang ma 'das dngos po kun/ /rang rig ye shes byang chub sems/ /snang stong gnyis 43—1167

su ma yin pas/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /rang rig bsam yas phyir yang snang / /gdul bya'i dbang gis brjod mi lang / /byang sems lhun grub rang snang bas/ /'phro 'du'i tshul du bdar bstan no/ /spros bral thugs kyi chos thams cad/ /snyoms par khyab pas rje nyid de/ /'bras bu lhun grub byin ldan pas/ /mtsho yi rlabs tshul kun tu snang / /bsam byas lhun kyis grub pa'i phyir/ /zhing khams rnams dang 'gro kun la/ /rdo rje 'dzin nas rtsi shing tshogs/ /so sor mthun pa'i sku snang yang / /stong nyid dngos dang bya byed med/ /chu zla'i tshul du kun snang yang / /byin rlabs khyab cing 'gro 'ong med—/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lus nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi gzugs ste/ /snang stong gnyis su ma yin zhing / /grangs dang che chung mtha' dbus kyang / /'di la sus kyang dmigs mi nus/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtha' bral ba /'od zer phyag rgya gdan rdzogs pa/ /ldan dang bral bas gnyis ka min/ /zhi khro la sogs sku gnyis tshogs/ /lhun gyis grub pas cir yang snang / /rim pa'am rim pa med tshul ni/ /gdul bya'i bsam pas phye ba yin/ /dus gsum du yang mi 'gyur phyir/ /rtag chen rdo rje'i sku zhes gsungs/ /bden pa gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das/ /dngos kun bdag phyir ming tshig tsam/ /thams cad tshig gi sgra ltar gnas/ /de nyid ma skyes sems yin phyir/ /rang bzhin brjod med don yin kyang / /sgra rnams sems su lhun rdzogs phyir/ /gsung cig tshig tu ma brjod kyang / /thar dang ma thar thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin gsal bar snang / /de phyir brjod nyid brjod pa med/ /gdul bya ma lus thams cad kun/ /de bzhin nyid las mi zhan phyir/ /gang zhig de nyid gyur 43—1168

pa yis/ /dus gsum sdug bsngal ma 'dres pas/ /log rtog rgyun tsam snang ba yang / /rang snang tshul kyis rtog med par/ /sgyu ma'i tshul du gsal bar gsungs—/ /de bas 'das dang ma 'das chos/ /rang rig byang sems ngo bo'i phyir/ /snga phyi cung zad yod min pas/ /mtshan nyid ma 'dres yongs sdogs par/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sngon nas mkhyen/ /so sor snang ba thams cad kyang / /rang rig rgyal por yang dag 'du/ /rang rig de nyid thams cad yin/ /spyod yul rang rig ye shes phyir/ /rang snang ye shes ngo bos stong //mtha' rnams bral ba'i rang rig la/ /ma skyes don snang me long bzhin/ /thams cad bdag tu gyur pa'i phyir/ /tha snyad gnyis ka ngang gis stong / /mtshan nyid bsam yas snang ba yang / /sems phyir so sor dmigs pa med/ /rang bzhin rnam dag ye shes la/ /bya byed dmigs par yod mi 'gyur/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /rtsa ba lnga zhes brjod mod kyang / /brjod pa'i mtshan nyid yod med de/ /mtshan nyid med par so sor snang / /de nyid thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ /mtshan nyid gnyis med dmigs mi 'gyur/ /gnas pa med par kun tu khyab/ /phyogs bcu snang grags bsam yas pa/ /rang rig nyid las mi zhan phyir/ /yon tan rin chen bkod pa dang / /ye shes brgyan gyis sprad ①pa yi/ /zhing gi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi zhing sbyor bas/ /dog yangs tshad kyang dpag tu med/ /sangs rgyas spyi gtsug lta bu'i mtshan/ /ye shes rgyu las grub pa'i phyir/ /'di zhes cig ces brjod du med/ /zag med bsod nams lhun grub pas/ /ji ltar bltas pa de ltar snang / /gdos pa can kyi chos min zhing / /thams cad rang rig 43—1169

dbang bsgyur ①bas/ /stong par bya 'am mi stong bya/ /thams cad dbyer med ngang nyid pas/ /rtog pa med las cir yang snang / /gzhan gyis sprog du med pa yi/ /bo de'i skor ni rin po che/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis/ /bya byed med par rnam bzhi mdzad/ /sgyu ma'i tshul du rol mdzad kyang / /bya ba byed dang dmigs su med/ /'das dang ma 'das bsam yas pa ma lus sems phyir dmigs su med/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /gnas dang ngo bo dbyer med de/ /de nyid rig pa rang snang ba/ /sna tshogs mtshan nyid rnam par rol/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid bsam yas kyang / /rang rig nyid du yang dag 'dus/ /de nyid thabs chen ma 'dres snang / /spyod yul 'phrog med spyod mi lang / /gnyis med thugs rje'i dbang gis na/ /'gro drug dus gnas snyoms par zhugs/ /rang rig nyid las mi zhan phyir/ /dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid du gsungs/ /des sogs mtshan nyid yon tan grags/ /stong gsum cig dang thams cad kyi/ /mgo lus kha lce cig rdzogs pas/ /bskal pa mtha' klas par brjod kyang / /de dag mthar thug yod mi 'gyur/ /mtshan nyid rmongs la mdor bsdus pa/ /bsgrub bya ma lus mngon gyur pas/ /bsam bya bslab pa kun las grol/ /thams cad ma spangs bdag nyid phyir/ /gang yang 'du shes thams cad spangs/ /gnyis med thugs rje chen po yis/ /mdzad pa gang yang 'gog pa med/ /sku gsung phyag rgya cir snang yang / /rang bzhin rdzogs phyir 'gro 'ong med/ /yum sogs bde ba kun ldan yang / /rang gi ngo bo mi dmigs pas/ /mtha' rnams kun las grol ba yin/ /khams gsum bdag nyid chen po'i phyir/ /43—1170

sems can kun gyis sems la son/ /sems sogs zhen mthas ma reg pas/ /cig pu rab tu che ba'i lha/ /de bzhin nyid dang dbyer med phyir/ /'di la spyod yul yod ma yin// //dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las bsdus pa/ /bsam yas lhun gyis ①grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa ste/ drug pa'o// //yongs rdzogs rgya che mtshan nyid rtogs dka' rlabs ldan rang rgyud rgya mtsho yi//mtshan nyid rjes mthun gnyis bral yig gsum gnyis gab sbas te ra chod don/ /snying rjes goms shugs mthong nyams 'brel pa dgos don dang por phreng ba gsal byas pas/ /rjes 'jug la sogs gnyis bcings ma lus de nyid shes grol goms thar shog /rim pa drug pa/ slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa sdogs so// //bsdur mchan/1148 ①mtshan byang 'di chos byed 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/1149 ①〈〈be+e 〉ra da/115༷ ①〈〈pe 〉ra ga1151 ①〈〈pe 〉byedan/1152 ①〈〈pe 〉byedar/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sgyur/1156 ①〈〈pe 〉byed/1157 ①〈〈pe 〉dzodar/1158 ①〈〈pe〉byed/116༷ ①〈〈pe 〉thadad/1162 ①〈〈pe 〉byedag43—1171
1164 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pachogs/1166 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rtse 'grub/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉grub/1167 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgyur/1169 ①〈〈pe 〉〉spras/117༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉ra/1171 6)〈〈pe 〉〉gyi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2544)43—1172

༄ga /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i man ngag rim pa gsum pa/①༄4/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhi lam 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /dris lam dam bca' mthar 'byung ba/ /lung dang man ngag rigs sgo nas/ /rtogs par bya phyir rnam bshad bya/ /dang po rnam pa gnyis bstan te/ /ngo bo'i gzhi dang brtags pa'i gzhi/ /gzhi yi ngo bo mtshan nyid dang / /nges tshig dpe yi rnam pa dang / /snang tshul gnyer gyis rtogs par bya/ /ngo bo thams cad sems nyid de/ /gser gyi dpe bzhin gnyis su med/ /mtshan nyid mtha' rnams kun bral bas/ /ci yang bzung du med pa'o/ /tha snyad gnyis kyi chos rnams kun/ /ma lus 'byung phyir gzhi zhes bya—/ /nam mkha' rgya mtsho rin chen sogs/ /nye ba'i dpe yis mtshon pa'o/ /rgyu rkyen bral ba'i skad cig ma/ /rang snang nyid du byung ba'o/ /lung dang man ngag gnyer dag gis/ /blo gting yid ches gyur par bya/ /43—1173

brtags gzhi gnyis su bstan pa'i chos/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das par gsungs—/ /'khor ba'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo dang / /dpe dang mtshan nyid byed po dang / /'khor tshul nyes pa'i dus rnams su/ /nges par bstan phyir mgon pos bshad/ /'khor ba'i 'byung rgyu rnam pa bzhi/ /rgyud mtshungs lhan cig nyer len pa/ /bder gshegs snying po ma rig dang / /rnam smin bag chags nyon mongs pa'o /rkyen gnyis bstan pa'i las gsum du/ /kun brtags ma rig nyon mongs lnga/ /ngo bo snod bcud 'jig rten kyi/ /snang dang zhen pa'i chos rnams so/ /zo cha tsā sogs me dpe bzhin/ /kun tu 'khor zhing mched pa'o/ /'jig dang chags dang stongs dang gnas/ /skye rga na 'chi bzhi ldan pas/ /mtshan nyid ther zug ma yin pa'o/ /rgyun dang bcas pa'i skad cig ma/ /las kyi byed par brjod pa'o/ /rten 'byel bcu gnyis tshul dag tu/ /phyi nang gnyis kar 'khor ba'o/ /'phags lam bral nas sdug bsngal stsong / /nyes pa rnam pa gnyis su gsungs/ /thog ma tha ma med dus nas/ /yang dag don ma rtogs pas nyams/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /nges tshig rnam grangs gang la snang / /mtshon pa ma grub tshul don bstan/ /ngo bo med bzhin kun snang bas/ /cig dang du ma las grol te/ /mtshan brjod mtha' rnams kun bral ba'o/ /skye 'jig chos rnams bral ba'o/ /skye 'jig chos rnams bral 'gyur bas/ /mya ngan 'das par de brjod do/ /rnam grangs gnyis su brjod pa ste/ /theg pa mtho dman bye brag gis/ /phyogs gcig pa dang mi gnas pa'i//mya ngan 'das par de bstan pa'o/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /de 43—1174

bzhin gshegs pa snang ba dang / /de yi sprul pa rgya chen nyid/ /gdul bya 'khrul la snang ba'o/ /chu bo rgal ba'i gru bzhin du/ /'khor ba'i chu bo rnam par rgal/ /brtson ①ra thar pa ji bzhin du/ /'ching ba'i mdud pa las grol ba'o—/ /gzhi po sems nyid ma grub pas/ /sprul snang chos kun ma nges te/ /cir yang brjod du med pa'o/ /dbu ma rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /grol lam thabs su rnam par bstan/ /dbu ma'i dang po ngo bo dang / /rkyen dang rnam grangs mtshon dpe dang / /bslab tshul rim pa bstan pa dang / /gong 'og dgos pa mthar phyin spyod/ /ngo bo shes rab rnam gsum gyis/ /sems bzhi skyes par bstan pa yin/ /tshig dang yi ge rkyen nyid las/ /brten dang rtog par byed pa yin/ /mtshan mar bsgom pa'i rim pa yang / /de bzhin nyid du bsgom pa yi/ /bye brag rnam pa gnyis su gsungs/ /khron pa sgron ma'i dpe bzhin du/ /grol lam sgo nas rtogs sgom bya/ /thun mong lam lngar bslab pa dang / /khyad la so so'i lam bzhin bslab/ /sngon du goms par gang byas pa/ /gong ma gsal bar 'gyur phyir ro/ /thun mong khyad par gnas skabs lam/ /ting 'dzin drod tshad nyams ldan na/ /lam mthar phyin pa zhes su bshad/ /ting 'dzin khyad par gyur pa'i phyir/ /rjes mthun spyod pa'i gzhung bzhin spyad/ /dbu ma gnyis pa bstan pa ni/ /rnam grangs gdam ngag thabs nyid de/ /rtogs tshul rgyu rkyen ldan pa yis/ /shugs kyis snang tshul gser 'gyur bzhin/ /gdams ngag steng dang 'og gi sgo/ /thig le rkyang bar bcas pa nyid/ /thabs rnams sngon du goms byas pa/ /de bzhin nyid du 'gyur byed pa/ /ting 'dzin khyad par dbang gi rgyu/ /43—1175

thabs kyi rgyu rkyen ngo bo dang / /nges tshig bskur ba'i rim pa dang / /mtshon dpe dgos pa bstan pa'o/ /khyad par rgyu rkyen lngar bshad de/ /bla ma'i dgongs dang rlung gi dus/ /sbyor ba'i thabs dang bsod nams las/ /phyag rgya yon tan ldan gyur pas/ /dngos po lhan cig skyes pas myong / /de phyir thabs su bstan pa yin/ /ngo bo nus phan gsang ba'i chos/ /shes rab ye shes bde chen po/ /'ching ba'i las rnams spyad pa yis/ /'gro bar 'gyur phyir ming du brjod/ /dad dang brtson 'grus gsum dang ldan/ /brtul shugs gsum la spyod pa la/ /go rim tshul du 'tsham par sbyin/ /rgyal po'i phru gu dug 'gyur bzhin/ /dbang thabs rnam gnyis nyams len bya/ /rim pa dbang gis bsgrod phyir dang / /thun mong lam gyi khyad par kyis/ /sgo 'byed thob phyir bstan pa yin/ /tha ma'i don la ngo bo dang / /mtshan nyid yon tan bstan pa dang / /mdzad spyod thugs rje'i snang tshul dang / /gdul bya gzigs tshul don rnams kyis/ /'bras bu don bzhin rtogs par bya/ /dang po sku gsung thugs rnams dang / /yon tan 'phrin las lngar bsdus pa'o/ /mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /ma lus cig min tha dad min/ /'bras bu yon tan lhun grub pas/ /yid bzhin nor ltar snang ba'o/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad spyod kyis/ /bya ba med par don rnams rdzogs/ /thugs rje chen po'i gdul bya la/ /rtag rgyun rang bzhin shugs gsol dang / /yul dang phrad pas 'byung bar snang / /nyid las mi zhan don rnams kyis/ /me long tshul du gzigs par 'gyur/ /gzhi lam 'bras shes bya ba rnams/ /bla ma mkhas nyams ldan pa la/ /dri ba drug gi tshul nyid las/ /rnam gsum tshul gyis zhu 43—1176

bar bya/ /bla ma mkhas ldan de nyid kyis/ /bu rnams mi shes mdud dgrol phyir//rnam gsum lan gdab gzhung nyid la/ /'go gcig rnam dbye'i dri tshul gyis/ /lan gdab yid ches gyur par bya/ /gal te gzhung las brtsod 'gyur na/ /dam bcas sgrub ste don nyid ni/ /dpe don gtan tshigs gsum ldan pas/ /shes bya de nyid mthar phyin bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs brgyud ①pa/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i don nyid las/ /rim gsum don nyid bsdus pa yis/ /ma lus mngon par sangs rgyas shog /de lta'i dge rtsa ci mchis pa/ /bdag gi rgyud la yongs smin te/ /bla med byang chub thob 'gyur nas/ /mtha' yas sems can 'dren par shog /bdag blo mun par 'phags pa yi/ /dgongs pa nyi ma shar ba yi/ /nyams dang lung la brten pa yi/ /brtsams nongs 'phags la bzod par gsol/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i man ngag rim pa gsum pa rdzogs so// //43—1177
bsdur mchan/1172 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/1174 ①〈〈pe 〉〉btson/1177 ①〈〈pe 〉〉spyad/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2545)43wa 1178

༄ga /sems bskyed pa'i cho ga mgor bshad pa/①༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems rdo rje kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal nas/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid mngon dad pa'i/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnams don phyir/ /sems bskyed ②cho ga bshad par bya/ /brtsom pa'i dang po med pas na/ /dpag tu med pa'i sgo spyod kyang / /sa bon rgya mtsho 'di med pas/ /mthar phyin 'bras bu mi snang ste/ /de nyid sdug bsngal sa bon 'gyur/ /de bas gzhi 'di goms par byos// //de la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan/'byung khungs kyi rtsa bar nges pa ni sems yin te/ gzhung las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems so/ /rtsa ba ni snying rje chen po las byung ba'o/ /thabs kyi mthar phyin pa'o ces 'byung ba dang / /rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi 43—1179

chos byang chub sems kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ /zhes pa dang / chos rnams kun gyi yo byad ni/ /snying rje byang chub sems yin te/ /yo byad de dang ma ldan na/ /don rnams grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /tshad med snying rje bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems la dga' ba ni/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i mchog yin te/ /bsgrub pa pos ni nan tan bya/ /rtsa ba byang chub sems nyid rtogs/ /thabs kyi pha rol phyin par spyod/ /snying rjes chud ma zos par zung / /gdon mi za bar 'grub ces gsungs—/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so// //de dag gi khyad par ni/ dper na sa chen po ni sems can thams cad kyi 'tsho ba ste/ 'gyur ba med cing lan du 'phan 'dogs pa la re ba med do/ /de bzhin du sems dang po skyed pa yang / snying po byang chub la thug gi bar du/sems can thams cad kyi 'tsho ba ste/ 'gyur ba med cing lan du phan 'dogs pa la re ba med pa'o/ /dper na/ rdo rje rin po che chag kyang gser gyi rgyan khyad par can thams cad zil kyis gnon pa ste/ rdo rje rin po che'i ming yang mi dor la/ dbul ba thams cad kyang bzlog go/ /de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du skyed pa'i sems rin po che bsgrub pa dang ma ldan yang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon te/ byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang mi 'dor la/ 'khor ba'i 'bul ba las kyang bzlog go/ /dper na seng ge'i phru gu'i dri ma nam pa'i rdzi phyogs na gnas pa'i gcan zan thams cad kyang 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang du phyin pa'i sa phyogs na gnas pa'i log par spyod pa'i sems can thams cad skrag par 'gyur ro/ /gnas 'dir bskyed pa rtsam ①kyis 43—1180

'jig rten gsum po bla mar bcas pa'o/ /mchod nas nyan thos bdud kyi sde rnams zil gyis gnon zhes gsungs so/ /thabs chen byang chub sems dpa'i gsang ba'i spyod pa'ang 'di nyid de/ /'di med rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad theg pa gsum ston mi srid do/ /skad cig tsam yang dad pa'i shugs skyed de yang myur du 'jam dpal gzhon nur 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor gsang bar zhugs shing theg chen dam tshig mchog kyang srung ba yin/ /tshul khrims sdom pa kun kyang bsrungs shing sbyin gnas dam par rab tu bsngags/ /gang dag 'dir ni mngon spyod la/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis phyogs byed pa/ /de ni dngos dang 'dra ba ste/ /'bras bu la yang mtho dman med/ /byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang / /de la gal te gzugs yod na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun gang ste/ /de ni de las lhag par 'gyur/ /ces pa la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so// //de la sems bskyed mdor bstan ste/ /dngos po gnyis dang rim pa bzhi//gzhi dang dbang po yo byad dang / /chog rims sems bskyed sdom pa'i dngos/ /sgo gsum las kyis spyod pa dang / /shes bzhin bshags pa rnam bcu gcig /las kyi gtso bor gang len pa/ /de ni ldog par ma gsungs te/ /cung zad tsam kyi las rnams kyang / /rgya mtsho bzhin du mi skam zhing / /'bras bu bdag gzhan gnyis la snang / /de bas nan tan snying pos gyis// //kun rdzob sems ni snying rje'i mchog /sdug bsngal bcu gcig yul byas te—/ /gdung bas bskyab pa'i sems bcas pas/ /mgon skyob bdag por yid la byed/ /bdag bde rje dang don 'dor ba/ /de ni ldog pa ma gsungs so/ /'khor los dpung gi tshogs 'dren bzhin/ /de ni sangs 43—1181

rgyas chos rnams 'dren/ /sa dang rgya mtsho nor bu bzhin/ /yon tan don dang snang ba rnams/ /snying rje chen po nyid las 'byung / /me long chu bzhin bsgrib byas pa/ /dngos grub gags su bral gsungs so/ /bu dang zhe 'gras spyod pa yis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ming med na/ /sangs rgyas khas ches rnal 'byor ci// //don dam nges par rab bshad pa/ /ma g.yos kun gzhi'i ngang du bshad//rang bzhin snang ba'i gser tshul ltar/ /gnyis su med par rgyal bas bshad/ /dri dang ga bur nus pa bzhin/ /mtshan ma med par sems mi dmigs/ /sems nyid gang yin chos nyid de/ /chos nyid kyang ni de bzhin no/ /chos sems gnyis med ldan gyur pas/ /bla med byang chub chen por bshad/ /nam mkha' gar khyab chos kyis khyab/ /chos nyid gar khyab sems yin pas/ /phyi nang gnyis med sems su gsal/ /mos dang rgyun dran mngon 'gyur bar/ /yid la byed pa'i sems dag gis/ /don 'di yongs su rdzogs par brjod// //g.yo zhing smon par byed pa ni/ /rang bzhin mtshungs par ldan pa dang / /zhar 'byung lhan cig byed pa dang / /yon tan mthong thos rjes 'jug dang / /byin rlabs shugs kyis 'brel pa bzhi/ /rkyen gyi rnam pa 'dus pa yin/ /skad cig cung zad sa bon las/ /btsa' me bzhin du skye bar gsungs/ /lhag par 'phel ba'i gang zag gis/ /snying rje skye dang ltar ldan pas/ /don gnyis rgyu ru 'di shes nas/ /goms par mang du byas pa yis/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du/ /je che je mang mngon 'phel bar/ /dam bcas 'jug par bya ba yin/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa mngon byas te/ /'gyur ba med par gnas par 43—1182

bya'o—/ /dngos gzhi gnyis la rab brtan pa/ /'jug pa'i skyes bur de bshad do/ /phyis 'byung sdom pa'i dngos po la/ /rgyun dang dum bur gang gnas pa/ /gnas pa'i sems su rab tu brtan/ /de nyams gsum du shes par bya/ /gnas pa mang po'i mthu rdzogs pas/ /mngon byas rkyen gyis mi 'phrogs shing / /bsgrub bya rkyen gyis mthar phyin pa/ /klong yangs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sprin med nyi ma 'bum gyis brdal①/ /mi skye mi 'gag ngo bo las—/ /ji ltar bltas dgu'i der snang bas/ /don gnyis lhun grub rtog bral ba/ /mthar rdzogs sems su rgyal bas gsungs/ /bsngo gzhi sgrib bral nyid du bstan/ /yul nyid lnga yi dbang po ni/ /rim pa gsum gyi mtshan nyid can—/ /snying rje chen po brlan ldan pas/ /khe grags 'dod pa'i sems gsum spangs/ /shes bya bar ma kun mkhyen pas/ /ma 'dres don gyi tha snyad rnams—/ /nad dang sman gyi rim bzhin byed/ /ston pa'i mchog du 'di gsungs pas/ /dang po'i rim la gnas pa'i mis/ /brtson 'grus dga' ba'i las rnams kyis/ /'du shes ston par bzhag ste blang / /cung zad 'gal ba'i sems med par/ /rtag par gdung bas rmongs byed pa/ /de 'dra bral bas ma gsungs so// //dpang 'gyur rdo rje dam can rnams/ /byin rlabs gnyan pa'i sems dag gis—/ /las kyi stongs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /zhing khams byed pa'i rdul 'das pa'i/ /sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs par bya/ /de dag rtag tu mngon bsam ste/ /shes bzhin rang gi sdom pa bsngo/ /smon lam dbang gis gzigs par 'gyur/ /maṇ+ḍal bdud rtsi'i dris byugs pa/ /tsan dan bdud 43—1183

rtsi'i chus sbyangs pa/ /dri zhim chas kyis rab brgyan ste/ /rin chen 'byor pas lag thogs bya/ /sna tshogs yol ba'i phyi rol 'dug /kha sbyar ban dha'i bum chu sbyin/ /dril bus rdo rje'i ming brtags bya/ /sangs rgyas 'khor bcas gzugs brnyan dgram/ /sna tshogs mchod pa rgyas pa dag /'khor gsum dag pa'i sems kyis dbul/ /khar gsil rol mo rgyas par sbyin/ /'byung po kun kyi gtor ma dang / /'gro drug sbyin pa chen po'i yang / /dug gsum spangs pa'i sems kyis ①gtang / /sems skyed mtshon pa'i rdo rje yang / /rtag tu bcang bar bya ba yin/ /dang po 'das dang 'jug 'dod dang / /g.yo bar mkhan pos gsol btab pas/ /mkhan pos gsol ba btab nas ni/ /dad pa'i sems la gnas su gzhug /dgos pa'i yo byad rang 'byor nas/ /dge ba'i bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje mi shigs gur cing ④bya/ /bum chu gsum po byin brlab phyir/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i dran pa yis/ /bgegs bskrad pa yi rang bzhin du/ /'bru lngas ye shes chu rgyun dgug /ma lus 'dus pa'i khro bzhin tshogs/ /bskyed dang spyan drangs mchod tshogs sbyar/ /sngags bzlos gsol btab bu byin brlab/ /khrus byas dri zhim rgyan ldan bu/ /yol phyir phyag byas thal sbyar te/ /dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag /'khor ba 'don pa'i ded dpon che/ /sdug bsngal chu bo rgyun bzlog dang / /don gnyis bdag gis mngon byas pa'i/ /thabs kyi las mtha' gang legs pa/ /rim pa yang dag bstan pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje nye bar skyed mdzad de/ /di ring gnang ba mdzad par rigs/ /ma lus phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i/ /sngon gyi dbang po ji snyed pa'i/ /rgyas par spyan drangs mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas lta ba'i 43—1184

mos byas pas/ /lag bzung nang du gnas par bya/ /thal sbyar zhing la lus dbul bya/ /bi shudhe dang spyor sngags kyis/ /tsan dan bdud rtsi chu sbyar de/ /dad pa'i lhar skres 1byin gyis brlab/ /rin chen bsnyen pas gsol btab pas/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /thugs rje nye bar bskyed mdzad de/ /dam tshig dam bcas rim pa bzhin/ /bdag la byin gyis brlabs par rigs/ /rab tu gtor ste 'brel pa brtag /rdo rje'i ming yang sbyin par bya/ /ding khyod sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor gyis/ /rim par rab zhugs nges pa yin/ /dam tshig 'dod pa'i sems skyed cing / /gzhan don rab dga'i sems ldan pas//bshags pa'i mchog gis rab shogs ste/ /dag pa'i sems kyis brlab par gyis//'dab brgyad 2pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /brtan nas sprad cing mos byed de/ /mtha' rnams bral ba'i byang chub sems/ /mi rtog mi gnas nam mkha' nyid/ /chos rnams de 'drar mos pa dang / /mthong sgom lam la gnas pa dang / /mthar phyin thams cad mnyam spyor bas/ /dam bcas yid kyis bstan par bya/ /rgyun yang de bzhin bstan par gsungs/ /de yi yon tan dpe rnams kyi/ /nges par mtshon pa bzhi ru bshad/ /brtan pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /ma rig bzhi dang bcas pa'i sems/ /skad cig rgyun gyi las nyon mongs/ /mthun par snang ba'i bstos 4pa'i chos/ /rmi lam bzhin du nyams thag rnams/ /dran pa'i snying rje gdung sems kyis/ /khud pa'i zhing du mngon byas pa/ /snyug bsngal rgya mtsho bzlog pa'i phyir/ /cho 'phrul las dang sku don rnams/ /rgyal bas grangs mtha' mi rtogs so/ /mngon 'dod bya ba'i mos pa dag /brtan par bskyed cing rgyun gnas pa/ /sems kyis sngon bzhin gnas par bya/ / 43—/ 185

thal sbyar gus pa'i lus gnas ste/ /dang por gsol pa'i tshig bshad bzhi/ /sngon du btang nas gtam par bya/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa sbyin sreg bsogs/ /gzhan don grangs ma ji snyed pa/ /tshe 'di gnas tsam mthar thug par/ /nam yang rgyun chad ma gyur cig /thun mong thabs kyis spyod drug dang / /mi mthun 'dul ba'i spyod pa rnams/ /de bzhin bstan par bsgrub pa yis/ /'gro ba mi 'dul med par shog /dam bcas rim pa'i sdom pa rnams/ /tshigs bshad bzhin du sems kyis bsgrub/ /don gnyis 'gyur ba'i lus spyod dag /lus kyi le lo spangs pas byas/ /don med spyod pa sems kyis gnan/ /snying po bshad dang phan pa'i gtam/ /ma gtogs pa'i rgyun bcad de/ /le lo spangs pas gsum bsgrub bya/ /ca co nam yang ma yin pa/ /sangs rgyas chos su de bshad do/ /bsam gtan shes rab rab ma dang / /snying rje sdom pa bsdos pa'i sems/ /g.yeng dang bying rmugs rnam spangs pas/ /bsam bya brtag par gang dran pa/ /sangs rgyas chos bzhir 'di bshad do/ /sgo gsum chung bar mos grub pas/ /rtag du rang nyams smod byed pa/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i gzhir shes bya/ /sangs rgyas sgu gsung thugs thob 'gyur/ /rgyas par yon tan brjod mi lang // //khud pa'i zhing du gyur rnams la/ /sdug bsngal yin yang mthar phan spyad//stod cing mtho sems rab spangs pas/ /'khrul pa ji snyed brjod mi lang / /'di 'dra ba yang snod ma smra/ /rgan po bla ma'i 'du shes byed/ /phrag dog can la sems ngan med/ /dpag tshad du ma'i mthar gnas bya/ /man ngag zang zing lan spangs sbyin/ /'gron gnyer rgos med dbang du bya/ /don yod sdig (3—/ /86

pa dang du blang / /ma bsngos 'tsho ba rtag tu spang / /grags dang 'gran nor dge ba dor/ /nyams la snying rje gtang snyoms spang / /don 'gyur phyir na bdag dge spang / /de ni ldog par ma gsungs so/ /'dzin spangs pa'i spyin pa bzhi/ /'chang bas sbyin pa bzlog par bya/ /lus 'dod dum bu'i sems dag gis/ /sprul sku thob phyir sbyin par bya/ /nyam sod log lta sun dbyung phyir//skal pa'i sbyin pas bzlog par bya/ /bsam gtan ro mchog rlung gnas kyang / /jeg dman 1spyod pa dor ba med/ /'dod pa'i sems kyis grong mi gnyer/ /bzlog pa'i sems kyis grong rgyu ba/ /chos kyi skyes kyis 'gro bar bya'o// //nad dang sdug bsngal can g.yos byed/ /tshul khrims bsam spyod thor mi 'dzin / /mnyes dang bral na dag par gsungs/ /brtsod pa'i rtsa ba sems dran dang / /rnam smin dran par bzlog par bya/ /khong khro nyes chen bral 'gyur ba/ /'di ldan byang chub sems dpa' med/ /chos spyod bcu la dam bcas nas/ /thun mong zhen pa bzlog par bya/ /sbug bsngal bsam pa nam mi 'dor/ /snod ma bltas la sems mi brtan/ /de la don 'gyur spang mi bya/ /phan byed rnams la lan mi glan / /mya ngan byu yang bsang bar bya/ /sgro sgur spangs te yon tan brjod/ /ngan byed mthong ba med smon dang / /sngos ngan mthong ba de bzhin ste/ /smon lam bdag gi zhing du btab/ /bzang bor spyod dang dngos po bzang / /mchod rdzas mthong ba ji snyed pa/ /bdag zhing kun gyis spyod par smon/ /gdug pa sangs rgyas zhing gnas dang / /'gro ba sprul pas don byed dang / /byen pa bsam gtan bden pa rnams dang / /bsam rtsis chos kyi bsam pa dang / /'greng ba sems can don bstan dang / /dpa' bo bdud bzhi g.yul 'joms dang / /thams cad 73—/ /87

spyod bzhin ma gos dang / /srog gcod khro bo'i phrin 1las dang / /'dod chags mnyam par spyor ba dang / /rku byed dngos grub len pa dang / /ri bo rtog pas mi phrogs dang / /chu rgyun chos spyod rgyun ldan dang / /'bras bu sgu dang ye shes dang / /me tog rnam grol phung po dang / /yul khams rnam dag 'jig rten dang / /kha zas ting 'dzin ro mchog dang / /skom dang snying rje chu 'thung bsogs/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can la/ /smon lam yid kyis zin par bya/ /gzhan phyir bdag kyang de bzhin smon/ /rtsa 2ba'i spyod pa gsum bsogs pa/ /sems skyed sdom pa blangs nas mthor/ /nyams med bsam pa'i dran pa dang / /shes bzhin lta bas brtag dngos te/ /gang zhig sngon goms dbang nyams pa/ /'gyod dang bcas pas sor gzhug bya/ /yi ge la sogs bzo mtha' rnams/ /rtsol bas rgyun tu 'jug byed pa/ /goms te sla bar ma gyur nga/'i/ /dngos sde gang yang yod ma yin/ /spyod lam rnam gsum dran bya ba/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ming thob ste/ /de ni ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /dper na phyug po nor sdod pa/ /med par gyur pa sor 'jug bzhin/ /spyod pa mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /zhig pa bzhin du mi gnas te / /gzhi 'am 'on te gzhan dag gam/ /dbang por gyur pa'i rten dag la/ /sngon du maṇ+ḍal mchod sbyar nas/ /me tog phyag 'tshal lus gus pas/ /'gyod sems dngos po gang gis bshags/ /de bzhin slar yang blang bar bya/ /bdag dang dngos po 'bras bu rnams/ /mi dmigs sems kyi bshags bya bar/ /de ni nyes par ma gsungs so/ /'di ni shin tu gsang ba'i chos/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i don 'gyur phyir/ /sdom pa rnam grangs 'phel mi bya/ /'dod pa sbyin pa'ang de bzhin no/ /thun mong rab tu zhen pa bzlog pa dang / /bslab pa mthar chub de 43—/ /88

2520ra༅/ /dam tshig gsal bkra zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar ston pa mchod byas nas / /lam gyi rnal 'byor rnams don phyir/ /rgyud gsum nges par gsal byed cing / /dam tshig chen po mdor bshad pa/ /lam gyi rgyud la zhugs pa rnams / /babe+eb pa gsum la gnas byas nas/ /don gnyis mngon du byed pa yang / /nang ris la la mun snang phyir/ /gcig gis 'thad pa ma yin la/ /la la cha mthun spyad nga/'i rigs/ /gdul bya skabs kyis rim spyod pa/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa 'di gsungs so// //gnyer 'di lung gis lus bzhag nas/ /ngo bo rnam grangs bsrung thabs dang / /nyams rgyu snga rtags skyon yo/na gnyis/ /bskang thabs dpe dang mdo bcur bcad/ /ngo bo rtsa ba bzhi dang ni/ /thun min thun mong yan lag gnyis//13byed/ /90

rtsa ba chen po mdor 'brel lo/ /dam tshig rnam pa'i grangs dag ni/ /sems can drangs 1dang log rtog grangs / /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi mkhyen phyir/ /rtog 'dul gnyen po dam tshig grangs / /rgyal ba nyid kyis rdzogs pa las/ /'on kyang rmongs la mdor gzung ba/ /byang sems rnam gnyis slob dpon drug /mchod bzhi sngags gsum phyag rgya bzhi'i / /gsang bcu rtsa bar shes par bya/ /spyad pa lnga dang mi spang lnga/ /dang du blang dang bsgrub de bzhin/ /shes bya lnga rnams thun min bshad/ /yan lag skabs su shes par bya/ /thun mong dam tshig mdor bshad pa/ /mdor bsdus bdag gzhan don gnyis so/ /rnam grangs skabs su shes par bya/ /bsrung ba'i thabs ni 'di lta ste/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i phyag rgya che/ /sems can khams kyang der shes shing / /snang stong gnyis med ye shes sgu/ /byas mthong zos pa thams cad la/ /sems phyir gang yang byas snang med/ /dran dang shes bzhin mngon bstang la/ /dus gsum rgyun du ma dran na/ /theg chen bsngags par ci zhig tshud/ /lta spyod dam tshig 'brel pa yi/ /spyi dang 'dren dang dam tshig dbang / /nyams chag 2skong dang shes rgyud 'grol/ /man ngag lung gi slob dpon rnams/ /lus la dbang ba'i rgyal po dang / /khu bo ma dang pha dang mig /snying bas lhag pa'i tshul ltas te/ /sgo gsum zol rgyu med pa ni/ /yi dam lha ltar rgyun du bsam/ /bsrung rim 'chad bzhin shes par bya/ /mtha' yas sems can rang rig phyir/ /gang yang bdag las 13byed/ /9/

gzhan min dang / /bde gshegs snying po yun ring phyir/ /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas rang bzhin yin/ /spyi yi mchod de pha tshan bzhi/ /sangs rgyas chos zhugs ring ba dang / /lta spyod mthun pas nye bar bshad/ /pha cig dam tshig nang 'dres pa/ /zhang tshan pha srun spun pas kyang / /lhag par bltas te bsrung 1ba ni/ /lus kyi zas nor mnyes bya ba/ /srur ma lta bur 'phangs pa med / /gtan bting khur sogs las bya ba/ /bran bzhin nges par dang du blang / /bla ma'i rigs 'khor de bzhin du/ /nor zas blangs pa rnam smin phyir / /til phub tsam yang mi 'bag cing / /mal gos chags sogs 'gong mi bya/ /mchod rten bshig dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /brdeg bsad sku 'phrog spyod pa ni/ /dngos 2su bya ba ci smos kyi/ /rtsed mo las su bya ba min/ /bdag gis skyon sbas yon tan bsgrags/ /tshul brjod pa ni nyams par 'gyur/ /bskyon bsgur la sogs mtshan nyid dag /bye mo gtam du zur mi bya'o/ /yid kyis g.yo rgyu phrag dog dang / /mngan sems dpya sems nor la brkam/ /se gol yun du'ang bya ba min/ /shin tu gdung zhing brtse bar bya/ /spyod lam cis kyang mnyes byed cing / /bka' yi zur yang mi bcag pa/ /de ni sdig par ma gsungs so/ /tsa ba skyed dang las sngags kyis/ /dam tshig las dang chos dang ni/ /sku nyid phyag rgya chen po bzhi/ /rang gi sgo gsum yi dam gyi/ /sgu gsu/nga thugs su mngon sbyar la/ /rtag tu bzlas pa byed pa ni/ /byang chub gzung la zhugs pa ni/ /rab kyis chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nas/ /nyin gsum mtshan gsum nyin cig du/ /ma spangs pa yi ngag gis bzlas/ /'bring gi zla gcig dus drug du/ /dus bzhi'i bar du mi bcad byung / /tha ma bya ba'i 13—/ /92

rnal 'byor pas/ /zla re'am ra ba'i dus dag du/ /brtson pas 'bad de mi phyed pa/ /byang chub sa bon brlag pa yin/ /tshogs dang gtor ma de bzhin te//tha ma lo zla mi zla'o/ /lta zab spyod pa glang po dang / /lha mi gzungs dang grub brtags rnams/ /spyi gsang rnam pa bzhir bshad do/ /bsgrub pa gnas dus grogs dang rdzas/ /rab tu gsang la bsgrub par bya/ /gsang bar 'os la mdor sbu na / /phung dang gtor ma tshogs dag dang / /ban dha phur pa mar me snod/ /rdzas dang lag cha dkyil 'khor rnams/ /skye bos mthong bar yod mi bya/ /dril bu rde chung la sogs sgra/ /skye bos thos par yod mi brdung / /grogs po spyod dang mtshang rnams dang / /sems can kun kyang ngan spyod dang / /kun la gnod pa'i spyod pa rnams/ /shin tu gsang na byang chub rgyu/ /gnyer gtad pa ni gdam ngag ste / /sngar bshad slob dpon rnams kyis so/ /gsang sngags skyon yod ma yin ste/ /sems can don phyir rab tu gsang / /gsang thub dngos grub mi yal bas/ /shin tu gsang 1na byang chub rgyu/ /gsang phyir gdam ngag sna tshogs gsungs/ /dam nyams dam las log pa dang / /dam med dkyil 'khor ma mthong zhing / /'dres dang ma 'dres thams cad la/ /sems kyis brtan par mi bsam zhing / /las kyis thams cad sbas la spyad/ /ngag gi rdo rje rtse yod kyang / /brjod pa dag tu bya ba men / /de dag rtsa ba bzhir bshad do/ /thun min yan lag bshad bya ba/ /sbyo ra sgrol ma yin len pa dang / /rdzun smra ngag brlang dpyad pa lnga/ /rang bzhin gyi ni spyor sgol dang / /dbang po yul gyi spyor sgol dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor sgrol dang / /mngon du phyung ba'i sbyor sgrol lnga'o/ /gnyis ni shes bya thun min bshad/ /ting 'dzin bslab pa thun mong gsungs/ /mngon phyung dam tshig chen po la/ /byed 43—/ /93

pa'i tshig lngar shes par bya/ /lta spyod ting 'dzin 'byel goms pas/ /dkon mchog slob dpon sgu dgra gnyis/ /dam nyams log dang 'khus pa dang / /'dus par 'ongs dang yongs la gnod/ /dam dgra ngan pa'i ngang tshul can/ /ngan song gsum dang bcu po ni/ /rnal 'byor kun gyis dang du blang / /grangs kyis rtsa ba bcu bzhi'o/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ /shin tu goms pas dbang bskur ro/ /byang chub zhing du dgod par bya/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas bag chags sbyangs/ /rnam shes lhar skyed 'og min 'phang / /ye shes tshogs byang rdzogs nga/ra 'gyur/ /phung po byin brlabs mchod par bsgo/ /bsod nams mchog du 'dis 'gyur ro// //de ltar bsgral ba'i dgos ched kyang / /byang chub sems 'phel sems can bde/ /lha mnyes bdag gis dam bskongs shing / /las ngan bar chad sdug yu/na thung / /rang gis bsags med ngan song las/ /bde lam 'di las gzhan med do/ /thabs kyi spyod pas 'ching 'gyur na/ /byang chub sems dang 'dul dbang gis/ /sngon dang smad 'tshong ston yang ltung / /khe dang spyod pas de min phyir/ /thabs chen lam la gnas pa yi/ /skye bo kun gyis bya bar 'byung / /'ga' na'i dam tshig chen po ni/ /log chags yid 'ongs spangs pa yi / /don gnyis mngon du byed pa yi/ /pad can dud can ri mo can/ /ban glang can dang lcug phran can/ /sdong cig me reg phyal ba brgyad/ /mnyen drang ske ring stod sma da phyed/ /yan lag 'phra 'jam tshigs dmig zlum/ /dpral 1ba'i dbyes che smin khyugs ring / /dmig phra dkyil nas at+pal mdog /chu zheng gnyis ka 'bring du bshad/ /lus dang chu klung ga bur dri/ /gsang (2 / /9 /

thub shes rab spyod pa dal/ /dad ldan 'grogs shing dad che ba/ /gsang ba'i gnas su spyad par bya/ /dbang bskur dam tshig chos gsum bshad/ /lus la rigs lnga'i rdul tshon dgye/ /thabs la mkhas pas skabs kyis sbyar/ /dam tshig rnam grangs bcu gnyis kyi/ /dngos grub yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /slob bu smin cing las rnams 'grub/ /skye gnas ngan 'gro ris drug des/ /thabs kyi jeg pa 'di bshad do/ /mtshan nyid chad dang rnam grangs dang / /lhos pa'i kun rtags rnam pa gsum/ /dngos po de nyid la rdzun shes/ /thams cad rang gi rtasnang phyir bden// //shes nas kun smra skyes bu'i yul/ /dkon mchog gsum dang slob dpon mched / /sems can gnod par 'ongs pa la/ /rdzun du smra ba'i dam tshig bya/ /gang la gsang bar bya ba rnams/ /gsang bcu las 'di rdzun bcu smra/ /bsrung ba bcu bdun nyams su blangs / /zhing bcur gyur pa'i nor bcu dang / /mtshan ldan gzungs dang bkra shis rdzas/ /sbas chos phal 'chad byin can rdzas/ /bsrung ba yod dam med pa'i nor/ /phyug ngo/ ser snas bcings nga/'i nor/ /ming gis blangs la tshogs su/ bsngo/ /dam tshig bcu bdun spyad par bya/ /zhing bcur gyur pa'i sems can la/ /babe+eng tshig bcu yi zhe bcad cing / /drag shul spyod pa sngags dag dang / /gzungs la blang ngo/ra sbyor ba'i tshig /slob bu sno da bcos zhe gcod dang / /'byung po zhe gcod rngam pa'i sgra/ /snod ldan bu la rngam chos bshad/ /ngag ji dam tshig bco lnga bsrung / /mi spang dam/ tshig bshad par bya/ /yang dag dug lnga log dug lnga/ /bshad nga/'i thabs/ mkhas 'dod chags dang / /'dod spyod sems kyi rgyan shes nas/ /shin tu zhen nga/ 73—/ /95

lam du gsungs/ /zhing bcu rlag byed zhe sdang mchog /lta ngan 'joms pa de bzhin te/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa yin/ /mngon par mtho ba'i lta ba dang / /ting 'dzin nges par sran tshugs pa/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i mchog tu gsungs / /lta bas phyogs ris mi phyed dang / /spyod pa blang dor mi byed pa/ /jeg pa chen po'i gti mug go/ /lta spyod sman la phrag dog cing / /dam 'dres la sogs spong byed pa/ /phrag dog dam tshig bsrung ba'o/ /log dug sems can kun ldan pa/ /dug lnga rang rig rang snang phyir/ /dran pa thams cad shes pa la / /shes pa thams cad rtsol ba yin/ /rtsol ba sems phyir thabs mkhas pa//thabs mkhas rang rig ye shes te/ /nyi ma'i dkyil na mun med ltar/ /ye shes rang snang ma rtogs pa/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba ngang gis med/ /de shes rang rig ye shes la/ /spang bar bya ba dmigs mi 'gyur/ /dam tshig bco lnga la gnas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor chen po don gnyis rdzogs/ /kun gyis blang ba'i dam tshig lnga/ /dri chen dri chu rma sa dang / /chil ma lhag pa'i sems rnams la/ /grub pa bzhi yis rgyan pa'i phyir/ /nad lnga bsal phyir blang ba dang / /gtsang dam rtog sbyang phyir blang dang / /thun mong dgos pa lnga phyir dang / /rigs lnga 'grub pa'i yon tan ni/ /sbug bsngal 'grub pa'i yon tan ni/ /bcud lnga btung dbang lam gyi mchog /thabs kyi lus la brten shes na/ /yon tan brjod las 'das pas gsungs/ /phye ba'i dam tshig sum cu nyid/ /skabs kyis dang du blang bar bya/ /bsgrub par bya ba lnga rnams la/ /rigs dang ye shes yab yum lnga/ /gcig la lnga lngar shes par bya/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan las/ /gcig kyang lnga lngar phye bas na/ /bzhi bcu lnga yi bye brag 13byed/ /96

rnams / /mtshan nyid shes nas bsgrub par bya'o/ /shes pa lnga la bye brag dang / /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/ /dbang po yul dang yan lag sor/ /nyon mongs dam rdzas sha dang ni/ /phyogs dang kha dog 'gro ba dang / /snyigs pa bag chags lnga lnga po/ /bdun cu la sogs 'khor ba'i chos/ /ye shes sgu rigs yab yum sogs/ /rang bzhin ngang gis kar dag pa/ /blo la nyams su lon pa ni/ /spyod yul yongs dag rnal 'byor pa'o// //thun mong dam tshig mdor bsdus na/ /bdag gzhan don tu shes par bya/ /rkyen 'gyed lus mdzes 'dus lta dang / /chang dang dregs spyod kheng sems dang //rdo rje gsum phog phyag byed dang / /che dag dge smod sdig bstod 1dang / /le lo ser sna snying gnyer dang / /khro gtum 2shes bzhin sngon mi btong / /bka' gcog sdig pa'i grogs bsten dang / /bag med spyod dang dam bca' 'dor/ /chog mi shes dang ngom la dga'/ /spang bya nyi shu gcig bzlog pa/ /bdag don mchog tu gyur pa ste/ /kun gyis bdag nyid khur bar 'gyur// //pha rol phyin drug chos spyod bcu/ /rnam bzhi las kyi spyod pa dang / /mthun 'jug thabs kyi spyod pa ni/ /theg pa rgu dang mu stegs rgu/ /'gro ba drug gi spyod pa rnams/ /'dzin dang nyam nga med par spyod/ /don 'gyur ci yang nyams su blang / /bzhi bcu bzhi la sogs pa yis/ /gdul bya ma lus dor mi bya/ /bsrung bya de dag grangs brtab la/ /dran dang shes bzhin gyis sdod pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen por gsungs/ /nyams par gyur pa'i rgyu dag ni/ /mi chos blun po'i las byed dang / /43—/ /97

bdag bstod 1gzhan smod zur 'dzin mkhas/ /khe drags nyid kyis 'du ste brnab / /rdzas la chags sems rang phyogs che/ /chang dang rang mthong lta spyod bsnyams/ /chos la phyogs ris ngoms rkyen dang / /gsang chung le lo gtsang ngam che/ /sgro bskur grogs kyi nyams len dang / /'khor ba'i rigs rgyud spel 'dod cing / /gcig pur mi gnas 'du la dga'/ /nyi shu nyams pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /snga rtags sngon du 'byung ba ni/ /nyam nga ba yi nad rnams dang / /dgra bgegs gnyin la bden mi 'jug /'khor dang longs spyod yid 'ong bral/ /ya kha ma nyes kha yogs 'byung / /brtsams pa'i las la 'bras med cing / /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs 'byung / /gal te nyams la rtags med par/ /legs/ par snang na mi rung ste/ /bde ba zang byas gtan du sbug /gal te ma nyams/ rtags byung na/ /sngon gyi rnam smin zad 'gyur phyir/ /skad so'i las la brtson byas na/ /ngan song sbug bsngal myong mi 'gyur// //nyams par gyur pa'i skyon rnams ni/ /byang sems dam tshig spangs par 'gyur / /skal bar dge ba ci bsags kyang / /bzhi rten med par 'gyur ba yin / /'khor ba'i khams su zag par 'gyur/ /sgu yi dam tshig nyams 'gyur na/ /ya nga'i nad sogs sdug bsngal che/ /dus min tshe zad bar chad mang / /skal bar rdo rje dmyal bar ltung / /bde bas rab tu 'brel par 'gyur / /gsung gi dam tshig nyams 'gyur na/ /bgegs rnams thogs med (3byed/ /98

'ong ba dang / /rkyen dang ye 'drog mang ba dang / /chos la byin rlabs med 'gyur zhing / /skal pa gnyis su dmyal bar thong / /bsgrub pa'i thabs las 'gyangs par 'gyur/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /smyo 'bog dbang po nyams dang chas/ /myos shing lkugs pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /gang yang bsgrubs pa rtags med cing / /lce la zhing rmod la sogs pa'i/ /dmyal bar skal pa gsum du gnas/ /rtsa ba kun nyams phyal ba dag /gso la nye bar mi brtson na/ /rdo rje dmyal bar de ltung ste/ /dmyal ba phal pa thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal gcig tu bsdoms pas ni/ /de yis 'bum gyi char mi phod/ /sangs rgyas stong gi 'od zer dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i 'phrin las kun/ /rgyun tu mdzad kyang phan mi 'gyur/ /bskal pa ther 'bum la sogs su/ /de ni mthon par mi 'gyur te/ /'jig rten 'jig na gzhan du 'pho/ /se gol gcig gis phyin par byed/ /de bas shin tu nan tan gyis/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams 'gyur na/ /longs spyod mang du 'phel med dang / /jeg pa che la 'phyas 'dogs shing / /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub rnams/ /shin tu ring bar gyur pa dang / /gdul bya'i don rnams yal bar 'gyur/ /lta spyod ya char gyur pa yis/ /theg pa phyi nang 'dres pa nyid/ /bka' yi byin nyams grub par dka'/ /bsrung ba'i lha rnams g.yel ba dang / /zab mo'i chos las ring 'gyur zhing / /skal par ngan song sdug bsngal myong / /rnal 'byor sngo skams nyid du 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor skyes bu chen po des/ /dam tshig ma nyams gzhung thub na/ /73—/ /99

lus la nad nyung mtshan ldan zhing / /'khor dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /thun mong nyes byas dag 'gyur dang / /srid pa gsum la dbang sgyur zhing / /jeg chen zab mo don thob 'gyur/ /gsung gis lha mnyes don thob 'gyur/ /mthu dang byin rlabs bsam mi khyab/ /las rnams dus su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su 'grub/ /thugs kyis skyo dub med pa dang / /man ngag sgod 'grub dngos grub nye/ /dgongs zab don la mkhas pa dang / /lha rnams kun gyis dbang sgur 'gyur/ /yan lag dam tshig ma nyams na/ /rnal 'byor byes bu chen po yis/ /skyon bzlog pa nyid yon tan ste/ /bdud bzhi 'joms shing ngan song spyong / /theg chen lta spyod gzhung srong bas/ /lha rnams 'go zhing bsam pa 'grub/ /don gnyis yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /jeg chen dam tshig la gnas shing / /'og ma'i 'dul sdom dam tshig gsum/ /bsrungs pa med par thub pas na/ /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de ni rnal 'byor chen po yin/ /nyams/ na bskang ba'i thabs rnams ni/ /byang chub sems kyi dam nyams na//mkhas la blangs te gnas par bya'o/ /sgu yi dam tshig nyams 'gyur na/ /gang la nyams pa der song la/ /nor zas 'byor pa mnyes phul nas/ /gang nyetha tshig du bshags byas la/ /phyin chad sdom pa legs par bca'/ /gal te grongs chad gyur pas na/ /de yi slob dpon bzhugs pa la/ /de tshe gong ma bzhin du bshags/ /med na mnyam pa brgya la bshags/ /de yang rnyed par ma gyur na/ /de dang mnyam pa gsum bkug la/ /sbyin sreg me thab rab brtsigs (3—/200

la / /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod rjes su/ /spyan drang gsang mtshan la sogs mchod / /gong du smos pa'i yon rnams ni/ /dbang po gsum la dbul bar bya'o / /gal te gus pas mi len na/ /gnyis ka rdo rje dmyal bar ltung / /de bas myur du tshangs par bya/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams 'gyur na/ /sgo gsum sgu gsung thugs nyid du/ /nges par shes na skongs par 'gyur/ /bslab pa bldab kyis bsab pa dang / /bsgrub pa chen po gsum kyis bskang / /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams 'gyur na/ /'gro drug sems su gsal rtogs na/ /bdag nyid bdag la gsang ba med/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin klong zhugs te/ /ma yengs blo la 'dris par bya/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /gang 'das de nyid sor bcug la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyis tshogs kyis bskang / /de ltar nyams su blangs na 'grub/ /snga rtags sdug bsngal 'byung mi 'gyur// //dam tshig chen po'i dpe bstan pa/ /sa gzhi lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /'a/sa dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams kun/ /dam tshig med par 'byung ba srid/ /so mtshams dag gi rang bzhin pas/ /bsrung ba thub dang ma thub las/ /nyes legs stobs chen 'byed pa'o/ /rin chen lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /dngos grub dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung / /nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /'di yod thams cad shor bar 'gyur/ /rno rbal mtshon gyi rang bzhin pas/ /'khor ba'i dra ba ma lus gcod/ /pha ma lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus bskyed/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /brlabs chen dus su 'byung bar byed/ /me dpung lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /43—/201

gang mchongs thams cad 'tshig par byed/ /de bzhin rtsi sman rang bzhin pas/ /'khor ba'i gcong rnying ma lus 'byin/ /rgyal po lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /phyogs 'ga' bsten pas rim gyis 'tsho/ /rgya mtshor nor len tshong dpon bzhin//thog ma nas mthar 'di phyin pas/ /'di la shin tu nan tan byos// //dam tshig dam tshig zhes bya ba/ /gud na yod pa ma yin te/ /rang gi sems nyid dam tshig yin/ /ji snyed snang ba'i chos rnams su/ /rang rig rkyen 'bras nyid snang bas/ /cir snang cir srid rang rig nyid/ /'gre log spyi gtsug gar 'gro yang / /snying po'i don las 'da' mi srid/ /rang bzhin dam tshig chen por bshad/ /rang bzhin lhun grub dam tshig la/ /rig pas phyin ci ma log na/ /sngon snang rtags pa'i chos med pas/ /lta ba'i dam tshig chen por bshad/ /de don blo la 'dris pa yis/ /spyod lam kun tu ma nyams par/ /ting 'dzin rgyun gyi dam tshig ste/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang spyod yul cig /'di la bsrung ba ci yang med/ /nyams pa rdul tsam 'byung mi srid/ /nam mkha' spyod la 'dzin med pas/ /lhag pa'i dam tshig rnam bzhir ldan/ /srung bya ma lus 'dir 'dus phyir/ /dam tshig kun gyi mdo zhes bya// //sgyu 'phrul rnam bkod gtor tshogs rgya mtsho'i rgyud chen las/ /lam 'bras snying po me long bcu gcig gis mtshon pa/ /'khor lo ngag mchu'i tshul gyis bsgegs pa'i blos bsdus pa'i/ /dge rtsas kun kyang dam gnas 'gro kun byang chub myur thob shog /dam tshig gsal bkra zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa'o/ /sdogs so// //43—/202

༄༅/ /dam tshig phra rgyas bstan pa/ 1༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi lha la phyag btsal nas/ /lam bzhi dag yod bya ba'i phyir/ /las snod skal bas gnas gyur pa/ /dam tshig phra rgyas gsungs pa de/ /thun mong mchog gi srung bya rnams/ /rnal 'byor cha la gnas pa yi/ /bdag dang gzhan dang chos kyi phyir / /gzhung tshul srung ba 'di mi bya/ /snga ma srung bar bya ba ni/ /mtha' yas gsungs pa mdo tsam du/ /nges 'byung bzhi yis gzhi rnams dang / /dka' thub 'dzin med sems kyis bsrung 2/ /gzhi phyir gzhan yang lus ngag gi//brgyan po 'gyed rnams dor ba dang / /mtshon thogs 'phong rtsed mchong rgyug dang / /ma rabs thor bu'i spyod kun dor/ /ngag gi bzhi dang grol ngag rnams//nam yang smra bar bya ba min/ /nyon mongs drug dang bying rgod bsogs/ /skyon sems bye brag bsam mi khyab/ /gang dag don med de len pa/ /kha na ma tho 73—/204

'phel ba dang / /skye bo'i gnas su mi 'gyur bas/ /'khor ba'i mtha' mar spyad thag yan/ /byang chub ched phyir gang yang spyad/ /de dag las ldog spyod pa gsum/ /sems kyis zin par gar spyod pa/ /sangs rgyas sku gsung thob par 'gyur/ /phyi ma rtsa ba yan lag pas/ /lnga bcu'i brgya dang drug cu dang / /nyis brgya'i srung bya ma lus pa/ /bka' lung gnyis kyi rjes su snyegs/ /pan tsi nying lag zhes bya ba'ang / /dang po nyid nas thabs spyod dang / /shes rab nyid kyis nyis 'gyur yin/ /de des srung bya bcu gsum ste/ /byang chub sems ni bla med lha/ /zhi khro'i lha dgu nyid dang bcu/ /bcu gnyis bsam las mi 'da' zhing / /thun mong mchog gis tshad med pa/ /bden gnyis byang chub rnam pa bcu/ /bla med gsal bas nyams mi bya/ /lha spangs dge spyad don med 'gyur/ /bdag nyid lha dang mnyam sbyor na/ /yon tan chung yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /de phyir dus gsum 'da' mi bya/ /bla ma bskur ba'ang sgo gsum gyis / /lus kyi srung ba'ang bdeg sogs las/ /thing klad rtsa 'du'ang bya ba min / /'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa dang / /gsang ba'i snod du dug mi spyod/ /'gro ba grang po'i phyogs spang dang / /gdan sa gdan sogs mi brlam dang / /'greng 'dug ngan spyod la sogs spang / /rgyan 'dogs ze ldir de bzhin ste/ /ma rabs spyod pa kun spangs la/ /spyod lam zon chag ste gnas bya/ /rdzun dang phra ma ngag rtsub dang / /'khyal pa nam yang mi bya ste/ /be phogs ma yin brda skad dor/ /gog du tshul brjod nyams par 'gyur/ /yon tan brjod cing snyan par smra/ /ca co la sogs ma yin pa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje gsung thob 'gyur / /dam pa ston pa'i bla ma la/ /chags sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang / /13—1205

phra dog dug lnga'i sems mi bya/ /ngan du mi sems lci bar sems/ /pha ma yi dam 'dra bar bsam/ /rtag tu gdung ba rgyun mi bcad/ /byang chub gzungs la zhugs pa yin/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad/ /zhi khro'i phyag rgya bdun gnyis cig /phyogs bcing rten dang khang pa'i sngags/ /rtsa skyed las rnams bzhi yi sngags/ /dbang bskur byin bsdu gsang sngags dang / /spyan drang stem brtan phyag 'tshal mchod/ /dus gsum rgyun du gzhi yin phyir/ /nam yang rgyun bcad spang mi bya/ /yang dag lam du zhugs pa'i grogs/ /snum pa ma yin slang mi bya/ /zla zer ma yin gzungs mi spyad/ /lta spyod mtho ba'i gong mi bcad/ /dbang dang dam tshig de bzhin ste/ /kun tu yangs bag zon phrig can/ /sgur stes mchod byed dga' bar spyod/ /rdzun sogs rnam bzhi spang ba dang / /bya ba mi smra tshul mi brjod/ /snyan smra zhes pa gsong por smra/ /bden tshig sri zhu'i sgra byed pa'o/ /sems kyi sngon bzhin dug lnga dor/ /mngan sbya sems mi spang ba dang / /mig 'drar lta zhing gdung bar bya/ /gnod sems spang dang rnam bcu'o/ /gsang ba'i phyir ni mi smra ba/ /spyi dang bar gsang bzhi bzhi dang / /'os dang gnyer gtad rnam pa bcu/ /sems kyis brtan par mi bsam zhing / /ngag gis brjod par yong mi bya/ /lus brdas brtan man sum cu'o/ /yan lag dam tshig lnga gnyis la/ /cig la bcu phrag gnyis su dbye/ /dang du blang ba'i dam bsgrub rdzas/ /bsgrub rdzas lnga yang rtsa ba brgyad/ /brgyad cha re zhing dang snyigs lnga/ /re re'ang rnam pa bcu ru 'gyur//zhing bcu'i bdud rtsi'i de bzhin pas/ /rnam par dbye ba nyi shu'o/ /bdag gzhan rang bzhin zhi dang gnyis/ /rjas bcu thabs spyod shes rab spyod/ /43—/206

bcu bcus nyi shur 'gyur ba'ang rigs/ /mi spang lnga la bcu gnyis te/ /zhing bcu thabs kyi mdzad pas 'joms/ /shes rab rang bzhin med par grol/ /thabs dang shes rab zhe sdang gis/ /bdag gzhan don rnams rdzogs par byed/ /yan lag bcu yis 1dam tshig la/ /thabs kyi mdzad pa mi 'byed cing / /shes rab gnyis med mi 'byed pa'i/ /gti mug bcu gnyis 'da' mi bya/ /de ltar thabs dang shes rab bcu/ /gnyis ni sdeng du gyur pa yi/ /lhag pa'i nga rgyal mi 'da' ba/ /nga rgyal chen po'i dam tshig go/ /zhing bcu thugs rjes mi stong pa/ /rigs lnga'i yum la thabs kyis rol/ /ting 'dzin thabs dbang rang bzhin sbyar//shes rab don dang 'du 'bral med/ /ma rtogs gnyis dang log rtogs gnyis/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/ /gsang sngags phyi yi jeg pa gsum/ /gsang sgor mdzad pas mi chud cing / /shes rab ngan pas mi chud pa/ /phra dog chen po'i dam tshig go/ /de lta ra su/ma brgya drug cu rnams/ /bdag gi rdo je mchog gsum pos/ /log par mi stong sdom pa'i dngos/ /sa gzhi lta bur srung ba yin/ /rgyas 'bring stong rtsa brgyad dang ni/ /sa ya 'bum sde bdag gzhan phyir/ /srung ba'i rgyud dag las grags pa/ /gsum gyi srung ba sngon bzhin no/ /dam tshig 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag /'grub 'gyur 'dir bde rtag pa yi/ /dbang phyug chen po nyid du 'gyur/ /byen rlabs gsum kyis mdzad pa dang / /nye 'du las byed rtag du srung / /yid 'ong gter 'dod bsam 'grub cing / /phun sum tshogs yon rgyud las 'byung / /myong la dam tshig rdo rje chu/ /bzhag cing go bas bsgrags byas na/ /rgyud lnga tha tshigs bral 'gyur na/ /rag sha yag shar gyur nas kyang / /bsad 43——/207

༄ga /sgyu 'phrul sbyin sreg gi rim pa mdor bsdus pa/1༄7/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtan tshigs gnyis rjes rims 'brengs nas/ /rang nyams goms pa'i rigs pa yis /rnam pa mtshan nyid 'bras bcas pa'i/ /sbyin sreg rim pa bshad par bya/ /las 'di lung gis bsgrubs byas na/ /sbyin sreg rnam pa nges tshig dang / /yon tan rnam pa gsum du gsungs/ /dang po phyi nang gsang ba la/ /rang bzhin thugs rje chen po dang / /lhag pa gzugs brnyan gsum du bshad/ /ting 'dzin lhag pa'i longs spyod nang / /khams bzhi'i khams ni gsang bar bshad / /rang rig ye shes rgyal po yis/ /phyogs bcu ma lus rgyas btab pas / /mi dmigs mi dmigs dmigs su med/ /thams cad rang rig khro bor gsal/ /dmigs med nyid la dbang sgyur ba/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar snang / /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa la/ /mtshan ma'i spros pa ngang gis me+ed/ /43—/209

nam mkha'i mkha' dkyil dang ba yi/ /yid bzhin tshogs rnams kun byung ba/ /sna tshogs 'byung zhing 'od 'phro 'bar/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs rmad nyapo che/ /'gro ba sna tshogs don byed pa/ /'di ni byang chub mchog du gsungs/ /cig shos las kyi gtsor gyur pa/ /rgyas par phyi nang shes par bya/ /dbu ma dang po gnyis yin te/ /ye shes rang rig rtags kyi ā+oṃ/ /rang dang spyi ru bstan pa dang / /sems kyi phrag dog thams cad kun/ /bdag med rang rig ye shes kyis / /dngos po gnyis med rtogs byas pas/ /dngos dang dngos med bag chags sregs/ /de ming ye shes me zhes bya/ /srid gsum sreg pa me yin te/ /yid kyi ye shes/ me ru 'bar/ /sman bcud len gyis dug sbyong ltar/ /phyi dang nang gi dri ma dag /bdag med gnyis kyis bdag por byed/ /gsal zhing bzhag par bya ba med/ /rang snang ting 'dzin ye shes ram/ /ri rab gling sogs khams gsum sbyangs/ /rab rib dag pa'i rang rig gis/ /sgu gsum rang bzhin mthong dbang sgyur/ /goms pas bzhi 'joms ngan song sbyong / /ting 'dzin las kyi mchog tu bshad/ /shes rab dang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /spyod yul rdzas rnams basbus nas ni/ /lhan ne lhang nge 'od du zhu/ /zhi 'gyur dbyings nas phyag rgya 'bar/ /rigs tshogs lha yi dkyil 'khor du/ /gsal 'gyur kun kyang de bzhin pa/ /spyod yul dag pas nang du gsungs/ /rang lus 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /lus dang rtsa dang dur khrod kyi/ /gzhal yas khang la sogs par bsgom / /myong byed kun gzhi'i zhal bsam ste/ /rdzogs dang bkod pa'i lha rnams bsgom4/ /ting 'dzin gsal bar yid kyis sbyar / /ye shes dkyil 'khor zhugs par bya/ /bsgrub bya 'od kyis nges sbyar 43—/210

ba'i / /longs spyod yi ge lngas sbyangs pa'i/ /dri sbar rtse lnga'i sgang blugs kyis//las bzhi'i mchod pa rab tu sbyin/ /bsam gtan bzhi bcas las nyid kyi/ /'bras ldan spyod yul dag 'gyur zhing / /yid bzhin sku dang— longs spyod 'grub/ /mchod sbyin rgya che rnam gnyis kyis/ /tshogs gnyis rgyun du rdzogs par byed/ /sum mdo'i snying rkog lte 'byung bzhi/ /kha dog las bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la/ /ye shes snying po ma lus zhal/ /thabs las ye shes me 'bar bas las kyi me+es bskul bde ba drang / /nges par zhal du chud pa na/ /ma lus mnyes pa'i dgyel ba yis/ /phyogs bcu kun tu khyab par 'gyur/ /mtshan ma rnam rtog kun sbyong zhing / /rtogs dka'i ye shes mngon du 'gyur/ /khams gsum bco brgyad bdag nyid de/ /ma lus rtsa bar 'di shes bya/ /gsal ldan ma 'am byin rlabs la/ /las bzhi'i dbyibs ldan ho khung du/ /las kyi bde ba'i lha bskyed cing / /stong gsum nyungs 'brur 'jug tshul du/ /dbyings nas dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ /nyung 1'bru me lha'i zhal nyid du/ /rdo rje sgang blugs bcas pa yis/ /dkar nag dmar gyis me mchod pas/ /rang bzhin rnam pa gnyis kyi lha/ /bsnyes dang 'gro mang bde thob 'gyur/ /dus bzhi'i sbyin sreg mchod sbyar bas/ /thun mong mchog gi yon tan rnams/ /dka' ba gred par len par gsungs/ /'jig rten mang tshogs rnams spangs pa'i/ /ji bzhin don ston ming nges tshig /de phyir sbyin gnyis stong dang thob/ /rdzas rgyun shes rab ting 'dzin dang / /byin rlabs stong dang rnam pa lnga/ /'dzin gred blo ni don gyi ming / /byin rlabs yon tan rnam pa gsum/ /gzugs brnyan me long tshul bzhin du/ /snang ba thob pas sbyin par bshad/ /rdzas dang 43—1211

spyod dang bdag gzhan kyi/ /spyod yul rgyu rkyen dang bcas pa'i/ /dag byed ming nges tshig ces bya/ /lhag par gzugs brnyan khas blangs pa'i/ /gnas rdzas thab kyi rnam pa dang / /gzung 1dang tso sems bsgrub bya dang / /phur pa lha dus las rim dang / /lhag ma bcu gcig shes par bya/ /ri bo 'dus pa'i rtse rnams dang / /chu gling 'jam pa'i sa phyogs su/ /dang bar byed pa'i las rnams rtsam/ /nags tshal ljon pa me tog tshal/ /lhun sdug ri bo rgyas par bshad / /sum mdo chu bo 'dus pa dang / /bzhi mdo'i khang stong sdud ces bya/ /dur khrod ngan pa'i sa phyogs su/ /lhag ma btsams na nges par 'grub/ /rang bzhin nus mthu ldan pa'i phyir/ /shin tu gces par bstan pa yin/ /gnyis pa rnam pa lngar bshad de/ /me yi rdzas gnyis sreg shing ni/ /rtse mo zhi byed yan lag brgyas2/ /sdong po dbang rtsa mngon spyod pa'o/ /kha dog las kyis sbyar bar bya/ /shug pa tsan dan dkar po dang / /u dusmra ra 'o ma'i shing / /zhi rgyas yam shing shes par bya/ /dmar la dri zhim shing rnams dang / /dug shing tsher ma can dag la/ /tshil byugs dbang drag me spar ro/ /bsgrub bya'i dam rdzas gos bsogs dang / /longs spyod de bzhin shes par bya/ /dug dang tsha ba sa gsum dang / /sha chen ra dang ba lang sha /mchog du gsod par byed pa yin / /sgyur ba dbang ste ling ka'i rdzas/ /'o ma 'bras chan rdul phye dang / /me tog dkar po gtor mi zha / /ldong ros dro chan zho dang phrum/ /me tog gser phye rgyas pa la'o/ /zabs 4phye bu ram 'bras dmar dang / /ram bu pad+ma'i rak+tar sbyar/ /thams cad gdud pa'i gtor ma yin/ /dug rnams lcags phye rdo phye dang / /ra kyi khrag dang sha chen dang / /dur sol mud ka'i 43—/212

chan rnams ni/ /gsod par byed pa'i gtor ma yin/ /mar dkar til dkar nas dkar chan/ /mdar gsum tsan dan dkar po'i shing / /thams cad ye shes bdud rtsis te/ /tha mas ye shes me skyed do/ /zho dang mar rnying 1 bu ram 'bras/ /rgun 'brum sha chen star ka dang / /dri zhim ser zhing rgyas pa la'o / /dan ti shing la shang tse dang / /dmar po'i shing tsha dag gis ni/ /thams cad 'gugs pa'i mchog du gsungs/ /dug dang tshil chen skye tshe mar/ /sran chan khrag sna sna tshogs dang / /tsher ma ba lang sha chen gsod / /'bras bu'i don phyir 'tshogs par bya/ /sa gzhi legs par sbyang byas te/ /dkyil 'khor zlum po rim pa gsum/ /khru gang spangs dang zheng du yin/ /zabs dang gyen du phyed du bshad/ /'khor lo oṃ kyi snying po can/ /rdo rje 'khor lo me 'od rim / /mda' bzhi zhags pa dkar pos bye/ /gzhan yang rtsibs bzhi'i 'khor lo la/ /rigs bzhi'i phyag rgya rims shes bya/ /oṃ dang gser mgo spel ma yis/ /mu khyud skor ba phyi ru bshad/ /thams cad zhi byed dkyil 'khor yin//ye shes phyogs bzhi dbus 'od 'bar/ /khru gang tshad bsogs rjes su mthun/ /rdo rje rin chen zhags pas bskor/ /dbus su pad+ma swa zer dṛ snying ldan/ /gzhan yang rin chen gnyis dbyibs su/ /rim pa la sogs rjes su sbyar/ /zhags pa ser pos skor bar bya/ /thams cad 'phel byed dkyil 'khor yin/ /ye shes phyogs bzhi dbus 'od 'bar/ /ho khung zla kham sdengs pa la/ /rdo rje pad mo 'od 'bar dang / /lcags sgog gtams pas mdzes par bya/ /dbus su pad+ma hri snying ldan/ /gzhan yang 'dab brgyad de bzhin du/ /tha ma srom shing mdzes pas skor/ /zhags pa dmar po sdud pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor gru 43—1213

gsum rtsegs pa la/ /dur khrod sol bas khyab par bya/ /rtsa gsum rdo rje sdengs pa dang / /thod pa lcags sgyu 1bsdams pas bskor/ /hūṃ bcas rdo rje'i rnam pa yin/ /dbang phyug zhags pa nag po bri/ /gzhan yang sdang spyan bsgrad pa yi/ /khro zhal shin tu 2'jigs pa bri/ /me dpung 'bar bas rab mdzes pa'i / /'di ni gsod pa'i mchog tu gsungs/ /bong chung lus mdzes zla ba'i mdog /g.yas 'khyil lus la de bzhin shes/ /skad gsal sngags zlos yid mi spyo/ /khro ba spangs pa zhi la sbyar/ /ba lang ser mo gru bzhi la/ /rna ba 'gram glang ring sha rgyas/ /yan lag zla mang las la mkhas/ /dal zhing blo gros ldan pa ni/ /'phel ba'i dus su shes par bya/ /dmar po zla gam mdzes pa'i zhal/ /yan lag rgyun nas rnam par spangs/ /thabs mkhas brtson 'grus ldan pa ni/ /thams cad sdud par byed pa yin/ /nag mo gru gsum rtsid mgo ma/ /khro gnyer can la gel bag can/ /gtum zhing brlang tshig 'dzem bag me+ed/ /sngags zlos brtul shugs ldan pa ni/ /tha ma'i dus su 'di shes bya/ /rang rig sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /thams cad rang dbang sgyur bdag phyir/ /bsgrub pa'i gtso bor 'di gsungs so/ /ma lus sems ni mtha' bral phyir/ /rang bzhin rnam dag mngon byas pas/ /sems gter rtog tshogs dkyil 'khor phyir/ /byin rlabs bsdus 'phel sngon du bsgom/ /thams cad bdag phyir tha mi dad/ /shin tu zhen pa nyid kyis 'grub/ /chags pa chen po nyid du bshad/ /rang bzhin cig phyir rngos med 'jig /log rtog khros pa'i sems kyis bsgul/ /yang dag zhe sdang chen por gsungs/ /bdag gzhan gnod pa'i sems dang ni/ /sbyor ba ngan pa'i rig —sngags las/ / (3—/2/

khams rkyen las gyur snod mang ba/ /nyon mongs bag chags sdug bsngal rnams/ /thabs phyir cig kyang dor mi bya/ /yon tan 'phel med nyung ba'i phyir/ /tshe dang longs spyod sgo gsum gyi/ /yon tan mngon par mi ldan pa'i/ /'jig rten pa dang 'das pa yi/ /yon tan bsdus te bstem pa dang / /sems ni rin chen gter gyi phyir/ /byin rlabs 'byel pa snang bar 'gyur/ /mos 'dud med pa las rkyen can/ /las gsum bdag gzhan don gyi phyir/ /gsum pa las la sbyar bya zhing / /lha yang de bzhin gshegs par bya/ /zhing bcur gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /dam pa'i chos 'jig ma rungs pa/ /dpa' bos 1dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ /kun la phan pas de bya'o/ /dngul lam dkar po'i shing rnams la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zlum po/ /steng 'og logs la khro bcu bsgom/ /'phro 'dus bder gshegs phur pa la/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pas/ /mtha' skor yan lag gnyis la sbyar/ /gser ram ser po'i shing rnams la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse gru bzhi/ /lha rnams de bzhin rin chen khro/ /zur bzhir gnas pas lus gnas bzhir/ /btab pas yon tan 'du bar 'gyur/ /zangs sam dmar po'i shing rnams la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum/ /de bzhin chags pa'i phur par shes/ /zla gam mtha' lnga dbang po sbyar/ /de dag bsgyur te 'dus par bya/ /lcags sam nag po'i shing rnams la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum/ /de bzhin rdo rje phur brlabs pas/ /zur gsum lus ngag sems la sbyar/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /las byed nyi shu gcig du'ang gsungs/ /sbyin dang sreg pa'i gnas gnyis te/ /sangs rgyas rigs kyi sprul pa'i phyir/ /las thams cad la 13—/2/5
