thogs med 'jug /sku mdog cha lugs las bzhin shes/ /baghu dhe sgrom zhags tri shul 'dzin/ /rigs kyi phyag rgya gdab par bya/ /oṃ hri hri 1t+t+waṃ sa bon snying / /aghi de ba zhal bzhi'i sngags/ /'od 'phro 'bar bas 'khor bar bsgom / /zhal bzhi sbyin pa'i lhar bshad do/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu'i gzhal yas ni/ /'od 'phro 'bar bas khyab par sbyar/ /rgyal po'i lus mdzes 'khor lo 'chang / /rgyan rnams zhi la dkar ba dang / /'od zer 'bar lhan lha ner sgom / /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /kun kyang gti mug rdo rje'i tshul/ /'khor lo 'od zer ldan pa yi/ /khams gsum thams cad khyab par bya /sa bon oṃ dang rang sngags ldan/ /gzhan yang de bzhin shes par byas / /rin chen dga' spro ser skya ni/ /'od zer 'bar ba rin chen can/ /sngags sogs gzhan ni snga ma'i tshul/ /sprul pa rjes su mthun pa ste/ /dza hūṃ baṃ ho 'don par bya / /'dod chags rdo rje lcags sgog dang / /mdog ni dmar rmug 'od po che/ /sngags ni yi ge ram̐ dang hri/ /phyogs bcur khyab pa'i tri la bsdu/ /gzhan la'ang de bzhin shes par bya/ /zhe sdang rdo rje gtum por 'bar/ /dud kha nag po'i mdog 'dra la/ /'bar bas sngon dmar me rtag 'khrug /nyi zla thod sbrul gdug pas rgyan / /seng ge glang chen stag rngam —dang / /rbod stong rngam pa'i phyag rgyar ldan/ /sgra skad drag po khams gsum 'khrug /sgrub byed phyag rgya goms pa yis/ /gang la dmigs pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid las rim dang / /snga dro gung dgongs nam phyed dus/ /las rim brtsams shing shis par gsungs/ /rdzas dang yo byad ldan byas la/ /sa gzhi sbyang ste gzugs bsnyan 5sbyar/ /stong gyur mgon la las bcol zhing / /kun 73—/216

kyang tshim bya bgo ba bya/ /shing gnyis mchod rdzas legs bkod de/ /kha dog me ngar legs pas dgab/ /ling ka'i gnas ni gzugs brnyan tshul/ /ming dus ldan pa phur bus bskor/ /rdo rje gur gyis phyogs bcing bya/ /nyi ma zla ba gnyis gnyis kyis/ /gzhong pa snod kyi rdzas rnams la/ /las kyi t+t+waṃ las 'bru lnga dgod/ /'phro 'dus bdud rtsi'i kha dog ldan/ /mang zhing sna tshogs ro dang ldan / /dkyil 'khor las kyi gzhung srang la/ /sna tshogs mchod yon rgyas par dbul/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor legs par rtag /mchod pa chen pos sbyar bar bya/ /sa bon rang gi 'bru 'od zer/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bskul ba dang / /khams gsum byin rlabs bsdus byas te/ /bsgrub bya nye bar sbyar bar bya/ /srog dang ldan pa'i bzlas pa ni/ /zhal gyi rang sngags khri 'bum du/ /rnam gsum tshul kyis dag par bya/ /shin tu stong 'gyur rgyas par bya/ /khams gsum pa yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /rngam zhing 'od zer 'bar bar sgom/ /bdag nyid ting 'dzin phyag rgya che/ /mtshan ma gzungs dang rang sngags gdon/ /rol pa'i pho nya bka' nyan tshogs/ /phyag rgya bzhi ldan sgra skad drag /khams gsum dkrugs te bral byas nas/ /bsgrub bya sngon du sbyar bar bya/ /lan gsum lan bdun mngon byed pa/ /hūṃ dang dza dang spo la sogs/ /'dren pa'i mchog du de gsungs so/ /brtan nas rang gi gtor ma sbyin/ /ting 'dzin so sor legs par sbyar/ /rnam shes lus bcud yig bsdus la/ /gsum bsdu lhag ma spros byas la/ /bsnyen po'i tshul du gsal bar ma /rang phur gsal byas sa bon che/ /dz+re sogs der bsnyus gnas bstem la/ /'dod bzhin ting 'dzin bzhi yis bya/ /yungs kar bcas bsgul 'od zer dbab/ /ji ltar 43—1217

dmigs pa 'grub par bsam/ /mtshan ma ming du bsdus pa la/ /mkha' las 'od 'phros bag chags sbyangs/ /rang rgyud sa bon ar gyur pas/ /ma skyes dbyings nas gsal ba'i hūṃ/ /mtshon gang 'od kyi sems dpa' che/ /ji ltar mngon gyi de bzhin du/ /smon lam byang chub lam du zhugs/ /lhag pa'i skabs las shes par bya/ /phyed ni ral gri zer bu'am mtshon cha lngas/ /gdul du byas te thod pa dag /rjes su mthun pa'i gzhal yas su/ /byin la so sor gdan ldan sgom/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i tshogs chen du/ /me lha asne dzas bkug la/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis des sbyar la/ /ram̐ zhes bya bas me spar la/ /gzar bu rigs kyi mtshan bcas pas/ /'dod yon bdud rtsi rgyas par 'bul/ /de dbus 'khor lo gsal btab ste/ /gnyis pa'i lha rnams spyan drangs bstem/ /mar dang shing bu chan la sogs/ /dmar gyi arga rgyun tu dbul/ /cig min thams cad bdud rtsir gsol/ /yang na lan gsum rgya rtsa brgyad/ /stong dang 'bum du dbul bar bya/ /dug gsum mchod pa'ang de bzhin te/ dbang med zhal du thim par 'gyur/ /ming dang las bzhi'i sngags kyis dbul/ /'grub 'gyur the tshom 1med ces bshad/ /gzugs brnyan lu gu rgyud skor la/ /e sogs tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rjes su mthun pa'i lha sgoms la/ /slas dang byi mo'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /khams gsum ma lus gang bar bya/ /srog dang ldan pa'i bro stabs gar/ /phyogs bcu ma lus kun brtul nas/ /bsgrub bya dbus su legs brtags te/ /sa bon 'od zer 'a/sa bzhin du/ /bstems nas bsam bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/ /rjes su mthun pa'i smon lam gdab/ /zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun/ /43—/2/8

thal ba bzhin du bklag nas kyang / /drag po 1las 'di 'grub par mdzod/ /'dod chags rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus kun/ /skad cig yud kyis dbang mdzad de/ /dbang du ma gyur med par mdzod/ /nga rgyal rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /gzi brjid ldan pa 'khor bcas kun/ /dpal dang gzi brjid chen po rnams/ /yud tsam gyis ni rgyas par mdzod/ /gti mug rdo rje 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten khams rnams ma lus kun/ /yud tsam gyis ni zhi mdzad de/ /thams cad zhing gyur dbyings su rol/ /hūṃ gsum bcas te bskul ba las/ /ma lus 'grub pa'i mchog du gsungs/ /rim pas bzlog ste brtsam par bya/ /khrag 'thung chen po la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu tshig chen po yis/ /las dang dngos grub ci 'dod par/ /thams cad ma lus byed pa yin/ /mdzod ldan chen mo la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu tshig chen pos ni/ /'du bar 'dod na 'du bar byed/ /'phel bar 'dod na 'phel bar byed/ /rbos mo chen mo la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu tshig chen pos ni / /lha ne+er 'dod na lha ne+er byed/ /rmugs par 'dod na rmugs par byed//seng gdong chen mo la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu tshig chen po yis/ /thams cad kun la bza' bar byed/ /gdul cha tsam yang med par byed/ /gzhad gdong chen mo la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu tshig chen mos ni/ /thams cad kun la 'byin par byed/ /de dag rab tu nyams par byed/ slas dang byi mo'i bro gar gyis/ /rbad cing gtang bar bya bas te/ /kun la thams cad byed pa yin / /bya byed yan lag rdzogs pa yis/ /thams cad sdud dang mnyam pa dang / /de dag sbyor ba zhi 'gyur zhing / /sku gsung rdo rje'ang 'jig 'gyur na//73—/2/9

khams gsum de dag smos ci dgos/ /bdag nyid 'dul ba'i dbang phyug du/ /las bzhi mnyam bzhag khro bo yis/ /'khor gyi khro rnams de bzhin gshegs/ /phra men tshogs rnams bsgul bsdus la/ /las bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nyid dag du/ /lhag ma kha chu 'dod pa sbyin/ /sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka /shin tu gdug cing gtum bag can/ /khams gsum ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /dbang dang byin rlabs rmad po che/ /lha chen la sogs dbang bsdus nas/ /'khor rnams dbang phyug slas su byas/ /so so'i las la bskos pa de/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /ma thogs myur du mngon par phyung / /dam bcas bzhin du ma byas na/ /ji ltar rang gis mnas bor ba'i/ /dam bcas de las 'das gyur na/ /mgo 'gas snying yang tshal pa ru/ /yaka sha khro bos gtub par 'gyur/ /de bas rnal 'byor sngags 'chang gi/ /ji ltar bcol ba bzhin du byos / /gal de 1las de ma byas na/ /rang gis khas blangs mnas bor bzhin/ /mgo lus tshig nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /rnal 'byor dam la gnas gyur pa'i/ /las rnams yongs su bya ba dang / /'khor rnams bu cig bzhin du skyongs/ /phra men ma yang dngos grub thob/ /bcol ba'i las rnams myur du gyis/ /dkyil 'khor snying la bsdu byas te/ /lhag mas mchod de gshegs su gsol/ /gsang phyir legs par nan tan bya/ /sgyu 'phrul sbyin sreg gi rim pa mdor bsdus pa/slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa sdogs so// //((3—/220

bsdur mchan/1209 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/121༷ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〉da/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i/ 5 ④〈〈pe 〉〉sgom/1211 17〈〈pe 〉〉nyang /1212 〉〈〈pe 〉stanazungs/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉rgyas/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉pa zhi/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉zangs/1213 17〈〈pe 〉nyasteng / rgya〈〈pe 〉〉bsod/1214 41 〈〈pe 〉〉sgyu/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉du/ 〈〈pe 〉〉brlabs/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉rigs/1215 cho) 〈〈pe 〉〉'os 〈 〈〈pe 〉〉tsom/1216 19〈〈pe 〉〉tri hri/ sa 〈〈pe 〉〉rgya/ (〈〈pe 〉〉brgyan/ gi 〈〈pe 〉〉dam/ lta〈〈pe 〉〉brnyan/1218 1 〈〈pe 〉〉tsom/1219 1 〈〈pe 〉〉polnga//122༷ 19〈〈pe 〉〉te/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2549)43wa 1 221

༄/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba ro sreg las kyi phreng ba/ 1༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das thugs rje'i 'dren pa byed pa po la phyag 'tshal lo / /sgyu 'phrul chen po'i rgyud dag las/ /rtog pa'i dra ba sreg pa dang / /brdos byas thugs rjes sbyang ba'i phyir/ /ro sreg las kyi phreng ba tsam/ /rtog pa'i dra ba bsal nas ni/ /sku lnga lhun kyis 'grub par shog /dang po de nyid lus bzhag pa/ /bgegs bskrad pa dang bcas pa dang / /gdags dang sbyang dang dbang bsgur dang / /thab khung sreg khang slob dpon dang / /las gzhung sbyin sreg bsdu bas te/ /lnga gnyis cig gis don rdzogs 'gyur/ /mdor bsnyus spyi yi don du 'dod/ /de dag rgyas par bshad pa ni/ /ci nus pa yis rnam par dbye/ /e ram̐ khams gsum ma lus kun/ /za byed 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /khog srungs lhan cig skyes rdzogs la/ /bdeg dang bsnun dang gzhom pa dang / /'phros te rten la gnyis med bya/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i cho 13—/222

ga yis/ /dam tshig sems dpa' srungs te bzhag /de ltar grangs dang zhag dus su/ /yang dang yang du gnan te bya/ /khrus dang rgyan dang byugs snapas te//phyi dang nang gi lnga gnyis la/ /brgya pa gnyis dang dag pa ni/ /chu la lan grangs mang bzlas te/ /mchod rten de la bkru bar bya/ /mi 'chi bcu phyed spos mar dang / /dri yis de la yang dag byug /zhun chen khu bar btsos pa yi//ras kyis steng nas yang dag bkri2/ /spos mar thor spyog de la dkon/ /mgul do rgyan yang gdags par bya/ /phung po lnga yi gnas dag du/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i phyag rgya dgod/ /rtsa ru yum lnga'i phyag rgya dgod/ /rnam shes dbang po yul rnams su/ /sems dpa' sems ma 'dzom pa dang / /'jom ma rim par dgod do zhes/ /mnyam pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa yin/ /rgyu drug 'khor ba'i gnas rnams su/ /thub drug sa bon dgod pa yin/ /kun bzangs yab yum de bzhin te/ /sdong bu re la lha rnams kyi/ /ma nor rtsa ba'i snying po dag /ras chen rgyu las byas te gdags/ /mya ngan 'das par gsungs pa yin/ /ro yi phyi rol shun pa la/ /'gro drug sa bon bkod nas ni/ /'od zer 'phro 'du'i sbyor ba yis/ /rim kyis sbyang ba'i las su bya/ /dbu rgyan cod pan 'phreng ba dang / /rdo rje dri bu la sogs pa/ /dbang mchog byin la stegs la bzhag /de nas me thab tsam bya ba/ /khru bzhi do yi tshang byas la/ /mthur du brus te dkyil 'khor du/ /za byed dkyil 'khor phyag rgya dgod/ /rdo rje me ris mtshan pa ni/ /thabs 4khung yin par gsal bar gsungs/ /phyi rol ka ba bzhi btsugs la/ /'og ma sgrengs pas sum brtsegs 5bya/ /bar ba shing gi rdzas dbus su/ /pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la/ /khro bo brgyad kyi snying por 73—/223

ldan / /dbus su me yi sa bon dgod/ /bzhin phyogs shar du bstan te dgod / /ro la gzungs thag btags nas ni/ /blo kar bzhi nas drangs byas la/ /bla ma bzhi'i phyag du gtad/ /sum rtseg yang thog chen po der/ /ras sam gro ga shing shun la/ /thugs rje dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /lding bur byas te gdags par bya/ /de nas rdo rje rgyal po yis/ /rang bzhin me yi 'phro 'du bya/ /rdo rje kar ma las mkhan gyis/ /srung dang skrad pa nas rtsams te / /las kyi 'phreng ba rdzogs par bya/ /rdo rje rgyal po bla ma yis/ /mtshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga/ /lci ba bzhi dag la sogs pa/ /ro yi nyes pa sgrang zhing bshags/ /rdo rje skabs spyor bla ma des/ /skabs skabs dag tu mchod pa dbul/ /bkra shis gnas kyis smon lam btab/ /skabs sam kun gyi 'jug du gdab/ /rdo rje grangs kyi ltang 'dzin pas/ /grangs bzung dkar byang bla mar dbul/ /sdig pa'i gnag byang bshags shing sreg /bzlas brjod 'phro 'dus rtog tshogs rnams/ /sbyangs te rang rang lha ru brlab/ /tshogs dang yo byad mchod pa kun/ /rim pas mdun du snang byas la/ /de las ram̐ skyed ram̐ las me/ /skyed de rang bzhin spyan drangs bstem/ /i li u li sta pa tis / /tshogs kyi mchod pa skabs su sbyar/ /mchod dang stong pa rim pa bzhin / /me yi lho bar gzhal yas khang / /lha dang bcas pa rim par skyed/ /gong gi dkyil 'khor gsal btab la/ /gnyis su me+ed par bstem byas la/ /mchod pa'i rim pa gong ma bzhin/ /stong pa la sogs de dang mtshungs/ /me yi ltas dang bzang dang ngan/ /rim pa bzhin du brtag par bya/ /de nas rdo rje bsdu ba yis/ /rim pa bzhin du sdus byas la/ /dam pa yin na sku gdung 43—/224

rtag /lhag ma bsdus la mchod rten nam/ /sku 'am gtsug lag zhal zhal lam/ /thad ka'i ri mo bya ba 'am/ /sa dang bsres la ri lu bya/ /sbyin sreg bya bas mkhas pas bshad/ /de nas bsdu dang phyag pa dang / /gshegs su gsol ba rim bzhin bya/ /tshon rtsi bsdus te rol mo yis/ /rgya mtsho chen por skyal te gtang / /'khor ba'i sems can log rtog 'khrul pas shin tu nyon mongs bcas pa des1/ /dral cing sreg dang brdos bcas sbyang phyir dri med bshes gnyen gdung ba dag gis kyang / /sgyu 'phrul rtogs dka' rngam pa rgya mtsho'i mtha' yas rgyud chen las basbus pa'i/ /ngal ba'i dge rtsas 'gro drug rgya mtsho'i sems can bsdos bcas 'di kun zag med shog /sgyu 'phrul dra ba ro sreg las kyi phreng ba rdzogs so// //slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa'o/ /(3—/22pya

༄ / /sgyu 'phrul dpe chung rang gnas kyi rim pa/1༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das ye shes rang gnas kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo//rdo rje 'dzin la phyag btsal nas/ /rnal 'byor rang gnas mngon 'dod pas/ /dngos dang bar ma rnam sbyang phyir/ /dpe chung rang gnas bshad par bya/ /rgyud dang rang bzhin rgyud nyid dang / /rang bzhin nang gi dkyil 'khor dang //'pho tshul bar ma'i mtshan nyid dang / /las bsnyen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum / /de dag ting 'dzin las rim dang / /rang gnas sbyang ba'i rim pa dang / /bdag nyid 'da' ka'i man ngag dang / /mthar gnas tshul gyi tha snyad bcu/ /rang gnas rmongs pa'i don phyir dbye/ /dang por gnas gnyis de la yang gnyis/ /bde gshegs snying po ma rig la/ /ma rig bdag lta mtshungs pa'i rgyu/ /kun rtags ma rig nyon mongs las/ /lhan cig skye rgyu rgyu yi rgyu/ /gnyis la rkyen gyi rnam par 'dod/ /mtshams spyor rnam bzhi zhen 43—/227

bcas pa/ /rlung gi rkyen gyis 'ongs mtshungs rgyu/ /rten sems len pa khrag dang bcas/ /pho mo 'dod skol sems kyis 'jug /len rten 'byung ba nges ldan pas/ /thal ba 'bru mar sha rus ltar/ /mi 'gyur nges par 'gyur ba yin//sum cu rtsa brgyad phrag bdun rlung / /lhan cig byed rgyu rkyen du 'dod/ /las rlung dang po zho chags tshul/ /kun sdud ma yi rtsibs las 'bud/ /cung zad sra bar 'gyur ba yin/ /mdzod ces bya bas zlum par byed/ /rab 'byed khrags shing mchi gu ltar/ /yang dag sdud pa yan lag gi/ /rtsa ba lnga po 'byung bar 'gyur / /zas kyi 'phro lnga de bzhin 'byung / /'khyim byed de bzhin lnga rdzogs byed / /zlog rgyur byed pa nyid cig rdzogs/ /rnam par 'byed pa bu gu dod/ /sra byed kun nas sgo mnyam pas/ /sra zhing rgyal ba lta bur 'gyur/ /rdo rje bug spyong kha sna nas/ /gnag khrag chu 'byung dbang po zlog /yon po'i sgos ni nang khrol 'byung / /zhor 'byung spu rgyus zhes pa'i las/ /rus pa'i tshig 1dang nang rnams ldan/ /skres skom byed pas de sems skyes/ /mas zos lte bar 'dzin cing phan/ /rgyus 2pa'i sgos ni rgyus pa g.yog /pad+ma nyi shu rtsa 'byung ste/ /phyogs bzhir lnga lnga cig la'ang brgya/ /nying lag phyogs cig nyi khri la/ /mdun rgyab sa ga stobs zhes bya/ /g.yas g.yon mthur ldan rten pa'o/ /de dag nying lag cig na'ang bdun/ /ngag gi bar te ba spu 'phel/ /kha dog dkar dmar ser por ldan/ /bdud rtsi dbang pos snying mig 'byed/ /dbugs rgyu dbang po rnams kyang rdzogs/ /'bri stong dbang po dang bar byed/ /snyan mgur dbang po'i lam mthur ldan/ /las byed dbang po gsum rdzogs byed//shin tu sra bas rus pa bstan/ /yang dag bskyed pas sha rnams bskyed/ /kun 43—1228

tu rgyal snabs khrag rnams 'byung / /yang dag 'dzin ni pags pa g.yogs/ /sprin 'dzin de nyid mdog ldan byed/ /grong khyer 'dzin pas khrag dngas byed/ /bye ba mngon grub spu rnams dang / /rgyus pa sen mo 'brel par byed/ /phan yon chen pos las bzhin du/ /sgra don phyi'i yul grub ste/ /dmigs pa med pa'i rjes thob la/ /dpe yi tshul gyis bar ma yi/ /lus dang phyi ma'i spyod yul snang / /de phyir 'pho ba'i tha snyad du/ /brtags pas yod par shes par bya/ /bar ma'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /rnam rtog 'byung ba'i lus spangs nas/ /dngas ma las byung yid kyi lus/ /phyis 'byung dbang po yan lag rdzogs/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ /sgyu ma lta ba'i lus ngag gis/ /thogs pa med pa kun la 'jug /dpag tshad bye ba brgya stong yang / /'od kyi rnam pas 'gengs par byed/ /'dod khams snod bcud ma lus pa/ /lha mig dag pas mthong bar 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i lam dag nges par shes/ /re dang dogs pa cung zad nyung / /tshe ni zhag bdun 'gyur du gsungs/ /'chi ka'i man ngag rab shes pas/ /'di tshe nges par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ma skyes rang bzhin ye shes la/ /e ram̐ khaṃ su e dkyil 'khor/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i klong yangs su/ /rang rig ye shes rang snang ba/ /skye 'gro 'byung ba nags tshal kun/ /ma lus khrag 'thung rdo rje'i rigs/ /mthing nag 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha can/ /lcer bu rngams mtshungs til gang sbyar/ /khros pas rngam langs khams gsum 'khrug /bsgrub bya'i dmigs su len par byed/ /dur khrod ras kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /khrag 'thung drug cu rtsa drug rnams/ /rim pa gsum du rtsegs pa ni/ /byin rlabs dbang gis mdzes pa yin/ /rngam tshul gzi byin ldan par bsgom / /43—/229

ye shes spyan drangs mchod gsum sbyar/ /zlas pa srog dang ldan par bya/ /thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /rang bzhin yid kyis dmigs byas te / /gcig dang gnyis su med tshul gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi ngo bor sgom / /bsdu ba'i spyor bas kun bsdus te/ /byin brlabs rtag par gsal bar bya/ /bsgrub bya khrus byas dri dang ldan/ /nges par shar sgo nyid du bzung //dkyil 'khor dang po gsal byas te/ /sprul pas mtshams bcad bum pa bzung / /bshad pa bzhin du bsgrub bya dgug /nges par gzugs la phab ste bcing / /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa 'dir shes te/ /'gro ba'i 'od zer thugs dam bskul/ /'dus pas bsgrub bya gnas sbyangs nas/ /rtog tshogs dkyil 'khor nyid du bslab / /slob bu sbyangs pa'i rim par gsungs/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor sgo phye nas/ /phyag byas bskor te gsol ba gdab/ /sgrib sbyang rang gi lhar bskyed la/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgyas bsrung bar bya/ /ta krid la sogs nges sbyor ba'i / /sngags dang nyungs kar 1sprul pa yis/ /nges grangs gtso bo'i mkha' la bzhag /de dag 'od zer mang po yis/ /nyon mongs mun pa dag byas nas/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar bya/ /rigs drug sbyong ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa bon rnam pa drug sbyangs te/ /ye shes chen po'i ros gang bas/ /ma lus 'joms pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /'bru bzhi nges par bstan pa'i tshe/ /sgra dbyangs gsung gi bstan pa rnams/ /nges par ston phyir bzhi ru 'dod/ /thams cad rang rig byang chub sems/ /de ni lung gi tshad mar bshad/ /tshad bzhis phab pa'i don bzhi ste/ /dag pa rnam gsum tshul gnas shing / /'bru lnga 'dus pa'i thabs chen po/ /'gro ba kun la rang ba'i/na gnas/ /rang 773—/230

bzhin sngon du byed rgyu ni/ /ngo bo dang ni rkyen nyid de/ /'jug ldang la sogs byang sems lnga/ /nges par skye ba ngo bo yin/ /thabs dang shes rab ma ning rgyud/ /rtan pa'i yig lam rkyen du gsungs/ /khong nas gab sbas don 'byin pa/ /ston pa rdo rje'i thugs la gnas/ /rang bzhin gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /dkyil 'khor snying po gser sgrom la/ /chos nyid ye shes yon tan dang / /rang rgyud bzhi la yan lag brgyad/ /'od bzhi la gnas rnam shes bzhi/ /sgo lnga rtag min zhor la bshad/ /sa bon zung gsum nyid dang bzhi/ /'od dang snod bcud tshul du gnas/ /chos nyid lha min dud 'gro zlum/ /kun gzhi'i oṃ gyi snying por ldan/ /ye shes lha ni gru bzhi yid/ /snying po hūṃ ni bde gshegs thugs/ /yon tan dmyal ba yi dwags saṃ1/ /zla gam gsung gi rang bzhin yin/ /dmar nag sdong la og zhol dbyibs/ /de ni blo rmugs snod yin te/ /shes pa gsum la snyoms par 'gogs/ /drag po nyid du'ang bshad pa yin/ /de dbus snying po ye shes rgyu/ /dar skud mtshal khu gser kyi rlangs/ /nyi ma'i me long ngad dag ni/ /'byung ba bzhi yi dngas ma yin/ /bde ba'i dngas ma nam mkha'i khams/ /'byung lnga shes rab rigs kyi yum/ /chen po rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs/ /thabs dang shes rab las nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor kun kyang gsal bar byed/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dkyil 'khor 'dis/ /thams cad nam mkhar byed pa'i phyir/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /lus can kun la yod par bshad / /sgrub pa'i gzhi ru 'di shes bya/ /'khrul dbang mi gnas tha snyad du//rnam shes 'phos par gsungs pa ni/ /nyi 'od sa bon sgur sgra bzhin/ /rgyu 43—/23/

las 'bras bu gzhan min gyi/ /'di nas 'phro bar 'gyur ba'i chos/ /gdul bya tsam yang med par gsungs/ /sa chu rnge rlung bzhi yi rlung / /sum mdo snying gi lte ba la/ /rigs rnams kun gyi rten yin te/ /las rgyu zad dang rten dag gi / /sngon dbang yan lag nyams pa na/ /tshogs drug sar thim gsal mi 'gyur / /sa dag chur zhugs lus nyams med/ /de nyid mar zhugs bu ga skam / /me rlung 'gro bas drod nyams 'gyur/ /rlung gi snying po thig le'i rten//rngub cing tha ma 'don par 'gyur/ /thig le me long dbugs bzhin du/ /mdzes dang che chung gsal bar byed/ /rtog pas 'du shes brgyad skye'o/ /me tog 'phreng bas kha dog bsgyur/ /pags bgos spu dang sen mo 'phel/ /bdun phrag lnga po yang byed kyis/ /mtshan ma thams cad 'phel bar byed/ /g.yo byed byung ba'i sems skye'o/ /dang bas phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /'du shes lnga po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de dag rang bzhin gsang ba'i las/ /chags bsogs rang bzhin bzhi bcu gnyis/ /shin tu gsal bar byed par 'gyur/ /thogs med rkyen kyis mgo lus bsgyur/ /rang bzhin sems dpa' lcums nas 'byung / /rang bzhin ye shes rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje phung po zhes gsungs so/ /rang bzhin gnas rgyad 1rnam pa gnyis/ /sems ni rang rig ye shes te / /ma bcos lcun gye skad cig ma/ /de yis ma byas gang yang med/ /ma rig mun 'khor klad pa ni/ /ji snyed 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i chos/ /phyi nang rten 'brel gnyis su 'khor/ /mi mthun bde sdug myong 'gyur ba'i/ /dbang po yul du snang ba kun/ /rang rgyud yod pa ma yin te/ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa nyid/ /dngos po sna tshogs bar snang bas/ /gnyis snang chos kun rnam 43—/232

rtog bshad/ /rnam rtog nyid na ye shes te/ /ma skyes ye shes brjod du med/ /thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sems nyid las ni gzhan med phyir/ /'di ltar rnam pa thams cad kun/ /sdos pa can gyi chos med do/ /rtog med rang rig 'od gsal ba'i/ /shes pa 'ba' zhig kho na'i phyir/ /'jig rten brtan g.yo la sogs pa/ /snang ba nyid na ngo bo med/ /de nyid chos sku chen por gsungs—/ /rnam dag rang bzhin rgyud nyid la/ /sgom dang sgom par bya ba yi//mtshan ma'i nyes skyon ngang gis med/ /gnas dang 'byung ba ma lus kun/ /rang rig ye shes gzugs su skye/ /sku dang ye shes bsam mi khyab/ /rdo rje phung po yan lag ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags/ /sa chu spyan dang ma ma ki—/ /me rlung gos dkar sgol mas te/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma//skye mched khams rnams mang po kun/ /sems dpa' sems ma'i dkyil 'khor yin—/ /gsang yul dbang po rnam shes reg /ma lus ①'joms phyir khro bor gsungs—/ /rtog bcas mtshan ma las skyed phyir/ /yul te las kyis mi gnas bshad/ /yid chos bzang po bzang mo'i mkha'/ /so drug las byung bde ba'i dus/ /chags sogs yang dag nyon mongs drug /ye shes drug gi sa bon drug /'dul phyir sprul pa nyid du gsungs/ /sku dang gsung thugs yon tan las/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga rang bzhin gnas/ /ye shes chos nyid yon tan ni/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi ngo bo yin/ /de steng dngas ma'i thig le ni/ /bsnyen bsgrub bzhi ru shes par bya/ /de dbyings ②las bzhi'i dkyil 'khor te/ /bzhi brgyad rtsa ni 'khor lor gsungs/ /gsang ba'i skabs las shes par bya/ /bdes gang bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rtsa/ /sa bon rgyus te yi ge gsung / /bde 43—1233

thugs rdo rje sku gsung ldan/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gsum 'phror 'gyur/ /cig kyang khams kyi bde bar ldan/ /zung gsum 'od kyi gong bur gsungs/ /rnam thar sku gsung yig gsum gyis/ /kha dog rang rgyud bzhin du bsgyur/ /'od kyis sngon bzhin byin rlabs bstem/ /rnam shes thugs te yi ge gsung / /'od ni sku yi rang bzhin la/ /dpa' sgeg byams pa gar byed rgyal/ /gsal ma chos nyid bdag mo la/ /sku gsung sgyu 'phrul ldan pa yi/ /thabs dang shes rab 'byor par bskyed/ /rnam thar dbu dang ye shes phyag /khams gsum sku gsung thugs rgyas btab/ /sa bcu gnyis la nges par phyin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dbang skur te/ /rdo rje thugs las bur byung nas/ /che mchog rgyun gyi dbang skur nas/ /'gu ya yak+ṣa rak+ṣa gsum/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur te/ /bdag gi 'od 'phros nam mkha' yi/ /bde gshegs rgyun gyis byin brlabs pas/ /che mchog dbang mchog dpal mchog gsum/ /thabs dang shes rab 'khyil par sgom/ /dbang mchog rol pa'i sems 'od nyid/ /che mchog mkha' la bsdu bar bya/ /de nyid dpal mchog la zhugs te/ /dpal mchog rang gi gsang lam nas/ /dngas ma'i ye shes snying po thim/ /gzhi yi sku gsung thugs nyid kyang / /de bzhin 'dus pa nyid du bya/ /rtsa ba brgyad kyi snying po yis/ /dus bzhi'i bde ba mchog du bsdus/ /rten gyi rtsa nas thig le zhugs—/ /mi shigs ye shes thig le ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag /gcig dang du ma rnam spangs pa/ /sna tshogs snang ba mtshon du med/ /rang dbang sgyur ba'i hūṃ rings las①/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mtshon gang ba/ /dbu la ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor mang po'i 'phro 'du can/ /43—1234

gtsug byung thugs rje'i dbang thob nas/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur pas/ /stong phrag gcig gi rtsa bcud rnams/ /sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor du/ /sngon byung rigs kyi bdag por 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i khams kyang de bzhin no/ /oṃ hri ma ha su ka badz+ra hūṃ ho/ hūṃ ma sgod yid kyis byon pa'i gnas mchog dam pa la—/ /yid bzhin rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i gdan steng na/ /rtag pa chen po mchog gi sku bzhugs pa/ /mnyam rdzogs dpe la 'das pa'i rgyan mnga' zhing / /yid bzhin rin chen gter la bde spyod pa/ /bde ba chen po bdag la bstan spyod pa/ /rtag pa chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sgu/ /rdzogs chen 'gyur med g.yung drung bdal ba'i ngang / /bde chen dbyings kyi yum dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i thugs ni 'gro ba yongs kyi bcud/ /rnam dag ye shes spyan gyis mun nag bsal/ /ye shes sgron ma'i thugs kyis bag chags sregs/ /rdo rje spu gri'i tshems kyis dug gsum bcad/ /rngam chen hūṃ nyid ring pos khro chen bskul/ /thugs dam mu la dza las dmyal khams sreg /ye shes rol pas rgyud drug gnas nas sgrol/ /srid gsum thig les zhal gyi rgyas spras spro ba skyed/ /ye shes byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas yongs kyi dpal/ /dpal chen bla med khro rgyal gsum gyi rje/ /kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs te/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi lha phung yin/ /ma lus 'dod pa'i dpal du gyur par mdzod / /spyod yul 'gyur bar mthong bas na/ /gsang ba'i gnas su nyon mongs yid/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba la/ /kun gzhi ye shes snying po yi//'od kyis khams gsum sbyangs bsdus te/ /mtshon gang 'od du gsal ba la /43—1235

dkar po hūṃ gnas rnam shes so/ /de dag sku gsung thugs bdag ste/ /shin tu'ang 'dris pa nyid du bya/ /rlung brtsegs bcud g.yo'i mtshan mthong na/ /ring po hūṃ gnyis nas sa nas/ /du ba'i tshud grangs 'od du bsdu/ /de bzhin zla ba yang shes par/ /'od zlum gsang ba'i lam zhugs te/ /phyir 'byung phyogs bcu khyab bdal bas/ /khams dag phyir mtha' dbus dang ni/ /phyi nang yul sems bral ba'i don/ /dran pas las kyi rgyun bcad de/ /rang gnas mthong bar gyur pa yin/ /gsang ba zhabs kyi rnam pa ni/ /gnyis kyang rnam shes gnyis 'dus te/ /lce rtse rkan la sbyar byas nas/ /hūṃ rings bslang ste te ru gyur/ /sna tshogs mchog ldan rgyan rdzogs pa/ /hūṃ brjod nas lam byung ste/ /'og min la sogs 'gro bar bya/ /'dod pa nges par 'grub par 'gyur—/ /theg mchog gsang mtha' mngon byas nas/ /gzhi bzhin ma lus bdag nyid phyir/ /rgya bral cig dang du ma spangs/ /'das dang ma 'das dus gsum kyi/ /ro myong dag phyir rnam rtog bral/ /ye shes dbyings las mi zhan phyir—/ /thugs rje chen pos ma lus mkhyen/ /sku dang gsung thugs yon tan las—/ /khyab dang bde dang rtag dbang bskur/ /rkyen gyis skye 'jig med pa yi—/ /rtag chen rdo rje'i sku zhes bya/ /rang bzhin gnas rgyud ye shes phyag /rgya khyon bsam yas mngon sum du/ /yul 'dra rang bzhin dang gnas pa/ /'khrul dang rnam par rgyud log pa'i/ /rtog gsum las rkyen rab rib zhen snang ba—/ /thabs mkhas spyan mnga' rgyud bzhin sgo skur bral/ /rgyud gsum thur ma gsal phyir gab gsungs pa/ /spyad yig goms rnams snang rgyud nyams su shar//gsal byas 'das dang da ltar rang rig mig thob shog /sgyu 'phrul dpe chung 43—1236

rang gnas kyi rim pa'o/ /sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1227 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/1228 ①〈〈pe 〉sgyutshogs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rgyud/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉bzhi/1229 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rkyal/ ②〈〈pe 〉sgrosgom/123༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉dkar/1231 yo)〈〈pe 〉stago1232 ①〈〈pe 〉〉spyod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wate/1233 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pas/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dbyibs/1234 ①〈〈pe 〉〉la/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2551)43wa 1237

༄khya/ /tho gdung las kyi 'phreng ba/1༄7/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba chen po'i rgyud dag las/ /sgu gdung spel mchod rim pa zhig /bdag gzhan snang dang mi snang phyir/ /legs par bsdus te bstan par bya'o/ /pha dang ma yi sems ldan mis/ /mtha' yas bu yi sems bzhag ste/ /tshogs chen zung la lam bya'i phyir/ /mi rtog nyid du rtog med 'dug /de las skad cig las kyi lha//gsal bya dgu 'am bcu gcig ldan/ /'phro 'dus dbang byin thob pa dang / /grangs te sngags kyi nga rgyal bskyed/ /sa man dza da e ha his/ /se gol kyo ta dza yis dgug /dza hūṃ bam̐ hos stim byas te/ /'bru brgyad sngags kyis bstan par bya/ /de ltar gsal ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od 'phros pas / /skor bor sbyangs la gnas gdan sngags/ /brjod pas gzhal yas gdan gsum ldan/ /'byung lnga'i rgyu nyid byin brlab pa/ /spyi dang khyad par lnga (3—/238

pa nyid/ /khong stong rgyan ldan rnam dag sngags/ /nga rgyal ldan brjod stong chen rgyu / /lhun grub ci bsam snang byin brlab/ /phyi ma lnga yis dbyings phyug ma/ /khong stong brgyan ldan oṃ bi ra/ /dz+ra dang badz+ra swā hā yis/ /rdo rje ye shes srog ldan bya/ /de bzhin spyan la 'degs pa'i rgyas/ /oṃ dang badz+ra di ra dza/ /a dang a ra swā hā yis/ /snga ma ji bzhin byin brlab bo/ /ma ma ki la rdo rje gdams / /je chung sgreng ste oṃ d+mā rin/ /da ra badz+ra swā hā yis/ / ting 'dzin srog dang ldan par bya/ /gos dkar khong stong spyor spros pas/ /oṃ dang badz+ra ag ne+e a/ /ga sha swā hā'i gsang sngags kyis/ /gong ma bzhin du byin gyes brlab/ /sgrol ma thal mo brlab bya zhing / /oṃ dang badz+ra a ni li/ /spra tsa la mo hūṃ rgya/ /da ra swā hās byin brlab bo/ /shes rab grangs 'dzin thabs kyis bdag 1hūṃ badz+ra grig /sum̐ dwa du shwa ri stom gyi sngags brjod cing / 'byung lnga ye shes rdo rje la/ /skor phor reg pas gzhal yas gdan/ /nang ngo phyi rol sku gdung dbyibs/ /mi bskyod yab yum 'khril zhugs pa'i/ /'od kyis don mdzad lha chen skor/ /de nyid 'byung lnga gang yin mkha'/ /gang brlabs rang gi lha mos na'ang / /so so'i gsang sngags brjod byas te/ /srog ldan rnal 'byor snga ma bzhin/ /'phrin las rnams las grub 'dod pas/ /rgyu lnga bzhi las rtsam pa na/ /zhi la snang mdzad gsang sngags ldan/ /shan ting ku ru swā hās mdzes/ /chos sgu thig le dkar 'od kyis/ /gzas dgu gdan byas 'od thim zhing / /rgyas la 'byung ldan yab yum sngags/ /pus ting ku ru swā hā yis//sku gsung ser rgyas 'od zer 'phros/ /bkug gdan 'od thim bdag rgyas byas/ /dbang la rta mgrin mtha' yas sngags/ /che ge ba shaṃ ku ru yis/ /zla gam 'od 73—/239

'bar 'phros bkug pas/ /gdan byas 'od thim dbang po bsgyur/ /drag po badz+ra te ru'i sngags/ /che ge gsod pa'i sngags brjod pas/ /chos sku gru gsum 'od nag gis/ /bkug ste gdan bstem bsgral bar bya'o/ /don yod grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /chos sku lhun grub lha gnas bya/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rtogs 'dod pas/ /mtha' yas rnal 'byor rten 'brel sngags/ /'od kyi ①bsgrib sbyangs rtogs skal ldan/ /nang du gdan gtso bzhugs la'o/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yisakye/ /lha de nye bar bsgrub pa ni/ /lha'i snying po bris bcug brjod/ /lha de nye bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten lha de dbang med bkug /mchod sogs sdogs pa'i las bya'o/ /gang zhig 'phos ④pa'i las byed na/ /gang goms lha'i rnal 'byor kyis/ /btab ste ma tha gnyis mtha' ru/ /sarba tir ya ga te/ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brjod pas byol song gi rgyud sbyang ba'o/ /pa tsa gnyis dang / sarba byu ta ka te he rdu hūṃ phaṭa/kyis yi dwags rgyud sbyangs so/ /da ha gnyis sarba na ra ga te te rdu hūṃ phaṭa brjod 'od 'phros pas/ sngon bzhin bkug la 'od kyis sbyang / /yang na mi bskyod rnal 'byor ldan/ /rgyun bcad sngags kyis sbyang ba'o/ /de nas sku gdung byin brlab ste/ /rdo rje gdams la tho bod rtsegs/ /oṃ ye dharmā te tu pra bha bā he turnye ṣān ④ta thā ga to h+ya ba dad/ te ṣān rjotsa yo ni ro dha e bam bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /chos kyi skur byin gyis brlab bo/ /rgyu 'bras kyi chos sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phyag rgya de nyid las/oṃ badz+ra rjoku sha mi ta u pa da/ si myag a ri te/ i tra ba la ag t+ya/ ma ga pa ri bu ra rnam phyi ti ku ru swā hā/ zhes rgyu'i chos rdzogs par byin gyis brlab bo//43—1240

'bras bu'i chos rdzogs par byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /mnyam pa'i phyag rgya 'od 'phro ba ltar byas la/ /oṃ badz+ra dzha na ban tsa ka yā gu na gar khang / pu mi ta/shi ti na ku ru swā hā/ dz+nya na bag sa man ta/ a mo ki sa man ta/ a mo ka ya swā hā/ zhes sku dang ye shes su gsal ba las/ 'bras bu'i chos thams cad dze+egs par bsam mo/ /de la rang bzhin gnas pa yang / /spyan las byas pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /stong khri 'bum sogs 'bad byas la/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg rgyas par sbyar/ /yi dam nar ma'i sbyor ba la/ /rang bzhin mchod rten lhar bcas pas/ /snyan dbab spyan drang bstem brtan pas/ /sngon bzhin byas la phyag gis mchod/ /a ti pra ti pu ho yis/ /spyi bral 1phyag dang lan rdzogs bya'o/ /kun bzangs mchod pa nam mkha'i mdzod/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod par bya'o//gzeng zhal rgyan ldan a ha ras/ /phyag dang zhal bsil gsol bar bya/ /lha mo bzhi'i sngags phyag rgyas/ /spyan shangs sgu la thim par bya/ /oṃ 'jig rten brtan g.yo thams cad la/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gnas mod kyang / /bzung 'dzin rnam rtog zhags pa yis/ /rang gis bsgribs shing bdag tu bcings/ /kun gyis yang dag rtogs bya'i phyir/ /de bzhin chos sgu'i gzugs 2brnyan bstan/ /yang dag thams cad rdzogs pa'i don/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las rnam par rol/ /don gyi snying po mchog gnas dang / /byang chub chos rnams rab tu sdogs/ /'jig rten gtso mchog rab tu bskor/ /a ho/ ho chos sgu'i yon tan lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /thal sbyar bo de ka ya bag /tsi ta ti sta badz+ra stan/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i don gyi phyir/ /'khor lo ngang mchu'i tshul bzhin du/ /bka' yi bcud bsdus bsod nams kyis/ /mtha' yas mngon par sangs rgyas shog /sgu gdung las kyi 'phreng 13—/2 /

༄ga /za tshogs gtor ma'i lung /①༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dang bral ba'i 'jig rten na/ /snang srid bde ba'i longs spyod la/ /chags pa spyad pas 'khyams pa rnams/ /'di ltar spyad na grol zhes gsungs/ /lta ba byin brlabs bskyed pa dang / /spyan dang mchod dang rol pa dang / /lhag ma'i las dang bsngo ba brgyad/ /rgyun du mi stong rnal 'byor yin/ /dbang po yul dus rnam shes kun/ /shes rab thabs sbyor ye sangs rgyas/ /'byung ba yum gyi mkha' klong las/ /sprul pa rang 'byung longs spyod lha/ /byang chub sems kyi klong bdal bas/ /gnyis med cig pa'i longs spyod yin/ /lta ba 'di la gang gnas pa/ /sangs ma rgyas pa gcig kyang med/ /dang por longs spyod kun ldan nas/ /bdag nyid lung gi khrag 'thungs 1las /yig 'bru gsum 'phros thim tsam gyis/ /sbyang ba sngags kyis kha bskang ba'o// /43—1243

bdag nyid khrag 'thung gsal ba las/ /lto bar bye las gzhal yas su/ /rim pa lnga yi dkyil 'khor lha/ /mi bskyod rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis bsgom/ /sa ma dza yi phyag rgya yis/ /'bar des 'phags pa 'khor dang bcas/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar dmigs/ /de nyid thig le'i tshul du bsgom/ /rim pa bzhin du gros te sbyang / /sngags kyis lha mo rim pa bzhin/ /shes rab thabs tshul mnyes pas mchod/ /bla med dngos grub sprul bar bsam/ /ā+oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ke te a mṛ te hūṃ ā+oṃ ba lin ta khar ma kha ram̐ ḍa stiki ni/ kha ro yo sh-i sgo ni—/ dang tai 1a la la ho/ zhes rgyas par mchod do/ /de nas bdag nyid mnyam bzhag pas/ /rnam gsum tshul gyis rol par bya/ /bdag nyid rang gi lha mnyes pas—/ /mchod sbyin yin te dngos ④grub bo/ /bdag nyid mnyam bzhag ta gi rgyal//ma tshogs dbang phyug dam la bsdu/ /sngags 'dis mchod la 'phrin las bcol/ /rang gi gnas su las la dgye/ /ā+oṃ ta ki ni a gat+ta ya/ a gat+ta ya/ a be+e sha ya/a be sha ya/ pra be+e sha ya pra be+e sha ya/ bharnya ya/ bharnya ya/ to sha ya/ to sha ya/ mo ha na/ mo ha na/ sarba ṭā ki ni nan/ hri da ya hūṃ dza/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ ta ki ni dza/ces pa dang / ā+oṃ badz+ra ta ki ni/ pra ti dza man bha lin ta/ hūṃ phaṭa kha'i/ ā+oṃ tram̐ tri ha—/ ces thim par mchod do/ /pha ma la sogs 'gro drug la/ /tshad med gtor ma 'di bsngos pas/ /longs spyod ldan zhing tshogs bsags nas/ /thams cad myur du sangs rgyas shog /ā+oṃ sarba spra ti nan a mṛ te hūṃ/ zhes byams pa dang snying rjes dmigs la/ ci 'dod pa 'byung bar bsam zhing gtor ro/ /'phrin las bcol ba ni/ sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs chom/ zhing bcu gdul du ltogs/ rnal 'byor pa'i bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad 43—1244

du gsol/ ya hi gha dza/ ā+oṃ ba lin te te dzo ba li ni ba la ba de gu he sa ma ye swā hā/rnal 'byor longs spyod gol ba'i phyi rabs la/ /ma spangs rol pas 'bras bu lhun grub pa/ /yid dam za tshogs gtor ma 'di btang bas/ /kun gyis rdo rje 'chang gi gral thob shog /za tshogs gtor ma'i lung rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1242 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉tshorathung /1244 ①〈〈pe 〉smug/ ②〈〈pe 〉stan/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉rta/ du〈〈pe 〉stanagos/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2553)43—1245

2627༄7/ /gsang ba'i mdo don bsdus pa/ 1༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal sgrol byed thugs rje'i rgyal po shin tu rnam nga/ra grol/ ba nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam nyid chos sku gsang ba'i sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs sgu sprul pa'i sgu/ /sgu lnga'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /kun bzang ngang la phyag 'tshal te/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa kun 'dus las/ /mdo don chos kyi rnam grol sgo/ /de shes de 'jug bde bsgrub phyir/ /mi 'gal/ tsam du bsdus te bshad/ /kun bzang thugs rjes 'gro don du/ /theg nga/ gsum snang 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /don dam nges pa'i theg mchog las/ /gsang sgo mtshon pa'i mdo rgyud don/ /rnam pa gsum du shes bya ste/ /bya ba'i gzhi dang byed pa'i rgyan/ /bya bral 'bras bu'i mthar phyin dag /ji snyed chos kyi rtsa bar bshad/ /phyi nang bye brag ji snyed pa'i/ /chos rnams thams cad byang chub sems/ /ji bzhin ngang du ye gnas pa/ /shes par bya ba'i rgyu don (3byed/2/6

yin—/ /rtsol bcas spyod pas 'dres 'jug pa'i/ /theg pa de ni bya byed rkyen//gzhan du 'bras bu re rtsol med/ /bsgrub bya nyid la lam gnas pas/ /thabs chen theg 'di bya bral ba'o/ /de yang phyi nang nyid la'ang / /gzhi dang thabs dang 'bras bu yi/ /tshul gsum bye brag chos su bshad/ /gzhi ni snga ma'i don nyid de/ /thabs ni lam yin rnam pa gsum/ /gol sgrib ngo bo yan lag ste/ /gol sa lhang ba'i sgo dgu dang / /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib sogs dang / /thun mong rtog pa brgya bcu gcig /dgu bcu la sogs skyon rnams dang / /shes pa'i bye brag drug la sogs/ /mi mthun gol sgrib phyogs su bshad/ /ngo bo thabs dang shes rab ste/ /rol pa'i ka ra la sogs pa'i/ /man ngag thabs kyi bder 'jug dang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i tshul 'gro ba'o/ /der ni 'jug pa rnam gsum ste/ /rtog dpyod don dang yi ge yi/ /rjes 'jug dang po sngon 'gro nyid/ /blo yi stobs kyis rnam pa gnyis/ /lus las snang ba'i chos rnams la/ /rigs pa'i gtan tshigs mtha' dag dang / /man ngag nges pa'i tshad ma yis/ /so sor rtog dang rtsol med par/ /rims dang cig car gtan la 'be+ebs/ /de nas 'jug pa'i tshul sgo ni/ /don la rims dang cig car pa'o/ /don ni chos nyid snying po la/ /rjes su 'jug pa sems yin te/ /de yang skabs kyi khyad par gyis/ /lam lnga'i skabs dang bcur 'gyur bas/ /rim par bsgod pa'i lam du bshad/ /blo zhan rim gyis 'jug pa 'ang / /yul dang shes pa'i tshul lta bur/ /ji bzhin pa la blo bzhag pas/ /rigs pa'i khyad par skabs su 'phags/ /gsal dang bstan dang yun rings dang / /shin tu ring dang tshad las 'das/ /mi mthun phyogs dang phrad pa'i tshe/ /de 43—1247

dbang gyur dang cung zad du/ /mi 'gyur thang cig gnas pa dang / /gsal bar bstan pa'i ring goms dang / /rang dbang gyur nas ches bstan dang / /spyod lam kun tu rlung gnas yin/ /de dag zag bcas bsam gtan te/ /gnyis med yul bral de mthong min/ /mnyam nyid gsang ba'i bde don la/ /dad dang mos dang der rtsol dang / /des de g.yo dang cher g.yos dang / /mthong dang 'dra bar 'gyur yin te/ /skar phran 'bring dang chen po dang / /gcig pa gnyis pa'i zla ba 'dra/ /rang gi mtshan nyid mngon sum du/ /gsal bar mthong bas dbugs phyin te/ /zag pa zad nas 'jig rten 'das/ /gsum pa'i ri bong spyan 'dra yin/ /mthong ba'i don la mnyam gnas pas/ /brtan par 'gyur te lung chen thob/ /'bras bu cher 'byung bzhi pa 'dra/ /rang dang spyi yi tha snyad bral/ /dmigs med kun gsal ye shes nyid/ /g.yo dang thob dang brtan rdzogs pa'i/ /rim pas mthar phyin gsum du snang / /lnga brgyad cu drug tshul du gsal/ /de dag sa dang rnal 'byor skabs/ /sems lam bcu dang lnga zhes bya/ /gang dag blo chen mngon rtogs pas/ /mnyam nyid yul bral rang gsal bar/ /mi g.yo cig car gang 'jug pa/ /sa dang lam gyi grangs rtsol med/ /yi ge mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor dag /blo yi khyad par che phra ba'i/ /thams cad gsal rdzogs cig car dang / /lnga dang bcu la sogs par snang / /lam lnga rnal 'byor rigs 'dzin gyi/ /sa dang gnas skabs ye shes dang / /sgrib dang gol sa rtog pa dang / /spyod dang ting 'dzin dam tshig dang / /dus dang dngos grub mthar phyin dang / /lta ba'i khyad par gnas 'gyur sogs/ /bye brag lam lnga'i chos su snang / /rnal 'byor sa bcu'i lam 43—1248

rnams la'ang / /khyad par de dag rnam bcur bsal/ /lha yi phyag rgya cig pa dang / /gnyis 'byel yan lag rdzogs pa dang / /'khor lo gcig dang rnam spros dang / /shin tu rnam spros dkyil 'khor dang / /gling gcig gang dang stong gsum dang / /grangs med shin tu grangs med dang / /chos dbyings mtha' yas rab gsal rdzogs/ /de dag rnam pa'i khyad par yang / /rtog dang mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor dang / /chu zla lta bur gzung med dang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis bral de nyid dang / /ci la'ang mi gnas mnyam nyid dang / /rang gi mtshan nyid gsal nges dang / /zag pa med dang lhun grub pa'i/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i rim pa yis/ /thob dang shin tu thob pa dang / /brtan rdzogs nyid de rnam bcu'o/ /tshad kyang khru bzhi brgyad cu drug /sum cu gnyis dang drug cu bzhi/ /de bzhin 'gyur sogs chos dbyengs rnams/ /lhar gsal 'phro 'du dbugs yul dang / /dri sgra gzugs sogs rim bzhin 'phags/ /de dag blo yi rtsal yin te/ /shes rab la sogs kun de bzhin/ /khyad par gyur cing rnam par 'phel/ /don dang yi ge gang de 'ang / /so so'i gnas skabs lam bdag nyid/ /bgrod dang de chos ldan pa dang / /rgyud mi gtong dang rten byed dang / /dus de skabs dang 'bras bu dang / /gags dang 'dra ba'i lhung gnas dang / /rtsol zhing bgrod pa'i lam sems dang / /spyod lam dang ni blo gnas dang / /ma 'da' bsrung dang dus nyid dang / /yon tan mthu dang bya bral dang / /shes rab stobs dang khyad par las/ /tha snyad bye brag rnams su gsungs/ /gzhan yang sems bskyed sngags la sogs/ /lam gyi chos sgo tha snyad kun/ /lnga dang bcu sogs grags pa yin/ /dang po gnyis 43—1249

la gnas pa ni/ /gsang chen 'bras bu lam gyi rten/ /de bzhin rim par bgrod gnas na/ /thong yang gzugs kyis zin pa dang / /lus ngan mi srid bde 'gro yis/ /yang dag gnas dang 'dod rigs sogs/ /bde 'gro'i gnas ngan mi srid dang / /khams gsum 'jig tshogs zag bral dang / /mi ldog mi gnas phyir 'ong la/ /mi shes skyon bral mtha' rdzogs nas/ /sa bar mi ldog sangs rgyas sar/ /thog ①med mngon gyur lhun gyis grub/ /de phyir lam kyi mchog tu brjod/ /de rkyen yan lag rnam pa gnyis/ /sgrub byed rkyen dang shes byed pa'i/ /lam kyi yan lag sum cu gnyis/ /mdo dang bzhi dang bslab pa'i mtha'/ /mdo ni bcu gnyis 'jug sgo dang / /dam tshig lta ba ting 'dzin dang / /dmigs pa zlas ⑤pa 'phrin las dang / /spyod pa dang ni thob bya'i dbang / /rigs 'dzin sa dang sangs rgyas sa/ /nges byed yan lag dag tu bshad/ /gzhi ni rnam bcu bsgrub pa dang / /gsang sngags ming dang spyod pa dang / /dngos grub gnas dang bzlas pa'i sgra/ /phyag rgya ting 'dzin lta ba dang / /cho 'phrul dag ste de dag ston/ /dpe bcus mtshon nas rab tu shes—/ /bslab pa'i mtha' ni rnam bcu ste/ /dam tshig bzhi dang rgyud dgrol dang / /sgo mo bsdur dang phul dbyung dang / /thag bcad pa dang nyams blang dang / /la dor spyod dang dbang rim dang / /man ngag don dang mdor bsdus rnams/ /rnal 'byor bslab pa'i mtha' bcur bcad/ /gzhi 'dzin pa ni dam tshig ste/ /sgo gsum sdom par gnas pa'i don/ /rtsa ba yan lag la sogs pa'i/ /bsrung dang bsgrub pa de nyid do/ /rgyud 'grol ba ni thos bsam ste—/ /mkhas ldan dam pa'i bla ma la/ /dad dang sri zhu gus pa yis/ /don 43—1250

gang nyan 'dzin rtogs byed 'grol/ /sgo bsdur ba ni theg pa rnams/ /shes par byed dang rtsol ba ste/ /gol sgrib phyogs su gang gsung dag /bcad phyir de dag rig shes byed/ /phul du dbyung ba 'di don nyid/ /mkhas shing rab tu shes pa'o/ /thag bcad pa ni lta ba ste/ /ji bzhin ma nor shes rab nyid/ /re dogs med par sngon 'gro don/ /nyams blangs pa ni ting 'dzin te/ /phyag rgya bzhis sogs spros pa dang / /spros med la sogs bsam gtan yin/ /la dor ba ni spyod pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi dang las bzhi dang / /bsgrub pa la sogs bye brag dang / /thun mong thabs kyi mdza' spyod nyid/ /dbang ni rim par bgrod byed pa'i/ /lnga dang lnga sogs nus mthu bskyed/ /man ngag don bsgrub thabs kyi mchog /gser 'gyur bdud rtsi lta bu'i tshul/ /mdor bsdu ba ni sems kyi don/ /ji bzhin ngang rtogs kun 'dus pa'o/ /shes byed yan lag rnam pa gnyis/ /mtshon byed tshig don yi ge'i sgra/ /rgyud don yan lag rnam drug dang / /de 'grel gtan la 'be+ebs byed pa'i/ /lde mig zhes su grags pa de/ /rgyud ni byin rlabs 'byung ba dang / /lung bstan rgyud pa rnam gnyis phyir/ /de 'grel pa yang rnam pa gnyis/ /byin rlabs sku bzhi bstan pa dag /bshad thabs lde mig rnam gnyis te/ /dpyod pa'i 'dren sgo rnam 'grel gsum/ /'byed pa drug dang 'grol pa bzhi/ /nges par 'byin pa rnam gsum mo/ /sgo gnyis spyi dang khyad par ste/ /spyi'ang rnam gsum yan lag mdo/ /rtsa ba dag gis 'grel par byed/ /khyad par gsang sgo'i rnam 'grel yang / /yan lag mdo dang rtsa ba yis/ /'byed 'grel nges par 'byin par byed/ /'byed pa rgyu dang rtsa ba dang / /'a brel dang tshig dang nges par sbyor/ /rgyu ni 43—1251

gleng gzhi ①drug yin te/ /don gang gang tshe gang nyid kyis/ /gang du gang la bshad brjod pa'o/ /rtsa ba gleng babe+eng rkyen nyid dang / /ji ltar babe+eng nas zhus bshad tshul/ /'grel pa gang brjod gang gis brjod/ /gang phyir gang gi stobs kyis bshad/ /'drin pa brjod pa'i rgyu 'di dang / /ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul bcu ste/ /rang bzhin lta ba'i nges don dang / /spyi don bsdud dang rnam par dbye/ /tshig don 'grol dang 'brel shugs sbyor/ /rang lugs nyid dang brgal lan dang / /sdem dgongs brda' dang dpes mtshon dang / /man ngag gab sbas 'byin bsdebs rnams/ /dpe bcu lta bur bshad pa'o/ /nges pa gtan tshigs rnam bcu gnyis/ /snod blo bzhi la bstan pa bzhi/ /'tsham par so sor nges byed dang / /lung dang don dang rigs pa dang / /mtshon dpe gtan tshigs mtha' dag gis/ /snang dang mi 'gal rgyas 'thad sbyar/ /de dag re re'ang dgos pa dang / /ngo bo nges tshig dmigs bzung bcas/ /rnam bcu gnyis kyis nges 'byed shes/ /sbyor ba byang chub yan lag ste/ /rtogs pa bzhi dang mtshan nyid bzhi/ /dgos 'brel bzhi dang yan lag bzhi/ /der 'jug bzhi dang mtshon dpe bzhi/ /bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi dag dang / /mtshan nyid tshul dang sbyor ba ni/ /rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis rnams/ /gzhi nyid 'byel dang zag bcas dang / /mthong dang bsgom dang mthor phyin dang / /sangs rgyas sa dang rnam drug du/ /bsdus te de yi yan lag yin/ /cho 'phrul bzhi dang mngon shes lnga/ /thabs dang thabs sbyar lnga lnga dang / /rang bzhin lnga dang 'phrin las bzhi/ /gzhan don spyod pa'i yan lag ste/ /bla med sbyor ba'i chos 'grel yin/ /mdo bzhi thos mthong mngon sum dang / /bya ba med 43—1252

dang rnam bzhir 'grel/ /rtsa ba nges pa'i man ngag gsum/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams bcad pa dang / /don mthun 'gro ba'i dpe mtshon dang / /nges pa'i don la gnas pa yi/ /don gsum tshul gyis rnam 'grel 'byin/ /lung bstan brgyud pa'i bstan pa yang / /de bzhin tshul du 'grel pa ste/ /rgyud don rnam gsum khungs dang rgyu/ /ngo bo nyid de dang po ni/ /thun mong bcas gzhi spyi rgyud do/ /gdam ngag lung bstan rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /gleng bzhi ①spyi yi rgyud ces bya//'khor 'dus smras dang bskul zhes pa/ /bstan pa 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen ste/ /ngo bo 'tshogs pa drug nyid do/ /gleng bslang la sogs drug rnams dang / /mdo bzhi rtsa ba gsum la sogs/ /tshul bzhin rjes su sbyang bar bya/ /de dag 'bras bu'i lam du bshad/ /'bras bu nyid ni rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan lnga/ /nyi shu lngar bsdus mtha' yas rnams/ /lhun rdzogs rnam kun mkhyen pa'o/ /gsang mchog gsang bdag bka' lung mdo rgyud do/ /gsang bsdus gsal bshad mdo tsam phyogs brjod pa/ /ma nor mi 'gal tsam du nyams kyis bstan/ /de yi dge ba gang mchis yongs la bsngo/ /gsang ba'i mdo don bsdus pa/ slob dpon dharma bo des mdzad pa rdzogs so// //43—1253

༄ga /skabs 'grel bye brag rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba/①ga skabs 'grel bye brag tu bshad pa bzhugs / ༄4/ /mi 'khrug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyud las 'byung ba'i skabs bshad bya/ /de yang rgyud nyid las—/ sa dang gnas skabs ye shes dang / /sgrib dang gol sa rtog pa dang / /spyod dang ting 'dzin dam tshig dang / /dus dang dngos grub mthar phyin dang / /lta ba'i khyad par gnas 'gyur rnams/ /thams cad gcig las med na yang / /grangs sam dbye ba'i bye brag rnams/ /snod kyi rtsal dang sbyar nas ni/ /chos rnams kun gzhir gcig pa la/ /kun gzhi'i gnas 'gyur rnam pa lnga/ /bye brag lam lnga'i chos su snang / /zhes gsungs pas/ lngar brjod pas 'di ni sgod kyi/ rim pas bcur yang 'gyur bar dgongs so/ /de la lngar drangs pa ni bcu'i yang rtsa bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ blo rims su sbyor ba'i rab kyi tshad du bstan te/ gang zhe na/ sa dang zhes pa/ 'gyur 43—1255

ba ma nges pa'i sa ni rkyen la rag lus pa dang / rigs thams cad pa yin te/'jug ldog be+eng dang bcas pa yis/ /kun tu 'khor zhing ma nges pa'o/ /zhes bka' las snang ngo / /gnyis pa gal chen sbyong ba'i sa ni/ ched du brtson 'grus la ma 'bad na/ legs nyes 'byung ba'i nyes dbang du 'gro bas/ slab pa bcu la 'jug cing spyor ba la brten pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang 'di skad du/dge dang mi dge'i las rnams kun/ /gcod sbyong sbyor ba'i tshul nyid kyis/ /legs nyes stobs chen 'gyed pa'o zhes snang ngo / /gsum pa mi ldog gnas pa 'am / /rten pas khyad par 'gro ba'i sa ni/ mthong lam thob pas 'jigs pa lnga dang bral ba'i phyir te/ mthong ba la brten nas/ bogs su 'gro ba'i rten gnas nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di skad du/ bdun nyid rdzogs pas 'gro ba ste/ /zhes pa dang / ngal so ba las thams cad mthong / /mi ldog pa la goms byar med/ /zhes snang ngo / /bzhi pa dmigs pa 'bras bu skye ba'i sa ni / bsgom pa'i lam ste/ 'dir gsang sngags kyi gzhung gis/ spyod yul mi dmigs mod kyi/ dmigs par tha snyad 'dogs te/ mthong ba'i don la blo shin tu mi dmigs pa yis/ 'bras bu 'byin pa'i gzhi'i phyir te/ 'di skad du/ khyad par rtsal 'phang kun rdzogs shing / /ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyor ba'o—/ /zhes snang ngo / /lnga pa rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i sa ni/ rgyal tshab skyes bur gyur pa'i phyir dang / mthar phyin pa'i lam pa yin pa'i phyir/ nus pa'i rtsal rdzogs pas/ sangs rgyas la sbyor bar byed pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro//'di skad du/ phyag rgya chen po sgyu ma yin/ /'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal chen yin/ /mthong ba'i gnas na bcu drug sa/ /zhes snang bas/ cho 'phrul 'gyed nus 43—1256

shing phyag rgya chen po'i rigs 'dzin yang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnas skabs zhes pa/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dbang du/ gnas dang skabs cig du ston ste/ bzhed tshig tu/ yon tan mthong thos rkyen phrad dang / /byin brlabs 'brel cing mtshungs ldan pas/ /g.yo sems 'byung zhing 'dun skye ba'i—/ /dus kyi thad la bab phyir skabs zhes bya'o/ /bslab pa 'jug pa'i skabs gnyis pa'ang / 'di skad du/ g.yo smon rgyu yis bslab bcu la/ /der mi sdod par ldang sems kyis/ /bcu la 'jug pa'i gzhi ①dang dus/ /thad du bab phyir ming thob pa'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ro myong ba'i skabs ni/'di skad du/ sems gsum rgyu yis bslab rdzogs nas/ /'jug pa'i sems rgyus bden mthong ba/ /ji bzhin nyid kyi ro myong ba'i/ /gnas dus nges pas skabs su brjod zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa yul la 'jug pa'i gnas skabs ni/ 'di skad du—/ mthong ba'i shes yul nges pa la/ /dgra dbang mi 'gyur lhag sems kyis/ /rang rig gnyis med mi g.yo bar/ /byed la 'jug pa'i skabs su smra zhes bya'o/ /lnga pa rtog chen la phebs pa'i gnas skabs ni/ 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor sngon sum rgyus—/ /rang rig mngon sum rig sems skyes/ /yang dag don mthong thil phebs phyir—/ /de la 'di skad brjod pa yin zhes bya'o/ /bshad rgyud kyi dbang du/ gnas dang skabs so so ste/ de la gnas zhes pa/ 'dod pa grub pa mthar phyin pa'i gnas ni/ ji skad du/ rkyen gyi rnal 'byor bya byed dang / /phyi ba'i rtags lam rdzogs pa dang / /'di nyid sngar spyad thams cad kyi/ /'dod pa'i gsang lam rnyed pa ni/ /las mthar phyin pas 'dir phrad cing / /de la brten phyir gnas su brjod zhes 43—1257

bya'o—/ /gnyis pa bzod pa grub 'phags pa'i gnas ni/ ji skad du/yang dag don la mi skad bzod/ /de phyir rigs nges gzungs sngags yod/ /de phyir 'phags pa zhes bya ste/ /skye bo sa las 'das pa'i gnas/ /zhes bya'o//gsum pa bden pa grub pa yang dag pa'i gnas ni/ ji skad du/ sgro bskur nyu med pa'i gnyis med don/ /mthong ba mthar phyin mi bslu zhing / /phyin ci ma log la brten phyir/ /dang po'i dbugs chen phyin pa'i gnas/ /zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa las su rung ba'i sbyor ba'i gnas ni/ ji skad du/ mthong nas goms pa mi g.yo ba'i/ /gnyis med gsal la mi g.yo ba'i/ /ting 'dzin goms pas 'bras bur sbyor/ /mthar lam thob la ma rag pa'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /lnga pa lhun kyis grub pa mnyam pa'i gnas ni/ ji skad du/ mthong goms stobs su gyur pa yis/ /'bras bu job pa'i skabs yin zhing / /shing 'bras tshogs kyi dpe lta bus/ /yon tan rdzogs pas blang dor med/ /zhes bya'o/ /skabs zhes pa lnga ste/ sems can gyi skabs ni/ ras bal sa bon lta bu'i gzhi//g.yo bas sgra yi rnal 'byor kyi/ /bsgom bya yid la byed pa'i gzhi/ /da dung ma nges dran tsam mo/ /zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'phags pa'i skabs ni/ ji skad du / dad pas mos pas lam 'gro zhing / /slob pa pa 'di bzod thob phyir/ /'du shes rigs nges khyad par 'phags/ /yang dag rgyud du nges phyir ro/ /gsum pas thob pa'i skabs ni/ 'di skad du/ mi slob chos mig rdul bral zhing / /dbugs chen phyin nas mi ldog pa'i/ /ting 'dzin thob pa'i dus nges phyir—/ /de la mtshan du de skad brjod/ /zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa rigs 'dzin byang chub thob pa'i skabs ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems chen por/ /43—1258

bdag phyir bzlog med gzhan don du/ /phyir 'ong rang dbang skye spyod phyir/ /rgyal ba'i sras po gdung 'tshob skabs zhes bya'o/ /lnga pa 'bras bu thob pa'i skabs ni/ ji skad du/ byang chub chen por rdzogs sems skyes/ /rgyal tshab skyes bur rtsal rdzogs pa/ /lam du gyur pa'i 'bras bu'i phyir/ /'bras bu'i skabs zhes mtshan nges pa'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /ye shes dang zhes bya ba ni/ mnyam par bzhag pa re re la/ /ye shes re re 'char ba'o/ /zhes snang bas/ skabs lngar sems lnga bsgom shar gyi ye shes lnga ste/ ji skad du/ yang dag bden pa gnyis med don/ /yid byed g.yo yi ye shes dang / /bzod thob 'jug slob ye shes dang / /ma nor mthong dga'i ye shes dang / /de nyid mi 'gyur gnas ye shes/ /de mthar rdzogs sems ye shes so/ /zhes bya'o/ /bsgrib dang zhes pa 'di skad du/ so so thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /sgrib las zhes rtsi byed cing zhes snang bas/ lnga ste/ 'di skad du/ sa 'am rnal 'byor rnam lnga po/ /rang rang mthong la zhen pa yis/ /gong ma gong ma ma mthong phyir/ /lam gyi dbye bas sgrib pa'ang lnga'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /gol sa zhes pa/ 'di skad du/ thun mong rgyu yi lam lngar gol/ /khyad par sgrib la bltos tshul gyis/ /lam lnga gong dmigs 'og lta can/ /rtsang nor phyir na sgra 'jug pa'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /rtog pa dang zhes pa ni/ ched du byas pa'i rtog pa ste/ 'di skad du/sa lnga dang po tshig la rtog /gnyis pa yi ge gsum pa ming / /bzhi brda tha snyad lnga par rtogs/ /bag chags lnga yod sbyong ba'i phyir/ /bltos na phyag rgya 'phro 43—1259

'du dang / /shes yul rnams la gnas phyir rtog /zhes bya'o/ /spyod dang zhes pa ni/ bzhi phyir spyod pa'ang skabs kyis bdag dang gzhan don du/ sngon 'byung dang rjes 'jug tshul du 'gyur ro/ /de la sa dang por ni/ rtsol ba dang tshogs kyi sa lam yin pa'i phyir/ rtsol tshogs gnyis la'ang shin tu 'bad/ /byin brlabs dbang sgyur thabs tshul gyis/ /gzhan don mtha' 'ga' sprul bas spyod/ /gnyis pa bdag phyir legs nyes la/ /gcod sbyong stobs phyir shin du 'ang / /brtson spyod dbe+en las phyogs gcig spyod//slob spyod bdag gzhan don kyang byed/ /gsum par mi dmigs shar ba yis/ /'dod pa'i dngos po dbyings sbyor phyir/ /bdag phyir mi dmigs gzhan phyed du//'khor lo sgyur bas gsang sngags ston/ /bzhi par bdag phyir rnal 'byor spyod/ /gzhan la phyir 'ong sa yin phyir/ /rang dbang can du skye zhes nas/ /ji ltar 'dod ltar thabs mchog sbyor/ /lnga par ting 'dzin rtsal rdzogs phyir/ /dbang sgyur thabs kyi spyod pa yis//cho 'phrul bzhi sogs sna tshogs ston/ /gdul bya smin cing 'khor lo'ang skor/ /zhes bya'o/ /dam tshig zhes bya ba/ skabs kyi ched du byed pa las/ /brtags kyi rtsa ba yan lag rnams/ /kun srung bye brag dang por ni/ /bdud lnga dgra bzhi bzlog pa dang / /spyod pa rgyun nam bzhi la gnas/ /'dun cing yi rang ma nyams byed/ /gnyis pa bslab pa bcu byed las/ /mi 'da' bzod las mi nyams byed/ /gsum par lta ba'i dam tshig byed/ /mthong ba mi gnas brtson par byed/ /'di skad du/ nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas/ /nam 43—1260

mkha' lta bu'i dam tshig srung / /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi par ting nge 'dzin kyi so nyid las/ mi nyams ma yengs mi 'da' ba'o/ /'di skad du/ brjed pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ bsrung ba med pa'i ngang du bsdam/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzhan du ni/ phyir 'ong bar dam bcas pa gang yin pa'o/ /lnga par med dang phyal ba cig pu dang / /lhun gyis grub pa rnam bzhi pa'o/ /ting 'dzin dang zhes pa'ang lnga ste/ rnam par mi rtog lha sgom pa'ang / /gang rung dang por yid la byed/ /gnyis pa 'phro 'du gcig pa dang / /gsum pa yongs su mi ldog cing / /bzhi par de bzhin nyid bsgom dang / /lnga par kun tu snang ba sgom/ /de phyir rnal 'byor rnal 'byor yin/ /zhes bya'o/ /dus dang zhes pa 'ang lnga stiste/ /gsang sngags yid la byed tsam yod/ /de phyir dran pa thob par smra/ /gsang ba'i bslab bcu thob pa'i dus/ /gnyis med rtogs pa thob pa'i dus/ /de nyid bsgoms pa goms pa'i dus/ /de mngon gyur pas mthar phyin dus/ /zhes bya'o/ /dngos grub zhes pa/ dang po 'dod pa grub pa dang / /gnyis pa bzod pa grub pa dang / /gsum pa bden grub bzhi pa las/ /rung ba grub pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/lhun gyis grub pa'i rigs thob pa'o/ /'on te dang po gnyis pa ni/ /dmigs pa grub pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ don dam bcud kyi rnam shes rgyas/ /bzhi pa 'khor ba'i dbyings su 'grub/ /lnga pa thams cad 'grub par gsungs/ /mthar phyin dang zhes pa/ dge ba'i las mtha' gsang sngags la/ /'dir phrad dang po gnyis pa ni/ /bslab mtha' bcu la slob phyir ro/ /gsum pa mthong mthar gsang sngags mthong / /de rgyus bzhi par gsang sngags don/ /43—1261

mthong ba goms bya de nyid mthar/ /phyin pa'o lnga par mthar lam 'bras /rdzogs phyir 'bras bu kun gyi mthar/ /rtsal chen rdzogs pa thob pa'o/ /lta ba'i khyad par zhes pa lnga ste/ dang po 'dun pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni/g.yo smon gyis gsang sngags la nyan dbang nos nas/ slob du zad kyang /tshig gi tshogs pa sgra'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ blo sman pas gsang sngags kyi don tshig tu smra zhing / mthong ba med de/ yid la byed pa'i lta ba'o/ /'on kyang phyogs las da dung bzod pa'ang ma thob bo/ /de yang 'di skad du/brtsal ba las kyi rnal 'byor pas/ /'dun pa sems dpa'i rnal 'byor la/ /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnam drug po/ /shes rab rtsal gyi 'phang dmas pas/ /ting 'dzin rtsal yang chud pa ste/ /don la mthong bar mi 'gyur bas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rigs chen 'byed pa'i lta ba ni/ /bcu yis sa gsum 'dus pa ste—/ /'dir byed nas/ slob pa bcu'i tshe bzod pa thob ste/ bden pa rnam gnyis dbyer med pa bstan pa la/ mi skrag cing slar spyod pas rang rig mtshan nyid du thos bsam gyi sgo nas shes te/ 'di skad du/ don la mi skrag ngo mtshar skye/ /dpyod sems 'jug pa'i sems dpa' de/ /ngan song mi ldog dgon par 'jug /zhes gsungs so/ /dbugs chen 'byin pa'i lta ba ni/ /sa lnga par bsgoms pas chos nyid ji lta bar mthong ste/ mi ldog pa'i lta ba'o/ /de yang / ngal so ba las thams cad mthong / zhes gsungs so/ /lung chen thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi lta ba ni/ mi g.yo ba'i lta ba ste/ de ltar mthong ba'o/ /rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i lta ba ni/ rang 'byung ye shes su bsgoms pas mngon du 'gyur ba ste/ 'di skad du/ rang 'byung rang rig mngon sum snang dus na/ /43—1262

rang 'byung ye shes de nyid mthong zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /la la dag ni 'di skad du/ lta ba lnga ni shes pa lnga/ /gsang sngags 'dod pa 'dam shes dang / /rnam par shes pa bslab bcu dang / /bzod thob rang gi mtshan nyid shes—/ /thams cad ma skyes ye shes dang / /de las yongs su mi g.yor shes/ /shes pa chen po kun tu snang / /mthong ba dam pa'i lta ba yin zhes smra'o/ /gnas 'gyur rnams zhes pa/ skabs lnga kun gzhi lnga bag chags lnga dang bcas pa gnas 'gyur ba ste/ dran pa thob pa'i dus sems can gyi skabs su skye bo'i shes pa ma rig pa las sems g.yo ba 'byung bas/ lam kyi gzhir gyur pas rkyen gyis bsgyur ba las kyi bag chags gnas te/ sbyong zhing 'dod pa shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang po'o/ /spyod pa thob pa'i dus 'phags pa'i skabs su bslab pa bcu yang dag pa'i don la sbyor ba'i phyir/ sbyor ba bdun pa'i kun gzhir 'gyur ste/ mngon du rgyu ba gnas te sbyong ngo / /rtogs pa thob pa'i dus sa thob pa'i skabs su/ 'og gi 'bad pas bden pa mthong ba'i phyir/ /snang ba don gyi kun gzhir gnas 'gyur te/ /de'i tshe kun du rgyu'i bag chags gnas te spyong ba'o/ /rigs 'dzin byang chub sems dpa'i skabs goms pa thob pa'i dus su—/ mthong ba la goms pas sems mi g.yo ba'i phyir/ 'gyur med gnas pa'i kun gzhir gnas 'gyur ste/ bag chags lhan cig skyes pa'i gnas de sbyong ba'o/ /mthar phyin pa'i dus byang chub chen po'i 'bras bu thob pa'i skabs su/ sngar goms pas mngon du gyur pa'i phyir/ btsal med gnas pa'i kun gzhir gnas 'gyur te/ bag la nyal gnas pa sbyong ba'o/ /zhes 'chad na/ kho bo ni dang po rigs ma nges pa dang / chos nyid ma shes pa'i phyir der 'gyur zhes mi 'dogs 43—1263

pa'i phyir/ dang po nas gnyis par 'gyur ba nas/ lnga pa nas sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba dang lnga ste/ lam lngar rang rig ting nge 'dzin brtan pas/ ye shes skyes pas sgrib pa re sbyangs pa skad cig ma phyi ma la lam lngar skabs lnga'i phyir/ kun gzhi'i gnas 'gyur rnam pa lngas/ /bye brag lam lnga'i chos su bshad/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bag chags lnga ni sgrib pa lngar yang gsungs te/ de dag ni rgyu 'bras kyi phyir khyad par yod de/ 'di skad du/ de dag re zhing rgyu 'bras gnyis—/ /snga ma snga ma gang dang gang / /phyi ma phyi ma smin pa'i rgyu/ /de bzhin kun tu 'khor bar 'byung / /zhes gsungs te/ 'chad pa'i bcu po'ang rgyu 'bras su 'gyur bar dgongs so/ /yang sa bcur bshad pa bya ba ni/ sa dang zhes pa/ 'gyur dbang ma nges pa'i sa dang / rten pa gzhi'i sa dang / gal chen sbyong ba'i sa dang /bslab pa rgyun gyi sa dang / bsod nams gter gyi sa dang / rten pas khyad par du 'gro ba'i sa dang / dmigs pas 'bras bu skye ba'i sa dang / gnas pa mi 'gyur ba'i sa dang / bdal ba chos nyid kyi sa dang / rdzogs pa spyir chib kyi sa'o/ /de yang bcur bstan pa ni/ gsang sngags rim 'jug gi 'bring gi yul lo/ /gzhi bcur de las spros pa ni/ /tha ma'i dbang du gsungs pa'o/ /de las lnga ni lnga'i skabs su bshad de/ sngar lnga'i skabs su ma bshad pa rnams cung zhig du dgol ba ni gang zhe na/ dang po gnyis pa rten pa gzhi'i ①sa ni/ 'di skad du/ dang po gsang ba'i bslab pa la/ /rtsol bar sbyong ba la brten nas/ /dang po'i las kyi rnal 'byor te/ /sa rnams kun gyi 43—1264

gzhi rten no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gal chen bshad zin to/ /de'i cha bslab pa rgyun gyi sa ni 'dir bslab pa bcu la zhugs nas mi gtong bar rgyun du 'bad pas bogs su byed pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di skad du/ bslab pa'i mtha' bcu mthar phyin cing / /ji ltar zla ba yar gsal bzhin/ /bslab pa'i ye shes 'phel 'gyur te/ /zhes gsungs te/ bsod nams gter gyi sa ni/'di skad du/ bslab pa bcu mthar phyin pa yi/ /bsod nams yon tan zad mi shes/ /slob pas mthar phyin bsgom pa'i sa mthong lam thob la ma rag pa'o—/ /zhes gsungs so/ /drug pa dang bdun pa dang brgyad pa gsum bshad zin to/ /dgu pa lnga pa las 'phros pa bdal ba chos nyid ni/ rang gi kun gzhi'i chos nyid dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa des bgos pa med par kun khyab par rtogs pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang yul don ye shes de sbyar bas/ shes par byas pa thams cad rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bcu pa rdzogs pa spyir chib pa ni/ 'di skad du/ bcu pa'i tha ma dang po las/ /mthar rdzogs kun kyi rtog yin te/ /klong yangs nam mkha'i snying po la/ /sprin med nyi ma 'bum gyis bdal/ /cir snang ci 'ang ma yin pa'i/ /mi skye mi 'gag ngo bo las/ /ji ltar bltas dgu der snang bas/ /theg mchog spyi rgya rlabs kyis bcad①/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnas skabs zhes pa de gnyis kun 'dus ltar/ gnas skabs bcur yang sbyar te/ 'dun pa skye ba'i gnas skabs dang / /zhes pa la sogs pas mngon no/ /dgongs 'dus ltar so sor bshad na/ dang po bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa'i gnas ni/ rten pa grub pa lam gyi gnas te/ lam rnams kyi 43—1265

gzhir gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa bshad zin to/ /bzhi pa ni bzod pa grub pa slob pa'i gnas te/ zab mo'i don la bzod pa thob pas/ ye shes 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ bslab pa bcu la slob pa'i sa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa babe+eb pa grub pa rtser chib pa'i gnas de babe+eb pa bcu khong du chud cing rtser chib pa'i sa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa bdun pa brgyad pa bshad zin to/ /rdeng du gyur pa chos nyid kyi gnas dgu par/ bsgoms pas ①phebs pa stobs su gyur pa de 'dir chos nyid rdeng du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /bcu pa 'bras bu grub pa rdzogs pa'i gnas ni/ mthar phyin pa'i phyir ro/ /skabs zhes pa/ dang po bshad—/ gnyis pa rtsol ba sbyor ba'i skabs te/ rton pas slob pa la rtsol ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa bshad/ bzhi pa 'du shes 'gyur ba'i skabs ni/ rigs phyed pas sbyor ba'i sems kyis 'du shes yang dag pa'i ye shes su 'gyur te/ ye shes 'phel bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa sbyor chen la 'jug pa'i skabs ni/ bslab bcus chib pas thos bsam gyis mthong ba'i don bsgom pa la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa bdun pa brgyad pa bshad zin to/ /dgu pa rdeng du gyur pa'i skabs te/rtags chen thob pa'i phyir ro/ /bcu pa las su rung ba'i skabs te/ rdzogs sems skyes pas ②bskyed du bya ba'i lam med pa'i phyir ro/ /ye shes dang zhes pa sngar brjod pa'i gtan tshigs kyis/ skabs bcur sems bcu skyes pas sems dang chos 'phrad pa'i ye shes grol thar pa thang re'o/ /de la dang po brjod zin/ smon pas khong du chud 'dod pa'i/ /bden gnyis mgo mthong yid la byed/ /smon pa'i ye shes gong ma'i rgyu/ /de rgyus der mi brtan par ldang / /bden gnyis rang gi mtshan nyid du/ /shes pa gcod sbyong 43—1266

sbyor ba yi/ /bslab pa'i ye shes ye shes gsum/ /bzhi pa de rgyus sbyor sems kyis—/ /lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med don/ /thos la mi skrag spyod cing 'phel—/ /bzod thob ye shes phyi ma'i rgyu/ /lnga pa de rgyus ye shes skyes/ /bden pa dbyer med thos bsams kyis/ /go ba'i don la 'jug sems pas/ /mthong la sbyor ba'i ye shes so/ /drug dang bdun pa brjod zin te/ /brgyad par 'di skad du/ mtshan ma'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du gsal/ /zhes gsungs te/ rig pa'i sems kyis mnyam nyid mthong ba'i ye shes so/ /dgu par gnas pa'i sems kyis dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i don shar ba ste/ 'di skad du/ srid pa'i sems can thams cad dang / /thar pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kun/ /so sor thams cad snang ba ste/ /kun kyang mnyam pa'i ngang du gsal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bcu pa rdzogs pa'i sems kyis rang 'byung ye shes rdzogs par shar ba ste/ 'di skad du—/ sa chu me rlung snod bcud rnams/ /kun kyang rang bzhin chos nyid don/ /chos nyid don las gzhan med pa/ /rang 'byung ye shes gsal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sgrib dang zhes pa bcu ste/ sa 'og ma bcus gong ma'i lta ba rnams yul du ma gyur par brjod zin te/ yang las kyi bag chags phra rags ni/ gnyis pa dang po dag la bsgrib/ /mngon du rgyu ba rab 'bring gsum/ /gsum pa bzhi dang lnga la sgrib/ /kun tu rgyu ba drug pa ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa bdun la gnas//bag la nyal ba phra rags 'bring / /brgyad dang dgu dang bcu la gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /43—1267

gol sa zhes pa/ 'di skad du/ rgyu yi tshogs dang drod rtse mo/ /bzod dang 'jig rten chos mchog dang / /mthong sgom mthar lam rnams su gol/ /yang na 'og ma 'og ma nyid/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rtog pa dang zhes pa bcu ste/ 'di skad du/ bag chags lnga yi phra rags bcu—/ /sa bcur ldan pas chos nyid la/ /ched du byed dang phyag rgya yang / /khyon dang 'phro 'du'i rtog sogs bcu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /spyod dang zhes pa bcu ste/ dang po bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa rgo 'di skad du/ bslab pa spyod dang nges pa la/ /dag dang ma dag gis spyod pa'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ phra men gyi spyod pa'o/ /gsum pa bshad zin to/ /bzhi pa ni ngal song mi ldog dgon par 'jug /bar chad dag kyang de las 'byung / /zhes gsungs pas/ phyogs cig pa sgom pa'i spyod pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ spyod pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor yin/ /zhes 'byung bas/ rgyun gyi spyod pa'o/ /drug pa ni/bdag don shes rab dang mthun pa'o/ /gzhan don du 'di skad du/ sgyu mas spyod pa'i skyes bu de/ /'khor lo sgyur ba'i cha byad du/ /rin chen bdun dang dpung tshogs kyis/ /dbang sgyur thabs kyi theg pa ston/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdun pa ni ting nge 'dzin kyi sbyor ba'o/ /zhes 'byung ba bdag don gzhan don du 'di skad du/ de bas skyes bu dam pa de/ /'bras bu nyid la lam shes pas//lam gyi yan lag bde rdzogs te/ /gzhan dag smin par bya ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dod par thabs mchog sbyor/ /zhes gsungs so/ /brgyad pa bdag don sbyor ba'i spyod pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin mang po la bsgoms ①pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan don du/ 'di skad du/ de bas rgyal tshab skyes bu de/ /chos kyi rgyal 43—1268

po gang de yi/ /gdung 'tshob dga' ldan theg chen ston/ /mi gnas bcu dus cho 'phrul snang / /zhes gsungs so/ /dgu pa ni/ sgyu ma'ang sgyu ma yin spyod pa'o / /zhes gsungs pas/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i spyod pa'o/ /bcu pa ni lhan gyis grub pa'i spyod pa'o/ /yang kun 'dus las/ sa brgyad 'di skad du/sbyor dang sgol bar byed pa dang / /ma byin len dang ngag sprul byed/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig spyod pa'i mchog /spyad par bya ba'i las yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dgu pa ni/ thams cad mnyam pa'i ngang la gnas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul las/ /dngos su spyod pa thams cad bya/ /de ni dam tshig chen po yin zhes gsungs so/ /bcu pa ni/ spyod dang spyod pa bya med pas//srid dang mu stegs 'jig rten pa'i/ /spyod par snang ba thams cad kun/ /lcun gyis grub pa'i mdzad spyod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dam tshig zhes pa bzhed tshig las/ /rang rang spyod las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dam bca' bcu ni dam tshig go zhes gsungs/ /de'i phyir dang po bshad zin to//gnyis pa rtsol ba las mi 'da'/ /bzhi pa bslab pa las mi 'da'/ /lnga pa 'jug sgom las mi 'da'/ /dgu pa chos nyid dam tshig gsum/ /brgyad pa dngos po bzhi la spyod pa las mi 'da'/ /bcu pa bzhi las mi 'da' 'o/ /brgyad pa 'di skad du/ 'dod pas chags pas 'joms pa dang / /gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog rnams/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i dam tshig ste/ /don dang ldan pa'i skyes bus spyod/ /dgu pa ni/ dam tshig dam pa gang zhe na/ /rtogs pa dam pas dam tshig ste/ /rtogs par byed pa gang yin pa/ /de ni dam tshig chen po'o/ /bcu pa ni med pa phyal ba cig pu dang / /lhun gyis sdogs pa'i 43—1269

dam tshig che/ /'di zhes ris su chad med pa/ /'di ni bsrung ba'i dam tshig go—/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ting nge 'dzin zhes pa'ang bcu ste/ /dang po yid la byed thob nas/ /gnyis pa de goms brtan pa'o/ /gsum pa 'dro ①'du gcig pa thob/ /bzhi pa de goms lnga par brtan/ /drug par mi ldog bdun de nyid/ /brgyad par kun snang thob nas ni/ /dgu pa goms nas bcu par ni/ /de brtan las su rung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon bde bar gsal mdzad kyis ni/'di skad du/ dang po yid la byed pa ste/ /rten pas yon tan 'byung gzhi'i phyir—/ /rin chen myu gu'i ting 'dzin thob/ /gsum pa nyes pa gcod sbyong phyir—/ /dug 'joms sman gyi ting nge 'dzin/ /bzhi pa bar chad 'byung ba'i phyiraske/ /rtse gcig ⑤'phro ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /lnga pa bsod nams gter gyi phyir—/ /tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /drug pa chos mig rdul bral phyir—/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bsgoms pas yon tan 'byung ba yi/ /mi bzad mdzod ni bdun pa'o/ /brgyad pa cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i phyir/ /'byung chen sprul pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /dgu pa chos nyid bdal ba'i phyir/ /rnam dag dbyings kyi ting nge 'dzin/ /bcu par ma lus lhun rdzogs phyir/ /thams cad rdzogs pa'i ting ④'dzin dang / /snang gsal ye mtsho'i ting nge 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /dus dang zhes pa/ lnga ni bshad pa dang yang mthun no/ /bzhed tshig las—/ dang po rjes su yi rang phyir/ /'dun pa skye ba'i 'du shes rjobya/ /gnyis pa slob pa la brtson phyir/ /rtsol ba sbyor ba'i dus nyid do/ /gsum pa 43—1270

gal chen sbyong ba'i phyir/ /bslab pa 'jug pa'i dus su brjod/ /bzhi pa rigs chen 'byed pa'i phyir/ /bslab gnas 'du shes 'gyur ba'i dus/ /lnga pa mthong don spyor ba'i phyir/ /sbyong chen 'jug pa'i dus chen yin/ /drug pa thams cad mthong ba'i phyir/ /dang po dbugs chen phyin pa'i dus/ /bdun po de don goms bya'i phyir/ /yul la 'jug pa'i dus su brjod/ /brgyad pa nges don phebs pa'i phyir / /rtogs chen nyid la phebs pa'i dus/ /dgu pa de stobs gyur pa'i phyir/ /bdeng snadu gyur pa'i dus zhes bya/ /bcu pa shin tu mthar phyin phyir/ /las rung tha ma'i dbugs phyin dus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dngos grub zhes pa 'ang bcu ste/ /sa bcu 'og ma 'og ma yis/ /gong ma gong ma thob pa nyid/ /skabs kyi rgyu 'bras yod pa'i phyir/ /gnas skabs zhugs pa'i dngos grub po/ /'di ltar yang 'chad de/ /dang pos 'dod pa'i dngos grub dang / /gnyis pas sbyor ba'i dngos grub dang / /gsum pas spyong spyod dngos grub dang / /bzhi pas drod rtags dngos grub dang / /lnga par bslab rdzogs dngos grub dang / /drug par rtogs pa 'grub pa dang / /bdun pa mi g.yo thob pa dang / /brgyad par cho 'phrul 'grub pa dang / /dgu par ye shes rgyu 4ma 'grub/ /bcu par rang 'byung ye shes nyid/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mthar phyin dang zhes pa/ 'dun pa'i nang nas 'dir 'dun dang / /'bras bu 'dun phyir mthar phyin pa'o/ /de bzhin rtsol ba thams cad kyi/ /mchog 'di stsol ba mthar phyin pa'o/ /nges don grub la brtson pa'i phyir/ /brtson pa'i mthar phyin gsum par thob/ /bzod pa'i nang nas mchog 'gyur phyir / /gsang don bzod pa mthar phyin mchog /bslab pa lhag pa bcu nyid 43—1271

phyir—/ /bslab pa mthar phyin lnga pa nyid/ /gnyis med bden rtogs mchog yin phyir—/ /drug pas mthong ba mthar phyin no/ /rang rig don goms mchog yin phyir//bdun par ting 'dzin goms mthar phyin/ /de nyid stobs kyis rang rig pa/ /rig pa'i nang na mthar phyin pa'o/ /dbyengs dang ye shes gnyis med la/ /rig pa rdeng gyur gnas mthar phyin/ /thams cad rang 'byung klong brdal phyir/ /gong na med pa'i 'bras mthar phyir①/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lta ba'i khyad par zhes pa/ dang po tshig tshogs sgra'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ tshig tsam lta ba'o/ /gnyis pa lhag pa'i bden pa gnyis/ /yid la byed pa'i lta ba'o/ /gsum pas bden gnyis rang mtshan du/ /mgo mthong gnyis med bzod pa thob/ /bzhi pa gnyis su med pa la/ /mi skrag spel byed g.yo dang thob/ /lnga par babe+eb bcu spyir chib pas/ /gnyis med thag chod de la 'jug /drug pa de rgyus ji bzhin mthong / /de yang 'di skad du/ rgyud nyid las/ chos kun mi mjong chos nyid kyang / /mi mthong sems can sems mi mthong / /sangs rgyas mi mthong gang mthong ba/ /des ni yang dag bden pa mthong / /zhes gsungs so/ /bdun pa de nyid goms pa yis/ /mi g.yo lta ba shes rab can/ /brgyad pa ⑤rang rig 'bras bu sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid du goms pa'i rgyus mthong ste/ 'di skad du/ sangs rgyas sems can thams cad dang / /dngos por brtags pa thams cad kun/ /don gyi ngang du gcig pa ste/ /de nyid sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /zhes gsungs so/ /dgu par dbyings dang ye shes yab yum dbyer med pa'i bde ba chen po rdeng du gyur te/'di skad du/ snod du gyur pa yum gyi dbyings/ /bcud rnams rgyal ba yab kyi 43—1272

mkha'—/ /'byung 'jug rig pas longs spyod ste/ /'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig yin zhes gsungs so/ /bcu pa'i lta ba bza' gtad dang bral ba ste 'di skad du/ma spangs bzhin du lhun grub pas/ /dbyer med pa ni chos kyi dbyings/ /dbyings las gzhan du lta yul med/ /'di ni lta ba'i dam tshig go/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnas 'gyur rnams zhes pa/ lnga'i bzlas bcur 'gyur te/ bzhed tshig las/ sa bcur sems bcur skyes pa yis/ /ting 'dzin stobs bstan ye shes re/ /shar ba'i skad cig snga ma yis/ /rang rang sgrib bcom phyi ma la//gong nas gong du sangs rgyas pa/ /gnas 'gyur bcu la lam rtegs kyibacu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'on te kun gzhi'i gnas 'gyur ba ni/ skye bo nas 'dun pa'i rnal 'byor du/ gnas 'gyur na'ang / de bzhin gshegs par rtsal chen sdogs pa'i skad cig ma la bag la nyal/ rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis bcom nas / phyi ma la sku lnga mngon du bya ste/ brtan du bar gnas 'gyur ba dang drug du 'gro bas/ kun gzhi'i gnas 'gyur rnam pa lngas/ /bye brag lam lnga'i chos su snang / /zhes pa dang 'gal/ 'on te 'dun pa'i rnal 'byor du gnas ma 'gyur ro zhe na'ang / 'dun pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/ yid la byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis lha'i sku rang gi chag tshad tsam du phyogs pa dang / g.yo ba'i sems skyes pa/ glegs bam bcu gnyis kyi dbang thob pas/ bdag nyid nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i ltas mthong bas/ de dag skye bo la med la/ /sa 'di pa la yod pa'i phyir/ /gnas ma 'gyur na rigs pa dang 'gal lo/ /zhes the tshom skye ba la/ de 'di ltar bcad par bya ste/ de ltar snang mod kyi/43—1273

'dun pa pa ni skye bo las 'phags mod kyang / der gnas 'gyur zhes mi bya ste/skye bo'i tshe rgyu rkyen med pa ma yin yang / nges pa'i shes pas sbyangs pas/'dun pa thob pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ der gnas 'gyur na/ gnas 'gyur 'bras bur 'gyur ba'i dang drug du 'gyur bas/ gong du lngas zhes pa'i lung dang yang 'gal/ rigs pas lam lngar gnas 'gyur nas rtsal chen rdzogs par brjod na/ de ni lhun gyis grub pa'i rigs 'dzin yin gyi/ rgyal ba sangs rgyas nyid ma yin pa'i phyir/ rgyal bar 'gyur dgos pas/ rigs pa dang 'gal lo/ /de'i phyir 'dun pa pa de/ chos nyid la da dung bzod pa tsam yang ma thob ste/ ma mthong ba'i phyir/ skye bo las 'phags kyang gnas 'gyur zhes mi bya'o/ /des na 'dun par mos pa'i lha bstan par bsgoms pas/mthu brtan tsam na/ 'du shes klungs su zhugs pas las bag chags bsra bas bkag sbyangs nas/ sbyor ba 'dun pa'i kun gzhi thob pa gnas 'gyur ba dang po'o—/ /de bzhin du sa 'og nas gong du 'gyur bzhin/ rtsal chen nas bder gshegs su 'gyur ba dang lnga'o/ /de'i phyir 'dun pa nas yar sangs rgyas su kun gzhi lnga gnas lan lngar 'gyur ba'i phyir lam lngar snang ste/ der 'gyur ba byas pa'o/ /des na gong gi lung nyid dang mi 'gal la/ mthar sangs rgyas chen po nyid du gnas 'gyur bas/ rigs pa dang yang mi 'gal lo//dka' 'grel rgyud kyi skabs tshig dka' ba bkrol/ /lung dang rigs pas mdun bsu rgyab sbyar nas/ /dka' bas bsdus pa'i dge rtsa ci mchis pa mtha' yas rgyud la smin cing grol thob shog /slob dpon ste ra ma stes sbyar ba'i/skabs 'grel bye brag rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //43—1274

bsdur mchan/1255 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉so//1257 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bzhi/1258 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skur/1261 ①〈〈pe 〉〉walnga/1264 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bzhi'i/1265 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bshad/1266 ①〈〈pe 〉〉par ②〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i/1268 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsgom/127༷ ①〈〈pe 〉sngaraphro/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉cig ②〈〈pe 〉〉 nge / du〈〈pe 〉〉dus zhes/1271 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rdong / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rtsol/1272 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gin/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉par/1273 ①〈〈pe 〉〉stegs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bzhi'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tsom/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2555)43—1275

༄ga /byang chub sems kyi spyon shing /sti༄7/ /dpal rdo rje mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po las can rnal 'byor las/ /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor bcu po rnams/ /yi ge rtog spyod don la 'jug /de 'dir nges pa rnam gnyis kyis/ /don 'jug byang chub ljon pa'i shing / /bskyed phyir legs par bstan par bya'o/ /de la blo gros zhen can phyir/ /shes rab thabs kyis nges gsungs pa'i/ /thog mar blo gros ldan pa yis/ /so sor rtog pa mngon 'gro bas/ /mtha' bcu slob cing de nyid la/ /ngo bo nges tshig dgos pa dang / /gal po re 'ang chos rtags dang / /ldan pas de 'dir thag bcad dgos/ /de yis don du 'gyur gzhi'i phyir/ /gnas dang cha rkyen ldan byas nas/ /sngon 'gro las rnams rdzogs byas te/ /ljon shing bskyed pa'i las la 'bad/ /rnal 'byor lnga'ang khyad par las/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i skabs bcu sems/ /snga ma phyi ma rgyu 'bras tshul/ /gyur 43—1276
