pa bcu drug rgyun gyis sdogs/ /'dun pa skye ba'i skabs dag la/ /mun pa'i sprin las skar phran gzer/ /snang ba lta bur gsal ba yis/ /don mchog thos dang rtog dpyod pas/ /lhag pa'i gsang ba'i bden gnyis tshul/ /rang min spyi yi mtshan nyid du/ /sgra la brten nas g.yos la bsgom/ /bdag don 'jug pa dang po'i tshe/ /bying rgod la sogs gnyen pos spong / /nyams gsum mtha' la 'jug pa'i drug /nang du du bas gzer 'phro mthong / /nyer mtshon rtags tshul gnyi kar sbyar/ /stsol ba sbyong ba'i skabs dag la/ /mtha' bcu nyid la 'jug par sprul/ /g.yo yi rgyu yis chos rnams kun/ /bden gnyis rang gi mtshan nyid du/ /rtogs par smon pas khyad par phyir/ /ma nges sems las lhag par bsgom/ /de tshe rang mtshan nyams rims mtha'/ /skar ma phal pa rab rib mthong / /dang po las kyi rnal 'byor 'di/ /yang dag tshol la brtson bya dgos/ /sems skyen g.yeng spong bskrun byas nas/ /ngan song las rnams gcod par 'gyur/ /bslab pa 'jug pa'i skabs dag la/ /mtha' bcur zhugs te gcod sbyong zhing / /de tshe lhag pa'i bden gnyis kyang / /smon rgyu bcu rkyen ldan pa yis/ /gnyis med rtogs pa g.yo zhing ldang / /dbyer med rang gi mtshan nyid du/ /ldang ba'i sems bsgoms 'phel stobs kyis//gre gzer skar chen lta bu'ang mthong / /'du shes 'gyur ba'i skabs dag la/ /bcu mthar gnas pas 'du shes kyang / /don la bzod pa thob par 'gyur/ /gnyis med don la sbyor sems skye/ /yul dang dbang po rnams shes chos/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos/ /rang rig snang phyir snang kun sems/ /yul med sems kyang dbyings mdog mtshan/ /yod med bral bas rigs rgyud 4 3—1277

min / /de phyir ma skyes snang stong mtha'/ /dbyer med bsgom pa'i nyams mtha' la/ /dgal med 'khor lo zla tshes snang / /spyor chen 'jug pa'i skabs dag la/ /ngan song mi ldog sngon thob cing / /mtha' bcu rtser chib gnyis med don/ /rtogs mthar phyin la ma dag pa/ /bstan pas de don 'jug sems skye/ /nyams gsum mtha' la sgon me 'am/ /zla tshes gnyis pa'i rtags mthong 'gyur/ /dbugs phyin mthong la ma rag kyang / /le los yul la ma brtson na/ /mthong lam mi thob lha mi yi/ /gnas bzlog zag pas cung zad 'khor / /bsgrub pa'i rigs 'dzin gang de la'ang / /bdag gi don 'jug sum cu gnyis/ /rang rang shes 'jug 'byor pa sngon/ /tshol thos bzhi bzhir skabs la'ang sbyar/ /'o na mod kyang sems lnga yi/ /rim pa ji bzhin khyad par 'gyur/ /ro myong ba'i skabs dag la/ /dga' ba lhag pa'i sems 'byung ste / /ci phyir sngon du bcu mthar bas/ /mnyan bsam bsgoms las chos nyid do/ /ma myong ma mthong sus shes myong / /chos kun mi mthong chos nyid kyang / /mi mthong sems can sems mi mthong / /sangs rgyas mi mthong gang mthong ba/ /des ni yang dag bden pa mthong / /'jigs pa lnga bral bde ba'i sems/ /bsgom pa bum pa mar me'i tshul/ /de nyid mthong dang tshes gsum mthong / /de nyid mthong ba'i khyad par gyis/ /spyod lam dngos gzhir gang spyad kyang / /'ching bar mi 'gyur grol 'gyur thabs/ /thams cad der sbyangs lam gnas mchog /yul la 'jug pa'i skabs dag la/ /mi 'gyur lhag pa'i sems 'byung ba/ /ji ltar ji bzhin nyid mthong nas/ /shes rab dngos yul de nyid la/ /rnal 'byor yang dag 'jog pa'i tshe/ /gnyis med 43—1278

rang gi mi g.yo bar/ /mthong lam 'du byed dang bral ba/ /phra mo'i bying rgod dbang 'gyur bral/ /shin tu mi g.yo'i sems ldan pas/ /bzhi pa'i ri bong can mthong 'phel/ /lam byas pa yi snga ltas dag /rang 'byung chen po'i rtags mchog nye/ /gdul bya'i 'dod pa ji lta bar/ phyir 'ong sngon dang smad 'tshong ston/ /rtog chen dag gi skabs dag la/ /rig pa lhag pa'i sems 'byung ste/ /rnal 'byor yang dag 'jog pa'i rgyus/ /dngos gnyis sems kyi cho 'phrul phyir/ /bdag nyid chen po gsal bar rig /rnal 'byor yul 'das rig pa yi/ /mngon sum skabs kyis byas pa'i phyir/ /lam rim rdeng chud rtags chen po/ /rang 'byung ye shes nye bar bstan/ /gdung 'tshogs dga' ldan jeg chen ston/ /rdeng du gyur pa'i skabs dag la/ /gnas pa lhag pa'i sems 'byung ba'ang / /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /rang rig dbyings kyi rtsal snang phyir/ /yul don ye shes de sbyar bas/ /shes par bya ba thams cad sdogs/ /bde chen stobs ldan je tshom med/ /spyod yul chos nyid bdal gnas pa/ /rang 'byung ye shes rtogs thob pas/ /don gsal brtan pa'i sgron me 'dra/ /de mthong brgyad pa'i skar 'dzin mtho'o/ /rtags chen ye shes grub phyir thob/ /las su rung ba'i skabs dag la/ /rdzogs pa lhag pa'i sems 'byung ste/ /byu phyir mtha' bcu sa bcu yi/ /spyir chib chos kun rang rig nyid/ /rang 'byung rang snang rgyu rkyen bral/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs su sdogs / /ye shes dbyings zhes bya ba'i don/ /tha snyad tsam du rtogs chud nas / /thams cad rdzogs pa spyir chib pas/ /tha ma'i dbugs chen 'di tshe 'byung / /mnyam bzhag ma bzhag snyad las 'das/ /rang rig mngon sum 43—1279

chen po che/ /sa bcu rnal 'byor phra mo rnams/ /rang sems cig la g.yo thob brtan—/ /rim pas gsal dang mi gsal ba'i/ /stobs kyis khyad par 'gyur ba yin/ /rdzogs sems de rjes gsum rim gyis/ /klong yangs chub la mngon sangs rgyas/ /ji snyed nyid kyi sku gsung thugs/ /mngon byas ngo bo nyid sku thob//'dus byas sku sogs lngar snang sgol/ /'dus ma byas pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /phyed snang gnas dang chags can phyir/ /g.yem la g.yem ston chags la chags/ /ji ltar dug gis dug nad ltar/ /thabs kyi chags pas nges bya'i phyir/ /chags chus gsang sems shing skyed pa'ang / /bsnyen sgrub bzhi sogs bdag don ldanaske/ /mtshan ldan bkra shis gsang ba'i yum/ /dga' ①bas btsal la chags pas brten/ /'dod yon lnga yis mchod byas te/ /gnyis su med par nan tan bya/ /bcas dka' bral ba'i bkra shis gnas/ /btsal la sngon du byas rnams la/ /bsnyen pa dag gi dus su ni/ /gang zag mi yi zas la brten//nye ba'i bsnyen pa'i tshe na ni/ /bcud kyi mchog gis 'tsho byas te/ /dam phog chos bshad bslabs bskul sogs/ /legs byas bcu gnyis gsum 'tshos bya/ /phan tshun snol mas 'bad byas te/ /de nas dbang po bsrub pa yis mtshon byas shing bcu bskyed brtag bya/ /de de'i rim pa 'di lta ste/ /bde ba'i mtshan rdzogs rig ma la/ /mthong bas 'dun skye g.yo ba ste/ /lus kun la gnas thig le nyid/ /rdul bya phal po g.yo bar byed/ /sems rtsol 'dod pa rtse gcig ⑤gis/ /smon nas cho 'phrul 'jug byed pa/ /'bring po rtsa yi thig le ni—/ /rdul 'dus sro ma'i mtshan nyid 'byung / /tha mal ba ru de brjod do/ /phrad pa'i rag pas cha phra ba'i/ /rdul phran ldan par gyur pa'i mthus/ /dngul 43—1280

chu lta bu'i nyungs kar ni/ /balhos pas chen por nges par 'gyur/ /de nyid bde ba'i lam slebs pas/ /stsol bral bde bar blo sbyar ba/ /thig le ngo bo zla cig 1tshul/ /gang zhig rtags 'dzin stsol bcas skabs/ /gzung 'dzin cho 'phrul sems bcu pa/ /thig le dngos dang ye shes kyang / /cung zad kyis 'phags kun la blta/ /cung zad phyed 'das bde ba myong / /spros pa nyer zhi dga' ba'i mchog /chas sgos pas na gsum nyid de/ /gzugs dang ye shes de bzhin shes/ /bde ba chos kyi mi dmigs yul/ /gar mthong ngo bo 'gyur med de/ /rim pa je zhi je zhi ba/ /mtshan nyid gnyis 'phags de bzhin no/ /stong nyid mi g.yo rnam rtog ste/ /rang rig ngo bo rang gsal ba/ /rdul phran lnga pa mya ngan 'das/ /rtse mo dbus su gang gnas sems/ /goms pa rdeng dang bcas pa ni/ /ye shes tshogs kyi bcu drug phyed/ /phyed rdzogs tshogs 'phel de phan chad/ /mi dmigs chos la blo sbyangs yin/ /je zhi je phra mi dmigs pa/ /mtshan ma shes bya bsrabs pa ste/ /mnyam pas stong par gyur pas na/ /thams cad chos skur rdzogs pa'o/ /gang zhig 'dren pa'i cho ga ni/ /las su bya ba kun grub phyir/ /stsal bya stsol byed gnyis rdzogs pa/ /bcu drug tshogs kyis sgogs pas na/ /mdzes pa'i nyi ma bcu drug gis/ /zla dkyil 'od kyi phyag rgya la / /mdzes pas spras pa'i bde ba de/ /bcu drug tshogs kyi bsod nams skrun / /dus de nyid du nyi zla 'char/ /mapa' rdzogs sems su rgyal bas gsungs / /de ltar nyams dang 'phrod ldan nas/ /bsgrub pa dag gi dus su ni / /khams las gyur pa'i bcud kyis 'tsho/ /rdo rje rtse gcig lta bur 'gyur/ /bsgrub pa chen por zag pa zad/ /kham gyi zas dang bral 'gyur yang / /43—1281

dbang po gzi mdangs gsal 'gyur zhing / /nam mkha' 'gro bar the tshom lkumed//cho 'phrul bzhi sogs ston par nus/ /mthar rdzogs rgyal rngu la the tshom 1med/ /byang chub sems kyi chu med na/ /rgyal ba rnams kyang skams par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems kyi chu bo 'dis/ /sngon zhen mtha' dang sngo skams brlan/ /nor bu rin chen gang bsrel 4ba/ /dbul ba'i 'jigs pa med pa ltar/ /gsang ba'i don gsang gang bsrel 7ba/ /ltung gnas 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa med/ /seng ge phru gu'i dris ni gar khyab par/ /gang dag mi bzod thams cad 'bros par 'gyur/ /snying po'i don la rig pa'i mthu med kyang / /sems skyed tsam gyis dbu ma zil gyis gnon/ /log pa'i dgra rnams zil gnon skrag 'gyur zhing / /rang rang gnas su zug ngus gzir bar 'gyur/ /dkar po mthar thug bsod nams kun/ /sen mo thog gis rdul tsam du/ /rdo rje snying bor gabyug bskyed pa/ /sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po tsam/ /gsang nyad 6snying po'i byin rlabs ni/ /gang du rnam par mi rtog bzhin/ /'dod pa 'byung ba'i bya ba byed/ /de la byed pa ci 'ang med/ /kun 'byung byang chub shing gis kun khyab kyang / /dra ba bzhir chud lnga la ljon shing med/ /de 'dir gsang chen spyor ba'i sdem dgongs kyis/ /drangs bcug nges bya'i gdul byar kun gyur kyang //gsang ba'i ljon shing yal ka lo 'dab dang / /me tog 'bras bu rgyas byed 'di bsdus pa'i/ /ngal ba'i dge rtsas dra ba bzhi por nas/ /byang chub chen po'i chus brlan sangs rgyas shog /byang chub sems kyi ljon shing / ste ra ma tis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //43—1282

ga rgyan dam pa sna tshogs pa rim par phye ba bkod pa'o// ༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhi bcom drug ldan mtha' gnyis 'das/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i dpal mnga' zhing / /rnam pa rnam med snang mdzad pa/ /sgu gsum che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten pa la 'jig rten 'das pa dgos/ /dkyil 'khor dam tshig bsgrub las yo gar 'brel / /sgu bzhi lha lnga yang dgos byang chub sems/ /bka' dang don bsdebs ste ra ma tis bshad/ /spyir ni ston pa'i rnal 'byor nas/ /ma 'ongs pa dag bsgrub thabs la/ /sde snod gsum gsungs snying po lnga'i/ /gsang sngags rdo rje'i rgyud mchog las/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i mkhos dag ni/ /bar 'dir ma lus mdo 'don pa/ /rlung bcad dang po sa gzhi gzung / /gnyis pa sta gon gnas par bya/ /nub gsum pa la gzhug pa'o/ /las rnams thams 43—1284

cad bdag sgoms 1la/ /sa stegs zla gam tshon sngon bsku/ /thig le bdun bris rlung rgyal dud/ /sha zhon pa dan dgug sogs byas/ /kham bor lam dang dh+ri yis bcad/ /spogs pa bal mig dong gzhug cing / /phur bu btab phyung 'o mas bkru/ /zhag bdun bdun nas bya bar bshad/ /mtshor sa'i dpyad las 'byung ba bzhin/ /brtag dang bslang dang gzung phur rin/ /bskrad dang bsrung zhing sbyang dang bdun/ /de bdun ldan na las rnams 'grub/ /phyi nang brtag pas rung mi rung / /bslang ba mngon mi mngon nye'o/ /de dus dbang bcol sbran par bya/ /gzung ba rnam rgyal khro bo phur/ /bstan pa skyong ba'i bdag po lnga/ /rin chen la sogs nyi shu lnga/ /gus bcas rin du sbyin par bya/ /de nas phyag rgya rdo rje grag /bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bskras 2par shis//hūṃ swa oṃ ha gsum ni/ phyogs bzhir mtshan bsgyur rtse gsum 'gros/ /ma dang ta las nyi zla'i dkyil/ /shin tu khros bcas mgo bstod de/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ gi nga rgyal bya/ /lha dang lha min la sogs pa/ /'di na ma gnas mgo 'gas dengs/ /hūṃ rdo rje rigs gtso bo nya ma'i tshogs/ /rig pa mang po brten pa'i lha mo des/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis bgegs rnams phung ba dang / sdam pa 'thon cing phyogs bcur 'bros par 'gyur/ /ral gri spu gri nags tshal gtams pa yis /lcags bsregs sa gzhi rdo rje de shes pas/ /phyogs 'di nas ni myur du 'bros par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mgon po 'jig rten phan phyir gshegs ngas ni/ /gnas mchog 'di dag kun bsrungs pas/ /gnod byed bgegs kun 'di na ma gnas shig /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ na ma sa man+ta/ badz+ra nan/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a nu ga she/ ban+da si na ma hā sa ma ya/ ni dzā te sma ra ni/ a pra ti ha te/ ka 43—1285

ta ka ta/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ban+da ban+da/ da shi ti da sha na/ sarba ta thā ga ta/a nud gnya' de/ bra ba dar ma la ma ta/ bye dza ya/ ba ga ba ti/ ku ru bi ku le/ le lu pu re swā hā/ de yis bdud srin rod rod po/ /rigs lnga'i 'phra men g.yog bcas kun/ /ci bgyi zhes su brjod pa dang / /khyed kyis bgegs bskrad tshar gcod dang / /las kyi bdag pos grogs bya'o/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mngag gzhu pho nya'i las mdzad pa/ /khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yis/ /bgegs kyi sbyor ba rgyun chod cig /na mo badz+ra rat+na tra ya ya/ na ma tsaṇ+ḍa 1badz+ra pa na ye/ ma ha yak+ṣa se na pa ta ya/ na mo badz+ra kro ta ya/ ma hā dang stod ka ta/ be+e ra ba ya/ a si mu sa la/ pa ra ya/ pa ra shu pa sha tash+tsa ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ tha kuṇ+ḍa ne+e li/ kha kha kha/kha hi kha hi kha hi/ tishra tirja tishra/ brnya ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na ha na/byu na byu na sgru na/ gardza gardza gardza/ spo ta ya spo ta ya spo ta ya/ bi spo ta ya bi spo ta ya bi spo ta ya/ sarba —bisnan/ ma hā ga na ba ti/ dzi bi tan+t+ra ka ra swā hā// //zhes de bzhin du swa dang saṃ dang has bsgyur te/ rad na pad+ma kar mas mtshams bcad do/ /bsrung ba'i las dag bya ba yang / /ji bzhin stegs bu brtsigs nas su/ /lugs ma'i phyag rgya'am bdag gnas te/ /rgyan ldan de yis bdag gzhan bsrung / /bsrung chen mo dang phyag rgya lnga/ /brtan rgyal brjid legs bde bar gnas/ /badz+ra bzhi yis bsrung bar bya/ /sa rnams gzhan gyis ma gtses dang / /'bab chu rgya mtshor ma gyur la/ /nyi zla'i mig dang yig 'bru'i tshogs/ /sbyang zhing spel ba'i las bya'o/ /kun rdzob don dam 43—1286

gleng gzhi'i rgyu dang bsnyen pa dang / /nges pa'i tshig dang byang chub sems//sta gon gnas dang phan yon rnams/ /mdor bsdus yan lag bdun bshad rigs—/ /ci don gang la gang zhus bshad/ /chos rnams don bsgrub bstod gleng gzhi'o/ /ngo mtshar don zhus bshad thos langs/ /dran pa dang skyes gleng gzhi rgyu/ /mtshan ma dus dang grangs la brtson/ /thob la ma reg bsnyen pa'o/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan skyagasum/ /sngags dang de'i don ma 'dal te/ /dga' ba chen po de nges tshig /byang chub mchog gi sems ldan bskyed / /sbyangs pa kun rdzob don dam mo/ /lha dang mi dang yo byad gsum/ /ting 'dzin nan tan sta gon bya/ /lha rnams sta gon je gnas te/ /gnyis pa mi rnams sta gon no/ /tha ma yo byad sta gon bya/ /rim pa de yis las rnams 'grub / /dkyil 'khor dag la las kyi bskal yod gang / /de bzhin gshegs dang 'khor gyi lha rnams dag /bsgrub pa'i don phyir lhag par sngar mchod la/ /dri zhim maṇ+ḍal gsol btab sta gon gnas/ /rtse gcig dul ba'i se slo cho ri shi stems ldan ba ma rnams/ / sa gtam ma pas na tu dbugs phyung / /ku sha tshom shing phyag rgya'i mchog rnams dang / /dag pa'i chus reg gtsang byas sta gon gnas/ /ston pa rdo rje gdan dag la/ /nam gshegs zhes ni brgya byin zhus / /ku sha phul dang dbang ldan gyis/ /tshod 'dzin gzhug ces de bzhin no / /phyag na rdo rjes ston pa la/ /bilba phul dang u du dang / /a shwad twa yis tshig dbang sprul/ /phyag rgya rgya gram sku gsum 'am/ /yang na go cha'i phyag 43—1287

rgya dang / /ldan pas pho g.yas mo g.yon dpung / /de yis bdud las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bdag po sngags g.yog dam bca' ste/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ku sha brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra tsakra tra ki shā bye/ oṃ 1saṃ hūṃ a bi shin tsa a/'khor lo ral gri pad mar gyur/ /bzhad dang bsrung bas choms shing bslab/ /oṃ badz+ra ha sa pa sha tram̐ hring / tshig dbang lha mos bkra shis rgyal/ /khro bo bcu yis bsrung sgud brlab/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a mri khyeta kun da li ban dha rak+ṣa haṃ/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i go char ldan/ /'jig rten 'di 'am 'di nas gzhan/ /yod med ming nas bos nas bris/ /'phan dang nor bu gdugs ldan bya/ /cho ga ma sdogs bar du ni/ /khams gsum bdag po rnams kyirgyal la/ /gtad pa'i las rnams byas 'gyur na/ /de ni bder gshegs 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de ltar gtad pa ma byas na/ /slob dpon de yi las rnams ni/ /myur du grub par mi gyur zhes/ /thub pa'i gtso bo nyid kyis gsungs/ /bcom ldan khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi/ /mtshan nyid bdag gis bsgrubs pas na/ /thugs rje bskul lo mthu mnga' ba'i/ /rgyal bas 'di la byin gyis zlobs/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta/ tre lo ka bi dza ya sa ma ya tish+tsa badz+ra hūṃ/ g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab byang chub sems/ /spyan ras gzigs dang nam mkha'i mdzod4/ /spyong ba glang po bzhi rnams so/ /rnam rgyal las rnams ma byas na/ /sdig can de dag mi thar zhes/ /bde 5gshegs rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gdan du brlab/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra durba mo 6ga la tishra tsakra hri/ lha grangs bzhin du dbus nas dgod/ /ku sha'i steng nyal rmi ltas gdab/ /gzhad gsung tshig dbang lha mos brlab/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ha sa pa sha tram̐ hri/ mo ga la tirja hūṃ/ ngag gi nyes bzhi dag par byed/ /43—/288

bsrung ba chen po chen mos brlab/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ban+da rak+ṣa haṃ/ badz+ra ga pa tsa man dung / /lus kyi nyes gsum dag par byed/ /mchod pa yo byad bzhugs gnas rgyan / /bla re 'phan gdugs rgyal ba ngan/ /lda ldi tshon dang tshon sgud bcas//mda' dang ral gri phur bu bum/ /ci bgyi khyad par che rtags so/ /dar dang do shal dril bu rnga/ /nor bu me long spyan nyi zla/ /yon chab bdug spos me tog dri / /me bshos 'o sbrang mar bu ram/ /bza' btung bca' ba sbyar legs sogs / /gtor ma nas kyi thug pa dang / /til dang yungs kar yos 'bras dang / /'bras chen nas gro ma du ba/ /ga bur gtsang 'bob yam bud shing / /shag te'u shug te'u dgang blugs gsar/ /phur bu gtun shing zhi ba'i rdzas/ /'o ma'i thug pa zho 'bras chan/ /nas ngar mtshan til sbyar gsum dang / /nag pus pa'i bil ba'i 'bras/ /'bru rnams rnam lnga bu sbrang ser/ /sgon shing shag te'u sgron te'u dgang / /blugs gzar yam shing bud shing rdzas/ /ba dang ra lug zho dag gis/ /bsrubs ma thag gi mar sar dang / /zangs phye tsha rnams yungs kar dang / /ske tshe til dang zhim thig la/ /la phug yungs nag rdog chung dang / /skyur ba'i shing tog thams cad dang / /sbrang ma'i gtor ma skyur ba dang / /dmar po'i shing ngam tsan dan dmar/ /shag je'u tsan the'u yam bud shing / /dbang gi phyem ril bu la sogs/ /btsag dang rgya skyags gis byugs te/ /dbang gi mchod mar dgang drugs rdzas/ /sha dang rus pa khrag dang skra/ /yungs kar yungs nag ske tshe dug /dur khrod thal ba rdo phye lcags/ /ko ba btubs pa'i dum bu dang / /mgal dum seng ldeng tsher nag la/ /yam shing bud shing a ri sta/ /shag te'u tsher te'u rtsubs par bya/ /drag shul spyod 43—1289

pa'i dgang blugs rdzas/ /rnam gsum phur bu gtun shing ni/ /so so'i shing la bya ba'o/ /zlum po gru bzhi zla gam dang / /gru gsum por ni bya bar bshad/ /zhi rtse rgyas par dbang gis spoms/ /drag po drungs pa dag gi'o/ /zhi rgyas dbang grags shebazhi yi stan/ /pad+ma ku sha khri dang gsum/ /drag po sa gzhi nyid la shis/ /rgyal thabs ༄ las rnams kun gyi mchog /rnam rgyal la sogs khro bo rnams—/ /sbyin sreg kun gyi dang por bshad/ /rten yang phyogs phyogs khro bo la'o / /sbyin sreg bum rgyan ldan bzhi yum/ /dpal rtse rtse gsum mda' gzhu sogs / /kha dog chas gos g.yab dar dang / /zhal khab la sogs byang phyogs sogs/ /gzhan yang las bzhi hom shing sogs/ /sogs pa nyid du bya ba yin/ /rgyu bzang gsar las nyis 'gyur ro/ /kha dog lnga las 'brel ba yi/ /bde gshegs gtso bo sku tshad do/ /gdugs chen gser gyi yu bar ldan/ /dkyil 'khor yog pa sor bran can/ /dkar nag dmar ser le brgan dud/ /khra bo ljang ser rgyan pa'o/ /khru brgyad spangs la khru bzhi lce/ /yu ba drang po ring po la/ /btags pa brgyad ni rgyal mtshan tshul/ /kha dog so sor gcig 'dra'o/ /kha dog sna tshogs nas 'bras tshul/ /gcus gcag rtsibs su 'brel pa'o/ /dkar po dmar po de bzhin ser/ /sngon po dang ni nag dang ldan/ /tshon sna lnga po de la ni/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor gang yin bsgom/ /thig skud dkyil 'khor gang yin pa/ /yum grangs bzhin du bsgril bar bya/ /rta babs brgyad dang dri zhim shing / /chu srin khas bzung zlum sa gzugs/ /khru phyed bzhi mgo rgya mdud can/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi zur bzhi la/ /chags pa'i mtshan ma chags pa ni/ /rdo rje mda' bzhi khru do gzugs/ /thugs rje chags 43—1290

pas 'gro ba 'dren/ /mi shes rgya mo 'dral ba ni/ /mtha' gnyis gcod dang mi gnas phyir/ /khru do zur bzhi legs par bye/ /seng ldeng tsher ma can la sogs / /sor ni brgyad pa cod pan can/ /khro bo lngas bsngags bar chod sel / /bum pa nag po ra ri med/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i cho gar ldan/ /dkyil 'khor dag gi mtha' ma yang / /sngon po dmar po gang yod pa/ /mu tig me tog la sogs pa/ /bsdogs pa'i dbus na rin chen can/ /tsong tsong dag la sbyangs par bya/ /rta babs par ni tsong tsong las/ /gser dngul zangs khar sbyangs pa'i sgra/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan yod brjod/ /gtsang ma'i sbu dang a shwad shun/ /dar dkar dag dang gsum la ni/ /rnga yab dar shing gser dngul sogs/ /tsong tsong dag la sbyang bar bya/ /rin cen yid 'ong phreng ba'i tshogs/ /tsong tsong dag la sbyang bar bya/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'gro ba ma lus rang bzhin mtshon/ /gzugs brnyan chu zla'i mig rgyu zhes/ /rtogs par bya phyir sbyangs par bya/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /thugs kyi ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pas rin cen la sogs pas/ /sa gzhi snying po can du bya/ /'phan phran nyid la bskal bzangs dang / /bkra shis tsa ka lis brgyan pa/ /nyi zla pad+mas mtshon pa yang /tsong tsong dag la sbyangs pa'o/ /yon chab bdug spos dri chab bre/ /me tog mar me khal dag dang / /lha bshos khur ba lha grangs so/ /'o ma sbrang rtsi bu ram mar/ /bre re btung ba bca' ba'i tshogs/ /gtor ma'i rgyu cha sna tshogs dang / /'byung po'i kha zas sogs par bya/ /gzhan yang zhi ba'i mchod rdzas ni//til dang yungs kar 'bras yos 'bras/ /nas dang gro dang ga bur rnams/ /43—1291

phul gang yin no sran thug dang / /'bras chan ma du bre gang shis/ /gzhan yang rgyas dbang drag po yi/ /thug pa thams cad bre re'o/ /gzhan ma kun yang phul re'o/ /lha bshos khur ba lde gu rnams/ /lha grangs bzhin du sogs par bya/ /pad+ma lhor gding ku sha'i nub/ /khri ni shar gyi gru gsum byang / /las bzhi gdan ni dgod par bya/ /rnam par rgyal lam khro phyogs ho/ /spyan sogs yum bzhi lhag chad 'bum/ /dbang po zhi ba zla ba 'dra/ /dbang po rgyas pa pad+ma 'dra/ /dbang po dbang ni nyi ma 'dra/ /dbang po drag bo dud pa 'dra / /dbyig pa bgrang 'phreng spyi blugs bzung / /dang po ting 'dzin kyis bskul nas/ /bum pa zla ba pad+ma dang / /dud pa'i mdangs ldan bsil byed yum / /bdud rtsi 'o ma bu ram zho/ /bkang ba'i bum pa so so dang 3bhe/ /rin chen phan byang gdugs ldan te/ /rnam snang mdzad dang gsum dag gi/ /zhabs kyi drung du bzung ba dang / /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /las dang sdug bsngal zhi bar byed/ yī gha ga na ga ga ne+e/ lo tsa na/ dza le dzu le tsun de/ ga tang gu tang shan ting ku ru swā hā/ dpal rtse rnon po rtse gsum pos / /dug gsum 'joms pa'i las rnams mdzod/ /lus ngag yid gsum sbyang ba dang / /btab pas gshed chags rlag par byed/ /ho ma zlum lham zla gam e/ /rdo rje pad+ma mda' gzhu dang / /gtsang thod rgyan gyis mdzes rgyan snagadengs / /zhi rgyas dbang drag lha rnams mchod/ /ya ma baṃ e'i dkyil 'khor dang / /phying bu dang ni dar gtsang 'bob/ /du yod pa la zung re'o/ —/yam shing dkar ser dmar nag la/ /khung gi khyad par rang sor gcal/ /brgyad dang bcu drug nyi shu bzhi/ /bud shing khru gang do gsum chu/ /sbom phra 43—1292

sngags mkhan mdzub mo tsam/ /zhi ba yi ni lha grangs bzhin/ /yam shing mdzub gang bcag khru gang / /brkyang khru gang du shes par bya/ /bud shing khru gang do bzhi'o / /rgyas pa yis rmyeni lha grangs bzhin/ /dbang gi yam bud zhi ba'i tshad/ /drag po'i yam bud rgyas pa'i tshad/ /zhi ba'i dris bsku rgyas sbrang rtsi/ /dbang tsag tsan dan bsres pas bsku/ /drag po khrag spos bsres pas bsku/ /zho can ser skyur rtsub shing la/ /sor bzhi ya rtse ral gri bzhin/ /rting zlum zur bzhi zor 'dra dang / /zur gsum ju thur tshad du bya/ /lo ma sor bzhi so so shing / /sor gnyis rtsa ba bshus lha grangs/ /thabs 3kyi bye brag che chung las/ /zho can ser sgyur rtsub shing la/ /yu ba sboms su mthe bo tsam/ /srid du khru do gang phyed gang / /sor bzhi sgyu kha ran sor cig —sna /zab sor gnyis la so so'i dbyebs//de dbus gtso mo phyag mtshan bri/ /kha ran phyogs bzhir phyag rgya bzhag /bar bar rdo rje pad+ma gzhu/ /thod pas mtshan ma dgang gzar bya/ /srid khru gang la sgyu sor gnyis/ /zabs sor gcig de'i dbus su ni/ /gtso bo phyag rgyas mtshan blugs gzar/ /blugs gzar steng sbub mdun du bzhag /zho can ser sgyur rtsub shing la/ /mgo mdud dag la gtso yum dgod/ /rtsibs la 'khor gyi yig 'bru dgod/ /rked mdud sgo ba khru khyud gang / /rtse mo ya ma baṃ e phaṭa/ /gtso bo phyag mtshan spyir bris te/ /rtsibs la chos kyi yig 'bru 'bar/ /khru gang tshad bya srid du'o/ /sbom phra mtho gang sor bzhi bya/ /sgyur sor bco brgyad zabs su ni/ /sor ni brgyad pa de dbus su/ /ri rab rgya mtsho bri bar bya / /ngos la ri bdun mtsho yang dgod/ /so so gtun kyi khar na la/ /rdo rje pad+ma mda' gzhu me 'od 'bar/ /thod rtsad me 'od 'bar gling mtsho/ /ji 43—1293

bzhin dkyil 'khor dag la'ang brgyan/ las bzhi sngags pa'i chas gos rgo/ /thugs kyi ze'u lding stod g.yogs dang / /brjid pa'i chos gos smad dkris dang //gar gyi gsang gos so so mdog /g.yab mos spyan 'dren phyag 'tshal ni/ /so so kha dog dar dag la/ /ba dan bzhi yang 'bar 'drar bya/ /dkar po ser po dmar nag la/ /ho ma'i bgab ma 'khor ba'o/ /dri zhim ser skyur rtsub shing gi/ /sa phyogs de dag nye ba ru/ /shing gi lha ste mdog dkar la/ /rin chen 7sna tshogs dri zhim bcas/ /phul la snying rje byams bsgoms la/ /rten 'byel brjod de rin phul la/ /me yi phyogs nas bcang bar bya/ /srid du ho ma grur mnyam la/ /spom phra khru gang yod pa'i shing / /gzhi zhe gnyis gsum gnyis mchog du ces —/ /gzhan yang ro bsreg shing dag la/ /sbom phra khru do yod pa yi/ /shar nub gnyis su re re yang / /srid du mchod rnam yang na ni/ /dngos grub gsol sgo gzhan shing gnyis/ /shing rgyu phra sbom mdo dang gsum/ /theg pa'i khyad par bstan pa ni/ /kri yog ma ha yo ga gsum/ /gang gi sgo zhugs de lhas sbyang / /goms pa'i dbang du shes pa'i mchog /rim pa gsum du shes par bya/ /de steng khang pa lus mgo tshang / /phrag gnon gzhi 4yang bzhir dmigs la/ /tshogs nas shing gi bdag po la/ /mchod pa gtor ma sna tshogs ni/ /stegs bu khru gang pad+ma bris/ /de dbus shing lha 'bag bris bzhag /las kyi skal ldan gang dag gis/ /dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa ni/ /yo byad thams cad tshang ba mchog /che chung mang nyung rgyu las tshad/ /ci yod yid 'ong mdzes par dgram/ /de dag byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ /khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal dang / /bdud rtsi 'khyil pas byin gyis brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra kro 43—1294

dha tri lo ka /bi dza ya/ ā+oṃ i hūṃ a a a/ bla re gtsug tor rnam rgyal brlab//ā+oṃ hūṃ ā+oṃ i hūṃ/ ba dan 'phan gtso des byin brlab/ /ā+oṃ tso bo'i sa bon oṃ i hūṃ / gdugs ni gtsug tor gdugs dkar brlab/ /yī thru ā+oṃ i hūṃ/ rgyal mtshan ke du des byin brlab/ /ā+oṃ rat+na ke du ā+oṃ i hūṃ/ lda ldi so so las rigs brlab / /ā+oṃ sarba karma tri lo ka bi dza ya oṃ i hūṃ/ tshon lnga bde gshegs lnga yis brlab/ /de yang dkyil 'khor gang yin nyid/ /ser po oṃ oṃ i hūṃ/bsgyur te smon lam btab par bya/ /dkar po ā+oṃ hūṃ oṃ saṃ hūṃ/ nag po oṃ swa ā+oṃ i hūṃ/ dmar po oṃ oṃ oṃ i hūṃ ljang gu o ha oṃ saṃ hūṃ/ srad bu gang yin gtso bos brlab/ /oṃ oṃ oṃ i hūṃ/ rta bas phyag rgya bzhi byin brlab/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ā+oṃ māṃ hūṃ/ mda' bzhi rdo rje chags pas brlab/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra rag ā+oṃ saṃ lkuhūṃ/ /ral gri rdo rje rnon pos brlab/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma tig sna oṃ i hūṃ/ phur pa khro bo lngas byin brlab/ /ā+oṃ a pa ra tsi ta/ ya man+ta ka /ha ya gri ba/ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ma ha pa la/ ā+oṃ a hūṃ/ bum pa gang yin yum gyis brlab/ /ā+oṃ da du shwa ri oṃ saṃ hūṃ/ bgab 'khor bsrung ba chen mos brlab/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ a pra ti ha ta/ā+oṃ saṃ hūṃ swā hā/ do shal gtsug tor rgyal bas brlab/ /oṃ hūṃ oṃ i hūṃ/ dril bu ku lan da ris brlab/ /ā+oṃ ku lan da ri prad nyo pa ba pa sho yo gā gā shu khya ā+oṃ saṃ hūṃ/ rnga yab rgyal po bzhis byin brlab/ /ā+oṃ tishra tishra/ be+e bu ru ta ka /be+e ru ba shā/ ba sha ra ma ne+e/ ā+oṃ e hūṃ/ nor bu kun gyi yon tan brlab/ /ā+oṃ sarba rat+na ku oṃ e hūṃ/ me long rdo rje sems dpas brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra swa ta a da ri sha ā+oṃ saṃ hūṃ/ spyan snying sangs rgyas kun gyis brlab/ /yī bhu dha sarba ku li tsi ta snyo na ā+oṃ i hūṃ/ nyi zla thabs dang shes rab brlab/ /ā+oṃ srur+ya tsan+d+ra du na 43—1295

prad nya oṃ saṃ hūṃ/ btung ba mā ma kis byin brlab/ /ā+oṃ rat+na badz+ra ā+oṃ saṃ hūṃ/bdug pa me tog dri chu me/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra dhu be+e puṣ+pe gadhe a lo ge ā+oṃ i 1hūṃ/ lha bshos khur ba bca' ba'i tshogs/ /ku lan da ris byin gyis brlab/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ku lan da ri ā+oṃ i hūṃ/ phung po lnga nyid rnam grol lngar bsgyur zhing / /ā+oṃ kan da shu dz+nya na ā+oṃ e hūṃ/ /'o ma la sogs mngar gsum ni/ /mā ma kis ni byin gyis brlab/ /ā+oṃ mā ma ki oṃ saṃ hūṃ/ /gtor ma thug pa drags ldan brlab/ /ā+oṃ swa ste badz+ra ā+oṃ i 2hūṃ/ 'bru rnams mā ma kis byin brlab/ /ā+oṃ mā ma ki yī i /dh+ri / /'bras yos ma du gos dkar mos brlab/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma badz+ra yī saṃ hūṃ/ ga bur sman rnams las thams cad pa/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ā+oṃ e hūṃ/gtsang 'bob sangs rgyas spyan gyis brlab/ ā+oṃ lam te shwa ra ti da du ā+oṃ e hūṃ/ /yam shing bud shing thams cad ni/ /me lhas byin gyis brlab par bya/ /ā+oṃ asne ye yī saṃ hūṃ/ shag te'u shug te'u tshan te'u sogs/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyis byin gyis brlab/ /ā+oṃ sum̐ badz+ra ā+oṃ e hūṃ/ /zangs phye ske tshe la la phud/ kro ti shwa ri sangs rgyas spyan gyis brlab/ kro ti shwa ri swa ta badz+re/ ā+oṃ i dh+ri4/tsher te'u la sogs mā ma kis/ /ā+oṃ mā ma ki ā+oṃ i hūṃ/ /dgang gzar gang yin yum gyis brlab/ /blugs gzar gang yin yab kyis brlab/ /phur bu gang yin gtso 'khor khro/ /gtun shing gang yin gtso bo 'khor/ /mda' gzhu ma mo tse'u ris brlab/ /badz+ra tse'u ri ā+oṃ i 5hūṃ/ /gzhan rnams thams cad bdud rtsi 'khyil pas brlab/ /g.yab dar rlung lhas byin gyis brlab/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ba ya bya ā+oṃ i zhwahūṃ/ zhal khab mā ma kis byin brlab/ /bsregs shing brum gyis brlab par bya/ /ā+oṃ bye e baṃ ma ya sbyar/ /ā+oṃ i 7hūṃ/ chas gos 'bru lngas byin 43—1296

brlab bzhag /ku sha gting ba'i gdan stengs su/ /sngags g.yog shar ltas nyal du gzhug /lha rnams kyis ni legs dgu ston/ /byin gyis brlab pa ma byas na/ /las rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bas nan tan bskyed de bya/yang na rnam par rgyal ba 'am/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa nyid kyis brlab kyang rung / /dkyil 'khor ci yang bzhengs pa la/ /'phrin las bzhi bzhi hom ldan bya/ /yang na ting 'dzin bye brag las/ /las bzhi cho ga rdzogs pa mchog /cho ga ma tshang las mi 'grub/ /de phyir sta gon rdzogs par bya/ /u dusbra ra'i me tog bzhin—/ /ston pa 'o ni shin tu yang / /de bas na ni 'jig rten du/ /'byung ba yang ni shin tu dkon/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ston pa dka'/ /dam chos ston pa srid par dka'/ /gsang sngags chos ni ston dka'o/ /gsang sngags chos ni ston dka' yang / /dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug dka'o/ /bskal par ni sngags spyad pa yi/ /las dbang gis ding mthong bas/ /rgyal po ni ma yin yang / /rgyal po ni chen por 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis / /yon tan ni mchog kyang thob/ /tshe ring ni longs spyod kyang / /phun sum ni tshogs par 'gyur/ /las rnams ni thams cad kyang / btang snyoms ni yan lag go/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i lus 1dag dang / /cho 'phrul bzhi yi che ba dang / /gang zhig dkyil 'khor nang gzhug pa/ /gsum po de ni gzhan don gsungs/ /dang po las gsungs rim pa ni/ /tshes grangs chos glog bzhi dag dang / /srad bu tshad ldan bgegs bsal bsrung / /thugs dam bskul g.yog dbang bskur sbyang / /rang bzhin sa thig slar bsdu dang / /tshon dgye phyag rgya rgyan rnams dgod/ /gsum lnga bdun dang bcu gcig dang / bcu 43—1297

gsum bco lnga yar gyis shis/ /zhi dang rgyas pa mchog tu bshad/ /bcu bdun nyi shu gnyis brgyad de/ /dbang dang drag po dkyil 'khor mchog /dus dang mtshan ma kri ya'o/ /nyi ma dge zhing rgyu skar 17bzang / /mtshan ma'i sems rtog mi dmigs pa/ /de ni chos dbyings gnas pa yin/ /de ltar dus dang mthun pa dang / /phyogs bzhi'i dge bsnyen gtsang sbra can/ /sha dang chang bcad bud med spangs/ /tshul du shis pas rgyun mi bcad/ /shar du sdud pa tshigs su bcad / /lhor ni bzang po spyod pa'o/ /nub du snang brgyad gsang ba'i mdo/ /byang du gser 'od dam pa gdon/ /gus par mchod cing bden par klag /tshon sna lnga skud bu mos bkal/ /de nyid kyis ni brgyar bzlas te/ /rgyu bzangs tshad la phebs pa dang / /bzang po'i ltas dang sbyar nas ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig gdab bo/ /lag na rdo rjes bgegs bskrad bya/ /srung ba chen mos bdag gzhan bsrung / /phyogs bcu'i gtso la sogs pa yi/ /thugs dam bskul nas srad bu thim/ /de lnga'i rigs bzhi thugs las phyung / /gtso bo gang yin thugs zhugs phyung / /de nas gtso bo gang yin kyis/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams sbyang ba dang / myur du sems can don bsgrub dang / /las kyi bdag po gang byed pa'i/ /las rnams ma lus khyod kyis byos/ /las kyi rdo rje don yod grub/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'byung ba las/ /oṃ saṃ hūṃ/ swā hā karma zhes ni de la dbang bsgur ro/ /bdag nyid shar lho mtshams 'greng ste/ /sngags g.yog byang shar mtshams su ni/ /dpung btsugs thal sbyar 'dug pa yis//dkyil 'khor gang bzhengs las rnams ni/ /gang bzhengs gtso bo bka' bzhin du / /las kyi byed par bdag gyur pas/ /thams cad ma lus bdag gis 43—1298

bgyi / /de nas thub dbang bskur byas nas/ /de nas sbyang bar bya ba ni/ /bdag po gang yin ting 'dzin las/ /yam gyis phrag dog gtor rlung gis/ /de las rdo rje rtse 'bar ba/ /'od 'phros dngos po'i mtshan ma bsreg /bdag nyid yi ge khaṃ gyur gtso/ /mnga' bdag de'i byin brlabs chu/ /rgyun gyi khams dag de nyid mer/ de yi byin brlabs yon tan bcu/ /de mthus las byed las rnams 'grub/ /mkhas pas thig gdab tsa ta'i mig /lha mos gshegs bskul skud la thim/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lngar gyur/ /lte ba'i thad kar thal bkan la/ /g.yas pa bkan bzhag mtheb ngos sbyar/ /de nas sbub log nam mkhar gdab/ /lan cig gnyis gsum btab pa'i mthus/ /rang bzhin byon dang ting 'dzin gsal/ /ngan song gsum bde zhus bshad stong / /mchog gsum lha tshogs mchod phyag 'tshal/ /ā+oṃ bye shu n+ya ta gnya' na badz+ra swa bha ba at+ma ko haṃ/ zhes pas rang bzhin thig gdab par bya/ /bdag nyid shar lho'i mtshams song ste/ /las bdag byang shar mtshams 'dug ste/ /de nas dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa/ /dam tshig bskul dang las bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ tshad ldan sngags g.yog med phur mchog /sems can don byas bdag nyid kyis/ /slar yang thugs kar bsdu bar bya/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sang ha ra na hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ni/ /yon tan 'phrin las rigs lnga yi/ /gtso bo gang yin de nyid la/ /gsang gsum zhes su bsgrags pa'ang mchog /mtshon ni dri dang pan tsa dang / /rin chen phung po gsum du bstan / /yon tan sku 'dra las thugs bzhin/ /dbus kyi pho brang bskor ba yin / /'khor lo rdo rje ra ba ni/ /phye ma dkar po nyis rim bri/ /las kyi lha 43—1299

las ma gtogs pa'i/ /phal pa dang ni bsrung bkra shis/ /phye ma dkar po zhig kyang bri/ /sgo yi tshon sna pan tsa'o/ /gnyis pa tri la sgo khang rtsig /brkyang dz+res phyag rgya dgod pa yang / /gtso bo'i gzugs la 'khor phyag rgya/ /phal la sogs pa'i yig 'bru'o/ /tha mal pa dag thig le'o/ /tshon la sogs pa'i las rnams kun/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas bya bar shis/ /dbang ldan 'dren pa'i lha dbang phyogs/ /tshon ni nang nas dgye bar bya/ /de nas phyag rgya nor bu bum / /dgod pa nyid du bya ba yin/ gzungs thag slob dpon gzung bar shis / /de 'og tshon rnams rim gyis btang / /de nas phyag rgya 'am yig 'bru bzhag /tha mar bsgo yi tshon bkye nas/ /de'i 'og sgo ba'i phyag rgya dang / /glang ser rnams kyang dgod par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal thams cad byi dor ni/ /dang po ba lci de 'og tu/ /rnam lngas bskus nas de 'og du/ /dri chu'i chus ni byug par bya / /tshon 'gyed dus su thugs dam bskul/ /sems can khams ni zhi byed pa'i / /de ni chos dbyings ro yin pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sngon gsungs te/ /de bas bdag gis bka' bzhin du/ /tshon 'gyed pa yi las bgyid na/ /rgyal bas kun byin dbang bskur cig /phyag rgya dgod phyir thugs dam bskul/ /sgu gsung thugs rtags mtshan ma 'di/ /'gro la phan phyir dgod do zhes/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sngon gsungs te/ /rgyal ba kun byin dbang bskur cig /rgyan rnams dang po nor bu ste/ /de la sogs pa dgod par bya/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i rin po ches/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /sngags rnams gong ma de las ni/ /ti sh+ya badz+ra bsnan par bas / /rin chen sna tshogs rgyu las byas/ /kha dog dbyibs su ldan pa yi/ /43—1300

shes rab yum gyi bum pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /rten gyis 'bras bu mtshon 'brel rtags/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin pas/ /thugs rjes lkugazungs thag chen po 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs / /'phrin las yon tan lhun grub pa'i/ /bla re kun bzang dang nyid rtags—/ /'bras bu rtags kyi phyag rgya yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs / /dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i/ /sku yi phyag rgya mtshon mdzad cing / /mtshan dang dpe byad phan chen kyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs / /nyon mongs gdung ba sel mdzad cing / /gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu bar ldan/ /skyabs chen byams pa chen po yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin kyis rlobs/ /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan te/ /rtags kyi rgyal mtshan chen po yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byen gyis rlobs/ /'phrin las cho 'phrul bzhi bzhi yis/ /las rnams rgya mtsho sdogs mdzad pa'i/ /snyan pa'i ba dan gsung bsgoms pas/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 'byel ba'i rtags/ /kha dog sna lnga 'bar ba yi/ /lhab lhub lda ldi chen po yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis zlobs/ /thugs rje gzungs thag ye shes bzhi/ /sangs rgyas bzhi yi 'phrin las thugs/ /thugs rje'i srad bu 'brel gzungs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /tshad med bzhi dang bsnyu ba bzhis/ /'gro ba'i don rnams rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /dri zhim rta babs phyag rgya yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro rmongs 'khyams pa'i mun sel mdzad/ /gti mug go dbral shes rab mdas/ /gting 'bugs byang chub lam 'god pas/ /43—1301

dkyil 'khor 'di la byin kyis rlobs/ /'khor ba'i dra ba chags pa'i rgyun/ /mtha' gnyis gcod mdzad byams pa'i mgon/ /shes rab rtags kyi ral gri 'dis / /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /khro gtum rngam pa'i tshul 'chang bas/ /log par lta ba'i zhe sdang 'dul/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i ki la yas//dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan ma'i yul rnams sel mdzad cing //bsrung dang mtshams kyi las mdzad pa/ /bgab 'khor srung ba chen po 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i/ /dpe byad rtags kyi do shal chun/ /yid 'ong me tog 'bar ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin kyis rlobs/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i rtags/ /rin chen mchog gsum mtshan brjod pa'i/ /gsung dbyangs drug cu ldan gril 'dis//dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan ma'i bag chags kun sel ba'i/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rgyal chen bzhis phul mchod mchog gis//dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan 'dra ba yi/ /rang bzhin dag pas rtog pa med/ /ma rmongs ston pa'i me long 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis zlobs/ /zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas shing / /'jig rten kun dang mthun 'jug rtags/ /thabs dang shes rab nyi zla 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rgyan 'os dang / /lha bshos phyogs kyi gtor ma yis/ /rgyu drug 'gro tshim byed mthu yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis brlobs1/ /gnyis pa bdag zhugs cho 'phrul kyi/ /che ba'i don thabs bstan pas 'dzin/ /ting nge 'dzin dang byin gyis rlabs / /dbang bskur mchod pa'i cho 'phrul lo/ /bdag nyid dang por rnam 'dug dang / /43—1302

ting 'dzin zhugs pa rnam gnyis so/ /bdag shar sgor 'dug 'dzin pa la/ /dam bca' dbang thob snying rje yis/ /thabs dang shes rab don byed par/ /'phags pa kun mkhyen spyan drangs la/ /ā+oṃ e hūṃ swā hā lnga yis/ /byin gyis brlab la swa dbang bskur/ /phyag rgya go ca ho 1gyis bgo/ /du sh+ya ho dang san ti ti shā dang / ya tha badz+ra swa ta shra ta saṃ baṃ/ dgongs pas bsgrubs pa bzhugs dang bskyed/ /de nas khro bos bgegs mtshams bcad/ /zhugs pas de bzhin nyid kun snang / /rgyu las byung ba rim lnga bskyed/ /de steng gzhal yas khang rgyan ldan/ /nang du gtan dag bskyed pa'i steng / /'khor lo yid 'ong gru chad dang / /sgo dang sgo khang bya dang bcas/ /sems can pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan—/ /ci rigs par ni mdzes par bya/ /de steng sems nyid dag pa yi/ /rgyu las chos nyid mngon byang chub/ /de gzugs zla ba yig 'bru dang / /phyag mtshan dang ni sku rdzogs pa'o/ /'bras bu lnga dang bskyed pa lnga/ /ston pa'i cho 'phrul lnga rgyu lnga/ /chos nyid rgyu las rnam snang mngon byang chub/ /gzugs brnyan zla ba mi bskyod mngon byang chub/ /yig 'bru rin chen 'byung ldan mngon byang chub/ /phyag mtshan snang ba mtha' yas mngon byang chub/ /gzugs sku don yod grub pa mngon byang chub/ /snang stong sra brtan sreg byed dang / /'gyes 'dzin shugs bskyod zad par lnga/ /nam mkha' sa me chu rlung gi/ /de yi byin rlabs thams cad mngon byang chub/ /rgyu las bag chags gnas 'gyur chos dbyings bskyed/ /zla ba kun gzhi gnas 'gyur me long bskyed/ /yig 'bru nyon mongs gnas gyur mnyam sems bskyed/ /phyag mtshan yid gyur so sor rtogs sems bskyed/ /sku ni sgo lnga bya ba nan tan bskyed/ /rtag chad 'dzin 43—1303

gzung bdag gzhan grub/ /chos nyid rgyu las rnam snang mngon bstan pa/ /bsam gtan tshul de sangs rgyas rjes dran sku/ /ā+oṃ tsi ta pra ti pe tang ka ro ya mi/e ma'o/ /don dam rang bzhin spros med sems kyi dbyings/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dang ye nas mnyam/ /mngon par byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de / /chos kyi dbyings nyid mi gnas ji bzhin dang / /gzugs brnyan zla ba mi bskyod mngon ston pas/ /ye shes tshul de dge 'dun rjes dran sku/ /ā+oṃ po te tsi ta tsan+t+ra ut+pa ta ya mi/ e ma'o/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen yongs rdzogs pa/ /zla ba nya ba bzhin du snang ba ste/ /kun tu bzang po ye nas dag pa'i don/ /mngon par byang chub rang bzhin 'od kyang gsal/ /yig 'bru rin chen 'byung ldan mngon bstan pa/ /sbyin pa'i tshul de gtong ba rjes dran sku/ /yī hūṃ swa ha saṃ ha tirja/ e ma'o/ /ma rig sel cing yang dag rig bskyed pa/ /gsung gi rang bzhin che ba'i byin rlabs te/ /gsang ba bsgrub pa'i mchog du bsngags pas na/ /don gyi snying po spros med byang chub dbyings/ /phyag mtshan so so mtha' yas mngon bstan pa/ /tshul khrims tshul te gnyis rtogs chos dran sku/ /tsakra badz+ra dharma rat+na pad+ma karma swa bha ba at+ma ko haṃ/ e ma'o / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs nyid ye shes lnga yi rtags su snang / /mi g.yo mi ldog mchog gi rang bzhin pas/ /ji bzhin mnyam pas byang chub chen po'i ngang / /skur gyur gzugs las don yod skur ston pa/ /brtson 'grus tshul te lha rjes dran pa'i sku/ /ā+oṃ hūṃ swa e ha ya tha swa teshra ta a haṃ/ e ma'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /ma skyes ye shes mnyam pa nyid/ /thabs la mkhas pas thugs rje yis/ /de nyid phyag rgya 43—1304

chen por snang / /sngags ni sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs/ /tshigs bcad don grub rtogs tshad phul/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /dgyes pa'i phyag ni spyi bor bzhag /byin gyis brlabs phyir ā+oṃ i hūṃ/ /dbang bskur swa 'bar rin po che/ /yongs su grub dang gzhan dbang dang / /kun brtags pa ni thams cad la'o/ /yongs su grub pa zhes pa ni/ /rnam snang mdzad chen de nyid do/ /gzhan dbang rjes su bstan pa ni/ /sangs rgyas mang pos sngags gsungs rtogs/ /kun brtags zhes su bstan pa ni/ /'og min gnas dang ri rab zom/ /rdo rje gdan sogs ston pa'o/ /'khor rnams thams cad sgo mdun bskyed/ /'bras bu lnga ni yongs su grub/ /bskyed pa gzhan dbang yin par bshad/ /ston pa'i cho 'phrul kun brtags pa'o/ /snyan gsan gsol spyan 'dren las gzhug /dam tshig phyag 'tshal mchod stod chos/ /byang chub sdom go byin rlabs dang / /mtshams bcad dam tshig dpog rigs bya/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na/ /rgyal ba gang bzhugs 'khor dang bcas / /mgon po dam can ji snyed pa/ /thams cad kun nas dgongs su gsol / /gnyis med rnam dag dbyings mchog na/ /mnyam nyid gnas pas de bzhin gshegs/ /bskul pa'i sa la gzhengs nas kyang / /sems can don la rab brtson pa'i/ /rgyal ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /byang chub sems dpa' be+em dral dang / khro bo khro mo la sogs kun/ /rgyud lnga'i sems can sbyang ba dang / /khyad par bdag dang yon bdag dang / /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin brlabs don/ /rang bzhin rdzogs chen bzhugs gnas nas/ /ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan gzhal yas 'dir/ /thugs rjes byon dgongs spyan 43—1305

'dren byon/ /e ha h+ye bhudha da du shā rī bod di swa ta swa ta'i sarba ma ma dzā/chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil yangs na/ /rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas khyad par can / /rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin klubs shing / /nyi zla pad sogs gdan steng nas/ /mi mjed 'dzam gling 'jig rten 'dir/ /bkra shis dpal tshogs gzhal yas khang / /bla med mchod pa rgyan bshams nas/ /'gro ba'i don phyir spyan 'dren na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i 'jig rten sgron/ /thugs rje dam can smon lam gyis/ /sems can don phyir chos sku las/ /gzugs skur longs spyod rdzogs skur snang / /thugs rjes sprul skur gshegs pa bzhin / /dkyil 'khor ma nyams dam pa 'dir/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis gshegs su gsol/ /dkyil 'khor gang lags lha tshogs kun/ /tshoms tshoms mtshams bsdebs spyan drang la/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang mi yi seng ger spyon/ /gti mug mun sel 'jig rten sgron ma spyon/ /nyon mongs nad sel sman pa'i rgyal po spyon/ /bdud ris 'pham mdzad thar pa'i lam ton 1snaspyon/ /dbang mdzad rgyal po 'dir spyon mchod pa bzhes/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus gnas 'dir spyon/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag spyan 'dren brtan pa'i bdag /gang phyir bdag gis spyan drangs pas/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la brtan par 'gyur/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rin chen zhags pa dam po'i bdag /rdul phran bzhugs pa thams cad kyang / /slar yang bdag gis dran par bgyi/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /pad+ma lcags sgrog 2dam po'i bdag /bcings pa kun las grol ba rnams/ /sems can don du bcing bar 'dod/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rgya gram 43—/306

dril bu dbab brtan bdag /kun kyi chos bdag gyur pa yang / /bran du yang ni gyur cing bzhugs/ /dza hūṃ ba 'u/ho/ e bye hi ba ga ban ma ha kā ru ni ka tri sha ho/ sa ma ya dza hūṃ/ oṃ la sogs pa'i lha rnams sngags/ /rting la a gad dzas brgyan cing / /so so sku gsung thugs kyi lha/ /ma lus pa rnams sbyan drang ngo / /mdor na 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir / /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje rin chen —pad+mo dang / /rgya gram 'khor los bskor du gsol/ /mgon po thugs rje cher ldan pa/ /thams cad kun rngo mkhyen rgyud rig pa/ /'dul ba'i thabs ni sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i don rnams mdzad du gsol/ /gtor ma las rnams kun kyi mchog /las kyi sna la brtan pa ni/ /shar du bstan pa srung ba la/ /lhor ni srid pa mnyam pa yin/ /nub du klu gdug bzlog pa'o/ /byang nas las la gzhug pa'o/ /de dag so so srung mtshams bcad/ /e ha nyi bos la las la gzhug /byin gyes brlabs byas mchod bstod cing / /smon lam btab cing slar ting gtang / /lag pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas ni/ /snying po mjug la gdags pa ni/ /badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya karma gdags shing dbyangs dang sbyar ba'o/ /thugs brtser ldan pa'i dgongs pa can/ /ji ltar 'phrin las bcol ba bzhin/ /'khor ba yul rings de srid du/ /don rnams mdzad cing brtan por bzhugs/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas ni/ /snying po mjug la gdags pa ni/ /dzā hūṃ bam̐ ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwa tishra badz+ra a gad dza/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta brnya nad ka ro ya mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu tsa pashra/ na ya at+ma rgo nir+ya ta ya mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a ti tirja swa rmi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga 43—1307

ta pu tsa a bi she ka ya/ at+ma rna nir+ya ta ya mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bi shin tsa rmi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu tsa pra brta na ya/ at+ma rna nir+ya ta ya mi/o sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra darma pra brta ya mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu tsa karma ni/at+ma rna nir+ya ta ya mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru me/ de nas mchod pa'i rim pa ni/ /dang por sbyin sreg las bzhi ste/ /de nas lhag pa'i mchod skyabs gsol/ /de nas thun mong mchod rnam lnga/ /de nas stod pa'i mchod pa'o / /de nas mchod sprin bya bar bshad/ /de kun ngag yid gdung dbyangs mchod/ /mchod pa'i dang po 'di yin no/ /de 'og rdzas kyi mchod pa la / /sbyin sreg mchod sbyin rnams kyi mchog /bsdebs sbyar mchog ni nyi ma'i lha / /mi yi mchog ni rgyal po ste/ /rgya mtsho chu bo rnams kyi mchog /zla ba rgyu skar rnams kyi mchog /nyi ma snang byed rnams kyi gtso/ /bsgrub pa'i mchog ni gsang sngags te/ /las kyi mchog ni rnam bzhi'o/ /gnas kyi mchog ni dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /steng dang 'og dang thad kar yang / /'gro ba'i 'gro ba ji snyed pa / /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /smra ba'i mchog ni rdzogs sangs rgyas / /bstan pa'i mchog ni rdzogs chen po/ /rdo rje'i rgyud du bsngags pa yin / /bzlas nga/ bdun dang bar skabs dang / /de bzhin bzlas pa'i 'og tu yang / /bsngags pas sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ /thams cad du yang bsngags pa yin / /sbyin sreg byas nas bzlas bya ba/ /dang por shin tu 'dod pa yin/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg 'brel ba 'di/ /de ni bar du 'dod pa yin /bzlas pa'i 'jug 1gi sbyin sreg gang / /de ni shin tu gtso bar bshad/ /dang pos bu lon rtog pa bsal/ /bar du lha rnams tshim bya'i phyir/ /tha mas lhag chad 43—1308

bskang ba'i don/ /baṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tsher ba la/ /dang byams yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /las rnams brtsam par byas nas ni/ /gtum chen rngam yang lhan ne+er 'gyur/ /lha rnams dkar po byams dang ldan/ /zlum po dkyil 'khor rtsibs brgyad par/ /lha rnams 'khor bcas brgyan par bzhugs/ /ho ma mchog zlum gdongs pa la /rdo rje pad+mas rab brgyan te/ /phur pa dkar po drug gdab par/ /yid la shin tu gsal byas te/ /byin za dge ba'i ram sbar bstan/ /yi shing dkar po rnams kyi me/ /ram̐ spar rdo rje khro bo yis/ /dang byams bzhag ste snyoms zhugs la/ /til bsregs bzhin du sdig sregs shig /oṃ che ge mo sarba pā pa da ha ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ dz+wa la ram̐/ shar lho kha khyer de nyid la/ /dam tshig nyid kyi re spros te/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi zla dkar bzhin/ /zhi ba lus dang lta ba'i thabs/ /skyed chen dkar po'i gdan bzhugs bsam/ /ye shes asne thugs dam bskul/ /oṃ na mo badz+ra pa ne+e gya/ oṃ na mo gnya' na gya twa asne ye de ba dz+wa la ram̐/ /lan gsum brjod pas zhal phyogs shing / /spyan gzigs thugs dgongs de nyid la/ /dam tshig pa yis lcags kyu bcas/ /gnyis min dbyings las bskul ba yi/ /ye shes drang srong chen po nyid/ /sngon gyi smon lam thugs rje yis/ /byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dzā hūṃ baṃ ho/a ha hi/ oṃ badz+ra ha ri baṃ ga ba dzi ba lo ki te ya sha de hi/ de ba ba ta ya swā hā/na mo badz+ra pa na gye/ oṃ gnya' na asne/ ki li ki li/ dedhe 1la po tra/ i ha i ha/ ā gad dzā hūṃ ta sha na ya swā hā/ ye shes me lha byon nas ni/ /dam tshig bskyed dang gcig gyur nas/ /mdun du bzhugs pa de nyid la/ /gnyis 43—1309

min drang srong asne la/ /bdug spos chur bcas gtsang ba ni/ /stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /spos lnga sna sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i khrus/ /ye shes sprin phung mkha' las char 'bebs pa/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs kun dag gyur cig /swa bhā ba sarba dharma shurnyo haṃ/ dag pa nyid du byas nas kyang / /mchod pa lnga yis mchod de bzhag /gnyis min drang srong asne la/ /bdug spos me tog me dri bshos/ /yon bdag don du 'bul lags na/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ dzha na satwa sa ma ya/ satwa sa ma ne+e ye dhu pe puṣ+pe / a lo ke/ nan gan de ba ha ra sarba dharma pu tsa ban tsa swā hā/ de nas mchod snod shing rta la/ /bzhugs pa nyid du bya ba 'am/ /kha khyer bzhag la las mchod bstod/ /de nas me yi dngos nyid pa'i/ /rang bzhin rnam rgyal khro bo phyogs/ /de la sogs pa gong nyid du/ /spyan drangs mdun du gsal bsgoms la/ /ting 'dzin gsal ba'i me nyid sbyang / /rnam par rgyal ba bos nas ni/ /gzugs brnyan shar g.yas 'am 'phral ba'i/ /rnam rgyal de yi lus gnyis gcig /de nyid na ni bzhugs bsam pa/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis / /tshur gshegs khams gsum rnam rgyal gtso/ /'bar ba'i nang du bzhugs nas ni/ /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes me sbyongs/ /dza hūṃ kri snasnaho/e bye hi/ oṃ tre lokya bhi dza ya sa ma ti mu tra hūṃ phaṭa a gad dza/ de ltar spyan drangs de nyid kyis/ /gdan mchog dam pa bstan pa ni/ /me tog lag du thogs nas ni/ /mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje'i ngang / /nyon mongs mi spong gos pa med/ /ma chags rang bzhin dag pas na/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma sa ma ya haṃ/ de ltar gdan la bzhugs pa yang yang 43—1310

dag nyid ni dag mod kyi/ /dri ma'i mtshan ma med mod kyang / /'jig rten sri zhu'i tshul kyis su/ /phyag dang zhabs ni bsil mdzod cig /a ha ra bi shubye swa bhā wa/ de nas mchod pa dbul ba ni/ /khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyis/ /che ge mo zhig sdig gshegs nas/ /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur te/ /yang dag nyid du bsgrub pa la/ /bar chad byed pa'i log rtog ni/ /gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong la sogs/ /chad pa bcad cing bka' phab ste/ /bka' 'am sngags kyi tshig tsam gyis/ /zhi ba la sogs rnam bzhi ni/ /bran bzhin du ni byed par 'gyur/ /de phyir dang por khro bo mchod/ /de phyir rnam par rgyal sogs la/ /mar khu shag te'u shu gu 'di/ /yon bdag don du 'bul lags na/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /snying ga'i thad ka nas 'bul bar bya/ /oṃ tre lokya r+bha dza ya kro dha ya ti bya ti bya na pu tsa na ye swā hā/ lag g.yas mtheb srin nyi ma a/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis//blangs te sku gsung thugs mnyes phyir/ /mchod pa'i gnas dang mchod rdzas dang //mchod mkhan nyid las byang chub sems/ /dkar po shel dag byung ba yis /gang la dmigs pa der bstim pas/ /las dang nyon mongs bag chags zhi/ /khro rgyal khams gsum rnam rgyal la/ /mngar gsum 'o thug nas kyi thug /'bras kyi lag pan 'bras yos dang / /'bru sna lnga la sogs pa 'bul/ /bdug spos me tog me dri bshog /oṃ tre lokya bhe dza ya kro dha ya/ du be puspa/a lo ke gan de/ a ha ra/ sarba dharma da ra pu tsa pan tsa swā hā/ ti bya ti bya ye swā hā/ de nas stod de mchod pa ni/ /rdo rje dril bu dbyangs ldan la/ /sku yi'aging 'gyur bcas par bya/ /zhi rgyas gnyis la rdor dril nang / /dbang 43— 1311

drag rdor dril phyir bskor bsil 7/ /ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od//ma rig 'dod pa'i bdud khams thams cad sreg /sprin gnyis 'thabs bzhin khro gnyer brjid pa'i zhal/ /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad 'joms//dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i bgegs kyi mtha' gnon pa'i/ /khro bo'i rgyal po dug gsum 'joms mdzad pa/ /khams gsum sems can ngan 'go las sgol ba/ /mdog sngon rdo rje pad+ma zhags pa bsnams/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal sogs/ /me nyid sbyang ba'i las mdzod bzhugs/ /tishra badz+ra/khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /mtshan ma'i ming du bcas par bya/ /bkug nas rdo rje phur bus gdab/ /dum bur byas la tshogs la bstab/ /oṃ tre lokya bhe dza ya/ ki li a mṛ ta pa na tsa pū tsa swā hā / bde gshegs khro chen rnam par rgyal/ /thugs rje che dang bdag 'byel pas / /gzhal yas nyid du bzhugs nas kyang / /me nyid sbyang ba'i las bcol ba'o/ /de nas lag g.yas kha phar bstan/ /g.yon pa tshur bstan mkhrig ma snol/ /mjeb gnyis mthil bzhag sor brgyad bskyod/ /oṃ ki li ki li badz+ra pi ma la re'u tri pra tri ti/ ma hā kro dha/ badz+ra ya na dza ha kṛ na ta hūṃ phaṭa/sbyangs pa'i las ni lha tshogs kyi/ /mdun du bya bar yang dag bshad/ /de nas dkon mchog gsum po ste/ /sbyang dang spyan 'dren gdan dag dang / /mchod pa la sogs rnam rgyal bzhin/ /mgon po thugs rje cher ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho bzhi/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /43—1312

dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing / /gcig du don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab du gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan bzhi/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum po yi/ /zhi ba la sogs grub par gsol/ /bde bar gshegs so dkon mchog gsum/ /khyed kyis byams pa'i las kun mdzad/ /dang ba'i yid kyis bskyed pa yi/ /gzhal yas nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e ga a gra ma ya hi ga tsa/ /me lha gnyis min spyan drang ba'i/ /mdun du ki lis me nyid sbyang / /de nas g.yas pa mthe bo yis—/ /mthe'u chung drung gtsugs g.yas nas ni/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis—/ /tshur gshegs zhes ni bos nas ni/ /dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ e bye hi ma hā byu ha de ba rik+shi/ tad dz+wa ma ni tri twa/ u ti ma hā ram̐①/ a smi sa ni/ to bha ba/ aghi ye/ a gad dza/ ha bya ka bya/ ma hā na ya swā hā/ de nas bzhugs par bya ba ni/ /lha yi drang srong kun dang ni/ /sreg sbyin bstabs par zhal ches pa/ /thugs rje dam tshig brtan pas ni/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /asne ye sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ tishra sa bha ba/ bi ga tip+ta/ dzi ba le hi ta ag sha di pa ya shudha swā hā/ phyag zhal bsil ba byas nas ni/ /gnyis min drang srong me lha la/ /shag te'u la sogs bdun gsum 'bul/ /oṃ ram̐ ram̐ asne ye ha bya ka bya ti bya na ya pū tsa na swā hā/ du pe pu spe a lo ke gan de snyu tsa pan tsa swā hā/ de nas rdo rje dril bur bcas/ /'ging gyur bcas la bstod pa ni/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs la bskyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis 43—1313

skur sprul pa/ /rig pa grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs sregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thabs ldan pa/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs/ /bgrang phreng 'dzin cing rig sngags gsung / /bdud rtsi bcud ldan gun+de bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /asne chen po'i thugs dam bzhin/ /me nyid ye shes mer byin rlobs/ /las kyi lha rnams mchod pa yisasti/ /sreg rdzas stobs pa'i las mdzod bzhugs/ /shing rta gcig la bzhugs gsol la/ /phyogs mtshams lha la bskor zhing mchod/ /asne ye ging ka ra pū tsa tirja/ las kyi lha rnams mchod pa yi/ /me sbyang spyan drang gdan dbul bsil/ /las brtan phyag 'tshal mchod bstod dgu/ /snang stong mchod rten chos nyid mkha'/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam dag sgu/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la'o/ /sra brtan rdo rje gzugs brnyan sa/ /me long ye shes thugs kyi sku/ /sa gnon chen po phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal sems dpa' mi bskyod la'o/ /sreg byed rin chen yig 'bru me/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan sku/ /mchod sbyin chen po phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal 'byung ldan dpal khyod la'o/ /dgyes 'dzin pad+ma phyag mtshan chu/ /kun rtog ye shes gsung gi sku/ /chos sgogs chen po phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la'o/ /shugs bskyod rgya gram sku ste rlung / /nan tan ye shes 'phrin las sku—/ /skyabs sbyin chen po phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o//43—1314

baṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du bhel bsdebs bskyod/ /bcings 'gyur bskyod pas phyogs bcur g.yo/ /thams cad g.yo bla med par 'gyur—/ /shan ting ku ru swā hā/ dngul lam dkar po'i shing rnams la/ /mgo bo rgya 'dud ①rtse zlum po/ /ngos su lha rnams 'khor bcas bsgom/ /btab na gdug rtsub zhi bar 'gyur/ /ki li ki li shan ting ku ru swā hā/ ma mo rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lha yi grub pa bsgom byas te/ /byams bcas zhi ba'i tho ba yis/ /brdungs pas gdug rtsub zhi bar 'gyur/ /sham pa ta shan ting ku ru swā hā/ dngul phye 'bras mchan dkar po la/ /'o mas sbyar ba'i gtor ma yis/ /thams cad ma lus bsgom byas nas/ /gtor bas gdug rtsub zhi bar 'gyur/ /sparna shan ting ku ru swā hā/ las rnams bya ba'i don bstan pa/ /bdag nyid byams pa chen po can/ /dkyil 'khor ho khung mchod rdzas 'tshogs/ /dkar po nyid du bsgom dang bya/ /lha rnams thams cad dkar po ste/ /sku yi gzi 'bar yon tan brjid/ /thams cad kun kyang 'tsher zhing zhi/ /byams par bcas pa'i lag pa nas/ /gtong ba thams cad byang chub sems/ /rgyun la 'chad par kun khyab bsgom/ /drang bas zhi gyur phur bus rgyas/ /brdung pas dbang mdzad gtor bas drag /de ni spyi yi las su gsungs/ /phyogs bcu'i gdug pa ma lus kun/ /gdug pa'i sems ni rab bor te/ /lha ni dkar po'i 'od du 'gyur/ /bde ldan byang chub 'od 'phro 'bar/ /'jig rten gtum dang 'das gtum dang / /'bru lnga byams dang ldan par byas na ni/ /gsol ba gdab par bya ba ni/ /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin dri za grul/ /lto 'phye dang ni nam mkha' lding dang 'dab/ /lus 43—1315

srul srin po gdon kyi rigs rnams dang / /sa 'am mkha' la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams/ /de rnams sdug bsngal zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /dad byams yid kyis lha rnams mchod byas te/ /lha yi byin brlabs sprul pa'i 'phro 'du yis/ /las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /na ma sa man ta bu ta nan/ oṃ a/ ma hā shan ting ka tang shan ting / ka ra bra sha ma dha ra nir dza ta/ a bha ba/ dhar ma satwa/ pra ba ta shan ting shi baṃ ku ru swā hā/ de ba shān ting ku ru swā hā/ na ga shaṃ ting ku ru swā hā/ rak+ṣa shan ting ku ru swā hā/ yag sha shan ting ku ru swā hā/ kri ha shan ting ku ru swā hā/ gung hing gung hing shan ting ku ru swā hā ra tang ra tang pra tang pra tang shan ting ku ru swā hā/ na bir lan shan ting ku ru swā hā/ bi ha sa nan tan shan ting ku ru swā hā/ si pa ra na shan ting ku ru swā hā/ na mo be+e shan ting ku ru swā hā/ a dz+re su tri pri du shan ting ku ru swā hā/ kram ka ri kram ka ri shan ting ku ru swā hā/ mi tsi mi tsi/ ra ra dhī dhī/ gi gi hūṃ hūṃ/ā+oṃ ā+oṃ/ e e/ a ra lan shan ting ku ru swā hā/ shri du ran mi tra shan ting ku ru swā hā/ de nas las sbyar rnam rgyal thabs/ /phyag mtshan nam mkhar phyar nas ni/ /gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /'jig rten khams ni ram sti'abyam kun/ /skad cig yud la zhi mdzad de/ /zhi bar gyur pas dbyings su rol—/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /dad pa'i yid kyis bskyed pa yi/ /gzhal yas nyid du re zhig gshegs/ /slar yang 'gro ba'i don la dgongs—/ /de bzhin lha tshogs mang po kun/ /go rim de bzhin las bya'o/ /ma yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tsher ba la/ /43—1316

snying rje dga' bas mchod byas nas/ /las rnams brtsam par byas nas ni/ /tshe dang longs spyod dpal 'phel 'gyur/ /pu steng ku ru swā hā/ ya yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tsher ba la/ /dga' chags yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /las rnams brtsam par byas nas ni/ /thams cad ma lus dbang du 'gyur/ /e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tsher ba la/ /btang snyoms khros pas mchod sbyin bya/ /las rnams brtsam par byas nas ni/ /thams cad ma lus rlag par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rgyud las 'byung ba'i las/ /sdig pa bsreg dang tshe 'phel ho/ /bsrung dang ro sreg bsgrub pa kun/ /cha shas tsam du bstan pa ni/ /hūṃ gi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /ye shes tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /haṃ gi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /ram gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /dkyil 'khor ā+oṃ ma tshad bstan pa/ /gsang gsum dkyil 'khor tha ma 'bring / /rab ni bcu gnyis dgu dang bdun/ /khru gang thams cad sgo gang bya/ /yan lag thams cad tshad bstan pa/ /de khru gang nas brtsams nas ni/ /ji srid dpag tshad thug gi bar/ /'dul ba'i dbang gi khyad par gyis/ /yang na tshad ni nges pa sked/ /ho khung tha ma 'bring dang rab/ /khru gang khru do khru gsum ni/ /'byor pa'i dbang bya pad zla gam/ /gru gsum ngang ni 'khor lo'i rtsibs /brgyad pa'i steng du zla ba'i 'od/ /dkar po dgod de dbus rdo rje/ /rtse lnga shar lho rin chen lho/ /nub tu pad+ma byang rgya gram/ /de steng kha 'khor sor bzhi rdo rje ra/ /sems dpa' sems pad+ma khong yon/ /'jig rten pa ni ci rigs mdzes par bya/ /nub phyogs 'dug ste zhi las bya/ /bram ze'i khyim du yang 43—1317

dag bshad/ /lho phyogs rgyas pa nub dbang bya/ /byang du drag po ho du bshad/ /dkyil 'khor drung ngam yang na ni/ /grong khyer phyi rol rje'u rigs dang / /rgyal rigs smad 'tshong smig ma khyer/ /sngags pa nub dang lho shar lho/ /'dug la mchod pa'i don dag ni/ /gang gi gtso dang thabs dang ni/ /shes rab tshul du ldan pa'i don/ /ho ma khung gi bye brag kyang / /de ci rigs par bya bar bshad/ /de la sogs te gtso yum ni/ /khung gi mthil du lhag par dgod//me 'od ngos la rdo rje kha/ /'khor rnams phyi rol yang dag dgod/ /ro sreg maṇ+ḍal khru bcu gnyis/ /khru bzhi pa na khru do zabs/ /brkos pa'i dbus su 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad pa la'ang byang chub kyi/ /mchod rten kun rig phyag rgya sogs/ /rigs bzhi dang ni yum bzhi yi/ /de mtha' rdo rje rtse lngas bskor—/ /kha la me 'od bri bar bya/ /de mtha' pad+ma 'dab ma la/ /sems dpa' skal bzang la sogs rnams/ /bri bya gru la lha mo bri/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams kyang / /phyi rim phyogs phyogs dag du bri/ /gzhung dang 'gal byas nyes sdog bshad/ /sdig pa chen po bskur btab yin/ /ston pa'i bstan pa dge ba'i las/ /pha ma mkhan po slob dpon dang / /mched dang lcam dral rnam lnga yis/ /dge ba mi dge dge mi dge/ /rgyas pa'i las la bskur ba yin/ /sdig can de ni mi thar zhes/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i thub pas gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor 'jug 'dzud byed pa'i phyir/ /ri mo 'am ni de bzhin bzhan①/ /ci bgyi tshad med bzhi bsgoms te/ /sha dang chang dang sgog btsong dang / /rku dang bud med spyad byas na/ /de ni yan lag bskur btab yin/ /de la bshags pa byar yod thabs/ /ci bzhin dam la gnas byas sam/ /theg chen 43—1318

sde la mchod byed na/ /sdig can de ni myur du 'grol/ /pha ma bsad dang phrogs bcom dang / /chos kyi mkhan po bsad pa dang / /dam tshig lung dang shes rab rgyud/ /man ngag dbang gi slob dpon gsum/ /snying nas smad cing bsad pa dang / /theg chen sde la gnas pa yi/ /mched dang lcam dral dbyen byas shing / /dam las log cing 'khus pa ni/ /de ni mtshams me lnga zhes bya/ /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra bar/ /las bzhi sdig sreg byas bcug na/ /sdig can de yang myur du 'grel/ /sngags dang phyag rgya yig 'bru rnams/ /lhag dang chad par byas pa ni/ /de dang nye ba'i sdig pa yin/ /ci phyir dbyings dang rnam thar gyi/ /sgo rnams gzhan du gyur pas na/ /bskal par brjod kyang dngos grub ni/ /thob par mi 'gyur dpa' bos gsungs/ /shes bya'i sdig pa thams cad ni/ /mi shes sdig las bcu 'gyur che/ /shes bya'i sdig bshags thams cad la/ /'bum lnga dag gis 'byang ngo zhes/ /tsha tsha bskor ba phyag dang ni/ /srog 'don mdo sde lnga dag la/ /'bum 'bum dag du gsungs pa yin—/ /de nas sdom la gnas pa yi/ /mtshams med lnga la sogs pa yi/ /sdig can de dag rnams dang ni/ /skad cig yud tsam smra mi bya/ /shes nas dam tshig gang nyams pa/ /de yi sdig pa brjod mi lang / /gso la nye bar mi brtson na/ /de dag dang yang smra mi bya/ /skad cig yud tsam smras pas kyang / /don gyi dngos po gang yin yang / /dmag la sogs don gcig pa bzhin/ /de yi bshags pa rgyud lngas so/ /pus 'gros thal 'bud tsher lcag dang / /'greng phyar srog sdom dag gis so/ /lhag dang chad pa'i kha skong ni/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po mnyes pa dang / /tshe rabs slob dpon pha ma dang / /slob 43—1319

—ma'i sdig zhi dbang bskur dang / /mtha' yas sems can don byas pas/ /de yi sdig pa nges 'byang ngo / /ho ma bzhi yi gtso bo gang / /bsreg rdzas bdun gsum nyi shu gcig /mnyes par bya phyir dbul bar bya/ /de nas tshe rabs slob dpon don/ /dkon mchog gsum la dus gsum gsum/ /dbul ba nyid du bya bar bshad/ /tshe rabs pha ma'i don gyi phyir/ /rigs kyi gtso bo rnams la'o/ /de nas slob ma rim gyis ni/ /bgegs bsal phyir ni spos chus bkru—/ /de nas g.yon phyogs tsog pur bzhag /lag g.yas slob dpon lag g.yon gyi/ /byams par bcas pas bzung nas ni/ /gtso bo dag gi sngags bdun bzlas/ /de nas sdig pa zad bya'i phyir/ /rigs yum lnga la bdun bdun no/ /de yis dbang bskur bsrung bar 'gyur/ /mtha' yas sems can kun don du/ /lha rnams kun la dbul bar bya/ /de dag bkra shis bya ba'i phyir/ /yum bzhi gzungs kyi bya ba ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan ni tshim byed ma/ /dbang po zhi ba zla ba 'dra/ /bstod tshig gis bskul sngags brjod bya/ /de nas bshags pa gus par bya/ /de nas sngags pas phyogs phyogs nas/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa/ te no pa tiṣ+ṭha z-i ①ḍho me bha ba/su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba sarba sidhidz+re pra yats+tsha/sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ/ shri yoḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga ban/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me/ muñca/ badz+ra bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya/ satwa aḥ/rigs lngar dbye zhing brjod nas ni/ /skar ma rab rib mar me dang / /sgyu ma zil ba chu bur dang / /rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bur/ /'dus byas chos kun de ltar lta/ /de ltar bsdu ba byas nas bzhag /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po 43—1320

la bltas te/ lhag pa'i mchod pa dbul/ /e ma bdag nyid slob bcas pa'i//dri zhim ngo bo thams cad kun/ /sngon 'das dpyid kyi du per ni/ /byin rlabs ①mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol/ /de bi du pe pu tsa ho/ /e ma bdag nyid slob bcas pa'i/ /dbyibs legs mjos pa thams cad kun/ /da ltar dbyar gyi pus per ni/ /byin brlabs mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol/ /de byi puspe pu tsa ho/ e ma bdag nyid slob bcas pa'i/ /gsal dro ngo bo thams cad kun/ /byon ma rag ston a lo ke/ /byin brlabs mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol / /de bi a lo ke pu tsa ho/ /e ma bdag nyid slob bcas pa'i/ /brlan bcas dri zhim thams cad kun/ /ma byon dgun gyi gan der ni/ /byin brlabs mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol/ /de byi gan de pu tsa ho/ /de ②ltar mchod nas skyabs gsol ba/ /dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas rten nyid de/ /rnam dag sku las ting 'dzin dag pa'i sku/ /sprul sku phyag rgya mtshon pa'i lha tshogs kyis/grags pas 'jig rten gsum bkang lham me ba/ /mgon po mchog nyid la ni skyabs su mchi/ /smra bsam brjod med gsung gi sprul pa'i tshogs/ /mtshan nyid so so'i ye shes kun ston pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum / /dam chos mdo sde bzhi la skyabs ①su mchi/ /rab tu lam stor 'khor bar mig zum pa'i/ /'gro ba bskyabs med rnams kyi pha ma mdzad/ /'phrin las bzhi yis rtse gcig don mdzad gtso/ /theg chen dge 'dun tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /de nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gus dang bcas pas phyag byas mchod/ /gtsang zhing gtsang mar bshams pa'i rdzas/ /khrus chab bdug spos ma dri bshos/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /thugs 43—1321

rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /na mas sa man+ta bud dha nan/ /ga ga na sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ bi sho bi shud dhe swā hā/ na mas sa man+ta bud dha nan/dharma twa ṭ+wā nā nu ga te swā hā/ na mabe+e man+ta bud dha nan/ ma hā man+t+ra buṅka te swā hārka/ na mabe+e man+ta bud dha nan/ dartsi pa ra na/ a ga ga sa ga ga ge ne 'u da ra ya swā hā/ na mam man+ta bud dha nan/ bhi shud dhe garnyor+bha ba ya swā hā/ na masma man+ta bud dha nan/ a ra ra/ sa ra ra/ ka ra ra/ ba lo ti①/ ma ni swā hā/ snang stong mchod rten chos nyid mkha'/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam dag sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par mdzad la'o—/ /de lta bu'i yon tan bcas pa la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' byams pa'i mchod—/ /spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa 'phro/ /gtsug tor rgyal ba'i gdugs kyis khebs/ byams pa thabs dang shes rab kyi/ /badz+ra dhu pa'i sdemachod pas rol—/ /rin chen 'byung ldan snying rje'i mchod/ /ut+pal mthing ga me tog 'thor—/ /rin chen zla gam dbyings su sbyor/ /snying rje thabs dang shes rab kyi—/ /rat+na puṣ+pe'i mchod pas rol/ /snang ba mtha' yas dga' ba'i mchod/ /dpal gyi sgron ma phyag na bsnams/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan rab 'bar 'dzugs/ /dga' ba'i thabs dang shes rab kyis/ /pad+ma ā lo'i mchod pas rol/ /don yod grub pa'i btang snyoms mchod/ /tsan dan bdud rtsi'i char 'be+ebs ma/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i thig ler 'be+ebs/ /spos spor thabs dang shes rab kyis—/ /karma gan+ta'i mchod pas rol/ /de ltar rigs la nye ba'i gzungs/ /mchod pa phul ba'i lan dag du/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rtogs pa'i yul/ /dung mdog sgeg mo rdo rje 'dzin/ /sems 43—1322

dpa' dkar ba ①ye shes 'be+ebs/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes la/ /badz+ra la se'i mchod pas rol/ /rin chen 'byung ldan mnyam pa'i yul/ /yid bzhin rin chen gtsug 'bar ma/ /'jam dpal rnon po'i dngos grub 'dzin/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la/ /rat+na ma le'i mchod pas rol/ /snang ba mtha' yas mkhyen pa'i yul/ /pad+ma dbyangs mkhan rma bya'i mgrin/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi shes rab bskyed/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la/ /pad+ma girti'i mchod pas rol—/ /don yod grub pa las kyi yul/ /gar mkhan 'gying ma gzi dang ldan//las kyi 'khor lo rnam par sgyur/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes la/ /karma nirti'i mchod pas rol/ /de ltar gzungs kyi mchod byas nas/ /rigs bzhi tshad med bsdu ba bzhi/ /mchod phyir dpal kyis gsungs pa'o/ /sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rtags/ /byams pa chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba rnam dag la/ /badz+ra a gu sha'i mchod pas rol/ /don mthun phun sum tshogs pa'i rtags—/ snying rje chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /rin chen phyag rgyas shes pa la/ /rat+na pa sha'i mchod pas rol/ /don spyad phun sum tshogs pa'i rtags/ /dga' ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /ye ①shes rab sgrol mas mdzad pa la/ pad+ma spo ta'i mchod pas rol/ /snyan pa phun sum tshogs pa'i brtags①/ /btang snyoms chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /chos sten chen pos kun rig la/ /karma gadhe'i mchod pas rol/ /de ltar tshad med mchod byas nas/ /rigs rnams byin gyis zlobs pas mchod/ /zhe sdang ma skyes rdo rje dam tshig ma/ /ye shes me long pha rol phyin pa'i ngang / /gnyis med rgyas 'debs drin ④ldan phyag rgya ma/ /satwa badz+ra dbyings phyug mchod pas rol/ /nga rgyal bdag med rin chen dam 43—1323

tshig ma/ /ye shes mnyam nyid pha rol phyin pa'i ngang / /mi 'gyur rmongs byed drin ①ldan phyag rgya ma/ rat+na badz+ra dbyings phyug mchod pas rol/ /'dod chags mi dmigs chos kyi dam tshig ma/ /ye shes kun rtogs pha rol phyin pa'i ngang / /mi rtog za byed dri ldan phyag rgya ma/ /pad+ma badz+ra dbyings phyug mchod pas rol/ /nga rgyal ma grub rgya gram dam tshig ma/ /ye shes nan tan pha rol phyin pa'i ngang / /mi skye tshe 'phel dri ldan phyag rgya ma/ /karma badz+ra dbyengs phyug mchod pas rol/ /de ltar byin brlabs mchod byas nas/ /rgyan kyi mchod par gsungs pa ni/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas ni/ /mchod gnas dam pa dpal kyi zhing / /yid du 'ong ba'i mchod sprin dang / /rol mo ṅgal snyan ②'phan gdugs dang / /bla re rgyal mtshan lhab lhub dang / /me tog 'phreng dang bdug spos sogs/ /mchod sprin sna tshogs phyogs bcur sprul/ /mchod sprin rig ①sngags bden pa dang / /nam mkha'i mdzod sngags ting 'dzin thugs—/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'byams su/ /mchod sprin sna tshogs klubs gyur cig /na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ na mo bha ga ba te/ badz+ra sā ra pra marda ne+e—/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyahūṃ bud dha ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā rbar+ya badz+re/ ma hā bo bye tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍi/ pra si kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa/ bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā—/ na mabe+erba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sadze+e thā khaṃ uṅga te/ spa ra ṇa i mo rjog ga na khaṃ swā hā/ de nas yum lnga las brtan mchod/ /shes rab dbyings phyug rigs yum lnga/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs la byin rlob cing / /thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhir gyur pas/ /'gro ba'i don rnams mdzad du gsol/ /43—1324

shes rab dbyings ma rigs kyi yum lnga ste/ /chos dbyings ye shes mkha' sogs gsal ba la/ /gsang chen bde ba'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ngang thabs ltar rol zhing brtan por bzhugs su gsol/ /yum rnams bdag la mchod thabs ni/ /bsgrub mchod bcu drug gzhung bzhin bya/ /bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad chen gyi/ /chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i yul/ /yum chen bhudha lo tsa na/thams cad zad par khas dbang bskur/ /bde gshegs kun gyi yum chen mo/ /phyag 'tshal kun tu bzang mo la'o/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' ⑨yi/ /me long ye shes chen po'i yul/ /yum chen badz+ra lo tsa na/ /thams cad zad par sas dbang bskur/ /rdo rje rigs gtso mang po'i yum/ /phyag 'tshal sangs rgyas spyan khyod la'o/ /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan gyis/ /mnyam nyid ye shes chen po'i yul/ /yum chen rat+na lo tsa na/ /thams cad zad par mes dbang bskur/ /rin chen rigs gtso mang po'i yum/ /phyag 'tshal na bza' kar mo la'o/ /bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /kun rtogs ⑤ye shes chen po'i yul/ /yum chen pad+ma lo tsa na/ /thams cad zad par chus dbang bskur/ /pad+mo'i rigs gtso mang po'i yum/ /phyag 'tshal mā ma tī nyid la'o/ /bcom ldan don yod grub pa yi/ /nan tan ye shes chen po'i yul/ /yum chen karma lo tsa na/ /thams cad zad par rlung dbang bskur/ /las kyi rigs gtso mang po'i yum/ /phyag 'tshal dam tshig sgol ma'o/ /de nas sems dpa' bcu drug kyang / /ci rigs pa 'am yang na ni/ /mtshan brgya ④rtsa brgyad pa yis mchod/ /de nas la se la sogs brgyad/ /phyi nang gnyis kyi lha mo dam tshig ma/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi ye shes gsal ba la/ /rol pa chen pos mchod pas gtso bo yi/ /43—1325

dgongs pa skongs la 'gro ba'i don rnams mdzod/ /ye shes dus bzhi gzugs nye gzungs/ /sprul sku 'khor bar mi ldog cing / /mya ngan 'das la mi chags pa'i—/ /don rnams mdzad cing brtan por bzhugs/ /rdo rje sgeg mo byang chub sems kyi ngang / /mchod sbyin smon byed gzi brjid 'bar zhing sdud/ /mdog dkar ①gser gyi khu tshur skur rten te/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje smon byed sgeg mo la'o/ /rin chen dpal phreng gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin/ /yid bzhin mchog 'byung gzi brjid 'bar zhing skor/ /sngo bsangs rin chen phreng bas re 'dod skongs/ /phyag 'tshal bdud rtsi char 'be+ebs phreng ba la'o pad+ma dbyangs mkhan gsung rab rgya mtshor sgrogs/ /snyan pas yid 'phrog gzi brjid 'bar ldan skongs/ /mdog dmar gser gyi pi bang phyag na bsnams/ /phyag 'tshal thabs kyis yid 'phrog gir ti la'o/ /las kyi gar mkhan 'phrin las rgya mtsho sgrol/ /gzugs mdzes skyod pas rol mo phyogs bcur mdzad/ /mdog ljang sna tshogs skur ston gzi brjid 'bar/ /phyag 'tshal yid 'ong mdzes bskyod ni rti la'o/ /spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa 'phro/ /kun tu tshim byed dri bsung thim—/ /mthon skya gser gyi bog phor bsnams/ /phyag 'tshal rnam dag bdug pa la'o/ /bltas mdzes rin chen phung po 'phro/ /byang chub yan lag me tog rgyan—/ /mthong ting me tog gzhong du ②bsnams/ /phyag 'tshal skyon med me tog la'o/ /'od gsal 'phros pas kun tu khyab/ /gti mug thibs po sel mdzad pa/ /dmar skya chos kyi mar me bsnams/ /phyag 'tshal sgron 'bar mar me la'o/ /tsan dan bdud rtsi char 'be+ebs ma/ /bdud rtsi bsil dro 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ljang sngon dung phor phyag na bsnams/ /phyag 'tshal reg bya dri 43—1326

chu la'o/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i bskal bzangs dang / /phyogs skyong bcu dang bkra shis brgyad/ /rdo rje lcags kyu 'gugs byed dang / /rin chen zhags pa gsol ka dang / /pad+ma lcags sgrog pho nya'i las/ /rgya gram dril bu shes rab mchog /dpe med rgyas ①sras rang rgyal dang / dgra bcom rgyal chen lha chen dang / /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding / /mi 'am ci dang lho 'phye tshe/ /sa bdag gza' skar rigs 'dzin dang / /srin po log 'dren sha za dang / /rgyu drug ngag gi mthu can sogs/ /thams cad ci rigs pa yis mchod/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po de nyid kyis/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi ting 'dzin zhugs/ /lce thog ②a las zla dkyil te/ /oṃ bsgoms rdo rje ye shes bsam—/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bsgoms nas ni/ /chos kyi phyag rgya can kyis ni/ /slob ma de la bshad par bya/ /oṃ dharma/ hūṃ dharma/ tram̐ dharma/ hri dharma/ a dharma—/ sa ma ya snya/ dharma/ ya na ya swā dharma/ a ho su ka dharma/ sa du sa du/ su pa haṃ/ swā dharma/ ru bo te te dharma/ a rta pra ba ti dharma/ha ha hūṃ ha dharma/ sarba ka ri dharma/ du ka tshe da dharma/ bu da sgo di dharma/ pra ti shab ta dharma/ su ba shing tram̐ dharma/ ni pa ya ༈ dharma/ shud tru bak+ka dharma/sarba sing dha dharma/ ma ha ra ti dharma/ ru ba sho be+e dharma/ shu rod tra be'u dharma/sarba bu rtse dharma/ pra ha ta ni dharma/ pra te dharma/ tsa gri dharma/ su gan dang gi dharma/ a ya hi dza dza dharma/ a ya hi hūṃ hūṃ dharma/ ho spo ta bo bo dharma/gan dha a a dharma/ de ltar lha tshogs sku gsung thugs/ /dkyil 'khor gang yin thams cad kyi/ so sor snying po tha mar ni/ dharmas btags la brjod pas ni/ /lha rnams thugs dgongs dngos grub stsol/ /kun rdzob dang ni don 43—1327

dam gyi/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya/ /sdom pa yi ni dam tshig dang /dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang / /sems can don byar bcas pa yi /rnam pa gsum dang ldan par bshad/ /rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgyar bcas/ /oṃ badz+ra ka ba tsa rak+ka a ti ti sta ho/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyis brlab/ /ka ya oṃske/ bag saṃ/ tsi ta hūṃ/ 'khor lo phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags/ /bar du gcod pa gsal bar bya/ /oṃ snyo na tsakra phaṭa/ nga yis bshad phog thams cad ni—/ /dam pas gsungs pa'i tshig yin pas/ /khyod kyang de las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma a dz+retha a/ byang chub rigs ①can nyid du ni/ /sngags ni brjod pas gyur pa'o/ /oṃ sgo dhi tsi ta a si ④me/ tri sa ma me/ ma ha sa ma ya swā hā/ hūṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ/gsum pa dkyil 'khor mjug gzhug pa/ /slob dpon zhugs dang slob ma gzhug /gshegs dang lhag chad kha bskang dang / /mthun par slar gshegs gsol ba dang / /las bzhi mchod nas bdag nyid kyis/ /dkyil 'khor sems kyis nam mkha' la/ bteg nas byang chub sems kyis ni/ /zhugs pa nyid du thub pas gsungs/ /bdug spos lag du thogs nas su/ /blo gros ldan pas lha rnams la/ gus pas gsol ba legs par gdab/ /de 'og sgo bzhi dbye bar bshad/ /zhugs lha gnyis su med bsgoms la/ /'gro ba drang ba'i las bya'o/ /bcom ldan nam mkha'i sangs rgyas kun/ /thugs rje chen po mthu ldan lags/ /bdag nyid rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan ltas/ /bdag la dbang mchog 'dir spyod cig /dkyil 43—1328
