'khor la ni 'khor lor bshad/ /de nyid dam tshig yin par bshad/ /sangs rgyas bka' yi dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'jug lags na/ /dkyil 'khor bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /bdag la byen gyis brlab du gsol/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /bsod nams can du bdag nyid 'gyur—/ /sngon gyi las kyis 'byel ba lags/ /thugs rjes sras su dgongs par mdzod/ /at+ma ko haṃ/ maṇ+ḍal ①sarba a be+e sha swa bhā ba/ rdo rje mdzub sogs legs par ni/ /sbyar la bkan te bsdebs nas su/ /khros nas rab tu dbye ba ni/ /sgo dbye ba yi mtshan nyid do/ /gnas rab sgo bzhi zhe sdang dang /nga rgyal 'dod chags phrag dog bzhis/ /sngon med dus nas bcad lags na/ /tshad med bsdu brgyad rigs bzhi yis/ thugs rje thabs la sprul pa yi/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dang / /dril bu phyag rgya'i mchog nyid kyis/ /ding nyid thar sgo dbye ru gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma/ kro da ga dod sa ma ya tsa twa ra/ pra be+e sha shi gran mā ra ya/ hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas bdag rdo rje rin chen dang / pad+ma rgya gram shugs kyis ni/ /rab tu gal te zhugs nas ni/ /gnyis su med par sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /snying rjes slob ma la sogs la/ /lha mo sprul sras bsgom byas drang / /de nas sngags g.yog dag gis ni/ /slob ma'i las rnams brtson bya ba/ /phyag 'tshal gsol 'jug khrus bkra shis/ /dam bca' me tog gtor mig dbye/ /slob dpon lan stsal lhas dbang bskur/ /dam tshig dpog dang dbang bskur dang / smon lam lha ngo bstan yon dbul/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'o/ /de nas shar sgo dag du ni/ /bdug spos lag tu thog lanas ni/ /shar phyogs mngon dga'i pho brang 'di'i/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 43—1329

sems la sogs/ /skal ldan rgyal sras dag pa zhig /ngag yid dang bas gus phyag 'tshal/ /lho phyogs dpal ldan pho brang 'di'i/ /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan sogs/ /skal ldan rgyal sras dag pa zhig /nub phyogs bde ldan pho brang 'di'i/ /bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas sogs/ /skal ldan rgyal sras dag pa zhig /byang phyogs rnam dag pho brang 'di'i/ /bcom ldan don yod grub pa sogs/ /skal ldan rgyal sras dag pa zhig /bcom ldan snying po'i pho brang 'di'i/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ /skal ldan rgyal sras dag pa zhig /ngag yid dang bas gus phyag 'tshal/ /bdag nyid dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje bla na med pa 'di/ /de ring bdag la dbab du gsol/ /bdag ni dam tshig rin chen ste/ /bdag ni dam tshig pad+mo ste/ /bdag ni dam tshig rgya gram ste/ /bdag ni dam tshig 'khor lo ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad yin par grags/ /'khor lo bla na med pa 'di/ /de ring bdag la dbab du gsol/ /shar phyogs mngon dga'i pho brang 'dir/ /bla med byang chub sems bskyed de/ /dngos grub dam pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis dad pas 'jug par bkyi/ /lho phyogs dpal ldan pho brang 'dir/ /nub phyogs bde ldan pho brang 'dir/ /byang phyogs rnam dag pho brang 'dir/ /bcom ldan snying po'i pho brang 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi①/ /phyogs su lta ba dgrol ba'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das la gnas par bgyi/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long yul/ /kun bzang phyag rgya'i bum pa ste/ /gnyis min byang chub sems rtags chus/ /zhe sdang rnam smin dag gyur cig /rin chen 'byung ldan mnyam shes yul/ /rna bza'i phyag rgya bum pa ste//43—1330

gnyis med byang chub sems rtags chus/ /nga rgyal rnam smin dag gyur cig /snang ba mtha' yas kun rtog yul/ /ma ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis min byang chub sems rtags chus/ /'dod chags rnam byun dag gyur cig /don grub nan tan ye shes yul/ /sgrol ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis min byang chub sems rtags chus/ /phrag dog rnam smin dag gyur cig /rnam snang chos dbyings ye shes yul/ /spyan gyi phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis min byang chub sems rtags chus/ /gti mug rnam smin dag gyur cig /mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i srid dang gti mug rnam sbyong ba/ /mgon po yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis dang / /dge mnyam bsam sems ldan pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa//bkra shis des ni deng 'dir zhi byed legs gyur shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rgyan gyis brgyan byas shing / /yang dag 'byor pa'i sbyin pas sbyin mdzad mi bslu ba/ /rin chen 'byung zhes bya ba'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bsam gtan dam pa ting 'dzin pha rol phyin gnas shing / /ye shes pad+ma'i steng bzhugs dpag med tshe ldan zhing / /tshe grangs med par byen gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /sems can don phyir las la thugs ni sbyor mdzad cing / /'gro ba thams cad bcings pa bcings las grol gyur pa/ /thub mchog don yod grub pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /rnam par snang mdzad ye shes dam pa mtsho chen ldan/ /zla ba nya 'dra sku mnga' srid pa'i mthar 'byin pa/ /dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir zhi byed legs gyur shog /yan ma gā lan shu ba sha man to sa ya dzin ta ka sha gye ag sho bya ra tsa/ bi shi na ta gye/ sarba ku na/ rma ga la su/ ma ṇa oṃ gā la da/43—1331

bha bha du shan te/ ka sa pra dz+nyā na ta ban/ du h+ye/ yan man dga' lan ma ni ku lan/ hi na bu ha ra/ pa pa du sha sha tsi na se ta/ no te ne+e/ ba stil na/pi pi pu ti na/ tan mang 'ga' lan/ bha bha du shan te/ ka ra na ba da na t+ya/yan mad 'ga' lan/ a ga ni/ a yur byed de sa gye/ ma ne+e pu ra ta la ya sa gye/ 'ga' rna badz+ra/ pa ri ga te/ sa gye/ ta thā ga te④/ ya mi/tan mang 'ga' lan/ bha bha du shan te/ kar na r+ya phaṭa/ kyai yan man 'ga' lan/ ma ma mu ne+e/ ba ra sha gye①/ ka a mo ka sid ti/ swā twa ta ra kar ma na ne+e/ bu da sha ba narjo/ sha ta la gye/ yo tsi ta man sa sa gye/mun sa gye/ bhan dha bhan dha bhan dha me bya/ tan man 'ga' lan/ bha bha du shan te/ kar rna ta t+ya⑤/ yan mang 'ga' lan sa ga la pu rarna/ ma to ra ta sa gye/ be ro tsa na gye/ ba rata nyani/ ma ha rarna ba se/ sa bu ra ra rna/tsa tra bu she/ hi ban da ka se/ tan mang 'ga' lan/ bha bha du shan te karna ta bad bye/ de la de bzhin gshegs gtso dang / /chos rnams kun la dbang bskur ro/ /rdo rje rigs gtso chen po dang / /khams gsum bdag por dbang bskur ro/ /rin chen rigs gtso chen po dang / /lha mis mchod par dbang bskur ro/ /pad+ma'i rigs gtso chen po dang / /chos kyi rgyal po chen por dbang bskur ro/ /las kyi rigs gtso chen po dang / /las bzhis gzhan don spyod dbang bskur/ /bkra shis brjod pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'jig rten dag tu mi rnams kun/ /grags pa rnams spel bgegs kyang med/ /sems nyid bder 'gro des byed la/ /mthar yang nges pa kho nar ni/ /zhi ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /de nas dam bca' bya ba ni/ /dpa' bo chen po 43—1332

rgyud dag las/ /sdom pa chen po legs par blang bar bya/ /je la sdom pa'i yon tan ni/ /dang pos sdom pas rgyud gnyis sbyang / tha ma'i sdom pas lha min sbyong / /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma yi/ /sdom pa yis ni ngan 'gro spyod/ /de bas sdom pa mnod pa mchog /de 'og dam bca' yang dag bya/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed brtan par gzung / /de ni spyi yi tshul khrims so/ rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril dang phyag rgya dang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin nam dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /pad+ma rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsumarka/ /dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /ding nas brtsams te gzung bar barmi/ /nam du yang ni mi spong ngo / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus gzung / /de nas shar sgo gnas pa de/ /na bza' stod smad dar dmar dkri/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya 'char/ /btsug ①la lag du rin chen dang / /me tog phreng ba la sogs thogs/ /gdong g.yogs dar dkar gyis g.yogs nas/ /a sa me tri sa me/ ma ha ②sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a ti tishā hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ sngon gyi tshe rabs grangs med nas/ /dge ba'i las kyis 43—1333

bsnyen pa'i lha/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gang yin pa/ /da lta nyid du bab par shog /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas kyang / /'gro la phan pa'i gtso chen gyis/ /sman par dgongs nas bzhes su gsol—/ /oṃ badz+ra pra ti kṛ ha na hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra ti tsa sa ma ya sa sto/ bo di tsi ta pu tsa ho/ me tog rin chen la sogs pa/ /gang las bab pa rigs kyi lha/ /gtso bo'i rigs de bsgrubs nas ni/ dngos grub myur de the tshom ①med/ /de nas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ /rin chen lhar bcas blangs nas ni/ /slob ma'i spyir bzhag thim gyur nas/ /mi gnyis gcig pa'i lhar bsams nas/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya/ dz+re tha ya me/ oṃ ā hūṃ/ a bhi shin tsa a/ da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /khyod ni theg chen 1'di nyid la/ /gsang ba chen po'i snod du 'gyur/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /thob pa mnyam med de ring thob/ /dam tshig gong 'og ma 'da' zhig /bla med byang chub chen po thob/ /oṃ badz+ra ha song ga ta ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra be+e sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ slob dpon lan gnyis dbyangs sbyar te/ rdo rje phyag rgya bcas la/ nga yi dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med 'di/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya a bye shin tsa a a/ nga ni dam tshig rin chen te/ /nga ni dam tshig pad+ma ste/ /nga ni dam tshig rgya gram ste/ /nga ni dam tshig 'khor lo ste/ /snying po 'khor lo yin par grags/ /'khor lo ye shes bla med 'di/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya—/ /oṃ rabe+e pad+ma karma tsakra/ a sgyi shin tsa a a/ sa ma ya dz+re tha/'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam las 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam 43—1334

tshig srungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi chu yis 'grub/ /ji ste dam tshig 'das na ni/ /de ma thag du bkas nas gshegs/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /bdun rgyud rigs ni rlag par mdzad/ /de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang / /sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka' / /shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsang mi bya / /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /brdzun dang 'dod la spyod pa rnams/ /dngos 1grub 'dod pas bya ba min/ /chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing / /sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya/ /sems can gnod par sbyor ba ni/ /nam yang bya ba ma yin te/ /dkon mchog gsum ni yong mi spang / /dus kun tu ni byang chub sems / /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang / lha dang bla ma de bzhin no/ /sdig la sogs pa gang yin dang / /bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /lha la phul ba'i snying po dang / /de yi grib mar 'gom mi bya/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang de bzhin no/ /sngags dang lha la smad mi bya/ /gdon gyi la sogs bya ba min / /myu stegs can la'ang smad mi bya/ /mdor na yid gnyis dogs mi bya//bdag gi de nyid sngags dang ni/ /thams cad 'dra bas de bzhin no/ /de nas dbang mchog bskur ba ni/ /ba gci slob ma'i phyogs dag tu/ /khru gang ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bri/ tshon ni dmar pos legs bris la/ /bkra shis brgyad kyi phyag rgya 'god/ /dbu rgyan cod pan me tog phreng / /phyag rgya bzhi dang rin chen bdun/ /gser byas thur ma 'khor me long / /dung dang bkra shis ras thog bzhag /bdug spos ram sar gdugs sham can/ /rnga yab bsil yab zho phor gang / bum pa bzhi sogs mi 43—1335

res gzung / /mchod pa la sogs bkra shis brjod/ /oṃ bri ta bri ta sarba a ra na ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tra tha tra tha sarba a ba ra na ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bi tra bi ① tra ba sarba a pa twad twa na ni hūṃ phaṭa/ sku gsung thugs su byin kyis brlab/ de nas thur ma me long dung / /'khor lo rtsa ba'i yig 'brus bskur/ /phreng ba bum pa nyan pa dang / /gsang sngags phyag rgya cod pan dang / /'khor sgyur mi dbang dbu rgyan dang / /las dang bcu'i gzungs rje'o/ /bcu gsum sa ni non dbang bskur/ /'khor lo rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /sa bcu kun la dbang ba dang / /theg pa mtha' dag ston pa yi/ /chos kyi rgyal po chen por shog /glang po rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /theg pa kun kyi don rtogs nas//stobs bcu kun la dbang thob nas/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob par shog /rta mchog rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi'i dbang thob nas/ /nyon mongs rgya mtsho brgal ba yi/ /thar pa'i 'bras bu thob par shog /nor bu rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /'jig rten dag tu de bzhin gshegs/ /dpe byad mtshan kyis brgyan pa yi/ gser kyi sku mdog thob par shog /dmag mi rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /mi 'jigs bzhi yi dbang thob nas/ /bas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i/ /go cha chen po bgos par shog /blon po rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dbang phyug rje/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i brgya byin gyi/ /lha yi rgyal po thob par shog /btsun mo rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /—shes rab yum gyi dbang thob cing / /skye 'gag med pa'i don rtogs nas/ /bla med 'bras bu thob par shog /de bzhin gshegs pas byin brlabs pa'i/ /nyon mongs sel ba'i grub rdzas dpa' bo 'di/ /bar chad kyebagegs kyi tshogs 43—1336

rnams rnam 'jig cing / /dngos grub mchog thob ding 'dir bkra shis shog /ji ltar lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtswa mchog pu da na//du rba'i gdan la sdogs nas bdud btul ltar/ /ding 'dir bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /ji ltar sngon gyi drang srong a gastes/ byen gyis brlabs pa'i phyugs kyi dngos grub 'di/ /khyim bdag dbang phyug che la byin pa yi / /skye dgu'i sos gyur bcud ldan bkra shis shog /rdo rje dang ni rin chen chu skyes dang / /de bzhin las kyi sems dpa' dbang sgyur ba'i/ /li kris 'jin rten gsum po dbang bsdus shing / /dngos grub mchog thob ding 'dir bkra shis shog /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi chos kyi dung / /na ra ya nar dung sgra bsgrags pa ltar/ /bu khyod dam pa'i chos sgra rab sgrogs shing / /'gro ba 'dren mdzad ding 'dir bkra shis shog /chos rnams thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /smig rgyu lta bur yang dag rtog pa'i mthus/ /ma rig mun sel ye shes thob gyur nas/ /dngos grub mchog thob ding 'dir bkra shis shog /ji ltar glang po chen po a ga snyis/ /'gi'u 1wang srog gi dbang por gyur pa ltar//de bzhin bu khyod chos srog 'dzin gyur nas/ /dngos grub mchog thob ding 'dir bkra shis shog /ji ltar rgyu dang sa bon chung ngus las/ /'bras bu cher smin shing tog bibe+e ltar/ /de bzhin bsod nams rgyu tshogs chung ngus las/ /'bras/ bu bla med byang chub thob par shog /gtsug tor spyan ljags go chas bsgur//'a/ga gnyis bcings te gung gshibs bsgreng / /mdzub gnyis bkug sbyar gtsug tor ro/ /na ma sa man t+ta bud dha nan/ t+t+waṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ lag gnyis bcings te gung srin lag /brkyang ste mthe bo nang bcug mig /na ma sa man ta bud dha 43—1337

nan—/ ga ga na ba ra la k+ka na/ ga ru na ma ya/ ta thā ga ta tsak+ṣu swā hā/lag gnyis thal mo khong stong sbyar/ /mdzub gnyis dkris la srin lag gtug /mthe bong gnyis gshibs ljags su bshad/ /na ma sa man ta bud dha nan/ ta thā ga ta dzi hwa sarba dharma pra ti tishra/ lag pa gnyis ni khong stong sbyar/ /mdzub gnyis ngos nas dkris pa ni/ /go cha'i phyag rgya zhes su bshad/ /na ma sa man ta bud dha nan/ pra tsan dha badz+ra la ya bi ra hūṃ/ de nas slob ma'i thog dag du//gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ /theg chen chos kyi ngo bo ste/ /nyon mongs gdung ba sel byed pa'i/ /dbang mchog dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /sum cu rtsa lngas legs dbang bskur/ /de nas dag pa sgo bzhi nas/ /sgra yi rjes su legs sbyar zhing / /blo dang ldan pas smon lam gdab/ /shar phyogs bsgo ①la purba bsdu/ /sngon dang thog ma purba bsdu/ /de mthun rdo rje sems la sogs—/ /sgrib gnyis byang bas tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /de bzhin slob ma tshogs rdzogs nas/ /me long ye shes thob par shog /lho sgo da shi na bsdu'o/ /sbyin gnas la yang da shi bsdu'o/ /nub sgo bas tsi mas bsdu'o/ /phyi ma'i ma 'ongs pas cis bsdu/ /byang sgo u da ra mi bsdu/ /thugs rje gzungs la u da bsdu—/ /gong gi rigs dang ye shes 'dra/ /sngon gyi smon lam don bstan pa/ /dri ma med pa'i dpe bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lha dag kyang / /ci rigs par ni bstan par bya/ /tan+t+ra rgya mtsho dbyings kyi gting rum nas/ /don mchog cha shas btus pa'i nying khu ste/ /spyor ba'i lam rgyud phyogs 'ga' 'grel pa yis/ /mchog thob rnam snang mdzad kyi zhal mthong shog /rgya gar kyi mkhan po ste ra ma tis/ yo ga'i gzhung rgyud phyi nang las/ /nges don mdo 43—1338
—— —ju — —— — rngo dzā

deb zhe gsum pa/grung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe sdur dang dpe sgrig zhus/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/zhin hwa dpe tshong khang pe cin 'grem spel khang gis bkrams/bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi glog rdul rtsis 'khor khang gis par gzhi bsgrigs/grung go'i glog brnyan dpe sgrun khang par khang gis dpar btab/spyi lo 999pa'i 7par par gaji dang po bsgrigs/spyi lo 99blod 7par par zengs da po btab/dpar grangs/ byed ci2ya7—80057—308—7snu 200
